papers.title: Interpretation of Nanohertz Gravitational Waves via Cosmic Strings in Post-BBN Matter and Kination Domination
papers.abstract: Recent pulsar timing array (PTA) observations have reported evidence for a common low frequency signal consistent with a stochastic gravitational wave background. In this work, we investigate the cosmic string interpretation of this signal in a non-standard cosmological history between big bang nucleosynthesis and recombination, featuring an early matter-dominated era followed by a kination phase. Previous studies have shown that kination can significantly modify the cosmic-string-induced gravitational wave spectrum, generating characteristic features in the nanohertz range and producing a shape consistent with current PTA data. Building on this, we perform separate Bayesian analyses of the NANOGrav 15-year and EPTA DR2 New+ datasets to quantify the extent to which such a cosmological history is favored by the data. We find substantial evidence for a transient period of matter and kination domination over the standard cosmological history within a cosmic-string interpretation of the gravitational-wave signal, with a Bayes factor $3.63^{+0.22}_{-0.21}$ from the NANOGrav 15-year dataset, while leaving the inferred cosmic-string tension nearly unchanged. This cosmic-string-dominated scenario is particularly relevant if the contribution from supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) is small, as hinted at by astrophysical population simulations. Compared with a scenario where gravitational waves are produced purely by SMBHBs, cosmic-string interpretations with and without an additional contribution from SMBHBs, across both expansion histories and datasets, reveal no significant preference.

classification.title_zh: 通过后BBN时期物质主导与kination主导下的宇宙弦解释纳赫兹引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 近期脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）观测报告了与随机引力波背景一致的共同低频信号证据。本文在宇宙弦解释框架下研究该信号，考虑大爆炸核合成与复合之间一段非标准宇宙历史：早期物质主导阶段之后跟随kination阶段。已有研究表明，kination可以显著改变宇宙弦诱导的引力波谱，在纳赫兹频段产生特征，并形成与当前PTA数据一致的形状。在此基础上，我们分别对NANOGrav 15年和EPTA DR2 New+数据集进行贝叶斯分析，量化数据对这种宇宙历史的偏好程度。我们发现，在宇宙弦解释引力波信号的前提下，相对于标准宇宙历史，存在对短暂物质主导和kination主导阶段的实质性证据：NANOGrav 15年数据给出的Bayes因子为3.63^{+0.22}_{-0.21}，同时推断的宇宙弦张力几乎不变。若超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）贡献较小（如天体物理族群模拟所暗示），这一宇宙弦主导情景尤其相关。与纯SMBHB产生引力波的场景相比，在两种膨胀历史和两个数据集中，含或不含SMBHB额外贡献的宇宙弦解释均未显示出显著偏好。
classification.one_liner: 对NANOGrav 15年与EPTA DR2的贝叶斯分析表明，在宇宙弦解释PTA信号时，数据对BBN后早期物质主导加kination阶段给出实质性证据，但未显著优于SMBHB场景。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息研究；属于宇宙学、引力波与宇宙弦方向，落在经典引力/宇宙学支线，与全息研究无直接关联。

papers.title: Systematic Uncertainties in Ultralight Boson Constraints from Superradiance
papers.abstract: Ultralight bosons are well-motivated candidates for physics beyond the Standard Model and may constitute part or all of the dark matter. Black-hole superradiance provides a powerful means of probing these particles through their gravitational interaction with rotating black holes. This mechanism has motivated a growing body of constraints from electromagnetic measurements of black-hole spins and, more recently, gravitational-wave observations. Gravitational-wave probes draw on several distinct signatures: the spins of merging binary black holes, gravitational radiation emitted by boson clouds, and potential imprints of cloud-induced changes to binary dynamics. The interpretation of these probes depends on method-specific astrophysical and theoretical assumptions, including black hole formation, natal spin, age, accretion history, population priors, and boson self-interactions. In this paper, we review the principal electromagnetic and gravitational-wave constraints derived from black-hole superradiance, with particular emphasis on their underlying assumptions and systematic uncertainties. The distinct observational signatures and systematic uncertainties of these approaches offer complementary perspectives on the viability of ultralight-boson models. In particular, their overlapping coverage around boson masses of $10^{-13}$-$10^{-12}$ eV makes this region particularly informative for comparing constraints, with attention to the assumptions underlying each result.

classification.title_zh: 超辐射对超轻玻色子限制中的系统不确定性
classification.abstract_zh: 超轻玻色子是标准模型之外物理的合理候选者，并可能构成暗物质的全部或一部分。黑洞超辐射提供了一种通过其与旋转黑洞的引力相互作用来探测这些粒子的有力手段。该机制推动了一系列来自黑洞自旋电磁测量以及近期引力波观测的不断增长的约束。引力波探测利用若干不同特征：并合双黑洞的自旋、玻色子云发出的引力辐射，以及云诱导的双星动力学变化可能留下的印记。这些探测的解释取决于方法特定的天体物理和理论假设，包括黑洞形成、初始自旋、年龄、吸积历史、族群先验和玻色子自相互作用。本文综述由黑洞超辐射得到的主要电磁和引力波约束，特别强调其背后假设和系统不确定性。这些方法的不同观测特征和系统不确定性为超轻玻色子模型的可存活提供互补视角。特别是，它们在玻色子质量 $10^{-13}$-$10^{-12}$ eV 附近的重叠覆盖使该区域对于比较约束尤其有信息量，同时需关注每个结果背后的假设。
classification.one_liner: 综述黑洞超辐射对超轻玻色子给出的电磁与引力波限制及系统不确定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究黑洞超辐射、旋转黑洞与引力波限制等经典引力/广义相对论现象，匹配‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Gravitational Memory: an approximate description
papers.abstract: The large-distance behaviour of a sandwich gravitational wave can be approximated by a continuous but not necessarily smooth profile, providing us with a simplified description of particle motion. Our approximate model is consistent with the Carroll symmetry. Our strategy is illustrated by the Poschl-Teller profile. The limits of the sandwich approximation are discussed.

classification.title_zh: 引力记忆：一种近似描述
classification.abstract_zh: 三明治引力波的远距离行为可以用一个连续但不一定光滑的剖面来近似，从而为我们提供对粒子运动的简化描述。我们的近似模型与 Carroll 对称性一致。我们通过 Pöschl-Teller 剖面来说明该策略。文中讨论了三明治近似的局限。
classification.one_liner: 用连续（可不光滑）剖面近似三明治引力波的远距离行为，得到与 Carroll 对称性一致的简化粒子运动描述，并以 Pöschl-Teller 剖面为例讨论近似的局限。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究引力波记忆/三明治引力波的经典时空近似，并与 Carroll 对称性相关，属于用户列出的经典引力/广义相对论重点，同时涉及平直时空渐近对称性。

papers.title: Study of gravitational radiation at $\mathscr{J}$ for the general type-D Einstein-Maxwell solution with cosmological constant
papers.abstract: We characterize the gravitational radiation present in the general Pleba\'nski-Demia\'nski type~D solution with cosmological constant $\Lambda$ of any sign. We show that radiation escapes towards infinity if and only if the acceleration parameter is non-zero. We calculate the Cotton-York tensor and the boundary stress-energy tensor at infinity for negative $\Lambda$, and for positive $\Lambda$ the $D$ tensor that complements initial or final data at $\mathscr{J}$. In addition, we recast a recent parametrization of this family of metrics into a new form by a simple homothety, correctly identifying $\Lambda$, and study the existence and regularity of the possible axes of symmetry, searching for a relation between deficit angles and radiation. We also identify the branch of general non-radiating solutions with non-vanishing Cotton-York tensor at $ \mathscr{J} $.

classification.title_zh: 含宇宙学常数的广义 type-D Einstein-Maxwell 解在零无穷处的引力辐射研究
classification.abstract_zh: 我们刻画了含任意符号宇宙学常数 Λ 的一般 Plebański-Demiański type D 解中的引力辐射。我们证明，辐射逃逸到无穷远当且仅当加速度参数非零。我们计算了负 Λ 情形下的 Cotton-York 张量和无穷远处的边界应力-能量张量，以及正 Λ 情形下在零无穷处补充初始或最终数据的 D 张量。此外，我们通过一个简单的相似变换，将该度规族最近的一种参数化改写为新形式，正确识别出 Λ，并研究可能的对称轴的存在性与正则性，寻找亏损角与辐射之间的关系。我们还识别出在零无穷处具有非零 Cotton-York 张量的一般非辐射解分支。
classification.one_liner: 研究含任意符号 Λ 的一般 Plebański-Demiański type-D Einstein-Maxwell 解在零无穷处的引力辐射，发现仅当加速度参数非零时辐射逃逸，并分析边界张量、对称轴与亏损角。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究含宇宙学常数的 type-D 精确解的引力辐射、零无穷边界量与对称轴性质，属于用户列出的“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力信息问题。

papers.title: de Sitter Scalar Discrete Series: Gupta-Bleuler Structure and Holography
papers.abstract: We show that scalar discrete-series unitary irreducible representations (UIRs) $\Pi_{p,0}$ ($p=1,2,\cdots$) of the de Sitter (dS) group $\mathrm{SO}_0(1,4)$ admit a dS-covariant Krein realization on the dS hyperboloid, endowed with a dS-invariant non-degenerate Klein-Gordon (KG) sesquilinear form, in which the group action is indecomposable and organizes naturally into a Gupta-Bleuler triplet. The positive- and negative-norm sectors are already present in the underlying Krein space, whereas a null sector emerges only at an intermediate stage, where the induced KG form becomes degenerate and its radical leads canonically to the physical quotient carrying the UIR $\Pi_{p,0}$. We further show that suitable limits of the bulk theory at the ``future'' and ``past'' conformal boundaries ${\mathcal{I}}^\pm$ give rise to dS-invariant boundary realizations endowed with induced kernel inner products. While the bulk negative-norm sector admits no independent boundary counterpart, the boundary realization retains the physical and gauge structures inherited from the bulk. The resulting boundary module nevertheless remains indecomposable, with its physical quotient carrying the discrete-series representation $\Pi_{p,0}$. The antipodal symmetry provides a natural relation between the realizations on ${\mathcal{I}}^+$ and ${\mathcal{I}}^-$, ensuring the consistency of the boundary construction and its geometric interpretation. At the heart of the analysis lies a Fourier-type bulk-boundary transform that provides a dS-covariant identification of the bulk and boundary physical sectors, establishing a one-to-one intertwining correspondence between the bulk and boundary realizations of $\Pi_{p,0}$ while preserving reflection positivity.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 标量离散系列：Gupta-Bleuler 结构与全息
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，de Sitter（dS）群 SO_0(1,4) 的标量离散系列酉不可约表示（UIRs）Π_{p,0}（p=1,2,⋯）在 dS 双曲面上承认一个 dS 协变的 Krein 实现，并带有 dS 不变的非退化 Klein-Gordon（KG）半双线性形式；其中群作用不可分解，并自然组织成 Gupta-Bleuler 三重态。正范数和负范数扇区已存在于底层 Krein 空间中，而零扇区仅在中间阶段出现；在中间阶段，诱导的 KG 形式退化，其根空间典范地导向携带 UIR Π_{p,0} 的物理商。我们进一步证明，体理论在“未来”和“过去”共形边界 I^± 的适当极限给出 dS 不变的边界实现，并带有诱导的核内积。虽然体负范数扇区没有独立的边界对应物，但边界实现保留了从体继承的物理与规范结构。所得边界模仍不可分解，其物理商携带离散系列表示 Π_{p,0}。对跖对称性在 I^+ 与 I^- 上的实现之间提供自然关系，确保边界构造及其几何解释的一致性。分析的核心是一个 Fourier 型体-边界变换，它给出体与边界物理扇区的 dS 协变识别，在保持反射正性的同时，在 Π_{p,0} 的体实现与边界实现之间建立一一对应的 intertwining 对应。
classification.one_liner: 在 dS 双曲面上构造标量离散系列 UIR 的 Gupta-Bleuler/Krein 实现，并导出保持反射正性的体-边界全息对应。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于理论全息中的 dS/共形边界表示论工作，但不直接落在所列重点标签（全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论）上。

papers.title: Quark and hybrid stars with renormalization group improvement of NNLO perturbative QCD
papers.abstract: Recently, the NNLO perturbative QCD pressure of cold and dense symmetric matter, with arbitrary quark masses, has been resummed within the renormalization-group-optimized perturbation theory (RGOPT) framework. By being imbued with renormalization group properties, the resulting pressure is less sensitive to renormalization scale ($\Lambda\equiv X \mu_B/3$) variations than the NNLO perturbative QCD pressure. Here, we extend this by considering $\beta$-equilibrium and charge neutrality to evaluate the corresponding equation of state (EoS). We provide a compact ``pocket" fitting formula for the EoS for $N_f=2+1$ massive quarks at different renormalization scale parameter ($X$) values. We describe pure quark stars as well as hybrid stars with quark-cores. Pure quark stars compatible with astrophysical observations were obtained with $X=2.71-3.30$, whereas a larger value (3.84) is needed if the secondary component of the observation GW190814 represents a neutron star. Hybrid stars were built considering three representative hadron models based on a relativistic mean-field description, and chosen to produce soft and stiff EoSs. Stable hybrid stars with masses compatible with the massive pulsar PSR J0740+6620 were obtained considering $X$ of the order of 2 to $2.71$, the largest scale giving rise to hybrid stars with a large quark core with a radius of 2 to 8 km , and the smallest to a small quark core at the center of the star.

classification.title_zh: 具有 NNLO 微扰 QCD 重整化群改进的夸克星与混合星
classification.abstract_zh: 最近，冷且致密对称物质的 NNLO 微扰 QCD 压强（任意夸克质量）已在重整化群优化微扰论（RGOPT）框架下被重求和。由于获得了重整化群性质，所得压强对重整化标度（Λ≡X μ_B/3）变化的敏感度低于 NNLO 微扰 QCD 压强。这里我们通过考虑 β 平衡和电荷中性来扩展这一点，以计算相应的状态方程（EoS）。我们为 N_f=2+1 有质量夸克在不同重整化标度参数 X 下的 EoS 提供了一个紧凑的“口袋”拟合公式。我们描述了纯夸克星以及带有夸克核的混合星。与天体物理观测兼容的纯夸克星在 X=2.71-3.30 时获得，而如果 GW190814 的次分量代表中子星，则需要更大的值（3.84）。混合星是在基于相对论平均场描述的三种代表性强子模型下构建的，并选择产生软和硬的 EoS。我们得到了质量与巨大脉冲星 PSR J0740+6620 兼容的稳定混合星，所考虑的 X 约为 2 到 2.71；最大标度导致具有半径 2 到 8 km 的大夸克核的混合星，而最小标度则导致星中心处的小夸克核。
classification.one_liner: 利用 RGOPT 改进的 NNLO 微扰 QCD 状态方程研究纯夸克星和混合星，并给出与脉冲星及 GW190814 约束相容的质量/半径参数范围。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文非全息研究，主要讨论 NNLO 微扰 QCD/RGOPT 状态方程及夸克星/混合星性质；涉及致密星与观测约束，可归入经典引力/致密星支线，但与 AdS/CFT、纠缠、全息相变等核心全息主题关联有限。

papers.title: Massive scalar fields in eccentric regime: Detectability and constraints from LISA observations of extreme mass-ratio inspirals
papers.abstract: Extreme mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) are among the most promising sources for future space-based gravitational wave (GW) observatories and provide sensitive probes of additional fundamental fields in the strong-gravity regime. In the present work, we investigate eccentric equatorial EMRIs around Kerr black holes in the presence of a massive scalar field. We assume that the inspiralling object carries a scalar charge, therefore, emits scalar radiation in addition to GWs. By solving the massive scalar perturbation equation in the frequency domain, we compute the relativistic scalar energy fluxes at the event horizon and at infinity and incorporate them into an adiabatic inspiral model. We investigate the impact of the scalar charge and scalar field mass on the orbital evolution and gravitational waveforms by analysing the accumulated phase differences and waveform mismatches relative to both general relativity (GR) and the massless scalar limit. Our results show that the massive scalar radiation can produce significant GW dephasing, with the effect becoming increasingly pronounced for more eccentric orbits. In addition, the scalar flux is suppressed for larger scalar field masses as fewer scalar harmonics satisfy the propagation condition at infinity. Finally, using both Fisher-information-matrix forecasts and Bayesian parameter estimation, we assess the capability of the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna to constrain the scalar charge and scalar field mass. The two inference approaches gives consistent constraints, demonstrating that eccentric EMRIs provide a promising avenue for probing massive scalar fields and scalar-tensor extensions of gravity in the strong-field regime.

classification.title_zh: 偏心区域中的大质量标量场：来自极端质量比旋近 LISA 观测的可探测性与限制
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋近（EMRI）是未来空间引力波天文台最有希望的源之一，并为强引力区中额外基本场提供了灵敏探针。本工作研究在存在大质量标量场时，围绕 Kerr 黑洞的偏心赤道 EMRI。我们假设旋近天体携带标量荷，因此除引力波外还发出标量辐射。通过在频率域求解大质量标量微扰方程，我们计算事件视界处和无穷远处的相对论标量能流，并将其纳入绝热旋近模型。通过分析相对于广义相对论（GR）和无质量标量极限的累积相位差与波形失配，我们研究标量荷和标量场质量对轨道演化和引力波形的影响。结果表明，大质量标量辐射可产生显著的引力波退相位，且效应在轨道越偏心时越明显。此外，标量场质量越大，标量通量被抑制，因为满足无穷远处传播条件的标量谐波更少。最后，利用 Fisher 信息矩阵预测和贝叶斯参数估计，我们评估 LISA 约束标量荷和标量场质量的能力。两种推断方法给出自洽的约束，表明偏心 EMRI 为在强场区探测大质量标量场和标量-张量引力扩展提供了有希望的途径。
classification.one_liner: 在偏心 Kerr EMRI 中纳入带标量荷天体的大质量标量辐射，分析波形退相位并用 LISA 约束标量荷与标量场质量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 Kerr 黑洞周围偏心 EMRI 中的大质量标量辐射与 LISA 参数约束，属于经典引力/广义相对论和引力波方向，匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息。

papers.title: Photon Surfaces in Higher-Curvature Gravity: Implications for Quasinormal Modes and Gravitational Lensing
papers.abstract: Effective field theory (EFT) provides a systematic framework to describe deviations from general relativity through higher-curvature corrections to the gravitational action. In this work, we investigate test-field quasinormal modes (QNMs) and weak and strong gravitational lensing in static, spherically symmetric spacetimes with higher-curvature corrections, focusing on null geodesics near the photon sphere. Using the strong deflection limit formalism developed by Bozza, we derive the logarithmic divergence of the deflection angle and separate the divergent and regular contributions. We normalize the dimensionful EFT couplings by appropriate powers of the horizon radius $r_s=2M$ and work perturbatively in the resulting dimensionless parameters. We analyze how higher-curvature corrections modify the photon sphere radius, the critical impact parameter, and the coefficients governing the strong deflection expansion. We further examine the corresponding effects on test-field QNMs in the eikonal regime. Our results provide a systematic characterization of how higher-curvature EFT corrections modify null geodesics, strong gravitational lensing, and test-field QNMs, and clarify the relation between EFT couplings and characteristic properties of the surrounding spacetime geometry.

classification.title_zh: 高阶曲率引力中的光子面：对准正规模与引力透镜的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 有效场论（EFT）提供了一个系统框架，通过引力作用量的高阶曲率修正来描述对广义相对论的偏离。在本工作中，我们研究具有高阶曲率修正的静态球对称时空中的测试场准正规模（QNMs）以及弱、强引力透镜，重点关注光子球附近的类光测地线。利用 Bozza 发展的强偏折极限形式，我们推导出偏折角的对数发散，并分离发散与正则贡献。我们通过视界半径 r_s=2M 的适当幂次对量纲性 EFT 耦合进行归一化，并在所得的无量纲参数中作微扰处理。我们分析高阶曲率修正如何改变光子球半径、临界碰撞参数以及控制强偏折展开的系数。我们进一步考察 eikonal 区域中对测试场 QNMs 的相应效应。我们的结果系统刻画了高阶曲率 EFT 修正如何修改类光测地线、强引力透镜与测试场 QNMs，并阐明了 EFT 耦合与周围时空几何特征性质之间的关系。
classification.one_liner: 在高阶曲率 EFT 修正的静态球对称时空中，研究光子球附近的强/弱引力透镜与测试场准正规模。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力/广义相对论中的高阶曲率修正、光子球、强引力透镜与测试场准正规模，匹配用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论和 QNM；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Looking for non-gaussianity in Pulsar Timing Arrays through the four point correlator
papers.abstract: Pulsar Timing Arrays have recently reported strong evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave background. In standard analyses, it is modeled through pulsar-dependent Fourier coefficients assumed to follow gaussian statistics, so that the signal is fully characterized by its two-point function. However, if the background arises from a finite population of inspiralling supermassive black hole binaries, non-gaussian features may emerge, making the determination of higher-order correlators essential. In this work, we compute the complete four-point correlator of the stochastic gravitational wave background Fourier coefficients for four arbitrary pulsar positions, identifying it as the leading probe of non-gaussianity. The result separates into a gaussian contribution, proportional to the square of the two-point function, and a genuinely non-gaussian connected component, whose non-trivial angular dependence generalizes the Hellings and Downs correlation to four pulsars. This angular structure depends only on averages of products of antenna pattern functions, and is therefore expected to be independent of the specific physical origin of the background. We further propose to incorporate the four-point correlator into the parameter-estimation pipeline by deriving a marginalized likelihood that perturbatively accounts for non-gaussian effects. Our results provide the theoretical framework to search for non-gaussian features in pulsar timing array data, opening the way to a more complete characterization of gravitational-wave backgrounds.

classification.title_zh: 通过四点关联器在脉冲星计时阵列中寻找非高斯性
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列最近报告了随机引力波背景的强证据。在标准分析中，它通过脉冲星依赖的傅里叶系数建模，并假定服从高斯统计，因此信号完全由两点函数表征。然而，如果背景来自有限数量的旋进超大质量黑洞双星，可能出现非高斯特征，使得确定高阶关联器变得必要。在这项工作中，我们计算了四个任意脉冲星位置的随机引力波背景傅里叶系数的完整四点关联器，并将其确定为非高斯性的主要探针。结果分为高斯贡献，正比于两点函数的平方，以及真正非高斯的连通分量，其非平凡角依赖将 Hellings 和 Downs 关联推广到四颗脉冲星。这种角结构仅依赖于天线方向图函数乘积的平均值，因此预期独立于背景的具体物理起源。我们进一步提出通过推导一个微扰地考虑非高斯效应的边缘化似然，将四点关联器纳入参数估计流程。我们的结果为在脉冲星计时阵列数据中寻找非高斯特征提供了理论框架，为更完整地表征引力波背景开辟了道路。
classification.one_liner: 计算随机引力波背景的四点关联器，为脉冲星计时阵列中搜索非高斯性提供理论框架。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/引力波背景统计与脉冲星计时阵列数据分析，涉及非高斯高阶关联器；不涉及全息、量子引力或用户标注的全息支线，但与经典引力重点标签相关。

papers.title: Global Consistency of Cosmological Braneworlds in Palatini and Metric-Affine f(R) Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate global consistency conditions for five-dimensional warped braneworlds in Palatini and metric-affine gravity. Starting from the generalized Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde framework, we derive integrated sum rules for cosmological warped geometries and examine how independent connection degrees of freedom modify the standard Einstein-gravity obstruction to smooth compact braneworlds. The analysis separates geometric, matter, and non-Riemannian contributions and clarifies the conditions under which the usual no-go result can be modified. We show that the generalized consistency relations provide necessary global constraints on admissible configurations and identify the terms responsible for possible departures from the Riemannian case. The results establish a systematic framework for testing the global consistency of smooth five-dimensional braneworlds in gravitational theories with independent affine structure.
authors: Paulo Michel L. T da Silva

classification.title_zh: Palatini 与度量-仿射 f(R) 引力中宇宙学膜世界的全局一致性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 Palatini 和度量-仿射引力中五维翘曲膜世界的全局一致性条件。从广义 Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde 框架出发，我们为宇宙学翘曲几何推导积分求和规则，并考察独立联络自由度如何修改标准 Einstein 引力中对光滑紧致膜世界的阻碍。该分析将几何、物质和非黎曼贡献分开，并澄清通常 no-go 结果可被修改的条件。我们表明，广义一致性关系给出了可容许构型的必要全局约束，并识别出可能导致偏离黎曼情形的项。结果为在具有独立仿射结构的引力理论中检验光滑五维膜世界的全局一致性建立了系统框架。
classification.one_liner: 在 Palatini/度量-仿射 f(R) 引力中推导宇宙学翘曲膜世界的积分求和规则，澄清独立仿射结构如何修改光滑紧致膜世界的 no-go 约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/膜世界与修改引力方向，涉及 no-go 定理和全局一致性；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力，因此与用户重点标签中的经典引力支线相关，但非全息核心主题。

papers.title: M2 brane $S^3/\mathbb Z_k$ instanton partition function in ${\rm AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction
papers.abstract: As was shown in arXiv:2609.14497, the 2-loop $ {\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction to the partition function of M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ vanishes. This is in agreement with the localization prediction for $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory interpreted in the grand-canonical ensemble according to the conjecture of arXiv:2505.21633. Here we study the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction for the M2 brane instanton wrapping $S^3/\mathbb Z_k\subset S^7/\mathbb Z_k$ dual to the leading non-perturbative large $N$ contribution to the ABJM free energy on 3-sphere. The 1-loop instanton M2 brane partition function was shown in arXiv:2307.14112 to match the localization prediction. The 2-loop computation is complicated by the presence of bosonic and fermionic zero modes, which requires to integrate over the collective coordinates. The collective-coordinate Jacobian provides a non-trivial ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ contribution in addition to the one of the quartic interaction vertex in the M2 brane action. We find that for $k>2$ the the quartic vertex contribution is cancelled by the Jacobian contribution for the choice of the separation of the fermionic zero modes from the quantum fields under which these form separate supermultiplets. Assuming the supersymmetric prescription for the paired zero modes we show that the cancellation persists after integration over the collective coordinates. Thus the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction vanishes, in agreement with the grand-canonical ensemble prediction. For $k=1$ the quartic vertex contribution reduces to equation-of-motion terms as in the case of ${\rm AdS}_3 \subset { \rm AdS}_7 \times S^4$ in arXiv:2511.22306 which is related to $S^3 \subset {\rm AdS}_4 \times S^7$ case by a formal analytic continuation.

classification.title_zh: AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 中 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数：2-loop 修正
classification.abstract_zh: 如 arXiv:2609.14497 所示，对包裹 AdS_2×S^1 并位于 AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 内的 M2 膜配分函数的 2-loop T^{-1}_2 修正为零。这与 ABJM 理论中 1/2-BPS 圆形 Wilson loop 的 localization 预言一致；按照 arXiv:2505.21633 的猜想，该预言在 grand-canonical ensemble 中解释。这里我们研究包裹 S^3/Z_k ⊂ S^7/Z_k、对偶于 ABJM 在 3-sphere 上自由能的大 N 领头非微扰贡献的 M2 膜瞬子的 T^{-1}_2 修正。arXiv:2307.14112 表明 1-loop 瞬子 M2 膜配分函数与 localization 预言匹配。2-loop 计算因存在玻色子和费米子零模而复杂，需要对集体坐标积分。集体坐标 Jacobian 在 M2 膜作用量的四次相互作用顶点贡献之外，提供非平凡的 T^{-1}_2 贡献。我们发现对于 k>2，在将费米子零模与量子场分离、使其形成独立超多重态的选取下，四次顶点贡献被 Jacobian 贡献抵消。假设配对零模采用超对称规定，我们证明在集体坐标积分后抵消仍然存在。因此 T^{-1}_2 修正为零，与 grand-canonical ensemble 预言一致。对于 k=1，四次顶点贡献约化为运动方程项，如同 arXiv:2511.22306 中 AdS_3 ⊂ AdS_7×S^4 的情形；后者通过形式解析延拓与 S^3 ⊂ AdS_4×S^7 情形相关。
classification.one_liner: 计算 AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 中 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数的 2-loop T^{-1}_2 修正，发现 k>2 时抵消为零，支持 grand-canonical ensemble 预言；k=1 约化为运动方程项。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于纯理论全息/AdS/CFT 计算，涉及 ABJM、M2 膜瞬子和 localization，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超导、探针膜、QNM、经典引力等重点支线。

papers.title: Localizing the M-Theory Path Integral
papers.abstract: We propose a supersymmetric localization formula for the local perturbative contribution to the M-theory path integral, reducing it to an integral over equivariant flux data. Relative equivariant extensions of the eleven-dimensional Chern--Simons couplings determine the localized action, while for M2-brane backgrounds a tangent-cotangent character computes the one-loop determinant. This gives the first closed form expression for the complete perturbative ABJM partition function at general squashing and chemical potentials, and new analytic results for the ABJM topologically twisted index describing black holes. Applied to the non-toric $V^{5,2}$ theory, the same prescription yields a closed analytic Airy constant previously known only numerically. Our formulas reproduce all available independent field theory results, and provide analytic predictions at general parameters where no field theory answer is currently known. We derive an all-genus result for the Type IIA expansion which is an equivariant form of the usual topological string constant map result, and also extract integrated correlators.

classification.title_zh: 局域化 M 理论路径积分
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个超对称局域化公式，用于 M 理论路径积分的局部微扰贡献，将其约化为对等变通量数据的积分。十一维 Chern--Simons 耦合的相对等变扩张决定局域化作用量，而对于 M2 膜背景，一个切丛-余切丛特征标计算单圈行列式。这给出了一般 squashing 和化学势下完整微扰 ABJM 配分函数的首个闭式表达式，以及描述黑洞的 ABJM 拓扑扭曲指标的新解析结果。应用于非环面 V^{5,2} 理论，同一方案给出了此前仅以数值已知的闭式解析 Airy 常数。我们的公式重现了所有可获得的独立场论结果，并在当前尚不知场论答案的一般参数下给出解析预言。我们推导出 Type IIA 展开的全亏格结果，它是通常拓扑弦常数映射结果的等变形式，并提取了积分关联函数。
classification.one_liner: 该文提出 M 理论路径积分的超对称局域化公式，并应用于 ABJM 配分函数、黑洞拓扑扭曲指标、非环面 V^{5,2} 理论和 Type IIA 展开。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT、M 理论与 ABJM 超对称局域化方向，并涉及黑洞拓扑扭曲指标；但不直接对应所列全息超流超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7 或经典引力等重点标签。

papers.title: Bootstrapping Holographic Theories in the Planar Limit
papers.abstract: We combine the numerical conformal bootstrap with supersymmetric localization to constrain the spectrum of holographic superconformal field theories in the planar large $N$ limit for finite 't Hooft coupling $\lambda$. We consider the stress tensor multiplet four-point function in $\mathcal{N}=4$ $SU(N)$ super-Yang-Mills (SYM), which is holographically dual to closed string scattering, as well as the flavor multiplet correlator in a certain $ 4d $ $\mathcal{N}=2$ $U\!Sp(2N)$ gauge theory with $SO(8)$ flavor symmetry, which is dual to open string scattering. In both cases, we combine dispersive sum rules with integrated constraints from supersymmetric localization to compute an upper bound on the scaling dimension of the lowest scalar single-trace operator for all $\lambda$. For $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM, we find that our bounds are close to the known integrability result for all $\lambda$. For the $\mathcal{N}=2$ theory, where integrability is not yet available, we find that our bounds are close to weak and strong coupling predictions in the relevant regimes.

classification.title_zh: 平面极限下全息理论的 Bootstrap
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将数值共形 bootstrap 与超对称局域化结合起来，以在平面大 N 极限、有限 't Hooft 耦合 λ 下约束全息超共形场论的谱。我们考虑 N=4 SU(N) 超杨-米尔斯（SYM）中的应力张量多重态四点函数，其全息对偶为闭弦散射；以及某个具有 SO(8) 味对称性的 4d N=2 USp(2N) 规范理论中的味多重态关联函数，其对偶为开弦散射。在这两种情况下，我们结合色散求和规则与来自超对称局域化的积分约束，计算对所有 λ 的最低标量单迹算符标度维数的上界。对于 N=4 SYM，我们发现我们的界在所有 λ 下都接近已知可积性结果。对于 N=2 理论，目前尚无可用可积性，我们发现我们的界在相关区域接近弱耦合和强耦合预测。
classification.one_liner: 结合共形 bootstrap 与超对称局域化，在平面大 N 极限下约束全息超共形场论谱，并覆盖有限 't Hooft 耦合。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与全息谱 bootstrap，但未涉及用户重点标签列出的全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、探针膜或经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: M2 brane in AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction to $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS Wilson loop vs localization in ABJM theory
papers.abstract: We study the quantization of an M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$, dual to the $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory. The classical action and the one-loop contribution were previously shown to reproduce the gauge-theory localization result. Here we extend the analysis to the two-loop order. In an adapted static and $\kappa$-symmetry gauge the world-volume action contains no cubic interaction vertices, so that the two-loop correction is determined entirely by quartic interactions and is manifestly free of logarithmic UV divergences. We find that the bosonic and fermionic contributions combine into a perfect square $ {\mathscr X}^2$ where ${\mathscr X}$ is a linear combination of the bosonic and fermionic 3d Green's functions and their derivatives. The evaluation of $\mathscr X$ requires fixing the $\mathrm{AdS}_2$ boundary quantization of the massless fermionic modes. With the boundary conditions selected by the preserved supersymmetry, $\mathscr X$ vanishes and hence the complete two-loop correction is found to be zero. This result would not be consistent with identifying the M2-brane loop expansion directly with the large-$N$ expansion of the canonical, fixed-$(N,k)$ localization prediction. Instead, it agrees precisely with the recent proposal that the semiclassical M2-brane partition function should be matched to the gauge-theory grand-canonical ensemble, in which the Wilson loop expectation value is perturbatively one-loop exact. The vanishing of the two-loop correction thus provides a non-trivial test of this grand-canonical identification.

classification.title_zh: AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 中的 M2 膜：对 1/2-BPS Wilson 圈的双圈修正与 ABJM 局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在 AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 内包裹 AdS_2×S^1 的 M2 膜的量子化，其与 ABJM 理论中的 1/2-BPS 圆形 Wilson 圈对偶。经典作用量和单圈贡献此前已被证明可重现规范理论局域化结果。这里我们将分析推广到双圈阶。在适配静态规范与 κ-对称规范下，世界体积作用量不含三次相互作用顶点，因此双圈修正完全由四次相互作用决定，并且显式地无对数紫外发散。我们发现玻色与费米贡献组合成完全平方 X^2，其中 X 是三维玻色与费米 Green 函数及其导数的线性组合。计算 X 需要固定无质量费米模式的 AdS_2 边界量子化。在由保持超对称所选定的边界条件下，X 为零，因此完整双圈修正为零。这一结果将不能与把 M2 膜圈展开直接等同于固定 (N,k) 局域化预言的大 N 展开相一致。相反，它精确符合最近提出的建议：半经典 M2 膜配分函数应与规范理论巨正则系综匹配，在该系综中 Wilson 圈期望值微扰地单圈精确。因此双圈修正的消失为这一巨正则识别提供了非平凡检验。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 中计算 M2 膜对 1/2-BPS Wilson 圈的双圈修正并发现其为零，支持半经典 M2 膜配分函数对应巨正则系综而非固定 (N,k) 局域化展开。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 精确检验与 M2 膜量子化，与用户重点标签（全息超流、p 波、畴壁、multi-trace、相变气泡、QNM、冷原子、探针膜/Floquet、经典引力）均不直接相关。

papers.title: The Junction That Remembers: Infrared Response of Two Coupled SYK Majorana Systems
papers.abstract: Two strongly interacting Majorana systems of the Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev type, each with its own independent disorder, are joined by a link that is switched on in time. We ask how the infrared structure of the link is imprinted on the response and whether the system remembers how it was opened. At large $N$ the leading cross-correlation between the two systems is an exact product of two equilibrium propagators and the switching profile; because the disorder is independent, no ladder dresses it. The link operator has scaling dimension one half, which gives its susceptibility a universal logarithm whose coefficient and phase we fix and verify numerically, while the gap of the coupled equilibrium problem grows more slowly than the naive crossover estimate. Exact dynamics for up to twelve Majoranas per side show strong parity transfer and entanglement several times the free-fermion ceiling. The work done by the switch has a first-order part that does not depend on the switching time and a second-order part that grows in magnitude with it. Once the work is held fixed, the protocol dependence of the entanglement, the link expectation value and a scrambling diagnostic nearly vanishes, and the small residuals do not depend on whether the protocols differ at low or at high frequency. These small systems have no infrared window, so they neither confirm nor exclude memory at large $N$.

classification.title_zh: 会记忆的结：两个耦合 SYK Majorana 系统的红外响应
classification.abstract_zh: 两个 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 型强相互作用 Majorana 系统，各自具有独立无序，通过一个随时间开启的连接耦合。我们询问连接的红外结构如何印记在响应上，以及系统是否记得它是如何被打开的。在大 N 下，两个系统之间的主导互关联精确地是两个平衡传播子与开关剖面的乘积；由于无序独立，没有梯形图修正它。连接算符的标度维数为 1/2，这使其感受率具有普适对数，我们确定其系数和相位并数值验证；耦合平衡问题的能隙增长比朴素交叉估计更慢。每侧最多十二个 Majorana 的精确动力学显示出强宇称转移和数倍于自由费米子上限的纠缠。开关所做的功有一阶部分不依赖于开关时间，二阶部分随开关时间增长而增大。一旦功固定，纠缠、连接期望值和一个 scrambling 诊断对协议的依赖性几乎消失，且小的残差不依赖于协议差异是在低频还是高频。这些小型系统没有红外窗口，因此它们既不能确认也不能排除大 N 下的记忆。
classification.one_liner: 在大 N 下分析两个耦合 SYK Majorana 系统通过时变连接开启后的红外响应、纠缠与功，发现小系统无法判定大 N 记忆。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 JT/SYK/AdS2 理论全息方向，研究耦合 SYK、时变连接与 scrambling；但未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7探针膜或经典引力等支线，故相关性偏低。

papers.title: An exact algorithm for U(N) matrix models in the gauge-invariant singlet sector
papers.abstract: Matrix models appear as fundamental descriptions of M-theory and D-brane dynamics, and via the gauge/gravity duality their gauge-invariant, or singlet, sector describes the purely gravitational degrees of freedom in the holographic dual. We present a new exact algorithm for computing observables of bosonic U(N) matrix models in the gauge-invariant singlet sector. This sector is spanned by an orthogonal basis of Schur polynomials (for a single matrix) and restricted Schur polynomials (for multiple matrices), which diagonalizes the free Hamiltonian and provides a natural truncation of the Hilbert space by excitation number. Matrix elements of the interaction Hamiltonian, or any gauge-invariant observable, are evaluated through a group-theoretic reduction to cosets and double cosets of suitable subgroups of the symmetric group, together with character sums on the symmetric group. The resulting entries are closed-form polynomials in the gauge-group rank N, assembled from group-theoretic data that are precomputed once and can be reused for any N and any coupling constants. We validate the one-matrix implementation against the exact mapping to N non-interacting fermions, demonstrating rapid convergence of the low-lying spectrum with the cutoff. The multi-matrix extension is outlined; its main bottleneck is the computation of restricted characters of the symmetric group, for which no algorithm comparable to the Murnaghan--Nakayama rule is currently known. The framework gives direct access to finite-N, finite-coupling dynamics of gauge-invariant states and opens a new computational window on the non-planar regime of holographic matrix models.

classification.title_zh: U(N) 矩阵模型在规范不变单态扇区中的精确算法
classification.abstract_zh: 矩阵模型作为 M 理论和 D-brane 动力学的基本描述出现；通过规范/引力对偶，其规范不变（或单态）扇区描述了全息对偶中纯引力的自由度。我们提出一种新的精确算法，用于计算规范不变单态扇区中玻色型 U(N) 矩阵模型的可观测量。该扇区由 Schur 多项式（单矩阵情形）和限制 Schur 多项式（多矩阵情形）的正交基张成；这组基使自由哈密顿量对角化，并给出按激发数对希尔伯特空间的自然截断。相互作用哈密顿量或任何规范不变可观测量的矩阵元，通过群论约化到对称群适当子群的陪集与双陪集，并结合对称群上的特征标求和来计算。所得矩阵元是规范群秩 N 的闭式多项式，由只需预计算一次、并可对任意 N 和任意耦合常数重复使用的群论数据组装而成。我们通过单矩阵实现与 N 个非相互作用费米子的精确映射进行验证，表明低能谱随截断快速收敛。多矩阵推广已作概述；其主要瓶颈是对称群限制特征标的计算，目前尚不知道有可与 Murnaghan--Nakayama 规则相比的算法。该框架可直接获得规范不变态的有限 N、有限耦合动力学，并为全息矩阵模型的非平面区域打开新的计算窗口。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种在规范不变单态扇区精确计算 U(N) 矩阵模型可观测量的群论算法，可访问有限 N、非平面全息动力学。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息矩阵模型/非平面计算方向，但与用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、QNM、D3-D7/Floquet 等具体支线无直接重合。

papers.title: Connecting boundary entropy and effective central charge at holographic interfaces
papers.abstract: The entanglement entropy of intervals in $1+1$ interface CFTs is modified in two ways compared to a CFT without interface: there is a finite boundary entropy contribution, and, for an interval with an endpoint at the interface, the coefficient of the logarithmically divergent contribution -- which is usually proportional to the central charge of the CFT -- is modified to an effective central charge. We show that the latter modification can be understood as a limit of the former using holographic duals of interface CFTs. Furthermore, we show that a finite contribution also appears in intervals that do not cross the interface and it is needed to ensure strong subbaditivity of the entanglement entropy.

classification.title_zh: 全息界面中连接边界熵与有效中心荷
classification.abstract_zh: 与没有界面的CFT相比，1+1维界面CFT中区间的纠缠熵有两处修正：存在有限的边界熵贡献；并且对于一端位于界面的区间，通常正比于CFT中心荷的对数发散项的系数被修改为有效中心荷。我们证明，利用界面CFT的全息对偶，后一修改可理解为前一修改的极限。此外，我们表明，在不穿过界面的区间中也会出现有限贡献，并且为了确保纠缠熵的强次可加性，这一贡献是必要的。
classification.one_liner: 在全息界面CFT中，区间纠缠熵的有效中心荷修正可由边界熵取极限得到，非穿越界面的有限项则保证强次可加性。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息纠缠熵/界面CFT的形式研究，与AdS/CFT基础相关；但不直接匹配列出的重点支线（全息超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7、经典引力等）。

papers.title: Charge-regular formulation and radiative amplitudes of Kerr-Newman perturbations
papers.abstract: We establish a charge-regular formulation of separated Kerr--Newman perturbations and an explicit map from master solutions to physical radiative fields. We derive regular angular and radial first-order systems and their second-order reductions, with finite-charge deformations of the spin $\pm1$ and $\pm2$ Teukolsky equations. The field and boundary normalizations recover the standard Kerr conventions while accounting for the nonuniform zero-charge limit at infinity. For physical Einstein--Maxwell perturbations with the usual peeling behavior, we obtain explicit outgoing gravitational and electromagnetic amplitudes and energy fluxes at nonzero real frequency. The resulting finite-charge radiation-composition ratios depend only on the regular angular functions, independently of the radial excitation.

classification.title_zh: Kerr-Newman 扰动的电荷正则形式与辐射振幅
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了分离的 Kerr–Newman 扰动的电荷正则表述，并给出从主方程解到物理辐射场的显式映射。我们推导了正则的角向和径向一阶系统及其二阶约化，其中包含自旋 ±1 与 ±2 Teukolsky 方程的有限电荷形变。场与边界归一化在复现标准 Kerr 约定的同时，也处理了无穷远处非均匀的零电荷极限。对于具有通常 peeling 行为的物理 Einstein–Maxwell 扰动，我们得到了非零实频率下显式的出射引力与电磁振幅以及能流。所得的有限电荷辐射组成比仅依赖于正则角向函数，与径向激发无关。
classification.one_liner: 建立 Kerr-Newman 扰动的电荷正则表述并给出引力/电磁辐射振幅与能流。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究 Kerr-Newman 黑洞的经典 Einstein-Maxwell 扰动、Teukolsky 方程与辐射振幅，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线。

papers.title: Analytic parity-violating greybody factors of a dynamical Chern-Simons black hole
papers.abstract: We study the low-frequency scattering of gravitational and pseudoscalar waves off a non-rotating black hole in dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) gravity, where the axial (odd-parity) gravitational sector is irreducibly coupled to the dynamical pseudoscalar while the polar sector remains general relativistic. Working to first order in the dimensionless coupling zeta = (ell_CS/M)^4 and using matched asymptotic expansions, we obtain an exact closed form for the graviton-to-pseudoscalar conversion probability, d_2 = 3(pi^2-9)^2/8, and a high-precision reconstruction, in a proven transcendental basis, of the graviton greybody (absorption) asymmetry, kappa_2 = (21/80) pi^4 + (27/8) pi^2 - 89833/1536, for the quadrupole (ell=2) channel. Both reduce to combinations of pi^4, pi^2, and rational numbers, with no ln2 or odd-zeta terms in the reconstructed basis; the transmission-phase sector, by contrast, contains an analytically derived zeta(3)-9/8 static integral, while its overall matching prefactor is identified numerically. The leading reflection-phase asymmetry vanishes, so that no polarization rotation is imprinted on the reflected wave at leading low-frequency order, while a subleading O(omegazeta) asymmetry remains in the transmitted phase. The normalized flux asymmetries are numerically consistent with a 1/(Momega)^2 falloff in the geometric-optics limit, where the leading remaining flux effect is conversion loss. The matched-asymptotic results are checked against direct two-channel integration, while the one-dimensional integral determining kappa_2 is evaluated to high precision within an analytically controlled transcendental basis. The results provide analytic targets linking dCS parity violation in absorption and mode conversion to the axial/polar quasinormal-mode splitting.

classification.title_zh: 动态 Chern-Simons 黑洞的解析宇称破坏灰体因子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了动态 Chern-Simons (dCS) 引力中非旋转黑洞对引力波和赝标量波的低频散射，其中轴向（奇宇称）引力扇区与动态赝标量不可约耦合，而极向扇区仍为广义相对论。我们在无量纲耦合 zeta = (ell_CS/M)^4 的一阶展开下，使用匹配渐近展开，得到引力子到赝标量转换概率的精确闭式 d_2 = 3(pi^2-9)^2/8，并在一个已被证明的超越基下高精度重构了四极（ell=2）通道的引力子灰体（吸收）不对称性 kappa_2 = (21/80) pi^4 + (27/8) pi^2 - 89833/1536。二者均约化为 pi^4、pi^2 和有理数的组合，在重构基中没有 ln2 或奇 zeta 项；相较之下，透射相位扇区包含一个解析导出的 zeta(3)-9/8 静态积分，而其整体匹配前因子由数值确定。领头反射相位不对称性为零，因此在领头低频阶没有偏振旋转印刻到反射波上，而透射相位中仍有次领头的 O(omega zeta) 不对称性。归一化通量不对称性在几何光学极限下与 1/(M omega)^2 衰减数值一致，其中剩余领头通量效应是转换损失。匹配渐近结果与直接双通道积分进行了核对，同时确定 kappa_2 的一维积分在解析控制的超越基内被高精度求值。这些结果为将 dCS 宇称破坏在吸收和模式转换中的效应与轴向/极向准正规模分裂联系起来提供了解析目标。
classification.one_liner: 在动态 Chern-Simons 引力中解析计算非旋转黑洞的低频灰体因子与宇称破坏模式转换，并联系到准正规模分裂。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究动态 Chern-Simons 引力中黑洞的低频散射、灰体因子与准正规模分裂，直接属于经典引力/修改引力及 QNM 相关重点支线；但并非 AdS/CFT 全息研究。

papers.title: Axial-metric/polar-gauge perturbations of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov wormhole
papers.abstract: We study linear perturbations of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov (MMP) wormhole in the parity sector that pairs axial metric perturbations with polar gauge perturbations. It contains the axial gravitational mode and the electric field along the magnetic field lines. The lowest Landau level (LLL) of the charged fermions responds through its charge. The gauge components $a_\tau$, $a_\rho$ form a two-dimensional gauge field on the worldsheet of each field line, and the fermions respond with the exact Schwinger current. Lifted over the sphere, it gives the electric field the MMP screening mass $m_S^2=\alpha q^2$, which is not small and survives in the mouth. In the throat the perturbation tilts the worldsheets, and the Casimir stress tensor acquires mixed components. Force balance then requires a current across the field lines, and charge conservation fixes an accompanying polarisation current, the counterpart of the Hall current of the polar sector. These currents close the Bianchi identities at first order in the fermionic backreaction $\alpha$. The system reduces to three coupled master equations, given in closed form and matched to the fermion-free mouth. Consistency alone does not select the fermionic constitutive relation, but locality, covariance and the index theorem do. At $\alpha=0$ the throat reduces to Poschl-Teller problems with masses $l(l-1)$ and $(l+1)(l+2)$ at $m_S^2=0$. At finite $m_S^2$ one mode is screened, one tends to the mass $l^2+l+2$, and one neutral charge-density wave stays exactly massless. The $O(\alpha)$ shifts of the massive normal frequencies are real and negative. The two parity sectors are isospectral only without fermions. The neutral channel sees an attractive region in each mouth, and a numerical solution coupled to the gravitational channel in the exact mouth potential finds no bound state. The sector has no growing mode for $l\ge2$ at this order.

classification.title_zh: Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov 虫洞的轴向度规/极向规范扰动
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov (MMP) 虫洞的线性扰动，所考虑的宇称扇区将轴向度规扰动与极向规范扰动配对。该扇区包含轴向引力模和沿磁场线的电场。带电费米子的最低朗道能级（LLL）通过其电荷响应。规范分量 a_τ、a_ρ 在每条场线的世界面上构成一个二维规范场，费米子以精确的 Schwinger 电流响应。提升到球面上，它给电场带来 MMP 屏蔽质量 m_S^2=α q^2，该质量不小且在虫洞口处依然存在。在喉部，扰动使世界面倾斜，Casimir 应力张量获得混合分量。力平衡则要求有跨越磁场线的电流，电荷守恒确定一个伴随的极化电流，即极向扇区霍尔电流的对应物。这些电流在费米子反作用 α 的一阶闭合 Bianchi 恒等式。系统约化为三个耦合的主方程，以闭合形式给出，并与无费米子虫洞口匹配。仅靠一致性无法选定费米子本构关系，但局域性、协变性和指标定理可以。在 α=0 时，喉部约化为 Pöschl-Teller 问题，质量分别为 l(l-1) 和 (l+1)(l+2)，此时 m_S^2=0。在有限 m_S^2 下，一个模式被屏蔽，一个趋于质量 l^2+l+2，而一个中性电荷密度波保持严格无质量。有质量简正频率的 O(α) 移动为实且负。两个宇称扇区仅在没有费米子时才同谱。中性通道在每个虫洞口看到一个吸引区域，而在精确虫洞口势中耦合到引力通道的数值解未发现束缚态。在该阶，该扇区对于 l≥2 没有增长模式。
classification.one_liner: 研究 MMP 虫洞轴向度规-极向规范宇称扇区的线性扰动，导出三个耦合主方程并分析费米子反作用对模式与稳定性的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究 MMP 虫洞的线性扰动、主方程与简正频率稳定性，属于经典引力/广义相对论，并与 QNM/扰动稳定性相关；但摘要未明确使用全息方法。

papers.title: Logarithmic corrections to massive particle trajectories for the classical soft log theorems at leading order in $G$
papers.abstract: We study the logarithmic corrections to the asymptotic trajectories of massive particles. These corrections enter the calculation of the soft-log sector of the radiative field at null infinity in four-dimensional gravitational scattering. We first isolate the part of the metric which enters the particle equations of motion. We show that the nonlinear source can only affect this sector through homogeneous modes on the hyperboloid, and that matching to the proposed soft tower implies that these modes vanish, except for the first mode. We show that this mode cannot affect the trajectory coefficients at leading order in G. We then invert the matter energy-momentum tensor on the particle worldlines to obtain the trajectory coefficients at leading order in $G$ and at every logarithmic order using Legendre polynomials. The first two coefficients reproduce the known results at orders $G$ and $G^2$. .

classification.title_zh: 大质量粒子轨迹的对数修正——经典软对数定理在 G 领头阶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究大质量粒子渐近轨迹的对数修正。这些修正进入四维引力散射中类光无穷远辐射场软对数扇区的计算。我们首先分离出进入粒子运动方程的度规部分。我们表明，非线性源只能通过双曲面上的齐次模影响该扇区，并且与所提出的软塔匹配意味着这些模除第一个模外都消失。我们表明该模在 G 领头阶不能影响轨迹系数。然后我们在粒子世界线上反演物质能量-动量张量，利用 Legendre 多项式获得 G 领头阶且每一对数阶的轨迹系数。前两个系数重现了 G 阶和 G^2 阶的已知结果。
classification.one_liner: 在 G 领头阶计算大质量粒子轨迹的对数修正，为四维引力散射的经典软对数定理提供所需输入。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究四维引力散射中经典软对数定理所需的大质量粒子轨迹修正，属于经典引力/广义相对论及平直时空渐近结构，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”直接相关。

papers.title: Intrinsic spatial-strain shortcuts in general relativity
papers.abstract: We analyze spacetime shortcuts generated by longitudinal contraction and transverse expansion of the intrinsic spatial metric at fixed reference volume. Smooth bounded ultrastatic corridors are globally hyperbolic and geodesically complete and produce an exact travel-time advance between exterior clocks. An axial maximum makes the axial light ray globally minimizing; a strict maximum on an interior interval establishes Olum's endpoint-surface criterion for exactly matched corridors. Exact Einstein-source identities distinguish integrated Eulerian matter energy from asymptotic mass: infinite tubes have negative integrated energy, whereas finite corridors admit competing gradient contributions. A transverse Ricci identity proves local null-energy violation in every nontrivial localized finite corridor. The axial averaged null energy is strictly negative for localized axial-maximum profiles, and quantitative bounds relate its magnitude to the reference time advance and peak strain. We also obtain the complete finite-profile Ricci spectrum and the axial passenger tidal tensor. These results provide explicit causal and source constraints on a prepared geometry without specifying its physical formation or matter dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论中的内禀空间应变捷径
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析了在固定参考体积下，由内禀空间度规的纵向收缩和横向膨胀产生的时空捷径。光滑有界的超静态走廊是整体双曲且测地完备的，并在外部时钟之间产生精确的旅行时间提前。轴向极大值使得轴向光线全局极小化；内部区间上的严格极大值建立了Olum端点曲面判据，用于精确匹配的走廊。精确的Einstein源恒等式将积分欧拉物质能量与渐近质量区分开来：无限管具有负的积分能量，而有限走廊允许竞争性梯度贡献。横向Ricci恒等式证明，在每个非平庸局域有限走廊中局域零能量条件被违反。对于局域轴向极大剖面，轴向平均零能量严格为负，定量界将其大小与参考时间提前和峰值应变联系起来。我们还得到了完整的有限剖面Ricci谱和轴向乘客潮汐张量。这些结果为一种制备好的几何提供了显式的因果和源约束，而没有指定其物理形成或物质动力学。
classification.one_liner: 在广义相对论框架下，内禀空间应变可构造光滑测地完备的时空捷径，但其有限局域走廊必然违反局域零能量条件并具有负的轴向平均零能量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究时空几何、因果结构、Einstein源约束与能量条件，与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”直接匹配。

papers.title: Anisotropic Cosmology with Inhomogeneous $SU(2) $ and $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ Nonlinear $\sigma$-Models
papers.abstract: We investigate the cosmological dynamics of the nonlinear $\sigma$-model in a locally rotational symmetric Bianchi V background geometry. We employ the $SU(2)$ and the $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ internal symmetries, for which the kinetic metric of the multi-scalar fields is a space of constant curvature. We assume an inhomogeneous ansatz for the scalar fields, such that the $\sigma$-model, which allows the existence of nontrivial solutions in the Bianchi V geometry. For an exponential potential, we perform a detailed analysis of the phase space, we determine the stationary points, and we study their stability properties. The scalar field inhomogeneities prevent both the slow-roll and hyperbolic inflationary epochs. The existence of a cosmological constant is required to describe cosmic acceleration.

classification.title_zh: 具有非均匀 SU(2) 和 SL(2,R) 非线性 sigma 模型的各向异性宇宙学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在局部旋转对称的 Bianchi V 背景几何中非线性 σ 模型的宇宙学动力学。我们采用 SU(2) 与 SL(2,R) 内部对称性，其中多标量场的动能度规为常曲率空间。我们对标量场采用非均匀拟设，使该 σ 模型允许在 Bianchi V 几何中存在非平凡解。对于指数势，我们详细分析了相空间，确定了定点，并研究了其稳定性。标量场的非均匀性阻止了慢滚和双曲暴胀阶段。要描述宇宙加速，需要存在宇宙学常数。
classification.one_liner: 在 Bianchi V 各向异性背景中，带指数势的 SU(2)/SL(2,R) 非线性 sigma 模型采用非均匀标量场拟设；相空间分析表明非均匀性禁止慢滚与双曲暴胀，宇宙加速需宇宙学常数。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/宇宙学范畴，涉及 Bianchi V 各向异性背景中的标量场动力学与相空间稳定性分析；不属于全息或量子引力，但与用户列出的经典引力/广义相对论重点标签相关。

papers.title: The price of regularity: core gradient instability in nonsingular dyonic black holes
papers.abstract: Spacetime singularities displayed by classical black hole solutions are expected to be cured by high-energy effects, beyond the regime of validity of General Relativity. On the other hand, there are well-known examples of classical theories allowing for nonsingular black hole solutions. The most prominent is obtained by complementing the gravitational sector of General Relativity with a minimally coupled nonlinear-electrodynamics sector. It has recently been shown that purely electric/purely magnetic nonsingular black holes in an Einstein-nonlinear-electrodynamics setup are always plagued by a gradient instability. In this work, we derive the quadratic action for linear perturbations of static, spherically symmetric dyonic solutions of Einstein-nonlinear-electrodynamics theories with a general dependence on both invariants. We show that regularity of the center, absence of ghosts and angular gradient stability cannot hold simultaneously: arbitrarily close to a regular center, at least one photon polarization has a negative squared angular propagation speed. We further show that regularity drives one electromagnetic kinetic eigenvalue to zero at the center, which may limit perturbative control near the core. Evading the obstruction requires extending the theory, for example by introducing additional degrees of freedom.

classification.title_zh: 正则性的代价：非奇异双荷黑洞中的核心梯度不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 经典黑洞解所显示的时空奇点预计会被超出广义相对论适用范围的高能效应消除。另一方面，已有一些经典理论允许非奇异黑洞解；最著名的例子是在广义相对论引力部分中加入最小耦合非线性电动力学。最近的研究表明，在 Einstein-非线性电动力学框架中，纯电或纯磁的非奇异黑洞总是存在梯度不稳定性。本文推导了具有对两个不变量一般依赖的 Einstein-非线性电动力学理论中静态球对称双荷解线性扰动的二次作用量。我们证明，中心正则性、无鬼场以及角向梯度稳定性不能同时成立：在任意靠近正则中心处，至少一种光子偏振具有负的角向传播速度平方。我们进一步表明，正则性会驱使一个电磁动能本征值在中心趋于零，这可能限制核心附近的微扰控制。要规避这一阻碍，需要扩展理论，例如引入额外自由度。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-非线性电动力学中，非奇异双荷黑洞的核心正则性、无鬼场与角向梯度稳定性不可兼得。
classification.relevance_reason: 主要研究经典引力中的非奇异黑洞与扰动稳定性，属于“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Null string holography in AdS from local BRST descent
papers.abstract: We show that the radial sector of a Carroll-Weyl gauged null string in Poincar\'e $\mathrm{AdS}_D$ is locally trivial in BRST cohomology. In a quotient-adapted BFV basis, the radial coordinate, its conjugate momentum, and the associated ghosts form a contractible quartet. An explicit contracting homotopy extends this reduction to the full algebra of local spatial jets, leaving precisely the $(D-1)$-dimensional ILST BRST complex. The same quartet carries zero net Virasoro central charge, so that the anomaly condition of the parent theory, $D=27$, descends to the ILST condition $d=26$.

classification.title_zh: AdS 中零弦全息：来自局部 BRST 下降
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，庞加莱 AdS_D 中 Carroll-Weyl 规范零弦的径向扇区在 BRST 上同调中是局部平凡的。在商适配的 BFV 基中，径向坐标、其共轭动量以及相应的鬼场构成一个可缩四重态。显式的收缩同伦将该约化推广到整个局部空间射流代数，恰好留下 (D−1) 维的 ILST BRST 复形。同一个四重态携带零净 Virasoro 中心荷，因此母理论的反常条件 D=27 下降为 ILST 条件 d=26。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS 中，Carroll-Weyl 规范零弦的径向 BRST 扇区可被同伦约化，留下 (D−1) 维 ILST 复形，并将 D=27 反常条件降为 d=26。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文处理 Carroll-Weyl 零弦在 AdS 中的 BRST 约化与 Virasoro 反常下降，属于全息/弦论基础问题，但未涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、探针膜、QNM、经典引力等具体支线，因此相关度低。

papers.title: Black hole radial geometry from a quantum spin chain
papers.abstract: We show that the radial differential equation for a scalar field in an anti-de Sitter black brane background can be encoded in an exactly solvable semi-infinite spin chain independent of dimensionality. The radial coordinate emerges as lattice quasimomentum. Spin coherence encodes the geometry, while the spectrum and response recover gravitational observables and yield exact screening-mass sum rules. We implement the finite chain on a superconducting processor. At finite filling and low energies, the model yields a conformal field theory in a coordinate proportional to proper radial distance.

classification.title_zh: 来自量子自旋链的黑洞径向几何
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，反德西特黑膜背景下标量场的径向微分方程可以编码在一个与维度无关、精确可解的半无限自旋链中。径向坐标表现为格点准动量。自旋相干性编码几何，而谱和响应可恢复引力观测量并给出精确的屏蔽质量求和规则。我们在超导处理器上实现了有限链。在有限填充和低能下，该模型在与固有径向距离成正比的坐标中给出共形场论。
classification.one_liner: 将 AdS 黑膜中标量场径向方程映射为可解量子自旋链，并在超导量子处理器上实现。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文围绕 AdS 黑膜中标量场径向方程的全息/量子模拟映射，属于 AdS/CFT 字典与量子信息交叉；与用户列出的全息超流、探针膜、相变气泡等具体重点标签不直接重合，故相关性中等。

papers.title: Maximally symmetric black holes with torsion in Lovelock gravity
papers.abstract: We analyze the existence of static black hole solutions with maximally symmetric horizons and nontrivial torsion in five-dimensional Lovelock gravity. For each symmetry class, we obtain a black hole solution characterized by two independent constants. We also determine the conserved charges associated with these solutions.

classification.title_zh: Lovelock引力中含挠率的极大对称黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析了五维Lovelock引力中具有极大对称视界和非平凡挠率的静态黑洞解的存在性。对于每个对称类，我们得到了由两个独立常数刻画的黑洞解。我们还确定了与这些解对应的守恒荷。
classification.one_liner: 在五维Lovelock引力中构造带挠率、极大对称视界的静态黑洞解并计算守恒荷。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究Lovelock引力中的带挠率黑洞解，但未涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: The Komar charges of type~II supergravity and supersymmetric localization
papers.abstract: We compute the on-shell closed, generalized Komar charges associated to an arbitrary Killing vector of the two 10-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$ supergravity theories which are the low-energy effective field theories of the type~IIA and IIB superstrings. We study different rewritings of this charge in terms of Page charges and forms with special properties that are used in the derivation of thermodynamical relations in black $p$-brane spacetimes. classification.title_zh: II 型超引力的 Komar 荷与超对称局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了与两个 10 维 N=2 超引力理论的任意 Killing 矢量相关联的壳上闭合广义 Komar 荷，这两个理论是 IIA 型和 IIB 型超弦的低能有效场论。我们研究了用 Page 荷以及具有特殊性质的形式对该荷进行的不同改写，这些形式被用于推导黑 p-膜时空中的热力学关系。然后，我们证明，当 Killing 矢量是由 Killing 旋量双线性构造的超对称 Killing 矢量时，理论中不同场的动量映射为……（原文摘要在此处中断）
classification.one_liner: 计算 II 型超引力中任意 Killing 矢量对应的广义 Komar 荷，并讨论 Page 荷改写、黑 p-膜热力学以及超对称 Killing 矢量下的动量映射。

papers.title: Fast holographic inversion of superconducting domes
papers.abstract: A holographic superconductor whose scalar mass depends on the gauge field strength, $M(\Fsq)$, reproduces a superconducting dome for a suitable $M$, and recovering that $M$ from a given dome has so far taken days for a single training run. We propose a new way of training this model, with which an inversion takes from about ten minutes to an hour. Training needs the gradient of the condition that fixes the critical temperature, which the earlier method obtains by finite differences, repeating the bulk integrations for every training parameter. Here that condition is obtained, without any fit, from two integrations started at the horizon and at the boundary, and its derivative with respect to $M$ is an integral over the same two solutions, so the gradient needs no integration of its own. We use the speed to study the part of $M$ that a dome cannot determine, on the interval between the value $\Fsq$ takes at the horizon for the lowest doping and $\Fsq=0$, at which $M$ is the scalar mass $M(0)$ that fixes the dimension of the dual operator. We hold the scalar mass at several values, which we call pinned masses, retrain everything else at each, and find that the reconstructions agree wherever the horizons of the dome reach, including the minima of $M$, and differ only on that interval. A rule that keeps the reconstruction with the simplest closed form recovers both the scalar mass and the mass function of a test dome. On Gaussian and double-Gaussian domes and on the measured phase diagrams of YBa$_{2}$Cu$_{3}$O$_{y}$ and 2M-WS$_{2}$, however, the pinned mass it keeps rests on ties or on narrow margins, so for these targets the scalar mass is left open. The dome thus constrains $M$ where its horizons reach, and fixing the dimension of the dual operator needs a second observable.

classification.title_zh: 超导穹顶的快速全息反演
classification.abstract_zh: 一个标量质量依赖规范场强度 M(F^2) 的全息超导体，在合适的 M 下重现超导穹顶，而此前从给定穹顶反演该 M 单次训练需数天。我们提出一种新的训练方法，使反演耗时约十分钟到一小时。训练需要固定临界温度条件的梯度；先前方法用有限差分获得该梯度，对每个训练参数重复体时空积分。这里该条件无需拟合，由分别从视界和边界出发的两个积分得到，而其对 M 的导数是对同样两个解的积分，因此梯度本身无需额外积分。我们利用这一速度研究穹顶无法确定的 M 部分，即最低掺杂下视界处 F^2 取值与 F^2=0 之间的区间；在 F^2=0 处 M 是决定对偶算符维数的标量质量 M(0)。我们把标量质量固定于若干值（称为钉扎质量），每次重新训练其余部分，发现重建结果在穹顶视界所达之处一致，包括 M 的极小值，仅在该区间不同。一条保留最简闭式重建的规则可恢复测试穹顶的标量质量与质量函数。然而在高斯与双高斯穹顶以及 YBa2Cu3Oy 和 2M-WS2 的测量相图上，它保留的钉扎质量依赖于平局或狭窄边缘，因此对这些目标标量质量仍未确定。因此穹顶在其视界所达之处约束 M，而确定对偶算符维数需要第二个观测量。
classification.one_liner: 提出快速训练方法反演全息超导穹顶，并指出穹顶只能在其视界所达处约束 M，确定对偶算符维数还需第二个观测量。

papers.title: Gravitational scattering amplitudes in collinear and high-energy limits
papers.abstract: In this thesis we study the high-energy and collinear behaviour of gravitational scattering amplitudes and their relation to classical scattering and radiation observables. Multi-Regge kinematics, characterised by a strong rapidity ordering, provides the factorised building blocks governing the leading logarithmic structure. Relaxing this ordering to next-to-multi-Regge kinematics allows two neighbouring particles to have comparable rapidities and provides the real emission building blocks entering at next-to-leading logarithmic accuracy. We extract the next-to-multi-Regge impact factor from tree-level MHV amplitudes for pure gravitons and derive its gravitational splitting functions. We then use BCFW recursion relations to reconstruct the five-point tree amplitude for two massive scalars scattering with the emission of one graviton. Its high-energy limit yields the massive scalar--graviton impact factor and, through the KMOC formalism, a representation of the leading high-energy collinear waveform. Finally, by sewing the relevant vertices across unitarity cuts, we construct the elastic \(H\) kernel, its radiative extension and a classical next-to-multi-Regge kernel. The latter reproduces the standard \(H\) kernel in the multi-Regge limit and the universal Weinberg current in the soft limit.

classification.title_zh: 共线与高能极限下的引力散射振幅
classification.abstract_zh: 在本论文中，我们研究引力散射振幅的高能与共线行为，以及它们与经典散射和辐射可观测量之间的关系。多重Regge运动学以强快度排序为特征，提供了支配领头对数结构的因子化构件。将这种排序放宽到次重Regge运动学，允许两个相邻粒子具有可比的快度，并给出进入次领头对数精度的实发射构件。我们从纯引力子的树级MHV振幅中提取次重Regge冲击因子，并推导其引力劈裂函数。随后，我们使用BCFW递推关系重建两个大质量标量散射并发射一个引力子的五点树振幅。其高能极限给出大质量标量-引力子冲击因子，并通过KMOC形式得到领头高能共线波形的一种表示。最后，通过在对幺正割上缝合相关顶点，我们构造弹性H核、其辐射扩展以及一个经典次重Regge核。后者在多重Regge极限下再现标准H核，并在软极限下再现普适Weinberg流。
classification.one_liner: 本论文用多重/次重Regge运动学、冲击因子与BCFW/KMOC方法研究引力散射振幅的高能和共线极限，并构造经典H核与辐射波形。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接涉及经典引力散射与辐射观测量的振幅计算，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，但并非全息对偶或AdS/CFT研究。

papers.title: A Double-Dilaton Holographic Model of QCD: Running Coupling and Meson Phenomenology
papers.abstract: We present a holographic model of QCD to study the strong coupling constant $\alpha_s$ from the low-energy region to the high-energy regime. The approach uses a double-dilaton background, which breaks conformal and chiral symmetries, while large-$N_c$ corrections are incorporated to connect the holographic description with perturbative QCD. The model leads to an infrared fixed point and provides a smooth transition to the pQCD running. The resulting background also produces linear Regge trajectories for scalar, vector, and tensor states in reasonable agreement with experimental data.

classification.title_zh: QCD 的双伸缩子全息模型：跑动耦合与介子现象学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个 QCD 的全息模型，用于研究强耦合常数 α_s 从低能区到高能区的行为。该方法采用双伸缩子背景，它破坏共形对称性和手征对称性，同时引入大 N_c 修正以将全息描述与微扰 QCD 联系起来。该模型给出一个红外不动点，并实现到 pQCD 跑动的平滑过渡。所得背景还为标量、矢量和张量态产生线性 Regge 轨迹，与实验数据合理符合。
classification.one_liner: 双伸缩子全息模型描述 QCD 跑动耦合，并给出与实验相符的标量/矢量/张量介子 Regge 轨迹。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息 QCD 建模，与 AdS/CFT 和介子谱相关，但不直接匹配用户列出的具体重点支线（全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet、经典引力）。

papers.title: Gravitational wave emission from nonspherical collapse in an early matter-dominated era using N-body simulations
papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of the collapse of a nonspherical overdense patch during an early matter-dominated era and the associated production of gravitational waves (GWs) using a semirelativistic N-body framework that we develop. The collapsing patch is initialized through a Zel'dovich deformation of a homogeneous sphere and evolved in an Einstein--de Sitter background, while the emitted signal is computed directly from the numerical quadrupole evolution. We show that a reliable prediction of the signal requires a fully numerical treatment of the nonlinear collapse dynamics. In particular, fitting-based procedures and Zel'dovich-based estimates fail to capture the post-shell-crossing evolution and can over/under-estimate the emitted power of the GWs. After averaging over realizations weighted by the Doroshkevich and BBKS (peak theory) distributions, we find that the two spectra have similar shapes and remain within the same overall order of magnitude at the peak amplitude, although the BBKS result is systematically smaller. The dominant contribution arises from peaks of relatively modest height, around $\nu \simeq 3$, while a larger variance significantly enhances the signal. Finally, by varying the horizon mass and reheating temperature, we map the present-day GW spectra to the sensitivity bands of different classes of detectors. In this way, the signal can populate a broad range of frequencies, from pulsar timing arrays to very high-frequency experiments, showing that GWs from nonspherical collapse can provide a probe of the pre-BBN thermal history.

classification.title_zh: 早期物质主导时期非球形坍缩的引力波发射：基于N体模拟
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用所发展的半相对论N体框架，研究早期物质主导时期一个非球形过密区域的坍缩动力学及其相关引力波产生。坍缩区域通过均匀球体的Zel'dovich形变初始化，并在Einstein–de Sitter背景中演化，而发射信号则直接由数值四极矩演化计算得到。我们表明，要可靠预测该信号，需要对非线性坍缩动力学进行完全数值处理。特别地，基于拟合的方法和基于Zel'dovich的估计无法捕捉壳层穿越后的演化，并可能高估或低估引力波的发射功率。在按照Doroshkevich分布和BBKS（峰理论）分布加权的实现集合上进行平均后，我们发现两种谱具有相似形状，并且在峰值振幅处处于同一总体数量级，尽管BBKS结果系统性地偏小。主要贡献来自高度相对适中的峰，约ν ≃ 3，而较大的方差会显著增强信号。最后，通过改变视界质量和再加热温度，我们将当今的引力波谱映射到不同类别探测器的灵敏度频带。这样，该信号可覆盖从脉冲星计时阵列到甚高频实验的广泛频率范围，表明非球形坍缩产生的引力波可以作为探测BBN之前热历史的探针。
classification.one_liner: 半相对论N体模拟表明，早期物质主导时期的非球形坍缩需完全数值处理才能可靠预测引力波；其谱可覆盖从脉冲星计时阵列到甚高频实验，用于探测前BBN热历史。

papers.title: Factorization Algebras for Linearized Gravity
papers.abstract: The purpose of this work is to bring gravitational theories into play within the quickly developing framework of factorization algebras. We fit the causal structure of Lorentzian manifolds into categorical language, and in the globally hyperbolic case discover a convenient equivalence of coverages. Then, we show how both perturbative general relativity and perturbative conformal gravity define Batalin-Vilkovisky classical field theories. Finally, we describe how the observables of linearized general relativity define a particularly nice factorization algebra on the category of Ricci flat globally hyperbolic manifolds and present a few conjectures which arise in specific cases, primarily motivated by the study of black hole entropy as a conserved Noether charge.

classification.title_zh: 线性化引力的因子化代数
classification.abstract_zh: 本工作旨在将引力理论纳入快速发展的因子化代数框架。我们将洛伦兹流形的因果结构放入范畴语言，并在全局双曲情形下发现一种方便的覆盖等价。随后，我们展示微扰广义相对论和微扰共形引力如何定义 Batalin-Vilkovisky 经典场论。最后，我们描述线性化广义相对论的观测量如何在 Ricci 平坦全局双曲流形范畴上定义一个特别良好的因子化代数，并提出一些在特定情形下出现的猜想，主要受将黑洞熵作为守恒 Noether 荷研究的启发。
classification.one_liner: 用因子化代数框架形式化微扰/线性化引力的经典 BV 场论，并讨论 Ricci 平坦全局双曲流形上的观测量与黑洞熵猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，涉及线性化引力、微扰引力与黑洞熵/Noether 荷，但不是 AdS/CFT 全息对偶研究。

papers.title: Joint inference for gravitational-wave signal and noise glitch: Method and application
papers.abstract: Non-Gaussian noise transients ("glitches") in gravitational-wave observatories degrade our ability to accurately perform astrophysical inference. We present the analysis pipeline bilby_glitch, which allows for simultaneous Bayesian inference of gravitational-wave signals and glitches. Our framework is modular and built on top of the popular bilby framework, facilitating future extensions with additional glitch and signal models. We integrate transdimensional bilby into our framework and discuss three glitch models: a physically-motivated slow scattering model, and flexible sine-Gaussian and chirplet models. Using a combination of simulated and real data, we demonstrate that bilby_glitch produces reliable results. We then reanalyse two gravitational-wave events - GW191109 and GW200129 - which show signs of interesting black-hole spins, but which may also be affected by data-quality issues. Our results for GW191109 are consistent with previous analysis. For GW200129, we recover results consistent with [Payne $\textit{et al.}$, Phys. Rev. D $\textbf{106}$, 104017 (2022) ], where the evidence of spin-precession is much weaker when using the waveform approximant NRSur7dq4 in combination with wavelet-based glitch modeling. Furthermore, we show the evidence of spin precession of this event is dependent on the interplay between the waveform approximant and glitch model, since in contrast to NRSur7dq4 we find that inference with the waveform approximant IMRPhenomXPHM shows strong evidence of spin-precession when used in combination with wavelet-based glitch modeling.

classification.title_zh: 引力波信号与噪声毛刺的联合推断：方法与应用
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波天文台中的非高斯噪声瞬变（“毛刺”）会降低我们准确进行天体物理推断的能力。我们提出分析流水线 bilby_glitch，可同时进行引力波信号与毛刺的贝叶斯推断。该框架模块化，构建在流行的 bilby 框架之上，便于未来用额外的毛刺和信号模型进行扩展。我们将跨维 bilby 集成到框架中，并讨论三种毛刺模型：物理动机的慢散射模型，以及灵活的 sine-Gaussian 和 chirplet 模型。结合模拟和真实数据，我们证明 bilby_glitch 能给出可靠结果。随后我们重新分析两个引力波事件——GW191109 和 GW200129——它们显示出有趣黑洞自旋的迹象，但也可能受数据质量问题影响。GW191109 的结果与先前分析一致。对于 GW200129，我们得到的结果与 Payne et al., Phys. Rev. D 106, 104017 (2022) 一致：当使用波形近似 NRSur7dq4 结合基于小波的毛刺建模时，自旋进动的证据弱得多。此外，我们表明该事件的自旋进动证据依赖于波形近似与毛刺模型之间的相互作用，因为与 NRSur7dq4 相反，我们发现使用波形近似 IMRPhenomXPHM 结合基于小波的毛刺建模时，推断显示强烈的自旋进动证据。
classification.one_liner: 提出 bilby_glitch 流水线，实现引力波信号与噪声毛刺的同时贝叶斯推断，并重新分析 GW191109 与 GW200129 的黑洞自旋进动证据。

papers.title: Cosmological perturbations of TDiff fields
papers.abstract: We study scalar field theories that break diffeomorphism invariance down to the subgroup of transverse diffeomorphisms through the matter sector in cosmological backgrounds. We focus on single- and multi-field models and develop the corresponding cosmological perturbation theory. We analyze the different contributions to the pressure perturbation, discussing the adiabaticity and the effects in the perturbation coefficients of the interactions that arise in the multi-field case as a consequence of the symmetry breaking. We also consider the stability of the perturbations in terms of the effective speed of sound and present particular models that could be of phenomenological interest.

classification.title_zh: TDiff 场的宇宙学扰动
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在宇宙学背景下通过物质部门将微分同胚不变性破缺到横微分同胚子群的标量场理论。我们关注单场和多场模型，并发展相应的宇宙学扰动理论。我们分析对压强扰动的不同贡献，讨论绝热性以及多场情形下由于对称性破缺在相互作用扰动系数中出现的影响。我们还从有效声速的角度考虑扰动的稳定性，并提出一些可能具有现象学意义的特定模型。
classification.one_liner: 在宇宙学背景下研究将微分同胚破缺为横微分同胚的标量场理论，建立单场/多场扰动理论并讨论压强扰动、绝热性、有效声速稳定性及现象学模型。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为修改引力/宇宙学扰动，落在经典引力/宇宙学范围，与全息对偶无直接关联；对经典引力/宇宙学重点标签有中等相关。

papers.title: Mitigation of Incoherent Spectral Lines via Adaptive Coherence Analysis for Continuous Gravitational-Wave Searches
papers.abstract: The sensitivity of continuous gravitational-wave searches is strictly limited by non-Gaussian spectral artefacts that accumulate coherent power over long observation baselines. In this paper, we present an unsupervised mitigation framework based on adaptive network coherence analysis. Unlike traditional veto methods that discard entire frequency bands, our pipeline selectively suppresses local artefacts while preserving global potentially astrophysical signals. We validate the method using Advanced LIGO O3 data, analysing the cleaning performance across subsets spanning 1, 3, and 5 days. For the subsets spanning five days of O3 data, the pipeline identifies and mitigates 89% and 77% of the total spectral lines in the Hanford and Livingston detectors, respectively, while effectively preserving the coherent population consistent with astrophysical morphologies. This is achieved while modifying less than 7% of the analysis bandwidth spanning 20 Hz to 2000 Hz. Rigorous statistical verification and recovery of simulated signals demonstrate that the mitigation effectively suppresses the non-Gaussian tail of the noise distribution while strictly preserving the statistical integrity of coherent signal candidates. By recovering detector sensitivity in parameter spaces previously contaminated by the spectral forest, this framework provides a robust preprocessing strategy for all-sky searches.

classification.title_zh: 通过自适应相干分析缓解非相干谱线以用于连续引力波搜索
classification.abstract_zh: 连续引力波搜索的灵敏度严格受限于在长观测基线中积累相干功率的非高斯谱伪影。本文提出了一种基于自适应网络相干分析的无监督缓解框架。与传统丢弃整个频段的否决方法不同，我们的流程选择性地抑制局部伪影，同时保留全局的潜在天体物理信号。我们使用 Advanced LIGO O3 数据验证该方法，分析跨越 1、3 和 5 天的子集上的清理性能。对于覆盖 5 天 O3 数据的子集，该流程分别在 Hanford 和 Livingston 探测器中识别并缓解了总谱线的 89% 和 77%，同时有效保留了与天体物理形态一致的相干族群。这是在修改 20 Hz 到 2000 Hz 分析带宽的不到 7% 的情况下实现的。严格的统计验证和模拟信号恢复表明，该缓解有效抑制了噪声分布的非高斯尾部，同时严格保持相干信号候选的统计完整性。通过在被谱森林污染的参量空间中恢复探测器灵敏度，该框架为全天搜索提供了稳健的预处理策略。
classification.one_liner: 提出无监督自适应相干分析框架，在 LIGO O3 数据中选择性抑制连续引力波搜索中的非高斯谱线伪影，同时保留天体物理信号。
