papers.title: Direct Waves in Black-Hole Binary Mergers: Insights from the Backwards One Body Model
papers.abstract: The merger-ringdown radiation from a black hole binary merger is accurately modeled by a sum of linear quasinormal modes (QNMs). Recently, the ``direct wave" component of the radiation, associated with prompt emission from a plunging perturber, has been identified. Motivated by the behavior of null geodesics perturbed from the remnant light ring, the Backwards One Body (BOB) approach has been shown to model the full merger-ringdown radiation to high accuracy, while using only a minimal number of parameters. In this work, using the P\"oschl--Teller potential, we first show how the BOB amplitude evolution can be recovered from the QNM pole contributions. We then apply rational filters to BOB and numerical relativity waveforms. We show that the BOB rational filter residual agrees well with the NR rational filter residual, possibly helping explaining its accuracy near the waveform peak. Finally, we show that the direct wave frequency follows a different spin dependence than the horizon frequency, even for high spin remnants, and instead tracks the News frequency at the time of the peak News amplitude.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞双星并合中的直接波：来自逆向单体模型的启示
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞双星并合产生的并合-铃宕辐射可由线性准正规模（QNM）之和精确建模。最近，与俯冲扰动源的即时发射相关的辐射“直接波”成分已被识别。受残余光环扰动的零测地线行为的启发，逆向单体（Backwards One Body, BOB）方法已被证明能以极少的参数高精度地建模完整的并合-铃宕辐射。在本工作中，我们首先使用 Pöschl-Teller 势，展示如何从 QNM 极点贡献中恢复 BOB 振幅演化。然后，我们将有理滤波器应用于 BOB 和数值相对论（NR）波形。我们表明，BOB 的有理滤波残差与 NR 的有理滤波残差吻合良好，这可能有助于解释其在波形峰值附近的精度。最后，我们表明直接波频率遵循与视界频率不同的自旋依赖关系，即使对于高自旋残余也是如此，并且转而追踪 News 振幅峰值时刻的 News 频率。
classification.one_liner: 本文用 Pöschl-Teller 势和有理滤波分析 BOB 模型，表明其可再现黑洞双星并合-铃宕辐射的直接波，且直接波频率与 News 峰值频率相关。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论，研究黑洞双星并合后的 QNM 与直接波，使用数值相对论和有理滤波，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”重点标签；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: BOB the (Waveform) Builder: Analyzing Analytical Black-Hole Binary Merger Waveforms with the Backwards One Body Formalism
papers.abstract: The Backwards-One-Body (BOB) model provides a fully analytical and physically motivated description of the merger-ringdown gravitational radiation emanating from a black hole binary merger. We perform a comprehensive validation of BOB for the dominant $(2,2)$ mode of quasi-circular and non-precessing systems, assessing its accuracy against numerical relativity (NR) simulations, state-of-the-art waveform models, and a sum of quasinormal modes. We demonstrate that BOB most accurately describes the gravitational wave news, achieving accuracy comparable to highly-calibrated Effective-One-Body and NR surrogate models. Because BOB is minimally tuned to NR catalogs, it retains a high level of accuracy in regions of the parameter space sparsely covered by current NR catalogs. BOB yields an analytic link between the amplitude of the fundamental quasinormal mode and the peak amplitude of the news, which we verify to within the errors of a surrogate ringdown model. We identify a flavor of BOB that requires only the remnant mass and spin, yet matches the accuracy of models that fit a sum of many overtones. Lastly, we show that BOB accurately models both the mass and current quadrupole waves for superkick configurations, contrary to a claim in the literature, and explain why that study was not actually implementing BOB as it has been defined. Our findings establish BOB as a powerful tool for gravitational wave analysis, for providing independent tests of NR-calibrated models, and for better understanding the underlying physics of the merger. We provide a companion python package, \texttt{gwBOB}, allowing for the easy construction of various flavors of BOB and comparison to NR waveforms.

classification.title_zh: BOB（波形）构建者：用逆单体形式分析解析黑洞双星并合引力波波形
classification.abstract_zh: Backwards-One-Body（BOB）模型为黑洞双星并合产生的并合-铃宕引力辐射提供了完全解析且具有物理动机的描述。我们对 BOB 在准圆、无进动系统的主导 (2,2) 模式进行了全面验证，将其精度与数值相对论（NR）模拟、最先进的波形模型以及准正规模求和进行比较。我们证明 BOB 最准确地描述了引力波 news，达到与高度校准的有效单体（EOB）和 NR 替代模型相当的精度。由于 BOB 对 NR 目录的调节极少，它在当前 NR 目录覆盖稀疏的参数空间区域仍保持高精度。BOB 给出了基频准正规模振幅与 news 峰值振幅之间的解析联系，我们在替代铃宕模型误差范围内验证了这一点。我们识别出一种 BOB 变体，它只需要残余质量与自旋，却能匹配拟合许多泛音之和的模型的精度。最后，我们证明 BOB 能准确模拟 superkick 构型的质量四极波和电流四极波，这与文献中的一项主张相反，并解释了为何该研究实际上并未实现所定义的 BOB。我们的发现确立了 BOB 作为引力波分析、对 NR 校准模型进行独立检验以及更好地理解并合背后物理的有力工具。我们提供了配套 python 包 gwBOB，便于构建各种 BOB 变体并与 NR 波形比较。
classification.one_liner: BOB 模型以完全解析的逆单体形式描述黑洞双星并合-铃宕波形，验证精度可与 EOB/NR 替代模型相当，并提供 gwBOB 工具。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，聚焦黑洞双星并合引力波波形、铃宕与准正规模；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Relativistic second gradient theory of continuous media
papers.abstract: Variational Relativity is a framework developed by Souriau in the sixties to better formulate General Relativity and its classical limit\,: Classical Continuum Mechanics. It has been used, for instance, to formulate elasticity from a Lagrangian (or Action) in General Relativity. In that case, two primary variables are involved, the universe (Lorentzian) metric $g$ and the matter field $\Psi$. A Lagrangian density depending on the 1-jet of these variables is then introduced which must satisfy the principle of General Covariance. Souriau proved in 1958 that under these hypotheses, the Lagrangian density depends only on the punctual value of the matter field $\Psi$ and of a secondary variable $\mathbf{K}$, the conformation, an invariant of the diffeomorphism group, which is the Relativistic analog of the inverse of the right Cauchy--Green tensor. In the present work, an extension of Souriau's results to a second order gradient theory in General Relativity is presented. Accordingly, new higher order diffeomorphisms invariants are found. Their classical limits are calculated, showing that the 3-dimensional Continuum Mechanics second gradient theory can be derived from such a relativistic theory. Some of these invariants converge to objective quantities in the Galilean limit (such as the fundamental variables of finite strain second gradient theory, modeling solids), others to non-objective quantities (such as those encountered in the modeling of fluids): objectivity is thus natural for the constitutive variables of solids and unnatural for those of fluids. The present work contributes to clarify the theoretical foundation of higher gradient Continuum Mechanics theory.

classification.title_zh: 连续介质的相对论二阶梯度理论
classification.abstract_zh: Variational Relativity 是 Souriau 在六十年代提出的框架，用于更好地表述广义相对论及其经典极限：经典连续介质力学。例如，它曾被用于从广义相对论中的作用量表述弹性。此时涉及两个基本变量：宇宙（洛伦兹）度规 g 和物质场 Ψ。引入依赖于这些变量 1-jet 的拉格朗日密度，并须满足广义协变原理。Souriau 在 1958 年证明，在这些假设下，拉格朗日密度仅依赖于物质场 Ψ 的点值和次级变量 K（构形 conformation），后者是微分同胚群的不变量，是右 Cauchy--Green 张量之逆的相对论类比。本文把 Souriau 的结果推广到广义相对论中的二阶梯度理论。相应地，找到新的高阶微分同胚不变量。计算了它们的经典极限，表明三维连续介质力学二阶梯度理论可由这样的相对论理论导出。这些不变量中，有些在伽利略极限下收敛为客观量（例如模拟固体的有限应变二阶梯度理论的基本变量），另一些收敛为非客观量（例如流体建模中遇到的量）：因此，客观性对固体的本构变量是自然的，而对流体的本构变量则不是自然的。本文有助于澄清高阶梯度连续介质力学理论的理论基础。
classification.one_liner: 将 Souriau 的变分相对论框架推广到广义相对论中的二阶梯度连续介质理论，并给出高阶微分同胚不变量及其经典极限。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线中的变分表述与连续介质力学基础，但不涉及 AdS/CFT、黑洞信息或量子引力全息，故与全息主线关联有限。

papers.title: Quasi-periodic eruption spectral-timing: EMRIs crossing warped accretion disks
papers.abstract: Quasi-periodic eruptions (QPEs) are repeating X-ray transients from galactic nuclei potentially caused by a stellar-mass orbiter repeatedly colliding with the accretion disk of a supermassive black hole (SMBH) in an extreme mass-ratio inspiral (EMRI). In this picture, the eruption arrival times encode the orbit and its relativistic precessions, while the quiescent spectral energy distribution (SED) probes the same disk and SMBH, providing two independent constraints on the same orbit-disk system. We present a joint spectral-timing framework that takes advantage of this by simultaneously fitting an analytic QPE timing model built on Kerr geodesic frequencies and a warped disk geometry, coupled to a self-irradiated disk SED model sharing the same SMBH mass, spin, and disk parameters. We apply it to the QPE sources GSN 069 and eRO-QPE2, showing that the QPE timings and quiescent spectra can be reproduced simultaneously in each, providing circumstantial support for the EMRI model and warped disks in these systems. However, given the sparse timing data in both sources, neither admits a unique solution. In eRO-QPE2, we identify six physical modes which reproduce the timings and SED comparably well, motivating denser observing campaigns to identify one unambiguously. Our results demonstrate both the promise of QPE spectral-timing as a precision probe of SMBHs, their accretion disks, and orbiting companions, and the aliasing subtleties of sparsely sampled QPE timings.

classification.title_zh: 准周期爆发光谱-时序：EMRI 穿越翘曲吸积盘
classification.abstract_zh: 准周期爆发（QPEs）是来自星系核的重复 X 射线暂现源，可能由恒星级质量轨道天体在极端质量比旋近（EMRI）中反复撞击超大质量黑洞（SMBH）的吸积盘引起。在这一图像中，爆发到达时间编码了轨道及其相对论性进动，而宁静态光谱能量分布（SED）探测同一吸积盘和 SMBH，从而对同一轨道-盘系统提供两个独立约束。我们提出一个联合光谱-时序框架，利用这一点，同时拟合基于 Kerr 测地线频率和翘曲盘几何的解析 QPE 时序模型，并耦合一个自辐照盘 SED 模型，二者共享相同的 SMBH 质量、自旋和盘参数。我们将其应用于 QPE 源 GSN 069 和 eRO-QPE2，表明在每个源中 QPE 时序和宁静态光谱可以同时再现，为这些系统中的 EMRI 模型和翘曲盘提供间接支持。然而，鉴于两个源的时序数据稀疏，二者都不存在唯一解。在 eRO-QPE2 中，我们识别出六个物理模式，它们对时序和 SED 的拟合效果相当，这促使开展更密集的观测 campaign 以明确识别其中一个。我们的结果既展示了 QPE 光谱-时序作为 SMBH、其吸积盘及轨道伴星精密探针的前景，也展示了稀疏采样 QPE 时序的混叠微妙性。
classification.one_liner: 联合拟合 QPE 时序与宁静态 SED，用 Kerr 测地线和翘曲盘模型分析 GSN 069 与 eRO-QPE2，支持 EMRI-翘曲盘图像但存在解简并。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线中的黑洞、EMRI 与吸积盘天体物理，与全息对偶无直接关系；对关注经典引力方向有一定相关性。

papers.title: Composition $g$-modes and $f$-modes of neutron stars with gravitationally coupled dark matter: degeneracy with the symmetry energy
papers.abstract: Composition gravity ($g$) modes have been proposed as a probe of dark matter in neutron stars, on the basis of one-fluid models in which the dark matter is in chemical equilibrium with the neutrons. We computed in full general relativity the $g$- and $f$-modes of stars in which fermionic dark matter couples to the nucleons only through gravity, and inferred the dark mass fraction from NICER and GW170817 data with a prior that comprises $63$ nucleonic equations of state (EOSs) from Skyrme and relativistic mean-field functionals, among them the models of Dutra \textit{et al.} and of the compilation of Sun, Bhattiprolu and Lattimer. The data do not prefer dark matter and bound its mass fraction at $0.12 - 0.26$ ($95\%$) for particle masses of $0.5$--$2$~GeV. Coupled only through gravity, the dark matter reaches the buoyancy that restores a $g$-mode only through the gravitational field: a dark core holding $10\%$ of the mass raises the fundamental $g$-mode by $10-15\%$ at fixed EOS, several times less than in the one-fluid picture. The larger effect is indirect: a star with a dark core needs a stiffer nucleonic EOS, and since the $g$-mode is set by the density dependence of the symmetry energy, its frequency reflects the EOS that the star requires rather than the dark matter it contains; at fixed radius and symmetry energy a core holding $10\%$ of the mass is equivalent to a change of the slope $L$ of $9-12$~MeV. The $f$-mode, which follows the mean density, behaves differently: a dark core breaks the relation between the $f$-mode and the tidal deformability by about one percent, far outside the posterior spread of nucleonic stars.

classification.title_zh: 引力耦合暗物质中子星的组分 g 模和 f 模：与对称能的简并
classification.abstract_zh: 组分重力（g）模曾被提出作为中子星暗物质的探针，其依据是暗物质与中子处于化学平衡的单流体模型。我们在完整广义相对论中计算了费米子暗物质仅通过引力与核子耦合的恒星 g 模和 f 模，并用 63 个核子状态方程（来自 Skyrme 和相对论平均场泛函，包括 Dutra 等人模型及 Sun、Bhattiprolu 和 Lattimer 的汇编）作为先验，从 NICER 和 GW170817 数据推断暗物质质量分数。数据不偏好暗物质，并对粒子质量 0.5--2 GeV 给出质量分数上限 0.12--0.26（95%）。仅通过引力耦合时，暗物质只有通过引力场才能达到恢复 g 模的浮力：占质量 10% 的暗核在固定 EOS 下将基本 g 模提高 10--15%，比单流体图像小几倍。更大的效应是间接的：带暗核的星需要更硬的核子 EOS，而由于 g 模由对称能的密度依赖性决定，其频率反映的是星所需的 EOS，而不是其包含的暗物质；在固定半径和对称能下，占质量 10% 的暗核等效于对称能斜率 L 变化 9--12 MeV。f 模跟随平均密度，行为不同：暗核使 f 模与潮汐形变率的关系破坏约 1%，远超出核子星后验散布。
classification.one_liner: 在完整广义相对论下计算含仅引力耦合暗物质中子星的 g 模和 f 模，发现 g 模与对称能简并，f 模-潮汐形变关系被破坏约 1%。

papers.title: LazyTB: Extended LTB-solutions with Multiple Interacting Fluids
papers.abstract: We present a low entry barrier numerical code LazyTB that solves the Einstein equations in the ADM-formulation for a general spherically symmetric problem with an arbitrary number of fluids with user defined equations of state and optional interactions between the fluids mediated by drag-vectors. We present the ADM equations in terms of carefully chosen dimensionless variables that avoid some numerical instabilities by analytic cancellation of potentially diverging terms. We demonstrate the code by applying it to a number of examples including the standard LTB model, a model with radiation and dark matter, a polytropic dark energy model with a non-vanishing sound speed and a model with coupled interacting dark matter and dark energy. We also implement a suite of diagnostic tools, including ray-tracing algorithms, that allow extracting physical observables such as luminosity distances for observers at arbitrary locations from the simulations. The code is built to be easy to extend also beyond the late-universe applications considered in the examples of this paper. LazyTB is available at https://github.com/ollijvaisanen/LazyTB.

classification.title_zh: LazyTB：具有多种相互作用流体的扩展 LTB 解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出低门槛数值代码 LazyTB，它在 ADM 形式下求解 Einstein 方程，用于处理具有任意数量流体的一般球对称问题；流体状态方程由用户定义，并可选通过 drag-vector 介导的流体间相互作用。我们用精心选择的无量纲变量写出 ADM 方程，通过解析消去可能发散项来避免一些数值不稳定性。我们通过若干例子演示代码，包括标准 LTB 模型、包含辐射和暗物质的模型、具有非零声速的多方暗能量模型，以及耦合相互作用的暗物质-暗能量模型。我们还实现了一套诊断工具，包括光线追踪算法，可从模拟中提取物理可观测量，如任意位置观测者的光度距离。该代码易于扩展，也可用于本文例子之外的晚期宇宙应用。LazyTB 可在 https://github.com/ollijvaisanen/LazyTB 获取。
classification.one_liner: 发布并演示 LazyTB 数值代码，在 ADM 形式下求解球对称 Einstein 方程，支持多流体及相互作用，用于扩展 LTB 宇宙学模型和光线追踪观测。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文是经典广义相对论/宇宙学数值代码，不涉及 AdS/CFT、量子引力或全息对偶。

papers.title: Scalar Perturbations and Induced Gravitational Waves from First-Order Phase Transitions in Lattice Simulations
papers.abstract: Cosmological first-order phase transitions can generate curvature perturbations through inhomogeneous quantum tunneling, as studied previously on superhorizon scales. In this work, we for the first time conduct three-dimensional lattice simulations that incorporate scalar metric perturbations and radiation perturbations, covering a range from bubble wall scales to super-horizon scales. We obtain the precise scalar perturbation power spectrum and the probability density function of energy density perturbations. Furthermore, we simulate the gravitational-wave energy spectra generated by each source during the first-order phase transition, including the scalar field itself, scalar metric perturbations, and the energy density and velocity perturbations of radiation. For gravitational waves, the contribution from other sources can exceed $1/3$ of that from the scalar field at superhorizon scales. Additionally, we compare the effects of different values of the transition strength and rate on the results. This paper provides more accurate numerical results for research aimed at detecting or constraining first-order phase transitions via gravitational waves and curvature perturbations.

classification.title_zh: 格点模拟中一阶相变产生的标量扰动与诱导引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 宇宙学一阶相变可以通过非均匀量子隧穿产生曲率扰动，此前已在超视界尺度上被研究。在本工作中，我们首次进行了三维格点模拟，纳入标量度规扰动和辐射扰动，覆盖从气泡壁尺度到超视界尺度的范围。我们获得了精确的标量扰动功率谱以及能量密度扰动的概率密度函数。此外，我们模拟了一阶相变期间各个源产生的引力波能谱，包括标量场本身、标量度规扰动以及辐射的能量密度和速度扰动。对于引力波，在超视界尺度上，其他源的贡献可超过标量场贡献的 1/3。另外，我们比较了不同相变强度和速率取值对结果的影响。本文为旨在通过引力波和曲率扰动探测或限制一阶相变的研究提供了更精确的数值结果。
classification.one_liner: 三维格点模拟首次同时纳入标量度规与辐射扰动，计算一阶相变产生的标量扰动谱及多源诱导引力波谱，并比较相变强度与速率的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于宇宙学一阶相变、气泡成核及诱导引力波/标量扰动方向，涉及经典度规扰动与引力波；但不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Shadow signatures and near-horizon energy accumulation in coherent quantum sine-integral black holes
papers.abstract: Quantum modifications of black hole spacetimes can lead to observable departures from the predictions of classical general relativity, particularly in the strong-gravity regime near the event horizon. In this context, the coherent quantum black hole model introduces a sine-integral correction to the gravitational potential, characterized by a coherence scale \(R_s\), which softens the central singularity and alters the near-horizon geometry. Motivated by the growing precision of black hole imaging and strong-field observations, we explore how these quantum-induced effects influence photon motion and the resulting shadow structure. Considering representative values within the interval \(R_s \in [0.5M, 1.2M]\), we show that the photon sphere shifts inward while the critical impact parameter decreases, reaching values such as \(b_{\rm crit}\approx 4.764M\) for \(R_s=0.5M\). Consequently, the shadow radius becomes systematically smaller and develops a more intricate structure than in the Schwarzschild case (\(b_{\rm crit}=3\sqrt{3}M \approx 5.196M\)). The analysis of the corresponding intensity distributions also reveals a pronounced enhancement of radiation near the shadow boundary, especially for intermediate coherence scales. This feature can be attributed to photons remaining longer within the modified near-horizon region before escaping toward distant observers. Such an increase in brightness may therefore provide a possible observational signature of quantum corrections at horizon scales. Furthermore, although the geometry allows radiation and energy to accumulate around an effective horizon surface, its response to perturbations differs from that expected for compact objects with stable light rings. Instead of contracting under backreaction effects, the accumulation surface shifts outward.

classification.title_zh: 相干量子正弦积分黑洞的阴影特征与近视界能量积累
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞时空的量子修正可能导致与经典广义相对论预言的可观测偏离，尤其是在事件视界附近的强引力区域。在此背景下，相干量子黑洞模型对引力势引入正弦积分修正，由相干尺度 R_s 表征，该修正软化中心奇点并改变近视界几何。受黑洞成像与强场观测精度提高的推动，我们探讨这些量子诱导效应如何影响光子运动和由此产生的阴影结构。考虑 R_s ∈ [0.5M, 1.2M] 的代表性取值，我们证明光子球向内移动，临界碰撞参数减小；例如 R_s=0.5M 时 b_crit≈4.764M。因此阴影半径系统性变小，并形成比 Schwarzschild 情形（b_crit=3√3M≈5.196M）更复杂的结构。对相应强度分布的分析还显示，阴影边界附近辐射显著增强，尤其对于中等相干尺度。这一特征可归因于光子在逃逸到远处观测者之前在修正后的近视界区域停留更久。因此，这种亮度增加可能提供视界尺度量子修正的一种可能观测印记。此外，尽管该几何允许辐射与能量在有效视界面附近积累，其对扰动的响应不同于具有稳定光环的致密天体：积累面不会在反作用效应下收缩，而是向外移动。
classification.one_liner: 在相干量子正弦积分黑洞模型中，量子修正使光子球内移、阴影变小并在近视界增强辐射，或可作为量子修正的观测特征。

papers.title: Acceleration radiation, quasinormal modes and quasi-bound states in generic rotating regular black holes
papers.abstract: We study horizon-brightened acceleration radiation for a neutral scalar field in separable Kerr-like rotating metrics with nonlinear-electrodynamic mass profiles. The principal branch has $M=0$ and $\mu=3$, with finite but direction-dependent central curvature limits. An analytic extremal charge--spin parametrization fixes the black hole domain. At a simple outer horizon, the scalar equation reduces to local conformal quantum mechanics with corotating energy $\epsh=\omega-m\OmH$. For an isolated outgoing channel we derive the first finite-gap correction in proper time, including the radial Frobenius coefficient, angular variation, geodesic terms, and switching slope. This replaces a coordinate-dependent trajectory-phase multiplier by a protocol-defined detailed-balance affinity. Direct integration of the outgoing scalar equation and an equatorial infalling trajectory validates the expansion for an explicitly specified finite gate; a solvable logarithmic-mode limit separates switching from geometric contributions. We also analyze forced equatorial circular atoms and show that co-rotating and counter-rotating ultra-relativistic motion yields a mode-dependent orbital response rather than the infalling Hawking affinity. We identify the shrinking near-extremal radial scale and quantify the effect of an unselected second radial branch, without asserting a uniform extremal limit. Random atomic injection gives a selected-mode master equation and a nonnegative population entropy-production identity. A direct first-law integrability test shows why horizon-area bookkeeping remains conditional for this off-shell metric. Independently converged Chebyshev scalar quasinormal frequencies validate the WKB results and probe the exterior geometry beyond the leading horizon data. The calculation distinguishes branch-resolved horizon thermality, finite detector protocol, and exterior scalar dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 一般旋转正则黑洞中的加速辐射、准正规模与准束缚态
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有非线性电动力学质量剖面的可分离 Kerr 类旋转度规中，中性标量场的视界增亮加速辐射。主支具有 M=0 和 μ=3，中心曲率极限有限但依赖方向。一个解析极端电荷-自旋参数化固定了黑洞域。在简单外视界处，标量方程约化为局部共形量子力学，共转能量为 ε=ω−mΩ_H。对于孤立出射通道，我们推导了固有时中的首个有限间隙修正，包括径向 Frobenius 系数、角变化、测地线项和切换斜率。这将坐标依赖的轨迹相位乘子替换为由协议定义的细致平衡亲和度。直接积分出射标量方程和赤道坠落轨迹，对一个明确指定的有限门验证了该展开；一个可解的对数模极限将切换与几何贡献分离。我们还分析了受迫赤道圆原子，并表明共转与反转超相对论运动给出模式依赖的轨道响应，而非坠落 Hawking 亲和度。我们识别了收缩的近极端径向尺度，并量化了未选择第二径向分支的效应，同时不声称存在统一的极端极限。随机原子注入给出选定模式主方程和非负布居熵产生恒等式。直接的第一定律可积性检验表明，为什么对于该 off-shell 度规，视界面积记账仍然是条件性的。独立收敛的 Chebyshev 标量准正规模频率验证了 WKB 结果，并探测超越主导视界数据的外几何。该计算区分了分支分辨的视界热性、有限探测器协议和外标量动力学。
classification.one_liner: 研究一般旋转正则黑洞中标量场的加速辐射、准正规模与准束缚态，并用 Chebyshev 与 WKB 结果检验外几何。

papers.title: Kerr geodesics on conformal projection diagrams
papers.abstract: We provide a rigorous representation of timelike geodesics in the maximally extended Kerr spacetime, using projection diagrams introduced by Chru\'{s}ciel, \"{O}lz, and Szybka. In contrast to standard conformal diagrams, projection diagrams allow for plotting general causal curves (not necessarily confined to the two-dimensional surface associated with the diagram), preserving their causal characteristics. Our analysis utilizes two systems of horizon-penetrating coordinates (both ingoing and outgoing) to ensure a regular description of geodesics crossing the event and Cauchy horizons. On the other hand, at most four causal blocks can be joined smoothly by a Kruskal-Szekeres-type construction proposed for projection diagrams. Consequently, depicting a trajectory spanning several causal blocks may require more than one diagram, as the conformal factor either vanishes or diverges at the block boundaries.

classification.title_zh: 共形投影图上的 Kerr 测地线
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用 Chruściel、Ólz 和 Szybka 提出的投影图，对最大延拓 Kerr 时空中的类时测地线给出严格表示。与标准共形图不同，投影图允许绘制一般因果曲线（不限于与图相关的二维曲面），并保持其因果特征。我们的分析使用两套穿透视界的坐标（入射和出射），以确保对穿过事件视界和 Cauchy 视界的测地线有正则描述。另一方面，对于投影图，利用 Kruskal-Szekeres 型构造最多可将四个因果块光滑拼接。因此，描绘跨越多个因果块的轨迹可能需要多于一张图，因为共形因子在块边界处要么消失要么发散。
classification.one_liner: 利用投影图和穿透视界坐标，严格表示最大延拓 Kerr 时空中的类时测地线，并讨论跨因果块拼接的图示限制。

papers.title: Ringdown analysis of GW250114 with RingCWB
papers.abstract: The binary black hole merger GW250114, the loudest gravitational-wave signal detected to date, offers an opportunity to perform a precise test of Einstein's general relativity (GR). Its exceptionally high signal-to-noise ratio enables accurate measurements of the quasi-normal modes (QNMs) and properties of the remnant black hole. In this work, we present a ringdown analysis of GW250114 using the RingCWB algorithm. We measure the dominant $(2,2,0)$ QNM along with its first overtone and constrain the fractional deviations in frequency and damping time from their GR-predicted values, finding $\delta f_{220} = 0.004_{-0.023}^{+0.022}$ and $\delta\tau_{220} = 0.010_{-0.087}^{+0.096}$ , both consistent with zero within the quoted uncertainties. These results represent stringent constraints on deviations from GR. The analysis also places tight constraints on the remnant spin, consistent with a binary black hole formed through stellar evolution.

classification.title_zh: 用 RingCWB 对 GW250114 的铃宕分析
classification.abstract_zh: 双黑洞并合事件 GW250114 是迄今探测到的最强引力波信号，为精确检验爱因斯坦广义相对论（GR）提供了机会。其异常高的信噪比使得能够准确测量准正模（QNM）以及终态黑洞的性质。本工作使用 RingCWB 算法对 GW250114 进行铃宕分析。我们测量了主导的 (2,2,0) QNM 及其第一泛音，并约束频率和阻尼时间相对于 GR 预言值的分数偏离，得到 δf220 = 0.004_{-0.023}^{+0.022} 和 δτ220 = 0.010_{-0.087}^{+0.096}，二者在给定不确定度内均与零一致。这些结果给出了对偏离 GR 的严格约束。该分析还对终态黑洞自旋给出了紧约束，结果与通过恒星演化形成的双黑洞一致。
classification.one_liner: 利用 RingCWB 对迄今最响的 GW250114 做铃宕分析，测量 (2,2,0) QNM 及其第一泛音，并给出与 GR 一致的高精度频率和阻尼时间约束。

papers.title: Anisotropic Fluid Model for Massive Boson Stars: Spherically Symmetric Configurations
papers.abstract: Boson stars are among the best-studied exotic compact objects and constitute one of the few black-hole mimickers for which both the formation mechanism and dynamical behavior can be investigated from first principles. Constructing boson star solutions is generally more challenging than constructing neutron star solutions, often requiring either extremely accurate initial guesses for the oscillation frequency or the use of computationally intensive relaxation methods to solve the field equations. In the strong-coupling limit, massive boson stars can be described effectively as perfect- fluid configurations, enabling their construction using methods analogous to those developed for neutron stars. In this paper, we relax the strong-coupling assumption and derive a phenomenological anisotropic-fluid model for spherically symmetric massive boson stars that remains applicable over a broad range of model parameters. We provide ready-to-use fits for both the anisotropy profile and the effective equation of state in terms of the central scalar-field amplitude and the ratio of the self-interaction coupling constant to the squared scalar-field mass. To validate the model, we compute the masses and radii of boson stars using a standard neutron-star construction approach and compare the results against full boson-star calculations. We find excellent agreement between the two methods, while the new approach reduces the computational cost by a factor of about 10. Our phenomenological fluid framework offers an efficient and accurate method for constructing spherically symmetric massive boson stars and computing their observable properties. We provide a ready-to-use Python implementation of the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff solver, allowing users to construct boson star configurations within the proposed framework.

classification.title_zh: 大质量玻色星的各向异性流体模型：球对称构型
classification.abstract_zh: 玻色星是研究最充分的奇异致密天体之一，也是少数能够从第一性原理研究形成机制和动力学行为的黑洞模仿者之一。构造玻色星解通常比构造中子星解更困难，往往需要对振荡频率给出极其精确的初始猜测，或使用计算量很大的松弛方法求解场方程。在强耦合极限下，大质量玻色星可以有效地描述为完美流体构型，从而能够使用类似中子星的方法来构造。本文放松强耦合假设，推导了一个适用于球对称大质量玻色星的唯象各向异性流体模型，该模型在广泛模型参数范围内仍然适用。我们提供了可直接使用的拟合公式，用于给出各向异性剖面和有效状态方程，自变量为中心标量场振幅以及自相互作用耦合常数与标量场质量平方之比。为验证该模型，我们使用标准中子星构造方法计算玻色星的质量和半径，并将结果与完整的玻色星计算进行比较。我们发现两种方法之间吻合极好，同时新方法将计算成本降低了约10倍。我们的唯象流体框架为构造球对称大质量玻色星并计算其可观测性质提供了一种高效而准确的方法。我们提供了可直接使用的Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff求解器Python实现，使用户能够在该框架内构造玻色星构型。
classification.one_liner: 提出大质量玻色星的各向异性流体唯象模型，用TOV方法高效构造球对称构型，精度高且计算成本降低约10倍。

papers.title: Collisions of Multiple Black Holes: A Numerical Relativity Study
papers.abstract: Numerical relativity has a profound impact on gravitational theory and gravitational wave astronomy. In this work, we present a systematic study of the head-on collisions of multipule black hole systems within the framework of numerical relativity using the Baumgarte-Shapiro-Shibata-Nakamura (BSSN) formulation. The numerical simulations of the dynamical evolution of gravitational fields are computed using the AMSS-NCKU code. We report numerical results for black hole collisions in several symmetric and non-symmetric configurations, in which the black holes are initially at rest and are described by Bowen-York type initial data. Our results suggest that black hole systems with perfectly symmetric configurations (e.g., black holes located at the vertices of a regular polygon or a regular polyhedron) impose strong constraints on the emitted gravitational waves, and no gravitational kick arises in these symmetric systems. For regular polygonal configurations, the radiation is dominated by the plus polarization of the $l=2$, $m=0$ mode. For regular polyhedral configurations, all the quadrupole modes with $l=2$ nearly vanish, and gravitational wave amplitudes are strongly suppressed to the order of $10^{-4}$ or below, which is in accordance with an analysis based on the quadrupole approximation. Gravitational radiations from $m \ne 0$ modes become non-negligible only when non-symmetric configurations are encountered. Keywords: Numerical Relativity, Black Holes, Gravitational Waves, N-Body Systems

classification.title_zh: 多黑洞碰撞：一项数值相对论研究
classification.abstract_zh: 数值相对论对引力理论和引力波天文学有深远影响。本文在数值相对论框架下，使用 Baumgarte-Shapiro-Shibata-Nakamura（BSSN）形式，系统研究多个黑洞系统的头对头碰撞。引力场动力学演化的数值模拟由 AMSS-NCKU 代码完成。我们报告了几种对称和非对称构型下黑洞碰撞的数值结果，其中黑洞初始静止，并由 Bowen-York 型初始数据描述。结果表明，具有完全对称构型（例如黑洞位于正多边形或正多面体顶点）的黑洞系统会对发出的引力波施加很强的限制，这些对称系统中不会出现引力反冲。对于正多边形构型，辐射主要由 l=2、m=0 模式的加号偏振主导。对于正多面体构型，所有 l=2 四极模式几乎消失，引力波振幅被强烈压制到 10^{-4} 或更低量级，这与基于四极近似分析的结果一致。只有当遇到非对称构型时，来自 m ≠ 0 模式的引力辐射才变得不可忽略。
classification.one_liner: 用 BSSN 数值相对论研究多黑洞头对头碰撞，发现对称构型强烈限制引力波且无引力反冲。

papers.title: Toward a complete understanding of the properties of GW190521
papers.abstract: Interpreting GW190521 remains challenging due to its exceptionally high total mass and correspondingly small number of observable gravitational-wave cycles, which gives rise to degeneracies between different physical interpretations. Motivated by the outstanding questions surrounding the event, we present a comprehensive reanalysis of GW190521 using waveform models drawn from multiple families, including a model that includes both eccentricity and spin-precession. We find evidence that the source was highly eccentric, with an inferred eccentricity of $0.81^{+0.05}_{-0.01}$ at 5 Hz, and show that non-eccentric interpretations arise from failing to probe the high-likelihood region at large eccentricities. We further demonstrate that when eccentricity is included in the analysis, there is no indication of spin precession, suggesting that the apparent precession in quasicircular analyses is at least partially driven by an eccentricity--spin-precession degeneracy. While all waveform models favor a comparable-mass binary, one model admits a secondary mode at more asymmetric masses. We find a robust probability $(\geq97\%)$ that the primary black hole lies within the pair-instability supernova mass gap ($\sim60-130\,M_\odot$), whereas the probability that the secondary lies in the gap depends on the waveform model. Through inference of GW190521-like injections, we show that the waveform systematics observed in the analysis of GW190521 could arise from the response of models to unmodeled eccentricity, rather than from intrinsic differences between waveform models. When analyzing a quasicircular spin-precessing injection similar to GW190521, we find no significant model dependence in the inferred parameters. Finally, because the inferred eccentricity lies beyond the calibration regime of current models, we test its robustness by recovering highly eccentric numerical-relativity waveforms.

classification.title_zh: 走向对GW190521性质的完整理解
classification.abstract_zh: 解释GW190521仍然具有挑战性，因为其总质量异常高且可观测引力波周期相应很少，导致不同物理解释之间存在简并。受该事件未决问题启发，我们使用来自多个波形族的模型对GW190521进行综合再分析，其中包括一个同时包含偏心率和自旋进动的模型。我们发现证据表明源高度偏心，在5 Hz处推断偏心率为0.81^{+0.05}_{-0.01}，并表明非偏心解释源于未能探测大偏心率处的高似然区域。我们进一步证明，当分析中包含偏心率时，没有自旋进动的迹象，这表明准圆轨道分析中表观进动至少部分由偏心率-自旋进动简并驱动。尽管所有波形模型都支持质量相近的双星，但一个模型允许在质量更不对称时存在次级模式。我们发现主黑洞位于对不稳定性超新星质量间隙（约60-130 M⊙）内的概率稳健（≥97%），而次黑洞位于该间隙的概率取决于波形模型。通过对类GW190521注入的推断，我们表明在GW190521分析中观测到的波形系统误差可能源于模型对未建模偏心率的响应，而不是波形模型之间的内在差异。当分析一个类似GW190521的准圆自旋进动注入时，我们发现推断参数没有显著模型依赖性。最后，由于推断的偏心率超出当前模型的校准范围，我们通过恢复高度偏心的数值相对论波形来检验其稳健性。
classification.one_liner: 对GW190521的多波形再分析表明其高度偏心，偏心率-自旋进动简并可解释表观进动，主黑洞很可能位于对不稳定性质量间隙。

papers.title: Detector orientation matters: Consequences for gravitational-wave background detectability
papers.abstract: Cross-correlation searches for gravitational-wave backgrounds depend on the geometrical configuration (physical separation and relative orientation) of the detectors comprising the network. Applying standard techniques to a few simple examples, we illustrate how the relative orientation of a pair of Earth-based L-shaped laser interferometers can drastically impact the detectability of both isotropic and anisotropic gravitational-wave backgrounds.

classification.title_zh: 探测器取向很重要：对引力波背景可探测性的后果
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波背景的互相关搜索依赖于组成探测网络的探测器的几何构型（物理间距和相对取向）。我们将标准技术应用于几个简单例子，说明一对地基L形激光干涉仪的相对取向如何能显著影响各向同性和各向异性引力波背景的可探测性。
classification.one_liner: 地基L形干涉仪的相对取向会显著改变各向同性和各向异性引力波背景的互相关可探测性。

papers.title: Spin and Quadrupole Sectors in Nonrelativistic Gravity
papers.abstract: We study the large-\(c\) expansion of general relativity in ADM variables. Using a unified even \(\omega\)-expansion, the ADM formulation gives a common starting point for Galilean and Carrollian limits. We focus on the Galilean branch and derive the ADM action and field equations up to NNLO. We then construct stationary vacuum solutions of the Galilean ADM equations up to NNLO in weak and strong branches. In the weak branch, we find NLO Kerr-type, Hartle--Thorne-type and mixed-type solutions. The NLO weak equations also allow a simple extension to higher mass multipoles. At NNLO, the weak Kerr-type and extended Hartle--Thorne-type sectors solve the equations separately, but their naive sum is not a solution. The nonlinear NNLO equations generate mixed \(J^2Q\) source terms, which require additional corrections to the NNLO lapse and NNLO spatial tensor field. This gives a mixed weak-branch Galilean solution of the truncated NNLO equations in the ADM gauge, whose full relativistic completion is not fixed by the truncated data alone. In the strong branch, Kerr-type data solve the equations through NNLO while the strong Hartle--Thorne-type data solve the NLO equations. We also explain how the ADM data can be reconstructed order by order into approximate spacetime metrics. These reconstructed metrics should not be interpreted by themselves as unique full relativistic completions. Since these metrics include spin, quadrupole and mixed spin--quadrupole effects, they may be useful for studying the spacetime around rotating compact objects such as black holes and neutron stars.

classification.title_zh: 非相对论引力中的自旋与四极矩扇区
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在 ADM 变量下广义相对论的大 c 展开。采用统一的偶 ω 展开，ADM 表述为伽利略极限和卡罗尔极限提供共同起点。我们聚焦伽利略分支，推导 ADM 作用量和场方程至 NNLO。随后在弱分支和强分支构造伽利略 ADM 方程的定常真空解至 NNLO。在弱分支，我们找到 NLO Kerr 型、Hartle-Thorne 型和混合型解。NLO 弱场方程还允许简单推广到更高质量多极矩。在 NNLO，弱 Kerr 型和扩展 Hartle-Thorne 型扇区分别求解方程，但它们的朴素相加不是解。非线性 NNLO 方程产生混合的 J^2 Q 源项，需要对 NNLO lapse 和 NNLO 空间张量场做额外修正。这给出了 ADM 规范下截断 NNLO 方程的混合弱分支伽利略解，其完整相对论完成不由截断数据单独固定。在强分支，Kerr 型数据求解方程至 NNLO，而强 Hartle-Thorne 型数据求解 NLO 方程。我们还解释如何将 ADM 数据逐阶重构为近似时空度规。这些重构度规本身不应被解释为唯一的完整相对论完成。由于这些度规包含自旋、四极矩以及混合自旋-四极矩效应，它们可能有助于研究旋转致密天体（如黑洞和中子星）周围的时空。
classification.one_liner: 通过大 c ADM 展开研究非相对论引力，构造含自旋与四极矩的伽利略 NNLO 定常真空解及其近似度规。

papers.title: Timelike Geodesics of Regular Black Holes with Scalar Hair
papers.abstract: We investigate timelike geodesics in asymptotically flat regular black holes supported by a phantom scalar field characterized by a scalar charge $A$. This parameter removes the central singularity and continuously deforms the Schwarzschild geometry while preserving asymptotic flatness. We derive the equations of motion for massive test particles and classify bounded and unbounded trajectories in terms of the conserved energy and angular momentum. We determine circular and critical orbits, including the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO), and analyze the transition between capture and scattering. We show that the scalar charge modifies the location of the unstable and stable circular orbits, the ISCO, and the threshold angular momentum for scattering, exhibiting a nontrivial dependence on the radial coordinate. Their physical scales are naturally described in terms of the invariant areal radius $R(r)=\sqrt{r^2+A^2}$. In the weak-field regime, we compute the perihelion precession and obtain corrections proportional to $A^2$, allowing us to constrain the scalar charge from Solar System observations. We also analyze the motion with vanishing angular momentum and show that, while the qualitative structure of the trajectories remains connected to the Schwarzschild limit $A\to 0$, the quantitative deviations encode the geometric effects of the scalar hair.

classification.title_zh: 带标量毛的规则黑洞的类时测地线
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究由幻影标量场支撑的渐近平直规则黑洞中的类时测地线，该标量场由标量荷 A 表征。该参数消除了中心奇点，并在保持渐近平直性的同时连续形变 Schwarzschild 几何。我们推导了有质量检验粒子的运动方程，并依据守恒能量和角动量对束缚与无界轨道进行分类。我们确定了圆轨道和临界轨道，包括最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO），并分析了捕获与散射之间的转变。我们表明，标量荷会改变不稳定圆轨道、稳定圆轨道、ISCO 以及散射阈值角动量的位置，并呈现出对径向坐标的非平凡依赖。其物理尺度自然由不变面积半径 R(r)=sqrt(r^2+A^2) 描述。在弱场情形下，我们计算了近日点进动，并得到正比于 A^2 的修正，从而可由太阳系观测约束标量荷。我们还分析了角动量为零的运动，并表明尽管轨道定性结构与 Schwarzschild 极限 A→0 保持联系，定量偏离编码了标量毛的几何效应。
classification.one_liner: 研究带标量毛规则黑洞中类时测地线、ISCO、散射阈值与弱场近日点进动修正。

papers.title: Scaling similarity and generalised conformal symmetry in D2-brane holography
papers.abstract: We study D2-brane holography within the purely dilatonic sector of four-dimensional maximal ISO(7)-gauged supergravity, obtained as a consistent truncation of type IIA supergravity on S$^6$. In the dual frame, the four-dimensional Lagrangian resulting from the reduction of the massless IIA theory exhibits scaling similarity, thus reflecting the generalised conformal symmetry of the dual three-dimensional maximally supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory. Using an auxiliary spacetime construction, we show that the holographic CFT$_3$ fixed points and RG-flows known in the massive IIA theory have natural counterparts in the massless IIA theory: QFT$_3$s with generalised conformal symmetry connected by generalised RG-flows, which we construct numerically. We also revisit the Coulomb branch solutions and propose an extension of Gubser's singularity criterion to supergravity theories exhibiting scaling similarity.

classification.title_zh: D2-膜全息中的标度相似性与广义共形对称性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在四维最大 ISO(7)-规范超引力的纯膨胀子扇区中研究 D2-膜全息，该扇区由 IIA 型超引力在 S^6 上的相容截断得到。在对偶框架中，由无质量 IIA 理论约化得到的四维拉格朗日量表现出标度相似性，从而反映对偶三维最大超对称 Yang-Mills 理论的广义共形对称性。利用辅助时空构造，我们证明：在 massive IIA 理论中已知的全息 CFT3 不动点和 RG 流，在 massless IIA 理论中有自然对应物——具有广义共形对称性的 QFT3，并由广义 RG 流连接；我们数值构造了这些流。我们还重新审视 Coulomb 分支解，并提出将 Gubser 奇性判据推广到表现出标度相似性的超引力理论。
classification.one_liner: 在 D2-膜全息中研究无质量 IIA 理论表现出的标度相似性，并构造具有广义共形对称性的三维 QFT 之间的广义 RG 流。

papers.title: Entanglement Wedge Reconstruction Beyond the Large N Limit via the Twirled Petz Map
papers.abstract: Entanglement wedge reconstruction provides the sharpest formulation of bulk locality in AdS/CFT, identifying the entanglement wedge as the largest bulk region reconstructible from a boundary subregion. While this statement is well understood at leading order in the large N expansion through both modular flow and Petz map reconstruction, its extension beyond the semiclassical regime has remained unclear. In this work, we show that quantum error correction provides the natural framework for addressing this problem. At leading order, we reproduce the known leading-order reconstruction formulas, and by employing the twirled Petz map, we obtain a systematic and explicit method for incorporating subleading 1/N corrections. Beyond the leading approximation, we have obtained a bi-local correction controlled by a subleading Petz kernel. Our results establish a controlled approach to bulk reconstruction beyond large N and sharpening the role of quantum error correction in holography. This framework provides a controlled path toward understanding bulk reconstruction in fully quantum gravitational settings.

classification.title_zh: 通过扭转Petz映射超越大N极限的纠缠楔重构
classification.abstract_zh: 纠缠楔重构为AdS/CFT中的体局域性提供了最精确的表述，将纠缠楔认定为可从边界子区域重构的最大体区域。虽然这一陈述在大N展开的领头阶通过模流和Petz映射重构已得到很好理解，但其在半经典区域之外的推广仍不清楚。在本工作中，我们表明量子纠错为处理这一问题提供了自然框架。在领头阶，我们重现了已知的领头阶重构公式，并通过采用扭转Petz映射，获得了一种系统且明确的方法来纳入次领头1/N修正。超越领头近似，我们得到了一个由次领头Petz核控制的双局域修正。我们的结果建立了一种超越大N的可控体重构方法，并强化了量子纠错在全息中的角色。该框架为理解完全量子引力设定下的体重构提供了一条可控路径。
classification.one_liner: 利用扭转Petz映射在量子纠错框架下系统纳入1/N修正，实现超越大N极限的纠缠楔重构。

papers.title: de Sitter and S-folds in type IIB from $\mathcal{N} = 4$ $D = 4$ gauged supergravity
papers.abstract: In this paper, we classify the type IIB uplifts of the $\mathcal{N}=4$ $D=4$ pure $\text{SO}(4)$-gauged supergravity admitting a dS$_4$ solution. As for their AdS cousins, the internal geometries of these uplifts consist of two $S^2$ fibred over a Riemann surface $\Sigma$, and are classified by pairs of harmonic functions $h_{1,\,2}$ on $\Sigma$, providing a new family of de Sitter solutions in type IIB. Choosing specific functions $h_{1,\,2}$ on $\Sigma = \mathbb{R} \times I$, we perform an S-fold quotient of the internal space along its non-compact direction. This S-folding allows us to evade the assumptions of the Maldacena-Nunez no-go theorem and provides a classical de Sitter solution of type IIB supergravity with finite and non-vanishing four-dimensional effective Newton constant.

classification.title_zh: 来自 N=4 D=4 规范超引力的 type IIB 中的 de Sitter 与 S-folds
classification.abstract_zh: 本文分类了容许 dS4 解的 N=4 D=4 纯 SO(4) 规范超引力的 type IIB 提升。与它们的 AdS 对应类似，这些提升的内部几何由两个 S^2 纤维化在黎曼面 Σ 上构成，并由 Σ 上的一对调和函数 h_{1,2} 分类，提供了 type IIB 中新的 de Sitter 解族。选取 Σ = R × I 上的特定函数 h_{1,2}，我们沿内部空间的非紧致方向进行 S-fold 商。这种 S-folding 使我们能够避开 Maldacena-Nunez no-go 定理的假设，并给出 type IIB 超引力的经典 de Sitter 解，其四维有效牛顿常数为有限且非零。
classification.one_liner: 分类并构造了 N=4 D=4 规范超引力提升到 type IIB 的新 dS4 解，并通过 S-fold 商绕过 Maldacena-Nunez 禁阻定理得到经典 de Sitter 解。

papers.title: The Normalised Wigner Negativity Rate as a Second-Moment Probe of Infall in AdS$_3$
papers.abstract: In spread complexity, the growth rate of the average position of a time-evolved state along its Krylov chain recovers the proper radial momentum of an infalling particle in AdS. It is, however, a measure of the first moment only, irrespective of the spread of the wavepacket away from its classical trajectory. The rate of a normalized Krylov-Wigner negativity can be proposed as a diagnostic of the second moment of the boundary state that captures this spreading. Starting with the seed-normalized Krylov-Wigner distribution, that is, the Wigner transform of the descendant cloud with the decaying return amplitude divided out, we obtain an analytic Bessel form in the macroscopic limit and compute its total negativity explicitly. Retaining the Bessel variable all the way through, we find that the negativity goes as $\sinh^{4\Delta}(\pi t/\beta)$. But the raw normalized-state negativity saturates to an $O(1)$ constant, well below the $O(\sqrt{D})$ bound. Using the exact negative binomial statistics of the Krylov chain, the normalized negativity is at late times a fixed power of the second moment of the Krylov wavepacket, $\mathcal{N}(t)\propto[\mathrm{Var}(\hat{N}_{\mathrm{Krylov}})]^{\Delta}$, for every $\Delta>1/2$. The relation linearizes precisely at $\Delta=1$. In this regime via the momentum dictionary of Caputa et al. (arXiv:2410.23334), the rate becomes the product of the proper radial position and momentum, $\mathcal{R}\propto\mathcal{C}\,P_\rho$, which we interpret as the rate of the tidal stretch of nearby geodesics falling into the horizon. We also comment briefly on a speculative direction for future research, in particular the interpretation of the transverse string size operator in terms of the Krylov number operator through the common $\mathrm{SU}(1,1)$ discrete series.

classification.title_zh: 归一化维格纳负性率作为 AdS_3 中内落运动的二阶矩探针
classification.abstract_zh: 在 spread complexity 中，时间演化态沿 Krylov 链平均位置的增长率可以还原 AdS 中下落粒子的固有径向动量。然而，它只测量一阶矩，不包含波包偏离经典轨迹的展宽。归一化 Krylov-Wigner 负性率可被提出作为边界态二阶矩的诊断量，从而刻画这种展宽。从种子归一化 Krylov-Wigner 分布出发，即把衰减返回振幅除掉后的后继态云的 Wigner 变换，我们在宏观极限下得到解析的 Bessel 形式，并显式计算其总负性。全程保留 Bessel 变量后，我们发现负性按 sinh^{4Δ}(πt/β) 增长。但原始归一化态负性饱和到 O(1) 常数，远低于 O(√D) 上界。利用 Krylov 链的精确负二项统计，归一化负性在晚期是 Krylov 波包二阶矩的固定幂次，N(t) ∝ [Var(N_Krylov)]^Δ，对任意 Δ>1/2 成立；该关系在 Δ=1 处精确线性化。在此区间，借助 Caputa 等人 (arXiv:2410.23334) 的动量字典，该速率变为固有径向位置与动量的乘积，R ∝ C P_ρ，我们将其解释为落入视界的邻近测地线潮汐拉伸率。我们还简要评论了一个推测性未来方向，特别是通过共同的 SU(1,1) 离散系列，将横向弦尺度算符解释为 Krylov 数算符。
classification.one_liner: 用归一化 Krylov-Wigner 负性率刻画 AdS_3 中下落波包的二阶矩，并联系邻近测地线的潮汐拉伸率。

papers.title: Scale-separated vacua with extended supersymmetry
papers.abstract: We propose the first examples of scale-separated vacua with extended supersymmetry. They arise as circle compactifications of four-dimensional vacua of massive type IIA supergravity with scale separation, upon introducing additional fluxes and sources. We provide both the ten-dimensional solutions and the three-dimensional effective descriptions in terms of K\"ahler potential and superpotential. The conformal dimensions of the putative dual two-dimensional field theory appear not to be integers. The superpotential for the additional fluxes of one of our models was guessed by ChatGPT and, to the best of our knowledge, it does not appear in existing literature. Should these vacua be solutions of string theory, they would allow to address the open problem of scale separation from the vantage point of extended supersymmetry.

classification.title_zh: 具有扩展超对称的尺度分离真空
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了首批具有扩展超对称的尺度分离真空的例子。它们来自四维大质量 IIA 型超引力中具有尺度分离的真空的圆紧致化，并引入额外的通量和源。我们给出了十维解以及以 Kähler 势和超势表示的三维有效描述。假定的对偶二维场论的共形维数似乎不是整数。我们其中一个模型额外通量的超势是由 ChatGPT 猜测的，据我们所知，它未出现在现有文献中。如果这些真空是弦论解，它们将允许从扩展超对称的视角处理尺度分离这一未决问题。

papers.title: Properties of black holes in non-linear electrodynamics
papers.abstract: We investigate the properties of charged black hole geometries in nonlinear electrodynamics. We focus on the recently reported analytic charged black hole solutions to illustrate the consequences of a non-monotonic lapse function that exists for a wide range of black hole solutions. The spacetime admits stable light-rings, static near-horizon observers, and trapped near horizon photon orbits. We also show that although these modifications near the horizon are screened from afar, they nonetheless lead to additional branches of quasinormal modes for the black hole that are longer lived than the canonical Einstein branches.

classification.title_zh: 非线性电动力学中黑洞的性质
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了非线性电动力学中带电黑洞几何的性质。我们聚焦于近期报道的解析带电黑洞解，以说明在广泛黑洞解中存在的非单调 lapse 函数的后果。该时空允许稳定的光环、静态近视界观测者以及被困在近视界的光子轨道。我们还表明，尽管这些近视界修正从远处被屏蔽，但它们仍导致黑洞出现额外分支的准正规模，这些模式比标准的爱因斯坦分支寿命更长。
classification.one_liner: 非线性电动力学带电黑洞的非单调 lapse 函数导致稳定光环、近视界光子囚禁以及更长寿命的额外准正规模分支。

papers.title: State-dependent geometries from magic-enriched quantum codes
papers.abstract: Quantum error-correcting codes provide a powerful framework for emergent spacetime, yet existing subsystem erasure-correcting holographic code models describe only quantum fields on a fixed background: in such codes, the entropic area term is state independent and cannot capture gravitational backreaction. We argue that this limitation is intrinsic to exact subsystem complementary recovery and that incorporating backreaction naturally leads to approximate quantum error correction. We introduce a Ryu-Takayanagi-like entropy decomposition for approximate subsystem erasure-correcting codes, defining bulk matter entropy via optimal recovery and a complementary proto-area entropy as the difference between boundary entropy and recoverable bulk entropy. For a broad class of skewed quantum codes obtained by small nonlocal perturbations of exact codes, the proto-area increases monotonically with bulk entropy, closely aligning with the changes in extremal surface areas in gravitational systems. We identify the origin of this response as a form of tripartite non-local magic in the Choi state of the encoding map, which vanishes in stabilizer codes and controls the leading matter-geometry coupling in approximate subsystem erasure-correcting codes.

classification.title_zh: 从魔法增强量子码得到态依赖几何
classification.abstract_zh: 量子纠错码为涌现时空提供了强大框架，然而现有的子系统擦除纠错全息码模型只描述固定背景上的量子场：在这类码中，熵的面积项与态无关，无法刻画引力反作用。我们认为这一局限是精确子系统互补恢复所固有的，并指出纳入反作用会自然导致近似量子纠错。我们为近似子系统擦除纠错码引入了一个类Ryu-Takayanagi熵分解，通过最优恢复定义体物质熵，并将互补的原面积熵定义为边界熵与可恢复体熵之差。对于通过对精确码施加小非局域微扰得到的一大类偏斜量子码，原面积随体熵单调增加，与引力系统中极值面面积的变化密切吻合。我们将这种响应的起源识别为编码映射的Choi态中一种三方非局域magic，它在稳定子码中消失，并控制近似子系统擦除纠错码中的主导物质-几何耦合。

papers.title: Generalised anomalies, QCD$_4$, and holography
papers.abstract: During the last decade, the notion of an 't Hooft anomaly has been generalised to the case of discrete symmetries. An interesting instance, discussed by Tanizaki, is the mixed anomaly between the discrete axial symmetry and the flavour and baryonic symmetries in massless QCD$_4$. The goal of this note is to provide a derivation of this anomaly from a top-down holographic dual of QCD$_4$. It is found that the topological couplings in the bulk supergravity dual of the D4-D8 system encode Tanizaki's anomaly, once fluctuations around the bulk gauge fields are turned on. A technical challenge for this computation is the difficulty in maintaining gauge invariance of supergravity theories in the presence of D-branes. To overcome this issue, a compact formulation of the flux sector of (massive) type IIA supergravity in the presence of D8 branes is presented. A crucial ingredient in the analysis is the need for smearing the D8 branes, in order to impose $\tau$-shift invariance on the fluctuation ansatz.

classification.title_zh: 广义反常、QCD$_4$ 与全息
classification.abstract_zh: 在过去十年中，'t Hooft 反常的概念已被推广到离散对称性的情形。Tanizaki 讨论的一个有趣例子是无质量 QCD$_4$ 中离散轴对称性与味对称性和重子对称性之间的混合反常。本文的目标是从 QCD$_4$ 的自上而下全息对偶出发给出该反常的推导。研究发现，一旦开启体规范场周围的涨落，D4-D8 系统的体超引力对偶中的拓扑耦合就编码了 Tanizaki 的反常。该计算的一个技术挑战是，在存在 D-膜时保持超引力理论规范不变性的困难。为克服这一问题，本文给出了存在 D8 膜时（有质量）IIA 型超引力通量扇区的一种紧致表述。分析中的一个关键要素是需要对 D8 膜进行涂抹，以便对涨落拟设施加 τ-shift 不变性。
classification.one_liner: 从 D4-D8 全息对偶的体超引力拓扑耦合推导无质量 QCD$_4$ 中的离散轴-味-重子混合反常。

papers.title: Universal Relations Meet Causality: Bounding the Dynamical Love Number of Neutron Stars
papers.abstract: The frequency-dependent tidal response of a neutron star is constrained by causality, reality and passivity, which turn a suitably rescaled response into a holomorphic self-map of the upper complex frequency half-plane after some suitable conditions. The Schwarz--Pick theorem then bounds the leading dynamical correction to the tidal deformability from above. In this work we confront this bound with the most recent calculations of the dynamical tidal response in the literature which have also shown that the static tidal deformability and its correction at second order in frequency are tightly correlated. We find that the bound is saturated to within a few per cent, a quantitative confirmation of f-mode dominance in the relativistic regime. The combination of the static deformability with an independent determination of the f-mode frequency thus may provide an equation-of-state-independent upper limit on the dynamical tide.

classification.title_zh: 普遍关系与因果性相遇：限制中子星的动力学 Love 数
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星的频率依赖潮汐响应受到因果性、实性与被动性的约束；在适当条件下，经重标度的响应函数成为上半复频率平面上的全纯自映射。Schwarz--Pick 定理由此给出潮汐形变率领头动力学修正的上界。本文将这一上界与文献中最新动力学潮汐响应计算进行对照，这些计算也表明静态潮汐形变率及其在频率二阶的修正紧密相关。我们发现该上界在百分之几的精度内被饱和，定量确认了相对论区域中 f 模的主导地位。将静态形变率与独立确定的 f 模频率结合，可能给出一个不依赖状态方程的动力学潮汐上限。
classification.one_liner: 因果性与全纯性导出的 Schwarz--Pick 上界被中子星动力学潮汐响应的最新计算在百分之几内饱和，支持相对论区域中 f 模主导。

papers.title: Gravitational Waves and Nambu-Goldstone Bosons from Infrared-Finite Cosmic Strings
papers.abstract: Skyrmion lines and semi-local strings are examples of infrared-finite cosmic strings that arise in theories with spontaneously broken global symmetries. Unlike global $U(1)$ strings, they do not support the long-range Nambu-Goldstone boson (NGB) profile responsible for a logarithmically infrared-divergent string tension. We argue that NGB emission from their low-frequency oscillations is strongly suppressed. Consequently, their gravitational-wave signals may be comparable to those from local strings.

papers.title: Regular black holes do not violate the first law of thermodynamics
papers.abstract: Regular black holes in general relativity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics have been reported to exhibit an apparent mismatch in their thermodynamics: the temperature obtained by differentiating the mass along the family of regular metrics differs from the Hawking temperature by a factor $\Xi$, and the first law seems to need a modified entropy or a corrected internal energy. We examine this question for an electrically charged family of regular black holes in $D\geq4$ dimensions whose metrics reduce to the Bardeen and Hayward geometries in four dimensions. The source is written as a Hamiltonian density $H(P)$ with fixed couplings and no solution parameters. This theory has a two-parameter family of static solutions, of which the regular metrics form a one-parameter subfamily. We prove analytically that on the whole solution space the standard first law of thermodynamics holds with the Hawking temperature, the area entropy and the horizon potential, in agreement with the general first law for nonlinear electrodynamics. The factor $\Xi$ appears when the mass is differentiated along the regular metric family at fixed length parameter, a variation that moves through the space of theories and also changes the conserved charge. We show that $\Xi^{-1}$ is the Jacobian of this projection, equal to the fraction of the mass inside the horizon, give its general form for an arbitrary regular mass function, and show that $\Xi^{-1}dM_{ADM}$ is not a closed one-form on the two-parameter metric family, so this correction cannot be the differential of a local state function there. We also point out that the Legendre map between the $F$ and $P$ frames degenerates at a radius that lies outside the horizon of near-extremal solutions in $D\geq5$.

classification.title_zh: 规则黑洞不违反热力学第一定律
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论与非线性电动力学耦合的框架中，规则黑洞曾被报道在其热力学上存在表观不匹配：沿规则度规族对质量求导得到的温度与 Hawking 温度相差一个因子 Ξ，并且第一定律似乎需要修正熵或修正内能。我们针对 D≥4 维的一类带电梯规则黑洞研究这一问题，其度规在四维退化为 Bardeen 和 Hayward 几何。源被写为具有固定耦合且不含解参数的哈密顿密度 H(P)。该理论具有双参数静态解族，其中规则度规构成一个单参数子族。我们解析证明，在整个解空间上，标准热力学第一定律以 Hawking 温度、面积熵和视界势成立，这与非线性电动力学的一般第一定律一致。因子 Ξ 出现在固定长度参数下沿规则度规族对质量求导时，这种变分穿过理论空间并改变守恒荷。我们证明 Ξ^{-1} 是这一投影的 Jacobian，等于视界内质量占比，给出任意规则质量函数的一般形式，并表明 Ξ^{-1}dM_ADM 在双参数度规族上不是闭一形式，因此该修正不能是该处局部状态函数的微分。我们还指出，在 D≥5 的近极端解中，F 与 P 框架之间的 Legendre 映射在一个位于视界之外的半径处退化。
classification.one_liner: 该文解析证明规则黑洞在整个双参数解空间上满足标准热力学第一定律，并说明表观 Ξ 因子来自沿规则子族投影的雅可比，而非局部状态函数修正。

papers.title: Probing beyond the Cosmic Horizon
papers.abstract: There are reasons to believe that the region of uniform curvature that we observe within our horizon is perhaps a tiny patch, much smaller than the length scales of inhomogeneity and global connectivity of an extremely complicated manifold. However, the recent supernova (SN) results suggest that the horizon scale could be comparable to or even much larger than curvature radius. Non trivial global structure too tends to be of the order of the local curvature scale. Probing (slightly) beyond the cosmic horizon can potentially reveal nontrivial global structure lurking around or just beyond the horizon scale. The cosmic microwave background (CMB) anisotropy is a sensitive probe of the universe on length scales up to and somewhats beyond the horizon scale and is perhaps poised to detect or put interesting limits on nontrivial features the global structure. This point is exemplified by high CMB anisotropy signal of the Elliptical topology in a large fraction of the revised parameter space of the closed FRW universe (spherical geometry) currently preferred by SN observations.

classification.title_zh: 探测宇宙视界之外
classification.abstract_zh: 有理由相信，我们在视界内观测到的均匀曲率区域可能只是一个极小的斑块，远小于一个极其复杂流形的非均匀性和整体连通性的长度尺度。然而，最近的超新星（SN）结果表明，视界尺度可能与曲率半径相当，甚至远大于曲率半径。非平凡的全局结构也趋向于局域曲率尺度的量级。探测（略微）超出宇宙视界，可能揭示潜藏在视界尺度附近或刚刚超出视界尺度的非平凡全局结构。宇宙微波背景（CMB）各向异性是探测宇宙在直至并略微超过视界尺度上的敏感探针，或许有望探测到全局结构的非平凡特征，或对其给出有意义的限制。最近被超新星观测偏好的闭合 FRW 宇宙（球面几何）的修正参数空间中，椭圆拓扑对应的高 CMB 各向异性信号在一个大参数比例上体现了这一点。

papers.title: Third-order scalar induced gravitational waves during a matter-dominated era: secular growth and implications for primordial black hole domination
papers.abstract: We investigate scalar induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) at third-order during a matter-dominated (MD) era. We classify the sources into four parts---built from three first-order scalars, and from a first-order scalar times the second-order tensor, vector, and scalar perturbations---and obtain all four kernel functions analytically in closed form. Unlike their radiation-dominated counterparts, the MD kernel functions grow secularly, translating into a rapid growth of the spectrum, $\Omega^{(3)}_{\mathrm{GW}}\propto x^{6}$ versus $\Omega^{(2)}_{\mathrm{GW}}\propto x^{2}$ at $x\equiv k\eta\gg1$. We derive the third-order power spectrum as a five-fold integral for a general primordial spectrum, and evaluate it numerically for a monochromatic one, where all contributions from the second-order vector source vanish identically. As an application, we consider the early MD era driven by primordial black holes (PBHs) before their evaporation. Requiring that the induced gravitational waves do not backreact on the cosmological perturbations, $\int\mathrm{d}\ln k\, \Omega^{\mathrm{tot}}_{\mathrm{GW}}<1$ then bounds the initial PBH abundance as $\Omega_{\mathrm{PBH},f}\lesssim4.6\times10^{-7}\, (m_{\mathrm{PBH}}/10^{7}\,\mathrm{g})^{-0.48}$, about three orders of magnitude stronger than the second-order-only bound. Our results indicate that higher-order SIGWs inevitably become nonperturbative during a sufficiently long MD era, with important implications for scenarios involving an early matter domination.

classification.title_zh: 物质主导时代的三阶标量诱导引力波：长期增长及对原初黑洞主导的启示
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究物质主导（MD）时代的三阶标量诱导引力波（SIGWs）。我们将源分为四部分——由三个一阶标量构成，以及由一阶标量乘以二阶张量、矢量和标量扰动构成——并以闭式解析形式获得全部四个核函数。与辐射主导情形不同，MD核函数会长期增长，从而导致谱的快速增长，当 x≡kη≫1 时，Ω^{(3)}_{GW}∝x^6，而 Ω^{(2)}_{GW}∝x^2。我们推导了一般原初谱下三阶功率谱的五重积分，并对单色谱进行了数值计算，其中来自二阶矢量源的所有贡献恒为零。作为一个应用，我们考虑原初黑洞（PBHs）在其蒸发前驱动的早期MD时代。要求诱导引力波不对宇宙学扰动产生反作用，即 ∫d ln k Ω^{tot}_{GW}<1，会给出初始PBH丰度的上限 Ω_{PBH,f}≲4.6×10^{-7}(m_{PBH}/10^7 g)^{-0.48}，比仅考虑二阶的界限强约三个数量级。我们的结果表明，在足够长的MD时代中，高阶SIGWs不可避免地会变为非微扰的，这对涉及早期物质主导的情形具有重要意义。
classification.one_liner: 物质主导时期三阶标量诱导引力波核函数呈长期增长，使PBH丰度上限比二阶结果强约三个数量级。

papers.title: Charged soliton--black hole phase transitions in three-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity
papers.abstract: We construct a magnetic soliton by double Wick rotating the static electrically charged black hole in three-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity. We match the boundary metrics and Maxwell sources under the chosen boundary condition and compute the difference of the renormalized Euclidean actions. Because the Maxwell potential grows logarithmically at infinity, the chosen finite Maxwell boundary term changes both the fixed Maxwell source and the renormalized action. The charge contributions for both the soliton and the black hole appear with plus signs in $\Delta I^{(c_{\mathrm{fin}})}$. For the grand-canonical boundary condition $c_{\mathrm{fin}}=1$, the black-hole and soliton branches can cross with different slopes. For the example considered below, the black-hole branch satisfying the response conditions ends at a maximum temperature, and the coexistence curve has a $T\to0^+$ endpoint at two opposite values of the spatial Maxwell source. At a nonextremal crossing, the entropy difference is $S_b-S_s=S_b$. For these two static solutions, equality of both current components requires both charges to vanish.

classification.title_zh: 三维 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中的带电孤子--黑洞相变
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过双 Wick 旋转三维 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中的静态带电黑洞，构造了一个磁孤子。我们在所选边界条件下匹配边界度规与 Maxwell 源，并计算重整化欧几里得作用量之差。由于 Maxwell 势在无穷远处呈对数增长，所选的有限 Maxwell 边界项同时改变固定的 Maxwell 源和重整化作用量。孤子与黑洞的电荷贡献在 $\Delta I^{(c_{\mathrm{fin}})}$ 中均以正号出现。对于巨正则边界条件 $c_{\mathrm{fin}}=1$，黑洞支与孤子支可以以不同斜率相交。在下面考虑的示例中，满足响应条件的黑洞支终止于一个最高温度，共存曲线在两个相反的空间 Maxwell 源值处具有 $T\to0^+$ 端点。在非极端相交处，熵差为 $S_b-S_s=S_b$。对于这两个静态解，要求两个流分量相等将使两个电荷都为零。

papers.title: Where the Gauss--Bonnet coupling enters the Bondi--Sachs hierarchy
papers.abstract: We integrate the Bondi--Sachs hierarchy of scalar--Gauss--Bonnet gravity with an arbitrary coupling function $f(\Phi)$ and a radiating massless scalar, and determine the first order in $1/r$ at which the coupling $\lambda$ becomes visible in each field equation. We obtain the asymptotic falloff of the effective Gauss--Bonnet stress tensor together with its leading coefficients in covariant form on the sphere: every component decays between one and three powers of $1/r$ faster than the slowest falloff compatible with a smooth null infinity. As a consequence, (i) the Bondi mass-loss formula and the evolution equation of the angular-momentum aspect are those of the minimally coupled Einstein--scalar system, a statement that is exact in $\lambda$ under the assumption of a smooth expansion; (ii) the coupling generates no logarithmic terms through the orders considered, even though the Horndeski representation of the theory involves logarithmic functionals; and (iii) the coupling first enters a dynamical equation in the evolution of the $O(r^{-3})$ coefficient of the angular metric, through the cross term $-2\lambda f'(\vp_0)\,\vp_1\,\partial_u N_{AB}$ between the asymptotic scalar charge aspect and the time derivative of the news. In Newman--Penrose form, the evolution equation of the leading coefficient of $\Psi_0$ acquires the source $-12\lambda f'(\vp_0)\,\vp_1\bar\Psi_4^0$, while those of $\Psi_1$ and $\Psi_2$ are unchanged. The Gauss--Bonnet invariant decays as $r^{-6}$ and affects the scalar hierarchy only from the evolution of the $r^{-5}$ coefficient onward. For vacuum black-hole spacetimes, where the scalar is sourced by the coupling itself, all these effects are of order $\lambda^2$; if $f'(\vp_0)=0$ they are pushed one further order in $1/r$.

classification.title_zh: Gauss--Bonnet 耦合在 Bondi--Sachs 层级中的进入位置
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将标量--Gauss--Bonnet 引力的 Bondi--Sachs 层级与任意耦合函数 f(Φ) 及一个辐射无质量标量场结合起来，并确定耦合 λ 在每个场方程中从 1/r 的哪一阶开始可见。我们得到有效 Gauss--Bonnet 应力张量的渐近衰减，以及其在球面上协变形式的首阶系数：与光滑零无穷远相容的最慢衰减相比，每个分量都额外衰减 1 到 3 个 1/r 幂次。因此，(i) 在光滑展开假设下，Bondi 质量损失公式和角动量 aspect 的演化方程与最小耦合 Einstein--标量系统相同，这一结论对 λ 精确成立；(ii) 在所考虑的阶数内，耦合不产生对数项，尽管该理论的 Horndeski 表述涉及对数泛函；(iii) 耦合首次进入动力学方程是在角向度规 O(r^{-3}) 系数的演化中，通过渐近标量荷 aspect 与 news 的时间导数之间的交叉项 -2λ f'(φ_0) φ_1 ∂_u N_{AB}。在 Newman--Penrose 形式中，Ψ_0 的首阶系数的演化方程获得源项 -12λ f'(φ_0) φ_1  arΨ_4^0，而 Ψ_1 和 Ψ_2 的演化方程不变。Gauss--Bonnet 不变量以 r^{-6} 衰减，并且只从 r^{-5} 系数的演化开始影响标量层级。对于真空黑洞时空，标量由耦合自身作为源，所有这些效应均为 λ^2 阶；若 f'(φ_0)=0，它们被推到 1/r 的再高一阶。
classification.one_liner: 在标量–Gauss–Bonnet 引力的 Bondi–Sachs 渐近层级中，耦合 λ 首次在角向度规 O(r^{-3}) 演化中动力学出现，但不改变 Bondi 质量损失与角动量演化。

papers.title: Propagation and horizon formation in Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet scalar collapse. I. Characteristic conditions, bounds and formation
papers.abstract: We study scalar collapse in five- and six-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity with positive coupling, treated as an exact classical theory. On spherical scalar backgrounds, the characteristic conditions of the tensor, vector and scalar gravitational sectors reduce to inequalities in two local invariants: $K=1+\tilde\alpha F/R^2$, which compares the enclosed mass with the areal radius $R$, and a scalar-gradient invariant $j$. In five dimensions they imply $R_h^2>\tilde\alpha$ for the areal radius $R_h$ of a regular marginal sphere on the GR branch and the sharp bound $\tilde\alpha^2\mathcal R_{abcd}\mathcal R^{abcd}<28$ for nonnegative mass. For initially untrapped five-dimensional spherical data with a regular center, a bound on $K$ alone ensures smooth continuation on compact domains of dependence, so any first characteristic loss occurs on a smooth background, and a marginal sphere formed before any loss forces a later loss. Complete smooth data form marginal spheres at every allowed radius with mass arbitrarily close to its sharp lower bound; in six dimensions radius and mass can both be arbitrarily small. Without spherical symmetry, complete initial data with weak curvature contain, at sufficiently large scale, outermost strictly stable marginal surfaces with prescribed $S^3$ geometries satisfying a spectral condition; Berger surfaces among them have arbitrarily small area at fixed mass. Their formation from untrapped data is left open. Near a contracting homogeneous core, exact nonspherical developments of smooth constrained data converging with every derivative have bounded curvature but, after the core's characteristic loss, a fixed discrepancy in a geometric tidal record. Classical existence, local geometric uniqueness and continuity of this pointwise record cannot all be guaranteed on a common observation region. A companion paper treats narrow incoming pulses.

classification.title_zh: Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 标量坍缩中的传播与视界形成。I. 特征条件、界限与形成
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了五维和六维 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中正耦合下的标量坍缩，将其视为精确经典理论。在球对称标量背景上，张量、矢量和标量引力扇区的特征条件约化为两个局部不变量的不等式：$K=1+\tilde\alpha F/R^2$，它比较包围质量与面积半径 $R$；以及标量梯度不变量 $j$。在五维中，它们对 GR 分支上正则边缘球的面积半径 $R_h$ 意味着 $R_h^2>\tilde\alpha$，并对非负质量给出尖锐界限 $\tilde\alpha^2\mathcal R_{abcd}\mathcal R^{abcd}<28$。对于具有正则中心的初始未捕获的五维球对称数据，仅对 $K$ 的界就保证了在紧致依赖域上的光滑延拓，因此任何首次特征损失都发生在光滑背景上，而在任何损失之前形成的边缘球迫使之后的损失。完全光滑的数据在每个允许半径处形成边缘球，其质量任意接近其尖锐下界；在六维中半径和质量都可以任意小。没有球对称性时，具有弱曲率的完全初始数据在足够大的尺度上包含最外层的严格稳定边缘面，其具有规定的 $S^3$ 几何并满足一个谱条件；其中的 Berger 面在固定质量下具有任意小的面积。它们从未捕获数据的形成仍悬而未决。在收缩均匀核心附近，光滑约束数据的精确非球对称发展以每个导数收敛，具有有界曲率，但在核心的特征损失之后，几何潮汐记录中出现固定差异。经典存在性、局部几何唯一性和该逐点记录的连续性不能在一个共同观测区域上同时得到保证。一篇伴随论文处理窄入射脉冲。
classification.one_liner: 研究五维和六维 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中标量坍缩的特征条件、边缘面形成与视界形成，给出尖锐界限并讨论非球对称情形。

papers.title: The quasinormal modes of Kerr-Newman black holes: a separated approach
papers.abstract: We compute Kerr-Newman quasinormal modes using a recently found exact separation of the gravitoelectric perturbation equations. For each spin-label $\varsigma=\pm1$, a matrix angular ordinary differential equation and a scalar second-order radial ordinary differential equation define a joint spectral problem for the complex frequency $\omega$ and separation constant $\lambda$. We solve this problem by imposing regularity at the angular poles, ingoing behavior at the event horizon, and outgoing behavior at infinity. We benchmark the numerical code built to solve the separated equations, and the resulting frequencies, against recently published spectral calculations of the coupled system. Comparisons with those results yield absolute differences of order $10^{-10}$ to $10^{-5}$, depending on the BH parameters and overtone number. We also find numerical hints of spin-label isospectrality in both the electromagnetic-led and gravitational-led sectors of fundamental quasinormal modes, even at near-extremal Kerr-Newman configurations. These results provide numerical evidence that the separated equations reproduce Kerr-Newman quasinormal frequencies and offer a practical route to exploring the ringdown of rotating, charged black holes.

classification.title_zh: Kerr-Newman 黑洞的准正规模式：一种分离方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用最近发现的 gravitoelectric 微扰方程精确分离，计算了 Kerr-Newman 准正规模式。对于每个自旋标签（取值 ±1），一个矩阵型角向常微分方程和一个标量二阶径向常微分方程定义了关于复频率 ω 和分离常数 λ 的联合谱问题。我们通过施加角向极点处的正则性、事件视界处的入射行为以及无穷远处的出射行为来求解该问题。我们将为求解分离方程所构建的数值代码及所得频率，与最近发表的耦合系统谱计算结果进行基准测试。与这些结果的比较给出绝对差异在 10^{-10} 到 10^{-5} 量级，具体取决于黑洞参数和泛音数。我们还在基本准正规模式的电磁主导和引力主导扇区中发现自旋标签等谱性的数值迹象，即使在近极端 Kerr-Newman 构型中也是如此。这些结果提供了分离方程能够重现 Kerr-Newman 准正规频率的数值证据，并为探索旋转带电黑洞的 ringdown 提供了一条实用途径。
classification.one_liner: 用精确分离的 gravitoelectric 微扰方程计算 Kerr-Newman 黑洞准正规模，并与耦合谱结果吻合。

papers.title: The pseudospectrum for gravitational perturbations in Kerr spacetimes
papers.abstract: We study the pseudospectrum of the Kerr black hole for gravitational perturbations with spin weight $s=2$, the case of greatest interest in gravitational-wave astronomy. In the hyperboloidal framework with two-dimensional Chebyshev collocation, we formulate the quasinormal mode problem as a non-self-adjoint eigenvalue problem. For $s\neq0$ the fields $\Psi^{(s)}$ and $\Psi^{(-s)}$ are independent, so the conserved current method yields no single-field energy norm. We overcome this with the Teukolsky--Starobinsky identities, which relate $\Psi^{(-2)}$ to a fourth-order operator on $\Psi^{(2)}$ and yield an $H^2$ energy norm after symmetrization. With the $H^1$ norm known for $s=0$, this suggests the pattern $H^{|s|}$, verified for $s=0$ and $s=2$. All results use an $\omega$-independent two-field hierarchy. We find that the pseudospectrum tightens by $1.1$ to $3.5$ decades at each step of $L^2\to H^1\to H^2$, yet stays large in every norm. The $s=+2$ and $s=-2$ operators are isospectral but not isopseudospectral: at twelve of fourteen probes the $\psi_0$ resolvent exceeds the $\psi_4$ one by $0.19$ to $0.82$ decades in the $H^2$ norm, while at the two probes furthest along the QNM line the ordering reverses by $0.18$ to $0.19$ decades. The gravitational pseudospectrum exceeds the scalar one by $0.5$ to $5.2$ decades in the window minimum and by $5.9$ decades in $L^2$ at $\omega M=0.47-0.17\,i$, while along the damping direction the $s=2$ resolvent is non-monotonic and the $s=0$ resolvent smooth. QNM spectral instability is therefore a universal feature of Kerr, and is stronger for gravitational perturbations.

classification.title_zh: Kerr时空中引力扰动的赝谱
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究Kerr黑洞自旋权重 s=2 的引力扰动赝谱，这是引力波天文学中最受关注的情形。在双曲型框架下，结合二维Chebyshev配点法，我们将准正规模问题表述为非自伴本征值问题。对于 s≠0，场 Ψ^(s) 与 Ψ^(-s) 相互独立，因此守恒流方法不能给出单场能量范数。我们借助Teukolsky--Starobinsky恒等式克服这一问题，该恒等式将 Ψ^(-2) 与作用在 Ψ^(2) 上的四阶算符联系起来，并在对称化后给出 H^2 能量范数。由于 s=0 的 H^1 范数已知，这提示 H^{|s|} 模式，并在 s=0 与 s=2 得到验证。所有结果使用与 ω 无关的两场层级。我们发现，在 L^2→H^1→H^2 的每一步，赝谱收紧 1.1 至 3.5 个数量级，但在每种范数下仍然很大。s=+2 与 s=-2 算符具有相同谱但并非等赝谱：在十四个探针中的十二个，ψ0 预解式在 H^2 范数下比 ψ4 大 0.19 至 0.82 个数量级；而在沿QNM线最远的两个探针处，顺序反转 0.18 至 0.19 个数量级。引力赝谱在窗口最小值处比标量赝谱大 0.5 至 5.2 个数量级，并在 ωM=0.47−0.17i 处在 L^2 中大约大 5.9 个数量级；而沿阻尼方向，s=2 预解式非单调，s=0 预解式平滑。因此，QNM谱不稳定性是Kerr的普遍特征，且对引力扰动更强。
classification.one_liner: 利用双曲型框架和Teukolsky--Starobinsky恒等式构造Kerr引力扰动的H^2能量范数，发现s=2赝谱比标量更大，QNM谱不稳定性对引力扰动更强。

papers.title: Symmetry-Driven $k$-Essence Cosmological Dynamics
papers.abstract: We investigate a family of $k$-essence cosmological models selected by the requirement that the field equations admit a nontrivial variational symmetry. Inside this general family of theories, we concentrate on the simplest modification to quintessence, induced by power-law terms of the kinetic energy. The symmetry generator introduces a conservation law which we use to obtain an exact vacuum solution. We generalize our analysis and investigate the structure of the phase-space of the cosmological field equations by performing a dynamical systems analysis, both in the absence and the presence of a pressureless matter source. We employ Hubble-normalized variables and the Poincar\'{e} compactification, so as to determine the asymptotic behavior of the model and identify all admissible cosmological epochs, from early-time to late-time behavior. We discuss in detail the existence and stability conditions of each fixed point as functions of the free parameters, and characterize the full asymptotic structure of the cosmological history as provided by this symmetry-driven $k$-essence model. We explore the conditions under which the model can describe cosmic acceleration. We find that this $k$-essence model successfully describes the inflationary epoch with a natural exit to the matter-dominated era, with the inflaton ultimately evolving to a dark matter source.

classification.title_zh: 对称性驱动的 k-essence 宇宙学动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一类 k-essence 宇宙学模型，其筛选条件是场方程允许非平凡变分对称性。在该一般理论族中，我们关注对精质模型的最简单修正，即由动能幂律项诱导的修正。对称生成元给出一个守恒律，我们用它获得精确真空解。我们推广分析，通过动力学系统分析研究宇宙学场方程相空间结构，分别考虑无压强物质源存在与不存在的情形。采用哈勃归一化变量和 Poincaré 紧致化，以确定模型的渐近行为并识别所有允许的宇宙学时期，从早期到晚期的行为。我们详细讨论每个不动点的存在性与稳定性条件对自由参数的依赖，并刻画该对称性驱动 k-essence 模型给出的宇宙历史完整渐近结构。我们探讨模型描述宇宙加速的条件。发现该 k-essence 模型成功描述暴胀时期，并自然退出到物质主导时期，最终暴胀子演化为暗物质源。
classification.one_liner: 通过动力学系统分析，研究具有变分对称性的 k-essence 宇宙学模型，发现其可实现暴胀并自然退出至物质主导，最终以暗物质形式演化。

papers.title: Light bending at two-loop order from scattering amplitudes
papers.abstract: We calculate the conservative deflection of a photon by a massive spinless source, such as a black hole, at third post-Minkowskian order using scattering amplitudes. We work in the heavy-source and long-range limits and adopt the geometric-optics approximation. The required five-point photon-graviton tree amplitude is constructed by on-shell recursion and sewn to three scalar-graviton vertices across a five-fold cut. Polynomial division organizes the cut information into sixteen contributions, including the residues with fewer propagators. We perform the source energy integrations and retain the near-on-shell photon regions in the remaining spatial integrals. Within the static region in which all exchanged momenta are soft, we relate a photon pole prescription to the subtraction of the cubic tree iteration from the conservative kernel. The sum of the sixteen contributions determines the classical logarithmic term at two loops. Its transverse Fourier transform gives the interaction radial action and yields the third-order deflection angle. The result agrees with the weak-deflection expansion of Schwarzschild null geodesics and demonstrates how nonlinear classical light bending is encoded in loop amplitudes around flat spacetime.

classification.title_zh: 从散射振幅计算双圈阶光偏折
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用散射振幅计算光子被大质量无自旋源（如黑洞）在第三后闵可夫斯基阶的保守偏折。我们在重源和长程极限下工作，并采用几何光学近似。所需的五点光子-引力子树振幅通过壳上递推构造，并通过五重割缝与三个标量-引力子顶点缝合。多项式除法将割缝信息组织为十六个贡献，包括具有较少传播子的留数。我们执行源能量积分，并在剩余空间积分中保留近壳光子区域。在所有交换动量均为软的静态区域中，我们将光子极点规定与从保守核中减去三次树迭代联系起来。十六个贡献之和确定了双圈阶的经典对数项。其横向傅里叶变换给出相互作用径向作用量并产生三阶偏折角。结果与 Schwarzschild 零测地线的弱偏折展开一致，并展示了非线性经典光偏折如何编码在平直时空周围的圈振幅中。
classification.one_liner: 用散射振幅方法计算光子被黑洞偏折的第三后闵可夫斯基阶经典结果，并与 Schwarzschild 弱偏折展开一致。
