papers.title: Glueball gravitational form factors in dynamical holography
papers.abstract: We present the first holographic study of gravitational form factors (GFFs) of scalar, pseudoscalar and canonical-spin-averaged tensor glueball targets. These observables test gravitational cubic couplings whose physical validity is not established by spectra and static-force calibration. We construct a dynamical Einstein--scalar--axion representation inspired by the Babington--Crooks--Evans adjoint-mass deformation of $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang--Mills theory and its Type-IIB supergravity dual. Leading ultraviolet source data are retained, while a soft-wall-like infrared reconstruction incorporates asymptotically linear radial mass-squared trajectories. Spectra and Wilson observables fix the parameters at a common Sommer scale without GFF input. The full constrained cubic vertices fail to describe 27 correlated scalar lattice observations, giving $\chi^2/\mathrm{dof}=73.60/27=2.73$. We propose normalized heavy-target (HT) effective cubic couplings for pure-glue matching. HT adopts leading radial shapes suggested by infinitely heavy targets at fixed probe dynamics and normalizes their overlap weights on the physical ground states. With the background, modes and propagators unchanged, HT gives $\chi^2/\mathrm{dof}=16.98/27=0.63$, without numerical adjustment to GFF data. Tensor and scalar source overlaps determine $A$ and the physical normalized trace; the exact finite-mass energy--momentum-tensor relation determines $D$. We predict the pseudoscalar and tensor form factors and three-target Breit pressure and shear profiles. On the reference infrared-decaying axion branch, the HT Breit mass radii are $0.276$, $0.300$ and $0.311\,\mathrm{fm}$, respectively. The results identify gravitational cubic matching as a distinct step beyond background calibration and provide a prescription for further lattice tests.

classification.title_zh: 动力学全息中的胶球引力形状因子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们首次在全息框架下研究标量、赝标量以及正则自旋平均张量胶球靶的引力形状因子（GFFs）。这些观测量检验引力三次耦合，而其物理有效性并不能由谱和静态力校准确定。我们构造了一个动力学 Einstein--scalar--axion 表示，其灵感来自 N=4 super-Yang--Mills 理论的 Babington--Crooks--Evans 伴随质量形变及其 Type-IIB 超引力对偶。保留领头紫外源数据，同时类软墙红外重构纳入渐近线性的径向质量平方轨迹。谱和 Wilson 观测量在共同 Sommer 标度下固定参数，且不使用 GFF 输入。完整约束的三次顶点无法描述 27 个相关的标量格点观测，给出 χ²/dof=73.60/27=2.73。我们提出用于纯胶球匹配的归一化重靶（HT）有效三次耦合。HT 采用固定探针动力学下由无穷重靶提示的领头径向形状，并在物理基态上归一化其重叠权重。在背景、模式和传播子不变的情况下，HT 给出 χ²/dof=16.98/27=0.63，且未对 GFF 数据进行数值调整。张量和标量源重叠决定 A 和物理归一化迹；精确的有限质量能量--动量张量关系决定 D。我们预言赝标量和张量形状因子，以及三靶 Breit 压强和剪切剖面。在参考的红外衰减 axion 分支上，HT Breit 质量半径分别为 0.276、0.300 和 0.311 fm。结果将引力三次匹配识别为超越背景校准的一个独立步骤，并为进一步的格点检验提供了方案。
classification.one_liner: 在动力学全息 QCD 模型中首次计算标量、赝标量和张量胶球的引力形状因子，并提出重靶有效三次耦合使格点比较显著改善。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息QCD/胶球研究，但未命中用户列出的重点支线标签（全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论）。

papers.title: Relative-Entropy Flow Across the Page Transition
papers.abstract: We develop a computational framework for the quantum relative entropy based on the replica trick and apply it to analyze the evaporation process method of Jackiw-Teitelboim black holes. We show that the relative entropies between the exact radiation state and the Hawking saddle state and the replica wormholes saddle state quantify information-theoretic costs inherent to coarse-grained semiclassical descriptions. During evaporation, the relative entropy for the Hawking saddle increases monotonically, reflecting a progressively higher thermodynamic cost of sustaining the Hawking description. Conversely, the relative entropy associated with the replica wormholes saddle decreases, which indicates that the description of connected geometries becomes progressively more accurate. Moreover, the sign of the difference between the two quantities reverses precisely at the Page time, providing an information-theoretic diagnosis for the transition between competing gravitational saddles. Our results recast the Page transition as a flow of relative entropy costs between competing semi-classical descriptions, revealing an information-theoretic structure underlying the emergence of effective irreversibility in coarse-grained black hole evaporation.

classification.title_zh: 跨 Page 转变的相对熵流
classification.abstract_zh: 我们基于复制技巧发展了一个量子相对熵的计算框架，并将其用于分析 Jackiw-Teitelboim 黑洞的蒸发过程。我们表明，精确辐射态与 Hawking 鞍点态以及复制虫洞鞍点态之间的相对熵，量化了粗粒化半经典描述所固有的信息论成本。在蒸发过程中，Hawking 鞍点的相对熵单调增加，反映出维持 Hawking 描述的热力学成本逐渐升高。相反，与复制虫洞鞍点相关的相对熵下降，表明连通几何的描述逐渐变得更准确。此外，这两个量之差在 Page 时间精确变号，为竞争引力鞍点之间的转变提供了信息论诊断。我们的结果将 Page 转变重新表述为竞争半经典描述之间相对熵成本的流动，揭示了粗粒化黑洞蒸发中有效不可逆性涌现背后的信息论结构。
classification.one_liner: 用相对熵流动刻画 JT 黑洞蒸发中 Hawking 鞍点与复制虫洞鞍点在 Page 时间前后的竞争与切换。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于黑洞信息、JT 引力与全息量子信息方向，涉及复制虫洞和 Page 转变；但未直接落在用户列出的全息凝聚态、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、QNM 等具体重点标签上。

papers.title: Conformal Anomalies and Generalised Energy Conservation in De Sitter Spacetime
papers.abstract: We show that for bulk discrete series fields whose dual operators have integer conformal dimensions, the Generalised Energy Conservation (GEC) condition for de Sitter (dS) scattering amplitudes defined in even-dimensional extended Poincar\'e spacetime corresponds precisely to the absence of boundary conformal anomalies, including beta-function contributions, at the level of tree-level contact interactions. In contrast, holographic consistency in AdS/CFT enforces only the locality of the conformal anomaly. We find novel, unique four-point interactions involving three identical conformally coupled scalars and one discrete series scalar by performing both GEC and holographic bootstraps. This demonstrates that the solutions to GEC form a measure-zero subset of the holographically consistent solutions. Our holographic analysis agrees precisely with the expected renormalisation conditions for conformal field theory correlators. In addition, the constraint for a particular four-point configuration may be relevant for testing holographic consistency of scale-separated non-supersymmetric AdS$_4$ vacua.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 时空中的共形反常与广义能量守恒
classification.abstract_zh: 我们表明，对于体离散系列场，其对偶算符具有整数共形维数，在偶数维扩展庞加莱时空中定义的 de Sitter (dS) 散射振幅的广义能量守恒（GEC）条件，在树级接触相互作用层面，精确对应于边界共形反常（包括 beta 函数贡献）的缺失。相比之下，AdS/CFT 中的全息一致性只要求共形反常的局域性。通过执行 GEC 和全息 bootstrap，我们发现了新颖且唯一的四点相互作用，涉及三个相同的共形耦合标量和一个离散系列标量。这表明 GEC 的解构成全息一致解的一个零测度子集。我们的全息分析与共形场论关联函数所预期的重整化条件精确一致。此外，某个特定四点组态的约束可能有助于检验尺度分离的非超对称 AdS$_4$ 真空的全息一致性。
classification.one_liner: 在 dS 散射的 GEC 与 AdS/CFT 全息一致性之间建立联系，发现 GEC 解是全息一致解中的零测度子集，并给出新的四点相互作用。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与 dS 全息一致性的理论研究，涉及共形反常、GEC 和全息 bootstrap；但与用户列出的具体重点标签（如全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、multi-trace、QNM与非线性演化等）没有直接对应。

papers.title: Thermodynamics and mechanical laws of causal-diamond horizons
papers.abstract: We develop a unified thermodynamic and mechanical framework for causal-diamond horizons in Minkowski spacetime. Euclidean regularity fixes the temperature $T_D=1/(\pi\alpha)$, where $2\alpha$ is the temporal extent of the diamond. The regulated Gibbons--Hawking--York contribution gives $I_D^E=-A_0/(4G)$, with $A_0$ the area of the horizon bifurcation surface, and the vanishing equilibrium geometric energy then yields the entropy--area relation $S_D=A_0/(4G)$. For weak matter perturbations crossing a localized portion of the future horizon, a Raychaudhuri analysis relates the associated Killing-energy flux to the area response, yielding a local physical-process first law at leading order near the bifurcation surface and, for classical matter satisfying the null energy condition, a local second law. Uniform conformal surface gravity establishes the zeroth law, while zero temperature is approached only in the limit $\alpha\to\infty$, in which the finite causal horizon disappears. These results show that a coherent horizon-law structure can arise within a causal diamond, a fundamental building block of the causal structure of Minkowski spacetime. The derivation is explicit in $(2+1)$ dimensions, while the physical results retain the same form for spherical causal diamonds in $d\geq3$.

classification.title_zh: 因果钻石视界的热力学与力学定律
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为闵可夫斯基时空中的因果钻石视界发展了统一的热力学与力学框架。欧几里得正则性确定温度 T_D=1/(πα)，其中 2α 是钻石的时间延展。正规化的 Gibbons-Hawking-York 贡献给出 I_D^E=-A_0/(4G)，其中 A_0 是视界分叉面的面积，而平衡几何能量消失则给出熵-面积关系 S_D=A_0/(4G)。对于穿过未来视界局域部分的弱物质扰动，Raychaudhuri 分析将相关的 Killing 能量通量与面积响应联系起来，在分叉面附近至领先阶给出局域物理过程第一定律，并且对于满足零能量条件的经典物质，给出局域第二定律。均匀共形表面引力确立了第零定律，而零温度仅在 α→∞ 极限下趋近，此时有限因果视界消失。这些结果表明，在因果钻石——闵可夫斯基时空因果结构的基本构件——内部可以出现一致的视界定律结构。推导在 (2+1) 维中显式给出，而物理结果对 d≥3 的球形因果钻石保持相同形式。
classification.one_liner: 在闵可夫斯基时空的因果钻石中，由欧几里得正则性导出温度与熵面积关系，并建立局域视界第一、第二和第零定律。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接讨论经典时空中的因果钻石视界热力学与力学定律，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；未涉及 AdS/CFT 等全息对偶，因此不归为理论全息。

papers.title: Spin-1 Bulk Local States in AdS/CFT and Carrollian Holography
papers.abstract: We construct the bulk local states of a massive spin-1 field in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ and three-dimensional Carrollian holography. In AdS, covariance under the isometries that leave a bulk point invariant determines the three components of the vector there and splits the solution into two branches of definite helicity, whose inner products reproduce the massive vector two-point function of AdS$_3$. By expanding the massive vector HKLL representation in boundary descendants, one can reproduce the three component states term by term. The two branches together describe the parity-invariant Proca field, and one alone the single propagating mode of Maxwell--Chern--Simons theory. The same conditions are solved in the induced representation of the Carrollian theory, where the solution again splits into two branches. Under the flat limit of the generators the highest weight module becomes the induced module, and the AdS states and Green's functions become their Carrollian counterparts, which supports the induced representation as the home of massive bulk excitations in Carrollian holography. This is the first bulk local state built with spin, complete from the state itself to its bulk-to-bulk propagator and to the limit relating the two descriptions.

classification.title_zh: AdS/CFT 与 Carrollian 全息中的自旋-1 体局域态
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了 AdS3/CFT2 以及三维 Carrollian 全息中一个大质量自旋-1 场的体局域态。在 AdS 中，保持一个体点不变的等距变换协变性决定了该点处矢量的三个分量，并将解分成两支具有确定螺旋度的分支，其内积重现 AdS3 的大质量矢量两点函数。通过将大质量矢量 HKLL 表示按边界后裔展开，可以逐项重现三个分量态。两支合起来描述宇称不变的 Proca 场，而单独一支描述 Maxwell-Chern-Simons 理论的单一传播模式。同样的条件在 Carrollian 理论的诱导表示中求解，解再次分成两支。在生成元的平直极限下，最高权模变为诱导模，AdS 态和格林函数变为其 Carrollian 对应物，这支持诱导表示作为 Carrollian 全息中大质量体激发的归属。这是首个带自旋的体局域态构造，从态本身到体-体传播子再到联系两种描述的极限均完整。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS3/CFT2 与三维 Carrollian 全息中构造带自旋的体局域态，给出自旋-1 HKLL 态、传播子及平直极限对应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础字典与 Carrollian 全息方向，但未涉及给定重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或经典引力等具体研究支线。

papers.title: The QCD phase diagram and critical end point at finite magnetic field from holography with neural networks
papers.abstract: We study the magnetic-field-driven critical end point (CEP) of the QCD thermal transition at zero baryon chemical potential using a five-dimensional Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton (EMD) model. We calibrate the model to lattice entropy at zero and finite magnetic fields using a neural-network formulation of holographic radial evolution. As the magnetic field increases, the thermal transition changes from a crossover to a first-order transition. The merger of temperature turning points, a divergent specific heat, and a vanishing squared sound speed identify $(eB_c,T_c)\simeq(7.22\,\mathrm{GeV}^{2},95.9\,\mathrm{MeV})$. The transition-region inflection of $s/T^3$ defines the crossover temperature, while an equal-pressure Maxwell construction determines the first-order coexistence line. The two lines meet at the CEP. The change of transition order agrees qualitatively with lattice results. The phase boundary is a prediction of the calibrated model.

classification.title_zh: 基于全息与神经网络的有限磁场 QCD 相图及临界端点
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用五维 Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton（EMD）模型，研究零重子化学势下 QCD 热相变由磁场驱动的临界端点（CEP）。我们采用全息径向演化的神经网络表述，将模型在零磁场和有限磁场下校准到格点熵。随着磁场增大，热相变从交叉过渡变为一级相变。温度回折点的合并、比热的发散以及声速平方的消失，共同确定 (eB_c,T_c)≃(7.22 GeV^2, 95.9 MeV)。s/T^3 在相变区的拐点定义交叉温度，而等压 Maxwell 构造确定一级相变共存线。两条线在 CEP 相遇。相变序的变化与格点结果定性一致。相边界是该校准模型的预言。
classification.one_liner: 用五维 EMD 全息模型结合神经网络校准格点熵，预言有限磁场下 QCD 热相变的临界端点约为 (eB_c,T_c)≃(7.22 GeV^2, 95.9 MeV)。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 QCD 与有限磁场相变研究，涉及临界端点和一级/交叉相变，与重点标签中的“相变与气泡成核”部分相关，但未直接涉及全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子等具体支线。

papers.title: Geometry of massive loops in gravitational scattering: Maximal cut, Riemann's bilinear relations and genus drop
papers.abstract: We study a representative two-loop family of worldline quantum field theory integrals relevant for classical gravitational scattering with a massive mediator and investigate the geometric structure of its maximal cut. We find that, unlike the massless case, the massive loops already give rise to an elliptic maximal cut at two loops, which degenerates into a nodal curve in the massless limit and in the static limit. In the global Baikov representation, two successive integrations reduce the maximal cut to a period of an elliptic curve. We further establish five primary consequences of this study: (a) The integration-by-parts method generates five master integrals, which, under reflection, split into a three-dimensional elliptic block and a two-dimensional polylog block. We derive the differential equation in two ways, one by Laporta reduction and subsequently by intersection theory in two cocycle bases, and construct the rational map between them. (b) The period matrices in arbitrary dimension have been computed in terms of Appell and Beta functions. Furthermore, we derive twisted Riemann period relations that yield nine quadratic identities among them. (c) We study the global monodromy relation of the differential system that satisfies Riemann's bilinear relation. (d) We explicitly derive the function space of the iterated integrals in terms of elliptic multiple polylogs. (e) In impact-parameter space, the Fourier-transformed cut is a Bessel-twisted differential on the elliptic curve, which we show has extra involution symmetries. Thus, the parity of the differential further decides which quotient - rational or elliptic its periods live on. All results presented concern the maximal cut and, therefore, the homogeneous solutions, but they open an important pathway to tackling the full massive two-loop integral.

classification.title_zh: 引力散射中有质量圈的几何：最大切割、Riemann 双线性关系与亏格下降
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一类有代表性的两圈世界线量子场论积分，它们与带有大质量中介粒子的经典引力散射相关，并考察其最大切割的几何结构。我们发现，与无质量情形不同，有质量圈在两圈时已经给出椭圆最大切割；它在无质量极限和静态极限下退化为节点曲线。在全局 Baikov 表示中，两次相继积分把最大切割约化为一条椭圆曲线的周期。我们进一步确立本研究的五个主要结果：(a) 分部积分方法生成五个主积分；在反射下，它们分裂为一个三维椭圆块和一个二维多对数块。我们以两种方式推导微分方程：一种通过 Laporta 约化，随后在两组余圈基中通过相交理论推导，并构造它们之间的有理映射。(b) 任意维数下的周期矩阵已用 Appell 和 Beta 函数计算。此外，我们推导出扭曲 Riemann 周期关系，给出它们之间的九个二次恒等式。(c) 我们研究满足 Riemann 双线性关系的微分系统的全局单值关系。(d) 我们明确用椭圆多重多对数给出迭代积分的函数空间。(e) 在碰撞参数空间中，傅里叶变换后的切割是椭圆曲线上的 Bessel 扭曲微分；我们证明它具有额外的对合对称性。因此，该微分的宇称进一步决定其周期生活在哪个商上——有理商还是椭圆商。所有给出的结果都只涉及最大切割，因而涉及齐次解，但它们为处理完整的有质量两圈积分开辟了一条重要途径。
classification.one_liner: 分析经典引力散射中有质量中介的两圈世界线积分最大切割的几何，揭示椭圆周期、Riemann 双线性关系与亏格下降，为完整积分铺路。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要明确面向经典引力散射的圈积分与最大切割几何，属于经典引力/引力波散射振幅的数学物理分支；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Generalised entanglement wedges in three dimensions
papers.abstract: Generalized entanglement wedges (GWs), proposed by Bousso and Penington for gravitating regions in general spacetimes, share many properties of ordinary entanglement wedges, including nesting, monotonicity and strong subadditivity of their generalized entropies. In AdS/CFT, the corresponding properties of entanglement wedges are consequences of the structure of the dual CFT. In this paper we ask whether the properties of GWs have a similar origin. We explore this question in vacuum AdS$_3$ at leading order in $G$. We first show that every GW on a static slice is a union of geodesically convex regions. Each such region is an intersection of ordinary entanglement wedges, so every GW is built from unions and intersections of entanglement wedges. We then use the Crofton formula of integral geometry to write the perimeter of a convex region as the measure of the set of geodesics that intersect it. In AdS$_3$ every geodesic is the Ryu--Takayanagi surface of a boundary interval, so this measure can be written in terms of the von Neumann entropies of CFT intervals. Strong subadditivity of the CFT entropy guarantees that the measure is positive. Monotonicity and strong subadditivity of GWs then follow from simple inequalities between sets of geodesics. The strong subadditivity of GWs is therefore a direct consequence of strong subadditivity on the boundary. Our results further suggest that GWs correspond to subsystems of the CFT that are more general than boundary subregions.

classification.title_zh: 三维中的广义纠缠楔
classification.abstract_zh: 由 Bousso 和 Penington 为一般时空中的引力区域提出的广义纠缠楔（GWs）具有普通纠缠楔的许多性质，包括嵌套性、单调性及其广义熵的强次可加性。在 AdS/CFT 中，纠缠楔的相应性质是对偶 CFT 结构的推论。本文追问 GWs 的性质是否也有类似起源。我们在真空 AdS3 中按 G 领头阶探讨这一问题。首先证明，静态切片上的每个 GW 都是测地凸区域的并集。每个这样的区域是普通纠缠楔的交集，因此每个 GW 都由纠缠楔的并与交构成。然后利用积分几何的 Crofton 公式，将凸区域的周长写成与其相交的测地线集合的测度。在 AdS3 中，每条测地线都是某个边界区间的 Ryu-Takayanagi 曲面，因此该测度可用 CFT 区间的冯·诺依曼熵表示。CFT 熵的强次可加性保证该测度为正。GWs 的单调性和强次可加性随后由测地线集合之间的简单不等式推出。因此，GWs 的强次可加性是边界上强次可加性的直接结果。我们的结果进一步表明，GWs 对应于比边界子区域更一般的 CFT 子系统。
classification.one_liner: 在真空 AdS3 中，广义纠缠楔可由普通纠缠楔的并与交构成，其强次可加性直接源于边界 CFT 熵的强次可加性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 AdS/CFT 中的广义纠缠楔与边界熵的强次可加性，属于全息纠缠/量子信息基础，不涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动或经典引力/广义相对论等具体重点支线。

papers.title: Multi-Point Affine Bialgebras for AdS/CFT Integrability
papers.abstract: In this work, we revisit the analytical structure of the classical affine Lie bialgebra underlying the integrable structures of AdS/CFT worldsheet scattering and the one-dimensional Hubbard model. Earlier work showed that the algebraic relations implied two singularity locations in the evaluation parameter plane besides the common expansion points infinity and zero for Laurent polynomials forming the basis for loop and affine algebras. Our aim is to formulate these singularities rigorously using meromorphic functions rather than by expansion into geometric series. We thus carefully analyse the analytical structure of the affine bialgebra relations in the complex plane paying attention to potential restrictions and extensions due to the additional singularities. As a first attempt with some shortcomings, we reformulate the affine bialgebra relations with the extra singularities serving as the expansion points for Laurent polynomials. We finally overcome the remaining issues by proposing three-point and four-point affine algebras for the rational and trigonometric cases. With a suitable choice of basis for meromorphic functions on the Riemann sphere with several punctures based on Krichever-Novikov algebras, we show that the multi-point affine algebras form consistent quasi-triangular Lie bialgebras.

classification.title_zh: 用于 AdS/CFT 可积性的多点仿射双代数
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们重新审视作为 AdS/CFT 世界面散射和一维 Hubbard 模型可积结构基础的经典仿射李双代数的解析结构。先前工作表明，这些代数关系意味着在求值参数平面中，除了构成圈代数与仿射代数基的 Laurent 多项式的常用展开点无穷远和零点之外，还存在两个奇点位置。我们的目标是用亚纯函数严格表述这些奇点，而不是通过几何级数展开。因此，我们仔细分析复平面中仿射双代数关系的解析结构，关注由于额外奇点可能带来的限制与扩展。作为带有一些缺点的初步尝试，我们用额外奇点作为 Laurent 多项式的展开点来重新表述仿射双代数关系。最后，我们通过为有理情形和三角情形提出三点和四点仿射代数，克服了遗留问题。通过在基于 Krichever-Novikov 代数的带多个穿刺的 Riemann 球面上为亚纯函数选取合适基，我们证明多点仿射代数构成一致的准三角李双代数。
classification.one_liner: 作者用亚纯函数和 Krichever-Novikov 基重新表述 AdS/CFT 可积性中的经典仿射李双代数，并构造三点与四点准三角李双代数。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题属于 AdS/CFT 可积性的数学结构，与列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet、经典引力等重点标签无直接重合。

papers.title: Localizing $\mathcal{N}=(2,0)$ $AdS_3$ solutions of M-theory
papers.abstract: We apply equivariant localization to supersymmetric $AdS_3\times M_8$ solutions of eleven-dimensional supergravity, dual to two-dimensional $\mathcal N=(2,0)$ SCFTs. We construct equivariantly closed polyforms encoding the magnetic flux and its dual, calibrated M2-branes and the warped volume, reducing protected observables to fixed point data of the $U(1)$ R-symmetry action. We apply the framework to $S^4$ bundles over coassociative four-cycles and $S^2$ bundles over compact six-manifolds, obtaining topological formulae for leading central charges and gravitational anomalies in terms of quantized fluxes and topological data. We recover the known results for $T^2\times KE_4$ solutions and construct a compact numerical solution with quantized flux that lies outside the known polynomial branch.

classification.title_zh: M理论中 N=(2,0) AdS_3 解的局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将等变局域化应用于十一维超引力的超对称 AdS_3×M_8 解，这些解对偶于二维 N=(2,0) SCFT。我们构造了等变闭多形式，编码磁通及其对偶、校准的 M2-膜和翘曲体积，将受保护观测量约化为 U(1) R-对称作用的固定点数据。我们将该框架应用于余结合四循环上的 S^4 丛以及紧致六维流形上的 S^2 丛，得到以量子化通量和拓扑数据表示的领头中心荷与引力反常的拓扑公式。我们重现了 T^2×KE_4 解的已知结果，并构造了一个具有量子化通量、位于已知多项式分支之外的紧致数值解。
classification.one_liner: 用等变局域化把 M 理论中 AdS_3×M_8 超引力解的中心荷和引力反常化为通量与拓扑固定点数据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与 M 理论超引力解的基础/形式研究，不直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜等支线。

papers.title: Deriving the $\text{AdS}_3\times\text{S}^3\times \text{T}^4$ Quantum Spectral Curve II: T-system and QSC
papers.abstract: We complete the systematic derivation of the Quantum Spectral Curve (QSC) for strings on $\text{AdS}_3\times\text{S}^3\times \text{T}^4$ with pure Ramond--Ramond (RR) flux, building on the extended Y-system obtained in our preceding paper. We establish the precise relation between the two formalisms of the Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz and the QSC, derive the previously conjectured QSC, and, along the way, uncover additional relations satisfied by its solutions. Our analysis also clarifies how massless excitations, although not explicit among the basic QSC building blocks, are encoded in their analytic structure. The derivation culminates in the so-called $\mathbf{P}{\mu}$-system, a compact formulation of the QSC in terms of a small set of functions and their analytic continuations.

classification.title_zh: 推导 AdS3×S3×T4 量子谱曲线 II：T-系统与 QSC
classification.abstract_zh: 我们完成了纯 Ramond--Ramond (RR) 流下 AdS3×S3×T4 弦论量子谱曲线 (QSC) 的系统推导，这基于我们前一篇论文得到的扩展 Y-系统。我们建立了热力学 Bethe ansatz 与 QSC 两种形式之间的精确关系，推导了此前猜想的 QSC，并在此过程中发现了其解所满足的额外关系。我们的分析还阐明了无质量激发虽然未显式出现在 QSC 基本构件中，但如何编码在其解析结构中。该推导最终给出所谓的 Pμ-系统，即用少量函数及其解析延拓对 QSC 的紧凑表述。
classification.one_liner: 从扩展 Y-系统系统推导纯 RR 流下 AdS3×S3×T4 弦的量子谱曲线及其 Pμ-系统表述。
classification.relevance_reason: 本文属于 AdS3/CFT2 可积性与量子谱曲线推导，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、相变/气泡成核、QNM/非线性演化、探针膜/Floquet、经典引力等方向。

papers.title: The Back-to-Back Plateau of the Energy-Energy Correlator from Weak to Strong Coupling
papers.abstract: The back-to-back limit of the energy-energy correlator (EEC) exhibits a finite plateau, capturing the evolution from perturbative soft-collinear radiation at weak coupling to string dynamics at strong coupling. At weak coupling, we resum its leading and next-to-leading-power logarithms through N$^3$LL in $\mathcal N=4$ SYM, including non-planar contributions. Combining this weak-coupling endpoint with bootstrap and strong-coupling data, we construct an interpolation for the plateau height from weak to strong coupling. The calculation uses a human-in-the-loop agentic workflow.

classification.title_zh: 能量-能量关联子的背靠背平台：从弱耦合到强耦合
classification.abstract_zh: 能量-能量关联子（EEC）的背靠背极限呈现一个有限平台，刻画了从弱耦合下微扰软-共线辐射到强耦合下弦动力学的演化。在弱耦合下，我们在 \mathcal N=4 SYM 中将领头和次领头幂次的对数重求和至 N^3LL，包括非平面贡献。结合该弱耦合端点与 bootstrap 及强耦合数据，我们构造了平台高度从弱耦合到强耦合的插值。该计算使用了人在回路中的智能体工作流。
classification.one_liner: 在 N=4 SYM 中重求和 EEC 背靠背平台的对数，并插值到强耦合，以刻画从微扰辐射到弦动力学的演化。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 N=4 SYM/全息强耦合精密计算，但与用户列出的重点支线（全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5、经典引力等）没有直接重合。

papers.title: Checking the Schwinger-Dyson equation in the purely open matrix-tensor model
papers.abstract: We test the proposed matrix-tensor description of three-dimensional gravity using a Schwinger-Dyson relation in its purely open sector. We enumerate and classify the topological contributions to a cylinder amplitude. Under a proposed counting prescription motivated by Virasoro TQFT, we find agreement with the conjectured unit difference between the numbers of contributing manifolds associated to the two interaction terms in the potential. By contrast, counting all inequivalent surface embeddings separately would instead give a mismatch. This comparison highlights the importance of specifying the set of bulk topologies to be included in the gravitational path integral.

classification.title_zh: 检验纯开放矩阵-张量模型中的 Schwinger-Dyson 方程
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用纯开放扇区中的 Schwinger-Dyson 关系，检验先前提出的三维引力的矩阵-张量描述。我们枚举并分类柱面振幅的拓扑贡献。在一种由 Virasoro TQFT 启发的计数方案下，我们发现与以下猜想一致：势中两个相互作用项对应的贡献流形数目相差单位。相反，若分别计数所有不等价的曲面嵌入，则会给出不匹配。这一比较凸显了明确规定引力路径积分中所包含体拓扑集合的重要性。
classification.one_liner: 在纯开放矩阵-张量模型中用 Schwinger-Dyson 方程检验三维引力的矩阵-张量描述，并强调体拓扑计数方案对匹配的重要性。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于矩阵-张量模型与三维量子引力路径积分的技术检验，与所列重点标签（全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、QNM、D3-D7/Floquet、经典引力等）没有直接重合。

papers.title: A New Entropy Puzzle in ABJM
papers.abstract: We point out a puzzle about BPS black holes in AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$: the entropy grows when $k$ increases although the number of gauge-invariant operators in the dual conformal field theory that can contribute to the entropy grows as $k$ decreases, due to the presence of monopole operators. Analyzing the superconformal index of ABJM, we show that the same puzzle exists for finite $N$ in the large charge limit. We propose a resolution based on an increasing number of trace relations as $k$ decreases, which dominates over the other effect. We argue that this mostly affects fortuitous operators and we provide an explicit example of a fortuitous operator that disappears at small $k$.

classification.title_zh: ABJM 中的一个新熵谜题
classification.abstract_zh: 我们指出 AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ 中 BPS 黑洞的一个谜题：当 $k$ 增大时熵增大，然而对偶共形场论中可对熵有贡献的规范不变算符数目却因单极子算符的存在而随 $k$ 减小而增大。通过分析 ABJM 的超共形指标，我们表明在大电荷极限下，对于有限 $N$ 也存在同样的谜题。我们提出一种基于迹关系随 $k$ 减小而增多的解决方式，该效应压过另一效应。我们论证这主要影响偶然算符，并给出一个在小 $k$ 下消失的偶然算符的显式例子。
classification.one_liner: 揭示 ABJM 中 BPS 黑洞熵随 $k$ 增大而增大与对偶 CFT 规范不变算符计数趋势相反的谜题，并提出迹关系增多的解决机制。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 ABJM 对偶中 BPS 黑洞熵与超共形指标/单极子算符的匹配问题，属于全息黑洞微观态，但不涉及用户列出的重点支线（全息超流超导、相变、QNM、探针膜、经典引力等）。

papers.title: All-Orders Classical Soft Graviton Theorems in the Newtonian Limit and Beyond
papers.abstract: The classical soft graviton theorem aims to determine certain terms in the early- and late-time tails of the gravitational waveform produced in a scattering process, using only the asymptotic momenta of the scattered objects. In this paper we find an infinite series of leading-logarithmic tail terms in the Newtonian limit, where the incoming and outgoing particles move slowly, but the scattering itself can be violent. The all-orders conjecture of Alessio, Di Vecchia and Heissenberg agrees with our results for two-particle scattering, but does not hold in general when the initial or final state contains three or more particles. We also propose an all-orders conjecture for these tails beyond the Newtonian limit, but do not prove it. Nevertheless, the conjecture passes several nontrivial consistency checks.

classification.title_zh: 牛顿极限及之外的全阶经典软引力子定理
classification.abstract_zh: 经典软引力子定理旨在仅利用散射物体的渐近动量，确定散射过程中产生的引力波波形在早期和晚期尾项中的某些项。本文在牛顿极限下找到了一系列无穷多的领头对数尾项，其中入射和出射粒子运动缓慢，但散射本身可以很剧烈。Alessio、Di Vecchia 和 Heissenberg 的全阶猜想在两粒子散射中与我们的结果一致，但当初始或末态包含三个或更多粒子时，该猜想一般不再成立。我们还为牛顿极限之外的这些尾项提出一个全阶猜想，但没有证明它。尽管如此，该猜想通过了若干非平凡的相容性检验。
classification.one_liner: 在牛顿极限下导出无穷多领头对数引力波尾项的全阶经典软引力子结果，并指出ADH全阶猜想在多粒子情形下失效，同时提出牛顿极限之外的全阶猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力中的软引力子定理与引力波尾项，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线。

papers.title: On rigidity of stationary black holes under a nontrapping assumption
papers.abstract: We prove that a smooth, regular, asymptotically flat stationary vacuum black hole has a nonextremal Kerr exterior if no null geodesic orthogonal to its stationary Killing field is trapped, establishing the rigidity conjecture of Alexakis, Ionescu, and Klainerman. In the rotating case, we start with the rotational Killing field constructed near the bifurcation sphere and study a maximal domain carrying its complete circle action. The main difficulty is to recover boundary regularity and the curvature condition needed for local Killing extension. We derive uniform estimates along complete rotational orbits from nontrapping and combine them with convexity along short null geodesics. These estimates show that a nonempty remaining boundary in the ergoregion is a timelike photon surface for the stationary quotient metric. Its null geodesics lift to spacetime null geodesics orthogonal to the stationary field. The vacuum circularity identities give their continuation through contact with the ergosurface, keeping their stationary projections in a compact set. This contradicts nontrapping and yields the global rotational symmetry required by black hole uniqueness.

classification.title_zh: 非俘获假设下稳态黑洞的刚性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，一个光滑、正则、渐近平直的稳态真空黑洞，若不存在与其稳态Killing场正交的被俘获零测地线，则其外部必为非极端Kerr外部，从而建立了Alexakis、Ionescu和Klainerman的刚性猜想。在旋转情形下，我们从分叉球面附近构造的旋转Killing场出发，研究承载其完整圆周作用的最大区域。主要困难在于恢复局部Killing延拓所需的边界正则性与曲率条件。我们从非俘获假设导出沿完整旋转轨道的均匀估计，并将其与短零测地线上的凸性结合。这些估计表明，能层中非空的剩余边界是稳态商度量的类时光子面。其零测地线提升为与稳态场正交的时空零测地线。真空圆性恒等式给出它们穿过与能层表面接触的延拓，并使其稳态投影保持在紧集中。这与非俘获假设矛盾，并给出黑洞唯一性所需的整体旋转对称性。
classification.one_liner: 在非俘获条件下证明渐近平直稳态真空黑洞外部必为非极端Kerr，从而解决Alexakis–Ionescu–Klainerman刚性猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究黑洞刚性与唯一性，与用户重点标签匹配；未涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Impact of Magnetic Field Topology on Electromagnetic and Gravitational Waves from Binary Neutron Star Merger Remnants
papers.abstract: We perform general relativistic magnetohydrodynamic (GRMHD) simulations of binary neutron star (BNS) mergers with four distinct magnetic field topologies: (i) a dipole pulsar-like configuration, (ii) a mixed linear superposition of poloidal and toroidal components inside the star, and (iii-iv) two topologies featuring a smooth transition from a confined mixed core to a pulsar-like structure at radii $0.95\,R_{\rm NS}$ and $0.5\,R_{\rm NS}$, with $R_{\rm NS}$ the radius of the star. The latter topologies are explored in BNS merger studies for the first time. We evolve systems with two equations of state (EoS), SLy and WFF1, with ADM masses 2.7 and 2.6, respectively, and include an additional lower-mass SLy binary to probe the behavior of long-lived remnants. We perform an extensive analysis of the emission properties of the systems, both electromagnetic and gravitational waves, and of the properties of the remnants, namely their frequency modes, density eigenfunctions, rotation, temperature, and convective stability. We report three key results: (1) for the first time, we assess the convective stability of magnetized remnants, extending previous unmagnetized analyses; (2) we identify a clear secondary peak in the gravitational-wave spectrum of pulsar-like configurations, consistent with the nonlinear coupling of the $m=0$ and $m=2$ modes, which is absent in other topologies; and (3) the magnetic field topology strongly influences the gravitational wave emission properties to the extent that nearby ($<50\,{\rm Mpc}$) events could allow one to observationally distinguish between different field structures with future gravitational-wave detectors. Across all models, we obtain luminosities compatible with short gamma-ray bursts (sGRBs), with purely poloidal configurations being the most efficient in driving possible relativistic jets.

classification.title_zh: 磁场拓扑对双中子星并合遗迹的电磁波与引力波的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 我们对双中子星（BNS）并合进行了广义相对论磁流体力学（GRMHD）模拟，采用四种不同的磁场拓扑：(i) 类似脉冲星的偶极构型；(ii) 星体内部极向与环向分量的混合线性叠加；(iii-iv) 两种在半径 0.95 R_NS 和 0.5 R_NS 处从受限混合核心平滑过渡到类脉冲星结构的拓扑，其中 R_NS 为星体半径。后两种拓扑首次在 BNS 并合研究中被探索。我们演化了两组状态方程（EoS）系统 SLy 和 WFF1，ADM 质量分别为 2.7 和 2.6，并额外加入一个较低质量的 SLy 双星以探究长寿命遗迹的行为。我们对系统的电磁波与引力波辐射性质以及遗迹性质（即频率模式、密度本征函数、转动、温度和对流稳定性）进行了广泛分析。我们报告三项关键结果：(1) 首次评估磁化遗迹的对流稳定性，扩展了此前未磁化的分析；(2) 在类脉冲星构型的引力波谱中识别出一个清晰的次级峰，与 m=0 和 m=2 模式的非线性耦合一致，而其他拓扑中不存在；(3) 磁场拓扑强烈影响引力波辐射性质，以至于邻近（<50 Mpc）事件可能允许未来引力波探测器在观测上区分不同的场结构。在所有模型中，我们获得与短伽马射线暴（sGRB）相容的光度，其中纯极向构型最有效地驱动可能的相对论性喷流。
classification.one_liner: GRMHD 模拟表明磁场拓扑显著影响双中子星并合遗迹的引力波谱、对流稳定性及电磁喷流效率。
keywords: 广义相对论磁流体力学模拟
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论与数值相对论范畴，直接研究双中子星并合遗迹的引力波谱、模式耦合和电磁辐射，符合“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；但不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Stochastic template banks for GW searches using low-discrepancy sequences
papers.abstract: Matched filtering remains the most sensitive method for detecting gravitational waves from compact binary coalescences. The efficiency of such searches depends on how well a discrete template bank covers the underlying parameter space. Conventional geometric, stochastic, and hybrid placement methods can lead to uneven coverage and redundant templates in higher dimensions. Hybrid methods are generally the most efficient among these, while stochastic methods are simpler to implement, particularly when the parameter-space metric is difficult to compute. In practice, both approaches rely on uniform random sampling, which often requires a large number of proposal points to achieve adequate coverage. We find that stochastic template banks constructed using low-discrepancy sequences achieve comparable recovery fractions while requiring 27.5\% fewer proposal points in two dimensions, about 12\% fewer in three dimensions and 17\% fewer in a four-dimensional eccentric equal-spin toy bank. The final template count is much less sensitive to the proposal sampling, consistent with the metric-volume constraints of the covering problem. We introduce a slab-wise coarse prefilter to accelerate candidate rejection for strongly anisotropic metrics. Applied to the 4D toy bank, it gives a total bank-construction speed-up of about $1.28\times$. The primary benefit of low-discrepancy sampling is therefore a reduction in the size of the initial proposal set, leading to lower memory usage and reduced bookkeeping during bank generation. These results show that low-discrepancy sampling provides a simple improvement to stochastic template-bank generation for current and future gravitational-wave searches.

classification.title_zh: 使用低差异序列为引力波搜索构建随机模板库
classification.abstract_zh: 匹配滤波仍然是探测致密双星并合引力波最灵敏的方法。搜索效率取决于离散模板库对底层参数空间的覆盖程度。传统几何、随机和混合放置方法在更高维度中可能导致覆盖不均和冗余模板。混合方法通常最有效，随机方法更易实现，特别是在参数空间度规难以计算时。两种方法通常依赖均匀随机采样，需要大量提议点才能实现充分覆盖。本研究发现，使用低差异序列构建的随机模板库在达到相当恢复分数时，二维所需提议点减少27.5%，三维减少约12%，四维偏心等自旋玩具模板库减少17%。最终模板数对提议采样方式远不敏感，符合覆盖问题的度规体积约束。作者引入分片粗预过滤以加速强各向异性度规下的候选拒绝；应用于四维玩具模板库时总构建速度提升约1.28倍。低差异采样的主要好处是减少初始提议集大小，从而降低模板库生成时的内存使用和簿记开销。这些结果表明低差异采样为当前和未来引力波搜索的随机模板库生成提供了一种简单改进。
classification.one_liner: 提出用低差异序列替代均匀随机采样来生成引力波搜索模板库，可在同等覆盖下减少提议点数量并降低内存开销。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波搜索的模板库生成与数据处理方法，与经典引力/广义相对论支线仅有边缘关联，不涉及全息对偶或量子引力物理。

papers.title: Polarization Analysis of Ringdown Signals
papers.abstract: Merging binary black holes exhibit a ringdown phase in which they primarily emit gravitational waves in the shape of damped sinusoids corresponding to quasi-normal modes of the Kerr remnant. In general, each mode carries four degrees of freedom encoding amplitude and phase information. When the modes are excited with equatorial reflection symmetry, as is the case for black hole mergers with spins (anti)aligned to the orbital angular momentum, the symmetry constrains two degrees of freedom. As a result, the relationship between polarization amplitudes and phases in each mode is fixed by the viewing (inclination) angle to the equatorial plane. We use such a constrained model to fit the ringdown signals of both non-precessing and precessing systems such as GW150914 and GW190521, respectively. We show that we can measure the degree of circular polarization and handedness of ringdown signals like those of GW150914, even if only the two LIGO detectors are available; such a polarization measurement can be translated into an inferred source inclination assuming the reflection symmetry above, again using the ringdown signal alone. On the other hand, the constrained polarization model is insufficient to capture the polarization structure of signals from precessing systems, leading to biases in the inferred mode frequencies and amplitudes. We explore the magnitude of this effect by fitting GW190521-like injections with the restricted model, finding weaker predictive accuracy relative to the arbitrary-polarization model and potentially significant systematic biases. As our detectors continue to improve, using the correct polarization model is increasingly important to avoid biased ringdown measurements.

classification.title_zh: 铃宕信号的偏振分析
classification.abstract_zh: 双黑洞并合存在铃宕阶段，主要发射对应 Kerr 残余黑洞准正模式的阻尼正弦波形式的引力波。一般来说，每个模式带有四个自由度，编码振幅和相位信息。当模式以赤道反射对称性被激发时——例如自旋与轨道角动量（反）对齐的黑洞并合——这种对称性约束两个自由度。因此，每个模式中的偏振振幅与相位之间的关系由相对赤道面的观测倾角固定。我们使用这种受约束模型拟合非进动和进动系统的铃宕信号，例如 GW150914 和 GW190521。我们表明，即使只有两个 LIGO 探测器可用，也能测量类似 GW150914 铃宕信号的圆偏振度和手性；若假定上述反射对称性，这种偏振测量可仅用铃宕信号反推源倾角。另一方面，受约束偏振模型不足以刻画进动系统信号的偏振结构，导致推断的模式频率和振幅出现偏差。我们通过用受限模型拟合类 GW190521 注入来探讨该效应的幅度，发现相对于任意偏振模型预测精度更弱，并可能存在显著系统偏差。随着探测器不断改进，使用正确的偏振模型对于避免有偏的铃宕测量日益重要。
classification.one_liner: 利用赤道反射对称性约束的偏振模型拟合黑洞并合铃宕，可测量圆偏振与倾角，但进动系统会导致模式频率和振幅偏差。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力波铃宕与准正模式偏振建模，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”重点标签，但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Implications of the LISA stochastic signal from eccentric stellar mass black hole binaries in vacuum
papers.abstract: Astrophysical formation channels of stellar-mass binary black holes (sBBHs) can induce significant orbital eccentricities in their early inspiral. We analyze the implications on the stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) from unresolved sBBHs, which can be detected with the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). We develop an improved SGWB model for the case of an idealized Dirac-delta eccentricity distribution, and extend it to the more astrophysical case of a thermal distribution. Using a fully Bayesian framework, we find that, if all binaries have a high initial eccentricity $e_0 \gtrsim 0.9$ at an orbital frequency of $f_{\rm orb} = 10^{-4}\,\mathrm{Hz}$, the resulting SGWB can be robustly distinguished from a background of quasi-circular sBBHs. For a thermal eccentricity distribution, the SGWB is consistent with a circular model when binaries form at $f_{\rm orb} = 10^{-5}\,\mathrm{Hz}$, but leads to significant systematic biases if formation occurs at $f_{\rm orb} = 10^{-4}\,\mathrm{Hz}$. We also show that, when eccentricity is properly accounted for, environmental effects such as dynamical friction can be distinguished from vacuum evolution, but only for sufficiently dense environments with gas densities $\rho \gtrsim 10^{-7}\,\mathrm{g\,cm^{-3}}$. Finally, we show that a LISA detection of the sBBH SGWB would place an upper bound on the maximum eccentricity of the sBBH population in the band of ground-based detectors, with direct implications for template modeling and data analysis. Our results highlight the importance of incorporating eccentricity in SGWB modeling to enable accurate astrophysical interpretation of LISA observations.

classification.title_zh: 真空中偏心恒星级质量黑洞双星所产生 LISA 随机信号的启示
classification.abstract_zh: 恒星级质量双黑洞（sBBHs）的天体物理形成通道可以在其早期旋进阶段诱导显著轨道偏心率。我们分析了未分辨 sBBHs 所产生的随机引力波背景（SGWB）的启示，该背景可被激光干涉空间天线（LISA）探测。我们针对理想化 Dirac-delta 偏心率分布发展了改进的 SGWB 模型，并将其推广到更符合天体物理的热分布情形。利用完全贝叶斯框架，我们发现，若所有双星在轨道频率 f_orb=10^{-4} Hz 处具有高初始偏心率 e_0 ≳ 0.9，则产生的 SGWB 可以被稳健地与准圆 sBBHs 背景区分开。对于热偏心率分布，当双星在 f_orb=10^{-5} Hz 形成时，SGWB 与圆形模型一致；但若形成发生在 f_orb=10^{-4} Hz，则会导致显著的系统偏差。我们还表明，当正确考虑偏心率时，诸如动力学摩擦等环境效应可以与真空演化区分开，但仅在气体密度 ρ ≳ 10^{-7} g cm^{-3} 的足够稠密环境中才能做到。最后，我们表明 LISA 对 sBBH SGWB 的探测将对地基探测器频带内 sBBH 群体的最大偏心率给出上限，这对模板建模和数据分析有直接影响。我们的结果凸显了在 SGWB 建模中纳入偏心率以实现对 LISA 观测进行准确天体物理解释的重要性。
classification.one_liner: 该工作建立了含偏心率的恒星级双黑洞随机引力波背景模型，并评估 LISA 对其与准圆背景及环境效应的区分能力。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/引力波方向，涉及黑洞双星、LISA 与随机引力波背景，但不涉及全息、量子引力或用户列出的其他全息重点支线。

papers.title: Scalable and sequential inference of the neutron star equation of state with the Einstein Telescope
papers.abstract: Future gravitational-wave observatories such as the Einstein Telescope will detect tens of thousands of binary neutron star mergers per year, making gravitational waves a dominant probe of the neutron-star equation of state in the coming decades. However, extracting this information requires hierarchical inference across a rapidly growing catalog of events, and existing methods must restart from scratch whenever a new event arrives, making them impractical at this scale. In this Letter, we introduce a hybrid sequential Monte Carlo algorithm that combines data and likelihood tempering to adaptively update the equation-of-state posterior in batches, reusing previous inference results instead of restarting from a wide prior. Accelerated by GPU hardware, our method infers the equation of state from a simulated month of around 1500 binary neutron star mergers in a few hours on a single GPU, and we project that a full year of detections could be processed in a few days on current hardware. This establishes sequential Monte Carlo as a practical route for real-time hierarchical inference with future gravitational-wave detectors.

classification.title_zh: 利用爱因斯坦望远镜对中子星物态方程进行可扩展的序贯推断
classification.abstract_zh: 未来的引力波天文台，如爱因斯坦望远镜，每年将探测到数万次双中子星并合，使引力波在未来几十年成为中子星物态方程的主导探针。然而，提取这些信息需要对快速增长的事件目录进行分层推断，而现有方法在每次新事件到来时都必须从头重启，使其在此规模下不切实际。在这封信中，我们引入一种混合序贯蒙特卡洛算法，它结合数据和似然回火，以批处理方式自适应更新物态方程后验，复用先前的推断结果，而不是从宽先验重新开始。在GPU硬件加速下，我们的方法可在单个GPU上于数小时内从模拟的一个月约1500次双中子星并合中推断物态方程，并预计在当前硬件上可在几天内处理一整年的探测事件。这确立了序贯蒙特卡洛作为未来引力波探测器实时分层推断的一条实用途径。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种GPU加速的混合序贯蒙特卡洛方法，可增量、可扩展地从未来引力波事件目录推断中子星物态方程。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力波与中子星物态方程推断方向，不涉及AdS/CFT全息或量子引力，但与用户列出的经典引力/广义相对论支线相关。

papers.title: Probing departures from Schwarzschild geometry with the S301 star and kilometre-baseline interferometry
papers.abstract: The S301 star reaches a pericentre one tenth that of S2, opening a new regime for probing black-hole spin and departures from Schwarzschild. We develop a post-Newtonian secular Hamiltonian framework for bound geodesics in stationary, axisymmetric spacetimes and compute the maximum projected astrometric deviation over one orbit. At the expected GRAVITY+ precision, S301 can probe several nonrotating geometries and sizeable spin-induced deviations, while kilometre-baseline interferometry can probe much smaller departures, establishing S301 as a powerful test of the spacetime geometry of Sgr A*.

classification.title_zh: 用S301恒星和公里基线干涉测量探测对史瓦西几何的偏离
classification.abstract_zh: S301恒星到达近星点仅为S2的十分之一，为探测黑洞自旋和偏离史瓦西几何开辟了新区域。我们为稳态轴对称时空中的束缚测地线发展了后牛顿长期哈密顿框架，并计算了一个轨道周期内的最大投影天体测量偏差。在预期的GRAVITY+精度下，S301能够探测若干非旋转几何和相当大自旋诱导的偏离，而公里基线干涉测量能够探测小得多的偏离，从而将S301确立为对Sgr A*时空几何的有力检验。
classification.one_liner: 利用S301恒星轨道与公里基线干涉测量，检验Sgr A*是否偏离史瓦西几何并限制黑洞自旋。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论，研究黑洞时空几何与史瓦西偏离，匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Learning When Black Hole Hair Is Observable: Physical Identifiability, Generalization, and Observable Complementarity
papers.abstract: High interpolation accuracy does not establish that physical parameters are identifiable. We study this distinction in a controlled Kiselev black hole benchmark with a validated timelike-emitter and three-dimensional null-geodesic shooting calculation. The exact $k=0$ boundary provides an analytically known null control because the spacetime becomes Schwarzschild and independent of $w_q$. Ringdown is informative for the deformation amplitude $k$, while photon geometry supplies an independent response direction that resolves much of the $w_q$ degeneracy. Relative to ringdown alone, ringdown plus photon geometry gives a median pointwise $4.54\times$ gain in minimum singular value and a $2.28\times$ improvement in Jacobian condition number. In grouped physical interpolation, identifiable-$w_q$ normalized mean absolute error decreases from 0.309 to 0.087. Random splitting is more optimistic, while directional extrapolation is substantially harder and split-conformal coverage degrades under distribution shift. A non-learned nearest-model inverse shows that the gain is not confined to the tested learned architectures. A uniform 161-phase audit gives a typical normalized prediction shift of $9.48\times10^{-4}$, while a targeted 321-phase audit resolves the remaining forward-feature comparisons. However, frozen HGB and random-forest tail shifts exceed prespecified robustness thresholds. Thus, physical observable complementarity is supported, but inverse-estimator robustness remains conditional. This is a theoretical identifiability benchmark, not an observational constraint.

classification.title_zh: 学习黑洞毛发何时可观测：物理可识别性、泛化与可观测互补性
classification.abstract_zh: 高插值精度并不证明物理参数可识别。我们在一个受控的Kiselev黑洞基准中研究这一区别，使用经过验证的类时发射体和三维零测地线射击计算。精确的 k=0 边界提供了一个解析已知的零对照，因为时空变为Schwarzschild且独立于 w_q。Ringdown对形变振幅 k 有信息，而光子几何提供一个独立的响应方向，解决了 w_q 简并的大部分。相对于单独ringdown，ringdown加光子几何给出最小奇异值中位数逐点 4.54 倍增益，并使Jacobian条件数改善 2.28 倍。在分组物理插值中，可识别 w_q 的归一化平均绝对误差从 0.309 降至 0.087。随机划分更乐观，而方向外推明显更难，分裂共形覆盖在分布移位下退化。非学习最近模型逆表明，该增益不限于所测试的学习架构。均匀 161 相位审计给出典型归一化预测位移 9.48×10^{-4}，而定向 321 相位审计解决了剩余前向特征比较。然而，冻结 HGB 和随机森林尾部偏移超过预设稳健性阈值。因此，物理可观测互补性得到支持，但逆估计器稳健性仍是有条件的。这是理论可识别性基准，不是观测约束。
classification.one_liner: 在Kiselev黑洞基准中，ringdown与光子几何联合可提升毛发参数可识别性，但逆估计器稳健性仍有限，这是理论基准而非观测约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典黑洞时空与可观测性/反问题研究，涉及ringdown与光子几何，不涉及全息对偶或量子引力理论。

papers.title: Constraining the gravitational-wave breathing mode with LVK antenna patterns and GWTC data
papers.abstract: Metric theories of gravity admit a massless breathing scalar $b$ besides the tensor modes $+$ and $\times$. Many scalar--tensor models predict a much smaller breathing amplitude; gravitational quantum field theory (GQFT) instead allows $h_b$ comparable to the tensor amplitudes. We evaluate the LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA (LVK) antenna patterns with PyCBC, including Michelson suppression of $b$. Here $F_b$ is the breathing antenna pattern and $\mathcal{S}_b=\sum_d F_b^{d2}$ is the network breathing power. At the H1 zenith at the GW150914 epoch, $F_b\sim 5\times 10^{-6}$; for $72$ Gravitational-wave Transient Catalog (GWTC) events with packaged strain the median inclination gain in $\mathcal{S}_b$ is $\sim 34\times$. Ranking multi-detector GWTC events (network $\mathrm{SNR}\ge 8$, $\ge 2$ sites) by $\mathrm{SNR}\sqrt{\mathcal{S}_b^{*}}$ identifies loud O4 triggers and GW170817 as geometric targets. Parameter-estimation (PE) weighted $\mathcal{S}_b$ on twelve events shows that the true sky can suppress this ranking (GW170817) and that GW200129_065458, GW150914, and GW190814 have the highest PE-weighted $\mathcal{S}_b$ for $\xi$ in $h_b=\xi h_+$ (GR: $\xi\equiv 0$). An HLV design-noise injection grid gives $\ln B(\mathrm{GR}+b/\mathrm{GR})\approx 13$ ($4$) for $\xi=1$ ($0.5$) on an inclined sky ($\mathcal{S}_b\sim 0.18$); near zenith ($\mathcal{S}_b\sim 0.016$) the $\xi$ posterior remains unconstrained. The GWTC limits are semi-joint: masses and spins fixed at PE medians, while $d_L$, $\theta_{JN}$, sky, and $\xi$ vary within PE-informed priors. Eleven of twelve events are analyzed (GW170817 omitted: PE sky on the breathing null). None favors $\mathrm{GR}+b$; $|\xi|_{90\%}\approx 0.15$, $0.18$, and $0.23$ for GW150914, GW200129_065458, and GW200311_115853 disfavor $|\xi|\sim\mathcal{O}(1)$, while weaker bounds (including GW190814) still allow that scale.

classification.title_zh: 利用 LVK 天线方向图和 GWTC 数据限制引力波呼吸模式
classification.abstract_zh: 度规引力理论允许无质量呼吸标量 b 与张量模式 +、× 并存。许多标量-张量模型预言的呼吸振幅小得多；而引力量子场论（GQFT）则允许 h_b 与张量振幅相当。我们用 PyCBC 计算 LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA（LVK）天线方向图，包括 Michelson 对 b 的抑制。F_b 为呼吸天线方向图，S_b=sum_d F_b^{d2} 为网络呼吸功率。在 GW150914 时期的 H1 天顶，F_b~5×10^-6；对 72 个带有 packaged strain 的 GWTC 事件，S_b 的中位倾角增益约 34 倍。按 SNR·sqrt(S_b*) 对多探测器 GWTC 事件（网络 SNR≥8，≥2 站点）排序，识别出响亮的 O4 触发和 GW170817 作为几何目标。对 12 个事件进行参数估计（PE）加权 S_b 表明，真实天空可抑制该排序（GW170817），而在 h_b=ξh_+ 中（GR: ξ≡0），GW200129_065458、GW150914 和 GW190814 具有最高的 PE 加权 S_b。HLV 设计噪声注入网格给出，对于 ξ=1（0.5），在倾斜天空（S_b~0.18）下 ln B(GR+b/GR)≈13（4）；近天顶（S_b~0.016）下 ξ 后验仍无约束。GWTC 限制是半联合的：质量和自旋固定在 PE 中位数，而 d_L、θ_JN、天空和 ξ 在 PE 信息先验内变化。十二个事件中分析了十一个（GW170817 省略：PE 天空位于呼吸零处）。没有一个偏向 GR+b；GW150914、GW200129_065458 和 GW200311_115853 的 |ξ|_90%≈0.15、0.18、0.23，排除了 |ξ|~O(1)，而较弱的限制（包括 GW190814）仍允许该尺度。
classification.one_liner: 利用 LVK 天线方向图和 GWTC 事件对引力波呼吸标量模式给出约束，未发现支持 GR+b 的证据。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究广义相对论之外引力波呼吸模式，并使用 LVK/GWTC 数据约束，属于经典引力/引力波检验重点。

papers.title: Line-of-Sight Acceleration-driven waveform corrections for unequal-mass compact binary coalescences
papers.abstract: A constant line-of-sight acceleration (LOSA) of the centre-of-mass of a quasi-circular compact binary coalescence (CBC) leads to modulations in the gravitational-wave (GW) waveform at $-4$ post-Newtonian (PN) order. In our previous work, we calculated the phase and amplitude corrections only for the $(\ell,m) = (2,2)$ mode. The gravitational wave event GW190814 has recently attracted considerable attention because it has been suggested to provide evidence for a nonzero LOSA. However, several LOSA analyses of GW190814 employ higher-order-mode waveform models, such as \texttt{IMRPhenomXPHM}, while incorporating LOSA corrections only for the dominant (2,2) mode. This approximation assumes that their omission has a negligible impact on parameter estimation. In this paper, we present a self-consistent implementation of LOSA in a higher-mode waveform model by deriving the corresponding phase and amplitude corrections. We show that these corrections are essential for asymmetric binaries such as GW190814 and that neglecting them biases parameter inference. We also discuss inconsistencies in the derivation and implementation of LOSA corrections in waveform models in the literature that include higher-order modes.

classification.title_zh: 视线加速度驱动的非等质量致密双星并合波形修正
classification.abstract_zh: 准圆轨道致密双星并合质心的恒定视线加速度（LOSA）会在-4后牛顿（PN）阶导致引力波波形调制。在此前工作中，我们仅计算了(ℓ,m)=(2,2)模式的相位和振幅修正。引力波事件GW190814近期受到广泛关注，因为有研究提出它提供了非零LOSA的证据。然而，若干针对GW190814的LOSA分析采用了包含高阶模式的波形模型，例如IMRPhenomXPHM，却只对主导的(2,2)模式加入LOSA修正。这种近似假定忽略高阶模式修正对参数估计影响可忽略。本文通过推导相应的相位和振幅修正，给出了在高阶模式波形模型中自洽实现LOSA的方法。我们表明，这些修正对于像GW190814这样的非对称双星至关重要，忽略它们会使参数推断产生偏差。我们还讨论了文献中在包含高阶模式的波形模型里对LOSA修正的推导和实现中存在的不一致之处。
classification.one_liner: 将视线加速度修正自洽地推广到包含高阶模式的引力波波形，并指出忽略这些修正会偏置非对称双星如GW190814的参数推断。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论与引力波波形修正，命中重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；与全息对偶无关。

papers.title: Line-of-sight Acceleration Driven Effects in Eccentric Compact Binary Coalescences
papers.abstract: The line-of-sight acceleration (LOSA) effect, imprinted in the gravitational wave (GW) signal of an inspiralling compact binary by an external gravitational potential, is one of the most promising means of probing the environment of compact binaries on a single-event basis. However, this effect is potentially degenerate with other low-frequency effects, particularly the binary's orbital eccentricity. LOSA effects and orbital eccentricity can mimic each other if only one or the other (but not both) are accounted for in the waveform template. In this work, we present the (2, 2) mode, leading eccentric harmonic, frequency-domain phase correction incurred by an accelerating eccentric compact binary, and discuss inconsistencies pertaining to this phase correction in the literature. We show that the degeneracy between LOSA and orbital eccentricity can be resolved if both effects are modeled in the template. To demonstrate this, we inject a GW170817-like signal, with eccentricity and LOSA added to it, and recover the parameters of the injected signal assuming an A+ like noise power spectral density (PSD) of the LVK detector network. We find that the true LOSA and eccentricity parameters, along with other binary parameters, are recovered within the $90\%$ credible interval (CI). This study highlights the importance of incorporating LOSA in eccentric waveform models to robustly and reliably estimate LOSA and eccentricity.

classification.title_zh: 偏心致密双星并合中视线加速度驱动效应
classification.abstract_zh: 视线加速度（LOSA）效应由外部引力势印刻在旋近致密双星的引力波信号中，是在单事件基础上探测致密双星环境最有前景的手段之一。然而，该效应可能与其他低频效应简并，特别是双星的轨道偏心率。若波形模板中只考虑二者之一而未同时考虑两者，LOSA效应与轨道偏心率可以相互模仿。在本工作中，我们给出了加速偏心致密双星所导致的(2,2)模式、主导偏心谐波的频域相位修正，并讨论了文献中与该相位修正有关的不一致之处。我们表明，如果在模板中同时对两种效应建模，LOSA与轨道偏心率之间的简并可以被打破。为证明这一点，我们注入一个类似GW170817的信号，并在其中加入偏心率和LOSA，假设LVK探测器网络具有类似A+的噪声功率谱密度（PSD），恢复注入信号的参数。我们发现，真实的LOSA和偏心率参数以及其他双星参数均在90%可信区间（CI）内被恢复。本研究强调了将LOSA纳入偏心波形模型以稳健可靠地估计LOSA和偏心率的重要性。
classification.one_liner: 论文研究偏心致密双星引力波中视线加速度与轨道偏心率的简并，并表明同时建模二者可在A+灵敏度下准确恢复参数。

papers.title: Analytic solutions for the gravitational spin Hall equations and black hole shadows
papers.abstract: In general relativity, the geometric optics approximation describes the propagation of high-frequency electromagnetic waves along null geodesics. Beyond this approximation, localized wave packets acquire frequency- and polarization-dependent corrections to null geodesic motion, described by the gravitational spin Hall equations. In this paper, these equations are integrated analytically, to first order in wavelength, in a large class of type D black hole spacetimes, whenever the corresponding null geodesics admit analytic solutions. The same framework yields analytic expressions for the shape of black hole shadows with polarization-dependent corrections.

classification.title_zh: 引力自旋霍尔方程与黑洞阴影的解析解
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论中，几何光学近似将高频电磁波的传播描述为沿零测地线的运动。超出该近似后，局域波包会获得频率和偏振相关的修正，其偏离零测地线运动的行为由引力自旋霍尔方程描述。本文在波长一阶近似下，对一大类 type D 黑洞时空中这些方程进行解析积分，只要相应的零测地线存在解析解即可。同一框架还给出了带偏振相关修正的黑洞阴影形状的解析表达式。
classification.one_liner: 在 type D 黑洞时空中解析求解波长一阶的引力自旋霍尔方程，并给出偏振修正下的黑洞阴影解析形状。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，直接研究黑洞时空中的经典波传播修正与黑洞阴影，与用户标注的经典引力重点标签高度相关。

papers.title: Self-lensing of gravitational waves from binary extreme-mass-ratio inspirals: Extended caustics and paired flashes
papers.abstract: We investigate strong gravitational lensing of gravitational waves from a compact source orbiting a Kerr black hole, motivated by self-lensing in binary extreme-mass-ratio inspirals. In the geometric-optics limit, we construct a point-to-point lens map from null-geodesic integrals and use the Jacobi map to compute the strain magnification of individual images. While lensed signals are generally demagnified, we show that they can be strongly amplified near the extended caustics of the Kerr lens map. For suitable source--observer geometries, the orbit crosses a caustic twice per revolution, producing two amplification peaks. Their arrival-time separation depends on the black-hole spin, observer inclination, and orbital radius through both the source motion and propagation delays. These signatures might offer a means of constraining the source--observer geometry and probing the spacetime of the central black hole.

classification.title_zh: 双星极端质量比旋近中引力波的自透镜效应：扩展焦散与成对闪光
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究紧凑源绕Kerr黑洞运动时引力波的强引力透镜效应，其动机是双星极端质量比旋近中的自透镜。在几何光学极限下，我们从零测地线积分构造点对点透镜映射，并使用Jacobi映射计算单个像的应变放大率。虽然透镜化信号通常会被缩小，但我们表明在Kerr透镜映射的扩展焦散附近它们可以被强烈放大。对于合适的源-观测者几何，轨道每转一圈会两次穿过焦散，产生两个放大峰。其到达时间间隔依赖于黑洞自旋、观测者倾角和轨道半径，通过源运动和传播延迟共同决定。这些特征可能提供一种约束源-观测者几何并探测中心黑洞时空的手段。
classification.one_liner: 研究EMRI中绕Kerr黑洞运动的源产生的引力波自透镜，发现扩展焦散可造成每圈两次放大峰。

papers.title: Impact of Correlated Test-Mass Noise on Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background Searches with Space-Based Interferometers
papers.abstract: The stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) is a major science target of future space-based interferometers because it encodes information about unresolved astrophysical populations and physical processes in the early Universe. Its stochastic nature, however, means that its detection and parameter inference rely on distinguishing its statistical contribution to the data from that of instrumental noise. In particular, both the SGWB and instrumental noise contribute to the data covariance, so an incomplete noise model can be misinterpreted as part of the SGWB and thereby bias the inferred spectrum and its parameters. Here we investigate this effect in the presence of correlations between the acceleration (ACC) noises of adjacent test masses (TMs) in each spacecraft. We simulate the correlated noise at the single-link level, propagate it through the moving-orbit response into the time-delay interferometry (TDI) observables, and analyze the resulting TDI auto spectra with two Bayesian frequency-domain templates: the Corr. Template includes the correlated-noise covariance, whereas the Non-Corr. Template neglects it. We find that, when correlated ACC noise is present in the mock data, the Non-Corr. Template exhibits systematic parameter offsets that generally become more pronounced with increasing correlation amplitude. In contrast, the Corr. Template recovers the injected SGWB and instrumental-noise parameters substantially more accurately. These results demonstrate that correlations in test-mass ACC noise can constitute a relevant systematic for space-based SGWB searches and motivate their explicit inclusion in mission-realistic noise models and inference pipelines.

classification.title_zh: 相关测试质量噪声对基于空间干涉仪的随机引力波背景搜寻的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 随机引力波背景（SGWB）是未来空间干涉仪的主要科学目标之一，因为它编码了未分辨的天体物理种群和早期宇宙物理过程的信息。然而，其随机性质意味着探测和参数推断依赖于将其对数据的统计贡献与仪器噪声区分开。特别地，SGWB 和仪器噪声都对数据协方差有贡献，因此不完整的噪声模型可能被误认为 SGWB 的一部分，从而偏置推断的谱及其参数。本文研究每个航天器中相邻测试质量（TM）的加速度（ACC）噪声之间存在相关性时的这一效应。我们在单链路层面模拟相关噪声，将其通过运动轨道响应传播到时间延迟干涉（TDI）观测量，并用两个贝叶斯频域模板分析得到的 TDI 自谱：Corr. 模板包含相关噪声协方差，而非 Corr. 模板忽略它。我们发现，当模拟数据中存在相关 ACC 噪声时，非 Corr. 模板表现出系统性参数偏移，且通常随相关幅度增加而更显著。相反，Corr. 模板能更准确地恢复注入的 SGWB 和仪器噪声参数。这些结果表明，测试质量 ACC 噪声中的相关性可能构成空间 SGWB 搜寻的相关系统误差，并促使在任务真实的噪声模型和推断流程中明确包含它们。
classification.one_liner: 研究表明相邻测试质量加速度噪声相关性会系统性偏置空间干涉仪随机引力波背景参数估计，而包含相关噪声协方差的模板可显著改善参数恢复。

papers.title: Time-Frequency Analysis for LISA: Galactic Foreground Modulation
papers.abstract: Observations by the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) will contain time-varying, cyclostationary confusion noise from the Galaxy, which is naturally handled using time-frequency analysis methods. We present a fast, forward model that maps the parameterized Galactic gravitational-wave luminosity density onto the annually modulated, unresolved confusion foreground in the complete set of time-delay interferometry channels. The line-of-sight luminosity integral is evaluated on a HEALPix grid and decomposed into spherical harmonics, while the detector response is decomposed analytically, independent of the Galaxy model, such that a new Galactic model costs a single map evaluation, transformation, and contraction. We compute the modulated covariance beyond the standard low-frequency limit, expanding the LISA response to second order in finite armlength corrections, and to first order in the unequal-arm corrections. These effects change the normalized modulation curves by up to $\sim\!0.23\%$ and $0.64\%$ for finite armlength corrections at $3$ and $5$ mHz respectively, and by $\sim\!0.074\%$ and $0.71\%$ for unequal-arm corrections in the self and cross channels respectively. Using the fast, forward model and a notional disk-and-bulge Galaxy model, we construct a Fisher matrix from the time-dependent channel covariance and forecast that one year of observation constrains the disk scale width and scale height relative to the distance to the Galactic center at the $8\%$ and $12\%$ levels respectively, and leaves the strongly correlated bulge fraction and bulge radius individually unconstrained.

classification.title_zh: 面向 LISA 的时频分析：银河系前景调制
classification.abstract_zh: 激光干涉空间天线（LISA）的观测将包含来自银河系的时变、循环平稳混淆噪声；这类噪声自然适合用时频分析方法处理。我们提出一个快速正向模型，将参数化的银河系引力波光度密度映射到完整时间延迟干涉测量（TDI）通道中经年度调制的未分辨混淆前景。视线光度积分在 HEALPix 网格上计算并分解为球谐函数，而探测器响应被解析分解，且与银河系模型无关，因此一个新的银河系模型只需一次地图计算、变换和收缩。我们计算了超出标准低频极限的调制协方差，并将 LISA 响应展开到有限臂长修正的二阶以及不等臂修正的一阶。对于有限臂长修正，这些效应在 3 mHz 和 5 mHz 处分别使归一化调制曲线改变约 0.23% 和 0.64%；对于不等臂修正，在自通道和交叉通道中分别改变约 0.074% 和 0.71%。利用该快速正向模型和一个假想的盘-核球银河系模型，我们从随时间变化的通道协方差构造 Fisher 矩阵，并预测一年观测对盘标度宽度和标度高度相对于银心距离的约束分别达到 8% 和 12% 水平，而强相关的核球比例和核球半径各自仍不受约束。
classification.one_liner: 提出快速正向时频模型，计算 LISA 中银河系引力波前景的年度调制并预测盘/核球参数约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 与全息对偶、量子引力、纠缠/复杂度等无直接关系；主题是 LISA 引力波数据分析与银河系前景建模。

papers.title: Horizon-Scale Corrections to Black Hole Geometry from a Conserved Quantum Atmosphere
papers.abstract: Black holes are usually described either as classical geometries on which quantum fields propagate or as objects whose complete quantum description lies beyond semiclassical gravity. Hawking radiation already shows, however, that a black hole is not an exactly isolated system: the horizon carries a thermal scale and, after coarse graining, may be associated with fluctuations, dissipation and environmental correlations. Whether this horizon-scale openness can be encoded directly in the gravitational background, before any stochastic treatment of the metric, remains an open question. Here we answer it by introducing, for the first time, a conserved Hawking-scale anisotropic source representing the coarse-grained near-horizon atmosphere and solving the Einstein equations for a static black hole at fixed ADM mass. The dressed geometry has a renormalized mass function, a self-consistently shifted horizon and a modified surface gravity. Because the same lapse governs the horizon and timelike geodesics, the thermal response is accompanied by a correlated orbital restructuring: the effective potential is renormalized, the ISCO moves inward and the near-horizon residence time increases. The construction adds no Langevin force to a fixed Schwarzschild background; rather, it defines a deterministic dressed mean geometry, providing a controlled background on which stochastic metric fluctuations may subsequently be treated in the Einstein-Langevin framework. This establishes the deterministic mean-field sector as the necessary first step for future stochastic gravity programs addressing horizon-scale openness.

classification.title_zh: 来自守恒量子大气的黑洞几何视界尺度修正
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞通常要么被描述为量子场在其上传播的经典几何，要么被描述为其完整量子描述超出半经典引力的对象。然而霍金辐射已表明黑洞并非严格孤立系统：视界携带热尺度，粗粒化后可能与涨落、耗散和环境关联相关。视界尺度的开放性是否能在对度规作任何随机处理之前直接编码进引力背景，仍是未决问题。我们通过首次引入一个守恒的霍金尺度各向异性源来代表粗粒化的近视界大气，并在固定 ADM 质量下为静态黑洞求解 Einstein 方程，从而回答该问题。修饰后的几何具有重整化质量函数、自洽移动的视界和修改的表面引力。由于同一 lapse 同时支配视界和类时测地线，热响应伴随着相关的轨道重构：有效势被重整化，ISCO 向内移动，近视界停留时间增加。该构造并未在固定 Schwarzschild 背景上加入 Langevin 力；相反，它定义了一个确定性的修饰平均几何，为之后在 Einstein-Langevin 框架中处理随机度规涨落提供受控背景。这确立了确定性平均场部分作为未来处理视界尺度开放性的随机引力计划的必要第一步。
classification.one_liner: 通过引入守恒的霍金尺度各向异性源并求解 Einstein 方程，得到带有移动视界、修正表面引力与向内移动 ISCO 的确定性修饰黑洞几何，为随机引力提供平均场背景。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究黑洞时空几何、视界修正、表面引力与 ISCO/测地线效应；但并非 AdS/CFT 全息研究，也未使用全息字典。

papers.title: Scale-Invariant Non-Collapse from Raychaudhuri Comparison
papers.abstract: We establish a scale-invariant spatial non-collapse estimate for hypersurface-orthogonal timelike geodesic congruences. The result extends a previous Raychaudhuri-based construction in which a comparison estimate for the expansion was used to control the volume of domains transported along the congruence. The additional ingredient here is a quantitative estimate of the spatial distance distortion induced by the expansion and shear. Assuming that the initial spatial geometry is non-collapsed up to a scale $r_0$, and that the expansion, shear, and timelike Ricci curvature satisfy suitable uniform bounds, we obtain, before the first blow-up time of the Raychaudhuri comparison solution, \begin{equation*} \operatorname{Vol}_{h_\tau}\bigl(B_{h_\tau}(p_\tau,r)\bigr) \geq \kappa_{\mathrm{L}}(\tau)\, r^3, \end{equation*} where \begin{equation*} \kappa_{\mathrm{L}}(\tau) = \kappa_0 e^{-3K\tau} \exp\!\left(\int_0^\tau \Theta(s)\,ds\right), \qquad K = \frac{\Theta_0}{3} + \Sigma_0 . \end{equation*} Here $\Theta$ denotes the solution of the scalar Raychaudhuri comparison equation and $K$ controls the spatial metric distortion. For every finite time strictly before the comparison barrier, $\kappa_{\mathrm{L}}(\tau)$ is positive. When the comparison solution has a finite blow-up time, the explicit comparison coefficient approaches zero as that time is approached from below. The comparison barrier is a boundary of the estimate and is not, by itself, a statement that the physical congruence develops a focal point or spacetime singularity. The result is structurally analogous to scale-invariant non-collapse estimates in geometric flow, but is mathematically distinct from Perelman's $\kappa$-noncollapsing theorem for Ricci flow.

classification.title_zh: 基于 Raychaudhuri 比较的尺度不变非坍缩
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为超曲面正交的类时测地线汇建立了一个尺度不变的空间非坍缩估计。该结果扩展了先前基于 Raychaudhuri 的构造；在先前构造中，一个关于膨胀的比较估计被用来控制沿该汇输运的区域的体积。这里新增的要素是对由膨胀和剪切所诱导的空间距离畸变的定量估计。假设初始空间几何在尺度 r0 之前是非坍缩的，并且膨胀、剪切和类时 Ricci 曲率满足合适的均匀界，则在 Raychaudhuri 比较解的首次爆破时间之前，我们得到 Vol_{h_τ}(B_{h_τ}(p_τ,r)) ≥ κ_L(τ) r^3，其中 κ_L(τ) = κ_0 e^{-3Kτ} exp(∫_0^τ Θ(s) ds)，K = Θ_0/3 + Σ_0。这里 Θ 表示标量 Raychaudhuri 比较方程的解，K 控制空间度规畸变。对于比较屏障之前的每个有限时间，κ_L(τ) 为正。当比较解具有有限爆破时间时，显式比较系数在从下方趋近该时间时趋于零。比较屏障是该估计的边界，其本身并不表示物理汇发展出焦点或时空奇点。该结果在结构上类似于几何流中的尺度不变非坍缩估计，但在数学上不同于 Perelman 关于 Ricci 流的 κ-非坍缩定理。
classification.one_liner: 在经典广义相对论几何中，用 Raychaudhuri 比较给出类时测地线汇的尺度不变空间非坍缩估计，并明确其与 Perelman κ-非坍缩定理的区别。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论的数学结构，围绕 Raychaudhuri 方程和测地线汇的非坍缩估计，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息字典；对经典引力支线有直接相关性，对全息主线相关性较低。

papers.title: Gravitational-wave signatures of spinning particles around rotating hairy black holes
papers.abstract: We study how the spin of a compact secondary and a gravitational-decoupling deformation of the Kerr geometry are imprinted on gravitational waves from strong-field eccentric motion around a rotating black hole. The orbit is evolved with the Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon equations under the Tulczyjew spin supplementary condition, and the radiation is computed with the numerical-kludge method. The deformation describes a black hole only below a critical curve in the plane of the two hair parameters. The spin of the secondary pulls the pericenter inward and, above a critical value, carries the particle into the black hole. The hair raises this capture threshold, from $S\simeq0.66$ in Kerr to $0.9$ and above close to the horizon boundary, because it reduces the effective mass near the black hole. The emitted signal remains a discrete comb of orbital harmonics: the spin strengthens the pericenter bursts and shifts power toward higher harmonics, while both the spin and the hair leave their main imprint through an accumulated dephasing. The imprint of the hair is controlled by the parameter that sets the radial reach of the deformation, disappears in the Kerr-like limit of the family, and is amplified by the spin of the secondary. For a source at $2$ Gpc with $M=10^6M_\odot$ and $\mu=10M_\odot$, a $6.8$ h segment of the signal carries a signal-to-noise ratio of about $1.4$ in LISA, $2.7$ in Taiji and $0.9$ in TianQin. Within the same segment the more extended deformations become distinguishable from Kerr, first in Taiji; since this holds for a nonspinning secondary, it applies directly to astrophysical EMRIs. The spin-induced frequency shifts are linear in the spin, so the large spins used here are a magnified illustration of a dephasing that, for realistic secondaries, accumulates to a phase of order a radian over an inspiral.

classification.title_zh: 旋转毛发黑洞周围自旋粒子的引力波特征
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究紧凑次级天体的自旋以及 Kerr 几何的引力退耦形变如何印刻在旋转黑洞周围强场偏心运动的引力波中。轨道用 Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon 方程在 Tulczyjew 自旋补充条件下演化，辐射用 numerical-kludge 方法计算。该形变描述的黑洞只存在于两个毛发参数平面中的临界曲线以下。次级自旋将近星点向内拉，并在超过临界值时把粒子带入黑洞。毛发提高了这一捕获阈值：从 Kerr 的 S≃0.66 提高到靠近视界边界时的 0.9 及以上，因为毛发降低了黑洞附近的有效质量。辐射信号仍是一组离散的轨道谐波：自旋增强近星点暴并功率推向更高谐波，而自旋和毛发都主要通过累积退相位留下印记。毛发的印记由决定形变径向范围的参数控制，在该族的 Kerr 类极限中消失，并被次级自旋放大。对于位于 2 Gpc、M=10^6 M⊙、μ=10 M⊙ 的源，6.8 小时信号段在 LISA 中信噪比约为 1.4，在 Taiji 中约为 2.7，在 TianQin 中约为 0.9。在同一段内，更延展的形变可先从 Kerr 中区分出来，首先是在 Taiji；由于这对无自旋次级也成立，因此直接适用于天体物理 EMRI。自旋引起的频移对自旋是线性的，所以这里使用的大自旋是对退相位的放大示例；对于实际次级，这种退相位在一次旋近中累积到约一弧度的相位。
classification.one_liner: 研究自旋次级天体与旋转毛发黑洞形变在强场偏心轨道引力波中的印记，并评估 LISA/Taiji/TianQin 可探测性。

papers.title: Natural Quenching of Inner Viscous Torques in Accretion Disks Around Mini-Boson Stars
papers.abstract: The standard Novikov-Thorne model for geometrically thin accretion disks assumes a zero-torque inner boundary condition at the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). Relaxing this assumption to allow a finite viscous torque---driven by magnetic stresses bridging the plunging region---can significantly enhance the radiative efficiency and high-frequency spectral emission of black hole accretion flows. While this mechanism is well-established for Kerr spacetimes, its thermodynamic viability around exotic, horizonless compact objects remains largely unexplored. In this article, we investigate the application of the inner viscous torque boundary condition to a thin disk embedded in a regular mini-boson star spacetime. By numerically integrating the coupled Einstein-Klein-Gordon field equations and employing the Lense-Thirring slow-rotation approximation, we generate an exact, horizonless background that strictly satisfies the weak energy condition. We demonstrate that the topological absence of a coordinate ISCO fundamentally alters the accretion dynamics. Without a sudden geodesic plunge, stable circular orbits penetrate deep into the dense scalar core, causing the physical inner boundary of the disk to be determined dynamically by the peak of the Keplerian angular velocity. Because the specific angular momentum of the fluid approaches zero at this deep microscopic boundary, the standard viscous torque is mathematically quenched. Consequently, the enhanced radiative flux divergence typically associated with boundary torques in black holes is naturally suppressed around regular boson stars. This torque quenching offers a robust phenomenological discriminator between standard black holes and horizonless ultralight scalar structures.

classification.title_zh: 迷你玻色子星周围吸积盘中内粘性力矩的自然淬灭
classification.abstract_zh: 几何薄吸积盘的标准 Novikov-Thorne 模型假设在最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）处为零力矩内边界条件。放松这一假设、允许由桥接俯冲区的磁应力驱动的有限粘性力矩，会显著提高黑洞吸积流的辐射效率和高频谱发射。尽管该机制在 Kerr 时空中已被充分确立，但其在奇异、无视界致密天体周围的热力学可行性仍基本未被探索。本文中，我们研究将内部粘性力矩边界条件应用于嵌入在规则迷你玻色子星时空中的薄盘。通过数值积分耦合 Einstein-Klein-Gordon 场方程，并采用 Lense-Thirring 慢转近似，我们生成一个严格满足弱能量条件的精确无视界背景。我们证明，坐标 ISCO 的拓扑缺失从根本上改变了吸积动力学。由于不存在突然的测地线俯冲，稳定圆轨道会深入致密标量核，使得盘的物理内边界由 Keplerian 角速度峰值动力学地决定。由于流体在该深微观边界处的比角动量趋于零，标准粘性力矩在数学上被淬灭。因此，通常在黑洞中与边界力矩相关的增强辐射通量散度在规则玻色子星周围被自然抑制。这种力矩淬灭为区分标准黑洞与无视界超轻标量结构提供了稳健的现象学判据。
classification.one_liner: 在规则迷你玻色子星时空的薄吸积盘中，ISCO 缺失导致内边界处比角动量趋于零，从而自然淬灭内粘性力矩，可作为区分黑洞与无视界标量结构的判据。

papers.title: A discontinuous Galerkin method with artificial viscosity geared toward numerical relativity applications
papers.abstract: Artificial viscosity can be used to deal with shocks and other discontinuities such as star surfaces, that can arise in matter. We explain in detail how a local discontinuous Galerkin method can be used to add artificial viscosity terms to hyperbolic evolution equations. These artificial terms are multiplied by a viscosity that is non-zero only in elements that are flagged as non-smooth by a newly developed smoothness indicator. Our artificial viscosity method works well in several simple shock test cases such as with Burgers' equation and blast wave tests. For the first time, we are also able to evolve single neutron star in full general relativistic hydrodynamics. To achieve this, we use different viscosities for the momentum density than for the rest of the matter variables.

classification.title_zh: 一种面向数值相对论应用的人工粘性间断伽辽金方法
classification.abstract_zh: 人工粘性可用于处理激波以及物质中可能出现的星体表面等其他间断。我们详细解释了如何使用局部间断伽辽金方法为双曲演化方程添加人工粘性项。这些人工项乘以一个粘性系数，该系数仅在新开发的平滑度指示器标记为非光滑的单元中非零。我们的人工粘性方法在若干简单激波测试案例（如 Burgers 方程和爆炸波测试）中表现良好。我们首次能够在完整广义相对论流体力学中演化单个中子星。为实现这一点，我们对动量密度与其余物质变量使用不同的粘性系数。
classification.one_liner: 提出面向数值相对论的局部间断伽辽金人工粘性方法，可处理激波并首次演化完整广义相对论流体力学中的单中子星。

papers.title: Chromatic Gravitational-Wave Tests of Dirac-Induced Torsion in Quadratic Einstein--Cartan Gravity: Nanohertz PTA Null Signatures
papers.abstract: We derive a conditional result for leading tensor propagation in Einstein--Cartan--Dirac gravity with the parity-even invariant $\zeta T_{\lambda\mu\nu} T^{\lambda\mu\nu}$ and algebraic torsion sourced by a coarse-grained fermionic axial current. On a spatially flat, homogeneous, and isotropic background, eliminating the nondynamical Lorentz connection yields the Einstein--Hilbert transverse-traceless (TT) action at leading two-derivative order if the matter state obeys an explicit factorized mean-field closure: the connected contribution to $\langle J_{5\mu}J_5^{\mu}\rangle$ is set to zero, the factorized scalar $\bar J_{5\mu}\bar J_5^\mu$ has vanishing first- and second-order TT response, and intrinsic TT anisotropic stress vanishes. Under these conditions, $Q_T= M_{\rm Pl}^{2}$, the tensor speed is luminal, and the local dispersion relation is $\omega^2=k_{\rm phys}^2$, with no leading propagation-induced polarization splitting. The contribution is a model-specific constrained TT-Hessian calculation for this invariant that retains the auxiliary-connection response and states the closure needed for the $\zeta$-dependent terms to cancel. The connected-current TT response of a general fermionic state is not evaluated; this is therefore a conditional result, not a general Einstein--Cartan no-go theorem. The coupling $\zeta$ remains in the axial--axial fermion contact interaction. We define null-test observables and a covariance-weighted statistic for future pulsar-timing-array (PTA) likelihood analyses. Published NANOGrav 15-year harmonic posteriors and the public 2026 collaboration preprint serve only as consistency checks: we perform no new time-of-arrival (TOA)-level likelihood or evidence calculation, and these data do not directly constrain $\zeta$.

classification.title_zh: 二次爱因斯坦–嘉当引力中狄拉克诱导挠率的色散引力波检验：纳赫兹脉冲星计时阵列零信号
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在含宇称偶不变量 ζ T_{λμν}T^{λμν}、且由粗粒化费米子轴矢流代数地源生挠率的 Einstein–Cartan–Dirac 引力中，推导领先张量传播的条件性结果。在空间平坦、均匀、各向同性背景上，若物质态满足显式的因子化平均场闭合条件：⟨J_{5μ}J_5^μ⟩ 的关联贡献被设为零，因子化标量 \bar J_{5μ}\bar J_5^μ 的一阶和二阶 TT 响应为零，且内禀 TT 各向异性应力消失，则消去非动力学洛伦兹联络会在领先二阶导数阶给出 Einstein–Hilbert 横向无迹作用。在这些条件下，Q_T=M_Pl^2，张量速度类光，局域色散关系为 ω^2=k_phys^2，没有领先传播诱导的偏振分裂。该贡献是针对此不变量的模型特定受约束 TT-Hessian 计算，保留了辅助联络响应，并说明 ζ 相关项相消所需的闭合条件。一般费米子态的关联流 TT 响应未被计算；因此这是条件性结果，而非普遍的 Einstein–Cartan no-go 定理。耦合 ζ 仍留在轴矢–轴矢费米子接触相互作用中。我们定义零检验观测量和协方差加权统计量，供未来脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）似然分析使用。已发表的 NANOGrav 15 年谐波后验和公开的 2026 年合作组预印本仅作为一致性检验：我们未进行新的到达时间（TOA）层级似然或证据计算，这些数据不直接约束 ζ。
classification.one_liner: 在二次 Einstein–Cartan–Dirac 引力中，满足特定平均场闭合条件时领先张量传播退化为类光 Einstein–Hilbert TT 模式，并给出供纳赫兹 PTA 零检验使用的条件性观测量。

papers.title: Noninertial Reference Frames in Special Relativity
papers.abstract: Although the special theory of relativity was conceived to relate inertial reference frames, it is not generally known by beginning students, or even by academics not specializing in general relativity, that it can be applied to noninertial reference frames. The general perception among non-specialists seems to be that noninertial reference frames can only be described through general relativity. This situation has led to some controversy regarding the necessity of general relativity to address problems involving accelerated systems, such as the twin paradox and the description of rotating reference frames. We discuss the controversy and propose that, to avoid the present confusion, the local validity of special relativity in the absence of gravitation, despite the use of noninertial frames, should be explicitly and clearly stated at an early stage of the learning process.

classification.title_zh: 狭义相对论中的非惯性参考系
classification.abstract_zh: 尽管狭义相对论是为了关联惯性参考系而提出的，但初学者乃至非广义相对论专业的学者通常并不普遍知道它也可以应用于非惯性参考系。非专业人士的普遍看法似乎是，非惯性参考系只能通过广义相对论来描述。这种情况导致了一些关于处理加速系统问题（如双生子佯谬和旋转参考系的描述）是否需要广义相对论的争议。我们讨论这一争议，并建议为了避免目前的混乱，在缺乏引力时狭义相对论的局部有效性——即使使用非惯性系——应在学习过程的早期就明确而清楚地说明。
classification.one_liner: 本文讨论非惯性系中狭义相对论的适用性争议，主张在教学中明确无引力时狭义相对论的局部有效性。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于狭义相对论基础与非惯性参考系的教学/概念讨论，未涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息，因此与全息研究重点无关；仅因讨论经典时空与相对论框架而与经典引力/广义相对论支线有边缘关联。

papers.title: Periodic Orbits and Their Gravitational-Wave Signatures around a Rotating Black Hole Surrounded by Perfect Fluid Dark Matter
papers.abstract: We investigate equatorial timelike motion of a massive test particle and the associated gravitational radiation around a Kerr black hole surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter. In the presence of a dark matter fluid, the radius of the innermost stable circular orbit decreases, while the specific angular momentum is modified and the specific energy increases as the dark matter (DM) parameter, $\alpha$, increases. We compute periodic timelike orbits using the rational frequency ratio $q$, with the $(z,w,v)$ classification, which is modified by the presence of DM while preserving the topological class. We analyze the gravitational waveforms corresponding to these periodic orbits and find that dark matter modifies the timing and distribution of the oscillatory features of the orbits. For a representative extreme-mass-ratio system, the corresponding characteristic strain is concentrated mainly in the millihertz (mHz) frequency band relevant to LISA. These results establish a direct connection between the dark-matter-induced modifications of strong-field orbital dynamics and the corresponding gravitational-wave signatures.

classification.title_zh: 完美流体暗物质包裹的旋转黑洞周围的周期轨道及其引力波信号
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在完美流体暗物质包裹的 Kerr 黑洞周围，大质量测试粒子的赤道面类时运动及相关的引力辐射。在暗物质流体存在时，最内稳定圆轨道半径减小，而随着暗物质参数 α 增大，比角动量被修正且比能量增加。我们使用有理频率比 q 以及 (z,w,v) 分类计算周期类时轨道；暗物质的存在会修正这些轨道，但保持拓扑分类不变。我们分析了这些周期轨道对应的引力波形，发现暗物质改变了轨道振荡特征的时间分布和分布形态。对于一个代表性的极端质量比系统，相应的特征应变主要集中在与 LISA 相关的毫赫兹（mHz）频段。这些结果建立了暗物质导致的强场轨道动力学修正与相应引力波信号之间的直接联系。
classification.one_liner: 在完美流体暗物质包裹的 Kerr 黑洞时空中，暗物质参数改变周期轨道并影响其毫赫兹引力波信号。
