papers.title: Dynamical Stability and Quasinormal Modes of Casimir Wormholes in dRGT Massive Gravity
papers.abstract: This paper investigates static, spherically symmetric traversable wormholes supported by Casimir energy within de Rham-Gabadadze-Tolley (dRGT) massive gravity. By deriving the exact shape function $b(r) = r_0 + \frac{\pi^3(-r + r_0)}{90 r r_0} - \frac{1}{2} C m_g^2 (r - r_0)[2C c_2 + c_1(r + r_0)]$, we verify that the geometry satisfies the local Morris--Thorne throat and traversability conditions, including $b(r_0)=r_0$ and $b'(r_0)<1$. For the nonzero massive-gravity parameters considered here, the resulting spacetime is not asymptotically flat, and its large-$r$ behavior is governed by the massive-gravity contributions to the shape function. The Casimir energy density $\rho = -\pi^2/(720 r^4)$ ensures the Null Energy Condition is violated throughout the throat region, as demonstrated by the negative behavior of $(\rho + p_r)$ and $(\rho - |p_r|)$ across all parameter values. Analysis of the volume integral quantifier reveals that the massive gravity parameter $m_g^2 c_2$ directly regulates the exotic matter requirement, with the integrated NEC violation becoming more negative as $m_g^2 c_2$ increases from $0.1$ to $0.5$. The mechanical equilibrium is rigorously established via the generalized Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equation, where the anisotropic force precisely balances the gravitational and hydrostatic forces. The quasinormal mode spectrum for scalar perturbations is extracted using both the analytical Mashhoon method and direct numerical integration. The effective potential forms a symmetric barrier at the throat, with the peak height increasing with the multipole number $\ell$. The damping rate $|\omega_I|$ grows systematically with increasing massive gravity parameter. These distinct spectral signatures provide robust theoretical markers for distinguishing Casimir wormholes from black holes in future gravitational wave observations.

classification.title_zh: dRGT 大质量引力中 Casimir 虫洞的动力学稳定性与准正模
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在 de Rham-Gabadadze-Tolley (dRGT) 大质量引力中由 Casimir 能量支撑的静态球对称可穿越虫洞。通过导出形状函数 b(r) = r_0 + π^3(-r + r_0)/(90 r r_0) - 1/2 C m_g^2 (r - r_0)[2C c_2 + c_1(r + r_0)]，验证了该几何满足局域 Morris-Thorne 喉部与可穿越条件，包括 b(r_0)=r_0 和 b'(r_0)<1。对于所考虑的非零大质量引力参数，所得时空并非渐近平直，其大 r 行为由形状函数中的大质量引力贡献支配。Casimir 能量密度 ρ = -π^2/(720 r^4) 使零能量条件在喉部区域整体被违反，表现为所有参数取值下 (ρ+p_r) 和 (ρ-|p_r|) 均为负。对体积积分量词的分析表明，大质量引力参数 m_g^2 c_2 直接调控奇异物质需求；当 m_g^2 c_2 从 0.1 增至 0.5 时，积分 NEC 违反变得更负。通过广义 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程严格建立力学平衡，其中各向异性力精确平衡引力与流体静力。利用解析 Mashhoon 方法和直接数值积分提取标量扰动的准正模谱。有效势在喉部形成对称势垒，其峰高随多极数 ℓ 增大而增加。阻尼率 |ω_I| 随大质量引力参数增大而系统性增大。这些不同的谱特征为未来引力波观测中区分 Casimir 虫洞与黑洞提供了稳健的理论标记。
classification.one_liner: 在 dRGT 大质量引力中，Casimir 虫洞的喉部条件、NEC 违反、TOV 平衡与标量 QNM 被系统分析，显示大质量引力参数可调控奇异物质需求和阻尼率。

papers.title: Gravitational Waves from Higgs Preheating after Inflaton $Z_2$-Symmetry Breaking
papers.abstract: In this paper, nonperturbative lattice simulations are used to study Higgs preheating and the associated gravitational wave (GW) background after the inflaton $Z_2$ symmetry is broken during inflation. This symmetry breaking generates both trilinear and quartic inflaton-Higgs interactions during preheating. The quartic inflaton-Higgs coupling is characterized by $q_{\phi h}\equiv \lambda_{\phi h}/\lambda_\phi$, while the trilinear interaction enters jointly through $q_{\phi h}$ and $q_\epsilon\equiv m_\phi/(\sqrt{\lambda_\phi}\phi_0)$. The Higgs self-coupling parameter $q_h\equiv \lambda_h/\lambda_\phi$ determines the onset of backreaction through the effective mass induced by Higgs self-interactions. Our simulations show that efficient preheating requires both a sufficiently broad resonance band and delayed backreaction. For $\lambda_\phi=10^{-13}$, the viable parameter region is approximately $q_{\phi h}>10$, $q_h<10^3$, and $q_\epsilon<10^{-5}$. Smaller $q_\epsilon$ keeps the system in a quartic-dominated regime and suppresses the rapid drift of resonance bands, while smaller $q_h$ delays the end of preheating by weakening self-interaction-induced backreaction. The amplified Higgs inhomogeneities source GW through the transverse-traceless part of the anisotropic stress tensor. The lattice results show that the GW spectrum grows rapidly during parametric resonance, broadens through rescattering, and saturates in the nonlinear stage. At late times, the spectrum develops a broad peak with amplitude $\Omega_{\rm gw}\sim10^{-6}$ at production. After redshifting to the present day, the peak frequency is $f\sim10^9\,{\rm Hz}$ with present-day amplitude $\Omega_{\rm gw,0} h^2 \sim 10^{-10}$. These results suggest that high-frequency GW from Higgs preheating may be detectable by future resonant-cavity detectors.
authors: Ruo-Peng Zhang (Chongqing Vocational Institute of Engineering)

classification.title_zh: 暴胀子 Z2 对称性破缺后希格斯预加热产生的引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 本文使用非微扰格点模拟研究暴胀期间暴胀子 Z2 对称性破缺后的希格斯预加热及伴随的引力波（GW）背景。该对称性破缺在预加热期间同时产生三线性与四线性暴胀子-希格斯相互作用。四线性暴胀子-希格斯耦合由 q_{\phi h}\equiv \lambda_{\phi h}/\lambda_\phi 表征，而三线性相互作用通过 q_{\phi h} 与 q_\epsilon\equiv m_\phi/(\sqrt{\lambda_\phi}\phi_0) 共同进入。希格斯自耦合参数 q_h\equiv \lambda_h/\lambda_\phi 通过希格斯自相互作用诱导的有效质量决定反作用开始。我们的模拟表明，高效预加热既需要足够宽的共振带，也需要延迟的反作用。对于 \lambda_\phi=10^{-13}，可行参数区域大致为 q_{\phi h}>10、q_h<10^3 和 q_\epsilon<10^{-5}。较小的 q_\epsilon 使系统保持在四线性主导区域并抑制共振带的快速漂移，而较小的 q_h 通过削弱自相互作用诱导的反作用延迟预加热结束。被放大的希格斯非均匀性通过各向异性应力张量的横向无迹部分产生 GW。格点结果显示，GW 谱在参量共振期间快速增长，通过再散射变宽，并在非线性阶段饱和。晚期，谱形成一个宽峰，产生时振幅 \Omega_{\rm gw}\sim10^{-6}。红移到今天后，峰值频率为 f\sim10^9\,{\rm Hz}，今日振幅 \Omega_{\rm gw,0} h^2 \sim 10^{-10}。这些结果表明，来自希格斯预加热的高频 GW 可能被未来谐振腔探测器探测到。
classification.one_liner: 格点模拟表明，暴胀子 Z2 对称性破缺后的希格斯预加热可产生峰值约 10^9 Hz、今日振幅 Ω_gw,0 h^2~10^-10 的高频引力波背景。

papers.title: Conformal prediction for uncertainties in the neutron star equation of state
papers.abstract: We study uncertainties in the equation of state of neutron stars using conformal prediction as a distribution-free and model-agnostic method that provides coverage guarantees. In particular, we apply the Conformalized Quantile Regression (CQR) method to posterior samples calculated from Bayesian inference, creating reliable uncertainty bands without assuming a specific form of the underlying distribution. We first construct CQR bands using a polytropic equation of state and the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations. We then apply CQR as a postprocessing step to the posterior distribution of neutron star mass-radius relations provided by the NMMA collaboration and to quantum Monte Carlo calculations of pure neutron matter. In all cases, empirical coverage studies confirm the robustness of the method.

classification.title_zh: 中子星状态方程不确定性的共形预测
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用共形预测作为一种无分布、模型无关且具有覆盖保证的方法，研究中子星状态方程中的不确定性。特别地，我们将共形化分位数回归（CQR）方法应用于贝叶斯推断得到的后验样本，在不对底层分布形式作假设的情况下构建可靠的置信带。我们首先使用多方状态方程和 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程构建 CQR 带。随后，我们将 CQR 作为后处理步骤应用于 NMMA 合作组提供的中子星质量-半径关系后验分布，以及纯中子物质的量子蒙特卡洛计算。在所有情形中，经验覆盖研究都证实了该方法的稳健性。
classification.one_liner: 将共形化分位数回归用于中子星状态方程后验，提供无分布假设的不确定性带并验证覆盖性。

papers.title: Radial Modes of Hot Neutrino-Trapped Hybrid Stars
papers.abstract: We study the fundamental radial oscillation mode of hot hadronic and hybrid stars under conditions relevant to proto-neutron stars and neutron-star merger remnants. The stellar backgrounds are constructed from finite-temperature equations of state with a covariant density functional for hadronic matter and three-flavor 2SC quark matter at high density. We consider two isentropic configurations in both neutrino-transparent matter and with trapped electron neutrinos at fixed electron-lepton fraction. For trapped matter we compare a Gibbs-type construction with global electron-lepton-number conservation to a locally constrained Maxwell-type prescription; in both cases the fixed-entropy stellar equation of state contains an extended coexistence region and no sharp interface requiring conversion rate-dependent junction conditions. We find that the fundamental radial frequency follows the corresponding purely hadronic sequence up to the onset of deconfinement and then decreases relative to it. Neutrino trapping shifts this dynamical signature to larger stellar masses and central pressures, reflecting the delayed appearance of quark matter. The Maxwell-type prescription moves the onset of deconfinement to still higher central pressure and produces a more rapid decrease of the mode frequency near the stability limit. We quantify the deconfinement effect through the fractional frequency shift between hybrid and hadronic stars at equal gravitational mass. These results show that the fundamental radial mode provides a sensitive dynamical probe of the interplay among entropy, lepton trapping, phase-transition construction, and quark deconfinement in hot compact stars.

classification.title_zh: 热中微子囚禁混合星的径向模式
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了与原型中子星和中子星并合残骸相关条件下，热强子星和混合星的基本径向振荡模式。星体背景由有限温度状态方程构建：强子物质采用协变密度泛函，高密度区采用三味 2SC 夸克物质。我们考虑两种等熵构型，分别处于中微子透明物质中以及固定电子轻子分数下存在囚禁电子中微子的情形。对于中微子囚禁物质，我们将具有全局电子轻子数守恒的 Gibbs 型构造与局部约束的 Maxwell 型方案进行比较；在这两种情形中，固定熵的星体状态方程都包含一个扩展的共存区，而不存在需要依赖于转化速率的界面连接条件的尖锐界面。我们发现，基本径向频率在退禁闭开始之前遵循相应的纯强子星序列，随后相对于该序列下降。中微子囚禁把这一动力学特征移到更大的星体质量和中心压强，反映了夸克物质出现被延迟。Maxwell 型方案将退禁闭开始移到更高的中心压强，并在稳定性极限附近产生更快的模式频率下降。我们通过在相同引力质量下混合星与强子星的分数频率移动来量化退禁闭效应。这些结果表明，基本径向模式为热致密星中熵、轻子囚禁、相变构造和夸克退禁闭之间的相互作用提供了一个灵敏的动力学探针。
classification.one_liner: 热中微子囚禁混合星的基本径向振荡频率可作为夸克退禁闭及相变构造的灵敏动力学探针。

papers.title: Radii and Scaling Relations of Dark-Matter-Admixed Neutron Stars
papers.abstract: The radius of a neutron star is closely related to the equation of state (EOS) of asymmetric nuclear matter, particularly to the nuclear symmetry energy. At fixed stellar mass, the neutron-star radius and the nuclear-matter pressure near saturation density approximately satisfy a pressure--radius (R-P) scaling relation, linking stellar geometry to strong-interaction matter. In the presence of dark matter (DM), changes in the stellar geometry can modify this relation. We investigate how GeV- and sub-GeV-scale DM affects the R-P relation in DM-admixed neutron stars (DANSs) within a gravity-only two-fluid framework. We extend the Buchdahl analytic solution to a two-fluid configuration to demonstrate this scaling and then use 21 nuclear EOSs to fit the relation $R_{\rm NM}=\bar C P_{\rm NM}^{\eta}$ for $1M_\odot$ and $1.4M_\odot$ DANSs. The exponent $\eta$ and coefficient $\bar C$ jointly quantify the DM-induced modification and depend on the DM particle mass, stellar DM content, and self-interaction strength. For bosonic DM, changes in $\eta$ and $\bar C$ occur mainly in the sub-GeV range, whereas significant fermionic-DM effects persist up to about 1.5 GeV. Increasing the DM content or strengthening a repulsive self-interaction generally increases $\eta$ and decreases $\bar C$. The modified R-P relation therefore encodes information about the DM particle mass, abundance, and self-interaction, and affect the extraction of the nuclear EOS from celestial observations. At DM masses of several hundred MeV, both fermionic and bosonic DM can also produce DM-dominated low-mass ($1M_\odot$) DANSs with large radial extensions, for which the conventional scaling relation ceases to apply.

classification.title_zh: 暗物质混合中子星的半径与标度关系
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星半径与不对称核物质的状态方程（EOS）密切相关，尤其与核对称能有关。在固定恒星质量下，中子星半径与饱和密度附近核物质压强近似满足压强—半径（R-P）标度关系，将恒星几何与强相互作用物质联系起来。在存在暗物质（DM）时，恒星几何的变化会修改这一关系。我们在仅引力相互作用的两流体框架中研究GeV和亚GeV尺度暗物质如何影响暗物质混合中子星（DANSs）中的R-P关系。我们将Buchdahl解析解推广到两流体组态以展示该标度关系，然后使用21个核EOS拟合1M⊙和1.4M⊙ DANSs的关系 R_NM = C̄ P_NM^η。指数η和系数C̄共同量化暗物质引起的修正，并依赖于暗物质粒子质量、恒星暗物质含量和自相互作用强度。对于玻色暗物质，η和C̄的变化主要发生在亚GeV范围，而费米暗物质的显著效应持续到约1.5 GeV。增加暗物质含量或增强排斥自相互作用通常会增大η并减小C̄。因此，修改后的R-P关系编码了暗物质粒子质量、丰度和自相互作用的信息，并影响从天体观测中提取核EOS。在几百MeV的暗物质质量下，费米和玻色暗物质均可产生具有大径向延展的暗物质主导的低质量（1M⊙）DANSs，此时传统标度关系不再适用。
classification.one_liner: 暗物质会改变暗物质混合中子星的压强—半径标度关系，其修正取决于暗物质质量、丰度与自相互作用。

papers.title: Photon Ring Astrometry I: A Simple Spin Measurement Technique for High-Resolution Images of M87*
papers.abstract: The supermassive black hole M87* is a target for future horizon-scale imaging that will resolve the first lensed (${n}~{=}~{1}$) sub-image of the photon ring. In this work, we identify a concrete observable---the displacement between the centers of the ${n}~{=}~{1}$ photon-ring sub-image and the direct image. Assuming that the observed large-scale jet of M87 is aligned with the black-hole spin axis, we separate the relative position of the photon ring into components parallel and transverse to the projected spin axis. We show that the parallel shift is primarily determined by inclination and emission radius, while the transverse shift is tightly correlated with inclination and spin. We demonstrate these effects both in a simple geometric model (to explain the underlying physics) and in {general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamics} simulations with magnetically arrested disks (to provide realistic instantiations). We find that a relative astrometric resolution of ${\lesssim}~{0.1\;\mu\rm{as}}$, achievable by the proposed Black Hole Explorer mission, is sufficient to constrain the spin to better than 9\% if the accretion flow is prograde, 25\% if the flow is retrograde, or 24\% if the direction of the flow is undetermined. More generally, this identifies photon-ring astrometry as a promising method to constrain the underlying spacetime geometry without relying on geometric modeling of the observed emission.

classification.title_zh: 光子环天体测量 I：M87* 高分辨率图像的简单自旋测量技术
classification.abstract_zh: 超大质量黑洞 M87* 是未来视界尺度成像的目标，这些成像将分辨出第一个透镜化的（n=1）光子环子像。在这项工作中，我们确定了一个具体的可观测量——n=1 光子环子像中心与直接像中心之间的位移。假设 M87 观测到的大尺度喷流与黑洞自旋轴对齐，我们将光子环的相对位置分解为平行和垂直于投影自旋轴的分量。我们表明，平行位移主要由倾角和发射半径决定，而横向位移与倾角和自旋紧密相关。我们用一个简单几何模型（解释潜在物理）和磁囚禁盘的广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟（提供现实实例）展示了这些效应。我们发现，对于提出的黑洞探索者任务可达到的约 ≲0.1 μas 的相对天体测量分辨率，如果吸积流是顺行的，足以将自旋限制到优于 9%；如果吸积流是逆行的，优于 25%；如果流动方向未确定，优于 24%。更一般地，这表明光子环天体测量是一种有前景的方法，可以在不依赖于对观测辐射进行几何建模的情况下约束潜在时空几何。
classification.one_liner: 利用 n=1 光子环子像与直接像中心的位移，提出一种不依赖辐射几何建模的 M87* 黑洞自旋测量方法。

papers.title: Testing Van der Waals black holes using black hole photon rings
papers.abstract: The Van der Waals black hole (BH) is a non-Kerr model in Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime that exhibits characteristic thermodynamic phase transitions. Whether the physical validity of parameters such as the BH molecular volume $b$ and pressure $P$ is feasible still requires observational verification. As a sensitive probe of strong gravitational fields, the BH photon ring directly carries spacetime geometric information, making it an ideal object for model testing. In accordance with the spacetime metric associated with this BH, this study obtains the null geodesic equations for photons and conserved quantities, determines the photon sphere conditions and radii via effective potential analysis, investigates the photon ring classification and radiative properties, and employs measurements from the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) to place constraints on parameters and simulate the optical appearance. The results show that the molecular volume parameter $b$ significantly regulates the radius of the photon sphere radius, photon ring structure, and the luminosity. Within a specific interval, the model exhibits a high degree of agreement with the EHT measurements for M87* and Sgr A*. This interval not only satisfies the energy conditions (weak, strong, and dominant) but also corresponds to a stable Van der Waals-type phase transition region. Furthermore, the photon ring can distinguish between the Van der Waals BH and the Schwarzschild BH: due to the small-black-hole-large-black-hole (SBH-LBH) phase transition and microstructural discontinuities, the photon ring of the Van der Waals BH is particularly sensitive to the parameter $b$, whereas the Schwarzschild BH lacks these features. This work uses the photon ring to probe BH molecular models, linking its microstructure, spacetime geometry and observational signatures, and provides a new way to derive BH microphysics from observations.

classification.title_zh: 利用黑洞光子环检验范德瓦尔斯黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 范德瓦尔斯黑洞（BH）是反德西特（AdS）时空中的一种非Kerr模型，表现出特征热力学相变。黑洞分子体积 b 和压强 P 等参数的物理有效性是否可行，仍需观测检验。作为强引力场的灵敏探针，黑洞光子环直接携带时空几何信息，使其成为检验模型的理想对象。根据与该黑洞相关的时空度规，本研究得到光子的零测地线方程和守恒量，通过有效势分析确定光子球条件与半径，研究光子环分类与辐射性质，并利用事件视界望远镜（EHT）的测量对参数施加约束并模拟光学外观。结果表明，分子体积参数 b 显著调节光子球半径、光子环结构和光度。在特定区间内，该模型与 M87* 和 Sgr A* 的 EHT 测量高度一致。该区间不仅满足能量条件（弱、强和主能量条件），还对应稳定的范德瓦尔斯型相变区域。此外，光子环可以区分范德瓦尔斯黑洞和史瓦西黑洞：由于小黑洞-大黑洞（SBH-LBH）相变和微观结构不连续性，范德瓦尔斯黑洞的光子环对参数 b 特别敏感，而史瓦西黑洞缺乏这些特征。这项工作利用光子环探测黑洞分子模型，将其微观结构、时空几何和观测特征联系起来，并提供了一种从观测推导黑洞微观物理的新途径。
classification.one_liner: 用光子环和 EHT 观测检验 AdS 中范德瓦尔斯黑洞的参数与相变特征，并区分其与 Schwarzschild 黑洞。

papers.title: Ultracompact anisotropic stars and gravastars in general relativity
papers.abstract: We study static, spherically symmetric ultracompact objects in General Relativity with anisotropic stress. Using the covariant anisotropic equation of state and assuming homogeneous density, we construct a mostly analytical model admitting configurations beyond the Buchdahl limit and with compactness arbitrarily close to the black hole value. The solutions exhibit two regimes separated by a critical curve in the parameter space of compactness and anisotropy, associated with the divergence of the central pressure: regular anisotropic configurations with positive central pressure, and singular configurations with negative central pressure for arbitrary anisotropy. In the latter case, we show that introducing a thick shell removes the pressure divergence, yielding regular ultracompact gravastar configurations. We further construct both anisotropic and isotropic gravastar models using this thick-shell construction.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论中的超致密各向异性星与引力星
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究广义相对论中具有各向异性应力的静态球对称超致密天体。利用协变各向异性状态方程并假设均匀密度，我们构建了一个大部分解析的模型，允许存在超越 Buchdahl 极限且紧致度任意接近黑洞值的位形。解在紧致度与各向异性参数空间中由一条临界曲线分为两个区域，与中心压强发散相关：具有正中心压强的规则各向异性位形，以及任意各向异性下具有负中心压强的奇异位形。在后一情形中，我们表明引入厚壳可消除压强发散，得到规则的超致密引力星位形。我们进一步利用该厚壳构造构建了各向异性和各向同性的引力星模型。
classification.one_liner: 该文在广义相对论框架下构造了超越 Buchdahl 极限的超致密各向异性星，并通过厚壳构造消除了中心压强发散，得到规则的引力星模型。

papers.title: Horizon-scale intensity and polarization images of rotating Konoplya-Zhidenko black holes with thick accretion flows
papers.abstract: We investigate the shadow and polarization images of a Konoplya--Zhidenko rotating non-Kerr black hole surrounded by a geometrically thick and optically thin accretion flow. The accretion flow is described by an analytical ballistic approximation accretion flow model. The numerical results show that the shadow image exhibits two main features, an outer bright ring and an inner dark region. The former corresponds to higher-order images, while the latter is associated with photon capture by the black hole. Increasing the deformation parameter $\eta$ does not significantly change the overall shape of the higher-order images, but it enlarges their size. Increasing either the spin parameter $a$ or the observer inclination angle $\theta_o$ enhances the asymmetry of the higher-order images and makes the intensity on the left side much larger than that on the right side. This behavior is associated with frame dragging and the relativistic Doppler effect. In the polarization images, the degree of linear polarization is much smaller in the higher-order image region than in other regions, and the polarization vectors extend over the whole image plane. Within the framework used in this work, these results illustrate how the spacetime geometry and near-horizon accretion dynamics jointly influence the intensity and polarization images.

classification.title_zh: 旋转 Konoplya-Zhidenko 黑洞与厚吸积流的视界尺度强度与偏振图像
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了被几何厚且光学薄吸积流包围的 Konoplya-Zhidenko 旋转非 Kerr 黑洞的阴影与偏振图像。吸积流由解析弹道近似吸积流模型描述。数值结果显示，阴影图像呈现两个主要特征：外部亮环和内部暗区。前者对应高阶像，后者与光子被黑洞捕获有关。增大形变参数 η 不会显著改变高阶像的整体形状，但会增大其尺寸。增大自旋参数 a 或观测者倾角 θ_o 会增强高阶像的不对称性，并使左侧强度远大于右侧。这种行为与参考系拖曳和相对论多普勒效应有关。在偏振图像中，高阶像区域的线偏振度远小于其他区域，偏振矢量延伸至整个像平面。在本工作所用框架内，这些结果说明了时空几何与近视界吸积动力学如何共同影响强度与偏振图像。
classification.one_liner: 用厚吸积流模型计算旋转 Konoplya-Zhidenko 黑洞的阴影与偏振图像，显示形变、自旋和倾角对高阶像的影响。

papers.title: Black Hole-Boson Star Binaries: Gravitational Wave Signals and Tidal Disruption
papers.abstract: We present a detailed, fully nonlinear study of binary systems involving one black hole and one boson star, considering the effects of both a quartic self-interaction and a solitonic potential for the scalar field. First, we show the importance of using initial data for which the boson star is in an equilibrated configuration to obtain accurate gravitational waveforms, and discuss methods to further improve constraint violations in the initial data. We then present a series of head-on collisions, showing that even in this simplified scenario the radiative efficiency varies significantly with the scalar potential chosen. In addition to this, we present a preliminary study of inspiral configurations, showing that an appropriate scalar self-interaction can suppress tidal disruption. We comment throughout on implications for attempts to build model-agnostic waveform template banks for exotic compact objects.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞-玻色星双星：引力波信号与潮汐瓦解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们对包含一个黑洞和一个玻色星的双星系统进行了详细的、完全非线性的研究，同时考虑了标量场的四次自相互作用和孤子势的影响。首先，我们表明使用玻色星处于平衡构型的初始数据对于获得精确的引力波形至关重要，并讨论了进一步改善初始数据中约束违反的方法。然后，我们展示了一系列迎面碰撞，表明即使在这一简化情形下，辐射效率也会随所选标量势显著变化。此外，我们对旋近构型进行了初步研究，表明适当的标量自相互作用可以抑制潮汐瓦解。我们通篇评论了这些结果对为奇异致密天体构建模型无关波形模板库的尝试的启示。

papers.title: Inverse Area Corrections to Black Hole Entropy Area Formula in F(R) Gravity and Gravitational Wave Observations
papers.abstract: We consider corrections to the Bekenstein Hawking Area Formula for black hole entropy, which have inverse powers of the horizon area for very large horizon areas, for classical spherically symmetric black hole solutions of F(R) modified gravity theory, using the Wald formula for the entropy function with modifications suggested by Jacobson, Kang and Myers. Requiring that the coefficient of such corrections be absolutely consistent with gravitational wave observational results validating the Hawking Area Theorem for binary black hole coalescences, implies constraints on parameters of F(R) gravity. For the sake of comparison, we present a computation of inverse area corrections for quantum black holes in quantum general relativity, using the It from Bit approach of Wheeler modified by some tenets of Loop Quantum Gravity.

classification.title_zh: F(R)引力中黑洞熵面积公式的逆面积修正与引力波观测
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑对黑洞熵的Bekenstein-Hawking面积公式的修正：对于F(R)修改引力理论中的经典球对称黑洞解，在视界面积很大时出现视界面积的逆幂修正。我们使用Wald熵公式以及Jacobson、Kang和Myers提出的修改来计算这些修正。要求这些修正的系数与验证双黑洞并合中Hawking面积定理的引力波观测结果完全一致，会对F(R)引力参数给出限制。作为比较，我们还使用Wheeler的It from Bit方法并加入圈量子引力的一些要点，计算了量子广义相对论中量子黑洞的逆面积修正。
classification.one_liner: 在F(R)修改引力中计算经典球对称黑洞熵的逆面积修正，并利用引力波对Hawking面积定理的验证约束F(R)参数，同时与量子黑洞的类似修正作比较。

papers.title: Asymptotically Euclidean Solutions of the Constraint Equations with Prescribed Asymptotics
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that in constructing asymptotically flat vacuum initial data sets in General Relativity via the conformal method, certain asymptotic structures may be prescribed a priori through the specified seed data, including the ADM momentum components, the leading- and next-to-leading-order decay rates, and the anisotropy in the metric's mass term, yielding a recipe to construct initial data sets with desired asymptotics. We numerically construct a simple explicit example of an initial data set, with stronger asymptotics than have been obtained in previous work, such that the evolution of this initial data set does not exhibit the conjectured antipodal symmetry between future and past null infinity.

classification.title_zh: 具有指定渐近性质的约束方程的渐近欧几里得解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们表明，在广义相对论中通过共形方法构造渐近平直真空初始数据集时，某些渐近结构可以事先通过指定的种子数据来规定，包括 ADM 动量分量、领头阶和次领头阶衰减率，以及度规质量项中的各向异性，从而给出一种构造具有所需渐近性质的初始数据集的方案。我们数值构造了一个简单的显式初始数据集例子，其渐近性强于此前工作所得，并且该初始数据集的演化不表现出所猜想的未来与过去零无穷远之间的对跖对称性。
classification.one_liner: 在共形方法中预先指定渐近平直真空初始数据的渐近结构，并数值给出一个违反未来/过去零无穷远对跖对称性猜想的例子。

papers.title: Tests of General Relativity with Einstein Telescope
papers.abstract: Gravitational wave signals from compact binary coalescences provide powerful and reliable probes of General Relativity. To date, the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA collaboration has provided stringent consistency tests of General Relativity predictions. In this work, we present forecasts for how accurately General Relativity can be tested using third-generation ground-based interferometers, focusing on Einstein Telescope (ET) and binary black hole mergers. Given the expected high detection rate, we use a Fisher matrix approach to simulate parameter estimation over large source catalogs, and jointly analyze events within a Bayesian hierarchical framework. We compare different ET configurations and forecast constraints on parametrized deviations of the inspiral post-Newtonian coefficients. Our results indicate that, within about four months of observations, ET could improve current LVK GWTC-3 bounds by roughly four orders of magnitude for the dipole radiation term and about two orders for higher-order coefficients. We further assess the number of detections required to confidently identify deviations from General Relativity at various post-Newtonian orders and for different detector configurations.

classification.title_zh: 用爱因斯坦望远镜检验广义相对论
classification.abstract_zh: 来自致密双星并合的引力波信号为检验广义相对论提供了强大而可靠的探针。迄今为止，LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 合作组已给出严格的广义相对论一致性检验。本文预测了利用第三代地面干涉仪，尤其是爱因斯坦望远镜（ET）和双黑洞并合，能够以多高精度检验广义相对论。鉴于预期的高探测率，我们采用 Fisher 矩阵方法在大量源星表上模拟参数估计，并在贝叶斯层级框架内联合分析事件。我们比较了不同的 ET 配置，并预测了对旋近后牛顿系数参数化偏离的约束。结果表明，在约四个月的观测内，ET 可将当前 LVK GWTC-3 对偶极辐射项的界限改善约四个数量级，对高阶系数约改善两个数量级。我们还评估了在不同后牛顿阶数和不同探测器配置下，有把握地识别广义相对论偏离所需的探测数量。
classification.one_liner: 利用 Einstein Telescope 对双黑洞并合引力波进行 Fisher 矩阵与贝叶斯层级预报，评估对广义相对论后牛顿修正的检验能力。

papers.title: Gravitational-wave background from supermassive black holes without merger trees: Tidally regulated mergers and direct inference from the NANOGrav 15 yr data
papers.abstract: We present a semi-analytic framework that computes the gravitational-wave background (GWB) from supermassive black hole (SMBH) binaries by direct integration of an $N$-body-recalibrated extended Press-Schechter accretion kernel, bypassing Monte Carlo merger trees entirely. The calculation is resolution-free and fast enough to be sampled directly against pulsar-timing data with no emulator or precomputed model bank. Between halo accretion and black-hole binary formation, we couple the satellite's simulation-calibrated tidal mass loss continuously to Chandrasekhar dynamical friction. Satellites below a sharp, nearly redshift-independent mass-ratio threshold, $\xi \simeq 0.04$, are stripped faster than they sink and stall: their drag collapses onto the stellar core, and 38% of accreted satellites are unmerged by $z=0$. Combining this population model with per-binary stellar-hardening turnovers and eccentric spectra, we sample the five-parameter posterior directly against the NANOGrav 15 yr Hellings-Downs-correlated free spectrum, excluding the $15.8$ nHz bin, whose excess power a subsequent chromatic-noise reanalysis attributes to pulsar noise. The data prefer a black-hole mass normalization $+0.31^{+0.20}_{-0.23}$ dex above the locally calibrated black-hole-bulge mass relation, consistent with earlier indications that the nanohertz background is loud relative to local SMBH calibrations and robust to the delay model, merger kernel, local mass calibration, and its redshift evolution. The spectrum is compatible with, but does not require, eccentric binaries or dense stellar environments.

classification.title_zh: 无需并合树的超大质量黑洞引力波背景：潮汐调控并合与从 NANOGrav 15 年数据直接推断
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个半解析框架，通过直接积分经 N 体重新校准的扩展 Press-Schechter 吸积核，计算超大质量黑洞双星的引力波背景，完全绕过蒙特卡洛并合树。该计算无分辨率限制，且足够快，可直接对脉冲星计时数据采样，无需 emulator 或预计算模型库。在晕吸积与黑洞双星形成之间，我们将卫星经模拟校准的潮汐质量损失连续耦合到 Chandrasekhar 动力学摩擦。低于一个尖锐且几乎与红移无关的质量比阈值 ξ≃0.04 的卫星，被剥离速度大于下沉速度并停滞：其拖曳坍缩到恒星核心，38% 的吸积卫星到 z=0 仍未并合。将该种群模型与每个双星的恒星硬化转折和偏心谱结合，我们直接针对 NANOGrav 15 年 Hellings-Downs 相关自由谱采样五参数后验，排除 15.8 nHz bin，其后随的色噪声再分析将该 bin 的超额功率归因于脉冲星噪声。数据偏好黑洞质量归一化比本地校准的黑洞-核球质量关系高 +0.31^{+0.20}_{-0.23} dex，这与早期迹象一致：纳赫兹背景相对于本地 SMBH 校准偏亮，且对延迟模型、并合核、本地质量校准及其红移演化稳健。该谱与偏心双星或致密恒星环境相容，但不要求它们。
classification.one_liner: 通过直接积分吸积核并耦合潮汐剥离与动力学摩擦，半解析计算超大质量黑洞双星引力波背景，并直接拟合 NANOGrav 15 年数据。

papers.title: Beyond dust in local cosmography: covariant kinetic theory
papers.abstract: Modelling cold dark matter as dust makes the matter congruence geodesic and therefore removes any intrinsic dipole from the local Hubble flow. The dust model breaks down as stream crossing develops, whereas a collisionless gas accommodates stream crossing via velocity dispersion in phase space. We develop a covariant kinetic framework for this regime without assuming a background spacetime or any geometrical symmetry. Starting from the exact massive Vlasov hierarchy, we construct its energy-integrated moments and organise these by velocity weight. A self-consistent truncation at the quadrupole closes the dynamics on the matter energy density, isotropic pressure and anisotropic pressure. Their gradients generate a matter-frame 4-acceleration, for which we find an exact nonlinear solution of the momentum constraint, valid in the general case without truncation. This goes beyond previous work in which an arbitrary 4-acceleration is introduced. Velocity dispersion also sources vorticity through the curl of 4-acceleration, and we derive the nonlinear expression for vorticity evolution. We then propagate the non-geodesic matter flow into covariant local cosmography, where the 4-acceleration is the intrinsic Hubble dipole and also enters the deceleration multipoles. Our construction provides a covariant kinetic completion of dust cosmography and identifies the quantities required to test collisionless matter directly with local distance--redshift data. A companion paper specialises the hierarchy to perturbed FLRW spacetime and predicts the size of the resulting cosmographic signals.

classification.title_zh: 超越局部宇宙学中的尘埃：协变动理学理论
classification.abstract_zh: 将冷暗物质建模为尘埃会使物质汇（congruence）测地，从而消除局部哈勃流中的内禀偶极。尘埃模型在流穿越（stream crossing）发展时失效，而无碰撞气体通过相空间中的速度弥散可以容纳流穿越。我们为此类情形发展了一个协变动理学框架，不假设背景时空或任何几何对称性。从精确的有质量 Vlasov 层级出发，我们构造其能量积分矩，并按速度权重组织。四极截断的自洽闭合将动力学闭合到物质能量密度、各向同性压强和各向异性压强上。它们的梯度产生物质系四加速，我们找到了动量约束的一个精确非线性解，在一般情形下无需截断也成立。这超出了先前引入任意四加速的工作。速度弥散还通过四加速的旋度产生涡量，我们推导了涡量演化的非线性表达式。然后我们将非测地物质流传播到协变局部宇宙学中，其中四加速是内禀哈勃偶极，也进入减速多极。我们的构造提供了尘埃宇宙学的协变动理学完备化，并确定了直接用局部距离-红移数据检验无碰撞物质所需的量。一篇姊妹论文将该层级特殊化到扰动 FLRW 时空，并预测由此产生的宇宙学信号的大小。
classification.one_liner: 用协变 Vlasov 动量层级超越尘埃近似，给出非测地局部宇宙学中由速度弥散引起的哈勃偶极与涡量。

papers.title: On the causality of gravitational pp-wave spacetimes: A null version of Anderson's rigidity theorem
papers.abstract: We prove that plane waves are the only gravitational pp-wave spacetimes which are distinguishing; in particular, they are the only strongly causal ones. This is used to prove a null version of Anderson's rigidity theorem, conjectured by Costa e Silva and Flores: every geodesically complete, transversally complete, strongly causal, Ricci-flat Brinkmann spacetime of dimension $4$ is isometric to a quotient of a plane wave spacetime.

classification.title_zh: 论引力 pp-波时空的因果性：Anderson 刚性定理的零版本
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，平面波是唯一可区分的引力 pp-波时空；特别地，它们是唯一强因果的。由此证明 Costa e Silva 和 Flores 猜测的 Anderson 刚性定理的零版本：每个四维、测地完备、横向完备、强因果、Ricci-平坦的 Brinkmann 时空都等距于一个平面波时空的商。
classification.one_liner: 证明可区分的引力 pp-波只能是平面波，并推出四维 Ricci-平坦 Brinkmann 时空的零版 Anderson 刚性定理。

papers.title: Polarization Transport and Polarized Images of a Rotating Braneworld Black Hole
papers.abstract: We investigate polarized synchrotron emission from an optically thin accretion flow around a rotating braneworld black hole, focusing on how higher-dimensional gravity modifies photon propagation and polarization transport. We integrate the null-geodesic and parallel-transport equations for the polarization four-vector and, within a common emissivity and magnetic-field prescription, examine the effects of tidal charge, black-hole spin, observer inclination, and prograde or retrograde orbital motion. We analyze the linearly polarized intensity, electric-vector position angle (EVPA), Stokes parameters, the joint $Q$--$U$ polarization-state space, and the cumulative net linear polarization degree, and compare representative braneworld configurations with Kerr and Kerr--Newman spacetimes. Within the parameter range considered, tidal charge and spin do not generate a qualitatively new large-scale polarization morphology. Instead, they primarily reorganize the polarized intensity, orientation, and polarization-state distribution in the strong-field region near the shadow boundary and photon ring. Viewing inclination controls the dominant projected morphology, while high inclinations enhance projection and Doppler asymmetries and make the distinction between prograde and retrograde flows more pronounced. The Stokes components and their joint state space expose local bending, stretching, and trajectory concentration that are less apparent in intensity images. The cumulative net linear polarization degree decreases with increasing cumulative radius, and larger tidal charge or spin lowers its amplitude for the representative models considered. Together, these complementary polarization observables provide a potential route for separating spacetime, viewing-geometry, and accretion-flow effects and for constraining braneworld tidal charge with horizon-scale polarimetry.

classification.title_zh: 旋转膜世界黑洞的偏振输运与偏振图像
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了旋转膜世界黑洞周围光学薄吸积流的偏振同步辐射，重点关注高维引力如何修正光子传播和偏振输运。我们积分了零测地线和偏振四矢量的平行输运方程，并在共同的发射率和磁场规定下，考察了潮汐电荷、黑洞自旋、观测者倾角以及顺行或逆行轨道运动的影响。我们分析了线偏振强度、电矢量位置角（EVPA）、斯托克斯参数、联合Q-U偏振态空间以及累积净线偏振度，并将代表性的膜世界构型与Kerr和Kerr-Newman时空进行了比较。在所考虑的参数范围内，潮汐电荷和自旋不会产生定性上新的大尺度偏振形态。相反，它们主要重新组织阴影边界和光子环附近强场区域的偏振强度、方向和偏振态分布。观测倾角控制着主要的投影形态，而高倾角增强了投影和多普勒不对称性，并使顺行与逆行流之间的区别更加明显。斯托克斯分量及其联合态空间揭示了强度图像中不太明显的局部弯曲、拉伸和轨迹集中。累积净线偏振度随累积半径的增加而减小，并且对于所考虑的代表性模型，较大的潮汐电荷或自旋会降低其振幅。总之，这些互补的偏振可观测量为分离时空、观测几何和吸积流效应以及用视界尺度偏振测量约束膜世界潮汐电荷提供了一条潜在途径。
classification.one_liner: 通过积分零测地线与偏振四矢平行输运方程，研究了旋转膜世界黑洞吸积流的偏振同步辐射图像，并比较了潮汐电荷、自旋和倾角对偏振态的影响。

papers.title: Puncture Evolution with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract: We investigate the application of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) to solve the vacuum Einstein equations in spherical symmetry. Our neural network architecture is designed to solve the 1+1D moving-puncture evolution, by minimizing a loss that combines a data term, the Ricci tensor of the reconstructed spacetime, and the moving-puncture gauge conditions. It represents the lapse, the shift and the Z4c conformal variables $\chi$ and $\widetilde{\gamma}_{rr}$, which remain regular at the puncture. We consider the evolution of a single, non-spinning black-hole in the puncture gauge and show that PINNs can interpolate numerical relativity (NR) data, predict its evolution, and reconstruct spacetime in regions where no data is provided. As an interpolant, the network provides a compact, differentiable representation of the NR data. Given only early-time and outer-boundary data, it evolves the puncture forward in time and reproduces the main features of the NR solution. Given only exterior data and no gauge condition, an ill-posed inverse problem, it recovers the interior of a Schwarzschild spacetime in coordinates of its own choosing, which we verify by learning the coordinate transformation to the Kerr--Schild form. Finally, we assess the strengths and limitations of PINNs for NR and outline their prospects for future applications.

classification.title_zh: 基于物理信息神经网络的穿刺演化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究将物理信息神经网络（PINNs）应用于求解球对称真空 Einstein 方程。我们的神经网络结构被设计用于求解 1+1 维移动穿刺演化，通过最小化一个结合数据项、重构时空的 Ricci 张量以及移动穿刺规范条件的损失函数。它表示 lapse、shift 以及 Z4c 共形变量 χ 与 γ~rr，这些变量在穿刺处保持正则。我们考虑在穿刺规范下单个非旋转黑洞的演化，并表明 PINNs 可以插值数值相对论（NR）数据、预测其演化，并在未提供数据的区域重构时空。作为插值器，网络给出了 NR 数据的紧致、可微表示。仅给早期与外部边界数据时，它能把穿刺向前演化，并重现 NR 解的主要特征。仅给外部数据且无规范条件——一个不适定逆问题——时，它在其自行选择的坐标中恢复 Schwarzschild 时空内部，我们通过学习到 Kerr-Schild 形式的坐标变换对此进行验证。最后，我们评估 PINNs 用于 NR 的优势与局限，并概述其未来应用前景。
classification.one_liner: 用物理信息神经网络求解球对称真空 Einstein 方程的移动穿刺演化，可插值、预测数值相对论黑洞演化并重构 Schwarzschild 内部。

papers.title: Dyonic Simpson Visser black-bounce spacetime surrounded by an exotic Einstein cluster in general relativity
papers.abstract: In this work, we present the Simpson-Visser black-bounce (SV-BB) spacetime with both electric and magnetic charges (the dyonic SV-BB) as an exact solution of general relativity coupled to Maxwell electrodynamics and an anisotropic fluid with vanishing radial pressure. We assume the anisotropic fluid represents an Einstein cluster, which consists of a dense system of particles moving in circular orbits that generate only tangential pressure and zero radial pressure. We show that the dyonic SV-BB metric, which provides a regular black hole spacetime, can be obtained as an exact solution to the Einstein field equations sourced by a combination of an Einstein cluster (which is responsible for providing the exotic matter required to keep a black-bounce throat open) and an electromagnetic field in the framework of Maxwell electrodynamics.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论中由奇异 Einstein 团簇包围的双荷 Simpson-Visser 黑洞反弹时空
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出双荷 Simpson-Visser 黑洞反弹（SV-BB）时空，作为广义相对论与 Maxwell 电动力学以及一种径向压为零的各向异性流体耦合的精确解。我们假设该各向异性流体代表 Einstein 团簇，由沿圆轨道运动的致密粒子体系构成，只产生切向压而径向压为零。我们证明，双荷 SV-BB 度规给出一个规则黑洞时空，可作为 Einstein 场方程的精确解获得，其源为 Einstein 团簇（负责提供维持黑洞反弹喉部张开所需的奇异物质）与 Maxwell 电动力学框架中的电磁场的组合。
classification.one_liner: 在广义相对论中，用 Einstein 团簇与 Maxwell 场构造出双荷 Simpson-Visser 黑洞反弹精确解。

papers.title: Scalaron Quasinormal and Quasi-Bound Modes of Schwarzschild Black Holes in the Bondi-Sachs Formulation of Metric $f(R)$ Gravity
papers.abstract: We study scalaron quasinormal modes and quasi-bound states of Schwarzschild black holes directly within the Bondi-Sachs formulation of metric $f(R)$ gravity, combining frequency-domain analyses with characteristic time evolution. Starting from the linearised characteristic equations, we obtain the massive scalar master equation and show that the tensor master equation takes the same form as in general relativity. For the analytic models considered here, the linear scalar spectra depend on the $f(R)$ theory only through the dimensionless combination $\mu M$. We compute both quasinormal and quasi-bound spectral branches using Leaver's continued-fraction method and compare them with independent literature benchmarks. To complement the frequency domain analysis, we evolve the scalaron perturbation equations using a fourth order convergent characteristic scheme. Applying matrix-pencil stability scans to the resulting waveforms, we independently recover fundamental quasinormal frequencies consistent with the continued-fraction results within the measured extraction-stability scales. Finally, for a selected finite-mass case, we demonstrate the extraction of both oscillation frequencies and damping rates of the fundamental quasinormal mode and quasi-bound state from separate time windows of the same waveform at one extraction radius, without imposing either spectral branch at the finite outer boundary.

classification.title_zh: 度规 f(R) 引力的 Bondi-Sachs 表述中 Schwarzschild 黑洞的标量子准正规模与准束缚模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在度规 f(R) 引力的 Bondi-Sachs 表述中直接研究 Schwarzschild 黑洞的标量子准正规模与准束缚态，结合频域分析与特征时间演化。从线性化特征方程出发，我们得到有质量标量主方程，并表明张量主方程与广义相对论中形式相同。对于所考虑的解析模型，线性标量谱仅通过无量纲组合 μ M 依赖于 f(R) 理论。我们使用 Leaver 连分数法计算准正规模与准束缚谱分支，并与独立文献基准比较。为补充频域分析，我们用四阶收敛特征格式演化标量子扰动方程。对所得波形应用矩阵束稳定性扫描，我们在测量提取稳定性尺度内独立复现与连分数结果一致的基本准正规模频率。最后，对一个选定的有限质量情形，我们展示可在同一提取半径的同一波形的不同时间窗口中，分别提取基本准正规模与准束缚态的振荡频率和阻尼率，而不需要在有限外边界强加任一谱分支。
classification.one_liner: 在 Bondi-Sachs 表述下用频域 Leaver 连分数与特征演化计算 f(R) 引力中 Schwarzschild 黑洞标量子的准正规模和准束缚态。

papers.title: Exact solutions of Maxwell vacuum equations in null homogeneous Petrov spaces with solvable motions groups
papers.abstract: Null homogeneous Petrov spaces $V^*_4(N)$ are considered. The geometry of $V^*_4(N)$ is determined by the geometry of the three-dimensional homogeneous Riemannian space $V_3(N)$, which is invariant under the action of the three-parameter motions group $G_3(N)$ ($N$ corresponds to the group number in the Bianchi classification). The canonical frame of the space $V_3(N)$ is used to construct the metric tensor of the space $V^*_4(N)$ and the components of the vector potential of the invariant electromagnetic field. Using this reper, we obtain Maxwell vacuum equations containing only the structure constants of the groups, the non-holonomic components of the contravariant metric tensor and vector potential, and their derivatives with respect to the wave variable. All non-equivalent exact solutions of Maxwell vacuum equations are found for the case of solvable motions groups $G_3(I)-G_3(VII)$. All solutions of Maxwell vacuum equations obtained in this article are written explicitly in terms of arbitrary independent functions of wave variable. Therefore, when integrating the Einstein-Maxwell equations, it has to consider only the remaining systems of Einstein equations which reduce to systems of ordinary differential equations that include only these independent functions.

classification.title_zh: 可解运动群零齐次Petrov空间中的Maxwell真空方程精确解
classification.abstract_zh: 考虑了零齐次Petrov空间 $V^*_4(N)$。$V^*_4(N)$ 的几何由三维齐次Riemann空间 $V_3(N)$ 的几何决定，而 $V_3(N)$ 在三参数运动群 $G_3(N)$ 作用下不变（$N$ 对应Bianchi分类中的群编号）。利用 $V_3(N)$ 的规范标架构造 $V^*_4(N)$ 的度规张量以及不变电磁场矢量势的分量。使用该标架，得到仅包含群结构常数、逆变度规张量和矢量势的非完整分量以及它们对波变量导数的Maxwell真空方程。对于可解运动群 $G_3(I)-G_3(VII)$ 的情形，找到了Maxwell真空方程的所有非等价精确解。本文得到的所有Maxwell真空方程解都用波变量的任意独立函数显式写出。因此，在积分Einstein-Maxwell方程时，只需考虑剩余的Einstein方程系统，这些系统可化为仅包含这些独立函数的常微分方程系统。
classification.one_liner: 在可解Bianchi运动群对应的零齐次Petrov空间中，显式求出Maxwell真空方程的全部非等价精确解。

papers.title: Bias-aware Fisher forecasts for stochastic gravitational-wave background
papers.abstract: Whittle-likelihood forecasting of the stochastic gravitational-wave background underpins planned mHz interferometers (LISA, Taiji, TianQin). A composite two-stage estimator, per-bin amplitude estimation then unweighted log-space template fitting, inflates the marginal-Fisher amplitude error bar on resolved-bin count by up to an order of magnitude at \(11.5\)-d baseline. This inflation arises from the composite implementation, not the determinant-approximate \texttt{gauss\_D} likelihood it approximates. Jointly maximised, \texttt{gauss\_D} is unbiased (\(R=1.000\) within \(10^{-4}\)) and is recommended baseline with exact-Whittle likelihood. With exact Whittle as control and \texttt{gauss\_D} as working model, we calibrate bias vector and mean-squared-error matrix for power-law and smooth broken-power-law templates. First, for sharp signals of a \(32\)-point sound-shell scan, the composite estimator inflates amplitude error bar by \(R=10.2\) at \(11.5\)-d baseline (median \(\simeq3\)), follows \(R^2-1\propto T_{\mathrm{seg}}^2\) at shorter segments, and has a non-removable efficiency gap \(\mathbf{C}_b\) up to \(18\%\) in \(\alpha_{\mathrm{out}}\). Second, the usual single-parameter Whittle-bias diagnostic does not track multi-parameter inflation and errs both ways. Third, inflation is negligible on \(30\)-min segments, \(R-1\le1.5\times10^{-3}\) over measured bias-exponent range, vanishes below sensitivity floor, and tracks resolved signal strength with \(\mathrm{corr}[\ln \mathrm{SNR},\ln(R-1)]=0.91\). Results are frequentist; interval diagnostics transfer to flat-prior credible intervals only in the locally Gaussian regime. The calibration is a strong-signal, stationary statement transferable only to a matching noise model.

classification.title_zh: 面向随机引力波背景的偏差感知 Fisher 预测
classification.abstract_zh: 随机引力波背景的 Whittle 似然预测是计划中的 mHz 干涉仪（LISA、Taiji、TianQin）的基础。一种复合两阶段估计器——先进行逐 bin 振幅估计，然后进行未加权对数空间模板拟合——在 11.5 天基线下，将已分辨 bin 数上的边缘 Fisher 振幅误差棒放大多达一个数量级。这种放大来源于复合实现，而非它所近似的行列式近似 gauss_D 似然。联合最大化时，gauss_D 是无偏的（R=1.000，在 10^-4 内），并被推荐为与精确 Whittle 似然一起使用的基线。以精确 Whittle 为对照、gauss_D 为工作模型，我们为幂律和光滑折幂律模板校准偏差向量和均方误差矩阵。第一，对于 32 点声壳扫描的锐信号，复合估计器在 11.5 天基线下将振幅误差棒放大 R=10.2（中位数约 3），在较短分段下遵循 R^2-1 ∝ T_seg^2，并且在 α_out 中具有高达 18% 的不可移除效率间隙 C_b。第二，通常的单参数 Whittle 偏差诊断不能追踪多参数膨胀，并会双向出错。第三，在 30 分钟分段上膨胀可忽略，R-1 ≤ 1.5×10^-3 在测量的偏差指数范围内，低于灵敏度下限时消失，并跟踪已分辨信号强度，corr[ln SNR, ln(R-1)]=0.91。结果是频率学派的；区间诊断仅在局部高斯区域转移到平坦先验可信区间。该校准是强信号、平稳的陈述，只能转移到匹配的噪声模型。
classification.one_liner: 该文校准随机引力波背景 Fisher 预测中复合估计器引起的偏差与误差膨胀，指出 gauss_D 联合最大化是无偏基线，并量化其适用范围。

papers.title: On the stability of spherically symmetric relativistic configurations with scalar field
papers.abstract: Static spherically symmetric asymptotically flat configurations in General Relativity with a minimally coupled scalar field typically possess naked singularities. We study a linear stability of these configurations against radial (monopole) perturbations in case of power-law scalar field potentials. We employ a new shooting method that extracts the eigenvalues corresponding to the exponentially growing modes of the perturbation. The problem is reduced to one second order ``master'' equation in a divergent form with a regularized effective potential. We confirm our previous results showing that instability modes exist for sufficiently small scalar charges of the initial static configurations.

classification.title_zh: 论含标量场的球对称相对论构型的稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论中，带有最小耦合标量场的静态球对称渐近平坦构型通常具有裸奇点。我们研究了这类构型在径向（单极）微扰下的线性稳定性，针对幂律标量场势。我们采用一种新的打靶法，提取对应于微扰指数增长模式的本征值。该问题被约化为一个发散形式下的二阶“主”方程，并带有正规化的有效势。我们证实了先前的结果：对于初始静态构型足够小的标量荷，存在不稳定模式。
classification.one_liner: 用新打靶法分析带标量场球对称GR构型的径向线性稳定性，发现小标量荷下存在不稳定模式。

papers.title: Bouncing Dust Collapse and Black-to-White Hole Transition on the Brane
papers.abstract: We study the spherical collapse of a homogeneous dust cloud on a three-brane in the Shtanov--Sahni braneworld, in which the extra dimension is timelike. In the high-energy regime the brane Friedmann equation acquires a negative quadratic term in the matter density, controlled by a critical density $\rhoc=2\lambda$, where $\lambda$ is the magnitude of the negative brane tension. For a spatially closed interior we integrate the dynamics exactly. Every turning point of the scale factor lies above $\astar=\sqrt{3/4\pi\lambda}$, a bounce exists if and only if a simple condition on the comoving density holds, and all curvature invariants stay below bounds fixed by $\lambda$ alone along the entire cycle. Comoving worldlines are geodesically complete. We then match the cloud across a comoving boundary to a spherically symmetric exterior with a trace-free effective source and solve the Israel conditions in closed form. The exterior is a charged Vaidya geometry whose mass function and tidal charge are fixed by the boundary radius. The tidal charge is positive, opposite in sign to the Randall--Sundrum case, and the exterior cannot be static. A trapped region forms on the boundary if and only if the mass exceeds $2/(3\sqrt{\pi\lambda})$, and in that case the bounce still takes place in an untrapped neighbourhood of the boundary. For trapped clouds we construct an exterior over the full contraction, bounce and re-expansion by joining an advanced and a retarded charged Vaidya patch through a static wedge. The matched metric is of class $C^{1,1}$, the effective energy conditions hold, and the cloud re-emerges through a white hole region into a second asymptotic region. In the general relativistic limit $\lambda\to\infty$ the Oppenheimer--Snyder solution is recovered.

classification.title_zh: 膜上的反弹尘埃坍缩与黑洞到白洞转变
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究Shtanov-Sahni膜世界中三维膜上均匀尘云的球对称坍缩，其中额外维是类时的。在高能区，膜Friedmann方程获得一个由临界密度 ρc=2λ 控制的物质密度负二次项，其中 λ 是负膜张力大小的绝对值。对于空间闭合的内部，我们精确积分其动力学。标度因子的每个转折点都高于 a*=√(3/4πλ)，当且仅当共动密度满足一个简单条件时存在反弹，并且在整个循环中所有曲率不变量都保持在仅由 λ 固定的界以下。共动世界线是测地完备的。然后我们将尘云跨过一个共动边界匹配到具有无迹有效源的球对称外部，并以闭合形式求解Israel条件。外部是带电Vaidya几何，其质量函数和潮汐电荷由边界半径固定。潮汐电荷为正，与Randall-Sundrum情形符号相反，且外部不能静态。当且仅当质量超过 2/(3√(πλ)) 时，边界上形成陷落区，而在此情况下反弹仍在边界的非陷落邻域中发生。对于陷落尘云，我们通过一个静态楔将超前和推迟带电Vaidya片连接起来，构造覆盖整个收缩、反弹和再膨胀的外部。匹配度规属于 C^{1,1} 类，有效能量条件成立，尘云通过白洞区域重新出现在第二个渐近区域。在广义相对论极限 λ→∞ 下，恢复Oppenheimer-Snyder解。
classification.one_liner: 在Shtanov-Sahni膜世界中，均匀尘云坍缩会反弹，并可与带电Vaidya外区匹配形成黑洞到白洞转变。

papers.title: Exact Solutions for Colliding Neutrino Waves and the Absence of Mutual Scattering for a Single Grassmann Mode
papers.abstract: We study the head-on collision of two plane neutrino waves in the coupled Einstein-Weyl system, treating the massless Weyl spinor as an odd Grassmann valued field. We show that the mixed components of the Einstein equations force the two counter propagating waves to be built on a single Grassmann mode, whose bilinear $\varepsilon=\eta\eta^{*}$ is nilpotent. With this structure the full coupled system is solved exactly in the interaction region for arbitrary amplitude and phase profiles, and the metric and spinor fields are matched to the single wave regions by the non-impulsive O'Brien-Synge junction conditions. The metric functions contain no terms coupling the two waves; the Weyl scalar $\Psi_2$ vanishes, and $\Psi_0$, $\Psi_4$ are proportional to the neutrino energy fluxes. The waves therefore traverse each other without mutual scattering; we trace this to the nilpotency of the single mode bilinear. We discuss the limits of this result and indicate where cross couplings can arise.

classification.title_zh: 碰撞中微子波的精确解与单 Grassmann 模下无相互散射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在耦合的 Einstein-Weyl 系统中研究两列平面中微子波的对头碰撞，将无质量 Weyl 旋量视为奇 Grassmann 值场。我们证明，Einstein 方程的混合分量迫使两列反向传播的波建立在单个 Grassmann 模上，其双线性 ε=ηη* 是幂零的。在此结构下，相互作用区域中对任意振幅和相位剖面的完整耦合系统被精确求解，并且度规与旋量场通过非脉冲 O'Brien-Synge 连接条件与单波区域匹配。度规函数不含耦合两列波的项；Weyl 标量 Ψ2 为零，而 Ψ0、Ψ4 与中微子能量通量成正比。因此两列波彼此穿过而无相互散射；我们将此归因于单模双线性的幂零性。我们讨论了该结果的适用范围，并指出交叉耦合可能出现的场合。
classification.one_liner: 在耦合 Einstein-Weyl 系统中，单 Grassmann 模的中微子平面波对撞可精确求解，且两波无相互散射。

papers.title: Optical Signatures of Black Holes Surrounded by a Generalized Cloud of Strings
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the optical signatures of black holes surrounded by a generalized cloud of strings, described by the Letelier--Alencar spacetime. We first analyze null geodesics, showing that the string parameters can either increase or decrease the photon sphere radius and the critical impact parameter relative to their Schwarzschild values. Since the spacetime is not asymptotically flat, the critical impact parameter does not directly coincide with the physical shadow radius. We use this distinction to derive constraints on the model parameters from the shadow radius bounds of Sgr A* and M87*. In the weak-field regime, we calculate the light deflection angle using both the Gauss--Bonnet method and a perturbative expansion of the null geodesic equations, obtaining consistent results that contain a contribution from the asymptotically conical geometry in addition to the local gravitational deflection. We also examine the Shapiro time delay and identify a distance dependent contribution associated with the non Minkowskian asymptotic background. Finally, we study the optical appearance of geometrically and optically thin accretion disks and construct celestial sphere images through backward ray tracing. The transfer functions and lensing images show that the generalized cloud of strings modifies the null geodesic mapping in a nonuniform manner rather than producing a simple rescaling of the Schwarzschild image. In particular, configurations with a smaller shadow may still produce an outward displacement of the main Einstein ring image, demonstrating that different optical observables probe distinct aspects of photon propagation in this geometry.

classification.title_zh: 被广义弦云包围的黑洞的光学特征
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究由Letelier-Alencar时空描述的、被广义弦云包围的黑洞的光学特征。我们首先分析零测地线，表明弦参数相对于Schwarzschild值既可以增大也可以减小光子球半径和临界碰撞参数。由于该时空不是渐近平坦的，临界碰撞参数并不直接等同于物理阴影半径。我们利用这一区别，从Sgr A*和M87*的阴影半径界限推导模型参数约束。在弱场区域，我们分别使用Gauss-Bonnet方法和零测地线方程的微扰展开计算光线偏折角，得到一致结果；除局域引力偏折外，结果还包含来自渐近锥形几何的贡献。我们还考察Shapiro时延，并识别出与距离相关的贡献，其关联于非Minkowski渐近背景。最后，我们研究几何薄和光学薄吸积盘的光学外观，并通过后向光线追踪构造天球图像。转移函数和透镜图像表明，广义弦云以非均匀方式修改零测地线映射，而不是对Schwarzschild图像产生简单重标度。特别地，阴影较小的构型仍可能使主爱因斯坦环图像向外位移，说明不同光学观测量探测该几何中光子传播的不同方面。
classification.one_liner: 分析Letelier-Alencar广义弦云黑洞的零测地线、阴影约束、偏折与时延及薄盘图像，发现弦参数非均匀改变光学观测。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究广义相对论框架下黑洞时空的零测地线、阴影、光线偏折、Shapiro时延与吸积盘光学图像，直接匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及AdS/CFT或全息对偶。

papers.title: Dynamical thin shells in black hole ringdown
papers.abstract: We study how a radially oscillating thin shell outside a black hole (BH) affects gravitational wave ringdown and derive matching conditions for polar and axial perturbations from the linearized Israel junction conditions on the moving worldtube. Periodic shell motion produces Floquet sidebands in the scattered wave. For a distant shell, the motion has little effect on the prompt ringdown and only weakly modifies the late time echoes. When the shell is closer to the BH, a replica of a long lived shell mode enters the incident frequency band, increasing the late time echo amplitude by roughly two orders of magnitude. We also identify an exceptional point where two polar modes coalesce and find the contribution of its second order pole in the late time waveform.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞铃宕中的动力学薄壳
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了黑洞（BH）外部径向振荡薄壳如何影响引力波铃宕，并从运动世界管上的线性化 Israel 拼接条件推导了极向和轴向扰动的匹配条件。壳的周期性运动在散射波中产生 Floquet 边带。对于远处的壳，运动对早期铃宕影响很小，仅微弱修正晚期回声。当壳更靠近黑洞时，一个长寿命壳模式的复制进入入射频带，使晚期回声振幅增加约两个数量级。我们还识别出两个极向模式合并的例外点，并发现其二阶极点在晚期波形中的贡献。
classification.one_liner: 研究黑洞外振荡薄壳对引力波铃宕和回声的影响，推导极向/轴向扰动匹配条件，并发现 Floquet 边带与例外点。

papers.title: Electromagnetic quasinormal modes of a Schwarzschild black hole in a superconducting plasma
papers.abstract: We formulate a generally covariant extension of London electrodynamics in four-dimensional curved spacetime and investigate the propagation of electromagnetic perturbations in a superconducting medium surrounding a black hole. The ordinary London relation is promoted to a gauge-invariant four-dimensional constitutive equation involving the electromagnetic four-potential and the phase of the superconducting condensate. When combined with the covariant Maxwell equations, the resulting system is equivalent, in the London (unitary) gauge, to a Proca theory with an effective photon mass set by the inverse London penetration depth. We derive the corresponding Schr\"odinger-like wave equations for electromagnetic perturbations in the axial and polar sectors of the Schwarzschild spacetime in the presence of the superconducting plasma. The axial sector is governed by a single Regge--Wheeler-type equation whose effective potential contains the London mass term, whereas the polar sector contains two coupled physical degrees of freedom. Quasinormal-mode boundary conditions are formulated for the Schwarzschild geometry. The London penetration depth shifts the oscillation frequencies, modifies the damping rates, and can generate long-lived quasibound configurations when the effective field mass is sufficiently large. This formalism provides a framework for studying electromagnetic relaxation in curved superconducting media, compact objects containing superconducting phases, and effective massive-vector fields around black holes.

classification.title_zh: 超导等离子体中 Schwarzschild 黑洞的电磁准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将 London 电动力学在四维弯曲时空中表述为一般协变扩展，并研究黑洞周围超导介质中电磁扰动的传播。普通 London 关系被提升为规范不变的、涉及电磁四维势与超导凝聚相相位的四维本构方程。与协变 Maxwell 方程结合后，所得系统在 London（幺正）规范下等价于 Proca 理论，其有效光子质量由 London 穿透深度的倒数设定。我们推导了在超导等离子体存在时，Schwarzschild 时空轴向与极性扇区中电磁扰动的相应类 Schrödinger 波动方程。轴向扇区由单个 Regge–Wheeler 型方程控制，其有效势包含 London 质量项；而极性扇区包含两个耦合的物理自由度。我们为 Schwarzschild 几何表述了准正规模边界条件。London 穿透深度移动振荡频率、改变衰减率，并在有效场质量足够大时能产生长寿命的准束缚构型。该形式体系为研究弯曲超导介质中的电磁弛豫、包含超导相的致密天体，以及黑洞周围的有效大质量矢量场提供了框架。
classification.one_liner: 在弯曲时空中建立协变 London 电动力学，导出超导等离子体中 Schwarzschild 黑洞电磁 QNM 的 Regge–Wheeler 型方程与有效 Proca 质量效应。

papers.title: Sharp Bounds on Ground State Energy of the SYK Model
papers.abstract: We study the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) Hamiltonian $H_{\operatorname{SYK}}$ on $n$ Majorana modes with $k$-body interactions, and prove that $\mathbb{E}\|H_{\operatorname{SYK}}\|_{\operatorname{op}} = (1 - o(1))\cdot\sqrt{2n}/k$ for super-constant $k\leq o(\sqrt{n})$, where the expectation is over the disorder variables in the Hamiltonian. This confirms predictions due to Garcia-Garcia, Jia and Verbaarschot and answers a question posed by Feng, Tian, and Wei. Our results extend to the sparse SYK Hamiltonian. As a corollary, we obtain that a dissipative quantum algorithm due to Basso, Chen, and Dalzell provably computes the ground state energy of the SYK Hamiltonian up to an $O(1)$-multiplicative factor for all $k < \sqrt{n}/4$. Our key technical idea is identifying an explicit, deterministic linear operator $\mathsf{x}$ such that a fixed quadratic form of $\mathsf{x}^{2\ell}$ exactly equals the expected trace moments of the SYK Hamiltonian for every $n$ and $k$. This linear operator can be naturally viewed as a twisted model of bosons on the space of hyperedges of a hypergraph. The problem thus reduces to identifying the spectral edge of $\mathsf{x}$, which we show is dominated by the spectrum of a natural ${n \choose k}$-dimensional matrix from the Johnson scheme and is straightforward to compute using known results. To show that our bound is sharp, we construct a witness state with a large quadratic form on $\mathsf{x}$ and transform it into a certificate of a lower bound on the largest quadratic form on $H_{\operatorname{SYK}}$. Beyond the SYK Hamiltonian, our techniques also apply to the $k-$local quantum spin glass (QSG), yielding $\mathbb{E}\|H_{k-\operatorname{QSG}}\|_{\operatorname{op}}\leq O(\sqrt{n/k})$ for all $1\leq k\leq\sqrt{n}/2$, thus improving the standard $O(\sqrt{n})$ bound by a factor of $\sqrt{k}$.

classification.title_zh: SYK 模型基态能量的尖锐界
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在 n 个 Majorana 模上带 k-体相互作用的 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 哈密顿量 H_SYK，并证明对于超常数 k≤o(√n)，有 E||H_SYK||_op = (1 - o(1))·√(2n)/k，其中期望对哈密顿量中的无序变量取。这证实了 Garcia-Garcia、Jia 和 Verbaarschot 的预测，并回答了 Feng、Tian 和 Wei 提出的问题。我们的结果可推广到稀疏 SYK 哈密顿量。作为推论，对于所有 k < √n/4，Basso、Chen 和 Dalzell 的耗散量子算法可证明以 O(1) 乘法因子计算 SYK 哈密顿量的基态能量。关键技术思想是找到一个显式的确定性线性算子 x，使得 x^{2ℓ} 的某个固定二次型对每个 n 和 k 都恰好等于 SYK 哈密顿量的期望迹矩。该线性算子可自然视为超图超边空间上玻色子的扭曲模型。于是问题归结为确定 x 的谱边缘；我们证明它由 Johnson 方案中一个自然的 {n choose k} 维矩阵的谱主导，并可用已知结果直接计算。为说明界是尖锐的，我们构造一个在 x 上具有大二次型的见证态，并将其转化为 H_SYK 上最大二次型下界的证书。除 SYK 哈密顿量外，我们的技术也适用于 k-局域量子自旋玻璃 (QSG)，得到对所有 1≤k≤√n/2，E||H_{k-QSG}||_op ≤ O(√(n/k))，从而将标准 O(√n) 界改进了因子 √k。
classification.one_liner: 该文证明 SYK 模型算符范数的尖锐渐近界，并推广到稀疏 SYK 与 k-局域量子自旋玻璃。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 SYK 模型算符范数严格界，虽属 JT/SYK/AdS2 方向，但与用户重点标签（全息超流、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、相变气泡、QNM、冷原子、探针膜、经典引力）无直接重叠。

papers.title: Cosmological stasis and the coupled dark sector of the Dark Dimension
papers.abstract: We study cosmological stasis in coupled dark matter and dark energy models in which a scalar field drives the dark energy and sets the dark matter mass, with the Dark Dimension as the motivating realization. Treating dark matter, dark energy, baryons, and radiation as an autonomous dynamical system, we show that exact stasis requires exponential slopes along the trajectory, and that running slopes give exact stasis or a drifting quasi-stasis depending on whether the running is integrable. The constant abundance solutions are the stationary solutions of coupled quintessence, which we read as stasis epochs with computable lifetimes and exits. Anchoring the cosmology to the measured abundances at matter-radiation equality and today, we show that the stasis region for this model cannot accelerate for any initial conditions, and that the total equation of state is never phantom although the effective dark energy of a $\Lambda$CDM fit can appear so. For the Dark Dimension, capture into stasis in the future is excluded for geometric sources of the potential once dark fifth-force bounds are imposed, and dark matter production from the Standard Model brane supports a further stasis which the standard scenario does not reach. The stasis solutions provide analytic exclusions of the parameter space which do not depend on initial conditions.

classification.title_zh: 宇宙学停滞与暗维度的耦合暗扇区
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究耦合暗物质与暗能量模型中的宇宙学停滞，其中标量场驱动暗能量并设定暗物质质量，并以暗维度作为动机性实现。将暗物质、暗能量、重子和辐射视为自治动力系统，我们表明精确停滞要求沿轨迹具有指数斜率；而跑动斜率在跑动可积时给出精确停滞，在不可积时给出漂移的准停滞。恒定丰度解是耦合精质的驻定解，我们将其解读为具有可计算寿命和退出的停滞时期。将宇宙学锚定到物质-辐射等密度时刻和当今测得的丰度，我们表明该模型的停滞区域对任何初始条件都不能加速，并且总状态方程从不是幽灵型，尽管ΛCDM拟合的有效暗能量可以显得如此。对于暗维度，一旦施加暗第五力限制，势的几何来源便排除未来进入停滞；而来自标准模型膜的暗物质产生支持另一种标准情形无法达到的停滞。这些停滞解给出了不依赖于初始条件的参数空间解析排除。
classification.one_liner: 研究暗维度启发的耦合暗扇区中的宇宙学停滞，并给出与初始条件无关的解析限制。
classification.relevance_reason: 不属于全息/AdS-CFT 或量子信息主题；主题为经典宇宙学与暗扇区动力学，因此与重点标签中的经典引力支线相关，但与全息研究支线无直接关系。

papers.title: Second-order scattering response of a Schwarzschild black hole
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves couple in a nonlinear fashion in the vicinity of a black hole. Black hole perturbation theory can be readily applied to compute the magnitude of this coupling, its dependence on the parity content, frequencies, and angular structure of the incoming gravitational waves. In this work we carry out this calculation, showing how the nonlinear coupling of gravitational waves generically peaks when the driven frequency matches the oscillation frequency of the fundamental quasinormal mode of the black hole. We also demonstrate how this excitation is largest at the maximal harmonics allowed, and study its dependence on the parity content of the incoming modes. At low frequencies, the quadratic response computed here encodes the nonlinear, dynamical tidal deformability of the black hole spacetime itself. We demonstrate numerically that the quadratic black hole coupling coefficient scales quadratically with the driving frequency, and recover this scaling from the 5-point Compton graviton scattering amplitude.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild黑洞的二阶散射响应
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波在黑洞附近以非线性方式耦合。黑洞微扰论可直接用于计算这种耦合的大小，及其对入射引力波宇称内容、频率和角结构的依赖。在本工作中，我们完成该计算，表明引力波的非线性耦合通常在驱动频率与黑洞基频准正模振荡频率匹配时达到峰值。我们还证明这种激发在允许的最大谐波处最大，并研究其对入射模宇称内容的依赖。在低频下，所计算的二次响应编码了黑洞时空本身的非线性、动态潮汐形变。我们数值证明二次黑洞耦合系数随驱动频率呈二次标度，并从5点Compton引力子散射振幅恢复该标度。
classification.one_liner: 计算Schwarzschild黑洞对引力波的二阶非线性散射响应，揭示QNM共振、宇称依赖与低频动态潮汐形变，并联系5点Compton引力子振幅。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究黑洞微扰论中的二阶非线性响应、QNM共振和经典引力非线性演化，与重点标签‘QNM与非线性演化’和‘经典引力/广义相对论’高度匹配。

papers.title: Null Completeness and Directional Rigidity in Bianchi I Spacetimes
papers.abstract: In Einstein gravity, every null geodesic of a non-static Bianchi I spacetime satisfying the null energy condition is incomplete in at least one direction within the Bianchi I region. We prove a stronger directional rigidity theorem: a single null geodesic complete in both affine directions forces staticity if the null curvature is nonnegative along it and, at each time, in one transverse null direction. The spatial metric need not be diagonal, and the expansion rates may have either sign. The proof uses caustic-free null congruences whose conserved spatial covectors define fixed screen hyperplanes. The two curvature conditions admit averaged replacements along the geodesic and, when cosmic time is complete, along comoving worldlines. In a non-static metric, at most four oriented directions are optically saturated; every other complete null geodesic has strictly negative averaged null curvature. Periodic and finite-pulse examples attain this bound with NEC-violating sources and nonpositive total energy density. For finite pulses, we derive bounds on metric excursions from three directional curvature budgets at fixed cosmic duration, and on the mode mixing of a free, massless, minimally coupled test scalar field from the averaged null-energy deficit at fixed affine duration.

classification.title_zh: Bianchi I 时空中的零测地线完备性与方向刚性
classification.abstract_zh: 在 Einstein 引力中，满足零能量条件的非静态 Bianchi I 时空的每条零测地线在 Bianchi I 区域内至少一个方向上不完备。我们证明更强的方向刚性定理：若一条零测地线沿自身以及每个时刻在一个横向零方向上的零曲率非负，则它在两个仿射方向都完备迫使时空静态。空间度规不必对角，膨胀率可正可负。证明使用无焦散的零测地线汇，其守恒空间余向量定义固定屏幕超平面。两个曲率条件允许沿测地线以及（当宇宙时完备时）沿共动世界线的平均替代。在非静态度规中，至多四个有向方向是光学饱和的；其他每条完备零测地线都有严格负的平均零曲率。周期与有限脉冲例子以违反 NEC 的源和非正的总能量密度达到该界。对有限脉冲，我们由固定宇宙时下的三个方向曲率预算导出度规偏移的界，并由固定仿射时下的平均零能量亏损导出一个自由、无质量、最小耦合试探标量场的模式混合的界。
classification.one_liner: 证明 Bianchi I 时空中零测地线完备性的方向刚性，并给出非静态宇宙中零曲率与模式混合的约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究 Bianchi I 时空中的零测地线完备性、刚性定理与宇宙学约束，不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Gravitational Enstrophy: Local Geometric Origin and Energy-Cascade Constraints
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional incompressible fluids conserve energy and enstrophy in the inviscid limit. Fj{\o}rtoft's argument uses this pair to constrain nonlinear energy transfer. We examine the corresponding question in General Relativity using the magnetic Weyl functional $\mathcal Z=\int B_{ab}B^{ab}\sqrt{\gamma}\,d^3x$. Its transverse radiativ e part carries an additional frequency-squared weight relative to gravitational-wave energy: $\delta\mathcal Z_k\simeq\omega_k^2W_k$ in the radiation zone, with $W=8\pi G E_{\rm GW}$. We derive its balance law from the Bianchi identities, obtaining the algebraic cancellations, bulk sources and boundary fluxes. Conservation of positive e nergy and curvature norm through nonlinear transfer gives a Fj{\o}rtoft constraint when their weights are ordered. Resonant weak-wave interactions generally change the c urvature norm; $2\leftrightarrow2$ dynamics instead conserves energy and wave action. We examine the competition between transfer and linear losses in Kerr and AdS backg rounds, where long-lived or confined modes provide time for nonlinear evolution. In the hydrodynamic regime of AdS$_4$, a fluid-weighted magnetic Weyl functional inherit s fluid enstrophy conservation in the inviscid limit. We compute its proportionality coefficient to boundary enstrophy in closed form at leading gradient order, giving a bulk diagnostic for holographic turbulence.

classification.title_zh: 引力拟涡能：局部几何起源与能量级联约束
classification.abstract_zh: 二维不可压缩流体在无粘极限下守恒能量和拟涡能。Fjørtoft 论证利用这一对量约束非线性能量转移。我们使用磁 Weyl 泛函 Z=∫ B_{ab}B^{ab}√γ d^3x 研究广义相对论中的对应问题。其横向辐射部分相对于引力波能量带有额外的频率平方权重：在辐射区 δZ_k≃ω_k^2 W_k，其中 W=8πG E_GW。我们从 Bianchi 恒等式推导其平衡律，得到代数相消、体源和边界通量。通过非线性转移守恒正能量和曲率范数，当它们的权重有序时给出 Fjørtoft 约束。共振弱波相互作用通常会改变曲率范数；2↔2 动力学则守恒能量和波作用量。我们考察 Kerr 和 AdS 背景中转移与线性损耗之间的竞争，其中长寿命或受限模式为非线性演化提供时间。在 AdS4 的流体力学区域，流体加权的磁 Weyl 泛函在无粘极限下继承流体拟涡能守恒。我们以领先梯度阶的闭合形式计算其与边界拟涡能的比例系数，为全息湍流提供体诊断。
classification.one_liner: 该文将二维流体的拟涡能与 Fjørtoft 约束推广到广义相对论，用磁 Weyl 泛函推导平衡律，并给出 AdS4 全息湍流的体诊断。
classification.relevance_reason: 主要属于经典引力/广义相对论，并涉及 Kerr/AdS 背景中的非线性能量级联与全息湍流；与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”相关，但不涉及全息超导、p波、multi-trace 等方向。

papers.title: Gravitational wave constraints on corrections to Bekenstein-Hawking Area Formula in classical F(R) gravity and quantum GR : implications for theory parameters
papers.abstract: This contribution considers constraints from analyses of gravitational wave data from binary black hole coalescence, on possible corrections to the Bekenstein-Hawking Area Formula for black hole entropy. Most recent analyses of gravitational wave data from the LVK Consortium appear to confirm the Hawking Area Theorem for black holes at a $5 \sigma$ accuracy, for the `loudest' signal (SNR of the order of $80$) of binary black hole merger inherent in the recent observation GW250114. Amalgamating this result with Bekenstein's ideas of black hole entropy and the generalized second law of thermodynamics, we constrain leading inverse area corrections for large horizon area spherical black hole solutions of classical $F(R)$ gravity, using the Wald entropy function formalism. The implementation of the observational constraints entails the notion of `absolute consistency' which we introduce and contrast with `relative consistency'. This absolute consistency criterion is shown to relate some of the parameters of $F(R)$ gravity. Next we consider leading quantum general relativistic corrections to the Area formula, arising both from the non-perturbative matter-free Loop Quantum Gravity and matter-dependent, perturbative Entanglement entropy approaches. Combining the leading logarithmic corrections in horizon area (for large areas) from both approaches, and imposing absolute consistency with the observational validation of the Area Theorem, is shown to lead to significant restrictions on the spin and number of species of Beyond Standard Model spectrum of elementary particles, some of which are often assumed to be Dark Matter candidates.

classification.title_zh: 经典 F(R) 引力与量子广义相对论中对 Bekenstein-Hawking 面积公式修正的引力波约束：对理论参数的含义
classification.abstract_zh: 本文利用双黑洞并合引力波数据，对黑洞熵的 Bekenstein-Hawking 面积公式可能修正施加约束。近期 LVK 对 GW250114 中最响信号（信噪比约 80）的分析似乎以约 5σ 精度确认了黑洞的 Hawking 面积定理。将这一结果与 Bekenstein 的黑洞熵思想及广义热力学第二定律结合，作者在 Wald 熵形式下约束经典 F(R) 引力大视界面积球对称黑洞解的首个反面积修正。文中引入“绝对一致性”概念，并与“相对一致性”对比；该绝对一致性判据可关联 F(R) 引力的某些参数。随后考虑量子广义相对论对面积公式的首个修正，分别来自非微扰、无物质的圈量子引力以及依赖物质的微扰纠缠熵方法。将两者在大面积下对数的领先修正结合，并要求其与面积定理的观测验证满足绝对一致性，会对超出标准模型粒子谱的自旋和种类数产生显著限制，其中一些常被假定为暗物质候选。
classification.one_liner: 用引力波对面积定理的检验约束 F(R) 引力与量子引力对黑洞熵面积律的修正，并进一步限制 BSM 粒子谱。

papers.title: New Improved Schwarzschild Black Hole and Its Thermodynamics and Topological Classification
papers.abstract: We construct a renormalization-group improved Schwarzschild-like black hole geometry using the exact new scheme running for the Newton coupling. The scale identification is implemented via a standard interpolating proper-distance function governed by an interpolation parameter $\gamma$ that smoothly connects the ultraviolet and infrared regimes. We present the resulting coordinate-dependent coupling and the improved metric function, analyzing its asymptotic expansions. The large-distance limit is shown to recover the classical Schwarzschild solution, while for $\gamma>0$ the short-distance behavior exhibits a regular de Sitter-like core, resulting in the regularization of the central singularity. We also analyze the thermodynamic properties of the solution, showing that quantum corrections significantly modify the small-radius behavior, leading to a remnant configuration and a nontrivial phase structure. Finally, we investigate the thermodynamic topology of the improved Schwarzschild black hole and show that the quantum-gravity corrections regularize the Hawking-temperature profile, giving rise to an additional thermodynamic defect with opposite winding number and changing the global thermodynamic-topological charge from the classical Schwarzschild value $W=-1$ to $W=0$.

classification.title_zh: 新改进的史瓦西黑洞及其热力学与拓扑分类
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用牛顿耦合的精确新方案跑动，构造了一个重整化群改进的类史瓦西黑洞几何。标度识别通过一个由插值参数 γ 控制的标准插值固有距离函数实现，该参数平滑连接紫外和红外区域。我们给出了由此得到的坐标依赖耦合和改进的度规函数，并分析了其渐近展开。大距离极限被证明可恢复经典史瓦西解，而对于 γ>0，短距离行为表现出规则的类 de Sitter 核心，从而导致中心奇点的正则化。我们还分析了该解的热力学性质，表明量子修正显著改变小半径行为，导致残遗构型和非平凡相结构。最后，我们研究了改进史瓦西黑洞的热力学拓扑，并表明量子引力修正正则化了霍金温度剖面，产生一个具有相反绕数的额外热力学缺陷，并将全局热力学-拓扑荷从经典史瓦西值 W=-1 改变为 W=0。
classification.one_liner: 利用牛顿耦合的精确重整化群跑动构造改进史瓦西黑洞，分析其正则化核心、热力学残遗与热力学拓扑荷从 W=-1 到 W=0 的改变。

papers.title: Nonlinear Relativistic Tidal Response of Neutron Stars
papers.abstract: We investigate the nonlinear tidal response of relativistic neutron stars by computing the fully relativistic, static, quadratic Love numbers. Using both the worldline effective field theory for extended gravitating bodies and second-order perturbations of relativistic stellar models, we derive the nonlinear tidal deformation induced by an external gravito-electric tidal field to quadratic order. Through a suitable matching procedure, we provide for the first time the leading nonlinear tidal corrections to the conservative dynamics and gravitational-wave signal of binary systems. Quadratic Love numbers are enhanced more than the linear ones in the small-compactness limit. Because of this, despite entering the gravitational-wave phase at 8th post-Newtonian (PN) order, the leading quadratic Love number can be as important as the next-to-next-to-leading order linear tidal correction, which enters at 7th PN order, and is larger than the subleading point-particle contribution entering at 4th PN order. In particular, quadratic Love numbers can be as large as ~10% of the linear Love numbers in the late inspiral phase. Our approach provides a framework to also compute the (subleading) nonlinear effects induced by magnetic tidal fields and higher multipole moments, and sets the foundations for incorporating nonlinear tidal effects in high-precision gravitational-wave modeling.

classification.title_zh: 中子星的非线性相对论潮汐响应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过计算完全相对论的静态二次Love数，研究中子星的非线性潮汐响应。利用扩展引力体的世界线有效场论和相对论恒星模型的二阶微扰，我们推导了由外部引力电潮汐场诱导的直至二次阶的非线性潮汐形变。通过适当的匹配程序，我们首次给出了双星系统保守动力学和引力波信号的首个非线性潮汐修正。在低致密性极限下，二次Love数比线性Love数增强更多。因此，尽管以8后牛顿（PN）阶进入引力波相位，主导的二次Love数可以与7PN阶的次次领头阶线性潮汐修正同等重要，并且大于4PN阶的次领头阶点粒子贡献。特别地，在旋近晚期，二次Love数可以达到线性Love数的~10%。我们的方法提供了一个框架，也可计算由磁潮汐场和高阶多极矩诱导的（次领头）非线性效应，并为将非线性潮汐效应纳入高精度引力波建模奠定了基础。
classification.one_liner: 计算中子星完全相对论静态二次Love数，首次给出双星系统引力波信号中的非线性潮汐修正。

papers.title: Algebraic structure in holographic tensor networks
papers.abstract: In a previous work 2511.21852, we explored the hypothesis that in general theories of quantum gravity, spacetime regions known as generalized entanglement wedges (introduced by Bousso and Penington) have an associated subalgebra of observables in a semiclassical limit. We defined an entropy associated with these subalgebras that obeys the same monotonicity and strong subadditivity properties as the generalized gravitational entropy of generalized entanglement wedges. Here, we test aspects of these ideas making use of tensor network toy models for holography. In this context, the analog of a generalized entanglement wedge is a region for which no region containing it has a smaller number of boundary legs. In the limit of large bond dimension (analogous to the semiclassical limit), we argue that each such region has a canonically associated subalgebra of the full algebra of observables on the boundary Hilbert space, as well as a family of unitarily related von Neumann factor subalgebras. We investigate in detail how various algebraic operations on these subalgebras (e.g. their intersections, joins, and commutants) are related to corresponding geometrical operations on the tensor network regions. We study to what extent the monotonicity and strong subadditivity properties of generalized entropy for generalized entanglement wedges follow from properties of our algebraic entropy. We also introduce an alternative entropic quantity $S(\omega || \omega \circ E_{\mathcal{A}'})$ associated with a subalgebra $\mathcal{A}$ that also obeys monotonicity and strong subadditivity properties with suitable conditions. Finally, we explain how to define a type $II_1$ von Neumann algebra based on an infinite family of random tensor networks with increasing bond dimension such that the regions corresponding to generalized entanglement wedges can be associated with exact subalgebras of this full algebra.

classification.title_zh: 全息张量网络中的代数结构
classification.abstract_zh: 在先前工作 2511.21852 中，我们探讨了一个假设：在一般量子引力理论中，称为广义纠缠楔（由 Bousso 和 Penington 引入）的时空区域在半经典极限下具有相关联的可观测量子代数。我们定义了与这些子代数相关的熵，它满足与广义纠缠楔的广义引力熵相同的单调性和强次可加性。本文利用全息张量网络玩具模型检验这些想法。在此背景下，广义纠缠楔的类比是这样一个区域：没有任何包含它的区域具有更少的边界腿。在大键维极限（类比半经典极限）下，我们论证每个这样的区域都典范地关联着边界希尔伯特空间上全观测代数的一个子代数，以及一族幺正相关的 von Neumann 因子子代数。我们详细研究这些子代数上的各种代数运算（如交、并和交换子）如何与张量网络区域的相应几何运算相关。我们研究广义纠缠楔的广义熵的单调性和强次可加性在多大程度上可由我们的代数熵性质推出。我们还引入一个与子代数 A 相关的替代熵量 S(ω || ω ∘ E_{A'})，它在适当条件下也满足单调性和强次可加性。最后，我们说明如何基于键维不断增大的无限随机张量网络族定义一个 type II_1 von Neumann 代数，使得对应于广义纠缠楔的区域可关联到该全代数的精确子代数。
classification.one_liner: 用全息张量网络检验广义纠缠楔对应的可观测代数结构及其熵性质。

papers.title: Journey to the Center of a Black Hole
papers.abstract: An infalling two-point function of a scalar field in a three-dimensional BTZ black hole, with one operator inserted in the exterior and the other inserted along a timelike geodesic, diverges when the infalling insertion point reaches the black hole singularity. In the boundary description, this divergence is tied to the exchange of double-twist operators rather than to the multi-stress-tensor sector that encodes curvature singularities in higher dimensions. We show that the inclusion of a tower of massive particles with Hagedorn growth gives rise to loop corrections that become important near the singularity, where they trigger a Hagedorn transition that renders the tree-level divergence untrustworthy. In the boundary theory, the corresponding tower of primary operators leads to a breakdown of the generalized free field description of the probe operator in the black hole state. In a large black hole, these corrections become important only near the singularity and remain exponentially suppressed at the horizon. The region where these corrections dominate is therefore parametrically separated from the horizon, as anticipated by the principle of black hole complementarity.

classification.title_zh: 到黑洞中心之旅
classification.abstract_zh: 在三维 BTZ 黑洞中，标量场的入落两点函数（一个算符插入外部，另一个沿类时测地线插入）在入落插入点到达黑洞奇点时发散。在边界描述中，这一发散与双扭算符交换相关，而不是与在高维中编码曲率奇点的多应力张量扇区相关。我们表明，引入具有 Hagedorn 增长的塔状大质量粒子会给出圈修正，这些修正在奇点附近变得重要，并触发 Hagedorn 相变，使树级发散不再可靠。在边界理论中，相应的主算符塔导致探针算符在黑洞态中的广义自由场描述失效。对于大黑洞，这些修正只在奇点附近重要，在视界处保持指数压低。因此这些修正占主导的区域与视界存在参数化分离，正如黑洞互补性原理所预期。
classification.one_liner: 通过 BTZ 黑洞中入落两点函数与边界双扭算符，讨论接近奇点时 Hagedorn 修正如何破坏树级发散与广义自由场描述。

papers.title: M2 brane $S^3/\mathbb Z_k$ instanton partition function in ${\rm AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction
papers.abstract: As was shown in arXiv:2609.14497, the 2-loop $ {\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction to the partition function of M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ vanishes. This is in agreement with the localization prediction for $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory interpreted in the grand-canonical ensemble according to the conjecture of arXiv:2505.21633. Here we study the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction for the M2 brane instanton wrapping $S^3/\mathbb Z_k\subset S^7/\mathbb Z_k$ dual to the leading non-perturbative large $N$ contribution to the ABJM free energy on 3-sphere. The 1-loop instanton M2 brane partition function was shown in arXiv:2307.14112 to match the localization prediction. The 2-loop computation is complicated by the presence of bosonic and fermionic zero modes, which requires to integrate over the collective coordinates. The collective-coordinate Jacobian provides a non-trivial ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ contribution in addition to the one of the quartic interaction vertex in the M2 brane action. We find that for $k>2$ the the quartic vertex contribution is cancelled by the Jacobian contribution for the choice of the separation of the fermionic zero modes from the quantum fields under which these form separate supermultiplets. Assuming the supersymmetric prescription for the paired zero modes we show that the cancellation persists after integration over the collective coordinates. Thus the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction vanishes, in agreement with the grand-canonical ensemble prediction. For $k=1$ the quartic vertex contribution reduces to equation-of-motion terms as in the case of ${\rm AdS}_3 \subset { \rm AdS}_7 \times S^4$ in arXiv:2511.22306 which is related to $S^3 \subset {\rm AdS}_4 \times S^7$ case by a formal analytic continuation.

classification.title_zh: AdS4×S7/Z_k 中 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数：2 圈修正
classification.abstract_zh: 如 arXiv:2609.14497 所示，包裹 AdS4×S7/Z_k 内 AdS2×S^1 的 M2 膜配分函数的 2 圈 T^{-1}_2 修正为零，这与 ABJM 理论中 1/2-BPS 圆形 Wilson 圈在巨正则系综下的局域化预言一致（依据 arXiv:2505.21633 的猜想）。本文研究包裹 S^3/Z_k ⊂ S^7/Z_k、对偶于 ABJM 理论三维球面上自由能的领头非微扰大 N 贡献的 M2 膜瞬子的 T^{-1}_2 修正。arXiv:2307.14112 已表明 1 圈瞬子 M2 膜配分函数与局域化预言相符。2 圈计算因存在玻色子和费米子零模而变得复杂，需要对集体坐标积分。集体坐标的雅可比在 M2 膜作用量四次相互作用顶点贡献之外，还给出非平凡的 T^{-1}_2 贡献。我们发现对于 k>2，在使费米子零模与量子场分离并各自构成独立超多重态的选取下，四次顶点贡献被雅可比贡献抵消。假设对配对零模采用超对称规定，我们证明在集体坐标积分后抵消仍然成立。因此 T^{-1}_2 修正为零，与巨正则系综预言一致。对于 k=1，四次顶点贡献约化为运动方程项，如 arXiv:2511.22306 中 AdS3 ⊂ AdS7×S^4 的情形，后者通过形式解析延拓与 S^3 ⊂ AdS4×S^7 情形相联系。
classification.one_liner: 计算 AdS4×S7/Z_k 中包裹 S^3/Z_k 的 M2 膜瞬子的 2 圈 T^{-1}_2 修正，发现在 k>2 时该修正因四次顶点与集体坐标雅可比贡献相消而为零，与 ABJM 巨正则系综预言一致。
