classification.title_zh: 热且重子致密 QGP 的全息输运与能量损失的不确定性量化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有 N_f=2+1 味的热密 QCD 的全息 Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton (EMD) 模型相图中的若干输运系数。我们的结果来自该模型的一个开源 C++ 实现，该实现作为 MUSES 框架内的一个模块公开可用。该代码包含一种新的数值方法，用于从全息模型的近边界渐近行为中提取热力学量，本文首次引入该方法，与早期实现相比，它极大地提高了数值稳定性和性能。得益于这一改进技术，我们能够针对从受零化学势格点 QCD 结果约束的贝叶斯后验分布中采样得到的该全息模型的许多实现进行计算。这使我们能够将格点 QCD 误差棒传播到宽温度与重子化学势窗口内输运系数的预言，涵盖 crossover 区域、预言临界点附近以及一阶相变线。物理观测量包括重子电导率和热导率、重子扩散、剪切与体粘度、喷注淬火参数、重夸克拖曳力以及 Langevin 扩散系数。在零重子密度下，我们将结果与 JETSCAPE 合作组从重离子数据中提取的估计值进行比较，发现二者符合良好。
classification.one_liner: 在 MUSES 框架内基于开源 EMD 全息模型，对热密 QCD 相图输运系数进行贝叶斯不确定性量化，并与 JETSCAPE 数据符合良好。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 QCD/核物理中的输运系数与能量损失研究，主要面向热密 QGP 相图与贝叶斯不确定性量化；未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核（尽管涉及相变线，但非气泡成核动力学）、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动或经典引力/广义相对论等支线。

papers.title: Physical properties of compact star-like systems harboring traversable wormholes: Effects of chaotic magnetic fields and anisotropic matter
papers.abstract: In this paper, we formulate exotic compact objects in form of compact star-like systems harboring traversable wormhole (CSSTW) supported by two scalar fields, allowing for both chaotic magnetic field and pressure anisotropy of the neutron fluid. The wormhole is traversable regardless of whether anisotropy of the neutron fluid and/or magnetic fields are included. In particular, the null energy condition (NEC) remains violated in the vicinity of the wormhole throat, ensuring the traversable nature of the geometry. The Kretschmann scalars for all considered configurations show that the entire spacetime is regular. The temporal metric functions for all considered configurations show that there are no horizons in any of the considered cases. For magnetized configurations, the resulting CSSTW can become extremely massive, with ADM masses exceeding $8\,M_\odot$, and can exhibit large surface redshifts exceeding $\mathcal{Z} \simeq 1.5$. The system can also reach the ultracompact regime, which allows us to calculate echo time that might be produced the systems. Our calculations of the echo time indicate that it can vary depending on the chaotic magnetic field configuration and fluid anisotropy. For non-magnetized configurations, the gravitational-wave echo time is of the order of $10^{-2}-10^{-1}$ ms. For the magnetized configurations, however, it ranges from the order of $10^{-1}$ $\mu$s $-10^{-1}$ ms, suggesting that magnetic fields broaden the range of echo time. Moreover, to investigate the direct impact of the magnetic field on the echo time, we derive an explicit expression for the echo time as a function of uniform magnetic field. The resulting relation shows that the echo time decreases as the magnetic field strength increases. The stability analysis of radial perturbations shows that all considered configurations with a surface magnetic field of $B_s=10^{15}$~G are stable.

classification.title_zh: 携带可穿越虫洞的致密星状系统的物理性质：混沌磁场与各向异性物质的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一类奇异致密天体——携带可穿越虫洞的致密星状系统（CSSTW），由两个标量场支持，并允许中子流体具有混沌磁场和压强各向异性。无论是否包含中子流体各向异性或磁场，虫洞都是可穿越的。特别地，在虫洞喉附近零能量条件（NEC）仍被违反，从而保证几何的可穿越性。所有构型的Kretschmann标量表明整个时空是规则的。时间度规函数表明所有考虑情形均无事件视界。对于磁化构型，所得CSSTW可以极其巨大，ADM质量超过8 M⊙，并表现出超过约1.5的大表面红移。系统还可达到超致密区域，从而允许计算可能产生的回声时间。回声时间计算表明，它可随混沌磁场构型和流体各向异性而变化。对于非磁化构型，引力波回声时间约为10^{-2}-10^{-1} ms。对于磁化构型，其范围约为10^{-1} μs至10^{-1} ms，表明磁场拓宽了回声时间范围。此外，为研究磁场对回声时间的直接影响，我们推导了回声时间作为均匀磁场函数的显式表达式。所得关系表明，回声时间随磁场强度增加而减小。径向微扰稳定性分析表明，所有表面磁场为B_s=10^15 G的考虑构型都是稳定的。
classification.one_liner: 在含混沌磁场和各向异性中子流体的致密星状可穿越虫洞中，考察NEC违反、规则性、质量/红移、回声时标与径向稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究虫洞与致密星状系统；不涉及AdS/CFT全息对偶，故对全息分类任务关联中等。

papers.title: Quantum Black Hole Chemistry from Double Holography
papers.abstract: Extended black hole thermodynamics highlights a sharp tension in the usual holographic dictionary: at fixed boundary conformal frame, changing the AdS radius changes both the central charge and the spatial volume of the CFT, so that the color and volume sectors of the first law becomes degenerate. We show that this degeneracy is naturally removed for quantum black holes in Karch--Randall double holography. The mechanism is intrinsically semiclassical. Replacing the holographic regulator surface by a physical brane induces gravity coupled to a cutoff CFT, so classical bulk black holes become lower-dimensional quantum black holes whose geometry includes the cutoff-matter stress tensor to all orders in backreaction. This backreacting matter sector supplies a color variable distinct from the defect volume. We demonstrate the mechanism explicitly for the quantum BTZ black hole. Thus quantum backreaction resolves the same color-volume degeneracy addressed by the recent Weyl-factor proposal, but without introducing a non-standard boundary Weyl factor. Instead, the missing thermodynamic direction is supplied by the physical cutoff-matter sector of the doubly holographic quantum black hole.

classification.title_zh: 双全息中的量子黑洞化学
classification.abstract_zh: 扩展黑洞热力学凸显了通常全息字典中的尖锐矛盾：在固定边界共形框架下，改变 AdS 半径会同时改变 CFT 的中心荷和空间体积，使第一定律中的色部门与体积部门简并。我们表明，在 Karch-Randall 双全息中，量子黑洞自然消除这一简并。该机制本质上是半经典的：用物理膜替代全息正则化面会诱导出与截断 CFT 耦合的引力，因此经典体黑洞变为低维量子黑洞，其几何在所有反作用阶都包含截断物质应力张量。这个反作用物质部门提供了一个不同于缺陷体积的色变量。我们对量子 BTZ 黑洞明确展示了该机制。因此，量子反作用解决了最近 Weyl 因子提议所处理的同一色-体积简并问题，但无需引入非标准的边界 Weyl 因子；缺失的热力学方向由双全息量子黑洞的物理截断物质部门提供。
classification.one_liner: Karch-Randall 双全息中，量子反作用通过截断物质部门消除扩展黑洞热力学的色-体积简并。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 与黑洞热力学交叉，但未直接涉及所列全息超导、探针膜、QNM、冷原子等具体重点支线。

papers.title: One loop aspects of Coleman de Luccia instantons at small backreaction
papers.abstract: We discuss the Euclidean path integral around Coleman de Luccia instantons. We compute their contribution at the one-loop level, at leading order in the small backreaction limit. At this level of approximation, their contribution factorizes into a pure gravity and a pure matter contribution. In deriving this result, we also clarify what happens to some zero mode contributions to the path integral, once the symmetry responsible for them is broken. With these results established, we propose a formula for the decay rate of the false vacuum in terms of gravitational path integrals, and we show that our definition matches the usual quantum field theory result as $G_{N}\rightarrow0$. Lastly, we propose a prescription to study how the phase of the gravity+matter path integral changes as we change the parameters of the theory.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 小反作用极限下 Coleman-de Luccia 瞬子的一圈效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们讨论围绕 Coleman-de Luccia 瞬子的欧几里得路径积分。我们在小反作用极限的领头阶计算它们的一圈贡献。在此近似水平下，它们的贡献分解为纯引力部分和纯物质部分。在推导这一结果时，我们也澄清了当导致零模贡献的对称性破缺后，路径积分中某些零模贡献会发生什么。建立这些结果后，我们提出一个用引力路径积分表示假真空衰变率的公式，并表明我们的定义在 G_N→0 时与通常量子场论结果一致。最后，我们提出一套方案来研究引力加物质路径积分的相位如何随理论参数变化。
classification.one_liner: 在小反作用极限下一圈计算 Coleman-de Luccia 瞬子对假真空衰变的贡献，并给出引力路径积分表述。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究 Coleman-de Luccia 瞬子、假真空衰变和气泡成核的一圈引力路径积分，并给出引力路径积分衰变率公式，与“相变与气泡成核”及“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签高度相关。

papers.title: Identifying sea and valence quarks in a magnetically driven catalysis
papers.abstract: In the present work, we study the magnetic response of a holographic plasma in a D3/D7 setup through the quasinormal spectrum of D7-brane embedding fluctuations. Extending the spectral analysis to nonzero spatial momentum, we show that the modes become increasingly quasiparticle-like as the kinetic momentum grows at fixed magnetic field, while increasing the field at fixed kinetic momentum suppresses this character. The possible existence of these competing effects in an actual quark-gluon plasma could account, on the one hand, for the partial success of quasiparticle-based effective descriptions due to the presence of a substantial population of modes stabilized by their high momentum, and, on the other, for the difficulty of isolating experimental signatures of such constituents because of the magnetic suppression that dominates at low momentum. Within the same setup, we introduce a holographic prescription to describe the contribution of valence and sea quarks to the phenomena of magnetic catalysis and its inverse, characterized herein through the induced expectation value of a scalar operator. We apply this prescription at vanishing spatial momentum to perform an initial calculation leading to results that are in agreement with those obtained from lattice QCD.

classification.title_zh: 在磁场驱动的催化中识别海夸克与价夸克
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在D3/D7全息模型中，通过D7膜嵌入涨落的准正态谱研究全息等离子体的磁响应。我们将谱分析推广到非零空间动量，表明在固定磁场下，随着动能动量增大，模式越来越像准粒子；而在固定动能动量下增大磁场会抑制这种特性。这些竞争效应若存在于实际夸克-胶子等离子体中，一方面可解释基于准粒子的有效描述为何部分成功——存在大量由高动量稳定的模式；另一方面也可解释为何难以分离出这类组分的实验信号——低动量时磁场抑制占主导。在同一模型中，我们引入一种全息方案，用以描述价夸克和海夸克对磁催化及其逆现象的贡献，并通过标量算符的诱导期望值来刻画。我们在零空间动量下应用该方案进行初步计算，结果与格点QCD一致。
classification.one_liner: 在D3/D7全息模型中利用D7膜嵌入涨落的准正态谱研究磁场对等离子体准粒子行为的影响，并提出区分价夸克与海夸克对磁催化贡献的全息处方。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接采用D3-D7探针膜与D7膜嵌入涨落的准正态谱，属于用户重点关注的D3-D7探针膜与QNM方向；同时涉及全息QCD磁催化。

papers.title: A Concise Course in String Theory
papers.abstract: These lecture notes offer a concise introduction to string theory, based on a one-semester graduate course taught at Fudan University, and develop the subject from the string sigma model action to the AdS/CFT correspondence. The exposition is deliberately compact, and is addressed to graduate students who seek a coherent overview of the foundations of the subject rather than an exhaustive treatment.

classification.title_zh: 弦论简明教程
classification.abstract_zh: 这些讲义提供了弦论的简明导论，基于复旦大学开设的一学期研究生课程，内容从弦 sigma 模型作用量发展到 AdS/CFT 对应。阐述刻意保持紧凑，面向希望获得该学科基础连贯概览而非详尽处理的研究生。
classification.one_liner: 一份从弦 sigma 模型讲到 AdS/CFT 对应的简明弦论研究生讲义。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于弦论与 AdS/CFT 的基础教学讲义，未针对用户列出的全息凝聚态、相变成核、QNM、探针膜等具体研究支线。

papers.title: Simpson-Visser regularization of the quantum Oppenheimer-Snyder-Datt black hole
papers.abstract: We study the spherical geometry from the Simpson-Visser prescription $r\to\sqrt{r^2+a^2}$ to the quantum Oppenheimer-Snyder-Datt (qOSD) black hole of loop quantum cosmology, whose lapse function $A=1-2M/R+\alpha M^2/R^4$ carries the correction $\alpha$. This family interpolates between the qOSD black hole ($a\to0$), the Simpson-Visser black bounce ($\alpha\to0$), and Schwarzschild. The geometry is regular for every $a>0$, the Ricci scalar at the throat is blind to $\alpha$ while the Kretschmann scalar is not, and the null energy condition is violated at the throat by $-1/(4\pi a^2)$. The $(\alpha,a)$ plane splits into a two-horizon regular black hole, a single-horizon black hole with a hidden bounce, no Cauchy horizon, and a traversable wormhole; the middle region removes the mass-inflation channel of regular black holes without fine tuning. Because circular orbits are governed by the areal radius, photon sphere, shadow, ISCO and azimuthal epicyclic frequency depend on $\alpha$ only, whereas the Lyapunov exponent and radial epicyclic frequency carry the factor $\sqrt{1-a^2/R^2}$: shadow constrains only $\alpha$, while ringdown damping and the twin-peak quasiperiodic-oscillation ratio are sensitive to $a$. We derive horizon thermodynamics with a first-law entropy that departs from the area law, show that the bounce changes the thermodynamic topological charge from $W=-1$ to $W=0$ at every $\alpha$, and compute scalar, electromagnetic and Dirac quasinormal spectra using third-order WKB, Chebyshev spectral collocation and time-domain integration, which agree with one another and with eikonal scaling. Greybody bounds, Hawking emission, cascade sparsity and ringdown quality factor complete the analysis, and in the wormhole region the double-peaked potential produces echoes.

classification.title_zh: 量子 Oppenheimer-Snyder-Datt 黑洞的 Simpson-Visser 正则化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了将 Simpson-Visser 规定 $r\to\sqrt{r^2+a^2}$ 应用于圈量子宇宙学中的量子 Oppenheimer-Snyder-Datt (qOSD) 黑洞后得到的球对称几何，其时移函数 $A=1-2M/R+\alpha M^2/R^4$ 带有修正 $\alpha$。该族在 qOSD 黑洞 ($a\to0$)、Simpson-Visser 黑洞反弹 ($\alpha\to0$) 和 Schwarzschild 之间插值。对任意 $a>0$，几何是正则的；喉处的 Ricci 标量对 $\alpha$ 不敏感，而 Kretschmann 标量则不然，且零能量条件在喉处被以 $-1/(4\pi a^2)$ 破坏。$(\alpha,a)$ 平面划分为双视界正则黑洞、带隐藏反弹的单视界黑洞、无 Cauchy 视界以及可穿越虫洞；中间区域无需精细调节就移除了正则黑洞的质量膨胀通道。由于圆轨道由面积半径决定，光子球、阴影、ISCO 和方位角本轮频率仅依赖 $\alpha$，而 Lyapunov 指数和径向本轮频率带有因子 $\sqrt{1-a^2/R^2}$：阴影只限制 $\alpha$，而铃宕阻尼和双峰准周期振荡比对 $a$ 敏感。我们推导了视界热力学，其第一定律熵偏离面积律；表明反弹在每个 $\alpha$ 下都将热力学拓扑荷从 $W=-1$ 变为 $W=0$；并使用三阶 WKB、Chebyshev 谱配置法和时域积分计算了标量、电磁和 Dirac 准正规模谱，它们相互一致并与 eikonal 标度一致。灰体界限、Hawking 辐射、级联稀疏度和铃宕品质因子完成了分析；在虫洞区域，双峰势产生回声。
classification.one_liner: 在圈量子宇宙学 qOSD 黑洞上应用 Simpson-Visser 正则化，研究正则黑洞/虫洞谱、阴影、热力学与准正规模。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典/半经典黑洞时空、正则黑洞与虫洞、阴影、热力学及 QNM，直接命中“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线，并部分命中“QNM与非线性演化”中的 QNM 部分；不属于 AdS/CFT 全息，也不涉及全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、multi-trace、探针膜等标签。

papers.title: Is DESI Seeing Dynamical Dark Energy, or a Cosmic Glitch in Gravity?
papers.abstract: Combined baryon acoustic oscillation and cosmic microwave background data have begun to mildly favor departures from $\Lambda\mathrm{CDM}$. This is usually framed as 2-parameter dynamical dark energy. However, a 1-parameter "cosmic glitch in gravity" model, whose cosmological gravitational coupling differs from Newton's constant as in Ho\v{r}ava gravity, fits at least as well. $\textit{Planck}$+ACT+SPT and DESI~DR2 give $G_\mathrm{cosmo}/G_\mathrm{N}=0.9920\pm0.0025$, a $3.3\,\sigma$ preference for weaker cosmological gravity, robust to adding CMB lensing and supernovae. Fitted to the CMB alone, the glitch predicts DESI distances; $w_0w_a$CDM does not.

classification.title_zh: DESI 看到的是动力学暗能量，还是引力中的宇宙学故障？
classification.abstract_zh: 结合重子声学振荡与宇宙微波背景数据已开始略微偏向偏离 ΛCDM。这通常被表述为双参数动力学暗能量。然而，一个单参数“引力中的宇宙学故障”模型——其宇宙学引力耦合不同于牛顿常数，如 Hořava 引力中那样——至少拟合得同样好。Planck+ACT+SPT 与 DESI DR2 给出 G_cosmo/G_N=0.9920±0.0025，即对更弱宇宙学引力有 3.3σ 偏好，且在加入 CMB 透镜和超新星后仍稳健。仅拟合 CMB 时，该故障模型能预言 DESI 距离；w0waCDM 不能。
classification.one_liner: 单参数“引力宇宙故障”模型可替代动力学暗能量，并能从 CMB 预言 DESI 距离。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于宇宙学/修改引力与观测数据分析，不涉及全息或量子引力；但与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论方向相关，因其讨论宇宙学引力耦合对 ΛCDM 与暗能量的替代解释。

papers.title: Quantum Gravity from Gluing Consistency: AdS/CFT to Spin-Foams
papers.abstract: We argue that BF theory with $SO(d+1,1)$ gauge group provides a SymTFT ''skeleton'' for building AdS$_{d+1}$/CFT$_d$ pairs via gluing consistency as the bootstrap principle, loosely analogous to how compact Chern-Simons theory is a TQFT skeleton for rational CFTs. This is a non-perturbative $bulk$ framework for quantum gravity. The bootstrap is formulated as presentation independence of physical amplitudes within a universal, defect-closed BF sewing calculus, which includes Wilson lines, codimension-two monodromy defects, and their junctions. The flat BF connection encodes the conformal geometry of the boundary, while Wilson-line path integrals construct candidate quantum-gravity microstates and charge sectors. When the bootstrapped spectrum has a stress tensor, Ward identities naturally connect it to the $B$-field, a relation we call generalized simplicity. In large-$N$, large-gap regimes admitting a gravitational EFT, this motivates the introduction of an effective notion of the $B$-field. In the Einstein limit, this becomes the ''simplicity'' relation used in spin-foam models. Conventional spin-foam models reach gravity by constraining BF theory. We suggest instead that BF theory is the Platonic sewing skeleton, from which theories are to be bootstrapped. Despite the topological nature of the skeleton, perturbative local bulk fields can emerge via Wilson-towers of multi-trace primaries, reproducing their one-loop determinants. We note that the BF Fourier kernel is a suggestive higher-dimensional analogue of the modular-$S$ structure. Because the bulk gluing principle in itself does not require a boundary description, the framework is conceptually broader than AdS/CFT. We sketch how de Sitter space may fit into this picture, with a natural role for observers. Our approach elevates gluing consistency to a universal bulk principle underlying theories of quantum gravity.

classification.title_zh: 从粘合一致性看量子引力：从 AdS/CFT 到自旋泡沫
classification.abstract_zh: 我们认为，具有 SO(d+1,1) 规范群的 BF 理论提供了一个 SymTFT“骨架”，可通过作为自举原理的粘合一致性来构造 AdS_{d+1}/CFT_d 对偶，粗略类比于紧致 Chern-Simons 理论作为 rational CFT 的 TQFT 骨架。这是一个非微扰的体量子引力框架。该自举被表述为：在一个普适的、对缺陷封闭的 BF 缝合演算中，物理振幅具有表示无关性；该演算包括 Wilson 线、余二维单值缺陷及其交汇。平坦 BF 联络编码边界的共形几何，而 Wilson 线路径积分构造候选的量子引力微观态和电荷 sector。当自举得到的谱含有应力张量时，Ward 恒等式自然地将其与 B 场联系起来，我们称此关系为广义 simplicity。在允许引力 EFT 的大 N、大 gap 区域，这促使引入有效 B 场概念。在 Einstein 极限下，这变为自旋泡沫模型中使用的“simplicity”关系。传统自旋泡沫模型通过约束 BF 理论到达引力。我们反而建议 BF 理论是柏拉图式的缝合骨架，理论应从中被自举出来。尽管骨架是拓扑的，微扰局域体场可以通过多迹 primary 的 Wilson 塔涌现，并复现其一圈行列式。我们指出 BF Fourier 核是 modular-S 结构的一个有启发性的高维类比。由于体粘合原理本身不需要边界描述，该框架在概念上比 AdS/CFT 更广。我们勾勒 de Sitter 空间如何能纳入这一图景，并赋予观察者自然角色。我们的方法将粘合一致性提升为量子引力理论背后的普适体原理。
classification.one_liner: 提出以 SO(d+1,1) BF 理论为 SymTFT 骨架，通过粘合一致性自举 AdS/CFT 与自旋泡沫等量子引力理论，并讨论其向 de Sitter 的推广。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 基础与量子引力框架，明确涉及 multi-trace primaries 与全息自举；但未涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、探针膜/Floquet、QNM、经典引力等主线。

papers.title: Non-Renormalizability Properties of Quarter-BPS Correlators in $\mathcal{N}$=4 SYM
papers.abstract: We study extremal and next-to-extremal four-point correlators involving general quarter-BPS operators in $\mathcal{N}$=4 Super Yang-Mills. Using a combination of $R$-symmetry considerations, operator product expansion content, and analytic superspace techniques, we show that such correlators get contributions only from operators belonging to short and semi-short multiplets. This result together with the non-renormalizability of the relevant three-point functions guarantees that all such four-point correlators are protected from quantum corrections.

classification.title_zh: N=4 SYM 中四分之一 BPS 关联函数的非重整化性质
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中涉及一般四分之一 BPS 算符的 extremal 和 next-to-extremal 四点关联函数。结合 R 对称性考虑、算符乘积展开内容以及解析超空间技术，我们证明此类关联函数只受到短多重态和半短多重态算符的贡献。这一结果连同相关三点函数的非重整化性，保证了所有此类四点关联函数免受量子修正。
classification.one_liner: 利用 R 对称性、OPE 与解析超空间证明一般四分之一 BPS 的 extremal/next-to-extremal 四点关联函数只由短与半短多重态贡献，从而不受量子修正。

papers.title: Carrollian Worldsheets on Carrollian Targets, When does ILST describe a null string theory?
papers.abstract: Null string theory (NST) is a two-dimensional (2d) sigma-model on a Carrollian worldsheet with 2d diffeomorphisms, Weyl and Carroll-Weyl (CW) scalings as gauge symmetries whereas the Isberg-Lindstr\"om-Sundborg-Theodoridis (ILST) theory on a generic target space only realizes the first two and not the CW gauge symmetry. We show in this work that NST on the Carrollian target spaces (CTS) is well-defined if the background admits a homothetic kernel generator and that, it is described by the ILST theory on the same CTS. To this end, we formulate a minimal null string theory on CTS, starting from first principles and then discuss beyond minimal theories as deformations away from minimality. We study some classes of such deformations involving the clock one-from for ruled Carrollian spaces and/or connection on the Carrollian space. We discuss implications of this for the recently introduced null string holography. As examples CTS, we briefly discuss null strings probing black hole horizons and the null string holography in this context.

classification.title_zh: Carrollian 靶空间上的 Carrollian 世界面：ILST 何时描述零弦理论？
classification.abstract_zh: 零弦理论（NST）是 Carrollian 世界面上的二维 sigma 模型，其规范对称性包括二维微分同胚、Weyl 缩放和 Carroll-Weyl（CW）缩放；而一般靶空间上的 ILST 理论只实现前两种，不包括 CW 规范对称性。本文表明，在 Carrollian 靶空间（CTS）上，如果背景具有 homothetic kernel generator，则 NST 是良定义的，并且可由同一 CTS 上的 ILST 理论描述。为此，我们从第一性原理构造 CTS 上的最小零弦理论，并讨论超出最小理论的形变。我们研究了几类此类形变，涉及 ruled Carrollian 空间的 clock one-form 和/或 Carrollian 空间上的联络。我们讨论这对近期引入的零弦全息的意义。作为 CTS 的例子，我们简要讨论探测黑洞视界的零弦以及此背景下的零弦全息。
classification.one_liner: 证明在具有 homothetic kernel generator 的 Carrollian 靶空间上，零弦理论可由 ILST 理论描述，并讨论其对零弦全息的启示。

papers.title: On the Stability of Warped Anti-de Sitter Spaces in Supergravity
papers.abstract: We discuss the perturbative stability of warped anti-de Sitter (WAdS$_3$) spaces in three-dimensional gauged supergravity. To this end, we first derive the analogue of the Breitenlohner-Freedman bound for a single scalar field on such a curved background. We then apply this analysis to the half-maximal $D=3$ gauged supergravity obtained from the compactification of the $D=6$, $\mathcal{N}=(1,1)$ supergravity on S$^3$. Families of three-dimensional configurations, uplifting to spaces of the form $\mathrm{WAdS}_3 \times \mathrm{WS}^3$, are found by turning on appropriate vector and scalar fields, supporting the AdS$_3$ and S$^3$ warpings, respectively. Finally, we show that the spectra of scalar fluctuations satisfy the stability criteria for each solution.

classification.title_zh: 论超引力中翘曲反德西特空间的稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们讨论三维规范超引力中翘曲反德西特（WAdS₃）空间的微扰稳定性。为此，我们首先导出此类弯曲背景上单个标量场的 Breitenlohner-Freedman 界类比。然后，我们将该分析应用于由 D=6、N=(1,1) 超引力在 S³ 上紧化得到的半极大 D=3 规范超引力。通过开启适当的矢量场和标量场，分别支撑 AdS₃ 和 S³ 的翘曲，找到了一系列三维构型，它们可提升为 WAdS₃ × WS³ 形式的空间。最后，我们表明标量涨落谱对每个解均满足稳定性判据。
classification.one_liner: 在三维规范超引力中研究 WAdS₃ 背景的微扰稳定性，并验证标量涨落满足 BF 型稳定性条件。

papers.title: Anisotropic Domain Walls and Cosmologies
papers.abstract: We investigate anisotropic domain wall and cosmological solutions in $D$-dimensional gravitational theories of arbitrary spacetime signature coupled to scalar fields with a scalar potential. We identify a class of scalar potentials for which the second-order equations of motion admit a first-order formulation. The associated bosonic flows allow non-trivial Ricci-flat worldvolumes, while their Killing-spinor realization further requires the worldvolume to admit a non-vanishing parallel spinor. Five-dimensional ${\cal N}=2$ gauged supergravity provides a concrete realization of this construction, with the worldvolume geometry determined by its signature and giving rise to pp-wave, hyper-K\"{a}hler, and hypersymplectic geometries. We further construct a general class of anisotropic solutions depending on a single variable, with the anisotropy encoded in a constant traceless matrix. A particular branch arises when a subset of scalar fields contribute through their kinetic terms but do not enter the scalar potential; these fields follow geodesics on the scalar manifold. As an explicit application, we recover the Kasner-dilaton-AdS solutions and show that, in the appropriate limit, they satisfy the first-order flow equations.

classification.title_zh: 各向异性畴壁与宇宙学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了任意时空号差的 D 维引力理论中，与带标量势的标量场耦合的各向异性畴壁和宇宙学解。我们找到一类标量势，使得二阶运动方程允许一阶表述。相应的玻色流允许非平凡的 Ricci 平坦世界体积，而其 Killing 旋量实现进一步要求世界体积允许一个非零平行旋量。五维 N=2 规范超引力提供了该构造的具体实现，其世界体积几何由号差决定，并产生 pp-wave、hyper-Kähler 和 hypersymplectic 几何。我们进一步构造了一类依赖于单个变量的广义各向异性解，其中各向异性编码在一个常无迹矩阵中。当一部分标量场仅通过动能项贡献而不进入标量势时，会出现一个特殊分支；这些场在标量流形上沿测地线运动。作为一个显式应用，我们重新得到 Kasner-dilaton-AdS 解，并证明在适当极限下它们满足一阶流方程。
classification.one_liner: 研究任意号差 D 维引力中带标量势的各向异性畴壁/宇宙学解，给出可一阶化的势类及 5D N=2 规范超引力实现，并恢复 Kasner-dilaton-AdS 解。

papers.title: Ultraviolet dissipation and defect OPE in bottom-up holographic interfaces
papers.abstract: We study the radial ultraviolet dissipation quantity $c_{UV}$ defined in arXiv:2601.16888v3 and defect OPE data in bottom-up holographic interfaces. We relate $c_{UV}$ along with the defect primary spectrum and BOPE coefficients in the large defect dimension limit to the optical length $\rho$ in the holographic bulk. In addition, we prove a new holographic bound for conformal interfaces relating entanglement entropy, energy transmission and UV dissipation: \[ c_{LR}\geq \frac{2c_{\mathrm{eff}}}{2+\pi(c/c_{\mathrm{UV}}-1)}. \] This compliments the upper bound of $c_{LR}$ by $c_\text{eff}$ proved in arXiv:2404.01515.

classification.title_zh: 自下而上全息界面中的紫外耗散与缺陷 OPE
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 arXiv:2601.16888v3 中定义的径向紫外耗散量 c_UV 以及自下而上全息界面中的缺陷 OPE 数据。我们将 c_UV 连同大缺陷维度极限下的缺陷原初谱和 BOPE 系数，与全息体中的光学长度 ρ 联系起来。此外，我们证明了一个新的共形界面全息界，将纠缠熵、能量透射和紫外耗散联系起来：c_LR ≥ 2 c_eff / (2 + π(c/c_UV - 1))。这补充了 arXiv:2404.01515 中由 c_eff 给出的 c_LR 上界。
classification.one_liner: 在全息界面中建立紫外耗散量、缺陷 OPE 数据与体光学长度的联系，并给出涉及纠缠熵、能量透射和紫外耗散的新下界。

papers.title: Note on the Pure State of Old Black Holes in Some Models of Asymptotically Flat Quantum Gravity
papers.abstract: We analyze two old models of black holes to see whether they realize the AdS/CFT paradigm of ``multiple representations of bulk data by boundary states that differ only in the expectation value of exponentially complex operators" . We find that the explanation of the firewall paradox in these models is much simpler and corresponds to the naive way entanglement is resolved when small constituents escape from a complex chaotic quantum system. The real issue is that the quantum field theory (QFT) picture of the states near the boundary of a causal diamond is wrong. The phrase in quotes above is correct in our models because most of the states associated with any causal diamond cannot be associated with ANY states in quantum field theory.

classification.title_zh: 关于某些渐近平直量子引力模型中老黑洞纯态的注记
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析了两个旧的黑洞模型，以检验它们是否实现了 AdS/CFT 范式：“体数据可由边界态多重表示，这些边界态仅在指数复杂算符的期望值上不同”。我们发现，这些模型中对火墙悖论的说明要简单得多，对应于当小成分从复杂混沌量子系统中逃逸时纠缠被解析的朴素方式。真正的问题是，因果菱形边界附近状态的量子场论（QFT）图像是错误的。上述引号中的说法在我们的模型中是成立的，因为与任意因果菱形相关的大多数状态不能与量子场论中的任何状态相关联。
classification.one_liner: 分析旧黑洞模型表明火墙悖论的解决更朴素，关键在于因果菱形边界附近大多数态没有量子场论对应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及 AdS/CFT 范式、黑洞信息与火墙悖论，属于全息/量子引力核心议题；但不直接对应所列的具体重点支线。

papers.title: Where in the Island is the Information?
papers.abstract: The Island Formula for Quantum Extremal Surfaces of large AdS black holes, which are made to evaporate by coupling the CFT of the AdS/CFT correspondence to an external system, demonstrates that the space time picture can reproduce the quantum mechanically required Page curve of the CFT/bath system if a region in the interior of the black hole has become entangled with the external radiation by the Page time. In an effective quantum field theory (EFT) description in ``nice slice" coordinates, this appears to imply paradoxical entanglement between degrees of freedom that have been causally disconnected since long before the Page time. We will give two arguments that all of the quantum information in the island is in fact concentrated in a tiny space-like portion of the island very close to the black hole horizon at the Page time. The first applies the covariant entropy bound\cite{fsb} (CEB) to the causal diamonds of geodesics originating on the space-like region that becomes the island, but on a time slice just before the Page time. All points on the island except those in a stretched horizon region very close to the horizon have entropy bounds that are tiny fractions of the black hole entropy. The second argument uses standard quantum statistical mechanics combined with the tensor network renormalization group regularization of CFT to argue that the wave function of a typical pure state in the microcanonical evaporating black hole always has most of its probability concentrated in a small range of wavelengths corresponding to a small range of radii in the dual tensor network/AdS slice.

classification.title_zh: 信息在岛屿中的何处？
classification.abstract_zh: 对于大 AdS 黑洞，通过将 AdS/CFT 对应中的 CFT 与外部系统耦合使其蒸发，量子极端曲面的岛屿公式表明：如果黑洞内部某一区域在 Page 时间之前已与外部辐射纠缠，则时空图像可以重现 CFT/浴系统在量子力学上所需的 Page 曲线。在“nice slice”坐标下的有效量子场论（EFT）描述中，这似乎意味着那些早在 Page 时间之前就已因果断开的自由度之间存在悖论式的纠缠。我们将给出两个论证，说明岛屿中的所有量子信息实际上都集中在 Page 时间时非常靠近黑洞视界的岛屿的一小段类空区域中。第一个论证将协变熵界（CEB）应用于从将成为岛屿的类空区域出发的测地线的因果钻石，但取 Page 时间稍前的时间切片。岛屿上除非常靠近视界的拉伸视界区域之外的所有点，其熵界都只是黑洞熵的极小分数。第二个论证使用标准量子统计力学，结合 CFT 的张量网络重整化群正则化，论证微正则蒸发黑洞中典型纯态的波函数总是将其大部分概率集中在对应于对偶张量网络/AdS 切片中一小段半径的小波长范围内。
classification.one_liner: 论文用协变熵界与张量网络重整化群论证，岛屿中的量子信息集中在 Page 时间黑洞视界附近的极小类空区域。

papers.title: Holographic thermal propagator at finite energy from modularity and triality
papers.abstract: We extend the modularity-based approach of arXiv:2509.02226 for the holographic thermal propagator to the physically relevant case of nonzero energy $\omega$. Via the AGT correspondence, the problem is mapped to $\mathcal{N}=2$ $SU(2)$ gauge theory with $N_f=4$ hypermultiplets. Turning on $\omega$ activates all four hypermultiplet masses, so that the full $SO(8)$ flavor symmetry constrains the low-temperature expansion, rather than the subgroup left unbroken at $\omega=0$. As a result, the building blocks of the expansion are no longer just Eisenstein series but also Jacobi theta functions. We use this fact, together with the Molien series of the resulting invariant ring and the modular anomaly equation, to fix the low-temperature expansion coefficients order by order, matching only a finite number of terms in the Zamolodchikov's $q$-recursion at each order. We obtain the low-temperature expansion of the propagator and find agreement with the result of a completely different method, the near-boundary expansion of the bulk wave equation.

classification.title_zh: 有限能量下的全息热传播子：模性与 triality
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将 arXiv:2509.02226 中基于模性的全息热传播子方法推广到非零能量 ω 的物理相关情形。通过 AGT 对应，该问题被映射到具有 N_f=4 超多重态的 N=2 SU(2) 规范理论。开启 ω 会激活全部四个超多重态质量，因此约束低温展开的是完整的 SO(8) 味道对称性，而不是 ω=0 时保持未破缺的子群。结果，展开的构建块不再只是 Eisenstein 级数，还包括 Jacobi theta 函数。我们利用这一点，结合所得不变环的 Molien 级数和模异常方程，逐阶确定低温展开系数，在每一阶只匹配 Zamolodchikov q-递推中的有限项。我们得到传播子的低温展开，并发现其与一种完全不同的方法——体波方程的近边界展开——的结果一致。
classification.one_liner: 论文将模性方法推广到非零能量，通过 AGT 对应、SO(8) triality、Molien 级数和模异常方程得到全息热传播子的低温展开，并与体波方程近边界展开一致。

papers.title: Entanglement Requires Fluctuations at Conformal Interfaces
papers.abstract: We conjecture that the universal logarithmic coefficient for capacity of entanglement $c_{\mathrm{cap}}$ is bounded below by the corresponding entropy coefficient $c_{\mathrm{eff}}$ at conformal interfaces. We prove the bound in free boson and fermion CFTs and in holographic models with interface branes, and establish it using defect perturbation theory. Numerical calculations at interacting interfaces between the tricritical Ising and Ising CFTs further support the bound. Despite this constraint, capacity provides independent interface data. We construct interfaces with identical entropy and energy transmission coefficients but different capacity coefficients, and show that capacity can even increase as entropy decreases.

classification.title_zh: 共形界面处纠缠需要涨落
classification.abstract_zh: 我们猜想，在共形界面处，纠缠容量（capacity of entanglement）的普适对数系数 c_cap 下方有界，其下界为相应的熵系数 c_eff。我们在自由玻色子和费米子 CFT 以及带界面膜的全息模型中证明该不等式，并用缺陷微扰论建立它。在三角临界 Ising 与 Ising CFT 之间的相互作用界面的数值计算进一步支持该界。尽管有这一约束，容量仍提供独立的界面数据。我们构造了具有相同熵和能量透射系数但不同容量系数的界面，并表明容量甚至可以随熵减小而增大。

papers.title: A Semiclassical Entanglement Wedge in Double-Scaled SYK
papers.abstract: We study the entanglement structure of partially entangled thermal states in double-scaled SYK , allowing flavor degrees of freedom carried by matter insertions to be in an arbitrary mixed state. In the semiclassical limit, followed by the heavy-probe limit, our replica calculation gives a Faulkner--Lewkowycz--Maldacena formula: the boundary entropy decomposes into an `area' term (independent of the flavor state) and the bulk matter entropy in a corresponding entanglement wedge. Varying the Euclidean locations of the operator insertions produces sharp transitions in the boundary entropy, which we interpret as individual matter excitations crossing the boundary of the wedge and hence as evidence for a sharply defined entanglement wedge. To derive this result, we analyze the semiclassical behavior of general Euclidean $2n$-point functions and give a probabilistic proof of their factorization into sums over products of two-point functions. We also give a complementary derivation from exact spectral representations, using the semiclassical behavior of the quantum $6j$-symbol.

classification.title_zh: 双标度 SYK 中的半经典纠缠楔
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究双标度 SYK 中部分纠缠热态的纠缠结构，其中物质插入所携带的 flavor 自由度可处于任意混合态。在半经典极限、随后重探针极限下，我们的 replica 计算给出一个 Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena 公式：边界熵分解为一个与 flavor 态无关的“面积”项，以及相应纠缠楔内的体物质熵。改变算符插入的欧几里得位置会在边界熵中产生尖锐转变，我们将其解释为单个物质激发穿过楔的边界，因而作为存在清晰定义纠缠楔的证据。为得到该结果，我们分析一般欧几里得 2n 点函数的半经典行为，并给出其分解为两点函数乘积之和的概率证明。我们还从精确谱表示出发，利用量子 6j 符号的半经典行为给出一个互补推导。
classification.one_liner: 在双标度 SYK 中，半经典 FLM 公式将部分纠缠热态的边界熵分解为面积项与纠缠楔内物质熵，插入位置变化对应物质激发穿越楔边界的尖锐转变。

papers.title: Temperature and Moduli Independence of the Supersymmetric Index from Gravity
papers.abstract: The supersymmetric index, which gives a signed count of the microstates of black holes, can be computed directly from a gravitational path integral with appropriate boundary conditions. From general arguments based on the supersymmetry algebra, the index is expected to be independent of the temperature and, away from walls of marginal stability, of the asymptotic values of the scalar moduli. On the gravity side, this has been verified by explicit computations in many examples, but a general proof is lacking even at the classical level. We fill this gap by showing that in any four-dimensional supergravity theory with $\mathcal{N} \geq 2$ supersymmetry in asymptotically flat space-time, the classical contribution to the index from each supersymmetric saddle is independent of both. The argument uses only the behavior of the solution and of the Killing spinor equations near infinity. The result therefore holds in the presence of arbitrary higher-derivative corrections and for multi-centered black hole configurations. In particular, moduli independence follows without appeal to the attractor mechanism, which relies on the near-horizon geometry.

classification.title_zh: 从引力得到的超对称指标的温度与模独立性
classification.abstract_zh: 超对称指标给出黑洞微观态的有符号计数，可以通过具有适当边界条件的引力路径积分直接计算。根据基于超对称代数的一般论证，该指标被期望与温度无关，并且在远离边际稳定墙时也与标量模的渐近值无关。在引力侧，这已在许多例子中通过显式计算得到验证，但即使经典层面也缺乏一般性证明。我们填补这一空白：证明在任何四维、渐近平坦时空中具有 N≥2 超对称的超引力理论中，每个超对称鞍点对指标的经典贡献都独立于温度和模。论证只用到解和 Killing 旋量方程在无穷远处的行为。因此，该结果在存在任意高阶导数修正以及多中心黑洞位形时仍然成立。特别地，模独立性无需借助依赖于近地平几何的吸引子机制。
classification.one_liner: 证明在四维 N≥2 渐近平坦超引力中，每个超对称鞍点对超对称指标的经典贡献独立于温度与标量模。

papers.title: Blackened BPS: the end of the thermal BMN branch
papers.abstract: We study the thermodynamics of the BMN matrix model at large $N$ and strong coupling, using its dual black holes in eleven-dimensional supergravity. Within the consistent truncation to two-dimensional $SO(9)$ gauged supergravity, the static $SO(3)\times SO(6)$-invariant black holes solve ordinary differential equations, which we solve to high precision. We formulate holographic renormalisation for this truncation and fix the finite counterterms using a supersymmetric solution. This gives the energy, the entropy and the response to the BMN mass independently, and we verify the first law and the Smarr relation along the branch. The thermal branch ends at a critical value of $\mu/T$, which power-law fits place at $4\pi$ with an estimated uncertainty below $10^{-10}$. The first-order transition inferred in earlier work, where the free energy was reconstructed from the entropy, does not survive, and an independent eleven-dimensional calculation agrees with ours over the range it covers. Instead, the free energy, the entropy and the mass response approach their values in the confined phase continuously at the end of the branch, where the solutions become singular. If this branch remains the dominant one up to its end point, the transition therefore coincides with the singularity. Near the end of the branch, the scalar fields follow a solution of the supersymmetric first-order equations, while the metric carries a nontrivial blackening factor. The horizon develops a neck whose profile is universal, with radii growing as the $2/5$ power of the distance from the pinch. Within the range we resolve, the geometry is not that of the Ricci-flat double cone which governs mergers of vacuum black holes.

classification.title_zh: 黑化的 BPS：热 BMN 分支的终点
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用十一维超引力中的对偶黑洞，研究大 N 强耦合下 BMN 矩阵模型的热力学。在约化到二维 SO(9) 规范超引力的相容截断中，静态 SO(3)×SO(6) 不变黑洞满足常微分方程，我们高精度求解了这些方程。我们为该截断建立全息重整化，并用一个超对称解固定有限反项。这分别给出能量、熵以及对 BMN 质量的响应，并沿分支验证了第一定律和 Smarr 关系。热分支终止于一个临界 μ/T 值，幂律拟合将其定为 4π，估计不确定度低于 10^{-10}。此前工作中由熵重构自由能所推断的一阶相变不再成立，而一个独立的十一维计算在其覆盖范围内与我们的结果一致。相反，自由能、熵和质量响应在分支终点连续趋近于禁闭相的相应值，此时解变得奇异。如果该分支直到终点仍占主导，则相变与奇点重合。在分支终点附近，标量场遵循超对称一阶方程的解，而度规带有非平凡的变黑因子。视界发展出一个颈部，其剖面是普适的，半径随到收缩点的距离以 2/5 次幂增长。在我们分辨的范围内，几何不是支配真空黑洞并合的 Ricci 平坦双锥。

papers.title: Twins in the Shadow: Phase Transitions in Proto-Neutron Stars
papers.abstract: We study the impact of a first-order phase transition from hadronic to deconfined quark matter on the evolution of proto-neutron stars. To maximize the applicability of our results, we construct an equation of state that is highly parameterizable, where we use a relativistic mean field approach to model hadronic matter and a constant speed of sound approach to model quark matter. We approximate the cooling behavior of proto-neutron stars as a sequence of decreasing entropy at constant baryonic mass. Some parameterizations lead to so-called "twin-stars", where two neutron stars have the same (gravitational) mass but different radii. Detecting them is regarded as a smoking gun signal for phase transition. We find, however, that proto-neutron star evolution suggests that gravitational twin stars are only possible if the hybrid star does not have, in addition, a baryonic twin. This rules out most twin star pairs, especially if the phase transition occurs at large densities. In a mass-radius diagram the unpopulated hybrid branch appears to be "in the shadow" of the hadronic branch.

classification.title_zh: 阴影中的孪生星：原中子星中的相变
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究从强子物质到退禁闭夸克物质的一阶相变对原中子星演化的影响。为最大化结果的适用性，我们构建了高度可参数化的状态方程，其中用相对论平均场方法描述强子物质，用常数声速方法描述夸克物质。我们将原中子星的冷却行为近似为在固定重子质量下熵递减的序列。某些参数化会导致所谓“孪生星”，即两颗中子星具有相同（引力）质量但半径不同；探测到它们被视为相变的决定性信号。然而我们发现，原中子星演化表明，引力孪生星只有在杂化星不额外具有重子孪生星时才可能；这排除了大多数孪生星对，尤其是当相变发生在高密度时。在质量-半径图中，未被占据的杂化支看起来处于强子支的“阴影”中。
classification.one_liner: 原中子星演化对一阶强子-夸克相变产生的引力孪生星施加限制，多数孪生星对因重子孪生条件而被排除。
classification.relevance_reason: 与全息对偶无关；但涉及经典引力/中子星质量-半径关系及一阶相变，和“经典引力/广义相对论”“相变与气泡成核”标签部分相关。

papers.title: Twin Universes and Bimetric Gravity: From Sakharov's Cosmological Symmetry to Modern Speculations on Negative Mass
papers.abstract: We review the conceptual and theoretical status of twin-universe models, from Sakharov's early ideas on baryogenesis, CPT symmetry, and reversed arrows of time to recent quantum-cosmological scenarios involving pair-created entangled universes. Particular attention is given to the distinction between Sakharov-type cosmological symmetry, modern bimetric theories of gravity, and speculative models involving negative mass sectors. We summarize the main consistency conditions faced by bimetric gravity, including the Boulware-Deser ghost, Higuchi-type bounds, covariant conservation laws, and no-go results for positive- and negative-mass sectors. We then examine the Janus cosmological model and related black-hole replacement proposals, emphasizing the difference between heuristic twin-universe narratives and fully specified relativistic field theories. We argue that while twin-universe ideas remain a fertile framework for questions about the arrow of time, matter-antimatter asymmetry, and the quantum origin of the universe, models combining bimetric gravity, negative mass, dark-sector phenomenology, and alternatives to Kerr black holes face a substantial burden of mathematical and observational proof.

classification.title_zh: 孪生宇宙与双度规引力：从萨哈罗夫宇宙学对称性到关于负质量的现代思辨
classification.abstract_zh: 本文综述孪生宇宙模型的概念与理论现状：从萨哈罗夫关于重子生成、CPT对称性和时间箭头反转的早期思想，到近期涉及成对产生纠缠宇宙的量子宇宙学情景。特别关注萨哈罗夫型宇宙学对称性、现代双度规引力理论与涉及负质量部门的思辨模型之间的区别。我们总结双度规引力面临的主要自洽性条件，包括Boulware-Deser鬼、Higuchi型界限、协变守恒律，以及正质量与负质量部门的不可能性结果。随后考察Janus宇宙学模型及相关的黑洞替代方案，强调启发式孪生宇宙叙事与完整指定的相对论场论之间的差异。我们认为，尽管孪生宇宙思想对于时间箭头、物质-反物质不对称和宇宙量子起源等问题仍是有成果的框架，但将双度规引力、负质量、暗部门现象学与Kerr黑洞替代方案结合起来的模型仍面临沉重的数学与观测证明负担。
classification.one_liner: 综述从萨哈罗夫宇宙学对称性到现代双度规引力与负质量孪生宇宙模型，并讨论其自洽性条件与黑洞替代方案。

papers.title: Primitive recovery methods for binary neutron star mergers with tabulated equations of state in SPHINCS_BSSN
papers.abstract: The dynamics and observable signatures of neutron star mergers are governed by physics under the most extreme conditions. They are particularly impacted by the high-density equation of state, which for the most sophisticated models is usually available in the form of tables. Numerical relativity codes usually evolve particularly well-behaved numerical ("conservative") variables, but at the price that the physically interesting ("primitive") variables need to be found at every computational element and at every integration sub-step by means of expensive (and not always successful) root-finding algorithms. We have recently developed the Lagrangian numerical relativity code SPHINCS_BSSN which evolves the spacetime on an adaptive mesh with well tested methods, but the fluid is evolved by means of freely moving particles. Since our evolution equations differ from those of conventional numerical relativity, we need to develop new conservative-to-primitive algorithms if we want to use tabulated equations of state. We present here three such algorithms: a 3D and a 2D Newton-Raphson method and a 1D root-finding algorithm based on Ridders' method. We find the 3D method to be very fast and robust with an average failure fraction in a full-blown neutron star merger simulation (with the DD2 equation of state) well below 1%. While we do not find obvious advantages for the 2D method, the 1D Ridders' method is slow, but essentially fail-safe. Therefore, we choose the 3D Newton-Raphson as default and fall back to the 1D Ridders' method as a safe "parachute".

classification.title_zh: SPHINCS_BSSN 中带表格状态方程的双中子星并合原始变量恢复方法
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星并合的动力学与可观测信号由极端条件下的物理决定，尤其受高密度状态方程影响，最精细模型通常以表格形式给出。数值相对论代码通常演化性质良好的数值（守恒）变量，但代价是必须在每个计算单元和每个积分子步通过昂贵且并非总是成功的求根算法找到物理感兴趣的（原始）变量。我们最近开发了拉格朗日数值相对论代码 SPHINCS_BSSN，它在自适应网格上用经过充分测试的方法演化时空，但流体用自由运动粒子演化。由于我们的演化方程不同于传统数值相对论，若想使用表格状态方程，需要发展新的守恒到原始变量算法。本文提出三种算法：三维和二维 Newton-Raphson 方法，以及基于 Ridders 方法的一维求根算法。我们发现三维方法快速稳健，在完整中子星并合模拟（DD2 状态方程）中平均失败比例远低于1%。二维方法未发现明显优势；一维 Ridders 方法较慢但基本不会失败。因此我们选择三维 Newton-Raphson 作为默认，并以一维 Ridders 方法作为安全“降落伞”。
classification.one_liner: SPHINCS_BSSN 针对表格状态方程开发三种守恒到原始变量恢复算法，推荐3D Newton-Raphson并备选1D Ridders。

papers.title: Deep Learning Search for Gravitational Waves from Compact Binary Coalescence
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave searches rely on a combination of methods, including matched filtering, coherent analyses, and more recent machine-learning-based pipelines. For compact binary coalescences --- where signals originate from the relativistic dynamics of compact objects --- matched filtering remains a central element, but its computational cost will increase substantially with the data volumes and parameter-space coverage required by next-generation interferometers such as the Einstein Telescope. Developing complementary strategies that reduce computational load while preserving detection performance is therefore essential. We investigate a hybrid approach that combines matched-filtering concepts with Convolutional Neural Networks, enabling efficient signal searches without relying on the usual $\chi^2$ rejection test. Using simulated data sets that include injected signals in Gaussian noise, transient noise, and physical effects not represented in the template bank --- such as eccentricity, precession and higher-order modes --- we show that the method achieves a detection efficiency comparable to or better than a standard matched-filtering search while offering a more resource-efficient pipeline in all the cases where the physics included in the signals were not represented in the template bank or when glitches were affecting the data. Conversely, the analysis also reveals some loss of detection capability for standard BNS/BBH searches in pure Gaussian noise. These results indicate that deep-learning-assisted searches can support sustainable gravitational-wave data analysis in future detector eras.

classification.title_zh: 用于致密双星并合引力波的深度学习搜索
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波搜索依赖于多种方法的组合，包括匹配滤波、相干分析以及较新的基于机器学习的流程。对于致密双星并合——其信号来源于致密天体的相对论动力学——匹配滤波仍是核心要素，但随着下一代干涉仪（如爱因斯坦望远镜）所需的数据量和参数空间覆盖度增加，其计算成本将大幅上升。因此，发展能够在保持探测性能的同时降低计算负载的互补策略至关重要。我们研究了一种将匹配滤波概念与卷积神经网络相结合的混合方法，从而无需依赖通常的 $\chi^2$ 拒绝检验即可实现高效信号搜索。使用包含高斯噪声中注入信号、瞬态噪声以及模板库未涵盖的物理效应（如偏心率、进动和高阶模式）的模拟数据集，我们表明该方法达到了与标准匹配滤波搜索相当或更好的探测效率，同时在信号中所含物理未被模板库代表或数据受毛刺影响的所有情形下，提供了更节省资源的流程。相反，该分析也揭示了在纯高斯噪声中标准 BNS/BBH 搜索时探测能力的一些损失。这些结果表明，深度学习辅助搜索可以支持未来探测器时代的可持续引力波数据分析。
classification.one_liner: 将匹配滤波思想与卷积神经网络结合，用于致密双星并合引力波搜索，并在非模板物理与毛刺场景下展现资源效率优势。

papers.title: A unified framework for photon and massive particle hypersurfaces in stationary spacetimes
papers.abstract: Massive particle surfaces (MPS), introduced by Kobialko, Bogush and Gal'tsov, are timelike hypersurfaces confining the trajectories of charged massive particles with fixed Killing energy and charge-to-mass ratio, in analogy with the photon surfaces of Claudel, Virbhadra and Ellis. We study both classes in standard stationary spacetimes within a unified Finslerian framework. For Killing-invariant hypersurfaces $\mathbb{R}\times S_0$, with $S_0$ a hypersurface of a spacelike slice $S$, we prove that photon hypersurfaces and MPS are exactly those for which $S_0$ is totally geodesic with respect to the Fermat metric and to a Jacobi--Randers metric on $S$, respectively. For MPS we also give a gauge-invariant version, in terms of a Riemannian Jacobi metric and a tangency condition on the reduced magnetic field. For arbitrary timelike hypersurfaces, we give a coordinate-free formulation of the partial umbilicity characterization of MPS and, in dimension at least four and under a natural energy condition, we characterize when an MPS is quasi-umbilical in the sense of B.-Y. Chen. In the Som--Raychaudhuri spacetime of a rigidly rotating charged dust we exhibit MPS which are neither photon hypersurfaces nor quasi-umbilical. Finally, under completeness assumptions on the Jacobi--Randers metric, we prove existence and multiplicity results for proper-time parametrized solutions of the Lorentz force equation connecting a point to a flow line of the Killing field and, under compactness assumptions, existence of solutions with periodic spatial projection, possibly confined to an MPS.

classification.title_zh: 稳态时空中光子与有质量粒子超曲面的统一框架
classification.abstract_zh: Kobialko、Bogush 和 Gal'tsov 引入的有质量粒子面（MPS）是限制具有固定 Killing 能量和荷质比的带电有质量粒子轨迹的类时超曲面，类似于 Claudel、Virbhadra 和 Ellis 的光子面。我们在统一的 Finsler 框架下研究标准稳态时空中的这两类面。对于 Killing 不变超曲面 R×S0，其中 S0 是空间切片 S 的超曲面，我们证明：光子超曲面和 MPS 恰好分别是 S0 关于 Fermat 度规和 S 上的 Jacobi–Randers 度规为全测地曲面的那些情形。对 MPS 我们还给出规范不变版本，用 Riemann 型 Jacobi 度规和约化磁场的相切条件表述。对任意类时超曲面，我们给出 MPS 部分脐性刻画的坐标无关表述；在维数至少四且满足自然能量条件下，我们刻画一个 MPS 何时按 B.-Y. Chen 意义为拟脐性的。在刚性旋转带电尘埃的 Som–Raychaudhuri 时空中，我们展示既不是光子超曲面也不是拟脐性的 MPS。最后，在 Jacobi–Randers 度规的完备性假设下，我们证明连接一点到 Killing 场流线的 Lorentz 力方程固有时参数化解的存在性和多重性结果；在紧致性假设下，证明具有周期空间投影的解的存在性，这些解可能被限制在一个 MPS 上。
classification.one_liner: 在统一 Finsler 框架下，将稳态时空中的光子面与有质量粒子面刻画为空间切片上的全测地超曲面，并研究其脐性及 Lorentz 力方程解的存在性。

papers.title: Parametrized model for gravitational waves from eccentric, precessing binary black holes: theory-agnostic tests of General Relativity with pTEOBResumS
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves from binary black hole mergers allow us to test General Relativity in the strong-field, high-curvature regime. However, existing gravitational waves-based tests for this have so far assumed non-eccentric signal sources, limiting their range of applicability. In this work, we present pTEOBResumS, a new parametrized inspiral-merger-ringdown model for null tests of General Relativity incorporating both orbital eccentricity and spin precession, building on the effective-one-body model TEOBResumS-Dal\'i. We introduce parametrized deviations from General Relativity both in the inspiral and the merger-ringdown regimes. We validate the model through parameter estimation of synthetic signals generated with the model itself or from numerical simulations, including of systems featuring physics beyond General Relativity. We thus establish the model's consistency, demonstrate its capability to identify effects beyond General Relativity, and gauge the impact of eccentricity on the recovery of deviation parameters. We then analyze a set of binary black hole events from the first three LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing runs, under either the eccentric, spin-aligned or precessing, quasi-circular hypotheses, searching for deviations in the remnant black hole's fundamental quasi-normal mode. We find no statistically significant evidence for such deviations in any of the events. We combine single event results either by multiplying likelihoods, or via a hierarchical procedure;consistent with previous works, we infer a mild preference for longer quasi-normal mode damping times than expected, though the limited event sample and potential systematics reduce the significance of this finding. We find no support for orbital eccentricity among the events, save for GW200129. An eccentric description is strongly favored for this event, although this result could be influenced by data quality issues.

classification.title_zh: 偏心、进动双黑洞引力波的参数化模型：使用 pTEOBResumS 进行理论无关的广义相对论检验
classification.abstract_zh: 双黑洞并合产生的引力波可在强场、高曲率区域检验广义相对论。然而，现有基于引力波的此类检验迄今假设信号源无偏心率，限制了其适用范围。本文提出 pTEOBResumS，这是一个新的参数化旋进-并合-铃宕模型，用于广义相对论零假设检验，同时纳入轨道偏心率和自旋进动，并建立在有效单体模型 TEOBResumS-Dalí 基础上。我们在旋进和并合-铃宕阶段都引入对广义相对论的参数化偏离。我们通过用模型自身或数值模拟生成的合成信号进行参数估计来验证模型，包括包含超出广义相对论物理的系统。由此确立模型的自洽性，展示其识别超出广义相对论效应的能力，并评估偏心率对偏离参数恢复的影响。随后，我们分析来自前三轮 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 观测运行的一组双黑洞事件，在偏心、自旋对齐或进动、准圆假设下，寻找残余黑洞基频准简正模的偏离。我们在任何事件中都没有发现此类偏离的统计显著证据。我们用似然相乘或分层程序合并单事件结果；与先前工作一致，我们推断出对更长准简正模阻尼时间的轻微偏好，但有限的事件样本和潜在系统误差降低了该发现的显著性。除 GW200129 外，我们在事件中未发现对轨道偏心率的支持。对于该事件，偏心描述受到强烈偏好，尽管该结果可能受数据质量问题影响。
classification.one_liner: 提出包含偏心与自旋进动的参数化 IMR 模型 pTEOBResumS，用于双黑洞引力波中理论无关的广义相对论检验，并在 LVK 事件中搜索 QNM 偏离与偏心率证据。

papers.title: Learning Approximate Isometric Embeddings for Efficient Template Placement
papers.abstract: The sphere covering problem has broad applications in science however, exact solutions are computationally infeasible on curved, high-dimensional manifolds because distances must be evaluated using a position-dependent metric. We present $\texttt{isobank}$, a normalizing flow that learns an approximately isometric coordinate transformation, such that Euclidean distances in the latent space approximate metric-induced proper distances in the physical parameter space. This enables template placement using Euclidean distance checks in the latent space, avoiding repeated metric evaluations during placement. We evaluate $\texttt{isobank}$ in the context of gravitational wave template bank construction, where the sphere covering problem corresponds to the template placement problem. On a five-dimensional eccentric binary parameter space, $\texttt{isobank}$ reaches 97\% coverage at a maximum mismatch of $\mu=0.03$ with 23\% fewer templates than the state-of-the-art stochastic placement code $\texttt{mbank}$, which reaches 94\% coverage. Coverage is measured on independent injections drawn uniformly over the masses, spins and eccentricity, using the exact waveform match rather than the metric approximation. Training the flow takes about 2.5h and placing the bank under 1h on 32 CPU cores. $\texttt{isobank}$ is publicly available on Github https://github.com/Alexandra-Wernersson/isobank

classification.title_zh: 学习近似等距嵌入以实现高效模板放置
classification.abstract_zh: 球覆盖问题在科学中有广泛应用，然而在弯曲高维流形上精确求解在计算上不可行，因为距离必须使用依赖位置的度规来评估。我们提出 isobank，一个归一化流，学习近似等距的坐标变换，使得潜在空间中的欧氏距离近似物理参数空间中度规诱导的固有距离。这允许在潜在空间中使用欧氏距离检查进行模板放置，避免放置过程中重复的度规评估。我们在引力波模板库构建背景下评估 isobank，其中球覆盖问题对应模板放置问题。在五维偏心双星参数空间上，isobank 在最大失配 μ=0.03 时达到 97% 覆盖率，使用的模板比最先进的随机放置代码 mbank 少 23%，后者达到 94% 覆盖率。覆盖率在独立注入上测量，注入在质量、自旋和偏心率上均匀抽取，使用精确波形匹配而非度规近似。训练该流约需 2.5 小时，在 32 个 CPU 核心上放置模板库不到 1 小时。isobank 已在 GitHub 公开：https://github.com/Alexandra-Wernersson/isobank
classification.one_liner: 提出 isobank 归一化流学习近似等距嵌入，在五维偏心双星引力波模板放置中以更少模板达到更高覆盖率。

papers.title: Parity Isospectrality of the Kerr--Newman--de Sitter Black Hole
papers.abstract: Vacuum Kerr perturbations in general relativity have identical even- and odd-parity quasinormal frequencies. We establish this parity isospectrality for linear gravitoelectromagnetic perturbations of subextremal Kerr--Newman--de Sitter black holes, without a slow-rotation or small-charge expansion. We reconstruct the radiative metric and gauge-potential perturbations directly from gauge-invariant master variables in radiation gauge, without an intermediate complex potential.

classification.title_zh: Kerr–Newman–de Sitter 黑洞的宇称等谱性
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论中，真空 Kerr 扰动的偶宇称与奇宇称准正规模频率相同。我们对次极端 Kerr–Newman–de Sitter 黑洞的线性引力电磁扰动建立了这种宇称等谱性，且未使用慢旋转或小电荷展开。我们在辐射规范下直接从规范不变的主变量重构辐射度规与规范势扰动，无需引入中间复势。
classification.one_liner: 证明 Kerr–Newman–de Sitter 黑洞线性引力电磁扰动存在宇称等谱性，且不依赖慢转或小电荷近似。

papers.title: Uniform Strong-Deflection Lensing in Near-Extremal Kerr
papers.abstract: Strong-deflection lensing by a subextremal Kerr black hole exhibits a logarithmic critical divergence, whereas the exactly extremal prograde problem develops stronger power-law behavior. We construct a uniform asymptotic description of the transition between these regimes for prograde equatorial null geodesics. The distinguished joint near-critical and near-extremal limit occurs when the impact-parameter offset from the exact critical value is of order \(M\kappa\), where \(\kappa=\sqrt{1-a^2/M^2}\). In this limit, the Kerr radial potential reduces to a quadratic normal form, yielding an analytic crossover function that connects the subextremal logarithmic and extremal power-law regimes. We derive a matched next-to-leading-order correction and validate it against high-precision integrations of the exact Kerr geodesic equations, finding improvement for all 55 trajectories tested. The same asymptotic structure yields a higher-order image-branch law interpolating between algebraic and exponential accumulation, with crossover order scaling as \(\kappa^{-1}\). We also derive and numerically validate the corresponding image-branch coordinate-time delay law, whose high-order extremal-like limit approaches the horizon-period spacing \(4\pi M\).

classification.title_zh: 近极端 Kerr 中的均匀强偏折透镜
classification.abstract_zh: 亚极端 Kerr 黑洞的强偏折透镜表现出对数临界发散，而精确极端顺行问题则出现更强的幂律行为。我们为顺行赤道零测地线构建了这些区域之间过渡的均匀渐近描述。当碰撞参数相对于精确临界值的偏移为 Mκ 量级（其中 κ=sqrt(1-a^2/M^2)）时，出现显著的联合近临界与近极端极限。在此极限下，Kerr 径向势约化为二次正规形，给出一个解析交叉函数，连接亚极端对数区域与极端幂律区域。我们推导了匹配的次领头阶修正，并用精确 Kerr 测地线方程的高精度数值积分进行验证，在测试的全部 55 条轨道上均有改进。相同的渐近结构给出一个高阶像分支定律，在代数累积与指数累积之间插值，交叉阶数按 κ^{-1} 标度。我们还推导并数值验证了相应的像分支坐标时间延迟定律，其高阶类极端极限趋近于视界周期间距 4πM。
classification.one_liner: 构建近极端 Kerr 黑洞中连接亚极端对数发散与极端幂律行为的均匀强偏折透镜渐近理论。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究 Kerr 黑洞经典强偏折透镜与测地线渐近，直接对应经典引力/广义相对论重点标签；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Non-Gaussian timing residual skewness in pulsar timing arrays
papers.abstract: Motivated by searches for weak primordial non-Gaussianity in the cosmic microwave background, we investigate perturbative departures from Gaussian stochastic gravitational wave background statistics using pulsar timing arrays. We consider a quadratic ansatz that shows three-point correlations at first order in the nonlinear coupling and covariance corrections at second order. We first examine the ansatz for gravitational wave helicity amplitudes. However, the timing residual bispectrum that this produces is not manifestly invariant under local polarization basis rotations for tensor and vector modes. Then, we formulate a polarization-frame-invariant phenomenological model for detector-projected amplitudes and evaluate its one-pulsar timing residual third moment with a simplified response. Our numerical benchmarks have shown that this gives a very small Gaussian-rms-normalized skewness.

classification.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列中的非高斯计时残差偏度
classification.abstract_zh: 受宇宙微波背景中微弱原初非高斯性搜寻的启发，我们利用脉冲星计时阵列研究对高斯随机引力波背景统计的微扰偏离。我们考虑一个二次拟设，其在非线性耦合的一阶给出三点关联，在二阶给出协方差修正。我们首先针对引力波螺旋振幅考察该拟设。然而，由此产生的计时残差双谱对张量和矢量模式而言，在局域偏振基旋转下并不显式不变。随后，我们为探测器投影振幅构造了一个偏振框架不变的唯象模型，并用简化响应评估其单脉冲星计时残差三阶矩。我们的数值基准表明，这给出一个非常小的、以高斯均方根归一化的偏度。
classification.one_liner: 研究脉冲星计时阵列中随机引力波背景的非高斯性，发现二次拟设的双谱缺乏偏振基不变性，改用偏振框架不变模型后单脉冲星计时残差偏度很小。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于脉冲星计时阵列与随机引力波背景统计/引力波现象学，可归入经典引力-引力波支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力信息问题。

papers.title: Multi-Band Constraints on Cosmic Strings: Unifying Harmonic and Burst Spectra
papers.abstract: Cosmic-string loops generate a broadband gravitational-wave background (GWB) that is typically modeled via two distinct formalisms: a discrete harmonic expansion, commonly used in pulsar-timing-array (PTA) studies, and a continuous burst superposition, employed in ground-based GWB searches. In this work, we formally unify the two formalisms, showing that they provide discrete and continuous representations of the same underlying radiation process and converge on the scale-invariant spectrum plateau. On the rising low-frequency branch, where the first few harmonics dominate, the discrete nature becomes important, causing the two formalisms to diverge. Within this unified framework, the spectral calculation is more consistent across frequency bands, enabling multi-band inference. Leveraging this physical insight, we perform joint Bayesian inference across four representative loop-distribution models using the NANOGrav, EPTA, and LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA (LVK) datasets. By jointly sampling the string tension $G\mu$ alongside the average cusp and kink numbers $\{N_c, N_k\}$, the loop-radiation uncertainties are accounted for. We find that employing the harmonic expansion strengthens the LVK bounds by $21\%-31\%$ for three of these models. Additionally, the stringent LVK bounds preclude three of these models from explaining the observed PTA common signal. For the sole surviving model, our multi-band analysis improves the inferred limit on $G\mu$.

classification.title_zh: 宇宙弦的多波段约束：统一谐波谱与暴发谱
classification.abstract_zh: 宇宙弦环会产生宽频段引力波背景（GWB），通常通过两种不同形式建模：一种用于脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）研究的离散谐波展开，另一种用于地基 GWB 搜索的连续暴发叠加。在本工作中，我们形式化地统一了这两种形式，表明它们是对同一底层辐射过程的离散与连续表示，并在尺度不变谱平台上收敛。在上升的低频分支上，前几个谐波占主导，离散性变得重要，导致两种形式出现分歧。在这一统一框架内，谱计算在不同频段间更一致，从而能够进行多波段推断。利用这一物理洞察，我们使用 NANOGrav、EPTA 和 LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA (LVK) 数据集，对四个代表性的环分布模型进行了联合贝叶斯推断。通过联合采样弦张力 Gμ 以及平均尖点数和扭结数 {N_c, N_k}，考虑了环辐射的不确定性。我们发现，对其中三个模型，采用谐波展开使 LVK 限制增强 21%--31%。此外，严格的 LVK 限制排除了其中三个模型解释观测到的 PTA 公共信号的可能性。对于唯一存活的模型，我们的多波段分析改善了推断出的 Gμ 限制。
classification.one_liner: 统一宇宙弦引力波背景的谐波与暴发谱描述，并联合 PTA 与 LVK 数据对弦张力进行多波段贝叶斯限制。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于宇宙学与经典引力/引力波方向，研究宇宙弦产生的随机引力波背景及多波段观测限制，与经典引力/广义相对论重点支线相关；不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

papers.title: Can the gravitational waves emitted by Eta Carinae be detected?
papers.abstract: In this article, we propose a search for gravitational waves emitted by Eta Carinae using the PTA technique, not to detect a background, but rather a strong, isolated source (a task not yet accomplished). We suggest including pulsars PSR J0952-0607, PSR J1719-1438, PSR J2322-2650, and PSR J1909-3744 in the search network, as they exhibit relatively high residual-to-pulse-width ratios and spatial positions that favor the detection of tensor polarizations. The high eccentricity (0.9) of the Eta Carinae binary orbit may facilitate signal identification within the data due to the presence of harmonics in the emitted gravitational waves. It is possible that some of the raw data have already been recorded and are available; the remaining step is to analyze them against a model of the gravitational wave signal arriving at Earth from Eta Carinae.

classification.title_zh: 船底座η星发出的引力波能被探测到吗？
classification.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出利用脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）技术搜寻船底座η星发出的引力波，不是探测背景，而是探测一个强而孤立的源（一项尚未完成的任务）。我们建议将脉冲星 PSR J0952-0607、PSR J1719-1438、PSR J2322-2650 和 PSR J1909-3744 纳入搜寻网络，因为它们表现出相对较高的残差与脉冲宽度之比，并且其空间位置有利于探测张量极化。船底座η星双星轨道的高偏心率（0.9）可能由于所发射引力波中存在谐波而有助于在数据中识别信号。部分原始数据可能已经被记录并可用；剩下的步骤是将其与从船底座η星到达地球的引力波信号模型进行比对分析。
classification.one_liner: 提出用脉冲星计时阵列搜寻船底座η星发出的强孤立引力波源，并建议特定脉冲星网络与利用高偏心率谐波来识别信号。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究经典引力波探测与脉冲星计时观测方案，不涉及AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力理论。

papers.title: Chaotic signatures in extreme-mass-ratio systems surrounded by bosonic environments
papers.abstract: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals are key gravitational-wave sources for testing strong gravity and the environments of massive black holes. While orbital motion in Kerr black hole spacetimes is integrable, realistic black holes may be surrounded by environments that break integrability. We investigate conservative orbital dynamics around rotating black holes surrounded by scalar clouds using fully nonlinear numerical solutions and an analytical post-Newtonian model. Poincar\'e sections and rotation curves reveal finite-width resonant islands, providing evidence for non-integrability even when the cloud carries only a small fraction of the black-hole mass. We show that the post-Newtonian description reproduces the dominant resonance and its island width for weak clouds, but underestimates the width in the configurations with stronger, more compact clouds examined here. Moreover, we find that for a scalar cloud as massive as the black hole, the phase space exhibits wider resonant islands as well as scattered layers indicative of chaotic motion. Together with earlier work, these results show that environmental effects can generically break the integrability of geodesic motion, motivating further study of resonance crossings and their gravitational-wave signatures once radiation reaction is included.

classification.title_zh: 玻色环境中极端质量比系统的混沌信号
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋进是检验强引力与大质量黑洞环境的关键引力波源。虽然 Kerr 黑洞时空中的轨道运动是可积的，真实黑洞可能被破坏可积性的环境所包围。我们使用完全非线性数值解和解析后牛顿模型，研究被标量云包围的旋转黑洞附近的保守轨道动力学。Poincaré 截面和旋转曲线揭示了有限宽度的共振岛，为即使云只携带黑洞质量的一小部分时也存在不可积性提供了证据。我们表明，后牛顿描述能重现弱云情形下的主导共振及其岛宽，但在本文考察的更强、更致密云构型中低估了岛宽。此外，我们发现对于质量与黑洞相当的标量云，相空间表现出更宽的共振岛以及表明混沌运动的散布层。结合此前工作，这些结果表明环境效应可以普遍地破坏测地运动的可积性，促使进一步研究共振穿越及其在包含辐射反作用后的引力波信号。
classification.one_liner: 用数值与后牛顿方法研究标量云环境中 EMRI 轨道动力学的可积性破坏与混沌共振岛。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力与引力波天体物理，研究 EMRI 在玻色环境中的轨道混沌与可积性破坏，不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息对偶。

papers.title: Einstein--Langevin source correlations in closed non-relativistic systems
papers.abstract: Stochastic semiclassical gravity represents stress--energy fluctuations through the Einstein--Langevin noise kernel. We examine its Newtonian projection for specified closed, particle-number-conserving non-relativistic sources and distinguish the source covariance from a reduced matter channel. The connected one-particle covariance is state dependent and differs from the universal potential-noise law postulated in the Di\'osi--Penrose model. To relate the source spectrum to dephasing, we define a separate static probe subject to a prescribed Gaussian noise law. For a finite-variance source operator in an isolated non-degenerate eigenstate, the full connected spectral measure has a gap around zero. The probe dephasing exponent is then bounded and its long-time slope vanishes. Stationary doublets can instead carry static or low-frequency spectral lines, while a specified freely spreading Gaussian source gives a finite limiting exponent. Continuum results depend on preparation, normalisation, infrared regularisation and the order of limits. We also compare coherent and incoherent many-body preparations and establish no-signalling for fixed classical-noise channels. These results identify the spatial, temporal and dynamical assumptions needed to relate source fluctuations to a matter-decoherence model. They do not exclude Markovian limits in other number-conserving non-relativistic preparations.

classification.title_zh: 封闭非相对论系统中的 Einstein–Langevin 源关联
classification.abstract_zh: 随机半经典引力通过 Einstein–Langevin 噪声核表示应力–能量涨落。我们考察其对指定的封闭、粒子数守恒的非相对论源的牛顿投影，并区分源协方差与约化物质通道。连通单粒子协方差依赖于态，且不同于 Diósi–Penrose 模型中所假设的普适势噪声律。为将源谱与退相位联系起来，我们定义了一个受指定高斯噪声律作用的独立静态探针。对于孤立非简并本征态中的有限方差源算符，完整的连通谱测度在零附近存在间隙。于是探针退相位指数有界，且其长时间斜率消失。相反，定态二重态可携带静态或低频谱线，而一个指定的自由扩展高斯源给出有限的极限指数。连续统结果依赖于制备、归一化、红外正则化以及极限顺序。我们还比较相干与非相干多体制备，并对固定经典噪声通道建立无信号性。这些结果确定了将源涨落与物质退相干模型相关联所需的空间、时间和动力学假设。它们并不排除其他粒子数守恒非相对论制备中的马尔可夫极限。
classification.one_liner: 在随机半经典引力框架中分析 Einstein–Langevin 源关联，并用静态探针将源谱与退相位联系起来，表明有限方差源在非简并本征态下谱隙导致退相位指数有界，结果依赖制备与极限顺序。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究随机半经典引力、Einstein-Langevin 噪声核与退相干，未涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或全息方法，因此与全息分类主线相关性低。

papers.title: Stationarity and angular momentum conservation in pulsar spin noise
papers.abstract: We present an analysis of pulsar spin noise based on physically-motivated two-component models of spin wandering. We focus on two models, distinguished by their total angular momentum dynamics: a singular, nonstationary model with a diffusive total angular momentum, and a minimal, stationary model anchored on a conserved total angular momentum. We develop scalable Gaussian process methods and, using mock data, show that the two models are fully testable and distinguishable with full-state observations, i.e., simultaneous independent data on the crust and the superfluid rotational states. This paves a path to testing stationarity in pulsar spin noise, potentially achievable with joint continuous gravitational wave observations and radio timing of pulsars. However, robust inferences and predictions are harder to achieve, and depend on the priors and data quality, when only one component is observationally accessible.

classification.title_zh: 脉冲星自旋噪声中的平稳性与角动量守恒
classification.abstract_zh: 我们基于物理启发的自旋游走双组分模型，对脉冲星自旋噪声进行分析。我们关注两种模型，它们由总角动量动力学区分：一种具有扩散总角动量的奇异非平稳模型，以及一种以守恒总角动量为锚点的最小平稳模型。我们发展了可扩展的高斯过程方法，并利用模拟数据表明，在全状态观测（即同时独立获得壳层与超流体转动状态的数据）下，这两种模型完全可检验且可区分。这为检验脉冲星自旋噪声中的平稳性开辟了路径，并可能通过连续引力波观测与脉冲星射电计时联合实现。然而，当只有一个组分可观测时，稳健的推断和预测更难实现，且依赖于先验与数据质量。
classification.one_liner: 用双组分自旋游走模型和高斯过程方法研究脉冲星自旋噪声的平稳性及角动量守恒可检验性。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于脉冲星/中子星自旋噪声与连续引力波观测的经典引力与天体物理方向，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力信息等用户重点全息支线。

papers.title: Hadronic description of nuclear matter and neutron star properties
papers.abstract: The composition of the neutron star is one of the most fundamental and long-standing problems in nuclear- and astro-physics. The known properties of nuclear matter, together with the astronomical observations, impose the stringent and interconnected constraints on the theoretical descriptions. In this work, by using the most general quantum hadrodynamics model including $\sigma, \omega, \rho$ and $a_0$ in addition to nucleons, and performing a Bayesian joint analysis of experimental nuclear matter data, the heavy-ion flow pressure, and astrophysical observations including the mass-radius inferences of PSR J0740+6620, PSR J0437$-$4715, PSR J0614$-$3329 and HESS J1731$-$347 and the tidal posterior of GW170817, we point out that the nuclear matter made of only hadrons can provide a unified description of nuclear matter properties and astrophysical observations.In addition, we find that the speed of sound in the GQHD develops a non-monotonic, peak-like structure which is absent in the Walecka-type models TM1, NL3 and FSU-$\delta6.7$. This soft-to-stiff transition, accompanied by a pronounced softening of the symmetry energy, results in small size intermediate mass neutron stars, $R_{1.4}\simeq (11.1-11.4)$~km, together with the maximum mass $(2.2-2.3)M_\odot$, and, to our knowledge, has not been found before in the Walecka-type relativistic mean-field models. What we find here indicate that the sequential measurement of neutron star mass and radius by the next generation facilities, especially that of the intermediate mass neutron stars, is crucial for distinguishing the pure nucleonic stars from the hybrid ones.

classification.title_zh: 核物质与中子星性质的强子描述
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星的组分是核物理与天体物理中最基本且长期存在的问题之一。核物质的已知性质与天文观测对理论描述施加了严格且相互关联的约束。本文使用最一般的量子强子动力学模型，除核子外还包含 σ、ω、ρ 和 a0 介子，并对实验核物质数据、重离子流压力以及天体物理观测（包括 PSR J0740+6620、PSR J0437−4715、PSR J0614−3329、HESS J1731−347 的质量-半径推断和 GW170817 的潮汐后验）进行贝叶斯联合分析，指出仅由强子构成的核物质能够统一描述核物质性质与天体物理观测。此外，我们发现 GQHD 中的声速呈现非单调的峰状结构，这在 Walecka 型模型 TM1、NL3 和 FSU-δ6.7 中不存在。这种由软到硬的转变伴随对称能显著软化，导致中等质量中子星尺寸较小，R_{1.4}≈(11.1–11.4) km，同时最大质量达到 (2.2–2.3) M⊙；据我们所知，这在 Walecka 型相对论平均场模型中尚未被发现。我们的结果表明，下一代设施对中子星质量和半径的连续测量，尤其是对中等质量中子星的测量，对于区分纯核子星与混合星至关重要。
classification.one_liner: 用含 σ、ω、ρ、a0 的量子强子动力学模型联合核数据与天文观测，统一描述核物质和中子星性质，并发现声速峰状结构导致小半径中等质量中子星。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于核物质与中子星物态方程研究，涉及中子星质量半径、潮汐形变等经典引力/中子星观测，与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签部分重合；但核心不是全息/AdS/CFT，也不涉及量子引力或强耦合全息方法。

papers.title: Properties of rapidly rotating hot neutron stars within Brueckner theory
papers.abstract: We study the properties of hot rapidly rotating neutron stars using various equations of state based on the Brueckner-Hartree-Fock approach at finite temperature. The temperature dependence of gravitational mass, equatorial radius, Kepler frequency, moment of inertia are analysed in detail and universal relations are examined.

classification.title_zh: Brueckner理论下快速旋转热中子星的性质
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用基于有限温度Brueckner-Hartree-Fock方法的各种状态方程，研究快速旋转热中子星的性质。详细分析了引力质量、赤道半径、开普勒频率和转动惯量的温度依赖性，并检验了普适关系。
classification.one_liner: 基于有限温度Brueckner-Hartree-Fock状态方程研究快速旋转热中子星的引力质量、半径、开普勒频率和转动惯量及其普适关系。

papers.title: Coexistence of strange quark stars and neutron stars: metastability and nucleation in proto-neutron stars
papers.abstract: If strange quark matter (SQM) is absolutely stable, hadronic neutron stars (NSs) and strange quark stars (QSs) may coexist in the so-called two-families scenario. A key issue is explaining how hadronic NSs can survive as long-lived metastable objects, rather than promptly converting into stable QSs. Since all NSs are born as hot proto-neutron stars (PNSs), a necessary condition for their existence is that the conditions for conversion, triggered by the nucleation of the first critical SQM droplet, are not reached in every PNS. We investigate the thermal nucleation of critical SQM droplets under representative PNS conditions, accounting for flavor-composition fluctuations and finite-size effects on color superconductivity by suppressing pairing in droplets smaller than the diquark coherence length. We define the nucleation conditions as the thermodynamic state at which a critical SQM droplet is expected to nucleate statistically within the characteristic dynamical timescale of the system. Under these conditions, the reduced nucleation barrier is nearly universal, with $W_*/T\simeq167$ to within a few units. Exploring the SQM parameter space, we show that requiring a canonical $1.4~\rm{M}_{\odot}$ NS to survive the PNS stage sets a lower bound on the hadron-quark surface tension $\sigma\gtrsim 67$ MeVfm$^{-2}$.

classification.title_zh: 奇异夸克星与中子星的共存：原中子星中的亚稳性与成核
classification.abstract_zh: 如果奇异夸克物质（SQM）是绝对稳定的，那么强子中子星（NSs）与奇异夸克星（QSs）可能在所谓的“两家族”情景中共存。一个关键问题是要解释强子中子星如何能作为长寿命亚稳客体存活下来，而不是迅速转化为稳定的奇异夸克星。由于所有中子星都诞生为热的原中子星（PNSs），它们存在的必要条件是在每个原中子星中都未达到由第一个临界 SQM 液滴成核所触发的转化条件。我们研究了代表性 PNS 条件下临界 SQM 液滴的热成核，考虑了味组分涨落，以及通过抑制小于双夸克相干长度的液滴中的配对来纳入颜色超导的有限尺寸效应。我们将成核条件定义为：临界 SQM 液滴在系统特征动力学时间尺度内以统计方式预期成核的热力学状态。在这些条件下，约化的成核势垒几乎是普适的，W_*/T ≈ 167，误差仅几个单位。通过探索 SQM 参数空间，我们表明，要求一个标准的 1.4 M⊙ 中子星能够存活过 PNS 阶段，会对强子-夸克表面张力给出下界 σ ≳ 67 MeV fm^{-2}。
classification.one_liner: 在奇异夸克物质绝对稳定的两家族情景下，原中子星中临界奇异夸克液滴的热成核分析给出中子星亚稳存活条件与强子-夸克表面张力下界。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究强子-夸克相变与临界液滴成核，匹配重点标签“相变与气泡成核”；对象为中子星/奇异夸克星，可关联经典引力-致密星支线，但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Twin-peaked gravitational wave signals from a $\mathcal{Z}_2$ phase transition
papers.abstract: We compute the gravitational wave spectrum from a phase transition associated with the spontaneous breaking of a $\mathcal{Z}_2^{\rm DW}$ symmetry. If the transition is second-order, the only source of gravitational waves is the annihilation of domain walls (biased by quantum gravity) formed after this breaking. However, if the transition is first-order, this yields a twin-peaked signal from both the transition itself and the biased domain wall annihilation. Both scenarios originate when a scalar singlet odd under the $\mathcal{Z}_2^{\rm DW}$ obtains a non-zero vacuum expectation value. An additional $\mathcal{Z}_2^{\rm DM}$ odd scalar doublet strengthens the transition by keeping the singlet scalar in thermal equilibrium with the Standard Model plasma at early times. Additionally, the same scalar doublet produces fermionic dark matter via freeze-in, matching observed dark matter relic density.

classification.title_zh: 来自 Z2^DW 相变的双峰引力波信号
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了与 Z2^DW 对称性自发破缺相关的相变所产生的引力波谱。如果该相变是二阶的，引力波的唯一来源是破缺后形成的畴壁（受量子引力偏置）的湮灭。然而，如果相变是一阶的，则会产生双峰信号，分别来自相变本身和受偏置的畴壁湮灭。两种情形都起源于一个在 Z2^DW 下为奇的标量单态获得非零真空期望值。额外的 Z2^DM 奇标量二重态通过使该单态标量在早期与标准模型等离子体保持热平衡来增强相变。此外，同一个标量二重态通过 freeze-in 产生费米暗物质，与观测到的暗物质遗迹丰度相符。
classification.one_liner: 计算 Z2^DW 自发破缺相变产生的引力波谱：二阶时仅畴壁湮灭，一阶时相变与偏置畴壁湮灭给出双峰信号，并可与 freeze-in 费米暗物质联系。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息/AdS-CFT 论文；与用户重点标签中的相变与气泡成核、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀相关，也产生引力波，但不涉及全息超流超导、multi-trace 或 D3-D7 等主线。

papers.title: Trace-anomaly decomposition and universal dark matter scaling in compact stars
papers.abstract: We investigate how dark matter (DM) admixture modifies the conformal properties and phase structure of dense neutron-star matter within a self-consistent single-fluid framework, with the global DM fraction $F_\chi=N_\chi/N_B$ fixing the local relation $n_\chi=F_\chi n_B$. We derive an exact decomposition of the total trace anomaly, $\Delta_{\rm tot}$, into microscopic contributions. For collider-motivated Higgs-portal benchmarks, explicit Higgs, vector-mediator, and contact-interaction contributions are negligible, while heavy nonrelativistic DM has an intrinsic trace anomaly close to the nonrelativistic limit, $\Delta_\chi\simeq1/3$. Consequently, the DM rest-mass energy fraction dominates the DM-induced modification of $\Delta_{\rm tot}$, producing a smooth upward shift of up to $\sim0.1$ for $F_\chi\sim0.2\%$. In the pressureless, comoving heavy-WIMP regime, we further identify a universal dark-sector scaling governed by the mass-loading parameter $\lambda=F_\chi m_\chi/m_N$: numerical calculations with different $(F_\chi,m_\chi)$ pairs at fixed $\lambda$ exhibit overlapping trace-anomaly, sound-speed, and mass--radius responses for a given baryonic equation of state. In hybrid stars, DM leaves the coexistence pressure and chemical potential essentially unchanged, whereas first-order hadron--quark deconfinement produces sharp discontinuities in the squared sound speed $c_s^2$, $\Delta_{\rm tot}$, and $\Delta_{\rm tot}-\Delta_B$. The combined softening substantially reduces the maximum stellar mass, placing $F_\chi\sim0.2\%$ in tension with the observed $2\,M_\odot$ neutron stars. These results show that the trace anomaly and its density evolution provide a sensitive diagnostic for distinguishing smooth DM-induced modifications of dense matter from genuine first-order deconfinement.

classification.title_zh: 致密星中的迹反常分解与普适暗物质标度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在自洽单流体框架内研究暗物质（DM）混合如何改变致密中子星物质的共形性质与相结构，其中全局 DM 分数 Fχ=Nχ/NB 固定局域关系 nχ=Fχ nB。我们导出了总迹反常 Δtot 的精确分解为微观贡献。对于对撞机动机的 Higgs 入口基准，显式 Higgs、矢量媒介子和接触相互作用贡献可忽略，而重非相对论 DM 具有接近非相对论极限的内禀迹反常 Δχ≈1/3。因此，DM 静止质量能量分数主导 DM 引起的 Δtot 改变，在 Fχ∼0.2% 时产生最高约 ∼0.1 的平滑上移。在无压、共动重 WIMP 区域，我们进一步识别出由质量负载参数 λ=Fχ mχ/mN 控制的普适暗部门标度：固定 λ 下不同 (Fχ,mχ) 对的数值计算，对于给定重子物态方程，显示出重叠的迹反常、声速和质量—半径响应。在混合星中，DM 基本不改变共存压强和化学势，而一阶强子—夸克去禁闭在声速平方 cs^2、Δtot 和 Δtot−ΔB 中产生尖锐不连续性。联合软化显著降低最大星体质量，使 Fχ∼0.2% 与观测到的 2 M⊙ 中子星相冲突。这些结果表明，迹反常及其密度演化是区分致密物质中平滑 DM 诱导修正与真正一阶去禁闭的敏感诊断。
classification.one_liner: 研究暗物质混合对致密星物质迹反常与相结构的影响，发现由质量负载参数控制的普适标度，并用迹反常区分平滑暗物质效应与一阶去禁闭。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于致密星/核物质与暗物质物态方程研究，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力；仅在经典引力/致密星支线上有边缘关联。

papers.title: Close Pulsar Pairs See Dark Matter Substructure through the Gravitational-Wave Background
papers.abstract: Pulsar timing arrays detect signals from dark matter substructure, but a nanohertz gravitational-wave background (GWB) severely degrades their sensitivity. We show that timing pulsar pairs separated by sub-parsec distances avoids this degradation. The GWB imprints nearly the same perturbation on both pulsars and is suppressed in the difference of their residuals, whereas a nearby dark matter subhalo perturbs the two differently and survives. We find that an array with pulsar pairs separated by $0.1\,\mathrm{pc}$ improves the sensitivity to subhalos of order $\sim10^{-6}$ solar masses by more than an order of magnitude, relative to an otherwise identical array of widely separated pulsars. Dense globular clusters naturally host many such pairs, though the baryonic environment must be separated from a dark matter substructure signal.

classification.title_zh: 近距离脉冲星对通过引力波背景探测暗物质子结构
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列可以探测暗物质子结构信号，但纳赫兹引力波背景（GWB）会严重降低其灵敏度。我们表明，对相隔小于秒差距距离的脉冲星对进行计时可以避免这种降级。GWB 对两颗脉冲星施加几乎相同的扰动，并在其残差差值中被压低，而附近的暗物质子晕对两者的扰动不同并得以保留。我们发现，与由相距较远的脉冲星组成的相同阵列相比，一个包含相隔 0.1 pc 的脉冲星对的阵列对质量约为 10^{-6} 太阳质量的子晕的灵敏度提高超过一个数量级。致密球状星团天然拥有许多这样的脉冲星对，不过必须将重子环境与暗物质子结构信号分离开来。
classification.one_liner: 利用近距离脉冲星对差分抑制纳赫兹引力波背景，从而提高对暗物质子晕的脉冲星计时探测灵敏度。
classification.relevance_reason: 不属于全息/AdS/CFT 或量子信息方向；是脉冲星计时、引力波背景与暗物质子结构的经典引力/天体物理研究。

papers.title: Systematic Bayesian investigation of the (2+1)-flavor QCD phase transition in a holographic model
papers.abstract: In this study, we construct a bayesian holographic QCD model by integrating the Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton (EMD) framework with lattice quantum chromodynamics (QCD) data at zero chemical potential, specifically entropy, the square of the speed of sound, and baryon number susceptibilities, while systematically incorporating error estimates from the lattice QCD (LQCD) results. Leveraging a bayesian inference framework, we first achieve a precise calibration of the model parameters, then perform a comprehensive investigation into the thermodynamic properties of \((2+1)\)-flavor QCD at both zero and finite chemical potentials, and finally provide a prediction for the location of the critical end point (CEP) in the QCD phase diagram. Our results indicate that, under the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimation, the CEP is located at $(T, \mu)_{\mathrm{MAP}} = (0.119, 0.615)\mathrm{GeV}$. Furthermore, we provide the predicted regions for the CEP at $68\%$ and $95\%$ confidence levels (CL), yielding $(T, \mu)_{68\% \mathrm{CL}} = (0.1176\text{--}0.1204,0.59\text{--}0.63)\mathrm{GeV}$ and $(T, \mu)_{95\% \mathrm{CL}} = (0.1172\text{--}0.1206,0.58\text{--}0.63)\mathrm{GeV}$, respectively. A thorough comparison with predictions from other theoretical models validates the robustness and predictive power of our approach. This work not only establishes a novel analytical framework for holographic modeling but also provides valuable theoretical insights into the phase transitions of strongly interacting matter under extreme conditions.
