papers.title: Gas-induced gravitational-wave dephasing and accretion periodicities of live post-Newtonian massive black hole binaries: warm disk
papers.abstract: We perform 3D hydrodynamical simulations of an equal-mass quasi-circular live $10^6~{\rm M}_\odot$ massive black hole binary (MBHB) embedded in a prograde, locally isothermal circumbinary disk (CBD) with $0.1$ aspect ratio. The binary evolves under the effect of gaseous torques and $2.5$ post-Newtonian dynamics. This approach allows us to track the influence of the CBD on a gravitational-wave (GW) driven MBHB inspiral all the way down to merger from $53$ Schwarzschild radii ($r_s$) over $1.5$ years. Comparing the GW inspiral rate with the viscous inflow, we find the binary to decouple from the CBD just $\approx2$ days before merger. We measure gas torques (gravitational and accretion) with and without concurrent GW emission, finding that their sums agree to within $\lesssim5\%$ down to $25~r_s$. We then measure a gas-induced phase-shift in the GW signal of $\approx9.0\times10^{-4}$ rad that accumulates over a year until $40~r_s$ and saturates afterward, which should be LISA-detectable at redshift $z{\lesssim0.2}$. We further characterize the mass accretion rate modulations. We recover the periodicity associated with the ``lump" at the inner cavity edge. The periodicities at the binary orbital period and at half of it are shifted to lower frequencies. We measure the former, due to relativistic apsidal precession, in an inspiraling binary for the first time, and newly identify the latter as due to the precession of the eccentric cavity. Our results have implications for multi-messenger astronomy, since observation of accretion rate modulation by LSST/Roman surveys and phase-shift by LISA will provide crucial information on the complex environment surrounding MBHBs.

classification.title_zh: 气体诱导的引力波退相位与实时演化后牛顿大质量黑洞双星的吸积周期性：暖盘
classification.abstract_zh: 我们对一个等质量、准圆形、实时演化的 10^6 M_sun 大质量黑洞双星（MBHB）进行了三维流体动力学模拟，该双星嵌入在一个顺行、局部等温、纵横比为 0.1 的环双星盘（CBD）中。双星在气体扭矩和 2.5 后牛顿动力学作用下演化。该方法使我们能够追踪 CBD 对引力波（GW）驱动的 MBHB 旋进的影响，从 53 史瓦西半径（rs）一直跟踪到并合，历时 1.5 年。比较 GW 旋进率与黏性流入，我们发现双星在并合前仅约 2 天与 CBD 退耦。我们测量了有无同时 GW 发射时的气体扭矩（引力扭矩和吸积扭矩），发现它们的总和在直到 25 rs 处符合到 ≲5%。随后我们测得 GW 信号中气体诱导的相位偏移约为 9.0×10^-4 rad，它在一年内累积直到 40 rs，之后饱和；该偏移在红移 z≲0.2 时应该可被 LISA 探测。我们进一步刻画了质量吸积率调制。我们恢复了与内腔边缘“团块”（lump）相关的周期性。双星轨道周期及其一半处的周期性均移至较低频率。我们首次在旋进双星中测量了前者，其由相对论性近星点进动引起，并新识别出后者源于偏心腔的进动。我们的结果对多信使天文学具有重要意义，因为 LSST/Roman 巡天对吸积率调制的观测以及 LISA 对相位偏移的观测，将为 MBHB 周围复杂环境提供关键信息。
classification.one_liner: 三维流体模拟显示，环双星盘气体可在 LISA 可探测范围内使大质量黑洞双星引力波产生退相位，并产生与轨道及偏心腔进动相关的吸积率周期性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究后牛顿大质量黑洞双星、引力波退相位与环双星盘吸积，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息，但与重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”直接匹配。

papers.title: Factorized neural posterior estimation for rapid and reliable inference of parameterized post-Einsteinian deviation parameters in gravitational waves
papers.abstract: The direct detection of gravitational waves (GWs) by LIGO has confirmed general relativity (GR), but testing GR via GWs requires estimating parameterized post-Einsteinian (ppE) deviation parameters in waveform models. Traditional Bayesian inference methods like Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) provide reliable estimates but suffer from prohibitive computational costs, failing to meet the real-time demands and surging data volume of future GW detectors. Here, we propose a factorized neural posterior estimation framework: we construct independent normalizing flow models for each of the nine ppE deviation parameters, and effectively integrate prior information from other source parameters via a conditional embedding network. Leveraging a hybrid neural network with a convolutional neural network and a Residual Neural Network for feature extraction, our method performs rapid and statistically reliable posterior inference directly from binary black hole signals. Compared to conventional MCMC, our approach achieves millisecond-scale inference time with a speedup factor of $9 \times 10^4$. Comprehensive validations show that the posterior estimates pass the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test and achieve empirical coverage probabilities close to theoretical targets. We apply this method to the GW150914 event and find that the resulting posterior distributions are in good agreement with existing results. This work demonstrates the great potential of deep learning for GW parameter estimation and provides a viable technical solution for real-time GR tests with next-generation detectors.

classification.title_zh: 用于引力波中参数化后爱因斯坦偏差参数快速可靠推断的因子化神经后验估计
classification.abstract_zh: LIGO对引力波的直接探测已证实广义相对论（GR），但通过引力波检验GR需要在波形模型中估计参数化后爱因斯坦（ppE）偏差参数。传统贝叶斯推断方法如马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）能提供可靠估计，但计算成本高得难以承受，无法满足未来引力波探测器的实时需求和数据量激增。在此，我们提出一个因子化神经后验估计框架：为九个ppE偏差参数分别构建独立的归一化流模型，并通过条件嵌入网络有效整合其他源参数的先验信息。利用结合卷积神经网络和残差神经网络的特征提取混合神经网络，我们的方法直接从双黑洞信号执行快速且统计可靠的后验推断。与传统MCMC相比，我们的方法达到毫秒级推断时间，加速因子为9×10^4。综合验证表明，后验估计通过Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验，经验覆盖概率接近理论目标。我们将该方法应用于GW150914事件，发现所得后验分布与已有结果吻合良好。这项工作展示了深度学习在引力波参数估计中的巨大潜力，并为下一代探测器的实时GR检验提供了可行技术方案。
classification.one_liner: 提出因子化神经后验估计框架，从双黑洞引力波信号毫秒级推断ppE偏差参数，以约9×10^4倍加速检验广义相对论。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究引力波参数估计与广义相对论检验，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Relativistic jets from millisecond proto-magnetars
papers.abstract: Rapidly rotating, strongly magnetized neutron stars (``millisecond proto-magnetars'') formed in stellar core-collapse, neutron star mergers, and white dwarf accretion-induced collapse have long been proposed as central engines of gamma-ray bursts (GRB) and accompanying supernovae/kilonovae. However, during the first few seconds after birth, neutrino heating drives baryon-rich winds from the neutron star surface, potentially limiting the magnetization and achievable Lorentz factors of the outflow and casting doubt on whether proto-magnetars can launch ultra-relativistic jets at early times, as needed to power short-duration GRB. We present 3D general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamic simulations of neutrino-heated proto-magnetar winds that incorporate M0 neutrino transport. While the global wind properties broadly agree with previous analytic estimates calibrated to one-dimensional models, our simulations reveal essential multidimensional effects. For rapidly rotating models with spin periods P = 1 ms, centrifugal forces strongly enhance mass loss near the rotational equator, producing a dense, sub-relativistic outflow ( ~0.1c). This equatorial wind naturally confines and collimates less baryon-loaded outflows emerging from higher latitudes, leading to the formation of a structured bipolar jet with a peak magnetization up to ~ 30-100 along the pole, sufficient to reach bulk Lorentz factors ~ 100 on larger scales. The resulting angular stratification of the outflow energy into ultra-relativistic polar and sub-relativistic equatorial components is broadly consistent with the observed partition between beaming-corrected GRB energies and supernova/kilonova ejecta. Our results demonstrate that millisecond proto-magnetars can launch relativistic jets within seconds of formation and highlight their potential role in powering the diverse electromagnetic counterparts of compact-object explosions.

classification.title_zh: 毫秒原磁星产生的相对论性喷流
classification.abstract_zh: 在恒星核心坍缩、中子星并合以及白矮星吸积诱导坍缩中形成的快速旋转、强磁化中子星（“毫秒原磁星”）长期以来被提出作为伽马射线暴（GRB）及伴随超新星/千新星的中心引擎。然而，在诞生后的最初几秒，中微子加热会从中子星表面驱动重子丰富的风，可能限制外流的磁化程度和可达到的洛伦兹因子，并使人们怀疑原磁星能否在早期发射短伽马暴所需的超相对论喷流。我们提出包含 M0 中微子输运的中微子加热原磁星风的三维广义相对论磁流体力学模拟。虽然整体风性质与先前基于一维模型校准的解析估计大致一致，但我们的模拟揭示了关键的多维效应。对于自转周期 P = 1 ms 的快速旋转模型，离心力强烈增强赤道附近的质量损失，产生稠密的亚相对论外流（约 0.1c）。该赤道风自然地约束和准直来自更高纬度的重子负载较少的外流，导致形成一个结构化双极喷流，极向峰值磁化参数可达约 30-100，足以在更大尺度达到体洛伦兹因子约 100。由此产生的外流能量角向分层为超相对论极向成分和亚相对论赤道成分，与观测到的束流修正后的 GRB 能量与超新星/千新星抛射物之间的分配大致一致。我们的结果表明，毫秒原磁星能够在形成后数秒内发射相对论喷流，并强调它们在驱动致密天体爆炸的多样电磁对应体中的潜在作用。
classification.one_liner: 三维广义相对论磁流体力学模拟表明，毫秒原磁星可通过赤道重子风准直极向喷流，在形成数秒内产生洛伦兹因子约100的相对论外流。
keywords: 广义相对论磁流体力学

papers.title: Curvature-induced phantom mimicry and cosmological bounces without violating the Dominant Energy Condition
papers.abstract: We explore the active geometric contribution of spatial curvature in a closed universe, distinguishing between kinematic superacceleration and the strict violation of matter energy conditions. We demonstrate that for pressureless matter obeying the Dominant Energy Condition (DEC), positive spatial curvature does not induce a phantom regime, but leads to a decelerating expansion that culminates in a late-time turnaround ($\dot{H}<0$). At this finite-scale moment, the expansion ceases and the apparent horizon stays regular, signaling the beginning of an eventual Big Crunch. We contrast this behavior with the genuine phantom case ($\omega<-1$), where positive curvature introduces a distinct, early finite-radius expansion bounce ($\dot{H}>0$) that cannot prevent the inevitable late-time Big Rip singularity. Finally, we contextualize these results, discussing how positive spatial curvature can dynamically mimic phantom phenomenology and permit geodesically complete cosmologies without relying on exotic, energy-condition-violating matter.

classification.title_zh: 曲率诱导的幽灵模拟与不违反主导能量条件的宇宙学反弹
classification.abstract_zh: 我们探讨闭合宇宙中空间曲率的主动几何贡献，区分运动学上的超加速与物质能量条件的严格违背。我们证明，对于满足主导能量条件（DEC）的无压物质，正空间曲率不会诱导幽灵区，而是导致减速膨胀，并最终在晚期发生掉头（\dot{H}<0）。在这个有限尺度时刻，膨胀停止，视界保持正则，标志着最终大挤压的开始。我们将此行为与真正的幽灵情形（\omega<-1）进行对比：在后者中，正曲率引入一个独特的、早期有限半径的膨胀反弹（\dot{H}>0），但无法阻止晚期不可避免的大撕裂奇点。最后，我们对这些结果进行语境化讨论，说明正空间曲率如何能够动力学地模拟幽灵现象学，并允许测地完备的宇宙学，而无需依赖违反能量条件的奇异物质。
classification.one_liner: 在闭合宇宙中，正空间曲率可以动力学地模拟幽灵行为并允许测地完备的宇宙演化，而无需违反主导能量条件。

papers.title: Gravitational wave propagation through viscous matter
papers.abstract: It has been known that gravitational waves (GWs) transfer energy to viscous matter through which they propagate, but the effect is too weak to be astrophysically significant. Using linearized perturbations about a Minkowski background, we previously showed that the interaction can become important when the distance between matter and source is smaller than the GW wavelength. Here, we review extensions to more realistic backgrounds, namely Schwarzschild spacetime and a static spherically symmetric setting. We find that GW damping and the associated heating of the viscous fluid are enhanced, and can lead to substantial attenuation or even gamma-ray bursts. We investigate astrophysical scenarios where these effects may be relevant, including core-collapse supernovae, binary neutron star mergers, and accretion onto binary black hole mergers.

classification.title_zh: 引力波在粘性物质中的传播
classification.abstract_zh: 已知引力波在传播过程中会向粘性物质传递能量，但该效应太弱，在天体物理意义上并不显著。我们此前利用闵可夫斯基背景上的线性化扰动表明，当物质与源之间的距离小于引力波波长时，这种相互作用可能变得重要。这里我们评述向更现实背景的推广，即史瓦西时空和静态球对称情形。我们发现引力波阻尼以及粘性流体的相应加热会被增强，并可能导致显著衰减甚至伽马射线暴。我们考察这些效应可能相关的天体物理场景，包括核坍缩超新星、双中子星并合以及双黑洞并合上的吸积。
classification.one_liner: 把引力波与粘性物质的相互作用推广到史瓦西和静态球对称背景，发现阻尼和加热增强，并讨论超新星、双中子星并合与黑洞吸积等场景。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究广义相对论框架下的引力波传播与经典时空背景效应，直接对应重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及全息对偶或其他重点支线。

papers.title: High-frequency gravitational wave transients from superradiance
papers.abstract: Ultralight bosons can form macroscopic gravitational-atom clouds around rotating black holes via superradiance, sourcing quasi-monochromatic gravitational waves through level transitions and annihilation. Primordial black holes provide a natural setting for such systems in a frequency range relevant for resonant-cavity experiments. We present a unified treatment of gravitational-wave emission from both isolated and binary-perturbed gravitational atoms in this regime. For isolated systems, we derive analytic expressions for the time- and frequency-domain strain from transition and annihilation channels, emphasizing their narrow-band structure. For binaries, we model resonantly driven level transitions using the Landau--Zener formalism and compute the resulting transient signals. We find that, while binary-driven transitions generically yield signals with durations compatible with detector response times, their characteristic strain lies well below the sensitivity of current experiments at astrophysically plausible distances, and event rates further suppress detectability by requiring sources at unrealistically small separations. We quantify the improvements in sensitivity, bandwidth, and response needed to render these signals observable, and identify gravitational-atom systems around primordial black holes as a theoretically well-motivated target for future high-frequency gravitational-wave searches.

classification.title_zh: 超辐射产生的高频引力波暂现信号
classification.abstract_zh: 超轻玻色子可以通过超辐射在旋转黑洞周围形成宏观的引力原子云，并通过能级跃迁和湮灭产生准单色引力波。原初黑洞为这类系统提供了一个自然场景，其频率范围与共振腔实验相关。我们对该区域中孤立和双星扰动引力原子的引力波辐射给出统一处理。对于孤立系统，我们推导了来自跃迁和湮灭通道的时域和频域应变的解析表达式，强调其窄带结构。对于双星系统，我们用 Landau--Zener 形式模拟共振驱动的能级跃迁，并计算由此产生的暂现信号。我们发现，虽然双星驱动的跃迁通常产生持续时间与探测器响应时间相容的信号，但在天体物理上合理的距离处，其特征应变远低于当前实验的灵敏度，而且事件率进一步通过要求源处于不切实际的小间距而抑制可探测性。我们量化了使这些信号可观测所需的灵敏度、带宽和响应方面的改进，并指出原初黑洞周围的引力原子系统是未来高频引力波搜寻的一个理论上动机充分的目标。
classification.one_liner: 研究原初黑洞周围由超辐射形成的引力原子在孤立与双星扰动下产生的高频引力波暂现信号及其可探测性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究黑洞超辐射产生的引力波暂现信号，属于经典引力/广义相对论与引力波物理，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息。

papers.title: Charged anisotropic white dwarfs in $f\left({R}, {T}\right)$ gravity
papers.abstract: In the framework of $f(R, T) = R + 2 \beta T$ gravity, wherein $R$ denotes the Ricci scalar and $T$ represents the trace of the energy-momentum tensor, the equilibrium structure of charged anisotropic white dwarfs is investigated. The stellar equations for the general scenario are derived, and numerical solutions are obtained for the Chandrasekhar equation of state alongside the charge density distribution proportional to the energy density, $\rho_{\mathrm{ch}} = \alpha \rho$. By scrutinizing the properties of the solutions under various parameter combinations, we conducted an exhaustive analysis of the influences of electric charge, modified gravity, and anisotropy on the structural characteristics of white dwarfs. Crucially, white dwarfs can transcend the trivial instances of General Relativity in various ways, thereby demonstrating super-Chandrasekhar phenomena. As an inquiry into the structure of white dwarfs, the findings of this research may contribute to elucidating astronomical observations such as superluminous type Ia supernovae.

classification.title_zh: f(R,T)引力中的带电各向异性白矮星
classification.abstract_zh: 在 f(R,T)=R+2βT 引力框架下，其中 R 为 Ricci 标量，T 为能动量张量的迹，研究了带电各向异性白矮星的平衡结构。推导了一般情形下的恒星结构方程，并针对 Chandrasekhar 状态方程以及电荷密度分布与能量密度成正比 ρ_ch=αρ 的情形获得数值解。通过考察不同参数组合下解的性质，全面分析了电荷、修改引力和各向异性对白矮星结构特征的影响。关键的是，白矮星能够以多种方式超越广义引力的平庸情形，从而展现超 Chandrasekhar 现象。作为对白矮星结构的研究，这些结果可能有助于解释超亮 Ia 型超新星等天文观测。
classification.one_liner: 在 f(R,T) 引力中研究带电各向异性白矮星，发现其可超越广义相对论情形并出现超 Chandrasekhar 现象。

papers.title: Improved Population and EOS Joint Inference for Binary Neutron Star Systems
papers.abstract: The extreme environment within neutron stars presents the opportunity to probe the nuclear equation of state at high densities while studying the properties of these stellar remnants. Historically, the equation of state and neutron star mass distribution have been inferred separately, with the latter often simply assumed to be fixed in studies of the former, but the dependence of the equation of state on neutron star mass indicates they should be inferred together. In this work, we extend the generalized version of the popular RIFT algorithm known as Hyperpipe to interface with flexible, user-provided priors that will facilitate joint inference of equation of state and binary neutron star population hyperparameters. We demonstrate this framework's utility via application to a combination of several existing observations, particularly including massive galactic pulsars, double neutron star systems, millisecond X-ray pulsars, the gravitational wave event GW170817 and the nuclear symmetry energy, within the context of a widely-adopted parametric EOS family and a simple Gaussian population model. We recover parameters consistent with previous analyses of the EOS and binary neutron star population, finding the latter to fit a bivariate normal distribution with mean $(\mu_1,\mu_2) = (1.39,1.27) M_{\odot}$ and width $\sigma = 0.08 M_{\odot}$. Furthermore, we implement novel coordinate transformations in our pipeline, with which we have discovered that the ad hoc prior boundaries used for this EOS family may be too restrictive. We present results with relaxed yet still physical prior boundaries, noting vastly improved hyperparameter posteriors and modestly different equation of state inferences.

classification.title_zh: 双中子星系统的改进族群与状态方程联合推断
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星内部的极端环境为在高密度下探测核状态方程，同时研究这些恒星遗迹的性质提供了机会。历史上，状态方程与中子星质量分布通常被分别推断，后者在状态方程研究中常被简单固定，但状态方程对中子星质量的依赖表明二者应联合推断。在本工作中，我们将流行 RIFT 算法的广义版本 Hyperpipe 扩展为可与灵活的、用户提供的先验接口，以促进状态方程与双中子星族群超参数的联合推断。我们通过将该框架应用于若干现有观测的组合来展示其效用，特别包括大质量银河系脉冲星、双中子星系统、毫秒 X 射线脉冲星、引力波事件 GW170817 以及核对称能，并在广泛采用的参数化 EOS 族和简单高斯族群模型背景下进行。我们复原的参数与先前对 EOS 和双中子星族群的推断一致，后者符合均值 (μ1, μ2) = (1.39, 1.27) M☉、宽度 σ = 0.08 M☉ 的二元正态分布。此外，我们在流程中实现了新的坐标变换，并据此发现该 EOS 族所用的事先设定的先验边界可能过于严格。我们给出了使用放宽但仍具物理性的先验边界的结果，并注意到超参数后验显著改善，而状态方程推断有适度差异。
classification.one_liner: 扩展 Hyperpipe 以联合推断中子星状态方程与双中子星族群超参数，并发现常用 EOS 先验边界可能过窄。

papers.title: Relativistic Spherical Accretion in Nonrotating Black Hole Spacetimes: Astrophysical Implications
papers.abstract: We present a systematic analysis of spherically symmetric accretion flows onto thirteen non-rotating black hole spacetimes, including charged and regular black holes, scalar and dilaton fields, dark energy, cosmological constants, modified gravity, and parametrized metrics. We generalize the Michel solution to arbitrary diagonal spacetimes and investigate the density, temperature, velocity, Mach number, mass accretion rate, and bremsstrahlung luminosity equilibrium profiles. Using the Schwarzschild solution as a reference, we find significant deviations in the accretion flow, with cosmological-constant and dark-energy models strongly suppressing accretion, while regular and Yukawa-like spacetimes generally enhance it. We provide fitting formulas for the accretion rates and luminosities as functions of the spacetime parameters. We then explore two astrophysical applications: accretion onto supermassive black holes, such as Sgr A* and M87*, and the inferred progenitor masses of the intermediate-mass black holes associated with the GW190521 gravitational wave event. We find that observational uncertainties may allow us to probe signatures of deviations from the Schwarzschild spacetime.

classification.title_zh: 非旋转黑洞时空中的相对论球对称吸积：天体物理启示
classification.abstract_zh: 我们系统分析了十三种非旋转黑洞时空上的球对称吸积流，包括带电黑洞和正规黑洞、标量场和膨胀子场、暗能量、宇宙学常数、修改引力以及参数化度规。我们将 Michel 解推广到任意对角时空，并研究了密度、温度、速度、马赫数、质量吸积率和轫致辐射光度的平衡剖面。以 Schwarzschild 解为参照，我们发现吸积流存在显著偏离：宇宙学常数和暗能量模型强烈抑制吸积，而正规黑洞和类 Yukawa 时空通常增强吸积。我们给出了吸积率和光度作为时空参数函数的拟合公式。随后我们探讨了两个天体物理应用：超大质量黑洞（如 Sgr A* 和 M87*）上的吸积，以及与 GW190521 引力波事件相关的中等质量黑洞的推断前身质量。我们发现，观测不确定性可能允许我们探测偏离 Schwarzschild 时空的特征。
classification.one_liner: 将 Michel 球对称吸积解推广到十三类非旋转黑洞时空，并评估其对吸积率、光度及天体物理观测的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典黑洞时空中的相对论球对称吸积及天体物理应用，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT、量子引力或全息对偶。

papers.title: AdS - de Sitter transition in interacting dark energy models
papers.abstract: Recent cosmological results, including the persistent $H_0$ tension and indications of dynamical dark energy, have raised the possibility that the standard $\Lambda$-Cold Dark Matter ($\Lambda$CDM) model may be incomplete. At the same time, theoretical developments based on swampland conjectures indicate that the realization of a stable de Sitter vacuum within string theory is challenging. Motivated by these observational and theoretical considerations, we investigate an interacting $\Lambda$ scenario characterized by a general linear coupling in the dark sector. At the background level, this model naturally allows the dark energy density to evolve from negative to positive values, opening the possibility of a transition from an anti-de Sitter-like phase to the de Sitter-like phase inferred by current observations. We derive the analytic background solutions and perturbation equations, discuss the physically acceptable region of parameter space, and constrain the model with DES-Dovekie type Ia supernovae, DESI BAO and CMB data. Our analysis suggests a parameter space allowing the dark energy density to change sign while maintaining positive dark matter density, motivating further investigation of an interaction-driven anti-de Sitter to de Sitter transition.

classification.title_zh: 相互作用暗能量模型中的 AdS-de Sitter 转变
classification.abstract_zh: 近期宇宙学结果，包括持续存在的 H0 张力以及动力学暗能量的迹象，提出了标准 Λ-冷暗物质（ΛCDM）模型可能不完整的可能性。与此同时，基于沼泽地猜想的理论发展表明，在弦理论中实现稳定的 de Sitter 真空具有挑战性。受这些观测和理论考虑启发，我们研究了一种相互作用 Λ 情景，其特征是暗扇区具有一般线性耦合。在背景层面，该模型自然允许暗能量密度从负值演化到正值，从而开启从类反 de Sitter 相到当前观测所推断的类 de Sitter 相转变的可能性。我们推导了解析背景解和微扰方程，讨论了参数空间中物理可接受的区域，并用 DES-Dovekie 型 Ia 超新星、DESI BAO 和 CMB 数据约束该模型。我们的分析表明，存在允许暗能量密度改变符号同时保持正暗物质密度的参数空间，这促使进一步研究相互作用驱动的反 de Sitter 到 de Sitter 转变。
classification.one_liner: 研究相互作用暗能量模型，使暗能量密度由负变正，实现类 AdS 到类 dS 的宇宙学转变，并用超新星、BAO 和 CMB 数据约束。

papers.title: Fisher and DALI posterior approximations for testing gravity with gravitational waves
papers.abstract: We investigate the accuracy and computational efficiency of posterior approximations for gravitational-wave (GW) parameter estimation based on Fisher Matrix and its higher-order extension, the Derivative Approximation for LIkelihoods (DALI), in the context of tests of General Relativity using parameterized deviations in the inspiral waveforms (the TIGER formalism). We adopt the \texttt{IMRPhenomD} waveform and compare the exact posterior sampling to the following approximations in increasing order of complexity: the traditional Fisher Matrix, the Fisher sampling (singlet-DALI), the doublet-DALI and the triplet-DALI. We find that both singlet and doublet-DALI are significantly faster than the exact posterior by factors between 20 and 1000, depending on the inspiral SNRs -- larger gains correspond to larger SNRs. These gains are considerably larger for more complete waveforms, such as \texttt{IMRPhenomHM}. To evaluate the accuracy of the approximations, we use Jensen-Shannon divergence. We conclude that both singlet and doublet-DALI systematically improves over the standard Fisher Matrix approximation, while triplet-DALI shows large variability, limiting its practical advantage. We also introduce a code with a new implementation of Fisher and DALI analysis (Symbolic DALI, \texttt{SymDALI}) which computes derivatives symbolically via \textit{Wolfram Language}.

classification.title_zh: 利用引力波检验引力的 Fisher 与 DALI 后验近似
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在利用 inspiral 波形中的参数化偏离（TIGER 形式）检验广义相对论时，基于 Fisher 矩阵及其高阶扩展 DALI（Derivative Approximation for LIkelihoods）的后验近似在引力波参数估计中的精度与计算效率。我们采用 IMRPhenomD 波形，并将精确后验采样与按复杂度递增的以下近似进行比较：传统 Fisher 矩阵、Fisher 采样（singlet-DALI）、doublet-DALI 和 triplet-DALI。我们发现 singlet-DALI 和 doublet-DALI 都比精确后验显著更快，加速因子在 20 到 1000 之间，取决于 inspiral 信噪比——信噪比越大增益越大。对于更完整的波形（如 IMRPhenomHM），这些增益更大。为评估近似精度，我们使用 Jensen-Shannon 散度。我们得出结论：singlet-DALI 和 doublet-DALI 都系统性地优于标准 Fisher 矩阵近似，而 triplet-DALI 表现出较大波动，限制了其实际优势。我们还发布了一个包含 Fisher 和 DALI 分析新实现的代码（Symbolic DALI, SymDALI），它通过 Wolfram Language 符号计算导数。
classification.one_liner: 比较 Fisher 矩阵与 DALI 高阶后验近似在引力波参数估计和广义相对论检验中的精度与效率，并发布符号计算代码 SymDALI。

papers.title: On Gauge Gravity's 'Hypermomentum Challenge' to the Geometric Trinity
papers.abstract: Claims concerning a dynamical equivalence between general relativity and two reformulations of it, in which gravity is encoded in torsion and non-metricity respectively, have attracted some attention. If taken to be true, this 'Geometric Trinity' suggests that it is impossible to determine, even in principle, whether one inhabits a spacetime solution possessing curvature, torsion or non-metricity (insofar as the probes of geometry are paths of test particles). This claim is in direct tension with the long tradition of studying gravity as a gauge theory, in which distinct geometric attributes couple to distinct properties of matter (such as energy-momentum to curvature and spin angular momentum to torsion). In this short paper, I compare these two conflicting frameworks for geometrizing spacetime and describe the precise source, nature and implications of their disagreement. The equivalence claim holds only under a substantive restriction on the matter sector, namely that matter does not couple to an independent affine connection. Because the relevant couplings remain beyond current empirical reach, the choice between the frameworks turns on a trade-off among ontological, epistemic, and methodological forms of parsimony.

classification.title_zh: 论规范引力对“几何三位一体”的“超动量挑战”
classification.abstract_zh: 关于广义相对论与其两种重新表述（分别将引力编码在挠率和非度规性中）之间存在动力学等价性的主张已引起一些关注。若该主张成立，这一“几何三位一体”意味着，即使在原则上也无法确定一个人所处的时空解究竟具有曲率、挠率还是非度规性（就几何的探针是测试粒子路径而言）。该主张与将引力视为规范理论的悠久传统直接冲突，后者中不同的几何属性耦合到物质的不同属性（例如能动张量耦合到曲率，自旋角动量耦合到挠率）。在这篇短文中，我比较这两种相互冲突的时空几何化框架，并描述其分歧的确切来源、性质与含义。等价性主张仅在物质部分受到实质性限制时才成立，即物质不耦合到独立的仿射联络。由于相关耦合仍超出当前经验范围，两种框架之间的选择取决于本体论、认识论和方法论简约性之间的权衡。
classification.one_liner: 本文辨析广义相对论与挠率/非度规表述的“几何三位一体”等价性主张，指出其依赖物质不耦合独立仿射联络的限制，并与规范引力中不同几何属性耦合不同物质属性的图景冲突。

papers.title: Flat limit of artificial cosmology for scalar waves in Schwarzschild-de Sitter
papers.abstract: How do cosmological waveforms approximate waveforms from isolated systems for a small cosmological constant? This question is motivated by the observed small value of the cosmological constant, and also by Misner's idea to regulate the formally singular terms introduced into the Einstein equations by conformal compactification. We investigate this question quantitatively using scalar waves on Schwarzschild--de Sitter backgrounds. A suitable flat limit requires the foliation to remain regular at the future conformal boundary. We compare bridge foliations extending from the black hole horizon to the cosmological horizon with a regular asymptotically flat limit. Comparisons of cosmological and asymptotically flat waveforms on geometrically matched data show that the flat limit is numerically well behaved and recovers the essential features of the asymptotically flat waveform. We extend Misner's artificial cosmology by introducing a cosmological source that leaves the near-zone geometry unchanged and show that it improves agreement of the ringdown waveform but fails to capture the intermediate polynomial tail behavior accurately.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild-de Sitter 中标量波人工宇宙学的平直极限
classification.abstract_zh: 当宇宙学常数很小时，宇宙学波形如何近似孤立系统的波形？这个问题由观测到的很小的宇宙学常数，以及 Misner 通过共形紧致化调节爱因斯坦方程中形式上奇异项的思想所驱动。我们使用 Schwarzschild--de Sitter 背景上的标量波定量研究这个问题。一个合适的平直极限要求叶状结构在未来共形边界处保持正则。我们将从黑洞视界延伸到宇宙学视界的桥式叶状结构与一个正则的渐近平直极限进行比较。在几何匹配的数据上比较宇宙学与渐近平直波形表明，平直极限在数值上表现良好，并恢复了渐近平直波形的基本特征。我们通过引入一个不改变近区几何的宇宙学源来扩展 Misner 的人工宇宙学，并表明它改善了 ringdown 波形的一致性，但未能准确捕捉中间的多项式尾行为。
classification.one_liner: 在 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 上定量检验标量波宇宙学波形的小宇宙学常数平直极限，并扩展 Misner 人工宇宙学。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究经典引力中的 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 标量波、平直极限与 ringdown/尾行为，匹配经典引力/广义相对论及 QNM 相关重点支线；不涉及全息。

papers.title: Testing charged bumblebee black holes through high-frequency quasi-periodic oscillations in X-ray binaries
papers.abstract: We investigate strong-field orbital dynamics for static spherically symmetric charged bumblebee black holes featuring spontaneous Lorentz-violating effects. Analysis of null and timelike circular geodesics yields the photon-sphere radius, the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) radius, and characteristic orbital frequencies for test particles. Within the relativistic precession model for high-frequency quasi-periodic oscillations (HFQPOs), observed twin-peak frequencies are governed by the full set of fundamental parameters $M$, $X=r/M$, $l_1$, $l_2$, and $Q_0/M$. Among them, $l_1$, $l_2$, and $Q_0/M$ enter frequency expressions only in combined forms, giving rise to intrinsic parameter degeneracy. An effective-parameter set $\Theta=(M,X,C,\beta)$ is accordingly introduced to characterize these composite contributions. Bayesian MCMC parameter inference is carried out using HFQPO observational data from three black-hole X-ray binaries: GRO J1655--40, XTE J1550--564, and GRS 1915+105. The 68\% credible intervals of composite parameter $C$ all contain the Reissner--Nordstr\"om limit $C=1$, revealing no statistically significant net Lorentz-violating correction under our model assumptions. Distinct triples $(l_1,l_2,Q_0/M)$ yield identical QPO predictions, so HFQPO observations alone cannot disentangle Lorentz-violating and charge-related effects; precise constraints on these fundamental quantities require additional, more precise observational data.

classification.title_zh: 通过 X 射线双星中的高频准周期振荡检验带电 bumblebee 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有自发洛伦兹破缺效应的静态球对称带电 bumblebee 黑洞的强场轨道动力学。对零测地线和类时圆轨道的分析给出了光子球半径、最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）半径以及试验粒子的特征轨道频率。在高频准周期振荡（HFQPOs）的相对论进动模型中，观测到的双峰频率由全部基本参数 M、X=r/M、l1、l2 和 Q0/M 决定。其中 l1、l2 和 Q0/M 仅以组合形式进入频率表达式，导致内禀参数简并。因此引入有效参数集 Θ=(M,X,C,β) 来刻画这些组合贡献。我们使用三个黑洞 X 射线双星 GRO J1655--40、XTE J1550--564 和 GRS 1915+105 的 HFQPO 观测数据进行贝叶斯 MCMC 参数推断。复合参数 C 的 68% 可信区间均包含 Reissner--Nordström 极限 C=1，表明在我们模型假设下没有统计显著的净洛伦兹破缺修正。不同的三元组 (l1,l2,Q0/M) 给出相同的 QPO 预言，因此仅凭 HFQPO 观测无法区分洛伦兹破缺效应与电荷相关效应；对这些基本量的精确限制需要额外、更精确的观测数据。
classification.one_liner: 在带电 bumblebee 黑洞时空中计算强场轨道频率，并用 X 射线双星 HFQPO 数据做贝叶斯限制，未发现显著洛伦兹破缺修正。

papers.title: Spherical thin shells with charge in unimodular gravity
papers.abstract: We construct spherically symmetric thin shells in unimodular gravity (UG) and analyze their dynamical stability under radial, symmetry-preserving perturbations. We use the UG junction conditions and adopt non-conservative charged exterior solutions sourced by a radial electric field. As an application, we build charged vacuum bubbles: a Minkowski interior surrounded by a charged thin shell and matched to an exterior UG geometry. The resulting spacetimes are free of event horizons and central singularities, while in de Sitter-like cases a cosmological horizon may exist outside the shell. We compare the stability regions and the matter content with their counterparts in general relativity, finding some differences controlled by the UG non-conservation parameter. This work extends previously published results.

classification.title_zh: 幺模引力中带电荷的球对称薄壳
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在幺模引力（UG）中构造球对称薄壳，并在径向、保持对称性的微扰下分析其动力学稳定性。我们使用 UG 连接条件，并采用由径向电场源产生的非守恒带电外部解。作为一个应用，我们构建带电真空泡：内部为 Minkowski 时空，外部由带电薄壳包围并匹配到 UG 外部几何。所得时空无事件视界和中心奇点，而在类 de Sitter 情形中壳外可能存在宇宙学视界。我们将稳定性区域和物质内容与广义相对论中的对应结果进行比较，发现一些由 UG 非守恒参数控制的差异。本工作扩展了此前发表的结果。
classification.one_liner: 在幺模引力中构造带电球对称薄壳与真空泡，分析其径向稳定性并与广义相对论比较。

papers.title: MADGRAV: a multilevel anomaly-detection pipeline for gravitational-wave searches applied to LIGO data
papers.abstract: We present the results of \textbf{MADGRAV}, a deep-learning-based search for high-mass compact binary coalescences, applied to the data collected by the LIGO interferometers during the third observing run and during the first and second part of the fourth observing run. The \textbf{MADGRAV} pipeline consists of a series of sequential convolutional neural networks that perform anomaly detection, glitch classification, coherence testing, and signal ranking. Data from the Hanford and Livingston LIGO detectors are studied (both individually and in coherence) by way of 1 second Q-transform windows. Of the candidates that survive every stage of the pipeline, 48 reach the significance threshold, and we report 47 gravitational wave detections characterised by a false alarm rate below $1\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$ with a probability of astrophysical origin $p_{\rm astro}>0.9$. Of the 47 detections, 44 are shared with the minimally modelled coherent WaveBurst search. The observed total source-frame masses, extracted from official gravitational wave transient catalogues, are in the $14-236 M_{\odot}$ range with a median of $69 M_{\odot}$, and a median SNR of 16. We note that the recovered fraction of confident detections rises with mass: for LIGO detectors network SNR $>10$ the pipeline recovers $8.1\%$ of confident catalog events below $30 M_{\odot}$, $39.8\%$ between $30$ and $100 M_{\odot}$, and $53.3\%$ above $100 M_{\odot}$, corresponding to $33.3\%$, $45.5\%$ and $53.3\%$ of the events detected by coherent WaveBurst in the same bins. These results suggest that anomaly detection pipelines can serve as an independent detection channel complementary to matched filtering in the high-mass high-SNR regime.

classification.title_zh: MADGRAV：应用于 LIGO 数据的引力波搜索多级异常检测流程
classification.abstract_zh: 我们展示了 MADGRAV 的结果，这是一个基于深度学习的高质量致密双星并合搜索，应用于 LIGO 干涉仪在第三次观测运行以及第四次观测运行第一、第二部分收集的数据。MADGRAV 流程由一系列顺序卷积神经网络组成，执行异常检测、毛刺分类、相干性检验和信号排序。我们通过 1 秒 Q 变换窗口研究 Hanford 和 Livingston LIGO 探测器的数据（分别以及相干）。在通过流程每一阶段的候选者中，48 个达到显著性阈值，我们报告了 47 个引力波探测，其虚警率低于 1 yr^-1，天体物理来源概率 p_astro>0.9。47 个探测中有 44 个与最小模型化相干 WaveBurst 搜索共享。从官方引力波瞬变目录提取的观测总源帧质量范围为 14–236 M_sun，中位数为 69 M_sun，中位信噪比为 16。我们注意到，回收的置信探测比例随质量上升：对于 LIGO 探测器网络 SNR>10，该流程回收 30 M_sun 以下置信目录事件的 8.1%，30–100 M_sun 之间的 39.8%，100 M_sun 以上的 53.3%，分别对应相干 WaveBurst 在同一区间探测事件的 33.3%、45.5% 和 53.3%。这些结果表明，异常检测流程可以作为独立探测通道，在高质量高信噪比区域补充匹配滤波。
classification.one_liner: MADGRAV 深度学习异常检测流程在 LIGO O3/O4 数据中报告 47 个高置信引力波探测，并显示在高质量区可作为匹配滤波的补充通道。

papers.title: Black Holes With Complete Asymptotic Throats
papers.abstract: We investigate whether a spherically symmetric black hole can have a complete inner end at finite, nonzero areal radius while satisfying the standard energy conditions sufficiently far outside its horizon. Retaining two independent metric functions, we treat both null-type and spacelike-type asymptotic throats and derive a necessary and sufficient integral criterion for causal geodesic completeness. Under boundedness and finite-limit assumptions on the independent curvature components, null-type ends have limiting curvature fixed by the throat radius, whereas spacelike-type ends admit an additional nonnegative curvature parameter. We obtain criteria for bounded curvature in timelike and null parallel-propagated frames. Complete spacelike-type examples can have bounded scalar invariants and bounded timelike-frame curvature but unbounded null-frame curvature at infinite affine parameter. We also prove that the radial null energy condition must fail arbitrarily close to every complete inner end in the stated class. Nevertheless, explicit real-analytic constructions with either type of throat satisfy the null, weak, dominant, and strong energy conditions throughout a sufficiently distant exterior region. Smooth constructions can become exactly Schwarzschild beyond a finite radius. These results establish the compatibility of complete asymptotic throats with exterior energy conditions while distinguishing completeness from different levels of curvature regularity.

classification.title_zh: 具有完备渐近喉的黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个球对称黑洞能否在有限非零面积半径处具有完备内端，同时在其视界外足够远处满足标准能量条件。保留两个独立的度规函数，我们处理零类（null-type）和类空型（spacelike-type）渐近喉，并推导因果测地线完备性的一个必要且充分积分判据。在对独立曲率分量有有界性和有限极限假设下，零类型端点的极限曲率由喉半径固定，而类空类型端点允许一个额外的非负曲率参数。我们得到了在类时和零类平行传播标架中曲率有界的判据。完备的类空类型例子可以有有界标量不变量和有界类时标架曲率，但在无限仿射参数处零标架曲率无界。我们还证明，在所陈述类别中，径向零能量条件必须在每个完备内端任意近处失效。然而，具有任一种喉的显式实解析构造在足够远的外部区域处处满足零、弱、主和强能量条件。光滑构造可以在有限半径之外变成精确的 Schwarzschild。这些结果确立了完备渐近喉与外部能量条件的相容性，同时区分完备性与不同层次的曲率正则性。
classification.one_liner: 该文证明球对称黑洞可在视界外满足标准能量条件的同时拥有完备渐近内喉，给出测地线完备性判据，并指出径向零能量条件在完备内端附近必被违反。

papers.title: Primordial Tensor Signatures and Gravitational Wave Constraints in Lorentz Violating Inflation with Non-Canonical Kinetics
papers.abstract: We investigate primordial tensor perturbations in a Lorentz violating inflationary framework with non-canonical scalar field dynamics. Using an Einstein-\AE{}ther type with a higher order kinetic term $K_3X^2$, we derive the tensor propagation speed and its dependence on an effective Lorentz violating coupling. We consider an analytically tractable potential free background and study two representative couplings, $q_k=\lambda_T\phi_k^2$ and $q_k=\lambda_T\phi_k^4$. The resulting tensor spectral index $n_T$ and its running $\alpha_T$ satisfy distinct consistency relations, providing potential signatures of Lorentz violation in the primordial gravitational wave spectrum. We derive corresponding constraints from the tensor tilt and running and compare them with the stringent late-time bound on the gravitational wave speed from GW170817/GRB170817A. We emphasize that translating this bound into primordial constraint requires an assumption about the evolution of tensor sector coupling between inflation and the late Universe. Our results demonstrate that primordial tensor observables can provide a complementary probe of Lorentz violation and its interplay with non-canonical inflationary dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 洛伦兹破坏暴胀中非正则动能的原初张量特征与引力波约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究洛伦兹破坏暴胀框架中带非正则标量场动力学的原初张量扰动。采用含高阶动能项 K3X^2 的爱因斯坦-以太型理论，导出张量传播速度及其对有效洛伦兹破坏耦合的依赖。我们考虑一个可解析处理的无势背景，并研究两种代表性耦合 q_k=λ_T φ_k^2 和 q_k=λ_T φ_k^4。所得张量谱指数 n_T 及其跑动 α_T 满足不同的一致性关系，为原初引力波谱中的洛伦兹破坏提供潜在特征。我们导出张量倾斜和跑动对应的约束，并将其与 GW170817/GRB170817A 给出的晚期引力波速度严格限制比较。我们强调，将该限制转化为原初约束需要对张量扇区耦合从暴胀到晚期宇宙的演化作出假设。结果表明，原初张量观测量可为洛伦兹破坏及其与非正则暴胀动力学的相互作用提供互补探针。
classification.one_liner: 在含非正则动能和爱因斯坦-以太型洛伦兹破坏的暴胀模型中，导出张量传播速度、谱指数与跑动的一致性关系，并讨论原初引力波约束及 GW170817 限制。

papers.title: Towards solving General Relativity with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are a machine-learning framework for approximating solutions to systems of partial differential equations by constraining neural networks to satisfy the underlying physical laws. The resulting continuous representation does not require a predefined computational mesh and can be evaluated at arbitrary points within the training domain. In this work, we investigate the application of PINNs to Einstein's equations of General Relativity. We discuss the mathematical formulation, network architectures, loss functions, and training strategies used to obtain accurate spacetime solutions, and demonstrate the approach through a series of standard benchmarks from Numerical Relativity. We then extend the method to a more astrophysical setting by considering the dynamical evolution of an isolated solitonic boson star. Our simulations show that a PINN operating directly in three-dimensional Cartesian coordinates can reproduce the equilibrium structure of a highly compact boson star and recover its characteristic radial oscillation frequencies. These results establish PINNs as a viable complementary framework for solving coupled matter-Einstein equations and exploring alternative formulations in numerical relativity.

classification.title_zh: 迈向利用物理信息神经网络求解广义相对论
classification.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）是一种机器学习框架，通过约束神经网络满足底层物理定律来近似偏微分方程组的解。由此得到的连续表示不需要预定义的计算网格，并可在训练域内任意点求值。在本工作中，我们研究将 PINNs 应用于广义相对论的 Einstein 方程。我们讨论用于获得精确时空解的数学表述、网络架构、损失函数和训练策略，并通过数值相对论中的一系列标准基准展示该方法。随后，我们将该方法扩展到更具天体物理背景的情形，考虑一个孤立孤子玻色星的动力学演化。我们的模拟表明，直接在三维笛卡尔坐标中运行的 PINN 可以重现高度致密玻色星的平衡结构，并恢复其标志性的径向振荡频率。这些结果确立了 PINNs 作为求解耦合物质-Einstein 方程以及探索数值相对论中替代表述的可行补充框架。
classification.one_liner: 将物理信息神经网络用于求解 Einstein 方程，并在数值相对论基准与孤子玻色星动力学中验证其可行性。

papers.title: A Strong Cosmologically Coupled Mass Growth Solution in Linearized General Relativity
papers.abstract: DESI Data Release 2 has heightened interest in cosmologically coupled black holes (CCBHs) as an explanation for accelerating late-time expansion, but known models for CCBHs grow too slowly to drive it. We construct at linear order a solution to General Relativity whose Hernandez-Misner-Sharp mass passively grows $\propto a^\kappa$ as the universe expands. The constant $\kappa$ enters all eigenvalues of the Weyl and stress-tensor operators, so growth is unambiguously physical in both free-field and material sectors. The solution is causal over spacetime relevant for stellar collapse compact objects. A cloud of energized vacuum emerges at $\kappa = 3$, complementing the $a^3$ scaling predicted elsewhere for the masses of energized vacuum black holes. This first step toward $\kappa \sim 3$ CCBH exact solutions enables observational tests with pulsar binaries.

classification.title_zh: 线性化广义相对论中一个强宇宙学耦合质量增长解
classification.abstract_zh: DESI Data Release 2 提高了对宇宙学耦合黑洞（CCBHs）作为加速晚期膨胀解释的兴趣，但已知的 CCBH 模型增长太慢，无法驱动该膨胀。我们在线性阶构造了一个广义相对论解，其 Hernandez-Misner-Sharp 质量随宇宙膨胀被动增长 ∝ a^κ。常数 κ 进入 Weyl 算符和应力-张量算符的所有本征值，因此这种增长在自由场和物质扇区中都是明确物理的。该解在恒星坍缩致密天体相关时空范围内是因果的。在 κ = 3 时出现一团被激发的真空云，补充了在其他地方为被激发真空黑洞质量预测的 a^3 标度。这是迈向 κ ∼ 3 的 CCBH 精确解的第一步，使得能够用脉冲星双星进行观测检验。
classification.one_liner: 在线性化广义相对论中构造了一个 Hernandez-Misner-Sharp 质量随尺度因子 ∝ a^κ 增长的宇宙学耦合黑洞解，为 κ∼3 情形和脉冲星双星观测检验铺路。

papers.title: Traversable Wormholes Supported by Conformally Coupled Scalar Fields in $D \geq 4$: Geometry, Geodesics, and Quasinormal Modes
papers.abstract: In this work, we analyze a two-parameter $(\mu, b)$ asymmetric family of traversable wormhole solutions generated by a massless conformally coupled scalar field. We show that, for a suitable range of parameters, the spacetime is everywhere regular and has two asymptotically flat regions. We then define the wormhole throat and verify the flare-out condition, which leads to violations of the classical energy conditions in GR, thereby requiring exotic matter to hold the throat open. We further analyze the motion of photons governed by null geodesics through an effective potential. The resulting trajectories are computed numerically and visualized using embedding diagrams. Following this route, we investigate scalar perturbations governed by the massless Klein-Gordon equation and find the QNM spectrum semianalytically and numerically. Interestingly enough, we show that such perturbations are governed by only one parameter $\mu$. Therefore, in $D = 4$, we find an isospectrality between the wormhole and the BBMB/Extremal Reissner-Nordstr\"om black hole. In the spirit of the seminal work of Morris and Thorne, we derive the conditions for traversability and compute the proper time for a traveler to traverse the wormhole. Finally, we discuss possible extensions and future directions for our work.

classification.title_zh: D≥4 中由共形耦合标量场支撑的可穿越虫洞：几何、测地线与准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 本文分析由无质量共形耦合标量场生成的一类双参数 (μ,b) 非对称可穿越虫洞解。我们表明在适当参数范围内，该时空处处正则并具有两个渐近平直区域。随后定义虫洞喉部并验证 flare-out 条件，这导致广义相对论中经典能量条件被违反，因此需要奇异物质来维持喉部张开。我们通过有效势分析由零测地线支配的光子运动，数值计算轨迹并用嵌入图可视化。沿此路线，研究由无质量 Klein-Gordon 方程支配的标量扰动，并半解析和数值地求出 QNM 谱。有趣的是，这些扰动仅由一个参数 μ 支配，因此在 D=4 中发现虫洞与 BBMB/极端 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞之间的等谱性。本着 Morris 和 Thorne 开创性工作的精神，我们推导可穿越性条件并计算旅行者穿越虫洞的固有时。最后讨论可能的扩展和未来方向。
classification.one_liner: 分析D≥4中双参数共形耦合标量场可穿越虫洞的几何、光子测地线、标量准正规模、等谱性与可穿越条件。

papers.title: Conserved charges and the first law of black holes for field dependent symmetry generators in the covariant phase space formalism
papers.abstract: In this paper, we generalize the covariant phase space formalism conjugate to field dependent vectors to include internal gauge transformations when gauge fields are present. In our formalism, the symmetry generators are combination of diffeomorphisms plus internal gauge transformations and depend on the field configuration. When the field dependence of the symmetry generators is considered in the covariant phase space formalism, the first law of black hole thermodynamics is a direct result for generally invariant gravitational theories. To check the validity of our formalism, we investigate the conserved charges and the first laws of thermodynamics for a torus-like black hole in Einstein-Maxwell theory and a charged Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg AdS black hole in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg nonlinear electrodynamics.

classification.title_zh: 协变相空间形式中依赖于场的对称生成元的守恒荷与黑洞第一定律
classification.abstract_zh: 本文将协变相空间形式推广到与依赖于场的向量共轭的情形，并在存在规范场时纳入内禀规范变换。在此形式中，对称生成元是微分同胚与内禀规范变换的组合，并依赖于场构型。当在协变相空间形式中考虑对称生成元的场依赖性时，对于一般不变引力理论，黑洞热力学第一定律是直接结果。为检验该形式，我们研究了 Einstein-Maxwell 理论中环面状黑洞以及 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg 非线性电动力学中带电 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg AdS 黑洞的守恒荷与热力学第一定律。

papers.title: Accretion and Neutrino-Motivated Thermal Diagnostics of Thermodynamically Reconstructed Black Holes from Three-Parameter Generalized Entropy
papers.abstract: We study accretion and thermal diagnostics motivated by neutrino processes for a static black hole reconstructed from a three-parameter generalized entropy. The construction is thermodynamic by design: the entropy deformation is not mapped to a radial-coordinate redefinition or to a prescribed Reissner--Nordstr\"om-like correction. Instead, the generalized entropy fixes the horizon response factor $\Xi_h=dS_G/dS|_{S_h}$. The effective exterior geometry is then reconstructed by requiring its surface-gravity temperature to reproduce the generalized thermodynamic temperature. As a result, the metric preserves the horizon area and the Schwarzschild asymptotics, and reduces smoothly to Schwarzschild when $\Xi_h\to1$. The entropy response is encoded in $\lambda_G=1/\Xi_{\rm h}-1$, whereas the exterior radial dependence requires an additional localization prescription. The detailed accretion analysis is performed for the power-law family $h(x)=x^{-p}$, with $p\geq2$. Within this reconstruction family, positive $\lambda_G$ moves the photon sphere and ISCO inward, decreases the critical shadow scale, raises the radiative efficiency, and concentrates the energy release toward the inner disk, while negative $\lambda_G$ produces the opposite trend. A complementary comparison with exponential and rational localization functions shows that this qualitative ordering is preserved for the profiles tested, although the magnitude of the strong-field shifts remains profile-dependent. classification.title_zh: 基于三参数广义熵热力学重构黑洞的吸积与中微子启发的热诊断
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由三参数广义熵重构的静态黑洞的吸积与中微子过程启发的热诊断。该构造在本质上是热力学的：熵变形并未映射为径向坐标重定义，也未映射为预先给定的类 Reissner-Nordström 修正。相反，广义熵固定了视界响应因子 $\Xi_h=dS_G/dS|_{S_h}$。随后通过要求其表面引力温度重现广义热力学温度来重构有效外部几何。因此，度规保持视界面积和 Schwarzschild 渐近行为，并在 $\Xi_h\to1$ 时平滑退化为 Schwarzschild。熵响应被编码在 $\lambda_G=1/\Xi_{\rm h}-1$ 中，而外部径向依赖还需要额外的局域化方案。详细吸积分析针对幂律族 $h(x)=x^{-p}$，$p\geq2$ 进行。在该重构族内，正的 $\lambda_G$ 使光子球和 ISCO 向内移动，减小临界阴影尺度，提高辐射效率，并将能量释放集中到内盘；而负的 $\lambda_G$ 产生相反趋势。与指数型和有理型局域化函数的补充比较表明，对所测试的剖面，这种定性排序得以保持，尽管强场移动的幅度仍依赖于剖面。最后，中微子启发的热部分……

papers.title: Holographic Dark Energy with Hubble Radius as an Infrared Cutoff in Einstein-Cartan Gravity
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate non-interacting holographic dark energy (HDE) with the Hubble radius as the infrared cutoff in Einstein-Cartan gravity. We derive the Einstein-Cartan equations from the action principle and obtain Friedmann-like equations by introducing a torsion scalar. Considering a Weyssenhoff spin fluid, we determine the scaling behavior of the torsion scalar as $\Phi \sim a^{-3}$ without introducing an ad hoc ansatz, resolving the ansatz problem of previous torsion scalar scenarios. In the absence of interactions between dark matter and dark energy, the torsion scalar shifts the equation of state for holographic dark energy toward negative values from the dust-like value obtained in HDE without torsion, making cosmic acceleration possible. In particular, the resulting equation of state can approach $\omega_X \simeq -1$ and cross the phantom divide within the weak torsion regime $|\Phi/H| < 1$. The model predicts a dynamical equation of state in which cosmic acceleration gradually weakens, potentially consistent with recent DESI observations. In spacetimes with torsion, the cosmic distance duality relation between the luminosity distance $d_L$ and the angular diameter distance $d_A$ is modified as $d_L = d_A (1+z)^2 (1+\eta)$. In the presence of the torsion scalar, we show that the standard relation between redshift and the scale factor is preserved, while the deviation parameter arising from torsion effects is determined as $\eta \sim \int_{t_S}^{t_O} dt a^{-3}$, where $t_S$ and $t_O$ denote the emission time at the source and the observation time at the observer, respectively. Overall, our results support the feasibility of the model and provide a theoretical framework for preparing likelihood analyses.

classification.title_zh: 以哈勃半径为红外截断的 Einstein-Cartan 引力中的全息暗能量
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了 Einstein-Cartan 引力中，以哈勃半径为红外截断的非相互作用全息暗能量（HDE）。我们从作用量原理推导 Einstein-Cartan 方程，并通过引入挠率标量得到类 Friedmann 方程。考虑 Weyssenhoff 自旋流体，我们在不引入 ad hoc ansatz 的情况下确定挠率标量的标度行为为 Φ ∼ a^{-3}，解决了先前挠率标量情景中的 ansatz 问题。在暗物质与暗能量之间无相互作用的情况下，挠率标量使全息暗能量的状态方程从无挠 HDE 得到的尘埃样值向负值移动，从而使宇宙加速成为可能。特别地，所得状态方程可以趋近 ω_X ≃ -1，并在弱挠率区 |Φ/H| < 1 内穿越 phantom divide。该模型预测一个动态状态方程，其中宇宙加速逐渐减弱，可能最近 DESI 观测一致。在带挠率的时空中，光度距离 d_L 与角直径距离 d_A 之间的宇宙距离对偶关系被修改为 d_L = d_A (1+z)^2 (1+η)。在存在挠率标量的情况下，我们表明红移与尺度因子之间的标准关系保持，而由挠率效应产生的偏离参数确定为 η ∼ ∫_{t_S}^{t_O} dt a^{-3}，其中 t_S 和 t_O 分别表示源处的发射时间和观察者处的观察时间。总体而言，我们的结果支持该模型的可行性，并为准备似然分析提供了理论框架。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-Cartan 引力中，以哈勃半径为红外截断的非相互作用全息暗能量模型可通过挠率使状态方程趋近 -1 并穿越 phantom divide。

papers.title: Large-charge ADHM-BMN index matching
papers.abstract: We compare the superconformal index of three-dimensional ADHM theory in fixed monopole sectors with the index of the BMN matrix model around fuzzy-sphere vacua. The monopole charges determine the sizes of the fuzzy-sphere blocks, and their multiplicities determine how many identical blocks occur. At a fixed number of fundamental hypermultiplets, we increase all positive monopole charges by the same amount while keeping their differences and multiplicities fixed. After dividing the ADHM index by the contribution of the bare monopole, it agrees order by order with the BMN index in the corresponding limit of large blocks. Fundamental excitations move to arbitrarily high orders in the index expansion, while the upper angular-momentum cutoffs of the BMN harmonics diverge, leaving the same vector and adjoint contribution.

classification.title_zh: 大荷 ADHM-BMN 指标匹配
classification.abstract_zh: 我们比较三维 ADHM 理论在固定磁单极荷扇区中的超共形指标与 BMN 矩阵模型在模糊球真空附近的指标。磁单极荷决定模糊球块的大小，其重数决定有多少个相同块出现。在基础超多重态数目固定时，我们让所有正磁单极荷增加相同量，同时保持它们的差与重数不变。将 ADHM 指标除以裸磁单极的贡献后，它在相应的大块极限下逐阶与 BMN 指标一致。基本激发移到指标展开中任意高阶，而 BMN 谐波的上角动量截断发散，留下相同的矢量与伴随表示贡献。

papers.title: A Geodesic Route toward Holography beyond AdS: Tessellating the Schwarzschild Black Hole
papers.abstract: In vacuum anti-de Sitter (AdS) space, the geometry admits a perfect tessellation by a geodesic network. This tessellation characterizes the background exactly, and a partial entanglement entropy (PEE) tensor-network toy model of AdS/CFT can be defined on it. It has so far been unclear whether this construction can be extended beyond vacuum AdS. In this paper we take the first step in this direction. We show that the exterior region of the Schwarzschild black hole and its Einstein--Rosen bridge are perfectly tessellated by a specific geodesic gas emitted from the boundary, so that Crofton reconstruction holds in these regions. We then prove that such a geodesic tessellation and the Crofton reconstruction it defines extend to more generic Riemannian manifolds. This allows us to construct a PEE tensor-network model of holographic duality on more generic geometric backgrounds. In the case of the PEE tensor-network model for the Schwarzschild background, we can concretely realize the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy, the Ryu--Takayanagi formula and the ER=EPR proposal. Our approach opens a new route towards holographic toy models beyond AdS/CFT.

classification.title_zh: 通往超越 AdS 全息的一条测地线路径：镶嵌史瓦西黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 在真空反德西特（AdS）空间中，几何可以由一个测地线网络完美镶嵌。这种镶嵌精确刻画了背景，并且可以在其上定义 AdS/CFT 的部分纠缠熵（PEE）张量网络玩具模型。迄今为止，尚不清楚这种构造能否推广到真空 AdS 之外。本文朝这个方向迈出第一步。我们表明，史瓦西黑洞的外部区域及其爱因斯坦–罗森桥可以被一种从边界发出的特定测地线气体完美镶嵌，从而使 Crofton 重建在这些区域成立。我们随后证明，这种测地线镶嵌及其定义的 Crofton 重建可以推广到更一般的黎曼流形。这使我们能够在更一般的几何背景上构造全息对偶的 PEE 张量网络模型。在史瓦西背景的 PEE 张量网络模型情形中，我们可以具体实现 Bekenstein–Hawking 熵、Ryu–Takayanagi 公式和 ER=EPR 提议。我们的方法为超越 AdS/CFT 的全息玩具模型开辟了一条新路线。

papers.title: Holographic warped CFTs from General Relativity on AdS$_3$
papers.abstract: We introduce a new set of boundary conditions for three-dimensional Einstein gravity with negative cosmological constant. The canonical generators plainly realize the semidirect sum of Virasoro and $u(1)$ Kac-Moody algebras in its standard form, without the need of additional redefinitions of the global charges. We show that requiring Euclidean BTZ and thermal AdS$_3$ to be diffeomorphic precisely induces the warped modular $S$-transformation of the chemical potentials. The corresponding warped Cardy formula then exactly reproduces the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, where the ground state is identified as Euclidean AdS$_3$. An explicit comparison with the boundary conditions of Brown-Henneaux and Compere-Song-Strominger is also addressed.

classification.title_zh: 来自 AdS$_3$ 上广义相对论的全息 warped CFT
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为具有负宇宙常数的三维 Einstein 引力引入一组新的边界条件。正则生成元直接以标准形式实现 Virasoro 与 $u(1)$ Kac-Moody 代数的半直和，无需对全局荷进行额外重新定义。我们表明，要求欧几里得 BTZ 与热 AdS$_3$ 微分同胚，会精确诱导化学势的 warped 模 $S$-变换。相应的 warped Cardy 公式则精确复现 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵，其中基态被认定为欧几里得 AdS$_3$。文中还与 Brown-Henneaux 以及 Compère-Song-Strominger 边界条件进行了明确比较。

papers.title: Why Cooper pairs live in AdS2: a spectral analysis of the Yukawa-SYK model
papers.abstract: We establish the spectral foundation of the geometric formulation of Cooper pairing in the Yukawa--Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model. Starting from the large-$N$ bilocal effective action, we derive the Gaussian fluctuation kernel in the even-frequency spin-singlet Cooper channel. Following the construction of Maldacena and Stanford, we determine the kernel eigenvalue $k\left(h\right)$ analytically for arbitrary conformal weight $h$ and resolve the pairing fluctuations into the continuous and discrete sectors of the associated de-Sitter space Laplacian. We show that the superconducting instability and the universal low-energy fluctuations near it reside entirely in the continuous scattering sector, while the discrete modes remain non-critical. Expanding the kernel about the lowest continuum mode yields a Klein--Gordon action on ${\rm dS}_2$, restricted to the continuous spectral subspace. This is precisely the subspace on which the inverse Radon transform to ${\rm AdS}_2$ is well defined. The projected bilocal Cooper-pair field can therefore be mapped onto a scalar matter field propagating in ${\rm AdS}_2$, without requiring any further spectral restriction on the bulk theory. Our results provide the missing microscopic justification for the projection implicit in earlier holographic formulations and clarify how a local bulk field emerges from the bilocal pairing theory.

classification.title_zh: 为什么库珀对生活在 AdS2：Yukawa-SYK 模型的谱分析
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为 Yukawa--Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev 模型中库珀配对的几何表述建立了谱基础。从大-$N$ 双局域有效作用量出发，我们推导了偶频自旋单态库珀通道中的高斯涨落核。按照 Maldacena 和 Stanford 的构造，我们对任意共形权重 $h$ 解析地确定了核本征值 $k(h)$，并将配对涨落分解为相应 de Sitter 空间 Laplacian 的连续谱和离散谱部分。我们表明，超导不稳定及其附近的普适低能涨落完全位于连续散射谱部分，而离散模保持非临界。将核围绕最低连续模展开，得到限制在连续谱子空间上的 ${\rm dS}_2$ 上的 Klein--Gordon 作用量。该子空间正是逆 Radon 变换到 ${\rm AdS}_2$ 定义良好的子空间。因此，投影后的双局域库珀对场可以映射到在 ${\rm AdS}_2$ 中传播的标量物质场，而无需对体理论进一步施加谱限制。我们的结果为早期全息表述中隐含的投影提供了缺失的微观依据，并阐明了局域体场如何从双局域配对理论中涌现。
classification.one_liner: 通过 Yukawa-SYK 的谱分析表明库珀对涨落位于连续谱扇区，并可映射为 AdS2 中的标量场，为全息库珀配对投影提供微观依据。

papers.title: Emergent States and Algebras from the Double-Scaling limit of Pure States in SYK
papers.abstract: Recent work has emphasized a subtlety of large- $N$ limits in AdS/CFT: a sequence of pure states in the microscopic theory need not remain pure with respect to the emergent algebra of observables. We study this phenomenon for Kourkoulou-Maldacena (KM) states in the double-scaling limit of the SYK model, and show that their ensemble-averaged algebraic description depends crucially on which observables survive the limit. For fermionic operators of size $N^{1/2}$, generic operators converge to the usual chord operators of double-scaled SYK. The resulting von Neumann algebra is the standard Type II$_1$ factor, and the KM pure states at infinite temperature converge to the tracial state, so generic probes lose access to microscopic purity. We then identify a class of operators adapted to the KM state that also survives the double-scaling limit. Since the KM state may be viewed as a projection inside the tracial state, these become dressed chord creation and annihilation operators. Once included, the limiting algebra becomes Type I$_\infty$ and the limiting state becomes pure. This gives a concrete example in which adding a sufficiently state-adapted operator to the emergent algebra restores access to the purity of the underlying state. We further show that correlators of the dressed operators admit exact modified chord-diagram rules, derive analytic expressions for uncrossed $2n$-point and crossed four-point functions, analyze their finite-temperature semiclassical and Schwarzian limits, study a deformation of the chord Hamiltonian that produces bound states and extends the correspondence with JT gravity plus an EOW brane to general brane tension, and identify an emergent $U(1)$ symmetry together with its finite-$N$ violation. Finally, we discuss analogies with boundary algebras proposed for black hole interiors and closed universes, and suggest lessons from our construction for both.

classification.title_zh: SYK 中纯态双标度极限下的涌现态与代数
classification.abstract_zh: 近期工作强调了 AdS/CFT 中大 N 极限的一个微妙之处：微观理论中的一列纯态相对于涌现的可观测量代数未必保持纯态。我们研究 SYK 模型双标度极限下的 Kourkoulou-Maldacena (KM) 态中的这一现象，并表明其系综平均的代数描述关键依赖于哪些可观测量在该极限下存活。对于尺度为 N^{1/2} 的费米子算符，一般算符收敛到双标度 SYK 通常的 chord 算符。所得的 von Neumann 代数是标准 Type II_1 因子，且无穷温度下的 KM 纯态收敛到迹态，因此一般探针无法获取微观纯度。随后我们识别出一类适应 KM 态的算符，它们也在双标度极限下存活。由于 KM 态可视为迹态内的一个投影，这些算符成为着装 (dressed) 的 chord 产生湮灭算符。一旦纳入它们，极限代数变为 Type I_∞，极限态变为纯态。这给出了一个具体例子：向涌现代数加入足够适应状态的算符可恢复对底层态纯度的访问。我们进一步表明，着装算符的关联函数具有精确的修正 chord 图规则，推导了未交叉 2n 点函数与交叉四点函数的解析表达式，分析了它们的有限温度半经典与 Schwarzian 极限，研究了对 chord Hamiltonian 的一种形变，该形变产生束缚态并将与 JT 引力加 EOW 膜的对应推广到一般膜张力，并识别出一个涌现 U(1) 对称性及其有限 N 破坏。最后，我们讨论了与为黑洞内部和闭合宇宙提出的边界代数的类比，并给出我们的构造对二者的启示。
classification.one_liner: 该文在双标度 SYK 中展示 KM 纯态的涌现代数依赖可观测集合：加入适应态的着装 chord 算符后，代数从 Type II1 变为 Type I∞ 并恢复纯态，同时推广 JT+EOW 膜对应。

papers.title: Cloud Screening of extremal charged BTZ black hole
papers.abstract: We study the instability of a charged scalar field in the near-horizon region of an extremal charged BTZ black hole. The extremal geometry contains an $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ throat supported by a constant electric field, which lowers the effective scalar mass and can violate the $\mathrm{AdS}_2$ Breitenlohner--Freedman bound. This identifies an infrared instability of the extremal normal state. We then construct a nearby finite-temperature branch of fully backreacted, source-free, node-free hairy black-hole solutions, thereby establishing the nonlinear continuation of the unstable mode near its onset. The scalar condensate modifies both the Maxwell field and the geometry, while stronger gravitational backreaction lowers the critical temperature and suppresses the condensate amplitude. Near the critical point, the condensate exhibits mean-field scaling. We also develop an effective near-horizon interpretation in terms of electric-flux screening. The exact zero-temperature endpoint of the hairy branch is not determined here and remains an open problem.

classification.title_zh: 极端带电 BTZ 黑洞的云屏蔽
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了极端带电 BTZ 黑洞近视界区域中带电标量场的不稳定性。极端几何包含由恒定电场支撑的 AdS2×S1 喉区，这会降低标量有效质量，并可能违反 AdS2 的 Breitenlohner--Freedman 界。这确认了极端正常态存在红外不稳定性。随后我们构造了一族邻近的有限温度、完全背反应、无源、无节点带毛黑洞解，从而建立了不稳定模式在其起始点附近的非线性延拓。标量凝聚修改了 Maxwell 场和几何，而更强的引力背反应降低临界温度并抑制凝聚振幅。在临界点附近，凝聚表现出平均场标度。我们还发展了基于电通量屏蔽的近视界有效解释。带毛分支的精确零温端点在此未确定，仍是一个开放问题。
classification.one_liner: 在极端带电 BTZ 黑洞近视界 AdS2 区域，带电标量不稳定性导致完全背反应的有限温度带毛黑洞分支，并呈现全息超导凝聚特征。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究全息带电标量凝聚与带毛黑洞解，涉及 AdS2 近视界不稳定性、背反应和临界行为，与全息超流超导及经典引力黑洞解重点高度相关。

papers.title: Schwinger instability for near-extremal charged BTZ black hole
papers.abstract: We study the near-horizon region of a near-extremal charged BTZ black hole, where a controlled AdS$_2\times S^1$ throat emerges. In this background we solve the Klein-Gordon equation for a charged scalar exactly, identify the BF-bound threshold, and compute the mean Schwinger pair-production rate, which reduces to the standard semiclassical formula in the appropriate limit. The hypergeometric solution is exact within the decoupled near-horizon AdS$_2$ black-hole patch; with ingoing conditions imposed at the true outer horizon, it yields a closed-form mean number of produced pairs throughout the controlled near-extremal throat regime. Its finite-temperature dependence enters only through the ratio of the mode frequency to the Hawking temperature, while the extremal limit reproduces the known AdS$_2$ Schwinger result and admits an exact thermal-like form in terms of curvature-corrected effective temperatures. We also compute charged Hawking emission via a WKB tunneling analysis done directly in throat coordinates, allowing a clean comparison between thermal and electric contributions and fixing the instability threshold in terms of an effective Unruh temperature. Finally, we discuss how the stress-energy flux generated by Schwinger production may enter the generalized-entropy extremality condition, while leaving a complete backreaction and quantum-extremal-surface analysis for future work.

classification.title_zh: 近极端带电 BTZ 黑洞的 Schwinger 不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究近极端带电 BTZ 黑洞的近视界区域，其中出现可控的 AdS2×S1 喉道。在此背景下，我们精确求解带电标量场的 Klein-Gordon 方程，确定 BF 界阈值，并计算平均 Schwinger 对产生率；该速率在适当极限下退化为标准半经典公式。该超几何解在解耦的近视界 AdS2 黑洞片中精确成立；在真实外视界施加入射条件后，它在整个可控近极端喉道区域给出产生对平均数的闭式结果。其有限温度依赖仅通过模式频率与霍金温度之比进入，而极端极限再现已知的 AdS2 Schwinger 结果，并具有以曲率修正有效温度表示的精确类热形式。我们还通过在喉道坐标中直接进行 WKB 隧穿分析来计算带电霍金辐射，从而可以清晰比较热贡献与电贡献，并用有效 Unruh 温度确定不稳定性阈值。最后，我们讨论 Schwinger 产生所生成的应力-能量通量如何可能进入广义熵极端性条件，同时将完整背反应和量子极端面分析留待未来工作。
classification.one_liner: 在近极端带电 BTZ 黑洞的 AdS2 喉道中精确求解带电标量 Klein-Gordon 方程，得到 Schwinger 对产生率、带电霍金辐射及不稳定性阈值。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及近极端 AdS2/黑洞量子不稳定性与带电霍金辐射，属于 AdS2/黑洞量子引力相关方向；但不直接匹配所列重点标签中的全息凝聚态、p 波、multi-trace、QNM、经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: Black objects in a five-dimensional swirling spacetime
papers.abstract: We construct a five-dimensional generalization of the swirling universe and embed in it the Myers-Perry black hole and the rotating black ring. We prove that both solutions are free of conical singularities, analyze their geometrical properties, compute their mass and angular momentum, and discuss their uniqueness.

classification.title_zh: 五维旋涡时空中的黑洞客体
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了旋涡宇宙的五维推广，并将 Myers-Perry 黑洞和旋转黑洞环嵌入其中。我们证明这两个解均无锥形奇点，分析其几何性质，计算其质量和角动量，并讨论其唯一性。
classification.one_liner: 构造五维旋涡时空并嵌入 Myers-Perry 黑洞与旋转黑洞环，证明无锥形奇点并计算质量与角动量。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接属于经典引力/广义相对论，研究五维精确黑洞解（Myers-Perry 黑洞、旋转黑洞环）及其几何与守恒量；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: The alternative scalar field dark sector of the Universe: Cosmological inflation, quintessence and ekpyrotic model in the framework of scalar-tensor cosmology
papers.abstract: This dissertation investigates scalar field descriptions of the dark sector (of the Universe), with emphasis on scalar-tensor cosmology, inflationary effective field theory, quintessence, and ekpyrotic/cyclic alternatives to inflation. The thesis first reviews scalar-tensor theories of gravity, starting from Brans-Dicke theory and extending to general non-minimally coupled scalar fields. Particular attention is paid to the interpretation of the scalar field, the relation between the Jordan and Einstein conformal frames, and the role of conformal transformations in cosmology. This provides the theoretical basis for treating scalar fields either as modified matter or as additional gravitational degrees of freedom. The second part discusses cosmological inflation from the viewpoint of effective field theory. The spontaneous breaking of time translations, the Goldstone description of adiabatic perturbations, higher-dimensional operators, radiative corrections and Planck-suppressed terms are analyzed in the context of ultraviolet sensitivity and the eta problem. The third part is devoted to quintessence as the simplest dynamical dark energy model. 'Tracking', 'scaling', 'thawing' and 'freezing' behaviors are discussed, together with observational diagnostics such as the statefinder parameters, the $(\omega_{\phi},\omega'_{\phi})$ plane and the $Om(z)$ diagnostic. The DESI DR2 results are used as motivation for considering time-dependent effective dark energy beyond a strict cosmological constant. The final part studies ekpyrotic and cyclic cosmologies. The ekpyrotic phase is analyzed as a smoothing mechanism based on an ultra-stiff scalar field equation of state. Perturbations, non-Gaussianity, tensor modes, bounce conditions, entropy production, geodesic incompleteness and phase-resolved field-space distance bounds are discussed.

classification.title_zh: 宇宙的替代标量场暗区：标量-张量宇宙学框架下的宇宙暴胀、精质和火劫模型
classification.abstract_zh: 本论文研究宇宙暗区的标量场描述，重点为标量-张量宇宙学、暴胀有效场论、精质以及火劫/循环暴胀替代方案。论文首先回顾标量-张量引力理论，从 Brans-Dicke 理论出发推广到一般非最小耦合标量场；特别关注标量场的解读、Jordan 与 Einstein 共形框架之间的关系，以及共形变换在宇宙学中的作用。这为将标量场视为修改物质或额外引力自由度提供了理论基础。第二部分从有效场论角度讨论宇宙暴胀，分析时间平移的自发破缺、绝热扰动的 Goldstone 描述、高维算符、辐射修正和 Planck 压低项，并联系紫外敏感性和 eta 问题。第三部分讨论作为最简单动力学暗能量模型的精质，涉及 tracking、scaling、thawing、freezing 行为，以及 Statefinder 参数、(ω_φ, ω'_φ) 平面和 Om(z) 诊断；DESI DR2 结果被用作考虑超出严格宇宙学常数的时间依赖有效暗能量的动机。最后一部分研究火劫与循环宇宙学，将火劫相视为基于超刚性标量场状态方程的平滑机制，并讨论扰动、非高斯性、张量模、反弹条件、熵产生、测地线不完备性以及按相区分的场空间距离界限。
classification.one_liner: 一篇综述性学位论文，系统讨论标量-张量宇宙学中作为暗区的标量场：暴胀有效场论、精质暗能量与火劫/循环模型。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题为标量-张量宇宙学、暴胀、精质与火劫模型，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力中的信息问题。

papers.title: Toward the CompactHedron: Bounds on Neutron Stars from Microscopic Principles
papers.abstract: We investigate the implications of causality and positivity for the tidal Love numbers of gravitating objects. We work within the framework of point-particle effective field theory, where the Love numbers correspond to the Wilson coefficients of operators constructed from the curvature tensor and its derivatives. For simplicity, we focus on the quadrupolar gravito-electric sector, which provides the leading contribution to tidal deformability. We show that requiring the tidal response to be retarded and to decay at high frequencies, together with the assumption of passivity, leads to nontrivial bounds on the Love numbers. These bounds delineate an allowed region in the parameter space of the effective theory and apply to any localized object. In particular, we study their application to neutron stars. We compute the dynamical Love numbers through fourth order in the frequency expansion for a representative set of polytropic and tabulated neutron-star equations of state and show that, in the low-compactness regime, the bounds translate into constraints on the first oscillation mode of the star. Importantly, these constraints are conceptually independent of the stability and thermodynamic conditions commonly imposed in the literature. While our focus is primarily on conservative systems, we also discuss how the bounds are modified in the presence of dissipation. Our results lay the ground for a systematic framework to derive bounds on compact objects from fundamental principles.

classification.title_zh: 迈向 CompactHedron：从微观原理对中子星的限制
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究因果性与正性对引力物体潮汐 Love 数的影响。我们在点粒子有效场论框架下工作，其中 Love 数对应由曲率张量及其导数构造的算符的 Wilson 系数。为简单起见，我们聚焦四极引力电扇区，它对潮汐形变率给出领头贡献。我们表明，要求潮汐响应是推迟的且在高频衰减，并结合被动性假设，会得到 Love 数的非平凡界限。这些界限在有效理论参数空间中划出允许区域，并适用于任何局域物体。特别地，我们研究它们对中子星的应用。我们计算了动力 Love 数，在频率展开中到四阶，对一组代表性多方和表格中子星状态方程，并表明在低致密 regime，这些界限转化为对恒星第一个振荡模式的约束。重要的是，这些约束在概念上独立于文献中通常施加的稳定性和热力学条件。虽然我们主要关注保守系统，我们也讨论在存在耗散时这些界限如何被修改。我们的结果为从基本原理推导致密天体界限的系统框架奠定基础。
classification.one_liner: 用因果性、正性和被动性约束引力潮汐 Love 数，并将边界应用于中子星第一振荡模式。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，聚焦中子星潮汐响应与振荡模式，符合用户重点标签。

papers.title: Black Hole Quasinormal Mode Resonances and Reconnections in Coupled Systems
papers.abstract: Black hole quasinormal modes (QNMs) provide a window into the underlying structure of black holes and the environments in which they arise. QNMs have particularly rich dynamics in coupled systems beyond general relativity, in which they are known to undergo avoided crossings, resonant excitation, and mode reconnections. Recent work has shown that reconnecting QNM trajectories can trace out a distinctive double spiral structure in the complex frequency plane. In this work, we study this phenomenology in a concrete model of perturbed dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) theory, as well as in a minimal toy model. In the former, we characterize the exceptional points, avoided crossings and reconnections for several values of the perturbation parameters, and find that the limiting frequency of the double spiral endpoints is independent of the perturbation strength. We compute the excitation factors and find that they follow the scaling characteristic of a resonance between the scalar and gravitational modes. To determine whether these phenomena depend on the specific features of dCS, we construct a toy model of coupled degrees of freedom with square potential barriers, and find that we can reproduce the avoided crossings and reconnections, indicating that these phenomena can occur more generally in coupled systems and are highly sensitive to the system parameters.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞准正规模共振与耦合系统中的重联
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞准正规模（QNMs）提供了洞察黑洞及其产生环境底层结构的窗口。QNMs 在超越广义相对论的耦合系统中具有特别丰富的动力学，其中已知会发生避免交叉、共振激发和模式重联。近期工作表明，重联的 QNM 轨迹可以在复频率平面上描绘出独特的双螺旋结构。在本工作中，我们在扰动 dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) 理论的具体模型以及一个最小玩具模型中研究这一现象学。在前者中，我们刻画了若干扰动参数取值下的例外点、避免交叉和重联，并发现双螺旋端点的极限频率与扰动强度无关。我们计算了激发因子，发现它们遵循标量与引力模式之间共振的特征标度。为确定这些现象是否依赖于 dCS 的具体特征，我们构建了一个具有方势垒的耦合自由度玩具模型，并发现可以重现避免交叉和重联，表明这些现象可以在耦合系统中更普遍地发生，并且对系统参数高度敏感。
classification.one_liner: 在扰动 dCS 理论与方势垒玩具模型中研究黑洞准正规模的避免交叉、例外点和双螺旋重联，发现其普遍性与参数敏感性。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究黑洞准正规模的共振、避免交叉与重联，匹配重点标签“QNM与非线性演化”；研究对象为修改引力中的经典黑洞扰动，匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”。

papers.title: Low Frequency Gravitational Wave Detection with Gravito-Magnetism
papers.abstract: The detection of gravitational waves in the low-frequency band (10 nHz to 1 micro-Hz) using inner solar system proof masses is severely limited by Newtonian gravity gradient noise (GGN) sourced by the asteroid belt. In this paper, we propose a novel detection concept that exploits the relativistic nature of gravitational waves to break the degeneracy between the signal and the asteroid GGN background. The non-relativistic motion of asteroids dominantly sources gravito-electric fields, with velocity suppressed gravito-magnetic components. Relativistic gravitational waves produce gravito-electric and gravito-magnetic components of equal magnitude. We propose detecting the gravito-magnetic component of low frequency gravitational waves using the Lorentz acceleration of test bodies. The measurement of this Lorentz acceleration is metrologically possible due to the fact that expected astrophysical sources of low frequency gravitational waves have considerably higher characteristic strains than the strains typically expected at higher frequencies. We show that this measurement allows for unambiguous extraction of the gravitational wave signal from the gravity gradient noise in a three satellite constellation. The gravito-magnetic measurement still requires a proof mass that is well isolated from non-gravitational noise. We propose the use of atom interferometers to serve as such a pristine inertial reference.

classification.title_zh: 利用引力磁效应进行低频引力波探测
classification.abstract_zh: 利用内太阳系检验质量探测低频段（10 nHz 至 1 微赫兹）引力波，受到小行星带产生的牛顿引力梯度噪声（GGN）的严重限制。本文提出一种新的探测概念，利用引力波的相对论本性来打破信号与小行星 GGN 背景之间的简并。小行星的非相对论运动主要产生引力电场，其引力磁场分量受到速度压低。相对论性引力波产生的引力电场与引力磁场分量大小相等。我们提出利用检验质量的洛伦兹加速度来探测低频引力波的引力磁场分量。由于预期的低频引力波天体物理源的特征应变显著高于通常在高频段预期的应变，对这种洛伦兹加速度的测量在计量学上是可行的。我们表明，在三卫星星座中，这一测量允许从引力梯度噪声中无歧义地提取引力波信号。引力磁场测量仍需要一个与非引力噪声良好隔离的检验质量。我们提出使用原子干涉仪作为这样一种纯净的惯性参考。
classification.one_liner: 提出通过测量引力波的引力磁场分量及其对检验质量的洛伦兹加速度，在三卫星星座中把低频引力波信号从小行星引力梯度噪声中分离出来，并用原子干涉仪提供惯性参考。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论与引力波探测，核心是引力磁效应和低频引力波测量，直接符合‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Five-dimensional thick branes in the scalar representation of $f(Q,B)$ gravity
papers.abstract: One examines a codimension-one thick braneworld in the scalar representation of $f(Q,B)$ gravity, where $Q$ is the nonmetricity scalar, and $B$ is the boundary term satisfying $R=Q-B$. We write the gravitational sector in terms of two auxiliary scalar fields, $\varphi=f_Q$ and $\psi=f_B$, and an interaction potential $U(\varphi,\psi)$ obtained by a Legendre transformation from the $f(Q,B)$ function. Working in the coincident gauge and assuming a five-dimensional warped geometry with four-dimensional Poincar\'e symmetry, we derive the complete set of brane equations sourced by a canonical bulk scalar field. To accomplish our purpose, we address two models of smooth asymptotically AdS thick brane with localized scalar profiles. Furthermore, we also analyze tensor perturbations and demonstrate the localization and stability of the massless graviton.

classification.title_zh: f(Q,B)引力标量表示中的五维厚膜
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了f(Q,B)引力标量表示中的余维一厚膜世界，其中Q是非度量标量，B是满足R=Q-B的边界项。我们将引力部分用两个辅助标量场φ=f_Q和ψ=f_B以及通过Legendre变换从f(Q,B)函数得到的相互作用势U(φ,ψ)来表示。在重合规范下，假设具有四维Poincaré对称性的五维翘曲几何，我们推导了由正则体标量场作为源的完整膜方程。为实现目标，我们处理了两个具有局域标量剖面的光滑渐近AdS厚膜模型。此外，我们还分析了张量扰动，并证明了无质量引力子的局域化和稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 研究了f(Q,B)引力中五维厚膜模型及其张量扰动与引力子局域化。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究f(Q,B)引力中的厚膜世界与张量扰动，属于经典引力/广义相对论和膜世界方向，与用户重点标签‘经典引力/广义相对论’直接相关；但不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Polar-metric/axial-gauge perturbations of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov wormhole
papers.abstract: We study linear perturbations of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov (MMP) traversable wormhole. On a magnetically charged background, polar metric perturbations couple to axial perturbations of the gauge field. We treat this sector and reduce it to two coupled master equations of Zerilli-Moncrief type. The wormhole has two regions. In the mouths the geometry is a nearly extremal magnetic Reissner-Nordstrom black hole with no quantum source. In the throat the Casimir energy of the lowest Landau level of charged fermions holds the wormhole open. We show that the throat equations are consistent only if the fermions respond to the perturbation, computed exactly from the two-dimensional conformal anomaly with the full stress tensor including the trace part that MMP discard. This response must be accompanied by an induced Hall current of the fermions. With both effects included, the linearised Bianchi identities hold at first order in the fermionic backreaction $\alpha$. Deriving the Hall current from the fermion effective action instead requires an Euler term with coefficient $c/48\pi$, which becomes a coupling between magnetic flux and curvature similar to a Wen-Zee term. At $\alpha=0$ the throat is exact AdS$_2\times S^2$ and the modes decouple into two Poschl-Teller problems with masses $l(l-1)$ and $(l+1)(l+2)$, with levels spaced by $1/\ell$ in frequency. We give the $O(\alpha)$ corrections in closed form. They mix the two modes and depend on frequency, and match the mouths in the overlap region. The symmetric part of the potential is positive throughout the wormhole, excluding purely exponential growth. The corrections lower the normal frequencies and split the levels shared by the two modes, with real shifts at first order in $\alpha$. This sector has no growing mode for $l\ge2$ at this order.

classification.title_zh: Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov 虫洞的极向度规/轴向规范微扰
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov (MMP) 可穿越虫洞的线性微扰。在磁荷背景上，极向度规微扰与规范场的轴向微扰耦合。我们处理该扇区，将其约化为两个 Zerilli-Moncrief 型耦合主方程。该虫洞有两个区域。在口部，几何是近乎极端的磁 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞，没有量子源。在喉部，带电费米子最低朗道能级的 Casimir 能量维持虫洞开放。我们表明，只有当费米子对微扰有响应时，喉部方程才自洽；该响应由二维共形反常精确计算，使用包含 MMP 所丢弃迹部分的完整应力张量。该响应必须伴随费米子的诱导霍尔电流。将两种效应都包括后，线性化 Bianchi 恒等式在费米子反作用 α 的一阶成立。若从费米子有效作用量推导霍尔电流，则需要一个系数为 c/48π 的 Euler 项，它成为磁通与曲率之间的耦合，类似 Wen-Zee 项。在 α=0 时，喉部是精确的 AdS2×S2，模式解耦为两个 Pöschl-Teller 问题，质量分别为 l(l-1) 和 (l+1)(l+2)，频率间隔为 1/ℓ。我们以闭合形式给出 O(α) 修正。它们混合两个模式并依赖频率，且在重叠区域与口部匹配。势的对称部分在整个虫洞中为正，排除了纯指数增长。这些修正降低正常频率，并分裂两个模式共享的能级，在一阶 α 有实位移。在此阶，该扇区对 l≥2 没有增长模式。
classification.one_liner: 本文对 MMP 可穿越虫洞的极向度规-轴向规范扇区做线性微扰，得到耦合主方程、AdS2×S2 喉部正常模式及 O(α) 修正，并表明该扇区无增长模。

papers.title: On Grey Galaxies and D3-branes on the Conifold
papers.abstract: We study the effective potentials for various probe D-branes surrounding AdS$_5$ black holes in consistent truncations of type IIB supergravity on Sasaki-Einstein 5-manifolds $Y^{p,q}$, focusing in particular on the conifold base $T^{1,1}$. The probes are either dual Giant Gravitons having support on AdS spacetime dimensions or D3 probe branes wrapped on non-contractible cycles of the internal manifold, which then appear "point-like" in the AdS spacetime. The non-contractible cycles of $T^{1,1}$ and $Y^{p,q}$ topologically stabilize the branes at a finite size, and we find stable supersymmetric wrapped D3 branes on Gutowski-Reall black holes, effectively providing a stable BPS composite system in AdS$_5$ made by a black hole surrounded by a baryonic condensate. We show that the onset of superradiance in the black hole backgrounds matches the emergence of stable minima in the probe effective potentials, extending the constructions of Dual Dressed Black Holes and the Grey Galaxies. We comment on the relevance of this result for recent studies concerning the classical cohomology problem and the associated fortuitous states in the dual Klebanov-Witten theory.
