classification.title_zh: 论灰色星系与锥形上的 D3-膜
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在 Sasaki-Einstein 五维流形 Y^{p,q}（尤其关注锥形底 T^{1,1}）上 IIB 型超引力一致截断中，环绕 AdS5 黑洞的各类探测 D-膜的有效势。这些探针要么是支撑在 AdS 时空维度上的对偶巨引力子，要么是包裹内部流形不可收缩闭链的 D3 探测膜，后者在 AdS 时空中表现为“点状”。T^{1,1} 和 Y^{p,q} 的不可收缩闭链从拓扑上把膜稳定在有限尺寸；我们在 Gutowski-Reall 黑洞上找到稳定的超对称包裹 D3 膜，从而在 AdS5 中有效提供了一个由黑洞及其周围重子凝聚体组成的稳定 BPS 复合系统。我们表明，黑洞背景中超辐射的开始与探测有效势中稳定极小值的出现相匹配，从而扩展了 Dual Dressed Black Holes 与 Grey Galaxies 的构造。我们还评论了该结果与近期关于经典上同调问题以及相关偶然态在对偶的 Klebanov-Witten 理论中研究的关联。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS5 黑洞背景下，锥形内部不可收缩闭链稳定了 BPS D3 探针膜，其有效势稳定极小值与超辐射 onset 对应，扩展了灰色星系/双重修饰黑洞图像。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息黑洞与探针 D-膜支线，涉及 AdS/CFT、重子凝聚体和超辐射；与用户重点标签中的探针膜/非均匀态有相邻关联，但不是 D3-D7/D3-D5 或 QNM 主线。

papers.title: Effective Field Theory for Holographic Compact Objects
papers.abstract: We study heavy-heavy-light-light correlators in holographic CFTs when the heavy operator is dual to a compact object localized on scales much smaller than the AdS radius. In the long-wavelength regime, the internal structure of the heavy state is described by a worldline effective field theory, whose local operators encode finite-size response coefficients such as tidal Love numbers. Focusing on weakly self-gravitating objects, we show that the Witten diagrams generated by local heavy-light interactions reorganize into the Born series of an effective wave equation for the light bulk field. We reproduce the same correlator by solving this wave equation with localized interactions and identify how the worldline Wilson coefficients are encoded in the CFT data. Our results provide a direct relation between the finite-size response of compact objects in AdS and the dimensions and OPE coefficients of heavy-light and light-light composite operators in the dual CFT.

classification.title_zh: 全息致密天体的有效场论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究全息 CFT 中的重-重-轻-轻关联函数，其中重算符对偶于局域在远小于 AdS 半径尺度上的致密天体。在长波区域，重态的内部结构由一条世界线有效场论描述，其局域算符编码潮汐 Love 数等有限尺寸响应系数。聚焦弱自引力天体，我们展示由局域重-轻相互作用产生的 Witten 图重组成轻体场有效波动方程的 Born 级数。我们通过求解带局域相互作用的波动方程复现同一关联函数，并确定世界线 Wilson 系数如何编码在 CFT 数据中。我们的结果给出 AdS 中致密天体有限尺寸响应与对偶 CFT 中重-轻和轻-轻复合算符的维度及 OPE 系数之间的直接关系。
classification.one_liner: 用世界线 EFT 和 Witten 图把 AdS 中致密天体的有限尺寸响应（如潮汐 Love 数）映射到全息 CFT 的算符维度与 OPE 系数。
classification.relevance_reason: 核心为全息 CFT 关联函数、Witten 图与算符数据，直接关联 AdS/CFT 字典；同时涉及致密天体、有限尺寸响应与潮汐 Love 数等经典引力概念。

papers.title: Multipartite Entanglement Can Probe Wormhole Moduli Invisible to Bipartite Entanglement
papers.abstract: In a companion paper, we found that near the untwisted point of a four-boundary AdS$_3$ wormhole, whenever the complete bipartite Ryu-Takayanagi entropy vector is insensitive to a Fenchel-Nielsen twist, the holographic $\mathtt q=4$ multi-entropy is insensitive as well. Here we show that the situation changes at finite twist. The twist lengthens the crossing geodesics and thereby enlarges the region in which all bipartite RT entropies remain invariant. In part of this enlarged region, a twist-sensitive $\mathtt q=4$ network becomes globally minimal. We thus find an open region of wormhole moduli space in which the complete bipartite RT entropy vector is exactly unchanged while the $\mathtt q=4$ multi-entropy detects the twist. Our result provides an explicit example in which the $\mathtt q=4$ genuine multi-entropy probes bulk geometric information invisible to all bipartite entanglement entropies.

classification.title_zh: 多部分纠缠可探测双部分纠缠不可见的虫洞模量
classification.abstract_zh: 在一篇姊妹论文中，我们发现，在四边界 AdS3 虫洞的未扭曲点附近，只要完整双部分 Ryu-Takayanagi 熵矢量对 Fenchel-Nielsen 扭曲不敏感，全息 q=4 多熵也不敏感。这里我们表明，在有限扭曲下情况发生变化。扭曲会拉长交叉测地线，从而扩大所有双部分 RT 熵保持不变的区域。在这一扩大区域的一部分中，一个对扭曲敏感的 q=4 网络成为全局最小。因此我们找到虫洞模空间中的一个开区域，其中完整双部分 RT 熵矢量完全不变，而 q=4 多熵探测到扭曲。我们的结果提供了一个显式例子，其中 q=4 真正多熵探测到所有双部分纠缠熵不可见的体几何信息。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS3 四边界虫洞中，q=4 多熵可在双部分 RT 熵完全不变时探测 Fenchel-Nielsen 扭曲。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 全息纠缠熵与多部分纠缠方向，与全息量子信息相关，但未直接涉及用户列出的重点支线标签，因此相关性为中等。

papers.title: Can Multipartite Entanglement Probe Wormhole Moduli Invisible to Bipartite Entanglement?
papers.abstract: We ask whether multipartite entanglement can probe bulk moduli invisible to bipartite entanglement. We study this question in an explicit family of four-boundary AdS$_3$ wormholes related by a Fenchel-Nielsen twist $\tau$, asking whether the complete set of bipartite RT entropies can remain exactly $\tau$-independent while the holographic $\mathtt q=4$ multi-entropy is sensitive to the twist. Within the class of configurations analyzed here, for sufficiently small $|\tau|$, we find no such regime along the symmetric line $\ell=m$: the globally minimal $\mathtt q=4$ network is itself exactly $\tau$-independent throughout the parameter range analyzed. This conclusion is not a priori obvious: it emerges from a competition among several admissible configurations whose relative ordering changes multiple times as the geometry is varied, and persists up to the point where the bipartite RT entropies themselves become twist-sensitive.

classification.title_zh: 多体纠缠能否探测双体纠缠不可见的虫洞模量？
classification.abstract_zh: 我们追问多体纠缠能否探测双体纠缠不可见的体模量。我们在由 Fenchel-Nielsen 扭转 τ 联系的一族显式四边界 AdS₃ 虫洞中研究这个问题，询问完整的一组双体 RT 熵能否保持严格与 τ 无关，而全息 q=4 多熵对扭转敏感。在此分析的一类构型中，对于足够小的 |τ|，我们发现在对称线 ℓ=m 上不存在这样的区域：全局最小的 q=4 网络本身在整个所分析参数范围内严格与 τ 无关。这个结论并非先验显然：它来自若干允许构型之间的竞争，这些构型的相对排序随着几何变化而多次改变，并持续到双体 RT 熵自身变得对扭转敏感之处。
classification.one_liner: 在四边界 AdS₃ 虫洞中，对足够小扭转，全局最小 q=4 多熵网络在对称线上仍与扭转无关，因此未发现多体纠缠能探测双体 RT 熵不可见的模量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息多体纠缠与虫洞模量探测，但不直接涉及用户列出的重点标签（如全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜、经典引力/广义相对论）。

papers.title: Relic of the Kink Shape Mode in a Topological Thick Brane - some implications
papers.abstract: The kink soliton provides a simple construction of a topological thick 3-brane sourced by a minimally coupled canonical scalar field in five-dimensional general relativity. Although the flat-space kink is a solution of $\varphi^4$ theory, the gravitating configuration requires $M_*$-suppressed $\varphi^6$ corrections to support a stable warped geometry. Unlike its flat-space counterpart, the scalar perturbation spectrum contains no normalizable bound state. We nevertheless identify a single quasi-bound, or resonant, mode. Using a time-independent relative-probability analysis, direct time evolution, and a four-turning-point WKB calculation, we establish a direct connection between this resonance and the massive bound shape mode of the flat-space $\varphi^4$ kink. We also show that, within an EFT-consistent parameter window, the resonance can transfer energy from bulk geometric fluctuations to localized matter, thereby allowing the possibility of high-scale reheating in the early universe.

classification.title_zh: 拓扑厚膜中扭结形状模的遗迹——若干启示
classification.abstract_zh: 扭结孤子为在五维广义相对论中由最小耦合正则标量场作为源的拓扑厚 3-膜提供了一种简单构造。虽然平直空间扭结是 φ^4 理论的解，但带引力的位形需要 M_* 压低的 φ^6 修正才能支持稳定的翘曲几何。与其平直空间对应物不同，标量扰动谱不包含可归一化束缚态。我们仍识别出一个准束缚或共振模式。利用时间无关的相对概率分析、直接时间演化和四转折点 WKB 计算，我们建立了该共振与平直空间 φ^4 扭结的 massive bound shape mode 之间的直接联系。我们还表明，在 EFT 一致参数窗口内，该共振可将能量从体几何涨落转移到局域物质，从而允许早期宇宙高能标重加热的可能性。
classification.one_liner: 在五维厚膜中，平直空间 φ^4 扭结的形状模表现为一个准束缚共振，并可能通过能量转移支持早期宇宙高能标重加热。

papers.title: Active normal-fluid feedback in quantum turbulence from holography
papers.abstract: The two-fluid model provides a powerful phenomenological framework for superfluids, where components interact through vortex-induced mutual friction. Quantum turbulence in such coupled two-fluid systems has become a central theme in low-temperature physics. However, the fundamental incompatibility between discrete vortex-line and continuum descriptions has historically forced reliance on phenomenological parameters. Here, we present an ab initio holographic simulation of this active two-fluid dynamics. Using a fully backreacted gravitational model, we intrinsically incorporate reciprocal momentum exchange and finite-temperature dissipation without empirical inputs. Contrasting continuously driven and freely decaying turbulence, we uncover pronounced non-Gaussian tails and spatial anisotropy in the normal-fluid velocity statistics, arising directly from the dynamical quantized vortex backreaction. Raising the temperature suppresses normal-fluid velocity fluctuations despite increasing the vortex density. This suppression is unambiguously traced to the thermal depletion of the superfluid condensate. Our results establish holographic duality as a rigorous first-principles framework for quantum turbulence, revealing the active role of the normal fluid far from equilibrium and yielding predictions for ongoing cold-atom and superfluid experiments.

classification.title_zh: 全息量子湍流中的主动正常流体反馈
classification.abstract_zh: 双流体模型为超流体提供了有力的唯象框架，其中组分通过涡旋诱导的互摩擦相互作用。耦合双流体系统中的量子湍流已成为低温物理的核心主题。然而，离散涡线描述与连续场描述之间的根本不相容，历史上迫使人们依赖唯象参数。本文给出这种主动双流体动力学的从头算全息模拟。利用完全反作用的引力模型，我们在没有经验输入的情况下内在地纳入互易动量交换和有限温度耗散。对比连续驱动与自由衰减湍流，我们发现正常流体速度统计中出现显著的非高斯尾和空间各向异性，这些直接来源于动态量子化涡旋的反作用。升高温度尽管增加了涡旋密度，却抑制了正常流体速度涨落。这种抑制被明确追溯到超流凝聚体的热耗竭。我们的结果确立全息对偶作为量子湍流的严格第一性原理框架，揭示了正常流体远离平衡时的主动作用，并为正在进行的冷原子和超流体实验提供预言。
classification.one_liner: 用完全反作用的全息模型从头算模拟双流体量子湍流，发现正常流体反馈导致非高斯统计与空间各向异性，并受凝聚体热耗竭抑制。

papers.title: Constructing and Probing Three-Boundary Booklet Geometries
papers.abstract: Partially entangled thermal states (PETS) provide semiclassical families of black-hole microstates prepared through heavy shell insertions. We extend this shell-state framework and propose three-boundary partially entangled thermal states (PETS$_3$) by replacing the two-index insertion data with a trivalent junction tensor. The corresponding bulk three-boundary booklet geometry is constrained semiclassically by the Israel junction condition, allowing us to identify candidate symmetric and mixed-orientation branches. We verify the self-consistency of this construction by counting states in the symmetric all-black-hole sector. Using a heavy-operator probe, we further estimate the detection-to-universal ratio to be $Z_D/Z_U \simeq 3$, twice the two-boundary value of $3/2$. These results suggest that a fine-tuned probe localized on one boundary can test the proposed three-boundary shell state and potentially distinguish it from its two-boundary counterpart.

classification.title_zh: 三边界书册几何的构造与探测
classification.abstract_zh: 部分纠缠热态（PETS）通过重壳插入提供了半经典的黑洞微观态族。我们扩展这种壳态框架，通过将双指标插入数据替换为三价结点张量，提出三边界部分纠缠热态（PETS$_3$）。相应的体三边界书册几何由 Israel 连接条件在半经典层面约束，使我们能够识别候选的对称分支和混合取向分支。我们通过在对称全黑洞扇区计数态来验证该构造的自洽性。利用重算符探针，我们进一步估计探测与普适之比为 $Z_D/Z_U \simeq 3$，是双边界值 $3/2$ 的两倍。这些结果表明，局域在一个边界上的精细调节探针可以检验所提出的三边界壳态，并有可能将其与双边界对应物区分开。
classification.one_liner: 将 PETS 框架推广到三边界，用 Israel 连接条件构造书册几何，并用重算符探针给出 $Z_D/Z_U\simeq 3$。

papers.title: The Origin and Fate of Rapid Negative Modes in Coleman--De Luccia Tunneling
papers.abstract: Coleman--De Luccia tunneling can exhibit an infinite tower of rapidly oscillating negative modes, complicating the semiclassical evaluation of the path integral. We show that this tower does not represent infinitely many bounce-specific instabilities, but instead is tied to a single underlying gravitational conformal sector. This sector is exposed in two different ways: by a large scalar gradient near the bubble wall and by the turning point of a compact Euclidean geometry. The corresponding conformal sector is already present in fluctuations about the false vacuum. Treating the bounce and the false vacuum in the same well-defined gauge and with a common regulator, we find that their high-frequency negative spectra approach one another. The ultraviolet tower therefore cancels from the relative negative-mode count, leaving a single bounce-specific negative mode. This clears a major conceptual obstacle toward a systematic calculation of the Coleman--De Luccia prefactor.

classification.title_zh: Coleman--De Luccia 隧穿中快速负模的起源与命运
classification.abstract_zh: Coleman--De Luccia 隧穿可以表现出无限多的快速振荡负模，使路径积分的半经典计算复杂化。我们表明，这一模态塔并不代表无限多个 bounce 特有的不稳定性，而是与一个单一的底层引力共形扇区相关。该扇区以两种方式暴露：气泡壁附近的大标量梯度，以及紧致欧几里得几何的转折点。相应的共形扇区已经存在于假真空附近的涨落中。通过在同一良定义规范中并采用共同正规化子处理 bounce 与假真空，我们发现它们的高频负谱彼此接近。因此，紫外模态塔在相对负模计数中相消，只留下一个 bounce 特有的负模。这清除了系统计算 Coleman--De Luccia 前因子的一大概念障碍。
classification.one_liner: Coleman--De Luccia 隧穿的无限负模塔源于同一引力共形扇区，在 bounce 与假真空之间相消，仅留一个真实负模，为前因子计算铺路。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究 Coleman--De Luccia 气泡成核/真空衰变中的负模与引力共形扇区，匹配重点标签“相变与气泡成核”；属于半经典 Euclidean 引力，也匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”。不涉及全息。

papers.title: Dirichlet gravitons in AdS$_4$ and $\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$ wedge algebra
papers.abstract: We derive the AdS deformation of the flat-space soft-graviton algebra with Dirichlet boundary conditions. Starting from the AdS$_4$ spinor-helicity representation, we Mellin-transform linearized graviton solutions and construct the AdS wedge, including its Laurent completion. The Dirichlet boundary condition pairs opposite helicities, while AdS covariance fixes their relative normalization. Assuming linear closure and normalizing the global modes to reproduce the geometric AdS isometries, covariance and the Jacobi identities uniquely determine the soft-mode bracket. The result is the wedge of $\mathcal L_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$, where $\Lambda=-\ell^{-2}$. This provides a bulk derivation of the cosmological-constant deformation that incorporates the AdS boundary condition, without relying on collinear splitting functions or a self-dual truncation.

classification.title_zh: AdS4 中的 Dirichlet 引力子与 L_Λ w_{1+∞} wedge 代数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 Dirichlet 边界条件下推导平直空间软引力子代数的 AdS 变形。从 AdS4 的旋量-螺旋度表示出发，对线性化引力子解做 Mellin 变换，并构造 AdS wedge，包括其 Laurent 完备化。Dirichlet 边界条件将相反螺旋度配对，而 AdS 协变性固定它们的相对归一化。假设线性闭合，并把全局模归一化以重现几何 AdS 等距变换，协变性与 Jacobi 恒等式唯一确定软模括号。所得结果是 L_Λ w_{1+∞} 的 wedge，其中 Λ = -ℓ⁻²。这给出了一个包含 AdS 边界条件的宇宙学常数变形的体空间推导，而不依赖共线分裂函数或自对偶截断。
classification.one_liner: 通过 Mellin 变换和 Dirichlet 边界条件，在 AdS4 体空间推导软引力子代数，得到 L_Λ w_{1+∞} 的 wedge。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与天球/软引力子代数的基础理论工作，未涉及用户列出的全息凝聚态、相变、QNM、探针膜等具体重点支线，因此相关性较低。

papers.title: Emergent Symmetries in Ensemble Averages
papers.abstract: It is widely believed that there are no exact global symmetries in quantum gravity. We review recent works showing that global symmetries can nevertheless emerge after ensemble averages of theories, as encountered in holography. As a precision case study, we discuss the ensemble average of two-dimensional Narain-type conformal field theories associated with an even quadratic form of general signature, which is computed by the Siegel-Weil formula and interpreted as a sum over geometries in a three-dimensional Abelian Chern-Simons theory. Global symmetries of the bulk anyons can emerge after the average, as T-dualities relating different theories in the ensemble are "folded" into symmetries of a single theory (duality origami). We discuss the relation to the Swampland program, including the emergence of global symmetries at infinite distance. Finally, we recast strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB) of mixed states as an emergence of symmetries in ensemble averages; in holography, wormholes connecting the two sides of a thermofield-double construction provide its bulk realization. This motivates a new Swampland conjecture.

classification.title_zh: 系综平均中的涌现对称性
classification.abstract_zh: 人们普遍认为量子引力中不存在精确的全局对称性。我们综述近期工作，表明在理论系综平均之后全局对称性仍可涌现，正如全息中所遇到的情形。作为一个精确案例研究，我们讨论与一般签名的偶二次型相关的二维 Narain 型共形场论的系综平均，它由 Siegel-Weil 公式计算，并解释为三维 Abel Chern-Simons 理论中的几何求和。在平均之后，体任意子的全局对称性可以涌现，因为联系系综中不同理论的 T-对偶被“折叠”为单一理论的对称性（对偶折纸）。我们讨论其与 Swampland 纲领的关系，包括无穷远距离处全局对称性的涌现。最后，我们将混合态的强到弱自发对称性破缺（SWSSB）重新表述为系综平均中对称性的涌现；在全息中，连接热场双构造两侧的虫洞提供了其体实现。这启发了一个新的 Swampland 猜想。
classification.one_liner: 综述：理论系综平均（如全息中的 Narain CFT 系综）可涌现全局对称性，并联系 T-对偶折纸、Swampland 与混合态 SWSSB 的虫洞实现。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为全息系综平均与量子引力中的全局对称性，属于 AdS/CFT 基础/Swampland 方向；不直接对应列出的重点支线（全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、QNM、经典引力等）。

papers.title: Carroll-Weyl symmetries in flat holography
papers.abstract: The degenerate geometry of a null boundary admits an enlarged local conformal freedom: in two dimensions, a Carrollian coframe allows two independent Weyl rescalings, one modulating and the other preserving the boundary volume form. We investigate whether both transformations can be realized as charged asymptotic symmetries in three-dimensional flat holography. We show that Einstein gravity canonically realizes the volume-modulating Carroll-Weyl transformation, together with local Carroll boosts, but does not admit the volume-preserving rescaling as an additional independent asymptotic symmetry. We trace this obstruction both back to the conformal completion of null infinity and to the absence of two independent commuting semisimple generators in the Poincar\'e algebra. Conformal gravity overcomes this obstruction through bulk dilatations, which supply the missing algebraic direction. We construct an asymptotically flat phase space of conformal gravity in which both types of Carroll-Weyl transformations and local Carroll boosts admit finite, integrable, and generically nonvanishing canonical charges, and derive their centrally extended algebra. Finally, we show that these central extensions arise from boundary anomalies through symplectic descent, yielding a gravitational prediction for Carroll-Weyl anomalies in flat holography.

classification.title_zh: 平直全息中的 Carroll-Weyl 对称性
classification.abstract_zh: 零类边界的退化几何允许一个扩大的局部共形自由度：在二维中，Carrollian 余标架允许两个独立的 Weyl 重标度，一个调制边界的体积形式，另一个保持边界体积形式不变。我们研究这两种变换是否都能在三维平直全息中实现为带电的渐近对称性。我们证明，Einstein 引力典型地实现体积调制的 Carroll-Weyl 变换以及局部 Carroll boost，但不允许将保体积重标度作为额外的独立渐近对称性。我们将这一阻碍追溯到零无穷的共形完成，以及 Poincaré 代数中不存在两个独立对易的半单生成元。共形引力通过体膨胀克服这一阻碍，体膨胀提供了缺失的代数方向。我们构造共形引力的渐近平坦相空间，其中两类 Carroll-Weyl 变换和局部 Carroll boost 都允许有限、可积且一般非零的规范荷，并推导其中心扩张代数。最后，我们表明这些中心扩张通过辛下降来自边界反常，从而给出平直全息中 Carroll-Weyl 反常的引力预测。
classification.one_liner: 在三维平直全息中，Einstein 引力只实现体积调制的 Carroll-Weyl 变换，而共形引力可通过体膨胀实现两类 Carroll-Weyl 变换并产生中心扩张与反常预测。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于平直全息/BMS-Carroll 与经典引力方向，涉及渐近对称性、共形引力、中心扩张和边界反常；与重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论相关，但不直接匹配全息超导、QNM、探针膜等具体支线。

papers.title: Signatures of Bulk Topology from the 't Hooft Worldsheet
papers.abstract: We study entanglement entropy in a certain ansatz of matrix quantum mechanics (MQM) wavefunctions which behave as generating functionals for a planar 't Hooft expansion. We argue that these 't Hooft diagrammatics can directly probe aspects of the topology of the bulk dual, such as the contractibility of a thermal or replica $S^1$ cycle. Our argument relies on treating 't Hooft diagrams as a non-perturbative definition of off-shell string theory worldsheets in which contractibility of replica cycle leads to worldsheets punctured by a conical deficit (as first described by Susskind and Uglum). We describe how a deconfinement transition in the MQM is tied to the exchange of dominant topologies, as well as to a candidate description of open string 'edge modes' of Susskind and Uglum. Lastly, we study toy models of black hole evaporation and show that the boundary planar expansion itself diagnoses the exchange of dominance between the disconnected topology and replica wormhole topology, without ensemble averaging and without independently postulating which bulk saddles should be included.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 从 't Hooft 世界面看体拓扑的特征
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究矩阵量子力学（MQM）波函数某一拟设下的纠缠熵，这些波函数充当平面 't Hooft 展开的生成泛函。我们论证这些 't Hooft 图可以直接探测体对偶的拓扑方面，例如热 S^1 或副本 S^1 圈的可收缩性。我们的论证依赖于将 't Hooft 图视为非微扰地定义离壳弦论世界面，其中副本圈的可收缩性导致世界面被锥形亏损穿孔（由 Susskind 和 Uglum 首次描述）。我们描述 MQM 中的退禁闭相变如何与主导拓扑的交换相关，以及如何与 Susskind 和 Uglum 的开弦‘边缘模’的候选描述相关。最后，我们研究黑洞蒸发的玩具模型，并表明边界平面展开本身就能诊断非连通拓扑与副本虫洞拓扑之间主导地位的交换，而无需系综平均，也无需独立假设应包含哪些体鞍点。
classification.one_liner: 将平面 't Hooft 图视为离壳弦世界面，用其拓扑特征探测体对偶，并诊断退禁闭与副本虫洞主导交换。

papers.title: Type IIB supergravity solutions for polarized IKKT
papers.abstract: The general local solutions to complexified Type IIB supergravity which are invariant under the complex Lie superalgebra $F(4)$, and which were derived and classified in arXiv:2508.14959, are supplemented here by the construction of their flux potentials and field strengths. We then focus on the Type IIB$^\star$ real form of complex Type IIB supergravity, where we obtain solutions with spacetime metric of the warped product form $dS_{1,5}\times S^2\times\Sigma$. We systematically derive boundary and regularity conditions under which the $dS_{1,5}\times S^2\times\Sigma$ solutions can be analytically continued to regular $S^6\times S^2\times\Sigma$ solutions in Euclidean Type IIB supergravity. Using these results, we construct explicit global solutions. These solutions include explicit realizations of recent proposals for a holographic description of the polarized IKKT model, and we clarify the charges carried by these solutions. We also obtain novel solutions in the same regularity class with different brane charges.

classification.title_zh: 极化 IKKT 模型的 Type IIB 超引力解
classification.abstract_zh: 在 arXiv:2508.14959 中导出并分类的、在复化 Type IIB 超引力中保持复李超代数 F(4) 不变的一般局域解，在此通过构造其通量势和场强得到补充。随后我们关注复 Type IIB 超引力的 Type IIB* 实形式，其中我们获得时空度规为扭曲乘积形式 dS_{1,5}×S^2×Σ 的解。我们系统地推导边界条件和正则性条件，使得 dS_{1,5}×S^2×Σ 解可以解析延拓为欧几里得 Type IIB 超引力中的正则 S^6×S^2×Σ 解。利用这些结果，我们构造显式的整体解。这些解包括对最近关于极化 IKKT 模型全息描述的提议的显式实现，并澄清这些解携带的荷。我们还获得同一正则类中具有不同膜荷的新解。
classification.one_liner: 构造了 Type IIB* 超引力中 dS_{1,5}×S^2×Σ 的全局解，可解析延拓至欧几里得 S^6×S^2×Σ，并实现极化 IKKT 的全息描述提议。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息/超引力解构造，但未涉及用户重点标签中的全息凝聚态、超流超导、探针膜、QNM、经典引力等具体支线；与极化 IKKT/矩阵模型全息有间接关系。

papers.title: Allowable complex saddles with real charges in the gravitational index
papers.abstract: We present a new supersymmetric, non-extremal complexification of asymptotically $\mathrm{AdS}$ black holes, characterized by real charges and multiple complex horizons. We investigate whether these solutions define admissible supersymmetric saddles of the gravitational path integral by applying the Kontsevich-Segal-Witten (KSW) criterion, and compare the resulting gravitational constraints with the convergence conditions of the dual superconformal index. For most of the cases studied, the KSW criterion in the asymptotic region agrees with the index convergence, while the full bulk condition is more stringent and excludes saddles whose chemical potentials lie within the index-convergence domain.

classification.title_zh: 引力指标中具有实电荷的可允许复鞍点
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一类新的渐近AdS黑洞的超对称、非极端复化，其特征是实电荷和多个复视界。我们应用Kontsevich-Segal-Witten（KSW）判据研究这些解是否定义了引力路径积分的可允许超对称鞍点，并将得到的引力约束与对偶超共形指标的收敛条件进行比较。对于所研究的大多数情况，渐近区域中的KSW判据与指标收敛一致，而完整体条件更严格，并排除了化学势位于指标收敛域内的鞍点。
classification.one_liner: 提出带实电荷的渐近AdS黑洞复化超对称鞍点，用KSW判据检验其可允许性并与对偶超共形指标收敛条件对比。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于AdS/CFT与黑洞/量子引力方向，讨论引力路径积分复鞍点与超共形指标，但未直接落在用户列出的重点标签支线内。

papers.title: How Neutron Star Radii Encode the Dense-Matter Equation of State and Hadron-Quark Transition
papers.abstract: We investigate how future high-precision neutron star (NS) radius measurements encode microscopic information about the dense-matter equation of state (EOS), focusing on a possible first-order hadron--quark phase transition and the resulting mass--radius topology. Within a Bayesian framework using meta-model EOSs with nine microscopic parameters, we analyze mock radius measurements $R_{1.4}=11.9\pm\sigma_R$ km with $\sigma_R=0.9$ and $0.1$ km for canonical NSs. We introduce inverse EOS--radius mappings by studying the conditional mean of each EOS parameter as a function of the model-predicted canonical radius $R_{1.4}$. Their slope measures the sensitivity of an EOS parameter to the radius, while their curvature determines the leading precision dependence of its posterior mean through the Jensen expansion. The symmetry-energy parameters $L$ (slope) and $K_{\rm sym}$ (curvature) are strongly encoded in $R_{1.4}$ and their posterior means shift appreciably with improved radius precision, whereas the higher-order hadronic parameters show stronger topology dependence. Among the transition parameters, the transition density $\rho_t$ is the most strongly encoded in $R_{1.4}$, while the energy-density jump and quark-matter sound speed are more strongly associated with the topology of the full mass--radius sequence. Since the different topologies have strongly overlapping $R_{1.4}$ distributions, even precise radius measurements cannot by themselves identify the topology or uniquely determine the high-density transition properties. These results provide a parameter-dependent hierarchy for assessing the scientific return of future high-precision radius measurements and complementary probes of high-density NS EOS.

classification.title_zh: 中子星半径如何编码致密物质状态方程与强子-夸克相变
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究未来高精度中子星（NS）半径测量如何编码致密物质状态方程（EOS）的微观信息，重点关注可能的一阶强子-夸克相变及其导致的质径拓扑。在贝叶斯框架下，使用含九个微观参数的元模型EOS，我们分析了对典型中子星的模拟半径测量 R_{1.4}=11.9\pm\sigma_R km，其中 \sigma_R=0.9 和 0.1 km。我们通过研究每个EOS参数的条件均值作为模型预言的典型半径 R_{1.4} 的函数，引入逆EOS-半径映射。其斜率度量EOS参数对半径的敏感度，而曲率通过Jensen展开决定其后验均值对精度的主导依赖。对称能参数 L（斜率）和 K_sym（曲率）被强烈编码在 R_{1.4} 中，且其后验均值随半径精度提高而显著移动，而更高阶强子参数表现出更强的拓扑依赖性。在相变参数中，相变密度 \rho_t 最强烈地编码在 R_{1.4} 中，而能量密度跳变和夸克物质声速与完整质径序列的拓扑更密切相关。由于不同拓扑的 R_{1.4} 分布强烈重叠，即使精确的半径测量本身也不能识别拓扑或唯一确定高密度相变性质。这些结果为评估未来高精度半径测量和高密度NS EOS互补探针的科学回报提供了参数依赖的层级。
classification.one_liner: 中子星半径对致密物质EOS参数的编码存在层级，且难以单独区分强子-夸克相变拓扑。

papers.title: What We Have Learned from NICER About Neutron Star Radii
papers.abstract: The cores of neutron stars have a combination of density, temperature, and neutron-proton asymmetry that cannot be replicated in laboratories or understood using first-principles quantum chromodynamics. Thus, observations of neutron stars are necessary to understand this regime. In particular, precise and accurate measurements of neutron star radii are highly informative about cold, catalyzed matter at a few times nuclear saturation density. X-ray observations with NASA's Neutron star Interior Composition Explorer (NICER) have yielded radius measurements for a few nonaccreting neutron stars, which have advanced substantially our understanding of dense matter. In this review we discuss the NICER radius measurements and their implications and demonstrate that the systematic errors thus far explored in NICER analyses have at most a minor effect on the inferred radii of neutron stars.

classification.title_zh: 我们从 NICER 关于中子星半径中学到了什么
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星核心所具有的密度、温度以及中子-质子不对称性的组合，无法在实验室中复制，也无法用第一性原理量子色动力学理解。因此，观测中子星对于理解这一区域是必要的。特别是，对中子星半径的精确测量，对于了解几倍核饱和密度下的冷催化物质极具信息量。NASA 的中子星内部组成探测器（NICER）的 X 射线观测已给出若干非吸积中子星的半径测量，这大大推进了我们对致密物质的理解。在这篇综述中，我们讨论 NICER 的半径测量及其启示，并表明迄今在 NICER 分析中探索的系统误差对推断出的中子星半径至多只有次要影响。
classification.one_liner: 综述 NICER 对非吸积中子星半径的 X 射线测量及其对致密物质状态方程的约束，并指出已探索系统误差影响较小。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为中子星 X 射线观测与致密物质约束，不属于全息/量子引力；仅与经典引力/中子星分支有边缘关联。

papers.title: Bayesian Constraints on Bosonic Dark Matter in Neutron Stars within a Covariant Density-Functional Equation-of-State Ensemble
papers.abstract: We investigate neutron stars admixed with repulsively self-interacting bosonic dark matter (DM) using current multi-messenger observations. The dark component is modeled as a complex scalar field coupled to baryonic matter only through gravity, allowing dark-core and dark-halo configurations. To quantify baryonic equation-of-state (EOS) uncertainties, we combine a three-dimensional scan over $(m_\chi,\lambda,F_\chi)$ with 27 DDME2-based covariant density-functional EOSs spanning $L_{\rm sym}=30,50,70$ MeV and $-600\le Q_{\rm sat}\le 1000$ MeV. The models are confronted in a Bayesian framework with NICER mass--radius measurements from the Amsterdam and Maryland/Illinois analyses and the GW170817 tidal-deformability constraint. After Bayesian evidence weighting over the EOS ensemble, the EOS-relevant dark-sector scale $\mu_\chi\equiv m_\chi/\lambda^{1/4}$ is localized around 250 MeV for both NICER data sets. In the $(m_\chi,\lambda)$ parameterization, the marginalized boson-mass posterior peaks at $m_\chi\simeq300$--$330$ MeV, while $\lambda$ remains broadly distributed. Since the bosonic EOS depends on $m_\chi$ and $\lambda$ only through $\mu_\chi$, their separate marginals are conditional on the adopted independent priors. The inferred DM fraction is more data-set dependent, with posterior modes near 4% for Maryland/Illinois and 12% for Amsterdam. Bosonic DM also shifts the inferred $Q_{\rm sat}$ from negative toward intermediate and positive values, whereas the response of $L_{\rm sym}$ is weaker. This indicates a model-dependent trade-off between DM-induced compactification and the high-density stiffness of baryonic matter. These constraints remain conditional on the selected EOS family and the assumption of a common effective $F_\chi$ for all sources.

classification.title_zh: 协变密度泛函状态方程系综中中子星内玻色暗物质的贝叶斯约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用当前多信使观测研究中子星中混合有排斥性自相互作用玻色暗物质（DM）的情形。暗物质成分被建模为复标量场，仅通过引力与重子物质耦合，从而允许暗核与暗晕位形。为量化重子状态方程（EOS）不确定性，我们将对 (mχ, λ, Fχ) 的三维扫描与 27 个基于 DDME2 的协变密度泛函 EOS 相结合，这些 EOS 覆盖 L_sym=30、50、70 MeV 以及 -600≤Q_sat≤1000 MeV。在贝叶斯框架中，将这些模型与来自 Amsterdam 和 Maryland/Illinois 分析的 NICER 质量—半径测量以及 GW170817 潮汐形变约束进行对比。在对 EOS 系综进行贝叶斯证据加权后，对于两个 NICER 数据集，与 EOS 相关的暗部门标度 μχ≡mχ/λ^{1/4} 被局域在 250 MeV 附近。在 (mχ, λ) 参数化中，边缘化后的玻色子质量后验峰值位于 mχ≃300–330 MeV，而 λ 仍呈宽分布。由于玻色 EOS 仅通过 μχ 依赖于 mχ 和 λ，它们各自单独的边缘分布以所采用的独立先验为条件。推断出的暗物质分数更依赖于数据集，Maryland/Illinois 的后验众数接近 4%，Amsterdam 接近 12%。玻色暗物质还将推断出的 Q_sat 从负值移向中间值和正值，而 L_sym 的响应较弱。这表明在暗物质诱导的致密化与重子物质的高密度刚度之间存在模型相关的权衡。这些约束仍以所选 EOS 族以及所有源具有共同有效 Fχ 的假设为条件。
classification.one_liner: 利用 NICER 与 GW170817 数据，在 27 个协变密度泛函 EOS 系综上对中子星内自相互作用玻色暗物质给出贝叶斯约束，得到暗部门标度约 250 MeV。

papers.title: Higher-order statistics of the stochastic gravitational wave background from supermassive black hole binaries
papers.abstract: Recent progress in gravitational wave observations has positioned pulsar timing arrays as a key tool for detecting the stochastic gravitational wave background in the nanohertz band. It is widely believed that this background is primarily attributed to the cosmic ensemble of inspiraling supermassive black hole binaries. While traditional analyses have predominantly focused on the spectral amplitude and frequency dependence of the gravitational wave background, higher-order statistics such as variance, skewness, and excess kurtosis could potentially be useful for extracting further physical information. However, these statistical moments are known to diverge when the redshift integration is extended down to z=0. In this study, we propose a strategy to resolve this issue by introducing a physically motivated lower integration limit, z_min, defined by the sensitivity for detecting individual sources. Since higher-order statistics are primarily determined by local sources, we may adopt the lowest-order approximation with respect to redshift in their computations. Under this approximation, we demonstrate that all higher-order statistics beyond the expectation value depend on the mass function only through a weighted average of the chirp mass, <\mathcal{M}^{10/3}>, irrespective of the redshift evolution model. We show that the ratio of the variance to the expectation value provides information on <\mathcal{M}^{10/3}>/<\mathcal{M}^{5/3}> independently of the total number of mergers. We also find a consistency relation between the excess kurtosis and the squared skewness, paving the way for testing the binary-origin hypothesis of the gravitational wave background. Our findings demonstrate that higher-order statistics provide a new window for interpreting the gravitational wave background, offering a methodology to break existing degeneracies and refine our understanding of the mass function.

classification.title_zh: 超大质量黑洞双星产生的随机引力波背景的高阶统计
classification.abstract_zh: 最近引力波观测的进展使脉冲星计时阵列成为探测纳赫兹频段随机引力波背景的关键工具。人们普遍认为该背景主要来自宇宙中相互旋进的超大质量黑洞双星群体。传统分析主要关注引力波背景的谱振幅和频率依赖性，而方差、偏度和超额峰度等高阶统计量可能有助于提取更多物理信息。然而，已知当红移积分延伸至 z=0 时，这些统计矩会发散。在本研究中，我们提出一种策略，通过引入物理动机的下积分下限 z_min 来解决该问题，该下限由探测单个源的灵敏度定义。由于高阶统计量主要由局部源决定，我们可以在其计算中采用关于红移的最低阶近似。在此近似下，我们证明除期望值外所有高阶统计量仅通过啁啾质量的加权平均 <M^{10/3}> 依赖于质量函数，而与红移演化模型无关。我们表明方差与期望值之比提供了关于 <M^{10/3}>/<M^{5/3}> 的信息，且不依赖于并合总数。我们还发现超额峰度与偏度平方之间的一致性关系，为检验引力波背景的双星起源假设开辟了道路。我们的发现表明高阶统计量为解释引力波背景提供了新窗口，提供了一种打破现有简并并改进对质量函数理解的方法。
classification.one_liner: 通过引入由单源探测灵敏度定义的 z_min 并采用低红移近似，论文给出超大质量黑洞双星随机引力波背景高阶统计量的可观测关系，用于检验双星起源并限制啁啾质量分布。

papers.title: A Systematic Study of Resonance-Driven Flux Modifications in Extreme-Mass-Ratio Inspirals
papers.abstract: Transient orbital resonances can introduce phase-dependent corrections to the evolution of extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs), potentially altering their long-term dynamics and emitted gravitational-wave signals. In this work, we quantify the resonance-induced modifications to the energy, axial angular momentum, and Carter constant fluxes and compute the corresponding resonance coefficients across a broad region of the orbital parameter space. Using the publicly available $\texttt{pybhpt}$ code, we solve the Teukolsky equation in the frequency domain to coherently combine the degenerate radial and polar harmonics that arise at resonance. We analytically derive a selection rule governing the relative radial-polar phase dependence of the resonant flux modifications. We argue that the relative strength of the resonant flux modifications reflects a balance between symmetry-induced cancellations and the degree to which the resonant orbit samples the underlying two-dimensional orbital phase space. For the dynamically important $3{:}2$ and $2{:}1$ resonances, we also characterize how the resonance coefficients vary with the primary black-hole spin, orbital eccentricity and inclination. Our results constitute the largest set of Teukolsky-based resonance coefficients calculated to date and provide essential input for future studies of transient orbital resonances in EMRIs.

classification.title_zh: 极端质量比旋进中共振驱动通量修正的系统研究
classification.abstract_zh: 瞬态轨道共振可对极端质量比旋进（EMRI）的演化引入相位依赖修正，可能改变其长期动力学与发出的引力波信号。本文量化共振引起的能量、轴向角动量和 Carter 常数通量修正，并在较宽的轨道参数空间计算相应的共振系数。我们使用公开的 pybhpt 代码，在频率域求解 Teukolsky 方程，以相干地组合共振时出现的简并径向与极向谐波。我们解析推导出一条选择定则，支配共振通量修正的相对径向-极向相位依赖。我们认为，共振通量修正的相对强度反映了对称性导致的对消与共振轨道对底层二维轨道相空间采样程度之间的平衡。对于动力学上重要的 3:2 和 2:1 共振，我们还刻画了共振系数如何随主黑洞自旋、轨道偏心率和倾角变化。我们的结果构成了迄今最大的基于 Teukolsky 的共振系数集合，为未来 EMRI 瞬态轨道共振研究提供关键输入。
classification.one_liner: 通过频域 Teukolsky 计算系统量化 EMRI 瞬态轨道共振对能量、角动量与 Carter 常数通量及共振系数的修正。

papers.title: On the geometrical and dynamical distinction between Unimodular and General Relativistic wormholes
papers.abstract: We characterize traversable wormholes in Unimodular Gravity (UG) and investigate what distinguishes them from their General Relativistic (GR) counterparts. For a class of static and spherically symmetric solutions, we analyze their embedding and timelike geodesics, showing that the geodesic structure is entirely determined by the metric and is therefore identical in both theories. To identify the physical origin of their differences, we compare the source sectors required to sustain the same wormhole geometry. We find that preserving a fixed UG geometry while imposing energy-momentum conservation requires restricting the equation of state, whereas relaxing this condition introduces an effective inhomogeneous vacuum contribution. We further show that the degree of exoticity is preserved even when energy-momentum is not conserved, while departures from the GR sector are encoded in an effective inhomogeneous vacuum structure whose asymptotic behavior resembles that of a cosmological constant. Our results reinforce that UG is geometrically equivalent to GR, while its distinctive features emerge in the dynamical interpretation of the source sector. More generally, our analysis illustrates that different gravitational theories may give rise to identical spacetime geometries while requiring different sources to sustain them.

classification.title_zh: 论幺模引力与广义相对论虫洞的几何与动力学区别
classification.abstract_zh: 我们刻画了幺模引力（UG）中的可穿越虫洞，并研究它们与广义相对论（GR）对应物的区别。对于一类静态球对称解，我们分析其嵌入和类时测地线，表明测地线结构完全由度规决定，因此在两种理论中相同。为识别其差异的物理起源，我们比较维持同一虫洞几何所需的源扇区。我们发现，在保持固定 UG 几何的同时施加能量-动量守恒，需要限制状态方程，而放宽该条件则引入一种有效非均匀真空贡献。我们进一步表明，即使能量-动量不守恒，奇异性的程度仍然保持，而对 GR 扇区的偏离编码在有效非均匀真空结构中，其渐近行为类似宇宙学常数。我们的结果强化了 UG 在几何上等价于 GR，而其独特特征出现在源扇区的动力学解释中。更一般地，我们的分析表明，不同引力理论可以产生相同的时空几何，但需要不同的源来维持它们。
classification.one_liner: 比较幺模引力与广义相对论中的可穿越虫洞，指出二者几何与测地线相同，差异体现在维持同一几何所需的源扇区与动力学解释。

papers.title: A Physical space derivation of Morawetz-Energy estimates in Kerr spacetimes with large angular momentum
papers.abstract: We revisit the derivation of Morawetz-energy estimates for scalar wave equations in the domain of outer communication of a Kerr spacetime $\KK(a,m)$. Our goal is to develop robust physical space methods which are well suited for extension to realistic perturbations of Kerr. The proof rests on several ingredients. First, we derive conditional Morawetz estimates which extend the physical space techniques initiated by Andersson and Blue \cite{AB}, and later adapted in \cite{GKS} to perturbations of slowly rotating Kerr, by exploiting a physical-space characterization of the full $r$-range of trapped null geodesics. Second, we use an idea introduced by Stogin \cite{St} in the axially symmetric case to handle the low-frequency difficulties in the Morawetz estimates. In the general case, the control of the lower order terms also requires making full use of the principal trapping term in the Morawetz bulk norm, together with a new use of Hardy-type inequalities. A crucial new ingredient is the control of the boundary terms generated by the Morawetz estimates. We use as input the results of our companion paper \cite{He-K2}, which provides a frequency independent estimate for the flux based on a purely physical space version of the seminal Whiting transform \cite{W}. Finally, a continuity argument yields an unconditional global-in-time Morawetz estimate, while a new energy estimate is obtained from the construction of a causal vectorfield which is Killing on the trapping set. In this new version we have added a new, much simpler, proof which covers the full subextremal case. The results proved here are restricted to scalar wave equations, corresponding to spin $0$, in the range $|a|/m\leq 0.75$. We expect this restriction to be technical, and the methods developed in this paper to extend to the Teukolsky equation.

classification.title_zh: 大角动量 Kerr 时空中 Morawetz 能量估计的物理空间推导
classification.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视 Kerr 时空 K(a,m) 外通讯域中标量波动方程的 Morawetz 能量估计推导。目标是发展稳健的物理空间方法，以便推广到 Kerr 的实际扰动。证明依赖若干要素。首先，我们推导条件 Morawetz 估计，通过利用全 r 范围内陷获零测地线的物理空间刻画，扩展 Andersson-Blue 开创、后经 GKS 适配到慢转 Kerr 扰动的物理空间技术。其次，我们使用 Stogin 在轴对称情形引入的想法处理 Morawetz 估计中的低频困难。在一般情形，低阶项的控制还要求充分利用 Morawetz 体范数中的主陷获项，并新用 Hardy 型不等式。一个关键新要素是控制 Morawetz 估计产生的边界项。我们以姊妹篇 [He-K2] 的结果为输入，该结果基于 seminal Whiting 变换的纯物理空间版本给出频率无关的通量估计。最后，连续性论证给出无条件整体时间 Morawetz 估计，同时通过构造在陷获集上为 Killing 的因果向量场得到新的能量估计。在这个新版本中，我们增加了一个更简单的新证明，覆盖整个次极值情形。这里证明的结果限于自旋 0 的标量波动方程，且 |a|/m≤0.75。我们预期这一限制是技术性的，本文发展的方法可推广到 Teukolsky 方程。
classification.one_liner: 用纯物理空间方法在 Kerr 外通讯域中证明标量波方程的条件与整体 Morawetz 能量估计，覆盖 |a|/m≤0.75 的次极值 Kerr。

papers.title: The Depletion of Collisionless Dark Matter Spikes
papers.abstract: Dense concentrations of dark matter surrounding black holes provide a compelling opportunity to probe the nature of dark matter. In the classic Gondolo--Silk model, the adiabatic growth of a massive black hole in a dark matter cusp produces a steep density spike ($\rho \propto r^{-7/3}$), potentially inducing measurable gravitational-wave dephasings in intermediate and extreme mass-ratio inspirals (IMRIs/EMRIs). We challenge this paradigm by considering a collisionless dark matter spike embedded in a realistic nuclear star cluster. Using Fokker--Planck models of isotropic nuclear clusters, we show that mass segregation in a multi-mass stellar cusp accelerates relaxation relative to single-mass models, thereby driving the dark matter to the lower density $r^{-3/2}$ Bahcall--Wolf profile within 1 Gyr. In the inner regions, where the Fokker--Planck description breaks down, we model strong triple interactions between dark matter particles and EMRIs using post-Newtonian 3-body simulations. We show that EMRIs eject dark matter particles via gravitational slingshots, depleting the inner spike over a few Gyr. Because EMRI number densities are too low to drive two-body relaxation, and replenishment by DM self-relaxation is negligible, this depletion is irreversible. While the extent of EMRI-induced DM depletion depends on the EMRI rate and mass, we find reductions in densities by several orders of magnitude. As a result, the dark-matter-induced dephasings for EMRIs may fall below the LISA detectability threshold for massive black holes at $z = 3$ (2.14 Gyr) with masses $\lesssim 10^{5}\,M_\odot$ (for a low $\mathcal{O}(10) \, \mathrm{Gyr}^{-1}$ EMRI rate), extending to $\lesssim 10^6\,M_\odot$ for more realistic rates of $\mathcal{O}(100 - 300)\,$Gyr$^{-1}$. Our findings substantially reduce the parameter space over which massive black holes can host detectable collisionless dark matter spikes.

classification.title_zh: 无碰撞暗物质尖峰的耗竭
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞周围的高密度暗物质聚集为探测暗物质本质提供了有吸引力的机会。在经典的 Gondolo--Silk 模型中，大质量黑洞在暗物质尖峰中的绝热生长会产生陡峭的密度尖峰（ρ ∝ r^{-7/3}），并可能在中等质量比旋进（IMRIs）和极端质量比旋进（EMRIs）中引起可测量的引力波退相干。我们通过考虑嵌入真实核星团中的无碰撞暗物质尖峰来挑战这一范式。利用各向同性核星团的 Fokker--Planck 模型，我们表明多质量恒星尖峰中的质量分层会加速弛豫，相对于单质量模型，从而在 1 Gyr 内将暗物质驱动到较低密度的 r^{-3/2} Bahcall--Wolf 轮廓。在内区，Fokker--Planck 描述失效，我们用后牛顿三体模拟来建模暗物质粒子与 EMRI 之间的强三体相互作用。我们表明，EMRI 通过引力弹弓效应抛射暗物质粒子，在几 Gyr 内耗竭内区尖峰。由于 EMRI 数密度太低，不足以驱动两体弛豫，而暗物质自弛豫的补充又可忽略，这种耗竭是不可逆的。虽然 EMRI 引起的暗物质耗竭程度取决于 EMRI 速率和质量，我们发现密度降低可达几个数量级。因此，对于 z = 3（2.14 Gyr）、质量 ≲ 10^5 M⊙ 的大质量黑洞（对应低 O(10) Gyr^{-1} 的 EMRI 速率），EMRI 的暗物质诱导退相干可能低于 LISA 可探测阈值；对于更现实的 O(100-300) Gyr^{-1} 速率，这一质量上限可扩展到 ≲ 10^6 M⊙。我们的发现大幅缩小了大质量黑洞能够承载可探测无碰撞暗物质尖峰的参数空间。
classification.one_liner: 多质量核星团弛豫与 EMRI 引力弹弓会不可逆地耗竭黑洞周围的无碰撞暗物质尖峰，从而大幅压低 LISA 可探测的暗物质诱导引力波退相干参数空间。

papers.title: Slowly rotating Black Holes in DHOST Theories
papers.abstract: We study slowly rotating black hole solutions within Degenerate Higher Order Scalar Tensor (DHOST) theories. Starting from a static, spherically symmetric metric solution of a DHOST theory, we employ the Hartle-Thorne ansatz to model a slowly rotating spacetime. We show that the differential equation governing the frame-dragging function $\omega$ (which is supposed to depend on the radial coordinate only) is integrable for any DHOST theory allowing us to obtain its explicit form. We also consider angular dependence in $\omega$ and show that regularity at the horizon and at infinity forbids it, as in General Relativity. As an illustration of the formalism introduced here, we study the slowly-rotating version of black hole solutions with primary hair obtained recently, examining the influence of the rotation on the Innermost Stable Circular Orbit (ISCO) and on the circular light trajectories in the equatorial plane.

classification.title_zh: DHOST 理论中的慢转黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在退化高阶标量张量（DHOST）理论中研究慢转黑洞解。从某一 DHOST 理论的静态球对称度规解出发，采用 Hartle-Thorne 拟设来刻画慢转时空。我们证明，主导参考系拖曳函数 ω（通常假定仅依赖于径向坐标）的微分方程对任意 DHOST 理论均可积，从而使我们能够得到其显式形式。我们还考虑了 ω 对角度方向的依赖，并证明与广义相对论一样，视界处和无穷远处的正则性会排除这种依赖。作为本文所引入形式体系的例证，我们研究了近期获得的带原生毛（primary hair）黑洞解的慢转版本，考察转动对最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）以及赤道面上圆型光线轨迹的影响。
classification.one_liner: 在 DHOST 理论中构造慢转黑洞解，证明参考系拖曳方程可积，并分析转动对 ISCO 与赤道光测地线的影响。

papers.title: From Stars to Waves: Stochastic Inference of Microlensed Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: When strongly lensed gravitational waves pass through the stellar field of a lensing galaxy, they acquire additional phase and amplitude modulations from gravitational microlensing by stars and stellar remnants along the line of sight. These microlensed waveforms depend on the masses and positions of thousands or more of the most relevant stars required for numerical convergence of the wave-optics diffraction integral, so that their deterministic reconstruction from the data is computationally prohibitive. We formulate the detection and parameter estimation of such events as a stochastic inference problem and propose a solution with the implementation of normalizing flows. As a proof of principle, we use the inferred surrogate microlensing parameters to identify microlensing signatures and show that 10.2% of microlensed events can be detected at $\ge 3\sigma$ significance with third-generation gravitational-wave detector networks for source redshifts $z_s \le 2$. The correlation between the surrogate parameters and the density of the underlying stellar field further connects microlensing detection to the properties of the lensing galaxy. This approach opens the door to probing microlensing effects and the properties of the underlying stellar fields. Beyond microlensed gravitational waves, a similar construction may also be applied to other intrinsically stochastic inference problems, such as detecting post-merger gravitational waves from binary neutron star coalescence and signals from core-collapse supernovae.

classification.title_zh: 从恒星到波：微引力透镜引力波的随机推断
classification.abstract_zh: 当强透镜引力波穿过透镜星系的恒星场时，视线方向上恒星和恒星遗迹的引力微透镜会给它们带来额外的相位和振幅调制。这些微透镜波形依赖于成千上万乃至更多最相关恒星的质量和位置，而这些恒星对于波光学衍射积分的数值收敛是必需的，因此从数据中确定性地重构它们计算量过大。我们将此类事件的探测和参数估计表述为随机推断问题，并提出用归一化流实现的解决方案。作为原理验证，我们使用推断出的代理微透镜参数来识别微透镜特征，并表明对于源红移 z_s ≤ 2，第三代引力波探测器网络可以以 ≥3σ 显著性探测到 10.2% 的微透镜事件。代理参数与 underlying stellar field 密度之间的相关性进一步将微透镜探测与透镜星系性质联系起来。该方法为探测微透镜效应及其 underlying stellar fields 的性质打开了大门。除了微透镜引力波之外，类似构造还可应用于其他本质随机的推断问题，例如探测双中子星并合后引力波以及核心坍缩超新星信号。
classification.one_liner: 用归一化流对恒星微透镜调制的强透镜引力波进行随机推断，并评估第三代探测器识别微透镜信号的能力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典引力波在星系恒星场中的微引力透镜效应及随机推断，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Post-Newtonian orbital evolution and gravitational wave forms of inspiralling compact binaries with mass transfer and spin corrections
papers.abstract: In this article, we focus on the effects of mass transfer between binary stars and stellar spin on the post-Newtonian (PN) orbital evolution and gravitational waveforms of compact binary systems. We employ the 2.5PN approximation and the mass quadrupole formula to compute the orbital evolution and gravitational waveforms. After an exhaustive discussion of the astrophysical processes relevant to the scenarios of interest, we summarize a one-dimensional mass transfer model that uniformly treats common envelope evolution and tidal disruption, and derive an approximate expression for the dependence of the mass transfer rate of the material flow through the first Lagrange point L1 on the orbital angular velocity. Furthermore, based on the perturbed Keplerian approach, we present a two-dimensional model for the orbital evolution of compact binary systems that simultaneously accounts for mass transfer and stellar spin corrections. Through numerical simulations, we investigate binary systems with significant relativistic effects, namely NS-NS (neutron star-neutron star), NS-BH (neutron star-black hole), and BH-BH (black hole-black hole) systems, and demonstrate the influence of mass transfer and spin corrections on the orbital evolution and polarization waveforms of gravitational waves of these compact binaries systems.

classification.title_zh: 含质量转移与自旋修正的旋进致密双星后牛顿轨道演化与引力波波形
classification.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们关注双星之间的质量转移和恒星自旋对致密双星系统后牛顿（PN）轨道演化和引力波形的影响。我们采用2.5PN近似和质量四极矩公式计算轨道演化和引力波形。在详尽讨论相关天体物理过程后，我们总结了一个一维质量转移模型，统一处理公共包层演化和潮汐瓦解，并推导了通过第一拉格朗日点L1的物质流质量转移率对轨道角速度依赖的近似表达式。进一步，基于微扰开普勒方法，我们提出了一个同时考虑质量转移和恒星自旋修正的致密双星系统轨道演化的二维模型。通过数值模拟，我们研究了具有显著相对论效应的双星系统，即NS-NS（中子星-中子星）、NS-BH（中子星-黑洞）和BH-BH（黑洞-黑洞）系统，并展示了质量转移和自旋修正对这些致密双星系统轨道演化和引力波偏振波形的影响。

papers.title: Gravitational-wave dark sirens as astrophysical probes: inferring galaxy-merger relations and identifying individual hosts
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave (GW) ``dark siren'' techniques, namely the statistical association of GW events with a galaxy catalog, have so far been used as a cosmological tool. Yet this association carries distinctive astrophysical information that remains unused---specifically, how compact binaries populate galaxies and the identities of individual hosts. In this work, we turn the dark-siren program into an astrophysical probe by inferring both simultaneously within a single hierarchical framework. The method reduces the many potential hosts to a compact, probabilistically ranked target list, providing a direct follow-up decision tool. Applied blindly to GW170817, it recovers NGC~4993 as the highest-ranked host and constrains the galaxy luminosity weighting, mildly favoring non-uniform host weights. Fixing the galaxy weighting can instead degrade host identification and even favor the wrong host. This framework recasts dark sirens as a potentially unique probe of the astrophysics of electromagnetically dark compact-binary mergers.

classification.title_zh: 引力波暗汽笛作为天体物理探针：推断星系-并合关系并识别单个宿主
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波“暗汽笛”技术，即把引力波事件与星系表进行统计关联，迄今一直被用作宇宙学工具。然而这种关联携带着尚未被利用的独特天体物理信息——具体来说，致密双星如何分布于星系中，以及单个宿主的身份。在这项工作中，我们通过在单一层次框架内同时推断这两者，将暗汽笛计划转变为天体物理探针。该方法把众多潜在宿主约化为一个紧凑的、按概率排序的目标列表，为后续跟踪提供直接的决策工具。将其盲目应用于 GW170817，可恢复 NGC 4993 为排名最高的宿主，并约束星系光度权重，轻微偏向非均匀宿主权重。固定星系权重反而可能降低宿主识别效果，甚至偏向错误的宿主。该框架将暗汽笛重新表述为探测电磁暗弱致密双星并合天体物理的潜在独特探针。
classification.one_liner: 将引力波暗汽笛从宇宙学工具拓展为同时推断星系-并合关系和识别单个宿主的天体物理探针。

papers.title: Bayesian Evidence for Inspiraling Hotspot Motion in the Galactic Center
papers.abstract: During flaring episodes, polarimetric observations of the Galactic Center black hole Sagittarius A* (Sgr A*) reveal evolving, loop-like trajectories in the Stokes Q-U plane, the so-called Q-$U loops. Keplerian models of transiently energized orbiting features, hotspots, have been employed to reproduce these polarimetric signatures. In this work, we develop a Bayesian framework to infer the time-dependent kinematics of the hotspot from polarized light curves, using a general prescription for its motion. We model the emitting region's trajectory as a continuous, piecewise sequence of K kinematic segments, each described by radial and azimuthal velocity parameters. We perform analyses with K=1,2,3 and compare these models to millimeter-wavelength ALMA observations of Sgr A* from 2017 April 11 that include two subsequent Q-U loops, extending the observational constraints on the kinematics. We examine the effects of the local magnetic field geometry, spectral index, and kinematic profile of the hotspot's trajectory on the polarized signal. We find statistically significant evidence that the emitting region follows a non-geodesic inspiraling trajectory, and this preference over a strictly Keplerian orbit strengthens sharply when a longer data segment is modeled. The inspiraling non-Keplerian models are preferred to a purely Keplerian model based on both the Bayesian log-evidence comparison and the reduced chi-square statistic. Our results offer new insight into the nature of flaring events in the Galactic Center and the episodically produced hotspots associated with them.

classification.title_zh: 银河系中心热斑旋进运动的贝叶斯证据
classification.abstract_zh: 在耀发期间，对银河系中心黑洞人马座 A*（Sgr A*）的偏振观测在 Stokes Q-U 平面上显示出演化的环状轨迹，即 Q-U 环。此前人们用瞬时被激发的轨道特征——热斑——的开普勒模型来再现这些偏振信号。本文发展了一个贝叶斯框架，从偏振光变曲线推断热斑的含时运动学，并采用一般的运动描述。我们将辐射区轨迹建模为 K 个连续分段序列，每段由径向和方位角速度参数描述。我们以 K=1,2,3 进行分析，并与 2017 年 4 月 11 日 ALMA 对 Sgr A* 的毫米波观测比较；该观测包含两个相继的 Q-U 环，从而扩展了运动学观测约束。我们考察局域磁场几何、谱指数以及热斑轨迹的运动学剖面对偏振信号的影响。我们发现统计上显著的证据表明辐射区遵循非测地线的旋进轨迹；当建模更长的数据段时，相对于严格开普勒轨道的偏好显著增强。基于贝叶斯对数证据和约化卡方统计，旋进的非开普勒模型优于纯开普勒模型。这些结果为银河系中心耀发事件及其伴随的间歇性产生热斑的性质提供了新认识。
classification.one_liner: 用贝叶斯模型比较 Sgr A* 的偏振 Q-U 环，发现热斑更符合非测地线旋进轨迹而非纯开普勒轨道。

papers.title: Fast and Flow-rious: Gravitational Wave Background Bayesian Model Comparison using Normalizing Flows and Nested Sampling
papers.abstract: In 2023, pulsar timing array (PTA) collaborations around the world announced evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background (GWB). Beyond increasing the detection significance, the next major goal is to characterize the GWB and identify its source(s). The typical model-comparison metric used in PTA analyses is the Bayes factor (BF). However, BF computation methods used in the PTA literature, such as product-space sampling and thermodynamic integration, are computationally expensive or inefficient if the models compared are dissimilar or non-nested. In this work, we introduce a PTA model-comparison method using a combination of normalizing flows, nested sampling, and a PTA likelihood that is marginalized over all non-GWB parameters. The flows are trained using a newly-developed Python package coppuccino, which learns the data's copula: the dependence structure after transforming to uniform marginals. We validate the method on both analytic targets and simulated PTA data, recovering the analytic evidence within error bars and achieving an area-under-the-curve (AUC) score of 0.996 when treating the BFs as binary classifiers of the injected models. The result is a method to perform Bayesian model comparison of arbitrary GWB spectral models in minutes on consumer hardware.

classification.title_zh: 快速而流涌：使用归一化流与嵌套采样进行引力波背景贝叶斯模型比较
classification.abstract_zh: 2023年，全球的脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）合作组宣布了纳赫兹引力波背景（GWB）的证据。除了提高探测显著性，下一个主要目标是刻画GWB并确定其来源。PTA分析中典型的模型比较度量是贝叶斯因子（BF）。然而，PTA文献中使用的BF计算方法，如乘积空间采样和热力学积分，当所比较的模型不相似或非嵌套时，计算代价高昂或效率低下。在本工作中，我们引入一种PTA模型比较方法，结合了归一化流、嵌套采样以及一个对所有非GWB参数边缘化后的PTA似然。这些流使用新开发的Python包coppuccino训练，该包学习数据的copula：在变换到均匀边缘分布后的依赖结构。我们在解析目标和模拟PTA数据上验证了该方法，在误差棒内恢复了解析证据，并在将BF视作注入模型的二分类器时达到了0.996的曲线下面积（AUC）分数。结果是，一种在消费级硬件上几分钟内对任意GWB谱模型进行贝叶斯模型比较的方法。
classification.one_liner: 提出用归一化流、嵌套采样和边缘化PTA似然快速计算纳赫兹引力波背景模型贝叶斯因子。

papers.title: Orbital stability, relativistic precession, and QPO constraints for constant-curvature black holes in $f(R)$ gravity
papers.abstract: We analyze circular-orbit stability, epicyclic resonances, relativistic precession, and quasi-periodic-oscillation (QPO) constraints in the constant-curvature vacuum sector of metric $f(R)$ gravity. The Schwarzschild--(anti-)de~Sitter and Kerr--(anti-)de~Sitter backgrounds are characterized by curvature $R_0$ satisfying the algebraic trace equation. We derive stationary-coordinate-time orbital and epicyclic frequencies and determine stable timelike circular-orbit domains. Positive curvature confines stable motion between innermost and outermost stable circular orbits, which merge at a critical curvature, and permits two resonance radii for suitable frequency ratios. Negative curvature allows stable motion to arbitrarily large radii, with $\Omega_\theta/\Omega_r\rightarrow1/2$, compared with unity in the asymptotically flat limit. We determine the $3{:}2$, $2{:}1$, and $3{:}1$ resonance branches and signed nodal precession, recovering the Lense--Thirring limit. We also evaluate angular-momentum-weighted rigid-flow precession and viscous alignment, with the outermost stable orbit bounding positive-curvature flows. A Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo analysis combining the simultaneous GRO J1655--40 QPO triplet with an independent dynamical-mass measurement yields $R_0M^2=-5.57^{+12.94}_{-16.15}\times10^{-4}$ at $68\%$ credibility, conditional on the geodesic relativistic-precession prescription and adopted time normalization. Kerr remains allowed, with negligible fit improvement from nonzero curvature. Doubling the mass uncertainty broadens the curvature interval by approximately $2.1$; removing the mass likelihood reveals an extended, prior-dependent degeneracy. This is therefore a joint QPO and dynamical-mass constraint, with no significant evidence for departure from Kerr.

classification.title_zh: f(R) 引力中常曲率黑洞的轨道稳定性、相对论进动与 QPO 约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析度规 f(R) 引力常曲率真空部分中的圆轨道稳定性、epicyclic 共振、相对论进动以及准周期振荡（QPO）约束。Schwarzschild--(anti-)de Sitter 与 Kerr--(anti-)de Sitter 背景由满足代数迹方程的曲率 R0 刻画。我们导出静止坐标时下的轨道频率和 epicyclic 频率，并确定稳定的类时圆轨道区域。正曲率将稳定运动限制在最内与最外稳定圆轨道之间，二者在临界曲率处合并，并在适当频率比下允许两个共振半径。负曲率允许稳定运动延伸到任意大半径，且 Ωθ/Ωr → 1/2，而渐近平坦极限为 1。我们确定 3:2、2:1、3:1 共振分支和有符号节点进动，并重现 Lense--Thirring 极限。我们还评估角动量加权刚性流动进动和黏性对齐，其中最外稳定轨道界定了正曲率流动。结合 GRO J1655--40 同时 QPO 三重态与独立动力学质量测量的贝叶斯 MCMC 分析给出 R0 M^2 = -5.57^{+12.94}_{-16.15} × 10^{-4}（68% 可信度），其条件为测地线相对论进动方案和采用的时间归一化。Kerr 仍被允许，非零曲率对拟合的改善可忽略。将质量不确定度加倍使曲率区间扩展约 2.1 倍；移除质量似然则显示扩展的、依赖先验的简并。因此这是联合 QPO 与动力学质量约束，没有显著证据表明偏离 Kerr。
classification.one_liner: 在 f(R) 常曲率黑洞时空中研究轨道稳定性与相对论进动，并用 GRO J1655-40 QPO 约束曲率；结果与 Kerr 一致，无明显偏离。

papers.title: Scaling RIFT 1: Extending RIFT to third-generation gravitational-wave analyses
papers.abstract: Interpretation of compact binary signals observed by third-generation gravitational-wave detectors is complicated by their high signal-to-noise ratios, often reaching hundreds to thousands, and by time- and frequency-dependent detector responses arising from Earth's rotation and the detectors' large physical extent. Building on prior work for LISA, we implement generic, robust extensions of the RIFT parameter estimation pipeline that enable interpretation of these sources using any existing waveform model, without recourse to intermediate pretrained data products like reduced-order approximations or normalizing flows. We demonstrate end-to-end recovery of finite-size binary-neutron-star injections in a three-site next-generation network to $\mathrm{SNR}=1000$, localizing the source's extrinsic parameters to $0.8\times10^{-3}\,\mathrm{deg}^2$ in minutes on a single GPU.

classification.title_zh: 扩展 RIFT 1：将 RIFT 扩展至第三代引力波分析
classification.abstract_zh: 第三代引力波探测器观测到的致密双星信号的解释因其高信噪比（常达数百至数千），以及由于地球自转和探测器巨大物理尺度引起的时间和频率依赖的探测器响应而变得复杂。基于此前针对 LISA 的工作，我们实现了 RIFT 参数估计流程的通用、稳健扩展，使得可以利用任何现有波形模型解释这些源，而无需借助诸如降阶近似或归一化流之类的中间预训练数据产品。我们在一个三站点下一代网络中，展示了在信噪比=1000下对有限尺寸双中子星注入的端到端恢复，在单块 GPU 上于数分钟内将源的外禀参数定位到 0.8×10^{-3} 平方度。

papers.title: Gravitational-Wave Inference For Noise PSD Jumps Across Data Gaps
papers.abstract: Long-duration gravitational-wave (GW) inference inevitably encounters data gaps, which are often accompanied by abrupt, non-stationary changes in the detector noise power spectral density (PSD). Conventional practice typically analyzes the pre-gap and post-gap data separately, causing avoidable information loss and potentially degrading parameter inference. We build on Bayesian gap augmentation in the Wilson--Daubechies--Meyer (WDM) time--frequency domain and focus on a practically important failure mode: short gaps with large PSD amplitude jumps. In this regime, the local diagonal (Whittle-like) approximation that underpins the WDM likelihood can no longer be relied upon in the time direction near the gap edges, which may lead to biased and/or less robust inference unless the local diagonal validity is restored without resorting to full segmentation. We propose a two-stage, validity-driven remedy. First, frequency-domain prior-predictive prewhitening (PW) incorporates endpoint-informed noise information to mitigate the dominant mismatch responsible for poor diagonal behavior, enabling a more favorable WDM representation while retaining computational tractability. Second, when a time-direction smoothness criterion still fails, we apply adaptive gap expanding (AGE), selectively enlarging only the minimal neighborhood around the gap boundaries needed to restore local diagonal validity. Toy-model simulations with chimeric PSD transitions show that WDM+PW+AGE yields substantially tighter and more accurate posteriors than single-sided pre-gap/post-gap analyses, while maintaining computational efficiency suitable for next-generation missions.

classification.title_zh: 跨数据间隙噪声PSD跳变的引力波推断
classification.abstract_zh: 长时间引力波（GW）推断不可避免地会遇到数据间隙，这些间隙通常伴随着探测器噪声功率谱密度（PSD）的突然、非平稳变化。传统做法通常分别分析间隙前和间隙后的数据，导致可避免的信息损失，并可能降低参数推断的质量。我们基于Wilson-Daubechies-Meyer（WDM）时频域中的贝叶斯间隙增广，并关注一个实际重要的失效模式：具有大PSD幅度跳变的短间隙。在这种情况下，支撑WDM似然的局部对角（类Whittle）近似在间隙边缘附近的时间方向上不再可靠，除非在不进行完全分段的情况下恢复局部对角有效性，否则可能导致有偏和/或稳健性较差的推断。我们提出了一种两阶段、有效性驱动的补救方法。首先，频域先验预测预白化（PW）结合端点噪声信息，以减轻导致对角行为不佳的主要失配，从而实现更有利的WDM表示，同时保持计算可行性。其次，当时间方向平滑度准则仍然失败时，我们应用自适应间隙扩展（AGE），仅选择性地扩大间隙边界周围所需的最小邻域，以恢复局部对角有效性。使用嵌合PSD过渡的玩具模型模拟表明，与单侧间隙前/间隙后分析相比，WDM+PW+AGE产生显著更紧且更准确的后验，同时保持适合下一代任务的计算效率。
classification.one_liner: 提出WDM+PW+AGE两阶段方法，解决数据间隙中噪声PSD跳变导致的引力波推断偏差问题。

papers.title: The Irreversible Depletion of Dark Matter Spikes by Extreme-Mass-Ratio Inspirals
papers.abstract: Dense dark matter spikes around massive black holes (MBHs) have been widely predicted to produce gravitational-wave dephasing in extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) that are potentially observable by LISA. We show that EMRIs, the very objects used to probe these spikes, also destroy them. Combining Fokker-Planck models of nuclear star clusters with post-Newtonian three-body simulations of EMRI-dark matter encounters, we demonstrate that repeated gravitational slingshots irreversibly eject dark matter particles from the cluster's loss cone over gigayear time-scales. For MBHs at $z = 3$ with masses $\lesssim 10^5 \,M_\odot$, even conservative EMRI rates of $\mathcal{O}(1-10) \, \mathrm{Gyr}^{-1}$ suffice to deplete the spike density by orders of magnitude; for more realistic rates of $\mathcal{O}(100-300) \, \mathrm{Gyr}^{-1}$, the mass range extends to $\lesssim 10^6 \,M_\odot$. As a result, the gravitational-wave dephasing expected from such systems is greatly reduced, narrowing the prospects of detecting DM through this channel. Only heavy, high-redshift systems with sufficiently low EMRI rates -- for example, a $\sim 10^6 \,M_\odot$ MBH at $z \gtrsim 5$ with $\lesssim 100$ EMRIs per Gyr -- can induce dephasing that exceeds one radian.

classification.title_zh: 极端质量比旋近对暗物质尖峰的不可逆耗尽
classification.abstract_zh: 围绕大质量黑洞（MBHs）的致密暗物质尖峰已被广泛预测会在极端质量比旋近（EMRIs）中产生引力波退相位，并有可能被LISA观测到。我们表明，EMRIs——正是用于探测这些尖峰的对象——也会摧毁它们。结合核星团的Fokker-Planck模型与EMRI-暗物质相遇的后牛顿三体模拟，我们证明重复的引力弹弓效应会在十亿年时间尺度上不可逆地将暗物质粒子从星团的损失锥中抛出。对于红移 z = 3、质量 ≲10^5 M⊙ 的MBH，即使保守的EMRI率 O(1-10) Gyr^-1 也足以将尖峰密度耗尽若干数量级；对于更现实的 O(100-300) Gyr^-1 速率，质量范围扩展到 ≲10^6 M⊙。因此，这类系统预期的引力波退相位大大降低，缩小了通过该通道探测暗物质的前景。只有重、高红移且EMRI率足够低的系统——例如红移 z ≳ 5、质量约 10^6 M⊙ 且每十亿年 ≲100 个EMRI——才能产生超过一弧度的退相位。

papers.title: Self-Interacting Dark Matter-Induced Dynamical Friction and Its Imprint on EMRI Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) provide a promising probe of the dark matter environment surrounding massive black holes through their long-duration gravitational-wave signals. In this work, we investigate the influence of self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) on EMRI dynamics and gravitational-wave phase evolution. Motivated by the collisional Boltzmann description of SIDM, we construct a leading-order effective correction to the conventional Chandrasekhar dynamical-friction force, controlled by the momentum-transfer cross section $\sigma_T$ and the dimensionless collisionality parameter $n_\chi\sigma_T r=r/\lambda_{\rm mfp}$. We then compute the resulting orbital evolution, waveform modification, and accumulated gravitational-wave dephasing. In the enhanced-drag regime considered here, increasing the SIDM self-interaction strength increases the effective dynamical friction, accelerates the inspiral, and produces a progressively larger phase deviation relative to the collisionless dark matter case. We further distinguish the total dark-matter-induced dephasing relative to vacuum from the additional phase correction generated specifically by dark matter self-interactions. Our results demonstrate that the cumulative gravitational-wave phase of EMRIs can be sensitive to the microscopic momentum-transfer properties of dark matter, suggesting that future space-based detectors such as LISA may provide a complementary probe of SIDM in the vicinity of massive black holes.

classification.title_zh: 自相互作用暗物质诱导的动力学摩擦及其对极端质量比旋近引力波的印记
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋近（EMRI）通过其长时标引力波信号，为探测大质量黑洞周围的暗物质环境提供了有前景的手段。本文研究自相互作用暗物质（SIDM）对EMRI动力学和引力波相位演化的影响。受SIDM碰撞玻尔兹曼描述启发，我们构造了对传统Chandrasekhar动力学摩擦力的领头阶有效修正，该修正由动量转移截面 σ_T 和无量纲碰撞参数 n_χ σ_T r = r/λ_mfp 控制。随后计算由此产生的轨道演化、波形修正和累积引力波退相位。在所考虑的增强阻尼区域，增加SIDM自相互作用强度会增强有效动力学摩擦、加速旋近，并相对于无碰撞暗物质情形产生逐渐增大的相位偏差。我们进一步区分了相对于真空的总暗物质诱导退相位与专门由暗物质自相互作用产生的附加相位修正。结果表明，EMRI的累积引力波相位可对暗物质的微观动量转移性质敏感，暗示LISA等未来空间探测器可能为探测大质量黑洞附近的SIDM提供互补手段。
classification.one_liner: SIDM自相互作用增强EMRI动力学摩擦，加速旋近并增大引力波退相位，可被LISA等未来探测器探测。

papers.title: Beyond circular and equatorial orbits: Bayesian constraint on vector charge with the adiabatic inspirals of generic Kerr geodesics
papers.abstract: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) offer a powerful probe of additional fundamental fields through their cumulative influence on gravitational-wave phases. However, modeling vector radiation from generic Kerr orbits requires the evolution of the Carter constant, which cannot be determined from energy and angular-momentum balance alone. Here we derive the orbit-averaged electromagnetic Carter-constant flux for eccentric and inclined, nonresonant Kerr geodesics, including sections at infinity and event horizon. Combining the gravitational and electromagnetic energy and angular-momentum fluxes, we construct generic adiabatic inspirals using a four-dimensional Chebyshev interpolation mathod. We incorporate the relativistic trajectories into the state of the art of FastEMRIWaveform package and perform Bayesian inference of vector charge carried by secondaries. Our analysis reveals substantial correlations between the charge and intrinsic source parameters, with vector charge constraints exhibiting a nonmonotonic dependence on orbital inclination. These results establish a framework for investigating additional vector-radiation channels in generic EMRIs and their implications for tests of gravity with future space-based gravitational wave observations.

classification.title_zh: 超越圆形与赤道轨道：用一般 Kerr 测地线的绝热旋进对矢量荷施加贝叶斯约束
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋进（EMRIs）通过其对引力波相位的累积影响，为探测额外基本场提供了强有力的手段。然而，对一般 Kerr 轨道产生的矢量辐射建模需要 Carter 常数的演化，而该常数不能仅由能量和角动量平衡确定。在这里，我们推导了偏心且倾斜、非共振 Kerr 测地线的轨道平均电磁 Carter 常数通量，包括无穷远处和事件视界处的部分。结合引力与电磁能量和角动量通量，我们使用四维 Chebyshev 插值方法构建了一般绝热旋进。我们将相对论轨迹纳入最先进的 FastEMRIWaveform 程序包，并对次级天体携带的矢量荷进行贝叶斯推断。我们的分析揭示了荷与内禀源参数之间存在显著关联，且矢量荷约束对轨道倾角表现出非单调依赖。这些结果为研究一般 EMRI 中额外的矢量辐射通道及其对未来天基引力波观测检验引力的意义建立了一个框架。
classification.one_liner: 用一般 Kerr 测地线的绝热 EMRI 波形对次级矢量荷做贝叶斯限制，发现其与源参数强相关且随轨道倾角非单调变化。

papers.title: Higher-curvature gravity in Weyl geometry: No-ghost and no-tachyon conditions
papers.abstract: Weyl geometry, in which the length scale can be chosen independently at each point of spacetime, provides a natural framework for extending general relativity through Weyl invariance, that is, local scale symmetry. We construct a gravitational theory whose Lagrangian is an arbitrary function of the scalar curvature in Weyl geometry and establish the conditions under which the theory is free of ghosts and tachyons around maximally symmetric vacua. For an arbitrary function, Weyl invariance requires a compensating scalar field in addition to the metric and the Weyl vector. By linearizing the action with an auxiliary field, we show that the Weyl vector couples to the scalar sector only through a single combination of the scalar fields. Consequently, the Weyl vector, shifted by the logarithmic gradient of this combination, becomes a Weyl-invariant massive vector field without gauge fixing. In the Einstein frame, given that the graviton is ghost-free, the no-tachyon condition for the Weyl vector, together with the no-ghost condition for the scalaron, the scalar mode associated with the higher-curvature terms, reduces to the positivity of the kinetic coefficient of the compensating scalar. When this coefficient vanishes, the scalaron does not propagate, leaving only the graviton and the massive vector. As an example, we show that for a Lagrangian containing constant, linear, and quadratic curvature terms, both a massive vector and a massive scalaron are necessarily present throughout the stability region, whereas without the linear term the scalaron becomes massless.

classification.title_zh: Weyl几何中的高阶曲率引力：无鬼与无快子条件
classification.abstract_zh: Weyl几何允许在时空每一点独立选择长度标度，通过Weyl不变性（即局域标度对称性）为扩展广义相对论提供了自然框架。我们构造了一种引力理论，其拉格朗日量是Weyl几何中标量曲率的任意函数，并确立了该理论在极大对称真空附近无鬼、无快子的条件。对于任意函数，Weyl不变性要求除度规和Weyl向量外还需一个补偿标量场。通过引入辅助场将作用量线性化，我们表明Weyl向量仅通过标量场的单一组合与标量扇区耦合。因此，Weyl向量在被该组合的对数梯度平移后，无需规范固定即成为Weyl不变的有质量向量场。在Einstein框架中，假设引力子无鬼，Weyl向量的无快子条件以及标量子（与高阶曲率项相关的标量模式）的无鬼条件归结为补偿标量场动能系数的正性。当该系数为零时，标量子不传播，只剩下引力子和有质量向量。作为一个例子，我们表明对于包含常数、线性和二次曲率项的拉格朗日量，在整个稳定区域内必然同时存在有质量向量和有质量标量子；而若没有线性项，标量子变为无质量。
classification.one_liner: 在Weyl几何中研究高阶曲率引力的无鬼与无快子条件，并给出补偿标量、标量子和Weyl向量的稳定性判据。

papers.title: Holographic dark energy in Einstein-Cartan spin cosmology
papers.abstract: We show that, in Einstein-Cartan theory, the torsion scalar modifies the dust-like equation of state of non-interacting holographic dark energy with the Hubble radius as the infrared cutoff, enabling late-time cosmic acceleration within the low-redshift domain of validity, which is not realized in the corresponding model in general relativity. Using the same holographic dark energy background, we further derive the torsion-induced modification of the cosmic distance duality relation, $d_L=d_A(1+z)^2(1+\eta)$. In the late-time universe, the magnitude of the deviation parameter, $|\eta|$, is small but non-vanishing, reflecting the cumulative effect of torsion along the light-propagation path.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Cartan 自旋宇宙学中的全息暗能量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们表明，在 Einstein-Cartan 理论中，挠率标量修改了以 Hubble 半径为红外截断的非相互作用全息暗能量的类尘埃状态方程，使其在低红移有效范围内能够实现晚期宇宙加速，而这在相应的广义相对论模型中无法实现。使用相同的全息暗能量背景，我们进一步推导了宇宙距离对偶关系 $d_L=d_A(1+z)^2(1+\eta)$ 的挠率诱导修正。在晚期宇宙，偏离参数 $|\eta|$ 的幅度很小但非零，反映了挠率沿光传播路径的累积效应。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-Cartan 自旋宇宙学中，挠率使全息暗能量可实现晚期加速，并修正宇宙距离对偶关系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文虽使用“全息暗能量”一词，但属于 Einstein-Cartan 宇宙学/经典引力框架，并非 AdS/CFT 全息对偶研究；与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线相关。

papers.title: Correspondence between multileaf topology of closed geodesics and spatiotemporal autocorrelations of hotspot images in Schwarzschild spacetime
papers.abstract: The classification of relativistic closed orbits by their multileaf structures provides a framework for studying strong-field dynamics. Identifying these structures in astronomical images remains challenging. Using ray tracing, we construct the spatiotemporal autocorrelations of the primary image of a pointlike hotspot moving along bound closed geodesics around a Schwarzschild black hole. These orbits are classified by three integers $(z,w,v)$, where $z$ counts the leaves, $w$ counts the additional whirls during each radial period, and $v$ specifies the order in which the orbital leaves are traced. For the orbit families examined, our numerical results establish a correspondence between the topological integers $(z,w,v)$ and the numbers of correlation bands $N_{\rm band}$ and recurrence points $N_{\rm rec}$. The integers are recovered as $z=N_{\rm rec}-1$, $w=\left\lfloor (N_{\rm band}+1)/(N_{\rm rec}-1)\right\rfloor-1$, and $v=(N_{\rm band}+1)\bmod(N_{\rm rec}-1)$. Here, $\lfloor x\rfloor$ denotes the greatest integer not exceeding $x$, and $\bmod$ denotes the remainder operation. These relations provide a quantitative method for recovering closed-orbit topology from hotspot image autocorrelations.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild时空中闭合测地线多叶拓扑与热点图像时空自相关的对应关系
classification.abstract_zh: 相对论闭合轨道的多叶结构分类为强场动力学研究提供了框架，但在天文图像中识别这些结构仍具挑战。我们使用光线追踪，构造沿Schwarzschild黑洞束缚闭合测地线运动的点状热点的初级图像的时空自相关。这些轨道由三个整数(z,w,v)分类，其中z计数叶数，w计数每个径向周期内的额外环绕，v指定轨道叶被追踪的顺序。对于所考察的轨道族，数值结果建立了拓扑整数(z,w,v)与相关带数N_band和回归点数N_rec之间的对应。整数可由 z=N_rec-1、w=floor((N_band+1)/(N_rec-1))-1 和 v=(N_band+1) mod (N_rec-1) 恢复。这些关系提供了从热点图像自相关恢复闭合轨道拓扑的定量方法。
classification.one_liner: 用光线追踪证明Schwarzschild黑洞周围闭合测地线的多叶拓扑可由热点图像时空自相关的相关带数与回归点数定量恢复。

papers.title: Threshold Tails of Black hole Differential Observables
papers.abstract: We study how first-order differential observables affect the zero-frequency behavior of black-hole wave equations. Quasinormal modes and late-time tails do not always change in the same way. We give a simple condition for when an observable removes the leading threshold term of a Green function. For Schwarzschild Regge-Wheeler modes, the relevant operator is determined by the regular static solution. The transformation is nondegenerate at nonzero frequency but becomes globally degenerate at zero frequency. As a result, the nonzero quasinormal-mode problem is unchanged, while the leading fixed-radius late-time tail gains one extra inverse power of time.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞微分可观测量的阈值尾
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一阶微分可观测量如何影响黑洞波动方程的零频行为。准正模与晚期尾并不总是以相同方式变化。我们给出了一个简单条件，说明一个可观测量何时会移除格林函数的主导阈值项。对于 Schwarzschild Regge-Wheeler 模，相关算符由正则静态解决定。该变换在非零频率下非退化，但在零频率下全局退化。因此，非零准正模问题保持不变，而主导的固定半径晚期尾多获得一个时间反幂次。
classification.one_liner: 一阶微分可观测量可移除格林函数阈值项，使 Schwarzschild 固定半径晚期尾多一个时间反幂次，而非零 QNM 不变。

papers.title: Computing gravitational radiation from highly eccentric bound binaries in the small-mass-ratio limit
papers.abstract: Precise strong-gravity models describing the evolution of bound compact binary systems provide important information about the gravitational radiation such binaries generate and how they evolve due to the radiation's backreaction. The limit of very high eccentricity, $e \to 1$, is challenging to model: frequency-domain techniques require many harmonics to accurately describe radiation in this limit, and time-domain techniques can be slow to converge due to the systems' long timescales. Many recent astrophysical analyses have nonetheless emphasized the importance of understanding gravitational-wave emission in this regime, highlighting the fact that many systems may evolve through $e \simeq 1$ en route to becoming detectable sources, and may enter the sensitive band of detectors with substantial eccentricity. In this paper, we show how to adapt frequency-domain methods for computing gravitational radiation in the small-mass-ratio limit to effectively handle high eccentricity. The key piece of this analysis is an integral over the source of the frequency-domain Teukolsky equation. We examine features of this integral that make it difficult to evaluate as $e \to 1$, and study methods to circumvent these difficulties. We find a simple fix which allows us to compute gravitational-wave amplitudes and the associated fluxes of energy and angular momentum with ease up to eccentricities $e = 0.99$; with patience (and stamina), we have pushed to $e = 0.999$, though numerical accuracy appears to degrade for such extreme cases. Interestingly, we find that the well-known and often used classic formulas of Peters and Mathews are subject to a systematic error which persists at quite wide separation. This has implications for models of compact binary formation which evolve through $e \simeq 1$.

classification.title_zh: 计算小质量比极限下高偏心率束缚双星的引力辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 精确的强引力模型描述束缚致密双星系统的演化，可提供有关其产生的引力辐射以及辐射反作用如何驱动演化的信息。极高偏心率极限 e→1 难以建模：频域技术需要大量谐波才能准确描述该极限下的辐射，而时域技术由于系统时间尺度长可能收敛缓慢。尽管如此，许多近期天体物理分析仍强调理解该区域引力波辐射的重要性，指出许多系统可能在变得可探测之前经历 e≃1，并可能以显著偏心率进入探测器敏感频带。本文展示如何改造小质量比极限下计算引力辐射的频域方法，以有效处理高偏心率。该分析的关键是对频域 Teukolsky 方程源项的一个积分。我们考察了该积分在 e→1 时难以计算的特征，并研究了规避这些困难的方法。我们发现一个简单修正，可轻松计算偏心率直到 e=0.99 的引力波振幅及相关的能量和角动量通量；凭借耐心和毅力，我们推进到 e=0.999，但在如此极端情形下数值精度似乎下降。有趣的是，我们发现著名且常用的 Peters 和 Mathews 经典公式存在系统误差，该误差在相当宽的分离下仍然存在。这对经历 e≃1 的致密双星形成模型具有启示。
classification.one_liner: 通过改进频域 Teukolsky 源积分，将小质量比高偏心双星引力辐射计算推进到 e=0.999，并指出 Peters-Mathews 公式的系统误差。

papers.title: What Fraction of Extreme Mass Ratio Inspirals That Merge After the LISA Mission Ends Are Detectable?
papers.abstract: Stellar-mass compact objects spiraling into massive black holes in galactic nuclei (referred to as "extreme-mass-ratio inspirals", or EMRIs) will be an important class of sources for the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). A stellar-mass compact object can radiate in the millihertz band for years to decades before it plunges into its massive black hole, so a substantial fraction of the EMRIs that LISA can detect will still be inspiraling when the mission ends. We calculate what fraction of detectable EMRIs will plunge after the mission ends, and for those we calculate how they are distributed as a function of various parameters, such as their post-mission lifetime. To do this, we draw from astrophysically motivated populations, backward-integrate fully relativistic Kerr FastEMRIWaveforms trajectories for a given time to plunge, and compute the full LISA response over both the four-year nominal and ten-year extended observing windows. We calculate the detectable fraction as an explicit function of time to plunge at signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) thresholds of $\rho=10$, 20, and 30. We find that post-mission EMRIs are roughly one in four of the LISA-detectable population at $\rho>20$ over the four-year mission, and roughly one in six over the ten-year extended mission. The in-window detectable fraction varies by nearly a factor of six at $\rho>20$ across the massive black hole spins and secondary masses we ran, while the share stays between 25% and 33% for the four-year mission and between 13% and 20% for the ten-year one across all of them. The search for EMRIs that plunge more than $\sim 1$ year after the mission ends may require a different algorithm than the one used for EMRIs that plunge during the mission, and the fact that post-mission detections are a substantial fraction of all detections gives some urgency to developing a detection pipeline suitable for them.

classification.title_zh: LISA 任务结束后才并合的极端质量比旋进有多大比例可被探测？
classification.abstract_zh: 在星系核中旋入大质量黑洞的恒星级致密天体（称为“极端质量比旋进”，EMRI）将成为激光干涉空间天线（LISA）的一类重要源。一个恒星级致密天体可在毫赫兹频段辐射数年到数十年，然后才坠入其大质量黑洞，因此 LISA 可探测的 EMRI 中有相当一部分在任务结束时仍处于旋进阶段。我们计算可探测 EMRI 中将在任务结束后坠入的比例，并针对这些源计算它们随各种参数（例如任务结束后的剩余寿命）的分布。为此，我们从具有天体物理动机的种群中抽样，对给定坠入时间的完全相对论性 Kerr FastEMRIWaveforms 轨迹进行反向积分，并计算在四年名义观测窗口和十年扩展观测窗口内的完整 LISA 响应。我们在信噪比（SNR）阈值 rho=10、20 和 30 下，将可探测比例计算为距坠入时间的显式函数。我们发现，在四年任务期间、rho>20 时，任务结束后坠入的 EMRI 约占 LISA 可探测种群的 1/4；在十年扩展任务中约占 1/6。在我们运行的大质量黑洞自旋和次级质量范围内，rho>20 时窗口内可探测比例变化近六倍；而在所有情况下，四年任务中的份额保持在 25% 到 33% 之间，十年任务中保持在 13% 到 20% 之间。对任务结束后超过约 1 年才坠入的 EMRI 的搜索，可能需要不同于任务期间坠入 EMRI 所用算法的算法；而任务结束后探测占全部探测的相当一部分，这为开发适合它们的探测流程带来一定紧迫性。
classification.one_liner: 计算 LISA 任务结束后才坠入的 EMRI 中可探测比例，并指出其占全部可探测 EMRI 的相当一部分。
