papers.title: Modified Double Copy for Quasitopological Gravity with Matter
papers.abstract: We extend the modified double-copy construction to quasitopological gravity (QTG) coupled to matter. Spherically symmetric QTG solutions in $D$ dimensions are generated from an auxiliary gauge field in a flat $(D+1)$-dimensional spacetime. The gravitational field equations reduce to two relations determined by the QTG generating function and the matter stress--energy tensor. For a broad class of spherically symmetric matter sources, solutions of the auxiliary gauge-field equations can be used to construct exact solutions of the QTG field equations. The framework applies to Maxwell theory, nonlinear electrodynamics, and Yang--Mills theory, encompasses both static and Vaidya-type solutions, and reproduces the Einstein-gravity limit.

classification.title_zh: 含物质拟拓扑引力的修改双拷贝
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将修改的双拷贝构造推广到与物质耦合的拟拓扑引力（QTG）。D 维球对称 QTG 解由平坦 (D+1) 维时空中的辅助规范场生成。引力场方程约化为由 QTG 生成函数和物质应力-能量张量决定的两个关系。对于一大类球对称物质源，辅助规范场方程的解可用于构造 QTG 场方程的精确解。该框架适用于 Maxwell 理论、非线性电动力学和 Yang-Mills 理论，涵盖静态和 Vaidya 型解，并再现 Einstein 引力极限。

papers.title: Rotating Black Holes and the Kerr/CFT Correspondence in Einstein-Bumblebee Gravity
papers.abstract: We constructed rotating black holes with equal angular momentum in five dimensional Einstein-Bumblebee gravity with and without cosmological constant. Their thermodynamic properties are examined via two distinct methods: the Wald formalism and the Komar integral. Notably, the conserved charges, including mass, angular momentum, and entropy, computed from these two approaches differ by a constant prefactor that is solely determined by the Bumblebee coupling. Subsequently, we apply the Kerr/CFT correspondence to derive the microscopic entropy of these black holes and find that it precisely reproduces the entropy in Komar-integral version, rather than the Wald entropy.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Bumblebee 引力中的旋转黑洞与 Kerr/CFT 对应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在五维 Einstein-Bumblebee 引力中，在有和没有宇宙学常数的情况下，构建了具有相等角动量的旋转黑洞。通过两种不同方法考察其热力学性质：Wald 形式与 Komar 积分。值得注意的是，由这两种方法计算得到的守恒荷，包括质量、角动量和熵，相差一个完全由 Bumblebee 耦合决定的常数前因子。随后，我们应用 Kerr/CFT 对应推导这些黑洞的微观熵，并发现它精确再现的是 Komar 积分版本的熵，而不是 Wald 熵。

papers.title: Scalarized extremal black holes in the Einstein-Maxwell-scalar theory with two U(1) fields
papers.abstract: We study scalarized extremal black holes in the Einstein-Maxwell-scalar (EMS) theory with two different scalar couplings to two U(1) fields. This theory is inspired by the dyonic EMS theory. Two scalarzied extremal black holes are found with constant scalar hair. We confirm that these are exactly obtained from the extremal scalarization and entropy function approaches. This may imply that it is not easy to find extremal black holes with primary scalar hair.

classification.title_zh: 具有两个 U(1) 场的 Einstein-Maxwell-scalar 理论中的标量化极值黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有两个不同标量耦合到两个 U(1) 场的 Einstein-Maxwell-scalar (EMS) 理论中的标量化极值黑洞。该理论受到双荷 EMS 理论的启发。我们找到了两个具有常数标量毛的标量化极值黑洞。我们确认它们可以精确地从极值标量化方法和熵函数方法得到。这可能意味着，找到具有初级标量毛的极值黑洞并不容易。
classification.one_liner: 在带两个 U(1) 场的 EMS 理论中构造标量化极值黑洞，并表明其可由极值标量化与熵函数方法精确重现。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 EMS 理论中的经典黑洞解、极值标量化和标量毛，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；摘要未涉及全息对偶或量子信息。

papers.title: Scalar Tsunamis from Black Hole Formation
papers.abstract: Stars and other macroscopic objects may be surrounded by potentially large field configurations of very light scalars coupled to ordinary matter. If the star ends in a black hole, e.g. via a supernova or a neutron star merger, the source vanishes, and the field is released. In this paper, we improve on previous estimates for the field configurations arriving at large distances by including the effects of general relativity and an improved modelling of the initial field configurations. The total amount of energy released is typically of the same order of magnitude as suggested by simple flat space estimates. The spectrum receives noticeable corrections.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞形成产生的标量海啸
classification.abstract_zh: 恒星及其他宏观物体可能被与普通物质耦合的极轻标量场的潜在大型场构型所包围。如果恒星最终形成黑洞，例如通过超新星或中子星并合，源消失，场被释放。本文改进了先前对到达远距离的场构型的估计，纳入广义相对论效应并改进初始场构型建模。释放的总能量通常与简单平直空间估计处于同一量级。频谱则受到明显修正。
classification.one_liner: 本文在广义相对论框架下改进黑洞形成时极轻标量场释放的远场估计，发现总能量与平直空间估计同量级但频谱明显改变。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究黑洞形成过程中标量场在广义相对论下的释放与远场谱，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线。

papers.title: On the Bondi accretion of a self-interacting complex scalar field
papers.abstract: Scalar fields with a global U(1) symmetry often appear in cosmology and astrophysics. We study the spherically-symmetric, stationary accretion of such a classical field onto a Schwarzschild black hole in the test-field approximation. Thus, we consider the relativistic Bondi accretion beyond a simplified perfect-fluid setup. We focus on the complex scalar field with canonical kinetic term and with a generic quartic potential which either preserves the U(1) symmetry or exhibits spontaneous symmetry breaking. It is well known that in the lowest order in gradient expansion the dynamics of such a scalar field is well approximated by a perfect superfluid; we demonstrate that going beyond this approximation systematically reduces the accretion rate with respect to the perfect fluid case. Hence, black holes can provide a way to distinguish a perfect fluid from its ultraviolet completion in form of the complex scalar field.

classification.title_zh: 关于自相互作用复标量场的 Bondi 吸积
classification.abstract_zh: 具有全局 U(1) 对称性的标量场常出现在宇宙学和天体物理中。我们在试验场近似下研究此类经典场向 Schwarzschild 黑洞的球对称、稳态吸积。因此，我们考虑超越简化完美流体设定的相对论 Bondi 吸积。我们关注具有正则动能项和一般四次势的复标量场，该势要么保持 U(1) 对称性，要么表现出自发对称破缺。众所周知，在梯度展开的最低阶，此类标量场动力学可由完美超流体很好地近似；我们证明，超越此近似会相对于完美流体情形系统性地降低吸积率。因此，黑洞可以提供一种区分完美流体与其复标量场形式紫外完成的方法。
classification.one_liner: 在试验场近似下研究复标量场向 Schwarzschild 黑洞的球对称稳态 Bondi 吸积，表明超越完美流体近似会系统性降低吸积率。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典广义相对论中的黑洞吸积与复标量场动力学，属于“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Constraining the Swift Memory Burden Effect with GW250114-like Events
papers.abstract: Black hole spectroscopy allows to infer the properties of the remnant of a binary black hole coalescence. Motivated by the recent proposal that a black hole's information load can alter its classical response to small perturbations, an effect known as the swift memory burden (SMB), we develop a minimal phenomenological framework to analyze the ringdown of a binary black hole merger and confront it with the data from the GW250114 event. In particular, we model the SMB imprint through a suppression factor derived as an upper bound and adopt the least-suppressive form. We perform a Bayesian analysis combining the frequencies of the (220) and (440) quasi-normal modes and obtain a lower bound $\log_{10}p \gtrsim 2$, where $p$ controls how the gaps reopen when the black hole's master mode occupation departs from the critical value. Moreover, using a Fisher information matrix (high signal-to-noise ratio) approximation, we forecast the lower bound $\log_{10}p \gtrsim 3$ for a GW250114-like event observed with Cosmic Explorer or Einstein Telescope. Within this minimal, weak-effect framework, our results disfavour rapid gap reopening, shedding light on how the swift memory burden effect can be probed with current and next-generation detectors.

classification.title_zh: 用类似 GW250114 的事件约束 Swift Memory Burden 效应
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞谱学可以推断双黑洞并合遗迹的性质。受近期提出的黑洞信息负载会改变其对小扰动的经典响应的启发，这一效应被称为 swift memory burden（SMB），我们构建了一个最小现象学框架，用于分析双黑洞并合的铃宕，并用 GW250114 事件的数据对其进行检验。特别地，我们通过一个作为上界推导出的压低因子来建模 SMB 印记，并采用压低最弱的形式。我们结合 (220) 和 (440) 准正规模频率进行贝叶斯分析，得到下界 log10 p ≳ 2，其中 p 控制当黑洞主模式占据数偏离临界值时能隙如何重新打开。此外，使用 Fisher 信息矩阵（高信噪比）近似，我们预测对于由 Cosmic Explorer 或 Einstein Telescope 观测到的类 GW250114 事件，下界为 log10 p ≳ 3。在这一最小、弱效应框架内，我们的结果不支持快速的能隙重新打开，并为如何用当前和下一代探测器探测 swift memory burden 效应提供了启示。
classification.one_liner: 通过 GW250114 铃宕的 (220)/(440) 准正规模频率贝叶斯分析，对 Swift Memory Burden 效应给出 log10 p 下界，并预测下一代探测器可达灵敏度。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接涉及黑洞铃宕准正规模与引力波观测约束，匹配用户重点标签中的 QNM与非线性演化、经典引力/广义相对论；不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息对偶。

papers.title: Reduction technique for expanding the Feynman diagrams in AdS$_2$
papers.abstract: We formulate the reduction technique for expanding the $n$-point AdS Feynman diagrams in two dimensions into the Wilson line networks. The technique applies to any $n$-point tree diagram, expressing it as several series of the matrix elements of Wilson line network operators, and employs the Wilson network expansions of the $(n-1)$-point AdS Feynman diagrams, which can in turn be obtained using the same technique. Consequently, the complexity of this technique does not increase with $n$, provided that the expansions of the $(n-1)$-point diagrams are known. To demonstrate the reduction technique, we apply it to all topologically distinct five-point AdS Feynman tree diagrams. The resulting expansions near the conformal boundary reproduce the known decompositions of the corresponding five-point Witten diagrams into conformal blocks.

classification.title_zh: 展开 AdS$_2$ 中费曼图的约化技术
classification.abstract_zh: 我们制定了将二维 AdS 费曼图展开为 Wilson 线网络的约化技术。该技术适用于任意 n 点树图，将其表示为 Wilson 线网络算符矩阵元的若干级数，并利用 (n-1) 点 AdS 费曼图的 Wilson 网络展开，而这些展开又可依次用同一技术获得。因此，只要已知 (n-1) 点图的展开，该技术的复杂度不随 n 增加。为演示该约化技术，我们将其应用于所有拓扑不同的五点 AdS 费曼树图。所得在共形边界附近的展开重现了相应五点 Witten 图已知的共形块分解。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种递归约化技术，将 AdS$_2$ 中任意 n 点树级费曼图展开为 Wilson 线网络矩阵元级数，并在五点 Witten 图上验证其边界展开给出共形块分解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 AdS$_2$ 中 Witten/费曼图的 Wilson 线网络展开及共形块分解，属于 AdS/CFT 基础与字典方法，与用户所列 AdS/CFT 基础及 AdS$_2$/JT 方向相关；但不直接涉及全息超导、相变、QNM 等重点支线。

papers.title: Finite-Time Doppler Covariance Spectroscopy in the AdS/CFT correspondence
papers.abstract: From a holographic perspective, we formulate an exact finite-duration covariance framework that resolves chirality in the AdS/CFT correspondence. In a rotating BTZ black hole spacetime, relative motion between two boundary controls converts sum-frequency matching on the compact boundary cylinder into discrete velocity resonances indexed by the angular momentum of the scalar field. Because the complete real-control covariance also contains difference-frequency sectors, a two-setting phase cycle with a common switching window cancels them exactly at finite duration and reconstructs the resonant pair contribution from complete positive-semidefinite covariance matrices. For an isolated angular mode, reconstructed pair responses at opposite resonance velocities sample the boundary spectrum at opposite angular momentum and a common control-selected frequency. Their normalized contrast cancels reflection-symmetric control factors and the state-independent operator normalization, yielding a finite-linewidth estimator of the reflected-mode BTZ contrast. Under the stated smoothness and moment conditions, common centered even narrowing windows give a bias beginning at quadratic order in linewidth. A real-projection leakage bound controls contamination from neighboring modes. Long-pulse calculations with the exact BTZ spectrum verify phase-cycle reconstruction and quadratic linewidth scaling. Bath-weighted calculations with exact truncated transfer amplitudes establish convergence to this baseline. Under the default controls, complete-sum contrasts for the first two nonzero angular modes reconstruct the reference-state rotation parameter at fixed mean inverse temperature with subpercent deterministic bias in the untruncated Gaussian limit. The inferred rotation parameter fixes the horizon parameters of the rotating BTZ black hole once the mean inverse temperature and AdS radius are known.

classification.title_zh: AdS/CFT 对应中的有限时间多普勒协方差光谱学
classification.abstract_zh: 从全息视角出发，我们建立了一个精确的有限时长协方差框架，以在 AdS/CFT 对应中分辨手性。在旋转 BTZ 黑洞时空中，两个边界控制之间的相对运动将紧致边界柱面上的和频匹配转化为由标量场角动量标记的离散速度共振。由于完整的实控制协方差还包含差频扇区，一个具有共同切换窗口的双设置相位循环在有限时长下精确抵消它们，并从完整的半正定协方差矩阵中重构共振对贡献。对于孤立的角模式，在相反共振速度下重构出的配对响应在相反角动量和共同的控制选择频率上采样边界谱。它们的归一化对比度抵消反射对称的控制因子和态无关的算符归一化，给出反射模 BTZ 对比度的有限线宽估计量。在所述光滑性和矩条件下，共同的中心化偶函数收窄窗给出的偏差从线宽的二次阶开始。实投影泄漏界控制来自邻近模式的污染。使用精确 BTZ 谱的长脉冲计算验证了相位循环重构和二次线宽标度。使用精确截断转移振幅的浴加权计算确立了向该基线的收敛。在默认控制下，前两个非零角模式的完全和对比度在固定平均逆温度下重构参考态旋转参数，在未截断高斯极限下具有亚百分比确定性偏差。一旦平均逆温度和 AdS 半径已知，推断出的旋转参数即固定旋转 BTZ 黑洞的视界参数。
classification.one_liner: 提出有限时间多普勒协方差光谱框架，在 AdS/CFT 中利用旋转 BTZ 边界控制的相对运动共振重构旋转参数与视界参数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与旋转 BTZ 黑洞的全息谱学/边界测量框架，与全息对应和黑洞谱学相关；但不直接落在所列的全息凝聚态、相变、QNM、multi-trace 等重点支线，且主要不是经典引力研究。

papers.title: On the (In)equivalence of de Sitter and Holographic Entanglement Entropies in Lovelock Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate the relation between de Sitter entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in higher-curvature gravity and its braneworld realization. Using the canonical formulation of the gravitational action and the Euclidean gravitational path integral, we derive the de Sitter entropy, including contributions from higher-curvature surface terms, and compare it with the holographic entanglement entropy obtained from the corresponding entropy functional. We first consider Gauss-Bonnet gravity and show that the two entropies coincide for static asymptotically de Sitter braneworld spacetimes on the RS II model, while they generally differ for stationary spacetimes. The mismatch in the stationary case arises from an extrinsic-curvature contribution associated with the constant-time surface, which vanishes for static configurations but is generally nonzero for stationary geometries. We then extend the analysis to general Lovelock gravity and show that the agreement between the de Sitter entropy and holographic entanglement entropy persists for static asymptotically de Sitter braneworld spacetimes in the RS II model beyond the Gauss-Bonnet case. We also comment that the same distinction between static and stationary configurations applies to braneworld black holes: the black hole entropy agrees with the holographic entanglement entropy in the static case, while the two generally differ for stationary braneworld black holes. Our results clarify the relation between gravitational and holographic entropies in higher-curvature gravity and provide a broader perspective on holographic correspondence in Lovelock theories and their braneworld realizations.

classification.title_zh: Lovelock 引力中 de Sitter 熵与全息纠缠熵的（非）等价性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究高阶曲率引力及其膜世界实现中 de Sitter 熵与全息纠缠熵的关系。利用引力作用量的正则表述和欧几里得引力路径积分，我们推导了包含高阶曲率表面项贡献的 de Sitter 熵，并将其与由相应熵泛函得到的全息纠缠熵进行比较。首先考虑 Gauss-Bonnet 引力，发现在 RS II 模型的静态渐近 de Sitter 膜世界时空中两者一致，而对稳态时空一般不同；稳态情形的差异来自与等时面相关的外曲率贡献，该贡献在静态构型中消失，但在稳态几何中一般非零。随后推广到一般 Lovelock 引力，表明在 RS II 模型中静态渐近 de Sitter 膜世界时空里，de Sitter 熵与全息纠缠熵的一致性在 Gauss-Bonnet 之外依然成立。我们还指出静态与稳态构型的这一区别也适用于膜世界黑洞：静态情形下黑洞熵与全息纠缠熵一致，而稳态膜世界黑洞中两者一般不同。我们的结果澄清了高阶曲率引力中引力熵与全息熵的关系，并为 Lovelock 理论及其膜世界实现中的全息对应提供了更广的视角。
classification.one_liner: 在 Lovelock 引力的 RS II 膜世界中，de Sitter 熵与全息纠缠熵在静态渐近 dS 时空一致，在稳态时空因外曲率项而一般不等价。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及全息纠缠熵、Lovelock 高阶曲率引力和膜世界，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；未涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、multi-trace、QNM 与非线性演化等具体重点方向。

papers.title: Unistochastic reduction of multi-matrix coherent-state kernels
papers.abstract: We study finite-$N$ coherent-state overlap kernels in multi-matrix BPS sectors of $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang--Mills theory. For commuting coherent-state parameters, the kernel is a Laplace transform of the Haar-pushforward measure on the unistochastic set. After quotienting row- and column-shift redundancies, the nontrivial source is an $(N-1)\times(N-1)$ matrix $D$. On the physical $m$-matrix locus, $D$ is a Gram matrix with $\operatorname{rank}D\leq m$, and the ordinary HCIZ sector is precisely the rank-at-most-one stratum. For $N=3$ we obtain an exact Bessel-integral representation of the first genuinely rank-two kernel. Along the rank-one ray $D=rE_{11}$, $F_N={}_1F_1(1;N;r)$ for arbitrary finite $N$. Using $K_N=\log F_N$ as the reduced K\"ahler potential, we study a controlled two-matrix embedding of the HCIZ sector and determine its transverse metric, second fundamental form, and Gauss--Codazzi geometry. The embedding is non-totally-geodesic at finite $N$. In the scaling $r=N\rho$, we find \begin{equation} Nh_N\to\min(\rho,1), \qquad \|B\|^2\to2(1-\rho)_+. \end{equation}

classification.title_zh: 多矩阵相干态核的酉随机约化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论多矩阵 BPS 扇区中的有限 N 相干态重叠核。对于可交换的相干态参数，该核是 Haar 前推测度在 unistochastic 集上的拉普拉斯变换。商去行和列移位冗余后，非平凡源是一个 (N-1)×(N-1) 矩阵 D。在物理 m-矩阵轨迹上，D 是秩不超过 m 的 Gram 矩阵，普通 HCIZ 扇区恰为秩至多为一的层。对于 N=3，我们得到第一个真正秩为二的核的精确 Bessel 积分表示。沿秩一射线 D=rE_{11}，对任意有限 N 有 F_N 等于合流超几何函数 _1F_1(1;N;r)。以 K_N=log F_N 为约化 Kähler 势，我们研究 HCIZ 扇区的一个受控双矩阵嵌入，并确定其横向度规、第二基本形式以及 Gauss-Codazzi 几何。该嵌入在有限 N 时非全测地。在标度 r=Nρ 下，我们发现 Nh_N 趋于 min(ρ,1)，||B||^2 趋于 2(1-ρ)_+。
classification.one_liner: 将 N=4 SYM 多矩阵 BPS 相干态重叠核化为 unistochastic 测度的拉普拉斯变换，并分析 HCIZ 扇区的秩结构与 Gauss-Codazzi 嵌入几何。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 N=4 SYM 多矩阵 BPS 扇区的相干态核、HCIZ/unistochastic 约化及嵌入几何，属于 AdS/CFT 基础工具和矩阵模型，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Accelerating black holes in higher-derivative gravity
papers.abstract: Accelerating black holes in General Relativity are described by the C-metric. We study how this geometry is modified by higher-derivative corrections, focusing on cubic curvature terms of even and odd parity. Using a suitable metric ansatz, we obtain closed-form solutions at first order in the coupling constants. The corrected geometries contain new integration constants, which correspond to physical deformations of the C-metric, and exhibit different behavior depending on the parity of the correction. In particular, parity-violating terms generate an off-diagonal metric component and induce rotation. For AdS solutions, we analyze the thermodynamics, including the Hawking temperature, entropy, and string tensions, and discuss the subtleties in defining the mass and thermodynamic string lengths.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 高阶导数引力中的加速黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论中，加速黑洞由 C-metric 描述。我们研究该几何在高阶导数修正下的修改，重点关注偶宇称和奇宇称的三次曲率项。利用合适的度规拟设，我们在耦合常数一阶得到闭式解。修正后的几何包含新的积分常数，它们对应 C-metric 的物理形变，并依据修正项的宇称表现出不同行为。特别地，宇称破缺项产生非对角度规分量并诱导旋转。对于 AdS 解，我们分析热力学，包括霍金温度、熵和 string tensions，并讨论定义质量和热力学弦长的微妙之处。
classification.one_liner: 在高阶导数引力中构造 C-metric 的修正解，并分析宇称效应与 AdS 黑洞热力学。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典广义相对论中的加速黑洞 C-metric 及其高阶曲率修正，属于“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；AdS 热力学分析也与黑洞热力学相关，但未使用全息对偶或量子信息方法。

papers.title: CFT$_3$ Realizations and Celestial Representation Theory of the $\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$ Algebra
papers.abstract: We study CFT$_3$ realizations and celestial representations of the $\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$ algebra. Free scalar and Dirac theories yield the same one-particle light-ray action. This action extends to the critical $O(N)$ model at $N=\infty$. At large but finite $N$, we use the light-ray algebra under its closure assumptions and check prescribed iterated limits of the frequency kernel. In the dimension-completed celestial hard-graviton representation, a closed raising subalgebra annihilates $G_3^+$ exactly. We construct two nonzero singular descendants in its induced module and prove that both vanish in the celestial realization. They implement the finite-spin condition and massless spin-two shortening of the generated highest-weight sector. The nonzero-$\Lambda$ quadratic Casimir has eigenvalue three throughout the hard family. The null descendants and low-spin Ward identities yield ordered differential--difference equations for celestial correlators.

classification.title_zh: CFT$_3$ 实现与 $\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$ 代数的天球表示论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 $\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$ 代数的 CFT$_3$ 实现与天球表示。自由标量场和 Dirac 理论给出相同的单粒子光锥作用量。该作用量可推广至 $N=\infty$ 的临界 $O(N)$ 模型。在有限但很大的 $N$ 下，我们在其闭合假设下使用光锥代数，并检验频率核的指定迭代极限。在维度补齐的天球硬引力子表示中，一个闭合的升子代数精确湮灭 $G_3^+$。我们构造其诱导模中的两个非零奇异后裔，并证明它们在天球实现中均消失。它们实现了生成最高权部分的有限自旋条件与无质量自旋二短化。非零 $\Lambda$ 的二次 Casimir 在整个硬族中具有特征值三。零后裔和低自旋 Ward 恒等式给出天球关联子的有序微分--差分方程。
classification.one_liner: 在 CFT$_3$ 与天球框架下研究 $\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$ 的表示，并导出硬引力子扇区的短化条件与关联子微分--差分方程。

papers.title: Cross-Correlations of Metric and Monopole Perturbations from Holographic Cosmology
papers.abstract: In this paper, we present the 1-loop calculation of the three-point function $\langle TJJ \rangle$ of the stress-energy tensor and two insertions of $SO(3)$ global currents, using a 3d toy model for holographic cosmology. By applying the holographic dictionary that relates these QFT $n$-point functions to cosmological correlators, together with the $Sl(2,\mathbb{Z})$ duality that maps the electric Noether current to a magnetic vortex current dual to cosmological magnetic monopoles, we relate the $\langle TJJ \rangle$ correlator to the cross-correlations between metric perturbations and the bulk magnetic monopole field, specifically mapping to the non-Gaussianities $\langle \xi \tilde{A} \tilde{A} \rangle$ and $\langle \gamma \tilde{A} \tilde{A} \rangle$. We calculate the semi-local contact terms necessary to achieve the exact factorization of the cosmological correlators in the squeezed limit, $p_1 \to 0$. Finally, we evaluate the effective non-linear parameters, showing that the scalar-monopole cross-correlation vanishes at leading order, $f_{NL}^{\xi \tilde{A} \tilde{A}} = 0$, while the tensor-monopole cross-correlation yields a non-zero $f_{NL}^{\gamma\tilde A\tilde A}$. These results respect the expected amplitude hierarchy of the non-Gaussian correlators, while pointing at new directions in which holographic cosmology can be tested experimentally.

classification.title_zh: 全息宇宙学中度规与单极子扰动的交叉关联
classification.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们使用全息宇宙学的三维玩具模型，给出了应力能量张量与两个 SO(3) 整体流插入的三点函数 ⟨TJJ⟩ 的单圈计算。通过应用将这些 QFT n 点函数与宇宙学关联函数联系起来的全息字典，并结合将电性 Noether 流映射为与宇宙学磁单极子对偶的磁涡旋流的 Sl(2,Z) 对偶，我们将 ⟨TJJ⟩ 关联函数与体磁单极场和度规扰动之间的交叉关联联系起来，具体映射到非高斯性 ⟨ξ Ã Ã⟩ 和 ⟨γ Ã Ã⟩。我们计算了在挤压极限 p1→0 下实现宇宙学关联函数精确因子化所需的半局域接触项。最后，我们评估有效非线性参数，表明标量-单极子交叉关联在领头阶为零，f_{NL}^{ξ Ã Ã}=0，而张量-单极子交叉关联给出非零 f_{NL}^{γ Ã Ã}。这些结果符合非高斯关联函数预期的振幅层级，同时指向全息宇宙学可被实验检验的新方向。
classification.one_liner: 在三维全息宇宙学玩具模型中计算 ⟨TJJ⟩，将其映射为度规扰动与磁单极场的非高斯交叉关联，发现标量-单极子领头阶为零，张量-单极子非零。

papers.title: Spontaneous Scalarization of Brane Black Holes: Quantum-Enhanced Tachyonic Instabilities
papers.abstract: We investigate the spontaneous scalarization of brane-localized charged black holes, focusing on the role of quantum-enhanced tachyonic instabilities. By solving the coupled bulk-brane equations numerically within the Einstein-DeTurck formulation, we construct fully backreacted static black hole solutions and map the system from the semi-classical limit to the strongly coupled quantum-dominated regime. We demonstrate that the holographic quantum effects, parameterized by $\kappa$, significantly modify the background geometry. Stability analysis, conducted via both effective potential diagnostics and quasinormal mode calculations, confirms that this geometric deformation deepens the negative well of the effective potential, thereby triggering a tachyonic instability. Integrating these results, we establish the global phase diagram of spontaneous scalarization in the $T_h/\mu-\kappa$ parameter space. The results reveal that these quantum-enhanced instabilities promote scalarization by substantially raising the critical temperature, providing a clear quantitative signature of quantum effects on black hole hair formation.

classification.title_zh: 膜黑洞的自发标量化：量子增强的快子不稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了膜局域带电黑洞的自发标量化，聚焦量子增强快子不稳定性的作用。通过在 Einstein-DeTurck 表述中数值求解耦合的体-膜方程，我们构造了完全背反的静态黑洞解，并将系统从半经典极限映射到强耦合量子主导区域。我们证明，由 κ 参数化的全息量子效应显著修改背景几何。通过有效势诊断和准正模计算进行的稳定性分析确认，这种几何形变加深了有效势的负势阱，从而触发快子不稳定性。综合这些结果，我们建立了自发标量化在 T_h/μ-κ 参数空间中的全局相图。结果表明，这些量子增强的不稳定性通过显著提高临界温度来促进标量化，为量子效应对黑洞毛发形成的影响提供了清晰的定量特征。
classification.one_liner: 量子增强的快子不稳定性可显著提高膜黑洞自发标量化的临界温度，为全息量子效应对黑洞毛发形成的影响提供定量特征。
classification.relevance_reason: 与准正模稳定性、相变/临界温度以及经典黑洞解相关，涉及用户重点标签中的 QNM 与相变分支；但主要面向膜黑洞标量化，不涉及全息超导/超流、多分量序参量或 D3-D7 等更具体支线。

papers.title: Flavour current correlators and the non-Abelian hydrodynamic approximation: the charged sector
papers.abstract: Flavor-current correlators are studied in strongly-coupled dense (holographic) matter, at finite quark chemical potential $\mu_q$ and finite isospin asymmetry. The non-Abelian hydrodynamic description of the charged currents is derived in the presence of an isospin chemical potential $\mu_3$. The two-point correlators of charged currents are then computed holographically at finite quark and isospin chemical potentials. In the near-extremal hydrodynamic regime, $\omega, k, T, \mu_3 \ll \mu \equiv \sqrt{\mu_q^2+\mu_3^2}$, relevant for cold strongly coupled matter, the IR properties of the correlators are studied. It is shown that in this regime, the correlators agree with the non-Abelian hydrodynamic predictions. Therefore, the traditional regime of validity of standard hydrodynamics extends beyond $\omega, k \ll T \ll \mu$ to the so-called extended hydrodynamic regime $T\ll \omega, k \ll \mu$. The holographic product formula is applied to the present non-Abelian system, and is used to propose an extended hydrodynamic approximation capturing both hydrodynamic-like poles and the leading effect of AdS$_2$ poles, by resumming the low-$\omega$ logarithms. The results are verified through a detailed numerical analysis of the exact correlators and quasi-normal mode spectrum.

classification.title_zh: 味流关联函数与非阿贝尔流体力学近似：带电扇区
classification.abstract_zh: 在强耦合稠密（全息）物质中，研究了味流关联函数，考虑有限夸克化学势 μ_q 和有限同位旋不对称性。在存在同位旋化学势 μ_3 时，推导了带电流的非阿贝尔流体力学描述。随后在有限夸克和同位旋化学势下，通过全息方法计算了带电流的两点关联函数。在近极端流体力学区间，ω, k, T, μ_3 << μ ≡ sqrt(μ_q^2+μ_3^2)，这对冷强耦合物质相关，研究了关联函数的红外性质。结果表明，在该区间，关联函数与非阿贝尔流体力学预言一致。因此，标准流体力学传统有效范围从 ω, k << T << μ 扩展到所谓的扩展流体力学区间 T << ω, k << μ。将全息乘积公式应用于当前非阿贝尔系统，并用其提出一种扩展流体力学近似，通过重求和小 ω 对数，同时捕捉类流体力学极点和 AdS2 极点的领头效应。结果通过对精确关联函数和准正规模谱的详细数值分析得到验证。
classification.one_liner: 在全息稠密物质中，带电流味流关联函数在有限夸克与同位旋化学势下的红外行为与非阿贝尔流体力学一致，并可用扩展流体近似捕捉流体极点和 AdS2 极点，经 QNM 数值验证。

papers.title: Analytical HTEE in Moving Plasmas
papers.abstract: We investigate the holographic temporal entanglement entropy of a boosted \((1+1)\)-dimensional plasma within the AdS\(_3\)/CFT\(_2\) correspondence, considering a Lorentz-boosted BTZ black hole background. We solve the coupled extremal-surface equations analytically and obtain a closed-form expression for the HTEE. Our results show that the real part of the SHTEE depends on the velocity, whereas the imaginary part is independent of the velocity and remains constant and universal. The known static BTZ result is recovered in the zero velocity limit, as expected.

classification.title_zh: 运动等离子体中的解析全息时间纠缠熵
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 AdS3/CFT2 对应下研究一个被 boost 的 (1+1) 维等离子体的全息时间纠缠熵，考虑洛伦兹 boosted BTZ 黑洞背景。我们解析求解耦合的极值曲面方程，并获得 HTEE 的闭式表达式。结果表明，SHTEE 的实部依赖于速度，而虚部与速度无关，保持常数且具有普适性。零速度极限下可恢复已知的静态 BTZ 结果，符合预期。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS3/CFT2 中解析计算 boosted BTZ 背景下的全息时间纠缠熵，发现实部依赖速度而虚部普适不变。

papers.title: Flat from AdS: in any even dimension and for any spin
papers.abstract: The space of solutions to the free equations of motion for massless fields of arbitrary integer spin in Minkowski spacetime is recovered as a smooth limit of the anti-de Sitter solution space for any even spacetime dimension. The infinite set of boundary data near null infinity that characterise solutions in Minkowski spacetime is obtained from an expansion of the anti-de Sitter source and vev in powers of the cosmological constant. In particular, the source gives rise to the analogue of the gravitational shear tensor, while the vev yields the analogues of the mass and angular-momentum aspects, as well as the subleading infinite tower of boundary data. These identifications are further supported by the branching of the source and vev into representations of the Lorentz algebra identified with the conformal algebra of the celestial sphere.

classification.title_zh: 从 AdS 到平直时空：任意偶维度和任意自旋
classification.abstract_zh: 任意整数自旋无质量场在 Minkowski 时空中自由运动方程的解空间，被恢复为任意偶数时空维度下反 de Sitter 解空间的一个光滑极限。刻画 Minkowski 时空解的零无穷附近无穷多边界数据，由 AdS 源和 vev 按宇宙学常数幂次展开得到。特别地，源给出引力剪切张量的类似物，而 vev 给出质量与角动量方面的类似物，以及次领头阶的无穷边界数据塔。这些对应关系进一步得到支持：源和 vev 分解为洛伦兹代数的表示，而该洛伦兹代数被等同于天球的共形代数。
classification.one_liner: 通过将 AdS 源和 vev 按宇宙学常数展开，在任意偶维度和任意整数自旋下从 AdS 解空间恢复平直时空无质量场解及零无穷边界数据。

papers.title: Groenewold-Moyal twists, integrable spin-chains and AdS/CFT
papers.abstract: We take the first steps to address via integrability the spectral problem of AdS/CFT dual pairs deformed by Groenewold-Moyal twists. In particular, we start by considering a twisted spin-chain that couples, through a Groenewold-Moyal twist deformation, two $\mathfrak{sl}(2)$-invariant spin-chains. We interpret this deformed spin-chain as a deformation of a subsector of the $AdS_3/CFT_2$ spin-chain, but the construction shares qualitative features also with the corresponding deformation of the $AdS_5/CFT_4$ spin-chain, for example. As in similar types of deformations, we show that there exists a certain basis in which the spin-chain Hamiltonian takes a Jordan-block form. At the same time, by working in the basis of eigenstates of the generators used to construct the Groenewold-Moyal twist, the Hamiltonian appears to be diagonalisable and with a deformed spectrum. Employing the method of the Baxter equation, we write down the energy of the ground state and of excited states in a perturbation of the deformation parameter. We then consider the string-theory side of the duality, where the twist is realised as a deformation of AdS of the type of Maldacena-Russo-Hashimoto-Itzhaki. We construct a deformation of the usual BMN classical solution, and in the large-$J$ limit we match the leading $\mathcal O(J^{-3})$ term of the energy of the spin-chain groundstate with a conserved charge of the string classical solution. Differently from the undeformed setup as well as similar kinds of deformations, we find that the general expression of this charge of the string sigma-model is non-local, and that it does not correspond to a standard isometry. Nevertheless, it can be computed from the monodromy matrix and it is part of the tower of conserved charges provided by integrability.

classification.title_zh: Groenewold-Moyal 扭曲、可积自旋链与 AdS/CFT
classification.abstract_zh: 我们迈出第一步，通过可积性来研究由 Groenewold-Moyal 扭曲形变的 AdS/CFT 对偶对的谱问题。特别地，我们首先考虑一个扭曲自旋链，它通过 Groenewold-Moyal 扭曲形变耦合两个 𝔰𝔩(2)-不变自旋链。我们将该形变自旋链解释为 AdS3/CFT2 自旋链某个子扇区的形变，但该构造也与例如 AdS5/CFT4 自旋链的相应形变具有定性共同特征。与类似类型的形变一样，我们证明存在某个基，在其中自旋链哈密顿量呈 Jordan 块形式。同时，在用于构造 Groenewold-Moyal 扭曲的生成元的本征态基下，哈密顿量看起来可对角化，并具有形变的谱。采用 Baxter 方程方法，我们在形变参数的微扰中写出基态和激发态的能量。随后我们考虑对偶的弦论一侧，其中扭曲实现为 Maldacena-Russo-Hashimoto-Itzhaki 类型的 AdS 形变。我们构造通常 BMN 经典解的形变，并在大 J 极限下，将自旋链基态能量的领头 O(J^{-3}) 项与弦经典解的一个守恒荷匹配。与未形变情形以及类似类型的形变不同，我们发现该弦 sigma 模型守恒荷的一般表达式是非局域的，并且不对应于标准等距。尽管如此，它可以由 monodromy 矩阵计算，并且是可积性所提供的守恒荷塔的一部分。
classification.one_liner: 通过可积自旋链与 BMN 弦解研究 Groenewold-Moyal 扭曲形变的 AdS/CFT 谱问题，并发现非局域守恒荷。

papers.title: Holographic Equidistribution
papers.abstract: Hecke operators acting on modular functions arise naturally in the context of 2d conformal field theory, but in seemingly disparate areas, including permutation orbifold theories, ensembles of code CFTs, and more recently in the context of the AdS$_3$/RMT$_2$ program. We use an equidistribution theorem for Hecke operators to show that in each of these large $N$ limits, an entire heavy sector of the partition function gets integrated out, leaving only contributions from Poincar\'e series of light states. This gives an immediate holographic interpretation as a sum over semiclassical handlebody geometries. We speculate on further physical interpretations for equidistribution, including a potential ergodicity statement.

classification.title_zh: 全息等分布
classification.abstract_zh: 作用在模函数上的 Hecke 算子在二维共形场论中自然出现，但也出现在看似不同的领域中，包括置换 orbifold 理论、码 CFT 系综，以及最近在 AdS$_3$/RMT$_2$ 纲领中。我们使用 Hecke 算子的等分布定理证明，在这些大 $N$ 极限的每一个中，配分函数的整个重态部门都会被积掉，只剩下来自轻态 Poincaré 级数的贡献。这立即给出一种全息解释：对半经典 handlebody 几何的求和。我们推测等分布还有进一步的物理解释，包括一个可能的遍历性陈述。
classification.one_liner: Hecke 算子等分布定理表明，在 AdS3/RMT2 等大 N 极限中重态被积分掉，全息对偶化为轻态 Poincaré 级数对应的半经典 handlebody 几何求和。

papers.title: From the Gravitational Compton Amplitude to Black Hole Perturbation Theory
papers.abstract: We employ a single worldline effective field theory in a Schwarzschild-Tangherlini background to compute the gravitational Compton amplitude up to third post-Minkowskian order. After excising the infrared divergences associated with the Weinberg phase, we establish a direct and exact map to results in black hole perturbation theory with a natural resummation and regularization of the forward divergences of the Compton amplitude. We also outline possible applications of this useful computational bridge for Compton amplitudes that include spin and tidal effects.

classification.title_zh: 从引力康普顿振幅到黑洞微扰理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 Schwarzschild-Tangherlini 背景中使用单一世界线有效场论，计算到第三后闵可夫斯基阶的引力康普顿振幅。在剔除与 Weinberg 相位相关的红外发散后，我们建立了向黑洞微扰理论结果的直接且精确的映射，并对康普顿振幅的前向发散进行自然的重求和与正则化。我们还概述了这一有用计算桥梁在包含自旋和潮汐效应的康普顿振幅中的可能应用。
classification.one_liner: 在 Schwarzschild-Tangherlini 背景中用世界线有效场论计算至三阶后闵可夫斯基的引力康普顿振幅，并精确映射到黑洞微扰理论。

papers.title: Entanglement inequalities, black holes and the architecture of typical states
papers.abstract: Using the holographic realization of the Araki--Lieb (AL) inequality, we argue that the leading entanglement plateau constrains the organization of typical pure states in a fixed-$(E,J)$ sector of a large-$c$ two-dimensional holographic CFT. On the field-theory side, its equality structure motivates an effective factorization of the regulated micro-canonical code subspace into ultraviolet (UV), intermediate and infrared factors, with part of the intermediate sector providing a purifier of the ultraviolet one. In the bulk, entanglement-wedge reconstruction realizes the ultraviolet sector as an asymptotic corona, universal to simple probes with length scale smaller than $L_{\rm UV}$. Crucially, $L_{\rm UV}$ is determined only by the conserved charges. At finite $c$, universal perturbative dressing correlates these leading factors and lifts the AL plateau at order $c^0$. We formulate a generalized ETH ansatz under which $O(e^{-S_<})$ fluctuations, with $S<=\min(S_L,S_R)$, account for the $O(c^0)$ deficit of the AL plateau, while the state dependence of matrix elements of individual simple operators smeared over lengths shorter than $L_{\rm UV}$ remains exponentially small. This provides a holographic realization and rotating generalization of the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis: for zero rotation it reduces to the standard $O(e^{-S/2})$. Independently, the separation between $L_{\rm UV}$ and the scale of quantum correlations is of order $e^{-6S_</c}$ at large $S_<$.

classification.title_zh: 纠缠不等式、黑洞与典型态的架构
classification.abstract_zh: 利用 Araki--Lieb (AL) 不等式的全息实现，我们论证领头的纠缠平台约束了大中心荷二维全息 CFT 中固定 (E,J) 扇区里典型纯态的组织方式。在场论一侧，其等号结构促使将正规化微正则码子空间有效分解为紫外 (UV)、中间和红外因子，其中中间扇区的一部分为紫外扇区提供纯化器。在体内部，纠缠楔重构将紫外扇区实现为渐近冠，对长度尺度小于 L_UV 的简单探针是普适的。关键的是，L_UV 仅由守恒荷决定。在有限 c 下，普适微扰修饰关联这些领头因子，并在 c^0 阶抬升 AL 平台。我们提出一个广义 ETH 拟设，其中 O(e^{-S_<}) 涨落（S_< = min(S_L,S_R)）解释了 AL 平台的 O(c^0) 亏损，而单个简单算符在短于 L_UV 的长度上 smeared 后的矩阵元的状态依赖性仍保持指数小。这为 ETH 提供了全息实现和带旋转的推广：无旋转时它约化为标准的 O(e^{-S/2})。独立地，L_UV 与量子关联尺度之间的分离在大 S_< 时为 e^{-6S_</c} 量级。
classification.one_liner: 通过全息实现 Araki-Lieb 不等式，论文刻画大 c 二维全息 CFT 典型态的 UV/IR 因子结构、纠缠平台及广义 ETH，并给出旋转推广。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息纠缠、黑洞信息与 ETH 基础，与全息量子信息/黑洞信息方向相关；但不直接涉及用户列出的全息凝聚态、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7 或经典引力等重点支线。

papers.title: Type II embeddings for $d=6$ Einstein-Maxwell gauged supergravity
papers.abstract: Bi-spinor and G-structure methods are used to classify the possible consistent truncations of type II supergravity to $d=6$ Einstein-Maxwell (gauged) supergravity, and its consistent sub-sectors. In the absence of R-symmetry gauging and a tensor multiplet we establish that every supersymmetric Mink$_6$ solution defines an embedding of the $d=6$ theory. Adding a tensor multiplet places restrictions on these embeddings, but embeddings still exist. In the presence of R-symmetry gauging the internal spaces of the embeddings are neither related to Mink$_6$ or AdS$_6$. Under the assumption that the internal space contains a single U(1) isometry housing the $d=6$ gauge field we classify the possible embedding manifolds. We find two classes of embedding for the entire theory, one of which is governed by a Toda-like equation and contains at least one prototype bounded embedding, albeit containing likely un-physical singularities. In the absence of a tensor multiple the classes of embeddings become more permissive, though the PDEs governing them become more complicated in general.

classification.title_zh: d=6 Einstein-Maxwell 规范超引力的 Type II 嵌入
classification.abstract_zh: 使用双旋量和 G-结构方法分类 Type II 超引力到 d=6 Einstein-Maxwell（规范）超引力及其一致子扇区的可能一致截断。在没有 R 对称性规范且没有张量多重态时，我们证明每个超对称 Mink6 解都定义了 d=6 理论的一个嵌入。加入张量多重态会限制这些嵌入，但嵌入仍然存在。存在 R 对称性规范时，嵌入的内部空间既不与 Mink6 也不与 AdS6 相关。假设内部空间包含一个单一 U(1) 等距，其中容纳 d=6 规范场，我们分类可能的嵌入流形。我们找到整个理论的两类嵌入，其中一类由类 Toda 方程支配，并包含至少一个原型有界嵌入，尽管可能含有非物理奇点。在没有张量多重态时，嵌入的类别变得更宽松，但支配它们的偏微分方程一般变得更复杂。
classification.one_liner: 用双旋量与 G-结构方法分类 Type II 超引力到六维 Einstein-Maxwell 规范超引力的一致截断/嵌入，并分析张量多重态与 R 对称性规范的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 Type II 超引力一致截断/嵌入分类，虽与 AdS/CFT 的体引力构造有间接基础关联，但摘要未涉及用户列出的全息凝聚态、相变、QNM、经典引力等具体研究方向。

papers.title: 3D $\mathcal{N}=1$ supergravity from Virasoro TQFT: Gravitational partition function and Out-of-time-order correlator
papers.abstract: In this paper, we compute the partition functions of $\mathcal{N}=1$ SUGRA for different boundary topologies, i.e. punctured sphere and torus, using super-Virasoro TQFT. We use fusion and modular kernels of the super-Liouville theory to compute the necklace-channel conformal block and showcase formalism by proving that the inner product holds for superconformal blocks, defined as states in the Hilbert space. Finally, we compute the out-of-time-order correlator for the torus topology with superconformal primary insertions as matter using the tools of super-Virasoro TQFT.

classification.title_zh: 来自 Virasoro TQFT 的三维 N=1 超引力：引力配分函数与乱序关联函数
classification.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们使用超 Virasoro TQFT 计算了不同边界拓扑（即带 puncture 的球面和环面）下 N=1 SUGRA 的配分函数。我们利用超 Liouville 理论的融合核与模核计算 necklace 道共形块，并通过证明定义为 Hilbert 空间中的态的超共形块的内积成立来展示该形式体系。最后，我们使用超 Virasoro TQFT 的工具计算了环面拓扑下以超共形原初插入作为物质的乱序关联函数。
classification.one_liner: 用超 Virasoro TQFT 计算三维 N=1 超引力的配分函数与 OTOC。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于三维超引力/Virasoro TQFT 与 OTOC 的形式计算，未直接涉及用户列出的重点支线（如全息超导、探针膜、经典引力、相变气泡成核等）。

papers.title: A Cuscuton Representation of the Loop Quantum Cosmology Bounce
papers.abstract: Loop Quantum Cosmology (LQC) replaces the big bang singularity of the homogeneous universe by a bounce, usually described by the modified Friedmann equation $H^2=\rho(1-\rho/\rho_c)/(3M_p^2)$. We show that this background dynamics follows from a local cuscuton effective theory, whose scalar equation is a constraint rather than a wave equation. One way to establish this is to write the cuscuton in terms of an angular coordinate $\theta$, identified with the LQC polymerization angle $2\lambda b$. Its constraint gives $H\propto\sin\theta$, while the Einstein constraint gives $\rho=\rho_c\sin^2(\theta/2)$, exactly reproducing the LQC bounce. To our knowledge, this is the first closed-form, local, generally covariant realization of the exact standard flat-FLRW LQC background dynamics for minimally coupled matter satisfying null energy condition, without introducing additional local dynamical degrees of freedom. A branchwise Legendre transformation establishes a canonical equivalence between the clock-gauge-fixed homogeneous mimetic system in the case of vanishing mimetic dust energy density and the cuscuton systems. It selects the constant-tension cuscuton coordinate $\Theta=\sin\theta-\theta$, while $\theta$ retains its interpretation as the LQC polymerization angle. This equivalence does not establish agreement of the inhomogeneous theories or their perturbations. The angular action also admits an explicit branched $f(K)$ representation, where $K$ is the mean extrinsic curvature of spatial hypersurfaces. The construction is therefore an effective covariant representation of the LQC holonomy correction, not a derivation from full loop quantum gravity.

classification.title_zh: 圈量子宇宙学反弹的 Cuscuton 表示
classification.abstract_zh: 圈量子宇宙学（LQC）用反弹取代均匀宇宙的大爆炸奇点，通常由修改的 Friedmann 方程 H^2=ρ(1-ρ/ρ_c)/(3M_p^2) 描述。我们表明，这一背景动力学来自一个局域 cuscuton 有效理论，其标量方程是约束而非波动方程。建立这一点的一种方式是用角坐标 θ 写出 cuscuton，并将其等同于 LQC 的聚合角 2λb。其约束给出 H∝sinθ，而 Einstein 约束给出 ρ=ρ_c sin^2(θ/2)，正好复现 LQC 反弹。据我们所知，这是对满足零能量条件的极小耦合物质，在不引入额外局域动力学自由度的情况下，首次以闭式、局域、广义协变的方式实现精确的标准平坦 FLRW LQC 背景动力学。分支式 Legendre 变换在 mimetic 尘埃能量密度为零的钟规范固定均匀 mimetic 系统与 cuscuton 系统之间建立正则等价。它选择常张力 cuscuton 坐标 Θ=sinθ−θ，而 θ 保持其作为 LQC 聚合角的解释。该等价并不证明非均匀理论或其扰动也一致。角作用还允许一个显式的分支 f(K) 表示，其中 K 是空间超曲面的平均外曲率。因此，该构造是 LQC holonomy 修正的有效协变表示，而不是从完整圈量子引力导出的结果。
classification.one_liner: 用局域 cuscuton 约束系统以广义协变闭式复现平坦 FLRW 的 LQC 反弹，并给出 mimetic 与 f(K) 对应。
classification.relevance_reason: 不属于全息/AdS-CFT，但涉及经典引力/宇宙学有效理论、修改 Friedmann 方程与广义协变表述，与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线相关；未触及用户其他全息重点标签。

papers.title: On eigenvectors of the SYK model
papers.abstract: We consider the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model with $N$ Majorana fermions and interaction order $q$. For even $q\in \{2,4,...,N-2\}$, we give an elementary proof and show that the eigenvectors of the model are completely delocalized in all deterministic directions.

classification.title_zh: 论 SYK 模型的本征向量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑具有 N 个 Majorana 费米子和相互作用阶 q 的 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型。对于偶数 q∈{2,4,...,N-2}，我们给出一个初等证明，并表明该模型的本征向量在所有确定性方向上完全离域。
classification.one_liner: 对 SYK 模型本征向量完全离域性的初等证明，适用于偶数相互作用阶 q。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 SYK/矩阵模型方向，研究本征向量离域性；未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动或经典引力/广义相对论等具体支线。

papers.title: Horizon, Null-Orbit, and Photon-Sphere Phase Structures in Logarithmic Nonlinear Electrodynamics
papers.abstract: We investigate static, charged, asymptotically flat black holes in LNED in the $(Q,\epsilon)$ parameter space. We distinguish three phase structures: the horizon geometry, the background circular null orbits, and the circular photon orbits of the effective optical geometry. All share a zero-radius boundary $Q_{\rm nc}(\epsilon;M)=\gamma M^{2/3}\epsilon^{1/6}$, but have distinct critical structures: the extremal curve $Q_{\rm ext}(\epsilon;M)$ and the merger curve $Q_{\rm m}(\epsilon;M)$ both terminate at the bifurcation point $(Q_{\rm b},\epsilon_{\rm b})$, with $Q_{\rm b}=9M/[2\Gamma^2(1/4)]$ and $\epsilon_{\rm b}=128\pi^2Q_{\rm b}^2$, whereas the effective photon-orbit merger curve $Q_{\rm m}^{\rm ph}(\epsilon;M)$ does not pass through this point. For $\epsilon\ge\epsilon_{\rm b}$, approaching $Q_{\rm nc}$ shrinks the horizon to zero and produces black points with quantum-corrected entropy $S_{\eta}(r_{\rm h}\to0)=\eta$. Their temperature vanishes at the bifurcation point and diverges for $\epsilon>\epsilon_{\rm b}$, except at $\eta\delta=1$. The background potential $V_{\rm eff}^{\rm bg}(r)$ develops an infinite barrier at $r=0$ without local extrema, acting as a perfect repeller. The photon potential $V_{\rm eff}^{\rm ph}(r)$ is regularized with a maximum at finite radius, acting as a partial reflector. Thus the black points retain a photon sphere at finite radius. Away from $Q_{\rm nc}$, for $\epsilon<\epsilon_{\rm b}$ both geometries support horizonless structures above $Q_{\rm ext}$; for $\epsilon\ge\epsilon_{\rm b}$ only the optical geometry does so in $Q_{\rm nc}<Q<Q_{\rm m}^{\rm ph}$. Non-radial geodesics are blocked from the singularity and can form metastable bound states, while radial geodesics either reach $r=0$ or escape to infinity. The critical impact parameter encodes both gravitational and optical-geometry effects, probing the distinct phase structures.

classification.title_zh: 对数非线性电动力学中的视界、零轨道与光子球相结构
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 LNED 的 (Q, ε) 参数空间中研究静态、带电、渐近平直黑洞。我们区分三种相结构：视界几何、背景圆零轨道，以及有效光学几何的圆光子轨道。三者共享零半径边界 Q_nc(ε;M)=γ M^{2/3} ε^{1/6}，但具有不同的临界结构：极端曲线 Q_ext(ε;M) 与并合曲线 Q_m(ε;M) 都终止于分岔点 (Q_b, ε_b)，其中 Q_b=9M/[2Γ^2(1/4)]、ε_b=128π^2 Q_b^2，而有效光子轨道并合曲线 Q_m^ph(ε;M) 不经过该点。对于 ε≥ε_b，趋近 Q_nc 会使视界收缩至零，并产生具有量子修正熵 S_η(r_h→0)=η 的黑点。其温度在分岔点为零，并在 ε>ε_b 时发散，ηδ=1 时除外。背景势 V_eff^bg(r) 在 r=0 处形成一个无局域极值的无限势垒，充当完美排斥体。光子势 V_eff^ph(r) 被正则化，并在有限半径处具有最大值，充当部分反射体。因此黑点在有限半径处保留一个光子球。远离 Q_nc 时，对于 ε<ε_b，两种几何都在 Q_ext 之上支持无视界结构；对于 ε≥ε_b，只有光学几何在 Q_nc<Q<Q_m^ph 中如此。非径向测地线被阻止到达奇点，并可形成亚稳束缚态，而径向测地线要么到达 r=0，要么逃逸到无穷远。临界碰撞参数同时编码引力与光学几何效应，探测不同的相结构。
classification.one_liner: 研究对数非线性电动力学黑洞在 (Q,ε) 参数空间中的视界、圆零轨道与有效光学几何光子球相结构，并分析临界曲线、有效势与测地线行为。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线，涉及黑洞、零测地线与光子球；但它不属于全息/AdS-CFT 研究。

papers.title: The separate universe approach with non minimal coupling to gravity
papers.abstract: In this paper we extend a study of the validity conditions of the separate universe approach of cosmological perturbations to models of inflation with multiple fields that are non minimally coupled to gravity. The separate universe approach effectively describes the universe as a collection of homogeneous and isotropic patches, leading to an effective description of cosmological perturbations at large scales. This approximation is a necessary step in stochastic inflation and in the $\delta \N$ formalism. We study and compare the dynamics of cosmological perturbation theory at large scales to the dynamics derived in the separate universe picture for non linear sigma models where we have allowed a non minimal coupling between the fields and gravity. We found that the separate universe approach adequately reproduces the dynamics of the large scale perturbations, provided the wavelength of the modes considered is greater than a list of lower bounds derived from the background evolution of the model we consider. These lower bounds are then compared to those derived in the classically equivalent Einstein frame description of the Jordan frame model at hand. In particular these conditions are derived and compared for a Higgs-like toy model of inflation in the large field limit.

classification.title_zh: 与引力非最小耦合的分离宇宙方法
classification.abstract_zh: 本文把对宇宙学扰动分离宇宙方法有效性条件的研究，推广到多个场与引力非最小耦合的暴胀模型。分离宇宙方法将宇宙有效描述为一系列均匀且各向同性的斑块，从而给出大尺度宇宙学扰动的有效描述。该近似是随机暴胀和 δN 形式中的必要步骤。我们研究并比较了大尺度宇宙学微扰论的动力学，与在允许场和引力之间存在非最小耦合的非线性 sigma 模型中由分离宇宙图像导出的动力学。我们发现，只要所考虑模式的波长大于由所考虑模型背景演化给出的若干下界，分离宇宙方法就能充分再现大尺度扰动的动力学。随后，这些下界与当前 Jordan 架模型在经典等价的 Einstein 架描述中导出的下界进行了比较。特别地，这些条件在一个大场极限下的 Higgs 型暴胀玩具模型中被推导并比较。
classification.one_liner: 将分离宇宙方法/δN 形式的大尺度有效性条件推广至与引力非最小耦合的多场暴胀，并与 Einstein 架的下界比较。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究暴胀宇宙学扰动、分离宇宙方法与 δN 形式，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力；仅与经典引力/宇宙学相关。

papers.title: Charged Simpson-Visser-AdS spacetime: QPOs and observational constraints
papers.abstract: In this article, we examine particle dynamics and Quasi-periodic oscillations within a charged Simpson-Visser-Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime. We first analyze the behavior of the metric and black hole horizons under the competing impact of electric charge $Q$, regularization parameter $b$, and AdS radius $l$. The roots of the metric function reveal transitions between three distinct topological classes: non-extremal configurations featuring distinct inner and outer horizons, extremal limits with a single degenerate horizon, and strictly positive, horizonless wormhole geometries. By evaluating the effective potential, we determine how this modified geometry shifts the Innermost Stable Circular Orbit (ISCO) and alters the angular momentum and energy of test particles. Moreover, we derive the Keplerian, radial, and vertical frequencies to model quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs). We show that the interplay between the regularization parameter $b$ and the AdS radius $l$ significantly modifies twin-peak QPOs. In particular, $b$ drives fundamental QPO frequencies higher than those predicted by standard general relativistic backgrounds. Twin-peak high-frequency QPO data from two black-hole binaries disfavor the Schwarzschild limit at $\sim\!4\sigma$, but constrain only a degenerate combination of charge and AdS curvature, leaving the regularization parameter entirely unconstrained by the data.

classification.title_zh: 带电 Simpson-Visser-AdS 时空：QPO 与观测约束
classification.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究带电 Simpson-Visser-反德西特（AdS）时空中的粒子动力学和准周期振荡。我们首先分析度规和黑洞视界在电荷 Q、正则化参数 b 和 AdS 半径 l 竞争影响下的行为。度规函数的根揭示了三种不同拓扑类之间的转变：具有不同内外视界的非极端构型、具有单个简并视界的极端极限，以及严格正的无视界虫洞几何。通过评估有效势，我们确定这种修改几何如何移动最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO），并改变测试粒子的角动量和能量。此外，我们推导开普勒频率、径向频率和垂直频率，以建模准周期振荡（QPO）。我们表明，正则化参数 b 与 AdS 半径 l 之间的相互作用显著修改双峰 QPO。特别地，b 驱动基本 QPO 频率高于标准广义相对论背景所预言的频率。来自两个黑洞双星的双峰高频 QPO 数据在约 4σ 水平上排斥 Schwarzschild 极限，但仅约束电荷和 AdS 曲率的退化组合，而正则化参数完全未被数据约束。
classification.one_liner: 该文在带电 Simpson-Visser-AdS 时空中分析测试粒子运动、ISCO 与 QPO，并用黑洞双星数据约束电荷、AdS 曲率和正则化参数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究带电 Simpson-Visser-AdS 经典时空中的粒子动力学、ISCO 和 QPO 观测约束，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息字典或量子引力。

papers.title: Gottfried-Jackson polarization filters for holographic dilaton and transverse-traceless gluon responses in near-threshold $J/\psi$ photoproduction
papers.abstract: Within the Hatta-Yang holographic graviton-dilaton amplitude for near-threshold $J/\psi$ photoproduction, we identify exact dilaton-null spin-projection channels in the Gottfried-Jackson basis. The $m=0$ and $m=-\lambda_\gamma$ amplitudes receive no dilaton contribution; for photon polarization normal to the reaction plane the $m=0$ channel further isolates $A_g(t)+B_g(t)$ and requires nucleon spin transfer. Standard beam-polarization spin-density-matrix elements then furnish TT-only controls and a bilinear containing linear dilaton-TT interference. A comparison with modern GlueX and CLAS12 cross sections shows that the original fixed-shape holographic amplitude cannot describe the full near-threshold data with one overall normalization, making the polarization filters tests of the production tensor rather than predictions of a globally validated reaction model.

classification.title_zh: 近阈值 J/ψ 光产生中全息伸缩子与横向无迹胶子响应的 Gottfried-Jackson 偏振滤波器
classification.abstract_zh: 在 Hatta-Yang 近阈值 J/ψ 光产生的全息引力子-伸缩子振幅中，我们在 Gottfried-Jackson 基下识别出精确的伸缩子零自旋投影通道。m=0 和 m=-λγ 振幅没有伸缩子贡献；对于垂直于反应平面的光子偏振，m=0 通道进一步隔离出 A_g(t)+B_g(t)，并且需要核子自旋转移。标准束偏振自旋密度矩阵元随后给出仅 TT 的控制项和一个包含线性伸缩子-TT 干涉的双线性项。与现代 GlueX 和 CLAS12 截面的比较表明，原始固定形状全息振幅无法用一个整体归一化描述全部近阈值数据，这使得偏振滤波器成为对产生张量的检验，而不是一个全球验证反应模型的预测。
classification.one_liner: 近阈值 J/ψ 光产生的全息引力子-伸缩子模型中，Gottfried-Jackson 偏振滤波器可分离伸缩子、TT 与干涉贡献，但原固定形状振幅无法用一个归一化统一拟合 GlueX/CLAS12 数据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 QCD/核物理，使用全息引力子-伸缩子振幅研究近阈值 J/ψ 光产生，但未直接匹配用户列出的重点支线标签。

papers.title: Two-horizon sector thermodynamics and NUT bi-hair in Kerr-Newman-NUT spacetimes
papers.abstract: First law consistency alone does not determine the black hole state space of NUT-charged spacetimes, because several inequivalent macroscopic formulations can yield consistent thermodynamics. We develop a two-horizon sector diagnostic for the electrically charged Kerr-Newman-NUT family by organizing the inner- and outer-horizon entropies and inverse temperatures into sum ($\Sigma$) and difference ($\Delta$) sectors. The charged rotating geometry gives a more stringent test of the uncharged Taub-NUT sector result, since the mass $M$, ordinary electric charge $Q$, ordinary angular momentum $J$, NUT charge $N$, and the NUT secondary hair $J_N=MN$ all enter the same two-horizon thermodynamics. For the physically anchored minimal homogeneous state spaces defined and tested here, we find a clear sector separation: the $\Sigma$ sector closes with the charge-like variables $Q$ and $N$, whereas the $\Delta$ sector additionally requires the rotation-like variables $J$ and $J_N$. Natural reductions that eliminate either $J_N$ or $N$ fail to reproduce the first law coefficient fixed by the sector temperature, and their associated Bekenstein-Smarr relations do not close with the assigned scaling weights. Within this class, electric charge and ordinary rotation therefore do not absorb the NUT secondary response, and the charged rotating family supports the NUT bi-hair organization: $N$ has a charge-like sector role, while $J_N=MN$ is a rotation-like thermodynamic secondary hair. The latter is defined off shell in the homogeneous equation of state, not as a new metric parameter or asymptotic conserved charge.

classification.title_zh: Kerr-Newman-NUT 时空中的双视界扇区热力学与 NUT 双毛发
classification.abstract_zh: 仅靠第一定律的自洽性不能确定带 NUT 荷时空的黑洞状态空间，因为若干不等价的宏观表述都可给出自洽热力学。我们为带电容性的 Kerr-Newman-NUT 族发展了一种双视界扇区诊断，将内、外视界熵和逆温度组织为求和（Σ）与差（Δ）扇区。带电转动几何为无电荷 Taub-NUT 扇区结果提供了更严格的检验，因为质量 M、普通电荷 Q、普通角动量 J、NUT 荷 N 以及 NUT 次级毛发 J_N=MN 都进入同一套双视界热力学。对于本文定义并检验的、具有物理锚定的最小齐次状态空间，我们发现清晰的扇区分离：Σ 扇区由类荷变量 Q 和 N 闭合，而 Δ 扇区额外需要类转动变量 J 和 J_N。若自然消去 J_N 或 N，则无法重现由扇区温度固定的第一定律系数，其关联的 Bekenstein-Smarr 关系也不能按指定标度权重闭合。在这一类中，电荷和普通转动因此不能吸收 NUT 次级响应，带电转动族支持 NUT 双毛发组织：N 具有类荷的扇区角色，而 J_N=MN 是类转动的热力学次级毛发。后者在齐次状态方程中离壳定义，而不是新的度规参数或渐近守恒荷。
classification.one_liner: 通过双视界 Σ/Δ 扇区分析，表明 Kerr-Newman-NUT 热力学支持 NUT 双毛发：N 为类荷扇区变量，J_N=MN 为类转动次级毛发。

papers.title: Thermal equilibrium in general relativity and the special nature of the cosmological constant
papers.abstract: The problem of thermal equilibrium in general relativity is discussed and the unique role played by the fluid associated with the cosmological constant is emphasized. In addition to being the only fluid that is always in thermal equilibrium, it is shown here that its energy can also be seen as a universal quantity given by $E_\Lambda=\rho_\Lambda V$, where $V$ is a spatial volume. Furthermore, if the cosmological constant turns out to be a universal constant, then the conclusion that any spatial volume $V$ has an intrinsic energy follows naturally from the approach considered here. A possible application to quantum theories of gravity that postulate the existence of a minimal length scale is discussed. In studying the energies, the so-called teleparallel equivalent of general relativity is used, and the difficulty with the zero-point energy is discussed in light of the gravitational energy problem. The quasi-local energies of the Reissner-Nordstr\"om-de Sitter black hole and of a regular black hole are calculated. The results obtained here with the teleparallel theory are consistent with our expectations.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论中的热平衡与宇宙学常数的特殊性质
classification.abstract_zh: 讨论了广义相对论中的热平衡问题，并强调了与宇宙学常数相关的流体所起的独特作用。除了是唯一始终处于热平衡的流体之外，本文还表明其能量可视为由 E_Λ=ρ_Λ V 给出的普适物理量，其中 V 是空间体积。此外，如果宇宙学常数最终是一个普适常数，那么任何空间体积 V 都具有内禀能量这一结论便自然地从本文所考虑的方法中得出。文中讨论了该方法在假设存在最小长度尺度的量子引力理论中的可能应用。在研究能量时，使用了所谓的广义相对论远平行等价表述，并结合引力能量问题讨论了零点能的困难。文中计算了 Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter 黑洞和一个规则黑洞的准局域能量。远平行理论得到的结果与我们的预期一致。

papers.title: Inhomogeneous dust collapse in five-dimensional AdS-Chern-Simons gravity
papers.abstract: We study the gravitational collapse of a spherically symmetric, inhomogeneous dust cloud in five-dimensional AdS Chern--Simons gravity. Working in the torsion-free sector and using comoving Lema\^{\i}tre--Tolman--Bondi coordinates, we derive the reduced field equations and obtain an exact collapsing interior solution. The areal radius evolves periodically in time, but the physical collapsing branch extends only up to shell focusing or an earlier loss of regularity, while the initial density determines a radial function whose square is proportional to the conserved quasilocal mass. This separates the roles of the initial velocity and density profiles in controlling shell focusing and trapping. We derive conditions for central regularity and for avoiding shell crossing, analyze the Kretschmann scalar, and show that shell focusing corresponds to a genuine curvature singularity, the weak and strong energy conditions are preserved throughout the regular collapsing phase. The homogeneous limit reduces consistently to a five-dimensional FLRW interior. The collapsing cloud is matched smoothly to the black-hole branch of the static AdS Chern--Simons exterior. The null expansions show that a finite-radius apparent horizon forms only when the quasilocal mass exceeds a critical threshold. Initially untrapped shells above this threshold become trapped before shell focusing, whereas below the total-mass threshold no finite-radius future-trapped symmetry sphere forms in the regular interior.

classification.title_zh: 五维AdS-Chern-Simons引力中的非均匀尘埃坍缩
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了五维AdS Chern--Simons引力中球对称、非均匀尘埃云的引力坍缩。在无挠扇区并使用共动Lemaître--Tolman--Bondi坐标，我们推导了约化场方程并获得了精确的坍缩内部解。面积半径随时间周期演化，但物理坍缩分支只延伸到壳层聚焦或更早的规则性丧失；初始密度决定一个径向函数，其平方正比于守恒准局域质量。这将初始速度和密度剖面在控制壳层聚焦与捕获中的作用分离开来。我们推导了中心规则性和避免壳层交叉的条件，分析了Kretschmann标量，并表明壳层聚焦对应真实的曲率奇点，弱能量条件和强能量条件在规则坍缩阶段始终保持。均匀极限一致地约化为五维FLRW内部解。坍缩云被光滑匹配到静态AdS Chern--Simons外解的黑洞分支。零膨胀表明，仅当准局域质量超过临界阈值时才形成有限半径表观视界。高于该阈值的初始未捕获壳层在壳层聚焦前变为捕获，而低于总质量阈值时，规则内部中不形成有限半径的未来捕获对称球面。
classification.one_liner: 在五维AdS-Chern-Simons引力中构造非均匀尘埃坍缩的精确内部解，并分析壳层聚焦、曲率奇点、能量条件及表观视界阈值。

papers.title: Does a Second-Class Primary Constraint Generate a Gauge Transformation? Electromagnetisms and Gravities, Massless and Massive
papers.abstract: In constrained Hamiltonian dynamics there are two views regarding how first-class constraints generate gauge transformations: individually or only in a certain combination, the Rosenfeld-Anderson-Bergmann-Castellani gauge generator. This gauge generator $G$ preserves Hamilton's equations and changes the canonical action at most by a boundary term; Hamiltonian's equations are the Euler-Lagrange equations for the canonical action. Hence the canonical formalism is equivalent to the Lagrangian formalism, and indeed subsumed within it (in important examples) with many canonical momenta serving as auxiliary fields. $G$ generates transformations basically equivalent to the usual 4-dimensional Lagrangian expressions, such as a 4-gradient in electromagnetism or a space-time coordinate transformation (on-shell) in General Relativity. It has been shown recently that separate first-class constraints lead to inequivalent observables between Proca non-gauge and Stueckelberg gauge massive electromagnetism. There is, however, widespread agreement that second-class constraints do not generate gauge transformations. Here it is shown that in such a sense as the first-class primary constraint in Maxwell's theory generates a gauge transformation, the second-class primary constraint in Proca's massive electromagnetism also generates a gauge transformation. Likewise the second-class primary constraints in various massive spin $2$ relatives of General Relativity generate as much of a gauge transformation as do the corresponding first-class primary constraints in GR. Hence the view that first-class constraints typically generate gauge transformations _individually_ faces a puzzle not faced by the gauge generator view.

classification.title_zh: 第二类初级约束是否生成规范变换？电磁理论与引力理论，无质量与有质量情形
classification.abstract_zh: 在约束哈密顿动力学中，关于第一类约束如何生成规范变换存在两种观点：分别地生成，或者仅以某种组合——Rosenfeld-Anderson-Bergmann-Castellani 规范生成元——生成。该规范生成元 G 保持哈密顿方程不变，并至多将正则作用量改变一个边界项；而哈密顿方程就是正则作用量的 Euler-Lagrange 方程。因此，正则形式与拉格朗日形式等价，并且在重要例子中可被后者包含，许多正则动量充当辅助场。G 生成的变换基本等价于通常的四维拉格朗日表达式，例如电磁学中的四维梯度，或广义相对论中的（在壳）时空坐标变换。最近已表明，分开的第一类约束会导致 Proca 非规范有质量电磁学与 Stueckelberg 规范有质量电磁学之间的可观测量不等价。然而，人们普遍同意第二类约束不生成规范变换。本文表明，在 Maxwell 理论中第一类初级约束生成规范变换的同等意义上，Proca 有质量电磁学中的第二类初级约束也生成规范变换。类似地，广义相对论的各种有质量自旋 2 亲缘理论中的第二类初级约束，生成的规范变换程度与广义相对论中相应的第一类初级约束一样多。因此，‘第一类约束通常分别地生成规范变换’这一观点面临一个规范生成元观点不会面临的难题。
classification.one_liner: 论文论证第二类初级约束在 Proca 有质量电磁学与有质量自旋 2 引力理论中也能像第一类初级约束那样生成规范变换，从而挑战逐个别生成规范变换的观点。

papers.title: Chaos bound for spinning particles in a hairy black hole with two photon spheres
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the unstable circular orbits of spinning test particles and the associated classical orbital chaos bound in a hairy black hole spacetime admitting a double photon sphere structure. This background supports two distinct branches of unstable circular orbits, referred to as the inner and outer branches. We find that, within the parameter ranges considered, the inner branch always satisfies the chaos bound, whereas violations can occur on the outer branch. This behavior contrasts with many previous studies focusing primarily on near-horizon violations of the chaos bound and reveals a clear dependence of the bound on the orbital branch. Our analysis further shows that the total angular momentum of the particle has a pronounced effect on the local orbital instability and can enlarge the bound-violating region on the outer branch. Meanwhile, the deformation parameter of the background geometry regulates the validity of the bound by modifying both the orbital Lyapunov exponent and the black hole surface gravity. By contrast, the effect of the particle spin is comparatively weak and mainly shifts the existing unstable circular orbits and the corresponding critical boundaries through the spin-curvature coupling.

classification.title_zh: 带双光子球的有毛黑洞中自旋粒子的混沌界
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了允许双光子球结构的有毛黑洞时空中自旋测试粒子的不稳定圆轨道以及相关的经典轨道混沌界。该背景支持两族不同的不稳定圆轨道，称为内支和外支。我们发现，在所考虑的参数范围内，内支总是满足混沌界，而外支可能出现违反。这种行为与先前主要关注视界附近违反混沌界的研究形成对比，并揭示了该界对轨道支的明显依赖。我们的分析进一步表明，粒子的总角动量对局部轨道不稳定性有显著影响，并能扩大外支上的违反区域。同时，背景几何的形变参数通过修改轨道 Lyapunov 指数和黑洞表面引力来调节该界的有效性。相比之下，粒子自旋的影响相对较弱，主要通过自旋-曲率耦合移动已有的不稳定圆轨道及相应的临界边界。
classification.one_liner: 在有双光子球的有毛黑洞中，自旋测试粒子的外支不稳定圆轨道可违反经典混沌界，且总角动量与几何形变参数显著影响违反区域。

papers.title: Journey to the Center of a Black Hole
papers.abstract: An infalling two-point function of a scalar field in a three-dimensional BTZ black hole, with one operator inserted in the exterior and the other inserted along a timelike geodesic, diverges when the infalling insertion point reaches the black hole singularity. In the boundary description, this divergence comes entirely from the exchange of double-twist operators, rather than from the multi-stress-tensor sector that encodes the curvature singularities in higher dimensions. We show that the inclusion of a tower of massive particles with Hagedorn growth gives rise to loop corrections that become important near the singularity, where they trigger a Hagedorn transition that renders the tree-level divergence untrustworthy. In the boundary theory, the corresponding tower of primary operators leads to a breakdown of the generalized free field description of the probe operator in the black hole state. In a large black hole, these corrections become important only near the singularity and remain exponentially suppressed at the horizon. The region where these corrections dominate is therefore parametrically separated from the horizon, as anticipated by the principle of black hole complementarity.

classification.title_zh: 前往黑洞中心之旅
classification.abstract_zh: 在三维 BTZ 黑洞中，一个标量场的落入两点函数——其中一个算符插入外部，另一个沿类时测地线插入——当落入插入点到达黑洞奇点时会发散。在边界描述中，这一发散完全来自双扭曲算符的交换，而不是来自在高维中编码曲率奇点的多重应力张量部门。我们表明，纳入具有 Hagedorn 增长的大质量粒子塔会产生圈修正，这些修正在奇点附近变得重要，并触发 Hagedorn 转变，使树级发散不再可信。在边界理论中，相应的原初算符塔导致黑洞态中探针算符的广义自由场描述失效。对于大黑洞，这些修正只在奇点附近变得重要，并在视界处保持指数压低。因此，这些修正主导的区域与视界在参数上分离，正如黑洞互补性原理所预期。

papers.title: Microscopic Organization of BPS Black-Hole States in the D1--D5--P CFT
papers.abstract: We study BPS states in the D1--D5 CFT through their fortuity, cycle structure, and probe response. Explicit fortuitous states with both long- and short-string geometries show that the cycle partition does not determine fortuity state by state. At large $N$, fixed-charge counting nevertheless selects a long string. In the open uncondensed region, an entropy-carrying exact non-graviton subspace concentrates on one cycle of winding $N-O(1)$. Assuming subexponential monotone dimension, the same holds for the harmonic fortuitous complement. Beyond the critical line, the free ensemble develops a short-string condensate. To test how this cycle structure appears in observables, we study finite-winding probes. The long-cycle scalar correlator approaches the extremal-BTZ response at fixed time, while finite winding is resolved at \(t=O(\sqrt N)\), the exact circle recurs at \(t=O(N)\), and states with the same cycle geometry remain distinguishable by their spectral weights.

classification.title_zh: D1-D5-P CFT 中 BPS 黑洞态的微观组织
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过 BPS 态的 fortuity、循环结构和探针响应研究 D1-D5 CFT 中的 BPS 态。具有长弦和短弦几何的显式 fortuitous 态表明，循环划分不能逐态决定 fortuity。在大 N 下，固定电荷计数仍然选择一条长弦。在开放未凝聚区域，一个携带熵的精确非引力子子空间集中在绕数为 N-O(1) 的一个循环上。假设次指数单调维度，谐振 fortuitous 补集亦如此。越过临界线后，自由系综发展出短弦凝聚。为检验这种循环结构如何在可观测量中出现，我们研究有限绕数探针。长循环标量关联子在固定时间趋近 extremal-BTZ 响应，而有限绕数在 t=O(√N) 时被分辨，精确圆在 t=O(N) 时复现，并且具有相同循环几何的态仍可通过其谱权重区分。
classification.one_liner: 通过 fortuity、循环结构和有限绕数探针分析 D1-D5 CFT 中的 BPS 黑洞态，发现大 N 固定电荷计数偏好长弦，并可观测到循环几何与谱权重。

papers.title: Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov equations and the analytic structure of strings in AdS$_3$
papers.abstract: The pole structure of string correlators in AdS$_3$ encodes essential information about the AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ duality. The corresponding residues for spectrally flowed three-point functions have been extracted from their exact expressions and shown to match the predictions of the holographic CFT. Away from the tensionless point, the latter is defined perturbatively in terms of a deformed symmetric orbifold. For $n$-point functions, this has so far only been achieved for a specific subset of poles and employing free-field techniques. Here we develop an alternative approach. We show that, starting from the localization properties of worldsheet correlators, one can solve the KZ equations on the corresponding locus and perform the integration over worldsheet moduli explicitly for any $n$ and for arbitrary values of the spectral flow charges. This provides a systematic framework for computing the remaining residues and, ultimately, for determining the full analytic structure of string amplitudes in AdS$_3$.

classification.title_zh: Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov 方程与 AdS$_3$ 中弦的解析结构
classification.abstract_zh: AdS$_3$ 中弦关联函数的极点结构编码了 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 对偶的重要信息。谱流三点函数对应的留数已从其精确表达式提取，并显示与全息 CFT 的预言一致。在无张力点之外，后者以变形对称轨道流形的微扰方式定义。对于 $n$ 点函数，此前仅对特定极点子集并借助自由场技术实现了这一点。这里我们发展一种替代方法。我们表明，从世界面关联函数的局域化性质出发，可以在相应轨迹上求解 KZ 方程，并对任意 $n$ 和任意谱流荷显式完成世界面模数的积分。这为计算剩余留数并最终确定 AdS$_3$ 中弦振幅的完整解析结构提供了系统框架。
classification.one_liner: 从世界面关联函数的局域化性质求解 KZ 方程，为任意 n 点谱流弦关联函数和 AdS$_3$ 弦振幅完整解析结构提供系统框架。
