papers.title: A gravitational realization of Courant-Hilbert deformations
papers.abstract: Courant-Hilbert (CH) deformations unify broad classes of solvable stress-tensor flows including $T\bar{T}$ and root-$T\bar{T}$. However, a gravitational action that systematically yields such general deformations has remained unknown. In this Letter, we construct a two-dimensional massive gravity theory whose on-shell action reproduces the complete CH deformation. The gravity sector is defined via an arbitrary function of the eigenvalue ratio $y$ of the relative zweibein. To bypass the technical difficulty of directly eliminating the auxiliary zweibein, we reformulate the matter sector using a $2 \times 2$ spectral decomposition involving $y$ and a rank-one projector $K$. Sequentially solving the equations of motion--first for $K$ and subsequently for $y$--naturally maps the system onto the Russo-Townsend form of the CH flow. Our work extends Tolley's massive gravity formulation of $T\bar{T}$ flows to the CH landscape, providing a clear geometric mechanism for solvable stress-tensor flows.

classification.title_zh: Courant-Hilbert 变形的引力实现
classification.abstract_zh: Courant-Hilbert (CH) 变形统一了包括 TTbar 和 root-TTbar 在内的多类可解应力张量流。然而，能够系统给出此类一般变形的引力作用量仍未知。本文构造了一个二维大质量引力理论，其壳上作用量重现完整的 CH 变形。引力部分由相对 zweibein 的本征值比 y 的任意函数定义。为绕过直接消去辅助 zweibein 的技术困难，我们用涉及 y 和秩一投影算符 K 的 2×2 谱分解重新表述物质部分。依次求解运动方程——先对 K，后对 y——自然地将系统映射到 CH 流的 Russo-Townsend 形式。我们的工作将 Tolley 的 TTbar 流大质量引力表述扩展到 CH 领域，为可解应力张量流提供了清晰的几何机制。
classification.one_liner: 构造二维大质量引力理论，其壳上作用量重现完整 Courant-Hilbert 变形，将 Tolley 的 TTbar 大质量引力表述推广到 CH 领域。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题涉及 TTbar/CH 应力张量变形及其二维大质量引力实现，与全息多迹变形和 AdS/CFT 字典相关；但摘要未明确讨论 AdS/CFT 具体应用或用户所列重点支线。

papers.title: Black holes with axion hair from cubic Riemann interactions
papers.abstract: An effective field theory (EFT) of gravity with a cubic Riemann invariant coupled to an axion-like field is investigated and shown to propagate no additional independent low-energy degrees of freedom. This interaction generates a curvature-induced scalar profile around black holes, characterised by a secondary axion charge fixed by regularity of the axion field at the horizon, while the requirement of a regular event horizon constrains the asymptotic axion background. We construct the corresponding black hole solutions and show that the backreaction of the axion field could affect the metric only at subleading order in the EFT expansion. The modified geometry impacts black hole thermodynamics and Hawking evaporation, thus providing a controlled realisation of black holes with higher-curvature contributions and secondary axion hair motivated by ultraviolet physics. The modified Hawking temperature allows for the existence of black hole remnants at the end of the evaporation within the regime of validity of the EFT.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 来自三次黎曼相互作用的带轴子毛黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 研究了引力的一种有效场论（EFT），其中三次黎曼不变量与类轴子场耦合，并表明它不会传播额外的独立低能自由度。该相互作用在黑洞周围产生曲率诱导的标量剖面，其特征是由视界处轴子场正则性固定的次级轴子荷，而正则事件视界的要求约束了渐近轴子背景。我们构造了相应的黑洞解，并表明轴子场的反作用只能在 EFT 展开的次领头阶影响度规。修改后的几何影响黑洞热力学和霍金蒸发，从而给出了由紫外物理驱动的、具有高阶曲率贡献和次级轴子毛的黑洞的可控实现。修改后的霍金温度允许在 EFT 有效范围内蒸发结束时存在黑洞遗迹。
classification.one_liner: 在带三次黎曼-轴子耦合的引力 EFT 中构造带次级轴子毛的黑洞解，并分析其对热力学、霍金蒸发和黑洞遗迹的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究修改引力中的黑洞解、黑洞热力学与霍金蒸发，属于经典引力/广义相对论，并对应‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签。

papers.title: Holography for integrable field theories
papers.abstract: We develop a holographic dual to the integrable field theories built from $4d$ Chern-Simons theory. The dual theory is a topological string on a generalized Calabi-Yau manifold, which is entirely encoded in a geometric object we call a planar spectral curve. We describe the RG flow for a planar integrable field theory as a geometric flow on the moduli of planar spectral curves. This description is valid at all orders in the 't Hooft coupling. We compute this flow explicitly up to two loops in many examples, and find an exact match with known field theory results. At one loop this includes a wide class of models. At two loops we reproduce the RG flow for the principal chiral model with WZ term, and for a class of integrable $\sigma$-models with target $U(N) \times U(N)$.

classification.title_zh: 可积场论的全息对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为基于四维 Chern-Simons 理论构造的可积场论发展了一个全息对偶。该对偶理论是广义 Calabi-Yau 流形上的拓扑弦，它完全编码在我们称为平面谱曲线的几何对象中。我们将平面可积场论的 RG 流描述为平面谱曲线模空间上的几何流。这一描述在 't Hooft 耦合的所有阶都成立。我们在许多例子中显式计算了这一流至两圈，并发现与已知场论结果精确匹配。在一圈阶，这包括一大类模型。在两圈阶，我们重现了带 WZ 项的主手征模型的 RG 流，以及一类靶空间为 U(N) × U(N) 的可积 σ 模型的 RG 流。
classification.one_liner: 用四维 Chern-Simons、拓扑弦和平面谱曲线为可积场论构造全息对偶，并精确重现其 RG 流。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息对偶与可积场论交叉方向，与给定的重点标签（全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论）均无直接对应。

papers.title: M2 brane $S^3/\mathbb Z_k$ instanton partition function in ${\rm AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction
papers.abstract: As was shown in arXiv:2609.14497, the 2-loop correction to the partition function of M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ vanishes, in agreement with the localization prediction for $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS Wilson loop in ABJM theory in the grand-canonical ensemble according to the conjecture of arXiv:2505.21633. Here we study the 2-loop correction in the case of the M2 brane instanton $S^3/\mathbb Z_k\subset S^7/\mathbb Z_k$ dual to non-perturbative large $N$ contribution to ABJM free energy on 3-sphere. The 1-loop instanton contribution was shown in arXiv:2307.14112 to match the localization prediction. The 2-loop computation is complicated by the presence of bosonic and fermionic zero modes, which require using projected Green's functions and accounting for the collective-coordinate Jacobian. The Jacobian provides a non-trivial 2-loop contribution in addition to the one of the 4-vertex in the M2 brane action. We find that for $k>2$ the transcendental $k$-dependence of the 4-vertex contribution is cancelled by the Jacobian for any choice of the separation of the fermionic zero modes from the quantum fields. The residual rational term vanishes for the separation selected by the supersymmetry, under which the collective coordinates and the quantum fields form separate supermultiplets. We conjecture that the remaining integral over the collective coordinates contributes only to an overall normalization of the partition function, so it is 1-loop exact. For $k=1$ the quartic vertex contribution reduces to equation-of-motion terms as in the case of ${\rm AdS}_3 \subset { \rm AdS}_7 \times S^4$ in arXiv:2511.22306 related to $S^3 \subset {\rm AdS}_4 \times S^7$ case by a formal analytic continuation.

classification.title_zh: AdS4×S7/Z_k 中 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数：2 圈修正
classification.abstract_zh: 如 arXiv:2609.14497 所示，包裹 AdS2×S1 并位于 AdS4×S7/Z_k 内的 M2 膜的配分函数的 2 圈修正消失，这与 ABJM 理论中 1/2-BPS Wilson 圈在大正则系综中的局域化预测一致，符合 arXiv:2505.21633 的猜想。这里我们研究 M2 膜瞬子 S^3/Z_k ⊂ S^7/Z_k 情形下的 2 圈修正，该瞬子对偶于 ABJM 理论在三维球面上的自由能中非微扰大 N 贡献。arXiv:2307.14112 已表明 1 圈瞬子贡献与局域化预测匹配。2 圈计算因存在玻色子和费米子零模而变得复杂，需要使用投影格林函数并考虑集体坐标雅可比。雅可比在 M2 膜作用量的 4 顶点贡献之外提供非平凡 2 圈贡献。我们发现对于 k>2，4 顶点贡献的超越 k 依赖对于费米子零模与量子场分离的任何选择都被雅可比抵消。剩余有理项在超对称所选择的分离下消失，此时集体坐标和量子场形成各自的超多重态。我们猜想，对集体坐标的剩余积分只对配分函数的整体归一化有贡献，因此它是 1 圈精确的。对于 k=1，四顶点贡献约化为运动方程项，正如 arXiv:2511.22306 中 AdS3 ⊂ AdS7×S4 的情形，通过形式解析延拓与 S^3 ⊂ AdS4×S7 情形相关。
classification.one_liner: 计算 AdS4×S7/Z_k 中 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数的 2 圈修正，发现 k>2 时雅可比抵消 4 顶点贡献，剩余项在超对称分离下消失。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 精确计算与 ABJM M2 膜瞬子配分函数研究，但未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或经典引力等支线，因此相关性低。

papers.title: Cylinder Defect Casimir Energy and Weyl Anomalies
papers.abstract: We distinguish two Casimir observables associated with a conformal surface defect. A circular cylinder embedded in flat space has a logarithmic contribution to its Casimir energy, $-d_1\log(R/\epsilon)/(24R)$, fixed by the displacement anomaly. A great cylinder obtained by radial quantization of the ambient theory instead has Casimir energy $-b/(12R)$ in the conformal defect vacuum with a fixed local anomaly convention. Free-field and holographic calculations provide checks of the proposed relations in both embeddings.

classification.title_zh: 柱面缺陷卡西米尔能量与Weyl反常
classification.abstract_zh: 我们区分与共形表面缺陷相关的两个卡西米尔观测量。嵌入平直空间的圆柱面对其卡西米尔能量有对数贡献，$-d_1\log(R/\epsilon)/(24R)$，由位移反常固定。作为替代，通过对环境理论做径向量子化得到的大圆柱面，在固定局部反常约定的共形缺陷真空中具有卡西米尔能量 $-b/(12R)$。自由场和全息计算为这两种嵌入中提出的关系提供了检验。
classification.one_liner: 区分平直空间中嵌入圆柱与径向量子化大圆柱两类共形表面缺陷的卡西米尔能量，并用位移/Weyl反常固定其系数，以自由场和全息计算检验。
classification.relevance_reason: 主要属于共形缺陷场论与反常的精确结果，全息仅作为检验；未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波、相变、QNM、探针膜等具体支线。

papers.title: dS/CFT Holography including Fermionic Fields
papers.abstract: We investigate some aspects of holography in de Sitter space, pertaining to the proposal for the dual theory residing on the late-time boundary [arXiv:astro-ph/0210603v5], including a Fermionic field that satisfies the Dirac equation. The modes of the solutions near the boundary are found to possess equal and oscillatory fall-off, similar to the scalar field belonging to the principal series representation of the isometry group of de Sitter space. We evaluate, by suitably adding a boundary term to the Dirac action, the wavefunctional of the Bunch Davies vacuum in path integral formalism in terms of the projections of the field on the eigenspaces of the time-like ${\gamma}$-matrix. We validate our path-integral construction of the wavefunctional by reproducing the two-point function between the field operators in the vacuum state as computed in the canonical formalism. By appropriately identifying the boundary sources in terms of the projected components of the bulk field, we find that a single Dirac field in the bulk corresponds to a pair of primary spinor fields in the boundary theory and show that the resulting wavefunction coefficients satisfy the conformal Ward identities. We check the robustness of our holographic map under the addition of a Yukawa interaction considering the two cases where the scalar field in the interaction term belongs to the complementary series and the principal series representations of the isometry group of de Sitter space respectively.

classification.title_zh: 包含费米子场的 dS/CFT 全息
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 de Sitter 空间全息的一些方面，涉及对偶理论位于晚期边界的提议 [arXiv:astro-ph/0210603v5]，并纳入满足 Dirac 方程的费米子场。发现边界附近解的模态具有相同且振荡的衰减行为，类似于属于 de Sitter 空间等距群主系列表示的标量场。通过适当向 Dirac 作用量添加边界项，我们在路径积分形式中用场在类时 γ-矩阵本征空间上的投影来表示 Bunch-Davies 真空的波函数泛函。我们通过重现正则形式下计算得到的真空态场算符两点函数，验证了波函数泛函的路径积分构造。通过适当地用体场投影分量识别边界源，我们发现体中的单个 Dirac 场对应于边界理论中的一对初级旋量场，并表明所得的波函数系数满足共形 Ward 恒等式。我们通过考虑相互作用项中标量场分别属于 de Sitter 空间等距群互补系列和主系列表示的情形，检验了在加入 Yukawa 相互作用后全息映射的稳健性。
classification.one_liner: 将 Dirac 费米子纳入 dS/CFT 晚期边界对偶，构造 Bunch-Davies 真空波函数并验证边界共形对称性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 dS/CFT 全息与边界波函数构造，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、探针膜、QNM、经典引力或冷原子等具体支线，因此与重点方向相关性低。

papers.title: Extrinsic Renormalization of New Massive Gravity
papers.abstract: The renormalization of asymptotically AdS spacetimes in New Massive Gravity is studied using boundary terms constructed with the extrinsic curvature. For generic values of the theory couplings, a single extrinsic boundary term produces a consistent holographic description, as the variation of the total action is finite and expressible in terms of the holographic source. This prescription applies to constant-curvature geometries and non-Einstein solutions with Brown-Henneaux asymptotic conditions. A suitable asymptotic expansion shows the agreement of the resulting holographic stress tensor with the one obtained from the auxiliary-field formulation. At the degenerate point, where the two maximally symmetric vacua coalesce, the Fefferman-Graham expansion admits an additional mode associated with relaxed AdS boundary conditions. A quadratic extrinsic counterterm removes the new divergences and leads naturally to a holographic picture with two independent sources. The corresponding responses obey a modified holographic Ward identity and determine finite conserved charges. Finally, the proper use of the Noether-Wald formalism reproduces the correct charges of the BTZ black hole, non-Einstein AdS waves, and the rotating hairy black hole.

classification.title_zh: 新质量引力的外禀重整化
classification.abstract_zh: 本文利用由外禀曲率构造的边界项，研究新质量引力中渐近 AdS 时空的重整化。对于理论耦合的一般取值，单个外禀边界项即可给出自洽的全息描述，因为总作用量的变分是有限的，并可用全息源表示。该方案适用于常曲率几何以及满足 Brown-Henneaux 渐近条件的非 Einstein 解。适当的渐近展开表明，所得全息应力张量与辅助场表述得到的结果一致。在简并点，即两个最大对称真空合并处，Fefferman-Graham 展开允许一个与松弛 AdS 边界条件相关的额外模式。一个二次外禀抵消项消除了新的发散，并自然导致具有两个独立源的全息图像。相应的响应满足修改后的全息 Ward 恒等式，并确定有限的守恒荷。最后，正确使用 Noether-Wald 形式可复现 BTZ 黑洞、非 Einstein AdS 波以及旋转带毛黑洞的正确荷。
classification.one_liner: 在新质量引力中，用外禀曲率边界项实现渐近 AdS 的全息重整化，并在简并点得到双源描述与修正 Ward 恒等式，复现多种黑洞/波的守恒荷。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接涉及 AdS/CFT 全息重整化、全息应力张量与守恒荷，且属于修改引力/经典引力中的渐近 AdS 黑洞与波解，贴合用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论。

papers.title: Charged regular AdS$_3$ black holes in a scalar-vector-tensor theory coupled to Born-Infeld electrodynamics
papers.abstract: We construct exact, static, circularly symmetric charged regular AdS$_3$ black hole solutions in a three-dimensional scalar-vector-tensor theory obtained from regularized Gauss-Bonnet couplings. While the Maxwell-charged counterpart of this theory suffers from a logarithmic curvature singularity at the origin, we demonstrate that coupling the action to non-linear Born-Infeld electrodynamics cures this pathology. We obtain the metric function and show explicitly the regularity of the core. Depending on the choice of parameters, the solution exhibits various horizon structures, including single-horizon, double-horizon, extremal black holes, and horizonless regular geometries. Finally, we discuss the significance of this regular spacetime as a testbed for microscopic entropy calculations in singularity-free setups.

classification.title_zh: 标量-矢量-张量理论中耦合 Born-Infeld 电动力学的带电正则 AdS3 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了三维标量-矢量-张量理论中精确、静态、圆对称的带电正则 AdS3 黑洞解，该理论由正则化 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合得到。虽然该理论的 Maxwell 带电版本在原点存在对数曲率奇点，但我们证明将作用量耦合到非线性 Born-Infeld 电动力学可以消除这一病态。我们得到了度规函数，并明确展示了核心的正则性。根据参数选择，该解表现出多种视界结构，包括单视界、双视界、极值黑洞以及无视界正则几何。最后，我们讨论了该正则时空作为无奇点设置中微观熵计算测试平台的意义。
classification.one_liner: 在标量-矢量-张量理论中耦合 Born-Infeld 电动力学，构造出无原点曲率奇点的带电正则 AdS3 黑洞，并给出多种视界结构。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文给出 AdS3 正则带电黑洞的精确经典解，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；虽提及微观熵，但未显式开展全息计算。

papers.title: 3d Lovelock gravity and the holographic c-theorem: Proof at all orders and resummation
papers.abstract: We prove that 3d Lovelock gravity, the Horndeski theory obtained from the regularized Lovelock invariants in three dimensions, admits a holographic c-theorem at all orders and for arbitrary values of the couplings. In the minisuperspace of domain wall solutions, the equation of the Horndeski scalar is a total derivative at every order, which locks the derivative of the scalar to that of the warp factor along the flows we consider and allows the null energy condition to be integrated into a monotonic c-function. The linear scalar profile of the resulting vacuum breaks the special conformal transformations, so the dual theory is scale-invariant but not conformal, and the central charge is defined as the coefficient of the logarithmic divergence of the on-shell action on the sphere. We compute it exactly for the Gauss-Bonnet case and asymptotically for the full tower, and find that it is linear in the couplings and matches the UV value of the c-function. Since all results depend on the couplings only through two generating functions, we give the resummed Lagrangians, c-functions and central charges in closed form for the choices of couplings that lead to regular black holes, and classify the resummed theories by the positivity of the effective Newton constant on the vacuum and the uniqueness of the vacuum with a non-trivial scalar.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 三维 Lovelock 引力与全息 c-定理：全阶证明与重求和
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，三维 Lovelock 引力——由三维正则化 Lovelock 不变量得到的 Horndeski 理论——在任意耦合值下、所有阶都满足全息 c-定理。在畴壁解的 minisuperspace 中，Horndeski 标量方程在每一阶都是全导数，这把我们考虑的流中标量的导数与翘曲因子的导数锁定在一起，并使零能量条件可积分为单调 c-函数。所得真空的线性标量剖面破坏特殊共形变换，因此对偶理论是标度不变但非共形的，中心荷定义为球面上 on-shell 作用量对数发散的系数。我们对 Gauss-Bonnet 情形精确计算该中心荷，对完整塔渐近计算，并发现它对耦合是线性的，且与 c-函数的 UV 值匹配。由于所有结果仅通过两个生成函数依赖耦合，我们针对导致正则黑洞的耦合选择，以闭式给出重求和后的拉氏量、c-函数和中心荷，并根据真空上有效牛顿常数的正性以及具有非平凡标量的真空唯一性对重求和理论进行分类。
classification.one_liner: 证明三维 Lovelock 引力中全息 c-定理在所有阶成立，并重求和得到 c-函数与中心荷。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究三维 Lovelock 引力的全息 c-定理与畴壁解，涉及经典引力/广义相对论以及畴壁/非均匀态；但未涉及全息超导、相变气泡成核、QNM 或实验启发等具体重点方向。

papers.title: Nonlinear pole topology of slow currents in holographic probe-brane metals
papers.abstract: Low-frequency Drude response does not by itself determine which nearly conserved sector carries an electric current. We classify the leading cubic retarded response of an isolated, inversion-symmetric slow vector by its pole topology. Constitutive nonlinearity produces only incoming-frequency poles, whereas nonlinear relaxation adds a propagator at the emitted frequency; coupling to a second scalar slow mode generates pair-frequency poles. We then compute the full complex third-harmonic response of finite-density Dirac--Born--Infeld probe branes in Lifshitz black-brane backgrounds. In the marginal $z=2$ theory, the dense infrared response approaches the relaxation topology, with a signed infrared weight $p_{\rm IR}=0.994\pm0.002$ and a normalization-independent zero at $\omega_\times/\Gamma_J=0.2918$. Nonmarginal $z=1$ and $z=3/2$ backgrounds instead realize mixed constitutive--relaxation weights, demonstrating that the topology is selected dynamically rather than imposed by the DBI square root. The exact nonlinear dc solution further yields a parameter-free dense-limit scaling function and a crossover field $E_{\rm nl}\propto T^{3/2}$ at $z=2$. These results connect emergent higher-form slow currents, nonlinear response theory, and holographic transport, while the two-mode extension identifies the additional pole structures expected when energy or deformation modes remain slow.

secondary_topics: 全息凝聚态/超流超导/强关联
classification.title_zh: 全息探针膜金属中慢电流的非线性极点拓扑
classification.abstract_zh: 低频 Drude 响应本身并不能确定哪个近守恒部门携带电流。我们根据极点拓扑对孤立、反演对称的慢矢量的领头立方推迟响应进行分类。本构非线性仅产生入射频率极点，而非线性弛豫则在发射频率处增加一个传播子；与第二个标量慢模式的耦合产生对频率极点。然后我们计算了 Lifshitz 黑膜背景中有限密度 Dirac-Born-Infeld 探针膜的完整复三次谐波响应。在边缘 z=2 理论中，稠密红外响应接近弛豫拓扑，具有带符号的红外权重 p_IR = 0.994 ± 0.002 和归一化无关的零点 ω_×/Γ_J = 0.2918。非边缘 z=1 和 z=3/2 背景则实现混合本构-弛豫权重，表明拓扑是动态选择的，而不是由 DBI 平方根强加的。精确非线性直流解进一步给出了无参数稠密极限标度函数和在 z=2 时的交叉场 E_nl ∝ T^{3/2}。这些结果连接了涌现的高形式慢电流、非线性响应理论和全息输运，而双模式扩展识别了当能量或形变模式保持慢速时预期的额外极点结构。
classification.one_liner: 通过极点拓扑分类全息探针膜金属中慢电流的非线性响应，并计算有限密度 DBI 探针膜在 Lifshitz 背景下的三次谐波响应，揭示红外拓扑的动态选择。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文研究全息探针膜金属中的非线性输运，涉及 DBI 探针膜和 Lifshitz 背景，与用户关注的 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜和非线性响应支线直接相关。

papers.title: Hairy Taub-NUT solution in gauged supergravity
papers.abstract: We present and study a family of exact Taub-NUT-AdS solutions with scalar hair in four-dimensional ${\cal N}=2$ gauged supergravity. The solutions are supported solely by a nontrivial scalar field and its self-interaction potential, with all gauge fields switched off. We determine the conditions under which Killing horizons exist and demonstrate that the spacetime admits at most one Killing horizon, and whenever it exists it is necessarily nondegenerate. In particular, the NUT deformation can give rise to a horizon in a branch whose static limit is horizonless. We also establish that the solutions with nontrivial scalar hair admit no Killing spinors. As in ordinary Taub-NUT-AdS spacetime, the global structure is afflicted by closed timelike curves. We compute the conserved mass using the covariant phase space method and formulate a restricted first law with the NUT parameter held fixed. Finally, we study the Euclidean sector, including an exceptional family specific to Euclidean signature, and determine the regularity conditions for bolts and nuts.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 规范超引力中的带毛 Taub-NUT 解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出并研究了一族在四维 N=2 规范超引力中带标量毛的精确 Taub-NUT-AdS 解。这些解仅由非平凡标量场及其自相互作用势支撑，所有规范场均被关闭。我们确定了 Killing 视界存在的条件，并证明该时空至多允许一个 Killing 视界，且只要存在就必然是非退化的。特别地，NUT 形变可以在其静态极限无视界的支上产生视界。我们还证明，具有非平凡标量毛的解不允许任何 Killing 旋量。与普通 Taub-NUT-AdS 时空一样，整体结构受到闭合类时曲线的困扰。我们使用协变相空间方法计算守恒质量，并在固定 NUT 参数的条件下表述了一个受限第一定律。最后，我们研究欧几里得部分，包括欧几里得符号特有的一个例外族，并确定 bolts 和 nuts 的正则性条件。
classification.one_liner: 在四维 N=2 规范超引力中构造并分析带标量毛的 Taub-NUT-AdS 精确解，讨论 Killing 视界、守恒质量、第一定律与欧几里得正则性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线：研究规范超引力中的精确 Taub-NUT-AdS 解、视界、守恒量与欧几里得正则性；未涉及全息对偶、全息凝聚态或用户列出的其他全息方向，但匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签。

papers.title: A backreacted bouncing geodesic in 2D
papers.abstract: In holography, analytically continued finite temperature correlation functions $G(t)$ exhibit signatures of the black hole singularity. These take the form of singularities at certain values of $t$ whose bulk origin is a null geodesic worldline "bouncing off" the black hole singularity. We study certain quantum corrections to this effect in 2D dilaton gravity that are captured by gravitational backreaction of the worldline onto the black hole geometry. These corrections smooth out the bouncing geodesic singularities. By following the backreacted geodesic saddle in a steepest descent analysis we find instead that the black hole singularity physics gets encoded in a subtle way involving a Stokes phenomenon near the coincident point singularity of $G(t)$ at $t=0$ (and its thermal image). We point out a parallel between the structure of Stokes lines uncovered in this analysis and the structure present in the analysis of forbidden singularities in large $c$ 2D conformal blocks. Finally we make some preliminary remarks about the significance of quantum corrections in these models beyond backreaction.

classification.title_zh: 二维中反作用后的反弹测地线
classification.abstract_zh: 在全息中，解析延拓的有限温度关联函数 G(t) 显示出黑洞奇点的特征。这些特征表现为某些 t 值处的奇异性，其在体时空的起源是一条从黑洞奇点“反弹”的零测地线世界线。我们研究 2D 膨胀引力中这一效应的某些量子修正，这些修正由世界线对黑洞几何的引力反作用所捕获。这些修正将反弹测地线奇异性抹平。通过在陡降分析中追踪反作用后的测地线鞍点，我们发现黑洞奇点物理反而以一种微妙方式被编码，涉及 G(t) 在 t=0（及其热镜像）处的重合点奇异性附近的 Stokes 现象。我们指出，此分析中揭示的 Stokes 线结构与大 c 二维共形块中禁戒奇点的分析中存在的结构有平行之处。最后，我们对这些模型中超出反作用的量子修正的意义作一些初步评论。
classification.one_liner: 在二维膨胀引力中，世界线反作用抹平反弹测地线奇异性，并将黑洞奇点信息转移到 G(t) 重合点附近的 Stokes 现象中。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及全息关联函数、黑洞奇点与二维膨胀引力中的量子反作用，属于全息量子引力核心方向，但不直接匹配所列重点支线（如全息超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM等）。

papers.title: General Relativity with Finite Boundaries
papers.abstract: In this thesis, we consider general relativity on a manifold with a timelike boundary of finite size, across all signs of the cosmological constant $\Lambda$. We impose conformal boundary conditions, whereby the conformal class of the induced metric and the trace of the extrinsic curvature $K$ are fixed at the boundary. In Lorentzian signature, we analyse the linearised Einstein equations about Minkowski, de Sitter (dS), and anti-de Sitter (AdS) space for a variety of boundaries, employing the Kodama-Ishibashi formalism adapted to manifolds with a boundary. In Euclidean signature, we study the thermodynamics of black hole and cosmological horizons enclosed by the boundary, computing the leading semiclassical approximation of the gravitational path integral, for which the boundary data define a conformal canonical ensemble of fixed conformal temperature and $K$.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 有限边界的广义相对论
classification.abstract_zh: 在本论文中，我们考虑具有有限大小类时边界的流形上的广义相对论，涵盖宇宙学常数 Λ 的所有符号。我们施加共形边界条件，即固定诱导度规的共形类和外曲率迹 K 在边界上。在洛伦兹号差下，我们使用适用于带边界流形的 Kodama-Ishibashi 形式，分析围绕 Minkowski、de Sitter（dS）和 anti-de Sitter（AdS）空间的线性化 Einstein 方程，针对多种边界。在欧几里得号差下，我们研究被边界包围的黑洞和宇宙学视界的热力学，计算引力路径积分的主导半经典近似，其中边界数据定义固定共形温度和 K 的共形正则系综。
classification.one_liner: 在有限类时边界与共形边界条件下，研究各 Λ 符号下的广义相对论线性化与半经典视界热力学。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典广义相对论、有限边界与黑洞/宇宙学视界热力学，属于用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线；摘要未显示 AdS/CFT 对偶或全息计算，因此不归为理论全息。

papers.title: Spread Complexity for Local Operator Quenches with Conserved Momentum
papers.abstract: We study a family of locally excited states in two-dimensional conformal field theories in different setups, defined on the plane, on the cylinder, or at finite temperature. These states are constructed by assigning independent chiral and anti-chiral regulators to a local primary operator, leading to excitations carrying net momentum. We analytically calculate the first few Lanczos coefficients and the early time behaviour of the spread complexity associated with these states. Then, using numerical methods, we obtain the coefficients reaching larger Krylov indices and find the associated spread complexity for a longer range of time evolution. We also compare the rate of change of the resulting spread complexity with the proposed holographic dual quantity, related to the proper momentum of an infalling particle in the dual bulk, but we observe a mismatch.

classification.title_zh: 带守恒动量的局域算符淬火的扩散复杂度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了二维共形场论中不同设置下的一类局域激发态，这些态定义在平面、圆柱或有限温度下。通过给一个局域原初算符分别指定独立的手征和反手征正规化子来构造这些态，从而得到携带净动量的激发。我们解析计算了前几个 Lanczos 系数以及这些态相关扩散复杂度的早期时间行为。随后，我们使用数值方法获得了达到更大 Krylov 指标的系数，并得到了更长时间演化范围内的相应扩散复杂度。我们还比较了所得扩散复杂度的变化率与所提出的全息对偶量，该量与被对偶体内下落粒子的固有动量有关，但观察到不匹配。
classification.one_liner: 在二维 CFT 中计算带净动量局域淬火态的 Lanczos 系数与扩散复杂度，并发现其变化率与全息下落粒子固有动量提案不符。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息量子信息中的 spread complexity/Krylov 复杂度方向，涉及 CFT 局域淬火及全息对偶比较；但不在给定重点标签清单中，故为中等相关。

papers.title: Nonlinear electroweak sphaleron clouds around Kerr black holes
papers.abstract: Kerr black holes and electroweak sphalerons are remarkable solutions of two pillars of modern physics: General Relativity and the Standard Model of particle physics, respectively. In this work, we investigate their interplay by constructing nonlinear sphaleron clouds around Schwarzschild and Kerr black holes in the probe limit. We first revisit static and spinning (multi-)sphalerons in flat spacetime, using the measured electroweak parameters. We then explore the domain of existence and physical properties of the corresponding black-hole configurations, revealing a rich branch structure. Remarkably, the sphaleron clouds retain a finite mass gap and do not approach linear clouds within the families studied, distinguishing them from the familiar clouds associated with the onset of superradiant instabilities. We also obtain a closed-form leading-order Higgs solution on an exact Yang-Mills configuration in a Schwarzschild background.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: Kerr黑洞周围的非线性电弱sphaleron云
classification.abstract_zh: Kerr黑洞和电弱sphaleron分别是广义相对论与标准模型的重要解。本文在探针极限下，通过构造Schwarzschild和Kerr黑洞周围的非线性sphaleron云来研究二者的相互作用。我们首先使用测量到的电弱参数，重新审视平直时空中的静态和自旋（多）sphaleron。然后探索相应黑洞构型的存在域和物理性质，揭示出丰富的分支结构。值得注意的是，sphaleron云保持有限的质量间隙，并且在所研究的族中不趋近于线性云，这使它们区别于与超辐射不稳定性出现相关的熟悉云。我们还在Schwarzschild背景下的精确Yang-Mills构型上得到了领先阶Higgs解的闭式表达式。
classification.one_liner: 在探针极限下构造Schwarzschild/Kerr黑洞周围的非线性电弱sphaleron云，发现其具有有限质量间隙且不同于超辐射线性云。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究Kerr/Schwarzschild黑洞背景下电弱sphaleron云的非线性构型，属于经典引力/广义相对论与孤子/非均匀态支线，但不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

papers.title: Localizing the M-Theory Path Integral
papers.abstract: We propose a supersymmetric localization formula for the local perturbative contribution to the M-theory path integral, reducing it to an integral over equivariant flux data. Relative equivariant extensions of the eleven-dimensional Chern--Simons couplings determine the localized action, while for M2-brane backgrounds a tangent-cotangent character computes the one-loop determinant. This gives the first closed form expression for the complete perturbative ABJM partition function at general squashing and chemical potentials, and new analytic results for the ABJM topologically twisted index describing black holes. Applied to the non-toric $V^{5,2}$ theory, the same prescription yields a closed analytic Airy constant previously known only numerically. Our formulas reproduce all available independent field theory results, and provide analytic predictions at general parameters where no field theory answer is currently known. We derive an all-genus result for the Type IIA expansion which is an equivariant form of the usual topological string constant map result, and also extract integrated correlators.

classification.title_zh: M-理论路径积分的局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个超对称局域化公式，用于 M-理论路径积分的局部微扰贡献，将其约化为对等变通量数据的积分。十一维 Chern-Simons 耦合的相对等变延拓确定局域化作用量，而对于 M2-膜背景，切-余切特征标计算单圈行列式。这给出了在一般 squash 和化学势下完整微扰 ABJM 配分函数的首个闭式表达式，以及描述黑洞的 ABJM 拓扑扭曲指数的新解析结果。应用于非环面 V^{5,2} 理论，同一公式给出此前仅数值已知的闭式 Airy 常数。我们的公式重现所有可获得的独立场论结果，并在目前尚无场论答案的一般参数处提供解析预测。我们推导了 IIA 型展开的全属结果，它是通常拓扑弦常数映射结果的等变形式，并提取了积分关联子。
classification.one_liner: 提出 M-理论路径积分的超对称局域化公式，给出 ABJM 配分函数及描述黑洞的拓扑扭曲指数的解析结果。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接给出 M-理论路径积分局域化与 ABJM 配分函数、黑洞拓扑扭曲指数的解析结果，属于 AdS/CFT 字典和量子黑洞核心方向。

papers.title: Cardy random matrix theory
papers.abstract: We construct and study a ``Cardy random matrix model'': a random matrix theory whose only input, in a maximal-ignorance prescription, is the constraint of $\mathbb{S}$-modular invariance. We regularize this constraint by coarse-graining over energy windows of fixed width, and obtain a potential for a single random matrix whose eigenvalues play the role of the scaling dimensions of primaries in a 2d CFT. The potential drives the coarse-grained density of states to the Cardy profile above a gap at the black hole threshold. We perform Monte Carlo simulations to confirm this behavior and find good agreement for the coarse-grained density of states, while at the same time revealing GUE statistics for nearby eigenvalues. We identify the scaling limit in which these phenomena emerge. In this limit, the model realizes a hierarchy of scales: at the macroscopic scale given by the window size, the occupations are frozen and the bootstrap constraint rigidly fixes the spectrum to the Cardy profile, while at the mesoscopic scale (inside a window) the Vandermonde repulsion rearranges the eigenvalues as in a random matrix theory. It is only at the microscopic scale of the mean level spacing that the individual levels are resolved. Accordingly, our random matrix model displays an effective Thouless time, set by the inverse energy width of the coarse-graining window. Our model provides a first step towards solving the matrix/tensor model dual to 3D quantum gravity on a computer.

classification.title_zh: Cardy 随机矩阵理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造并研究了“Cardy 随机矩阵模型”：一种随机矩阵理论，在最大无知规定下，其唯一输入是 S-模不变性约束。我们通过在固定宽度的能量窗口上粗粒化来正则化该约束，并得到一个单个随机矩阵的势，其本征值扮演二维 CFT 中初级算子标度维度的角色。该势将粗粒化态密度驱动到黑洞阈值处能隙之上的 Cardy 分布。我们进行 Monte Carlo 模拟以确认这一行为，发现粗粒化态密度符合良好，同时揭示邻近本征值的 GUE 统计。我们确定了这些现象出现的标度极限。在此极限下，模型实现了一个尺度层级：在由窗口大小给出的宏观尺度上，占据数被冻结，bootstrap 约束刚性固定谱为 Cardy 分布；而在介观尺度（窗口内部），Vandermonde 排斥像随机矩阵理论中那样重新排列本征值。只有在平均能级间距的微观尺度上，单个能级才被分辨。因此，我们的随机矩阵模型表现出一个有效 Thouless 时间，由粗粒化窗口能量宽度的倒数设定。我们的模型为在计算机上求解与三维量子引力对偶的矩阵/张量模型提供了第一步。
classification.one_liner: 构建以 S-模不变性为唯一输入的 Cardy 随机矩阵模型，将粗粒化态密度驱动到黑洞阈值之上的 Cardy 谱，并呈现 GUE 统计与有效 Thouless 时间，为求解三维量子引力对偶的矩阵/张量模型迈出第一步。
classification.relevance_reason: 文章聚焦 Cardy 随机矩阵、S-模不变性、二维 CFT 谱与三维量子引力的矩阵/张量模型，不属于用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动或经典引力/广义相对论等支线。

papers.title: Nuclear Physics of Binary Neutron Star Mergers
papers.abstract: Binary neutron star mergers provide a unique laboratory for studying matter under conditions that cannot be reproduced in terrestrial experiments. They probe dense matter at supranuclear density, finite temperature, rapid rotation, strong gravity, and extreme neutron excess, while producing observable signals in gravitational waves, electromagnetic radiation, and, in principle, neutrinos. This review focuses on the nuclear physics of binary neutron star mergers. We discuss the dense-matter equation of state (EoS), the inspiral and merger dynamics, the structure and lifetime of the post-merger remnant, transport and dissipative processes, weak interactions and neutrino transport, and the production of heavy elements through $r$-process nucleosynthesis. Particular emphasis is placed on the connection between microscopic physics and multimessenger observables, including tidal deformability, post-merger gravitational-wave spectra, kilonova light curves, short gamma-ray bursts, and afterglows. We also review how observations of events such as GW170817, together with neutron star mass and radius measurements, laboratory nuclear experiments, and theoretical many-body calculations, constrain the EoS and the composition of dense matter. The goal is to summarize the current understanding of how nuclear physics controls the dynamics and observable signatures of binary neutron star mergers, and to identify the open questions that future multimessenger observations and improved nuclear theory will address.

classification.title_zh: 双中子星并合的核物理
classification.abstract_zh: 双中子星并合为研究地面实验无法复现的条件下的物质提供了独特实验室。它们探测超核密度、有限温度、快速旋转、强引力以及极端中子过剩条件下的致密物质，同时在引力波、电磁辐射以及原则上中微子中产生可观测信号。本综述聚焦双中子星并合的核物理。我们讨论致密物质状态方程（EoS）、旋近与并合动力学、并合后遗迹的结构与寿命、输运与耗散过程、弱相互作用与中微子输运，以及通过 r 过程核合成产生重元素。特别强调微观物理与多信使可观测量之间的联系，包括潮汐形变、并合后引力波谱、千新星光变曲线、短伽马射线暴和余辉。我们还综述 GW170817 等事件的观测，连同中子星质量和半径测量、实验室核实验以及理论多体计算，如何约束 EoS 和致密物质组成。目标是总结当前对核物理如何控制双中子星并合动力学与可观测特征的理解，并指出未来多信使观测和改进核理论将解决的开放问题。
classification.one_liner: 一篇综述，总结双中子星并合中致密物质状态方程、中微子输运、r 过程核合成及其引力波/电磁多信使信号。
classification.relevance_reason: 不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息理论；其核心是核物理与致密物质，但因涉及中子星并合、强引力与引力波多信使观测，可归入经典引力/广义相对论支线。

papers.title: NICER constraints on low density matching and high density continuation in neutron star equations of state
papers.abstract: We investigate whether current astrophysical data constrain not only the high-density continuation of the neutron star equation of state, but also the low density matching procedure itself. To this end, we compare two low density branches propagated through a common high density extension and confront them with direct NICER mass-radius posteriors, a lower bound on the maximum mass and an effective constraint on $\Lambda_{1.4}$. We find that the observable predictions of the two branches remain strongly overlapping, while the NICER-informed posterior still induces a nontrivial constraint on the matching parameters. Current data therefore constrain primarily the shared continuation above $n_1$, but also indirectly restrict the low density matching sector.

classification.title_zh: NICER 对中子星物态方程低密度匹配与高密度延拓的约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究当前天体物理数据是否不仅约束中子星物态方程的高密度延拓，也约束低密度匹配程序本身。为此，我们比较两条低密度分支，并将它们通过一个共同的高密度延拓传播，然后用直接的 NICER 质量-半径后验、最大质量下界以及对 Λ_{1.4} 的有效约束来检验。我们发现两条分支的可观测预言仍强烈重叠，而 NICER 给出的后验仍对匹配参数产生非平凡约束。因此，当前数据主要约束 n1 以上的共同延拓，但也间接限制低密度匹配部分。

papers.title: Structural quasi-universality in highly magnetized differentially rotating neutron stars
papers.abstract: Universal relations among macroscopic properties of neutron stars provide a powerful framework to probe their internal structures while minimizing uncertainties associated with the equation of state (EoS). Although such relations have been extensively studied for uniformly rotating stars, their extension to differentially rotating and strongly magnetized configurations is relatively less explored. We systematically investigate equilibrium configurations for a wide range of EoSs, rotation profiles, and magnetic field strengths with XNS numerical simulation code. For sequences with fixed angular momentum, we analyze the dependence of normalized moment of inertia on compactness. We establish a generalized quasi-universal relation between the moment of inertia and compactness that remains remarkably insensitive to the underlying EoS across uniformly rotating, differentially rotating, and strongly magnetized toroidal configurations. For sequences with fixed angular momentum, the normalized moment of inertia exhibits a quasi-universal dependence on compactness, with deviations primarily due to magnetic field strength and degree of differential rotation. We derive analytic expressions for these dependencies, enabling a unified phenomenological model applicable over a wide range of stellar configurations. As astrophysical applications, we quantify the systematic bias in magnetar luminosity estimates and the rotational kinetic energy of post-merger remnant of GW170817. These results extend quasi-universal relations beyond the standard assumptions of uniform rotation and weak magnetization, providing a robust framework for interpreting observations of highly magnetized and differentially rotating neutron stars, and enabling more reliable constraints on their astrophysical properties.

classification.title_zh: 高度磁化差速旋转中子星中的结构性准普适性
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星宏观性质之间的普适关系为探测其内部结构提供了有力框架，同时可最大限度减小状态方程（EoS）带来的不确定性。尽管这类关系在均匀自转星体上已被广泛研究，但其向差速旋转和强磁化位形的推广仍相对较少。我们使用XNS数值模拟代码，系统研究了广泛EoS、转动剖面和磁场强度下的平衡位形。对于固定角动量的序列，我们分析了归一化转动惯量对致密度的依赖。我们建立了一个广义准普适关系，使转动惯量与致密度之间的关系在均匀自转、差速旋转以及强磁化环形位形中都能对 underlying EoS 保持显著不敏感。对于固定角动量序列，归一化转动惯量表现出对致密度的准普适依赖，偏差主要来自磁场强度和差速旋转程度。我们推导了这些依赖的解析表达式，从而给出一个适用于广泛星体位形的统一唯象模型。作为天体物理应用，我们量化了磁星光度估计中的系统偏差以及GW170817并合后遗迹的转动动能。这些结果将准普适关系推广到超出均匀自转和弱磁化标准假设的范围，为解释高度磁化、差速旋转中子星的观测提供了稳健框架，并有助于更可靠地限制其天体物理性质。
classification.one_liner: 用XNS数值模拟研究固定角动量序列中转动惯量与致密度的广义准普适关系，并推广到差速旋转与强磁场环形位形。

papers.title: Black hole-neutron star binaries with high spins and large mass asymmetries: III. Properties of the ejected material and its electromagnetic signatures
papers.abstract: Compact binary systems consisting of a black hole (BH) and a neutron star (NS) are expected to provide detectable signals both in the gravitational wave and in the electromagnetic channels, thus representing excellent sources for multi-messenger astronomy. In this third paper in a series, we report on the geometric and thermodynamic properties of the purely dynamical ejecta component modeled in our general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamical simulations of BHNS systems over a comprehensive binary parameter space consisting of large mass ratio and high BH spin. The tidal disruption and dynamical mass ejection is studied by monitoring the transfer of energy and angular momentum to matter for the particular case of a highly unequal-mass binary with large BH spin, extending known results for low-mass-ratio, irrotational BHNS binaries. By varying the binary parameters, we investigate their influence on the geometric, thermodynamic, and kinematic properties of the ejected matter. Furthermore, we employ the nuclear-reaction network SkyNet to obtain the elemental abundances resulting from the r-process active in the ejecta and study how they depend on the properties of the progenitor objects. Finally, using the radiative-transfer code POSSIS, we compute the kilonova light-curves from the results of our simulations, discuss their bolometric and optical/near-infrared evolution, and compare them with the AT2017gfo data and upper-limits for S190814bv, finding overall consistency.

classification.title_zh: 高自旋和大质量不对称的双星黑洞-中子星系统：III. 抛射物性质及其电磁信号
classification.abstract_zh: 由黑洞和中子星组成的致密双星系统预计可在引力波和电磁波段同时给出可探测信号，因而是多信使天文学的优良源。在本系列第三篇论文中，我们报告在对BHNS系统进行广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟时建模的纯动力学抛射物成分的几何和热力学性质，覆盖由大质量比和高黑洞自旋组成的广泛双星参数空间。通过监测能量和角动量向物质的转移，研究了大质量比和高黑洞自旋这一特定情形下的潮汐瓦解和动力学质量抛射，扩展了已知的低质量比、无自旋BHNS双星结果。通过改变双星参数，我们研究它们对抛射物质的几何、热力学和运动学性质的影响。此外，我们使用核反应网络SkyNet获得抛射物中r过程产生的元素丰度，并研究其如何依赖于前身天体的性质。最后，使用辐射输运代码POSSIS，我们根据模拟结果计算千新星光变曲线，讨论其热辐射和光学/近红外演化，并与AT2017gfo数据以及S190814bv的上限进行比较，发现总体一致。
classification.one_liner: 通过GRMHD模拟研究高自旋、大质量不对称黑洞-中子星并合的动力学抛射物及其r过程与千新星电磁信号。

papers.title: Probing Gravitational Wave Signatures from Periodic Orbits of Regular Black Holes in Asymptotically Safe Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate bound and periodic timelike geodesics and their associated gravitational-wave (GW) signatures in the spacetime of a regular black hole arising in asymptotically safe gravity (ASG). The geometry incorporates quantum corrections via a running gravitational coupling, encoded in a dimensional scaling parameter $\xi$, that modifies the near-horizon structure while preserving asymptotic flatness. We derive the effective potential for massive test particles and determine the conditions for stable circular and bound motion as functions of $\xi$, including the shift in the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). The three topological integers $(z,w,v)$, which represent the number of zooms, whirls, and vertices per radial cycle, are used to categorize the test particles' periodic orbits using Levin's zoom -- whirl taxonomy. Moreover, we employ the rational frequency ratio $q = \frac{\omega_\phi}{\omega_r} - 1$ to find closed orbits, where $\omega_\phi$ and $\omega_r$ stand for the azimuthal and radial frequencies, respectively. We examine how the orbital frequency spectrum is altered, whirl behaviour is enhanced, and deviations from the Schwarzschild limit are produced by the quantum parameter $\xi$. The GW forms for extreme mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) are calculated within the quadrupole approximation. We find that as $\xi$ increases, the signals that are released exhibit detectable amplitude modulations and phase shifts. The corresponding typical strain spectra fall within the anticipated sensitivity limits of space-based detectors such as LISA, Taiji, and TianQin, as they peak in the millihertz frequency band. Peak strain increases monotonically with $\xi$, indicating that observational restrictions on quantum-gravity-induced deviations from classical general relativity in the strong-field domain can be obtained from precise measurements of zoom -- whirl dynamics in EMRIs.

classification.title_zh: 探测渐近安全引力中正则黑洞周期轨道的引力波信号
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究渐近安全引力（ASG）中出现的正则黑洞时空中束缚和周期类时测地线及其相关引力波（GW）特征。该几何通过跑动引力耦合引入量子修正，并由标度参数 ξ 编码，从而修改近视界结构，同时保持渐近平坦性。我们推导大质量试验粒子的有效势，并确定稳定圆轨道和束缚运动条件作为 ξ 的函数，包括最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）的移动。利用三个拓扑整数 (z,w,v)，分别表示每个径向周期内的 zoom、whirl 和顶点数，并采用 Levin 的 zoom--whirl 分类法对试验粒子的周期轨道进行分类。此外，我们采用有理频率比 q = ω_φ/ω_r - 1 寻找闭合轨道，其中 ω_φ 和 ω_r 分别表示方位角和径向频率。我们考察量子参数 ξ 如何改变轨道频谱、增强 whirl 行为并产生对 Schwarzschild 极限的偏离。在四极近似下计算极端质量比旋近（EMRI）的引力波波形。我们发现，随着 ξ 增大，所释放的信号表现出可探测的振幅调制和相位移动。相应的典型应变谱峰值位于毫赫兹频段，落在 LISA、太极和天琴等空间探测器预期灵敏度范围内。峰值应变随 ξ 单调增加，表明通过精确测量 EMRI 中的 zoom--whirl 动力学，可以获得强场区域量子引力导致的偏离经典广义相对论的观测限制。
classification.one_liner: 研究渐近安全引力中正则黑洞的束缚/周期类时测地线及其 EMRI 引力波特征，显示量子参数 ξ 可导致可观测的振幅调制与相位移动。

papers.title: Addressing leakage and mode suppression in angular power spectrum estimation for gravitational-wave backgrounds using pulsar timing arrays
papers.abstract: Mapping gravitational-wave background (GWB) anisotropy with pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) is affected by harmonic-space mode suppression and mode coupling arising from an array's nonuniform sky response. Spherical harmonic expansions must be truncated at finite multipole l_max^rec, often set to l_max^N_pair$\equiv {\rm int}\left[\sqrt{\text{N_pair}}-1\right]$, where N_pair is the number of distinct pulsar pairs in an array. This choice is motivated by the counting argument that cross-correlations provide at most N_pair independent constraints. We obtain the multipole l_max^res corresponding to the maximum informative angular scale of a PTA. It is defined such that expansions to l_max^res (approximately) span the space of "observable skies" encoded in the N_pair eigenmaps of the Fisher information matrix, and therefore depends on the array configuration. We explicitly show that GWB power contained in multipoles l$\gtrsim$l_max^res do not significantly affect analyses that use expansions out to l_max^res, because the PTA response acts as a low-pass filter. In contrast, truncating at l_max^rec< l_max^res leads to leakage of small-scale angular power from l_max^rec<l$\leq$l_max^res. Even choosing l_max^rec=l_max^res, the standard frequentist estimator of the angular power spectrum C_l remains biased by the modes unobservable by the array. Although we can (partially) debias the standard estimator -- improving its agreement with an injected spectrum -- this reduction in bias comes at the expense of an increase in variance, particularly for poorly constrained modes with l$\gg$l_eff. We therefore recommend: (i) using l_max^res for PTA analyses involving spherical harmonic expansions, and (ii) using the debiased standard estimator for C_l recovery, but only out to multipoles l<l_eff ($\ll$l_max^res) corresponding to sufficiently constrained modes.

classification.title_zh: 解决脉冲星计时阵列引力波背景角功率谱估计中的泄漏与模式压制
classification.abstract_zh: 利用脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）绘制引力波背景（GWB）各向异性图会受到谐空间模式压制和模式耦合的影响，这些效应源于阵列非均匀的天空响应。球谐展开必须在有限多极矩 l_max^rec 处截断，通常设为 l_max^N_pair ≡ int[√N_pair − 1]，其中 N_pair 是阵列中不同脉冲星对的数目。这一选择基于计数论证：交叉相关最多提供 N_pair 个独立约束。我们得到了对应于 PTA 最大信息角尺度的多极矩 l_max^res。它的定义使得展开到 l_max^res（近似）张成 Fisher 信息矩阵的 N_pair 个本征图所编码的“可观测天空”空间，因此依赖于阵列构型。我们明确显示，包含在多极矩 l ≳ l_max^res 中的 GWB 功率不会显著影响使用展开到 l_max^res 的分析，因为 PTA 响应起到低通滤波器的作用。相反，在 l_max^rec < l_max^res 处截断会导致来自 l_max^rec < l ≤ l_max^res 的小尺度角功率泄漏。即使选择 l_max^rec = l_max^res，角功率谱 C_l 的标准频率派估计量仍会因阵列不可观测的模式而有偏。尽管我们可以（部分）去偏标准估计量——改善其与注入谱的一致性——但这种偏倚的降低以方差增加为代价，特别是对于 l ≫ l_eff 的约束较差的模式。因此我们建议：（i）在涉及球谐展开的 PTA 分析中使用 l_max^res；（ii）使用去偏标准估计量恢复 C_l，但仅到对应于充分约束模式的、l < l_eff（≪ l_max^res）的多极矩。
classification.one_liner: 研究 PTA 引力波背景角功率谱估计中有限多极截断导致的模式压制与泄漏，提出 l_max^res 并建议截断与去偏策略。

papers.title: Black hole binaries in shift-symmetric Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet gravity experience a slower merger phase
papers.abstract: In shift-symmetric Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet gravity, stationary black holes have a non-vanishing scalar charge. During the inspiral, the phase evolution is modified by several effects,primarily an additional scalar dipole radiation, which enters at -1PN order. Including corrections up to 2PN, this effect accelerates the inspiral when compared to general relativity, but changes in the conservative dynamics may do the opposite. Using fully non-linear numerical simulations of quasi-circular, comparable mass binaries, we characterize the late stages of the orbital dynamics. We find that the overall effect is still an accelerated merger phase for the modified gravity case, but noticeably less than predicted by PN alone, which we relate to the conservative dynamics, showing that at the late inspiral stage more energy must be emitted in scalar-Gauss-Bonnet gravity to induce a given change in frequency. In longer signals, this may lead to a distinctive frequency evolution relative to general relativity as the binary approaches merger, but its effect close to merger is to suppress the difference with GR. This work suggests we may need to revisit existing constraints on the theory that are obtained assuming PN approximations apply up to merger, or based on order by order approximations that neglect backreaction effects on the metric, and shows the importance of including non-linear effects that modify the gravitational sector in the strong field regime.

classification.title_zh: 平移对称 Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中的黑洞双星经历更慢的并合阶段
classification.abstract_zh: 在平移对称 Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中，稳态黑洞具有非零标量荷。在旋近阶段，相位演化被若干效应修改，主要是一个额外的标量偶极辐射，它出现在 -1PN 阶。计入至 2PN 的修正后，与广义相对论相比，该效应会加速旋近，但保守动力学的改变可能产生相反作用。我们使用准圆、可比质量双星的全非线性数值模拟，刻画轨道动力学的晚期阶段。我们发现，对修正引力情形，整体效应仍是并合相加速，但明显小于仅由 PN 给出的预言；我们将其与保守动力学联系起来，表明在晚期旋近阶段，在 scalar-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中要引起给定频率变化必须辐射更多能量。在较长信号中，当双星接近并合时，这可能相对于广义相对论导致独特的频率演化，但其在临近并合时的效应是压低与 GR 的差异。这项工作表明，我们可能需要重新审视现有对该理论的约束，这些约束假设 PN 近似一直适用到并合，或基于逐阶近似而忽略了度规上的反作用效应；并显示在强场区域纳入修改引力部门的非线性效应的重要性。
classification.one_liner: 全非线性双星模拟显示，平移对称 EsGB 引力中并合阶段虽仍较 GR 加速，但比 PN 预测更慢，需考虑强场非线性反作用来更新约束。

papers.title: Gravitational and kinematic redshifts of black holes in nonlinear electrodynamics
papers.abstract: Spacetimes arising from nonlinear electrodynamics (NED) are a good laboratory for studying both the nature of regular black hole (RBH) solutions and the imprints of nonlinear electromagnetic fields within this context. Over the past few decades, NED-sourced black hole (BH) spacetimes have attracted considerable attention, but electrically charged RBHs obtained in the so-called $F$ framework have been less addressed in the literature. We consider two electrically charged, fully regular members of the h-family that are solutions to general relativity minimally coupled to NED. Because of their potential astrophysical and astronomical applications, we mainly focus our investigation on the motion of photons and its implications for the gravitational and kinematic redshifts, as well as for the shadow radius, considering the effective geometry followed by photons in NED. Moreover, we consider the observational data for Sagittarius A$^{\star}$ and Messier 87$^{\star}$ BHs to impose some constraints on the charge-to-mass ratio of the fully RBHs. We obtain the general equations that govern the gravitational and kinematic redshifts of NED-sourced BH spacetimes. In particular, for fully RBHs with BH charge-to-mass ratios above some moderate value, we observe discrepancies in their physical and geometrical properties compared to those of the Reissner--Nordstr\"om (RN) BH. Therefore, our results indicate that it is possible to distinguish NED-based RBH solutions from RN BHs, from the perspective of gravitational and kinematic redshifts, suggesting potential astrophysical relevance.

classification.title_zh: 非线性电动力学中黑洞的引力红移与运动学红移
classification.abstract_zh: 由非线性电动力学（NED）产生的时空是研究规则黑洞（RBH）解性质以及非线性电磁场印记的良好场所。过去几十年，NED 源黑洞时空引起了广泛关注，但在所谓 F 框架中得到的带电规则黑洞在文献中讨论较少。我们考虑 h 族的两个带电且完全规则的成员，它们是广义相对论与 NED 最小耦合的解。由于潜在的天体物理和天文应用，我们主要关注光子运动及其对引力红移、运动学红移以及阴影半径的影响，并考虑 NED 中光子所遵循的有效几何。此外，我们利用人马座 A* 和 M87* 黑洞的观测数据对完全规则黑洞的荷质比施加限制。我们得到控制 NED 源黑洞时空引力红移和运动学红移的一般方程。特别地，对于荷质比高于某个中等值的完全规则黑洞，我们观察到其物理和几何性质与 Reissner-Nordström（RN）黑洞存在差异。因此，我们的结果表明，从引力红移和运动学红移的角度，有可能区分基于 NED 的规则黑洞解与 RN 黑洞，这暗示了潜在的天体物理相关性。
classification.one_liner: 在非线性电动力学支持的规则黑洞时空中研究光子运动导致的引力/运动学红移与阴影，并用 Sgr A* 与 M87* 观测限制荷质比。

papers.title: Mass and spin properties of black-hole mergers reveal formation in triples
papers.abstract: Deciphering the formation channels of the observed binary black hole mergers remains a central open problem in gravitational-wave astronomy. With hundreds of detections, the inferred distribution of masses and spins reveals a rich diversity which is difficult to reconcile with traditional formation scenarios from isolated binary stars or dense stellar environments. Here, we consider the large fraction of massive progenitor stars found in hierarchical triples and investigate black hole mergers driven by gravitational perturbations from tertiary companions. Simulations of their dynamics and stellar evolution reproduce key features of the merger population, including: i) a sharp primary mass peak at $m_1\sim10\,\rm M_\odot$ dominating the population; ii) substantial fractions of systems with large spin-orbit angles within and beyond the peak, matching the skewed distributions of the spin parameters $\chi_{\rm eff}$ and $\chi_p$; iii) a mass-ratio distribution favouring equal masses with matching slopes. We further predict a sharp decline of mergers near $m_1\sim30\,\rm M_\odot$, coincident with the location of inferred features that may signal another channel dominating the high-mass tail. Our models of hierarchical triples demonstrate, for the first time, a formation scenario which simultaneously reproduces the principal properties inferred for the low-mass bulk of binary black hole mergers.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞并合的质自旋性质揭示其三体系统中的形成
classification.abstract_zh: 解读观测到的双黑洞并合的形成通道仍是引力波天文学的核心开放问题。随着数百次探测，推断出的质量和自旋分布显示出丰富多样性，难以与孤立双星或致密星环境中的传统形成场景相协调。这里，我们考虑层级三体中存在的大比例大质量前身星，并研究由第三体伴星的引力扰动驱动的黑洞并合。对其动力学和恒星演化的模拟再现了并合族群的关键特征，包括：i) 主星质量在 m1∼10 M⊙ 处出现主导族群的尖锐峰值；ii) 在峰值内外均有相当比例系统具有大的自旋-轨道夹角，与自旋参数 χ_eff 和 χ_p 的偏斜分布相符；iii) 质量比分布倾向于等质量且斜率相符。我们还预测在 m1∼30 M⊙ 附近并合率急剧下降，与可能表明另一通道主导高质量尾部的推断特征位置一致。我们的层级三体模型首次展示了一种同时再现双黑洞并合低质量主体主要推断性质的形成场景。
classification.one_liner: 层级三体中的引力扰动驱动黑洞并合，可同时解释低质量双黑洞并合的主要质量与自旋特征。

papers.title: Mind the second gap: The impact of gaps on noise and signal parameter inference
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave data is never analysed without some conditioning: filtering and tapering act multiplicatively on the noise, destroying the stationarity on which the Whittle likelihood --- the backbone of nearly all gravitational-wave inference --- rests. The problem is particularly evident for LISA, where gaps are expected to overlap almost all signals and the noise must be estimated jointly with those astrophysical signals. We provide an analytical and numerical framework to assess the impact of noise mis-modelling when signal and noise parameters are inferred jointly in the presence of gaps. From a Fisher-matrix formalism verified against Bayesian inference, we obtain closed forms for the model uncertainties, their maximum-likelihood estimates and the true scatter in the latter, for various approximations to the likelihood. The Fisher-based linear formalism is extended through the Godambe--White curvature to the non-linear regime that severe mis-modelling produces. We survey gap families from long, well-tapered interruptions to short, high-rate ones, injecting massive black-hole binaries. Except in the case of frequent gaps, we show that the windowed covariance is well approximated by its leading diagonal --- the window convolved with the power spectral density --- for the estimation of both signal and noise parameters. By omitting the convolution, the signal sector remains unbiased but the noise parameters, in particular the optical-metrology noise which is dominant at high frequency, is displaced by over an order of magnitude in power. At the highest glitch rates the diagonal approximation stays accurate yet loses an order of magnitude in precision. To remedy this, we propose an exact time-domain likelihood of the surviving samples which can be efficiently (and accurately solved) via preconditioned conjugate gradient methods.

classification.title_zh: 注意第二个间隙：间隙对噪声与信号参数推断的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波数据从来不会在未做任何预处理的情况下被分析：滤波和窗函数以乘性方式作用于噪声，破坏了 Whittle 似然——几乎所有引力波推断的支柱——所依赖的平稳性。该问题在 LISA 中尤为明显，预期间隙会与几乎所有信号重叠，且噪声必须与这些天体物理信号联合估计。我们提供一个解析和数值框架，以评估在存在间隙且信号与噪声参数联合推断时，噪声错误建模所造成的影响。基于与贝叶斯推断核验过的 Fisher 矩阵形式，我们针对不同的似然近似，得到模型不确定性、其最大似然估计以及后者真实散布的闭式表达式。我们通过 Godambe--White 曲率将基于 Fisher 的线性形式扩展到严重错误建模所产生的非线性区域。我们考察从长且良好加窗的中断到短而高频率的间隙族，并注入大质量黑洞双星。除频繁间隙情形外，我们表明窗化协方差在其主导对角项——窗函数与功率谱密度卷积——下对信号和噪声参数的估计都近似良好。若忽略卷积，信号部分仍保持无偏，但噪声参数（尤其是高频占主导的光学度量噪声）的功率会被偏移超过一个数量级。在最高故障率下，对角近似仍准确，但精度损失一个数量级。为弥补这一点，我们提出一种针对存活样本的精确时域似然，可通过预条件共轭梯度方法高效且精确地求解。
classification.one_liner: 论文研究 LISA 时间间隙对联合信号-噪声参数推断的影响，建立 Fisher/Godambe--White 分析框架并建议精确时域似然。

papers.title: Teleparallel Regularization of Gravitational Action
papers.abstract: We study the gravitational action in the teleparallel equivalent of general relativity, where the spin connection contributes to the action through a surface term and, when chosen appropriately, regularizes the action by effectively playing the role of a counterterm. We resolve several apparent ambiguities in this procedure using the Schwarzschild spacetime as an example. We show that the apparent discrepancy between bulk and quasilocal actions originates from contributions associated with spacetime singularities, and that the quasilocal action agrees with the standard results obtained in general relativity. We further clarify the role of the tetrad choice in determining the corresponding spin connection, showing that the proper diagonal and canonical frames give the same Euclidean action, while only the proper diagonal frame reproduces the expected Lorentzian action on the Wheeler--DeWitt patch. Finally, we establish the uniqueness of the regularization scheme and show that imposing an appropriate fall-off behavior of the torsion tensor removes the remaining ambiguity and fixes the Euclidean action uniquely.

classification.title_zh: 引力作用量的远平行正则化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究广义相对论远平行等价理论中的引力作用量，其中自旋联络通过一个表面项对作用量作出贡献，并且当选取适当时，它通过有效扮演抵消项的角色使作用量正则化。我们以 Schwarzschild 时空为例，解决了这一程序中的若干明显歧义。我们表明，体作用量与准局域作用量之间的表面差异源于与时空奇点相关的贡献，并且准局域作用量与广义相对论中得到的标准结果一致。我们进一步阐明了标架选择在确定相应自旋联络中的作用，表明恰当的对角标架与正则标架给出相同的欧几里得作用量，而只有在 Wheeler--DeWitt 片上，恰当的对角标架才重现预期的洛伦兹作用量。最后，我们确立了该正则化方案的唯一性，并表明对挠率张量施加适当的衰减行为可以消除剩余的歧义并唯一地确定欧几里得作用量。
classification.one_liner: 在远平行等价理论中，自旋联络的表面项可正则化引力作用量；该工作以 Schwarzschild 为例澄清歧义、标架依赖并证明方案唯一性。

papers.title: Charged Letelier--Alencar Black Strings with a Quintessence and the Cosmolgical Constant
papers.abstract: This study derives charged black string solutions in the presence of a Letelier--Alencar cloud of strings and quintessence within Einstein--Maxwell--$\Lambda$ theory. We study the curvature scalars in order to investigate the asymptotical behavior of these solutions. We calculate the relevant conserved and thermodynamic quantities, confirming their compliance with the first law of thermodynamics. System stability is rigorously analyzed through heat capacity and Gibbs free energy, identifying regimes of local and global equilibrium. Additionally, by interpreting the cosmological constant as thermodynamic pressure within an extended phase space, we establish the validity of the extended first law and derive the corresponding Smarr relation for these solutions. We also investigate the null geodesic structure, deriving the equation for the photon cylinder radius, which generalizes the known result for charged black strings by incorporating the effects of the Letelier--Alencar cloud of strings and quintessence. The numerical analysis of this equation determines the existence and location of photon cylinders as functions of the model parameters.

classification.title_zh: 带精质和宇宙学常数的带电 Letelier--Alencar 黑弦
classification.abstract_zh: 本研究在 Einstein--Maxwell--Λ 理论中，推导了存在 Letelier--Alencar 弦云和精质（quintessence）时的带电黑弦解。我们研究曲率标量以考察这些解的渐近行为。我们计算相关守恒量和热力学量，确认它们满足热力学第一定律。通过热容和吉布斯自由能严格分析系统稳定性，识别局域和全局平衡区域。此外，将宇宙学常数解释为扩展相空间中的热力学压强，我们建立扩展第一定律的有效性，并推导这些解对应的 Smarr 关系。我们还研究零测地线结构，推导光子柱半径方程，该方程通过纳入 Letelier--Alencar 弦云和精质效应，推广了已知的带电黑弦结果。对此方程的数值分析确定了光子柱的存在性与位置随模型参数的变化。
classification.one_liner: 构造带弦云和精质的带电黑弦解，并分析其热力学、扩展相空间与零测地线光子柱结构。

papers.title: Architecture Acceleration of Machine Learning Gravitational Waveform Surrogate Models
papers.abstract: Accurate and computationally efficient waveform models of compact binary coalescences are a fundamental requirement for gravitational wave data analysis. This work presents differentiable and hardware-accelerated implementations of the machine-learning surrogate models mlgw and mlgw-bns within the JAX ecosystem. The proposed framework enables JIT compilation, vector paralellization, native GPU acceleration, and automatic differentiation, while preserving the original surrogate training infrastructure and its applicability to arbitrary non-precessing waveform approximants. Benchmarks are performed in the binary black hole case with a newly trained surrogate of the SEOBNRv5HM approximant; on CPU, they show speed-ups in waveform evaluation time with respect to the original mlgw implementation that exceed one order of magnitude; further, when exploiting GPU acceleration and large-batch vectorization these reach approximately two orders of magnitude. The benchmarks performed in the case of binary neutron stars with a TEOBResumSPA surrogate model achieve similar gains on GPU. Our JAX-based surrogate modeling framework can be integrated into Bayesian parameter estimation pipelines through GWgpu-jax, an open-source package that connects JAX-compatible gravitational waveform generators to JAX-native sampling algorithms. We demonstrate this capability with a nested-sampling pipeline built upon BlackJax-NS, performing parameter estimation analyses of the GW150914 and GW170817 events with mlgw and mlgw-bns. The analyses require approximately twelve and seventeen minutes, respectively, on a single GPU and yield posterior distributions consistent with those reported by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration. Beyond nested sampling, JAX automatic differentiation provides efficient gradient and Hessian evaluations of the waveform models, enabling integration with gradient-based Bayesian inference methods.

classification.title_zh: 机器学习引力波波形代理模型的架构加速
classification.abstract_zh: 致密双星并合的精确且计算高效的波形模型是引力波数据分析的基本需求。本文在 JAX 生态中提出了机器学习代理模型 mlgw 和 mlgw-bns 的可微且硬件加速实现。该框架支持 JIT 编译、向量并行化、原生 GPU 加速和自动微分，同时保留原始代理训练基础设施及其对任意非进动波形近似模型的适用性。基准测试在双黑洞情形下使用新训练的 SEOBNRv5HM 近似代理进行；在 CPU 上，波形评估时间相比原始 mlgw 实现加速超过一个数量级；进一步利用 GPU 加速和大批量向量化后，加速约达两个数量级。对双中子星情形使用 TEOBResumSPA 代理模型的基准测试在 GPU 上也取得类似增益。我们的基于 JAX 的代理建模框架可通过 GWgpu-jax 集成到贝叶斯参数估计流程中，该开源包将 JAX 兼容的引力波波形生成器连接到 JAX 原生采样算法。我们通过基于 BlackJax-NS 的嵌套采样流程演示了这一能力，使用 mlgw 和 mlgw-bns 对 GW150914 和 GW170817 事件进行参数估计分析。这些分析在单块 GPU 上分别约需十二分钟和十七分钟，并给出与 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 合作组报告一致的后验分布。除嵌套采样外，JAX 自动微分可高效评估波形模型的梯度和 Hessian，从而支持与基于梯度的贝叶斯推断方法集成。
classification.one_liner: 本文用 JAX 实现并加速机器学习引力波波形代理模型，在 CPU/GPU 上显著提升评估速度并用于事件参数估计。

papers.title: Gravitational wave radiation from periodic orbits around a black hole in Einstein-Maxwell-scalar theory
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the periodic orbits around a black hole (BH) in Einstein-Maxwell-scalar (EMS) theory and the corresponding gravitational waveforms. First, we study the test particle dynamics around the BH by using the Lagrangian formalism. Using the corresponding conditions, we explore the effect of the spacetime parameters on the marginally bound orbit (MBO) and innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). The results indicate that MBO and ISCO quantities decrease with the rise of the $\beta$ parameter and BH charge $Q$, and vice versa for the $\gamma$ parameter. Subsequently, we plot the different zoom-whirl orbits around the BH in EMS theory by finding the test particle's corresponding energy and angular momentum. Finally, the gravitational waveforms of the extreme mass ratio inspirals, which contain a supermassive BH in EMS theory and a stellar mass object, are demonstrated. It is shown that the zoom-whirl orbits shrink as the BH charge increases, and, as a result, gravitational waveforms shift towards shorter times.

classification.title_zh: 爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-标量理论中黑洞周围周期轨道的引力波辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-标量（EMS）理论中黑洞周围的周期轨道及相应的引力波形。首先，利用拉格朗日形式研究黑洞周围的测试粒子动力学。利用相应条件，我们探讨时空参数对边际束缚轨道（MBO）和最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）的影响。结果表明，MBO和ISCO量随β参数和黑洞电荷Q增大而减小，而对γ参数则相反。随后，通过求解测试粒子对应的能量和角动量，我们绘制了EMS理论中黑洞周围不同的zoom-whirl轨道。最后，展示了极端质量比旋进（EMRI）的引力波形，其中包含EMS理论中的超大质量黑洞和一个恒星质量天体。结果表明，随着黑洞电荷增大，zoom-whirl轨道收缩，因此引力波形向更短时间移动。
classification.one_liner: 在Einstein-Maxwell-scalar黑洞时空中研究测试粒子周期轨道与EMRI引力波形，分析时空参数对MBO/ISCO和zoom-whirl轨道的影响。

papers.title: Teukolsky Master Equation for a Kerr-like metric with Mass Quadrupole Moment
papers.abstract: The Teukolsky Master Equation (TME) is a powerful technique used to study perturbations of a spacetime with gravitational, electromagnetic, and neutrino components. The well-known Kerr metric is a suitable candidate for this formalism because it is a Petrov type D metric. However, the Kerr metric represents the exterior spacetime of a perfect sphere and only black holes are described using this metric. For another astrophysical object, such as fast-spinning neutron stars, the Kerr metric is not valid due to the rotation induced deformations to the gravitational source. The main goal of the present work is to show a TME for a Kerr-like metric (KL) with a mass quadrupole moment parameter $q$. This new parameter will represent deformations from a perfect sphere; therefore, KL is a better candidate to study perturbations surrounding spinning stars.

classification.title_zh: 具有质量四极矩的类Kerr度规的Teukolsky主方程
classification.abstract_zh: Teukolsky主方程（TME）是研究具有引力、电磁和中微子分量的时空微扰的有力技术。著名的Kerr度规因其为Petrov D型度规而适合该形式。然而，Kerr度规描述完美球体的外部时空，只用于黑洞。对于快速旋转中子星等其他天体，由于旋转导致引力源形变，Kerr度规不再适用。本文主要目标是给出带有质量四极矩参数q的类Kerr度规（KL）的TME。该新参数表示对完美球体的形变；因此，KL是研究旋转恒星周围微扰的更合适候选。
classification.one_liner: 将Teukolsky主方程推广到带质量四极矩的类Kerr度规，以研究旋转恒星周围的微扰。

papers.title: Photon spheres, elliptic surfaces, and Seiberg-Witten geometry
papers.abstract: We study null geodesics in Reissner-Nordstr\"om-de Sitter spacetime and in its $\omega=-2/3$ Kiselev deformation through the elliptic curves defined by the radial equation. The relation of these curves to the non-critical $E_7$ Seiberg-Witten family yields differential equations for finite-distance light deflection, and explains the boundary source term through a suitable gauge of the Seiberg-Witten differential. This geometry separates the extremal point $Q^2=M^2$ from the Argyres-Douglas point $Q^2=9M^2/8$. We also determine the Kiselev critical and horizon loci, and show that, at fixed nonzero angular momentum, the Argyres-Douglas and ultracold loci meet only at zero Killing energy.

classification.title_zh: 光子球、椭圆曲面与 Seiberg-Witten 几何
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过径向方程定义的椭圆曲线研究 Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter 时空及其 ω=-2/3 Kiselev 形变中的零测地线。这些曲线与非临界 E7 Seiberg-Witten 族的关系给出了有限距离光偏折的微分方程，并通过 Seiberg-Witten 微分的适当规范选择解释了边界源项。该几何将极端点 Q^2=M^2 与 Argyres-Douglas 点 Q^2=9M^2/8 分开。我们还确定了 Kiselev 临界轨迹与视界轨迹，并表明在固定非零角动量下，Argyres-Douglas 轨迹与超冷轨迹仅在 Killing 能量为零时相交。
classification.one_liner: 通过椭圆曲线与 E7 Seiberg-Witten 几何分析 RN-dS/Kiselev 时空中的光子球与光偏折。

papers.title: Geometry as Thermodynamics:Entropy Stationarity and Horizon Residues
papers.abstract: Thermodynamic descriptions of gravity involve both variational conditions for spacetime dynamics and analytic structures associated with horizons. We examine their relation while keeping their assumptions distinct. First, we present an explicit derivation of the Einstein equation from the established null-vector entropy functional, including the null constraint, the matter term, and the integration constant associated with the cosmological constant. Second, for an analytic static spherical geometry with a nondegenerate Killing horizon, we define a meromorphic radial one-form whose residue is the inverse of twice the surface gravity. Euclidean regularity then fixes the Hawking temperature. Combining this residue with the Einstein--Hilbert Noether charge gives a normalized contour representation of the Wald entropy. The construction reproduces the Schwarzschild temperature, entropy, and Smarr relation, but does not constitute an independent microscopic derivation of the area law. We establish the limits of a stronger identification between pole structure and dynamics: an asymptotically flat family can retain the Schwarzschild horizon residue, area, surface gravity, and mass while violating the vacuum Einstein equation, and an extremal charged solution possesses a higher-order pole. We also show why exponentiating an unspecified entropy functional does not produce a universal entropy residue. The resulting framework separates entropy stationarity, horizon analyticity, and charge normalization, providing explicit consistency tests for further thermodynamic interpretations of gravitational singularities.

classification.title_zh: 几何作为热力学：熵平稳性与视界留数
classification.abstract_zh: 引力的热力学描述既涉及时空动力学的变分条件，也涉及与视界相关的解析结构。我们在保持各自假设相互独立的前提下考察二者关系。首先，我们从已有的零矢量熵泛函出发，给出爱因斯坦方程的显式推导，包括零约束、物质项以及与宇宙学常数相关的积分常数。其次，对于具有非退化 Killing 视界的解析静态球对称几何，我们定义一个亚纯径向一形式，其留数为表面重力的倒数之半。欧几里得正则性随后固定霍金温度。将该留数与 Einstein--Hilbert Noether 荷结合，得到 Wald 熵的归一化围道表示。该构造重现 Schwarzschild 温度、熵和 Smarr 关系，但并不构成面积律的独立微观推导。我们确立了极点结构与动力学之间更强等同关系的界限：一个渐近平坦族可以保留 Schwarzschild 视界留数、面积、表面重力和质量，却违反真空爱因斯坦方程；而一个极端带电解具有高阶极点。我们还说明为何对未指定的熵泛函取指数不会产生普适的熵留数。由此得到的框架将熵平稳性、视界解析性与荷归一化区分开来，为引力奇点进一步的热力学解释提供了显式的自洽性检验。
classification.one_liner: 该文在经典引力框架下区分熵平稳性、视界解析性与荷归一化，用留数和 Wald 熵重现 Schwarzschild 热力学，并指出极点结构与动力学强等同的局限。

papers.title: Exceptional points and near-extremal boundary response in rotating BTZ black holes
papers.abstract: We investigate whether the coalescence of long-lived quasinormal modes enhances the boundary response of rotating BTZ black holes. Using exact scalar solutions with mixed Robin boundary conditions and the retarded boundary correlator, we compare frequency-domain resonances and time-domain signals at fixed source and operator normalizations. An exceptional point (EP) can be crossed by varying the spin alone in a suitably selected fixed theory. Along a distinct near-extremal path that tracks the co-rotating EP surface by tuning the scalar mass and boundary coupling, a taller, narrower resonance coexists with a weaker but longer-lasting double-pole impulse response. The frequency-domain enhancement persists away from the EP and is therefore not unique to mode coalescence. Thus, the EP determines the double-pole structure and Jordan relaxation, but does not by itself determine the response strength, which also depends on the physical path and excitation protocol.

classification.title_zh: 旋转 BTZ 黑洞中的例外点与近极端边界响应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究长寿命准正规模式的并合是否会增强旋转 BTZ 黑洞的边界响应。利用具有混合 Robin 边界条件的精确标量解和延迟边界关联函数，我们在固定源与算符归一化的条件下比较频域共振与时域信号。通过仅改变自旋，可以在适当选定的固定理论中穿过一个例外点（EP）。沿着一条不同的近极端路径——通过调节标量质量和边界耦合来追踪共转 EP 面——一个更高、更窄的共振与一个更弱但持续时间更长的双极点脉冲响应共存。频域增强在 EP 之外仍然存在，因此并非模式并合所独有。因此，EP 决定了双极点结构和 Jordan 弛豫，但本身并不决定响应强度；响应强度还取决于物理路径和激发协议。
classification.one_liner: 在旋转 BTZ 黑洞中，例外点决定双极点结构与 Jordan 弛豫，但边界响应增强并非模式并合独有，还取决于路径与激发协议。

papers.title: On the completeness of gravitational pp-wave spacetimes: A counterexample to the {Ehlers--Kundt} conjecture
papers.abstract: This paper concerns the geometry of gravitational pp-wave spacetimes. We give a counterexample to the Ehlers--Kundt conjecture. In fact, we show that geodesic completeness is generic, in the sense of Baire category, among gravitational pp-waves. We also define a concept of ``universal pp-wave'', i.e. a pp-wave whose metric approximates that of every other gravitational pp-wave arbitrarily closely on arbitrarily large compact sets, and we show that there are geodesically complete universal pp-waves. Our machinery also suffices to give a new proof of the polynomial case of the Ehlers--Kundt conjecture (previously proved by Flores and S\'anchez).

classification.title_zh: 关于引力 pp 波时空的完备性：Ehlers–Kundt 猜想的一个反例
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究引力 pp 波时空的几何。我们给出 Ehlers–Kundt 猜想的一个反例。事实上，我们证明在 Baire 范畴意义下，测地完备性在引力 pp 波中是通有的。我们还定义了“通用 pp 波”的概念，即其度规能在任意大的紧集上任意接近地逼近任何其他引力 pp 波的度规，并证明存在测地完备的通用 pp 波。我们的工具也足以为 Ehlers–Kundt 猜想的多项式情形给出新证明（此前由 Flores 和 Sánchez 证明）。
classification.one_liner: 证明引力 pp 波中测地完备性在 Baire 范畴意义下通有，构造反例否定 Ehlers–Kundt 猜想，并给出测地完备的通用 pp 波。

papers.title: Thin Accretion Disk and Optical Signatures in f(R,T) Modified Gravity
papers.abstract: Accretion disk surrounding around compact astrophysical objects serve as a powerful laboratories for testing gravitational theories in the strong-field regimes. In this work, we systematically investigated the structural, dynamical, and thermodynamic properties of the steady-state thin accretion disk within the framework of $f(R,T)$ gravity by adopting the linear functional form $f(R,T) = R + 2\chi T$ coupled with the pressure-free dust fluid matter Lagrangian ($\mathcal{L}_m = -\rho$). We demonstrate that the modified field equations seamlessly reduce to standard General Relativity in the pure vacuum limit ($T_{\mu\nu} = 0$). Utilizing a perturbative approach for a small coupling parameter ($\vert{}\chi\vert{} \ll 1$), we derive the first-order corrections to the background Schwarzschild metric potentials, which subsequently govern the modified particle kinematics, the specific energy $E$, the specific angular momentum $L$, and the Keplerian angular velocity $\Omega$. Our analysis reveals that the geometry-matter coupling parameter $\chi$ significantly shifted towards the location of the Innermost Stable Circular Orbit ($r_{isco}$) and alters the radial energy dissipation rate $F(r)$ and the effective surface temperature profile $T(r)$ across the Shakura-Sunyaev thin disk. Furthermore, the resulting modifications in the Spectral Energy Distribution (SED) and overall radiative efficiency $\eta$ provide robust theoretical signature.

classification.title_zh: f(R,T) 修改引力中的薄吸积盘与光学特征
classification.abstract_zh: 围绕致密天体物理天体的吸积盘可作为强场区域检验引力理论的有力实验室。本文在 f(R,T) 引力框架内，采用线性函数形式 f(R,T)=R+2χT，并耦合无压强尘埃流体的物质拉格朗日量 L_m=-ρ，系统研究了稳态薄吸积盘的结构、动力学与热力学性质。我们证明，修改后的场方程在纯真空极限（T_{\mu\nu}=0）下无缝退化为标准广义相对论。利用小耦合参数（|χ|≪1）的微扰方法，我们导出了背景 Schwarzschild 度规势的一阶修正，这些修正继而支配修改后的粒子运动学、比能 E、比角动量 L 以及开普勒角速度 Ω。分析表明，几何-物质耦合参数 χ 显著移动了最内稳定圆轨道（r_{isco}）的位置，并改变了 Shakura-Sunyaev 薄盘中的径向能量耗散率 F(r) 和有效表面温度分布 T(r)。此外，谱能量分布（SED）和总辐射效率 η 的相应修改提供了稳健的理论特征。
classification.one_liner: 在 f(R,T) 修改引力下计算 Schwarzschild 背景薄吸积盘的一阶修正，并讨论 ISCO、能量耗散、温度分布、SED 与辐射效率的光学特征。

papers.title: MAGGIE: A Magnetic Gravitational Wave Induction Experiment
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves (GWs) can induce effective electromagnetic currents when interacting with external electric and magnetic fields, as described by linearized gravity modifications to Maxwell's equations. This coupling enables a novel detection approach for high-frequency gravitational waves (HFGWs) using axion haloscope experiments. Here we present the MAGnetic Gravitational wave Induction Experiment (MAGGIE), the first lumped-element HFGW detector proposed in Europe, designed to probe HFGWs in the kHz-MHz regime by leveraging a 14 T solenoidal magnet at the University of Hamburg. The GW-induced magnetic flux is captured by a custom-designed pickup loop optimized for the expected symmetry of the effective current. A figure-8-shaped geometry, oriented to break the azimuthal symmetry, is implemented, together with a blind-loop configuration, for real-time noise rejection and calibration. The readout scheme is tailored for continuous signals and time-domain transient searches, using waveform templates for primordial black hole (PBH) mergers. The expected experimental reach in terms of strain spectral noise density at the 40 MHz high-frequency end is projected to reach $\sim 4 \times 10^{-16}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ for transient searches, and in terms of strain, projected to reach $\sim 10^{-19}$ for 1 year of continuous search. This allows MAGGIE to constrain currently unexplored regions of the HFGW parameter space.

classification.title_zh: MAGGIE：磁引力波感应实验
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波（GWs）在与外部电场和磁场相互作用时，可以诱导有效电磁流，这由线性化引力对麦克斯韦方程组的修正所描述。这种耦合使得利用轴子晕镜实验进行高频引力波（HFGWs）探测的新方法成为可能。这里我们介绍磁引力波感应实验（MAGGIE），这是欧洲提出的首个集总元件 HFGW 探测器，旨在利用汉堡大学的 14 T 螺线管磁体探测 kHz-MHz 频段的高频引力波。引力波诱导的磁通由定制的拾取环捕获，该拾取环针对有效电流的预期对称性进行了优化。我们实现了一种呈 8 字形、取向旨在破坏方位对称性的几何结构，并结合盲环配置，以进行实时噪声抑制和校准。读出方案针对连续信号和时域瞬态搜索而设计，使用波形模板处理原初黑洞（PBH）并合。在 40 MHz 高频端，预期的实验探测范围在应变谱噪声密度方面对于瞬态搜索预计达到约 4×10^{-16}/√Hz，在应变方面对于 1 年连续搜索预计达到约 10^{-19}。这使 MAGGIE 能够限制 HFGW 参数空间中目前尚未探索的区域。
classification.one_liner: 提出欧洲首个集总元件高频引力波探测器 MAGGIE，利用强磁场中引力波感应的有效电磁流探测 kHz–MHz 频段高频引力波。

papers.title: Primordial Black Hole mass growth from neutrinos during the radiation era
papers.abstract: We present a new picture of primordial black holes mass evolution through neutrino absorption. Using semi-classical approach and a closer look at the kinetic of the early plasma we revisit the thermal absorption of radiation by a population of primordial black holes ranging from $10^{-3}-10^9 M_\odot$ embedded in a thermal bath. We find significant mass growth of intermediate mass and supermassive PBHs, the effect shift the predicted $e^+e^-$ peak from thermal history. Depending on the value of the collapse fraction an additional peak around the intermediate mass range, might become significant. Moreover, because PBH grow from the thermal bath the fraction of DM in PBH $f_{\rm PBH}$ also change. These results revise the previous view on mass evolution of PBH and have implications for dark matter PBH observations.

classification.title_zh: 辐射时代原初黑洞通过中微子吸收的质量增长
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种原初黑洞通过中微子吸收实现质量演化的新图景。利用半经典方法并更仔细地考察早期等离子体动力学，我们重新审视了质量范围在 $10^{-3}-10^9 M_\odot$ 的原初黑洞群体在热浴中对辐射的热吸收。我们发现中等质量与超大质量原初黑洞存在显著质量增长，这一效应会使热历史预言的 $e^+e^-$ 峰发生移动。取决于坍缩分数，在中质量范围附近可能出现一个额外峰。此外，由于原初黑洞从热浴中增长，原初黑洞在暗物质中的占比 $f_{\rm PBH}$ 也会改变。这些结果修正了此前关于原初黑洞质量演化的观点，并对原初黑洞暗物质观测具有意义。
classification.one_liner: 中微子吸收使辐射期原初黑洞显著增长，改变 e+e- 峰与 PBH 暗物质占比。

papers.title: Theoretical and experimental assessment of Einstein-Cartan theory: A comparative analysis within the USMEG-EFT framework
papers.abstract: The Unified Standard Model with Emergent Gravity (USMEG-EFT) framework achieves Standard Model-gravity unification by treating 4D General Relativity as an effective field theory. This work presents a comparative analysis of Einstein-Cartan (EC) theory and USMEG-EFT against experimental constraints and theoretical consistency requirements, distinguishing minimal EC with algebraically determined torsion from variants in which the spin connection is an independent quantum field. The latter class includes the Faddeev-Popov quantization framework of Brandt, Frenkel, Martins-Filho and McKeon adopted in their unification proposal, and for it gravitational wave polarization measurements directly test the additional propagating degrees of freedom. General relativity's spin-2 graviton produces exactly two tensor polarizations, while EC theory with independent dynamical spin connection predicts up to six modes. LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA null tests for GW170817 favor pure tensor over pure vector and pure scalar hypotheses at Bayes factors exceeding $10^{20}{:}1$, improved to approximately $10^{26}{:}1$ with a gamma-ray-burst jet-orientation prior. Complementary matter-sector constraints from the Standard Model Extension yield $|\tilde{b}^n_\perp| < 8.4 \times 10^{-34}$ GeV, constraining background-torsion scenarios, while MICROSCOPE bounds equivalence principle violation at $\eta < 1.5 \times 10^{-15}$. For minimal EC theory, the four-fermion contact interaction generated upon coupling to fermions introduces non-renormalizable divergence structures at two-loop order, a case not addressed by the BRST framework established for the independent spin connection. We situate EC theory within the broader landscape of gauge gravity theories and acknowledge USMEG-EFT's limitations, including sub-Planckian validity and currently untestable distinctive predictions.

classification.title_zh: 爱因斯坦-嘉当理论的理论与实验评估：USMEG-EFT 框架内的比较分析
classification.abstract_zh: 统一标准模型与涌现引力（USMEG-EFT）框架通过将四维广义相对论视为有效场论来实现标准模型与引力的统一。本文在实验约束和理论自洽性要求下，比较分析 Einstein-Cartan（EC）理论与 USMEG-EFT，并区分扭率由代数关系确定的最小 EC 和自旋联络作为独立量子场的变体。后者包括 Brandt、Frenkel、Martins-Filho 与 McKeon 在其统一方案中采用的 Faddeev-Popov 量子化框架；对该变体，引力波偏振测量可直接检验额外传播自由度。广义相对论的自旋-2 引力子恰好产生两个张量偏振，而具有独立动力学自旋联络的 EC 理论预言最多六个模式。LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 对 GW170817 的零检验以超过 10^20:1 的贝叶斯因子支持纯张量而非纯矢量与纯标量假设；加入伽马射线暴喷流方向先验后约提升至 10^26:1。标准模型扩展的物质部门约束给出 |b_perp^n| < 8.4×10^-34 GeV，限制背景扭率情形，而 MICROSCOPE 将等效原理违反限制为 η < 1.5×10^-15。对最小 EC 理论，与费米子耦合产生的四费米子接触相互作用在双圈阶引入不可重整化发散结构；该情形未被针对独立自旋联络建立的 BRST 框架处理。我们将 EC 理论置于更广泛的规范引力理论图景中，并承认 USMEG-EFT 的局限，包括亚普朗克有效性以及当前不可检验的独特预言。
classification.one_liner: 比较 Einstein-Cartan 理论与 USMEG-EFT，并用引力波偏振、等效原理及量子化一致性约束评估其可行性。
