papers.title: T-duality of string charge density/bit threads correspondence in type II supergravity
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study Abelian T-duality of the string charge density/bit threads correspondence in ten-dimensional Type II supergravity. T-duality along the common compact circle maps the Type IIB F1-NS5-P background to a Type IIA P-NS5-F1 background with the winding and momentum charges exchanged. The radial F1 source remains an F1 source, and its projected charge density gives a bit-thread flow whose maximal flux reproduces the black hole entropy. The same duality maps D1-D5-P to D0-D4-F1. In this case, a radial D1 source becomes a D2 source wrapped on the dual circle. Contracting the resulting spatial bivector with the normalized closed one-form on that circle gives a conserved effective radial flow whose maximal flux again reproduces the entropy. Although the local metrics, dilatons, source currents, and flow norms change, the dilaton-weighted transverse area density and the integrated maximal flux are invariant. These results provide a nontrivial T-duality test of the correspondence and extend it from string currents to wrapped-brane currents that reduce to string-like flows.

classification.title_zh: II 型超引力中弦电荷密度/比特线对应的 T 对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究十维 II 型超引力中弦电荷密度/比特线对应的阿贝尔 T 对偶。沿共同紧致圆的 T 对偶将 IIB 型 F1-NS5-P 背景映射为 IIA 型 P-NS5-F1 背景，并交换绕数和动量荷。径向 F1 源仍为 F1 源，其投影电荷密度给出比特线流，其最大流量复现黑洞熵。同一对偶将 D1-D5-P 映射为 D0-D4-F1。在此情形下，径向 D1 源变为缠绕在对偶圆上的 D2 源。将所得空间双矢量与该圆上归一化闭 1-形式缩并，得到一个守恒的有效径向流，其最大流量再次复现熵。尽管局域度规、伸缩子、源流和流范数改变，伸缩子加权的横向面积密度和积分最大流量不变。这些结果为该对应提供了非平凡的 T 对偶检验，并将其从弦流扩展到可约化为弦状流的包裹膜流。
classification.one_liner: 在十维 II 型超引力中，T 对偶保持弦/包裹膜电荷密度与比特线对应的最大流量不变，仍复现黑洞熵。

papers.title: When duality changes the poles: $SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$ transformations of linear response EFTs
papers.abstract: We study how $SL(2,\mathbb Z)$ transformations act on pole-truncated linear-response effective theories in $(2+1)$ dimensions. For correlators meromorphic within a finite low-frequency domain, the EFT data include both derivative-expanded transport coefficients and the retained non-hydrodynamic poles. Since the $S$-transformation inverts the optical conductivity and exchanges its poles and zeros, it does not necessarily commute with the infrared truncation. We derive explicit maps for static susceptibilities, the Einstein relation and AC transport coefficients. In the purely hydrodynamic sector the map closes on the original transport data, while in quasihydrodynamic regimes the transformed pole positions and, in general, residues constitute additional infrared data. We test the construction in the alternatively quantised D3/D5 probe-brane system, where an EFT retaining one original gapped pole can correspond to transformed EFTs retaining zero, one or two. The holographic results verify the analytic maps and exhibit an inverse-Drude conductivity at large values of the control parameter.

classification.title_zh: 当对偶改变极点：线性响应 EFT 的 SL(2,ℤ) 变换
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 SL(2,ℤ) 变换如何作用于 (2+1) 维中极点截断的线性响应有效理论。对于在有限低频区域内亚纯的关联函数，EFT 数据既包括导数展开的输运系数，也包括保留的非流体力学极点。由于 S 变换将光学电导率取逆并交换其极点与零点，它不一定与红外截断对易。我们推导了静态感受率、Einstein 关系以及交流输运系数的显式映射。在纯流体力学部分，该映射闭合于原始输运数据；而在准流体力学区域，变换后的极点位置以及一般情况下的留数构成额外的红外数据。我们在另一种量子化的 D3/D5 探针膜系统中检验该构造，其中保留一个原始有能隙极点的 EFT 可以对应保留零个、一个或两个极点的变换后 EFT。全息结果验证了解析映射，并显示出在控制参数较大时出现反 Drude 电导率。
classification.one_liner: 论文推导了 SL(2,ℤ) 对极点截断线性响应 EFT 的映射，并在 D3/D5 探针膜全息模型中验证，说明对偶在准流体区域会引入新的极点/留数红外数据。

papers.title: Logarithmic correction to the entropy of near-extremal higher-curvature black holes
papers.abstract: The spherically symmetric sector of broad classes of $D$-dimensional gravitational theories can be effectively described by general two-dimensional Horndeski theories. Exploiting this correspondence, we study the low-temperature dynamics of near-extremal black hole solutions of the parent theories by deriving a universal near-horizon effective description in terms of Jackiw--Teitelboim (JT) gravity. We explicitly show that the logarithmic quantum correction to the entropy, $S_{\rm JT}=\frac{3}{2}\log \left(T/T_{\rm breakdown} \right)$, previously derived for near-extremal black holes in Einstein gravity coupled to matter from the one-loop exact JT partition function, is universal across all models admitting an effective two-dimensional Horndeski description. We determine the general form of the scale at which this correction becomes dominant, $T_{\rm breakdown}$, in terms of the data of the $D$-dimensional theories. We illustrate our general results with charged black holes in Lovelock gravities and regular black holes in Quasitopological gravities.

classification.title_zh: 近极端高阶曲率黑洞熵的对数修正
classification.abstract_zh: D维引力理论的球对称扇区可由一般二维Horndeski理论有效描述。利用该对应，我们通过导出以Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT)引力表示的普适近地平有效描述，研究母理论近极端黑洞解的低温柔动力学。我们显式证明，先前从单圈精确JT配分函数对爱因斯坦引力耦合物质得到的近极端黑洞熵的对数量子修正 S_JT = 3/2 log(T/T_breakdown)，对所有允许有效二维Horndeski描述的模型普适。我们确定了该修正占主导的能标 T_breakdown 的一般形式，并用Lovelock引力中的带电黑洞与Quasitopological引力中的正则黑洞进行示例。
classification.one_liner: 在二维Horndeski/JT有效理论框架下证明近极端高阶曲率黑洞熵的对数修正普适，并确定其主导能标。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究近极端高阶曲率黑洞的熵对数修正及JT有效描述，属于黑洞量子引力与JT/AdS2有效理论，不直接涉及用户关注的超流、p波序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、探针膜/Floquet驱动或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Ramp, Plateau, and Wormholes without Averaging, and Hyper-non-perturbative Structures in Gravity
papers.abstract: Universal hallmarks of quantum chaos---such as the ramp and plateau in the spectral form factor---and the ramp's gravitational duals involving wormholes are widely interpreted as consequences of spectral or ensemble averaging. In this paper, following an earlier proposal of~\cite{Liu25c}, we develop an alternative approach: these phenomena arise as macroscopic smooth structures hidden within erratic microscopic data, which can be isolated through a smooth filter projection. Using the semiclassical Gutzwiller trace formula as a paradigmatic example, we illustrate how many features characteristic of random matrix models---including the ramp, the plateau, the spectral curve, and single-eigenvalue instantons---can be derived in the semiclassical limit without invoking ensemble or explicit spectral averages. We postulate the existence of a minimal Gutzwiller-like structure in the large-$N$ limit of holographic systems and explore its consequences. Beyond deriving the ramp and the plateau, this Gutzwiller-like structure predicts universal rapid macroscopic oscillations in the density of states and the possible existence of hyper-instantons, both of which involve double exponentials in $1/N^2$. On the gravity side, we demonstrate how spacetime wormholes enable the construction of emergent hyper-non-perturbative objects---such as baby-universe and wormhole condensates---which yield double exponential effects in $G_N$. This mirrors the postulated boundary Gutzwiller-like structure and provides a dual gravitational derivation of the universal rapid macroscopic oscillations in the density of states and the spectral plateau.

classification.title_zh: 无需平均的斜坡、平台与虫洞，以及引力中的超非微扰结构
classification.abstract_zh: 量子混沌的普适标志——例如谱形因子中的斜坡和平台——以及斜坡涉及虫洞的引力对偶，通常被解释为谱平均或系综平均的结果。本文遵循 Liu25c 此前的提议，发展一种替代方法：这些现象作为隐藏在不规则微观数据中的宏观平滑结构出现，并可通过平滑滤波投影分离。以半经典 Gutzwiller 迹公式为范例，我们展示随机矩阵模型的许多特征——包括斜坡、平台、谱曲线和单本征值瞬子——可在半经典极限下导出，而无需引入系综或显式谱平均。我们假设全息系统大 N 极限存在一个最小类 Gutzwiller 结构，并探索其后果。除导出斜坡和平台外，该结构还预测态密度中的普适快速宏观振荡以及超瞬子的可能存在，二者均涉及 1/N^2 的双指数。在引力方面，我们展示时空虫洞如何使涌现的超非微扰对象——例如婴儿宇宙和虫洞凝聚体——的构造成为可能，这些对象在 G_N 中产生双指数效应。这镜像了所假设的边界类 Gutzwiller 结构，并提供了态密度中普适快速宏观振荡和谱平台的对偶引力推导。
classification.one_liner: 本文提出无需系综平均，通过边界类 Gutzwiller 结构和引力虫洞凝聚体导出量子混沌的斜坡/平台及 1/N^2、G_N 双指数超非微扰效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文核心是量子混沌谱统计、随机矩阵、虫洞与全息对偶中的非平均结构，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet 或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: All-multiplicity monodromy and KLT relations for AdS string integrals
papers.abstract: We propose and study all-multiplicity building blocks for tree-level string amplitudes in AdS. These are worldsheet integrals obtained by dressing the corresponding flat-space disc and sphere integrals with multivariable multiple polylogarithms and their single-valued analogues, respectively. We derive monodromy relations for the open-string building blocks and a KLT factorisation for their closed-string counterparts. This extends the non-commutative AdS uplift of lower-point flat-space structures to general $n$-point kinematics.

classification.title_zh: AdS 弦积分的全多重数单值性与 KLT 关系
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出并研究 AdS 中树级弦振幅的全多重数构建块。它们是通过分别用多变量多重多对数及其单值类似物修饰相应的平直时空圆盘和球面积分而得到的世界面积分。我们推导了开弦构建块的单值性关系，以及闭弦对应物的 KLT 因子化。这将低点平直时空结构的非对易 AdS 提升推广到一般的 n 点运动学。
classification.one_liner: 提出 AdS 树级弦振幅的全 n 点世界面积分构建块，并给出开弦单值性关系与闭弦 KLT 因子化。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS 弦振幅与形式理论方向，涉及 AdS/CFT 基础，但未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Symmetry-resolved Krylov Complexity and the Uncoloured Tensor Model
papers.abstract: The symmetry-resolved Krylov complexity is a useful tool for studying the chaotic properties of systems endowed with symmetries. We investigate the conditions under which an invariant Hermitian operator would have the symmetry-resolved Krylov complexity in a charge subspace identical to the Krylov complexity of the full operator, and find a necessary and sufficient condition that ensures this matching at all temperatures. Further, we study the Krylov complexity of the Uncoloured Tensor Model, a disorder-free kin of the SYK Model, which has a plethora of symmetries. We identify charge subspaces of the same operator in which equipartition holds, as well as those where it doesn't, along with observations on the underlying mechanism behind these. We also find that, within the computational limits, the Krylov complexity, averaged over the symmetry subspace, is bounded above by that of the operator in the full space.

classification.title_zh: 对称分辨的Krylov复杂度与无色张量模型
classification.abstract_zh: 对称分辨的Krylov复杂度是研究具有对称性的系统混沌性质的有用工具。我们研究了不变厄米算符在某个电荷子空间中的对称分辨Krylov复杂度与全算符Krylov复杂度相同的条件，并找到一个充要条件，确保该匹配在所有温度下成立。进一步，我们研究了无色张量模型（SYK模型的无无序近亲）的Krylov复杂度，该模型具有大量对称性。我们识别了同一算符中满足等分的电荷子空间，以及不满足等分的子空间，并对背后机制进行了观察。我们还发现，在计算限制内，按对称子空间平均的Krylov复杂度被全空间中的算符Krylov复杂度所上界。
classification.one_liner: 研究对称分辨Krylov复杂度何时等于全空间复杂度，并分析无色张量模型（SYK类模型）中不同电荷子空间的复杂度行为与等分现象。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于量子混沌/Krylov复杂度与SYK类张量模型支线，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动或经典引力等方向。

papers.title: The physical meaning of the Belinfante-Rosenfeld ambiguity
papers.abstract: Current literature lacks consensus on how to theoretically describe spin polarization and its transport in matter. The underlying reason is the presence of the Belinfante-Rosenfeld (BR) ambiguity in the form of the energy-momentum and spin tensors. I re-examine the BR ambiguity in Einstein-Cartan spacetimes, using the bi-form formalism in a manner applicable to any conserved current and its corresponding gauge field. This allows us to physically interpret the BR ambiguity as the choice of splitting a conserved current into its matter and gauge field contributions. We argue this follows from Noether's second theorem and show that certain examples of BR ambiguities reduce to large gauge transformations.

classification.title_zh: Belinfante-Rosenfeld 歧义的物理意义
classification.abstract_zh: 当前文献对于如何在理论上描述物质中的自旋极化及其输运缺乏共识。其根本原因在于能量-动量张量与自旋张量形式中的 Belinfante-Rosenfeld (BR) 歧义。我重新审视 Einstein-Cartan 时空中的 BR 歧义，采用双形式形式体系，其方式适用于任意守恒流及其对应的规范场。这使我们可以将 BR 歧义物理解释为：选择将守恒流拆分为物质贡献和规范场贡献。我们论证这源自 Noether 第二定理，并表明某些 BR 歧义实例可约化为大规范变换。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-Cartan 时空中用双形式方法表明，Belinfante-Rosenfeld 歧义可理解为守恒流在物质与规范场之间拆分的选择，并联系 Noether 第二定理与大规范变换。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 Einstein-Cartan 时空中的 Belinfante-Rosenfeld 歧义，属于经典引力/广义相对论的基础问题，直接匹配用户‘经典引力/广义相对论’标签；但不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息字典，对全息方向无直接贡献。

papers.title: "Filtering" CFTs at large N: Euclidean Wormholes, Closed Universes, and Black Hole Interiors
papers.abstract: Despite its successes, the large-$N$ holographic dictionary remains incomplete. Key features of gravitational path integrals--most notably Euclidean wormholes and the associated failure of factorization--lack a clear interpretation in the standard large-$N$ framework. A related challenge is the possibility of erratic $N$-dependence in CFT observables, behavior with no evident semiclassical gravitational counterpart. We argue that these puzzles point to a missing ingredient in the dictionary: a large-$N$ filter. This filter projects out the erratic $N$-dependence of CFT quantities when mapping them to semiclassical bulk physics, providing an intrinsic boundary definition of gravitational "averages." It also offers a boundary explanation of wormhole contributions and a boundary prediction of their amplitudes, thereby giving a natural resolution of the factorization puzzle. In addition, we derive an infinite tower of inequalities constraining wormhole amplitudes and argue that internal wormholes do not induce random couplings in the low-energy effective theory. Beyond resolving factorization, the large-$N$ filter supplies a generalized framework from which richer Lorentzian spacetime structures can emerge, including closed universes and black hole interiors. We argue that, as a consequence of erratic large-$N$ behavior, both closed universes and black hole interiors are quantum volatile, and that an AdS spacetime entangled with a baby universe is likewise quantum volatile. This volatility may allow an observer in AdS to infer the existence of the baby universe, whereas for an infalling observer, the ability to make measurements near a black hole horizon may become fundamentally limited--even if they may not live long enough to notice.

classification.title_zh: 在大 N 下“过滤”CFT：欧几里得虫洞、闭合宇宙与黑洞内部
classification.abstract_zh: 尽管 large-N 全息字典取得了成功，但它仍然不完整。引力路径积分的关键特征——最显著的是欧几里得虫洞以及相关的因子化失效——在标准 large-N 框架中缺乏清晰的解释。一个相关的挑战是 CFT 可观测量中可能出现不规则的 N 依赖，这种行为没有明显的半经典引力对应。我们认为这些谜题指向字典中缺失的一个要素：一个 large-N 过滤器。当将 CFT 量映射到半经典体物理时，该过滤器投影掉其不规则的 N 依赖，为引力“平均”提供了内在的边界定义。它还为虫洞贡献提供了边界解释，并对其振幅给出了边界预测，从而自然地解决了因子化谜题。此外，我们推导出无穷多个不等式来约束虫洞振幅，并论证内部虫洞不会在低能有效理论中诱导随机耦合。除了解决因子化问题，large-N 过滤器提供了一个广义框架，从中可以浮现出更丰富的洛伦兹时空结构，包括闭合宇宙和黑洞内部。我们论证，由于 large-N 行为的不规则性，闭合宇宙和黑洞内部都是量子易变的，并且与婴儿宇宙纠缠的 AdS 时空同样是量子易变的。这种易变性可能允许 AdS 中的观察者推断出婴儿宇宙的存在，而对于落入的观察者来说，在黑洞视界附近进行测量的能力可能变得从根本上受限——即使他们可能活得不够长以至于注意到。
classification.one_liner: 提出 large-N 过滤器作为全息字典中缺失的要素，用于解释欧几里得虫洞、因子化失效，并预言闭合宇宙和黑洞内部的量子易变性。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接讨论 AdS/CFT 全息字典、虫洞与因子化问题，属于全息对偶基础与量子引力前沿，对全息理论研究人员有重要参考价值。

papers.title: On thermal holographic RG flows
papers.abstract: Holographic Renormalization Group (RG) flows, described by Einstein gravity coupled to matter fields, have been thoroughly explored in the context of vacuum states. In this work, we shift the focus to \emph{thermal} states. We develop the Hamilton-Jacobi functional up to \emph{second order} in the boundary derivative expansion. Using this formalism, we derive the Ward identity associated with broken dilatation symmetry for thermal correlators. Furthermore, we also obtain the modified Callan-Symanzik equation for the dual thermal CFT. We then employ the Hamiltonian constraint approach to analyze the black hole interior and comment on the near-singularity behavior from this perspective.

classification.title_zh: 论热全息 RG 流
classification.abstract_zh: 全息重整化群（RG）流，由与物质场耦合的 Einstein 引力描述，此前主要在真空态背景下得到充分研究。本文将关注点转向热态。我们在边界导数展开中发展至二阶的 Hamilton-Jacobi 泛函。利用这一形式，我们导出热关联子中与破缺的伸缩对称性相关的 Ward 恒等式。此外，我们还得到对偶热 CFT 的修正 Callan-Symanzik 方程。随后，我们采用 Hamiltonian 约束方法分析黑洞内部，并从该视角评论近奇异行为。
classification.one_liner: 研究热态全息 RG 流，建立二阶 Hamilton-Jacobi 形式并推导热 CFT 的 Ward 恒等式与修正 Callan-Symanzik 方程，同时用 Hamiltonian 约束探讨黑洞内部近奇异行为。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及全息 RG、热 CFT 与经典引力/黑洞内部，可关联经典引力重点标签，但不直接覆盖全息超导、相变、QNM、探针膜等专题。

papers.title: Kruglov-entropy cosmology from apparent-horizon thermodynamics: background dynamics and observational constraints
papers.abstract: We investigate two late-time cosmological models generated by Kruglov's nonadditive entropy at the apparent horizon. Model I, originally derived by Kruglov, follows the Cai--Kim thermodynamic construction and leads to an implicit modified Friedmann equation, whereas Model II, proposed and derived in this work, is obtained from an entropy-integral prescription and contains an effective vacuum contribution. We formulate both models in terms of the dimensionless Hubble parameter, include radiation, impose exact present-day closure, and evolve the physical branch using analytic derivatives of the implicit Friedmann equations. We constrain the models with DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillations and a compressed CMB likelihood, with and without DES-Y5 Type-Ia supernovae. Model I is driven to a markedly lower Hubble constant, $H_0\simeq62.4,\mathrm{km,s^{-1},Mpc^{-1}}$ for the combined data, and remains non-phantom with $w_{\rm DE,0}\simeq-0.814$; it is strongly disfavoured relative to flat $\Lambda$CDM. Model II stays close to $\Lambda$CDM in the standard cosmological parameters and gives $w_{\rm DE,0}\simeq-1.003$, while its two entropy-sector parameters remain strongly degenerate. Its best-fit likelihood is comparable to $\Lambda$CDM, but the additional parameters are not supported by information criteria. These results show that the two thermodynamic realizations of the same nonadditive entropy have sharply different phenomenological consequences at the homogeneous-background level. In summary, the observational plausibility of entropy-based cosmology hinges critically on how the generalized horizon entropy is incorporated into the Friedmann dynamics.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 基于表观视界热力学的 Kruglov 熵宇宙学：背景动力学与观测限制
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由表观视界上的 Kruglov 非加性熵产生的两个晚期宇宙学模型。模型 I 最初由 Kruglov 导出，遵循 Cai--Kim 热力学构造，并导致隐式修改的 Friedmann 方程；模型 II 是本文提出并导出的，采用熵积分方案，包含有效真空贡献。我们将两个模型用无量纲 Hubble 参数表示，纳入辐射，施加精确的当今闭合条件，并利用隐式 Friedmann 方程的解析导数演化物理分支。我们用 DESI DR2 重子声学振荡和压缩 CMB 似然，在有和没有 DES-Y5 Ia 型超新星的情况下限制模型。模型 I 被驱动到明显更低的 Hubble 常数，H0≈62.4 km/s/Mpc（联合数据），且保持非 phantom，w_DE,0≈-0.814；相对于平坦 ΛCDM 被强烈排除。模型 II 在标准宇宙学参数上接近 ΛCDM，给出 w_DE,0≈-1.003，而其两个熵部门参数仍强烈简并。其最佳拟合似然与 ΛCDM 相当，但额外参数不被信息判据支持。这些结果表明，同一非加性熵的两种热力学实现，在均匀背景层面具有显著不同的现象学后果。总之，基于熵的宇宙学的观测合理性关键取决于广义视界熵如何被纳入 Friedmann 动力学。
classification.one_liner: 同一 Kruglov 非加性熵在表观视界热力学中的两种实现导致显著不同的晚期宇宙学背景与观测拟合。

papers.title: Circular orbits and particle collisions in the space-time of boson stars and their frozen states
papers.abstract: In this paper, we discuss the dynamics of test particles in the space-time of spherically symmetric, charged boson stars and their frozen states. These latter objects consist of a de Sitter core and a black hole exterior with a shell of finite thickness interpolating between the two. We discuss charged and uncharged massive particles, find the ISCOs and determine whether collisions of massive particles close to the core of (frozen) boson stars can lead to large center of mass energies. We also discuss massless test particles and find that photons rings as well as light points are possible in the space-time of frozen boson stars. We compare our results with those in the corresponding Reissner-Nordstroem space-time and point out differences.

classification.title_zh: 玻色星及其冻结态时空中的圆轨道与粒子碰撞
classification.abstract_zh: 本文讨论球对称带电玻色星及其冻结态时空中的测试粒子动力学。冻结态由 de Sitter 核心和黑洞外部组成，两者之间由有限厚度的壳层插值连接。我们讨论带电与不带电有质量粒子，求出 ISCO，并判断在（冻结）玻色星核心附近有质量粒子的碰撞是否能产生大的质心能量。我们还讨论无质量测试粒子，发现冻结玻色星时空中可能出现光子环以及光点。我们将结果与相应的 Reissner-Nordström 时空进行比较并指出差异。
classification.one_liner: 在带电玻色星与冻结态时空中分析测试粒子的圆轨道、ISCO、碰撞质心能及光子环，并与 Reissner-Nordström 结果对比。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究玻色星/冻结态经典时空中的测试粒子动力学、ISCO、碰撞与光子环，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，直接匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”。

papers.title: Thermodynamic geometry as the missing link: toward a unified framework for black hole first-order phase transitions
papers.abstract: Black hole first-order phase transitions have been described by several seemingly independent frameworks, including local geometry, global topology, complex analysis, and thermodynamic geometry. While the first three have been unified, thermodynamic geometry has remained outside. We prove that the divergence points of the normalized Ruppeiner curvature scalar $R_N$ coincide exactly with the solutions of $T'(r_h)=0$, where $r_h$ is the horizon radius. These solutions include extremal points (spinodal points) and stationary inflection points (thermodynamic critical points). Thus, the divergence of $R_N$ is a necessary but not sufficient condition for a first-order phase transition. This clarifies the mathematical origin of curvature divergence and why thermodynamic geometry can reliably indicate but not alone confirm phase transitions. Using the local geometric framework as a central framework, we incorporate Ruppeiner geometry into this unified picture; a similar analysis also applies to Weinhold geometry. Consequently, the four frameworks are unified within a single structure based on the local folding of the temperature function. This advances our understanding of the mathematical structure of black hole first-order phase transitions and provides clues for possible extensions to other types of phase transitions.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 热力学几何作为缺失环节：迈向黑洞一阶相变的统一框架
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞一阶相变曾被若干看似独立的框架描述，包括局部几何、整体拓扑、复分析和热力学几何。前三个框架已被统一，而热力学几何仍在此之外。我们证明，归一化 Ruppeiner 曲率标量 R_N 的发散点恰好与 T'(r_h)=0 的解重合，其中 r_h 是视界半径。这些解包括极值点（旋节线点）和驻拐点（热力学临界点）。因此，R_N 的发散是一阶相变的必要条件而非充分条件。这澄清了曲率发散的数学起源，以及为何热力学几何能够可靠地指示但不能单独确认相变。以局部几何框架为中心框架，我们将 Ruppeiner 几何纳入这一统一图像；类似分析也适用于 Weinhold 几何。因此，这四个框架在基于温度函数局部折叠的单一结构内得到统一。这推进了我们对黑洞一阶相变数学结构的理解，并为可能推广到其他类型相变提供了线索。
classification.one_liner: 证明 Ruppeiner 曲率发散点对应 T'(r_h)=0，从而将热力学几何统一进黑洞一阶相变的局部几何框架。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究黑洞一阶相变与热力学几何，匹配“相变与气泡成核”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；摘要未涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: $k-$deformed Schwarzschild AdS black strings
papers.abstract: Considering a cylindrically symmetric spacetime, a novel exact $\kappa$-deformed Schwarzschild-AdS black string solution is derived in General Relativity in the presence of a negative cosmological constant. The geometric properties of the resulting solution are systematically investigated by computing the Ricci and Kretschmann curvature scalars. The analysis reveals the existence of a curvature singularity at the origin, which remains enclosed by an event horizon provided that the $\kappa$-deformation parameter satisfies a specific constraint. Subsequently, the influence of various model parameters on the horizon structure and configuration is examined in detail. The thermodynamic properties of these black strings are thoroughly evaluated; in this regard, the Hawking temperature, entropy, mass, isobaric heat capacity, and Gibbs free energy are self-consistently extracted. The effects of the parameters, particularly the $\kappa$-deformation parameter, on these thermodynamic quantities are comprehensively explored. Furthermore, it is demonstrated that these state variables fundamentally satisfy the extended first law of black hole thermodynamics and yield a modified Smarr relation. Finally, the temporal profile of the Hawking radiation is probed via the dimensionless sparsity parameter, through which the impacts of the underlying parameters on the quantum emission rate are systematically analyzed.

classification.title_zh: κ-形变 Schwarzschild AdS 黑弦
classification.abstract_zh: 在柱对称时空中，本文在含负宇宙学常数的广义相对论中推导了一个新的 κ-形变 Schwarzschild-AdS 黑弦精确解。通过计算 Ricci 和 Kretschmann 曲率标量，系统研究了所得解的几何性质。分析表明原点处存在曲率奇点，只要 κ-形变参数满足特定约束，该奇点就被事件视界包裹。随后，详细考察了各模型参数对视界结构和构型的影响。全面评估了这些黑弦的热力学性质；据此自洽地提取了 Hawking 温度、熵、质量、等压热容和 Gibbs 自由能。深入探讨了参数，特别是 κ-形变参数，对这些热力学量的影响。进一步证明这些状态变量从根本上满足黑洞热力学的扩展第一定律，并给出修正的 Smarr 关系。最后，通过无量纲稀疏参数探测 Hawking 辐射的时间轮廓，系统分析了底层参数对量子发射率的影响。
classification.one_liner: 在含负宇宙学常数的广义相对论中构造 κ-形变 Schwarzschild-AdS 黑弦，并分析其曲率、视界、热力学与霍金辐射稀疏性。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接属于“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线，并涉及 AdS 黑洞热力学；但摘要未涉及 AdS/CFT 全息字典，因此不归为理论全息。

papers.title: Rotating Weyssenhoff fluids in linearized Einstein-Cartan theory
papers.abstract: The Weyssenhoff fluid expands the ordinary perfect-fluid description of general relativity by taking into account the intrinsic spin of its constituent particles. Within the linearized regime of Einstein-Cartan theory, we investigate the exterior geometry produced by isolated slowly rotating Weyssenhoff fluids, i.e., sources endowed with both macroscopic and microscopic angular momenta. Our work represents an extension of the foundational analysis of Arkuszewski, Kopczy{\'n}ski and Ponomariev, which was restricted to the static fluid configuration. Under the assumptions of stationarity and axial symmetry, we derive the explicit expression for the linearized stress-energy tensor of the source and obtain the corresponding metric through a multipole expansion. The ensuing solution exhibits a generalized Lense-Thirring structure, with both the gravitoelectric and gravitomagnetic sectors affected by the quantum spin and macroscopic rotation. We also discuss some phenomenological implications of the model, including the gyroscope precession and the Sagnac effect, along with potential experimental probes of the predicted corrections.

classification.title_zh: 线性化 Einstein-Cartan 理论中的旋转 Weyssenhoff 流体
classification.abstract_zh: Weyssenhoff 流体通过考虑其组成粒子的内禀自旋，扩展了广义相对论中普通理想流体的描述。在 Einstein-Cartan 理论的线性化范围内，我们研究孤立的缓慢旋转 Weyssenhoff 流体所产生的外部几何，即同时具有宏观和微观角动量的源。我们的工作扩展了 Arkuszewski、Kopczyński 和 Ponomariev 的基础分析，后者局限于静态流体构型。在稳态和轴对称假设下，我们推导了源在线性化下的应力-能量张量显式表达式，并通过多极展开得到相应的度规。所得解展现出广义的 Lense-Thirring 结构，其中引力电和引力磁部分都受到量子自旋和宏观旋转的影响。我们还讨论了该模型的一些现象学意义，包括陀螺仪进动和 Sagnac 效应，以及对所预测修正的潜在实验探测。
classification.one_liner: 在线性化 Einstein-Cartan 理论中，旋转 Weyssenhoff 流体的自旋与宏观转动共同修正外部度规，呈现广义 Lense-Thirring 效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线，研究线性化 Einstein-Cartan 理论中的旋转自旋流体及其经典时空效应；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Quasinormal modes and shadow of Schwarzschild-Tangherlini black hole with GUP
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate quasinormal modes and the shadow of a Schwarzschild-Tangherlini black hole in $(d+1)$ dimensions, incorporating corrections arising from the Generalized Uncertainty Principle (GUP). Using the WKB approximation up to sixth order, we calculate the quasinormal frequencies for $l=1, 2$ and $d=3, 4, 5, 6$, and analyze the effects of the dimensionless linear and quadratic GUP parameters $\bar{\alpha}$ and $\bar{\beta}$, respectively. We find that the linear correction increases the oscillation frequency and the damping rate, whereas the quadratic correction produces the opposite behavior within the parameter range considered. Using the finite difference scheme, we obtain the time-domain evolution and find that higher dimensions lead to faster damping and that the visibility of GUP-induced modifications to the time-domain waveform depends on the excitation profile of the initial perturbation, whereas the underlying quasinormal spectrum remains determined by the black hole geometry.Furthermore, we investigate the shadow and establish its correspondence with the quasinormal spectrum in the eikonal limit through the properties of the unstable circular null geodesics. Finally, we confront the predicted shadow size with Event Horizon Telescope observations of Sagittarius A* and use these constraints to investigate the allowed GUP parameter space.

classification.title_zh: 带有广义不确定性原理的 Schwarzschild-Tangherlini 黑洞的准正模与阴影
classification.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了 (d+1) 维 Schwarzschild-Tangherlini 黑洞的准正模与阴影，并纳入由广义不确定性原理（GUP）产生的修正。利用最高六阶的 WKB 近似，我们计算了 l=1,2 以及 d=3,4,5,6 的准正频率，并分别分析无量纲线性与二次 GUP 参数 ̄α 和 ̄β 的影响。我们发现，在所考虑的参数范围内，线性修正增大振荡频率与阻尼率，而二次修正产生相反行为。利用有限差分方法，我们得到时域演化，并发现更高维度导致更快阻尼，且 GUP 引起的时域波形修正的可观测性依赖于初始扰动的激发轮廓，而底层的准正谱仍由黑洞几何决定。此外，我们研究了阴影，并通过不稳定圆形零测地线的性质，在 eikonal 极限下建立其与准正谱的对应关系。最后，我们将预言的阴影大小与事件视界望远镜对人马座 A* 的观测进行对比，并利用这些限制研究允许的 GUP 参数空间。
classification.one_liner: 在 GUP 修正下计算高维 Schwarzschild-Tangherlini 黑洞的准正模与阴影，并用 EHT 对 Sgr A* 的观测限制 GUP 参数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接涉及准正模、黑洞阴影与经典引力时空，并属于 QNM/经典引力重点支线；但不包含 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶内容。

papers.title: Bootstrapping Holographic Theories in the Planar Limit
papers.abstract: We combine the numerical conformal bootstrap with supersymmetric localization to constrain the spectrum of holographic superconformal field theories in the planar large $N$ limit for finite 't Hooft coupling $\lambda$. We consider the stress tensor multiplet four-point function in $\mathcal{N}=4$ $SU(N)$ super-Yang-Mills (SYM), which is holographically dual to closed string scattering, as well as the flavor multiplet correlator in a certain \( 4d \) $\mathcal{N}=2$ $U\!Sp(2N)$ gauge theory with $SO(8)$ flavor symmetry, which is dual to open string scattering. In both cases, we combine dispersive sum rules with integrated constraints from supersymmetric localization to compute an upper bound on the scaling dimension of the lowest scalar single-trace operator for all $\lambda$. For $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM, we find that our bounds are close to the known integrability result for all $\lambda$. For the $\mathcal{N}=2$ theory, where integrability is not yet available, we find that our bounds are close to weak and strong coupling predictions in the relevant regimes.

classification.title_zh: 平面极限下全息理论的 bootstrap
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将数值共形 bootstrap 与超对称局域化相结合，以约束平面大 N 极限下、有限 't Hooft 耦合 λ 时全息超共形场论的谱。我们考虑 N=4 SU(N) 超杨-米尔斯（SYM）中的应力张量多重态四点函数——它全息对偶于闭弦散射——以及某个具有 SO(8) 味对称性的 4d N=2 U Sp(2N) 规范理论中的味多重态关联函数——它对偶于开弦散射。在这两种情形中，我们将色散求和规则与来自超对称局域化的积分约束结合起来，计算对所有 λ 的最低标量单迹算子标度维数的上界。对于 N=4 SYM，我们发现我们的界对所有 λ 都接近已知可积性结果。对于 N=2 理论，在尚无可积性结果的情况下，我们发现我们的界在相关区域内接近弱耦合和强耦合预言。
classification.one_liner: 结合共形 bootstrap 与超对称局域化，对平面大 N 全息超共形场论中最低标量单迹算子的标度维数给出全耦合上界。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与共形 bootstrap 方法，但未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流、多分量序参量、探针膜/Floquet、QNM、相变成核或经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Fate of Bouncing Singularities at Finite $G_N$
papers.abstract: The gravity approximation to a thermal two-point function can develop a complex-time singularity associated with a trajectory that reaches the black-hole singularity. We show that the corresponding singularity is absent at finite $G_N$. This is done by extending Conformal Field Theory analyticity properties to the second sheet (and to the universal cover). We also put two different upper bounds on the amplitude of the correlator at the would-be singularity, by certain finite partial sums, and by a certain partition function on a manifold with nontrivial topology, where two thermal geometries are glued. We discuss the possible implications for the black hole singularity.

classification.title_zh: 有限 $G_N$ 下反弹奇点的命运
classification.abstract_zh: 热两点函数的引力近似会出现一个复时间奇点，它与一条到达黑洞奇点的轨迹相关。我们证明，在有限 $G_N$ 下相应的奇点不存在。为此，我们将共形场论的解析性质延拓到第二黎曼面（以及万有覆盖）。我们还通过某些有限部分和，以及通过一个在具有非平凡拓扑的流形上的配分函数——其中两个热几何被粘合——给出了关联函数在候选奇点处振幅的两个不同上界。我们讨论这对黑洞奇点的可能含义。
classification.one_liner: 有限 $G_N$ 下，热两点函数中与黑洞奇点相关的复时间奇点消失，并给出关联函数上界。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息对偶与黑洞奇点/量子引力的基础问题，未直接涉及所列重点标签中的全息超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、探针膜或经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: Hilbert space in the flat limit of AdS/CFT. I. Massive particles
papers.abstract: The flat limit of AdS$_4$ spacetime corresponds, at the level of the symmetry algebra, to the In\"on\"u--Wigner contraction $\mathfrak{so}(2,3) \to \mathfrak{iso}(1,3)$. We describe the emergence of the Hilbert space of massive scattering states of arbitrary integer spin $s$ from unitary lowest-weight representations $\mathcal{D}(\Delta,s)$ of the conformal group, using a basis of `pseudo-momentum' states first introduced by Fronsdal. These states nicely reduce to Wigner's momentum eigenstates in the limit of vanishing AdS curvature radius $\ell \to \infty$, at fixed $m=\Delta/\ell$. A simple conformal map relates this description to conformal fields in $\mathbb{R}^3$ familiar from radial quantization, with the interior and exterior of the unit ball respectively corresponding to outgoing and ingoing momenta. Under the contraction, and upon appropriate rescaling, the inner product on $\mathcal{D}(\Delta,s)$ converges to the standard Lorentz-invariant inner product of Wigner's massive particles, so that unitarity is preserved throughout. The contraction to massless particles is briefly discussed here, and will be treated in detail in a forthcoming paper.

classification.title_zh: AdS/CFT 平直极限中的希尔伯特空间 I. 大质量粒子
classification.abstract_zh: AdS$_4$ 时空的平直极限在对称代数层面对应于 Inönü–Wigner 收缩 $\mathfrak{so}(2,3)\to\mathfrak{iso}(1,3)$。我们描述了任意整数自旋 $s$ 的大质量散射态希尔伯特空间如何从共形群的酉最低权表示 $\mathcal{D}(\Delta,s)$ 中出现，所用基是 Fronsdal 最早引入的“赝动量”态。在 AdS 曲率半径 $\ell\to\infty$ 且固定 $m=\Delta/\ell$ 时，这些态良好地约化为 Wigner 的动量本征态。一个简单的共形映射将这一描述与 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中径向量子化所熟悉的共形场联系起来，其中单位球内部和外部各自对应出射和入射动量。在该收缩下并经过适当重标度后，$\mathcal{D}(\Delta,s)$ 上的内积收敛为 Wigner 大质量粒子的标准洛伦兹不变内积，因此整个过程中酉性保持。这里简要讨论了到无质量粒子的收缩，详细处理将在后续论文中给出。
classification.one_liner: 通过共形群表示的 Inönü–Wigner 收缩，构造 AdS 平直极限中任意整数自旋大质量粒子的 Wigner 希尔伯特空间，并显示内积与酉性在极限中保持。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 基础与平直极限的表示论研究，与全息对偶字典相关；但不涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、探针膜、QNM、非均匀态或经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: de Sitter Spacetime: Geometry, Causal Structure, and Quantum Fields
papers.abstract: de~Sitter spacetime plays a central role in modern cosmology, providing an excellent approximation to both inflation and the present accelerated expansion. It also offers a particularly simple setting in which gravity, spacetime symmetry, and quantum field theory depart qualitatively from their Minkowski-space counterparts. These lecture notes introduce de Sitter spacetime, from its geometry and symmetries to quantum fields and perturbations on a fixed \(3+1\)-dimensional de Sitter background. We cover coordinate systems, causal structure, unitary representations, particle production in time-dependent backgrounds, and cosmological perturbations, with emphasis on physical interpretation, applications to cosmology, and how curvature reshapes the notions of mass, vacuum, particles, and late-time observables.

classification.title_zh: 德西特时空：几何、因果结构与量子场
classification.abstract_zh: 德西特时空在现代宇宙学中起着核心作用，它为暴胀以及当前的加速膨胀提供了极好的近似。它还提供了一个特别简单的背景，在其中引力、时空对称性和量子场论以与闵可夫斯基时空对应物定性不同的方式呈现。这些讲义介绍德西特时空，从它的几何与对称性到固定 3+1 维德西特背景上的量子场与扰动。我们涵盖坐标系、因果结构、幺正表示、含时背景中的粒子产生以及宇宙学扰动，重点放在物理解释、宇宙学应用，以及曲率如何重塑质量、真空、粒子与晚时观测量等概念。
classification.one_liner: 这些讲义系统介绍德西特时空的几何、因果结构以及固定背景上的量子场与宇宙学扰动。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及 dS/天球及经典引力主题，涵盖德西特几何、因果结构与固定背景量子场；但不涉及全息对偶、QNM、凝聚态或用户列出的多数重点支线。

papers.title: Entanglement transitions in holographic conformal interfaces
papers.abstract: We study entanglement transitions for pairs of disjoint intervals in two-dimensional holographic interface conformal field theories. We consider several holographic models with equal central charges on the two sides of the interface: thin-wall geometries with one and two branes, the Janus solution, and the super-Janus solution. We first discuss the finite interface contribution to the entanglement entropy of a single interval, distinguishing intervals that cross the interface from those that lie entirely on one side. We then use the mutual information to locate the transition between connected and disconnected Ryu--Takayanagi geodesic configurations for two intervals. When the interface lies between the two intervals, increasing the boundary entropy $\log g$, which provides a measure of interface strength in the models considered here, generally decreases the critical separation at which the connected configuration ceases to dominate. When both intervals lie on the same side of the interface, the behavior is model dependent: the connected phase persists to larger separations in the Janus and super-Janus models, while the critical separation is unchanged in the thin-wall models. Thus, as diagnosed by the two-interval transition, the interface weakens correlations across the interface while preserving or enhancing correlations between regions on the same side. We also identify a universal ``Silver Blaze'' configuration, in which the interface lies inside one of the intervals and the transition occurs at the same location as in a CFT without an interface, independently of the interface parameters and of the holographic model. This universality follows from a cancellation between crossing and non-crossing interface contributions to the mutual information.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 全息共形界面中的纠缠转变
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究二维全息界面共形场论中一对不相交区间的纠缠转变。我们考虑若干在界面两侧具有相等中心荷的全息模型：带一个和两个膜的薄壁几何、Janus 解以及 super-Janus 解。我们首先讨论单区间纠缠熵的有限界面贡献，区分跨界面区间与完全位于一侧的区间。随后利用互信息确定两个区间对应的连通与不连通 Ryu--Takayanagi 测地线构型之间的转变。当界面位于两区间之间时，增大边界熵 log g（在所考虑的模型中度量界面强度）通常会降低连通构型不再占主导的临界间距。当两个区间位于界面同一侧时，行为依赖模型：在 Janus 和 super-Janus 模型中连通相持续到更大的间距，而在薄壁模型中临界间距不变。因此，由双区间转变所诊断，界面削弱了跨界面关联，同时保持或增强同一侧区域之间的关联。我们还识别出一个普适的“Silver Blaze”构型：界面位于其中一个区间内部，且转变位置与没有界面的 CFT 中相同，与界面参数及全息模型无关。这一普适性来自互信息中跨界面与非跨界面贡献之间的抵消。
classification.one_liner: 在全息界面CFT中，用互信息和RT测地线转变研究界面如何改变两区间纠缠结构，并发现一类与界面参数无关的Silver Blaze普适构型。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究全息共形界面/畴壁及其对两区间纠缠与RT转变的影响，与“畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀”重点支线相关；但不涉及全息超流超导、p波、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或D3-D7/D5探针膜等其它重点标签。

papers.title: Informational and algebraic renormalization group
papers.abstract: Renormalization group (RG) is a core concept in physics from statistical mechanics to quantum field theory, yet its schemes differ widely between field theory and many-body physics. We formulate the Wilsonian RG as a quantum channel, whose Kraus representation yields pure conditional trajectories for pure inputs and recovers mixed-state flows upon averaging. We then develop an algebraic extension applicable beyond the usual momentum-space, factorized setting: the low-energy algebra is constructed from the one-particle spectrum, and coarse graining is a conditional expectation onto it. We further construct a resource theory of RG whose free states are fixed points. Under stated assumptions, the resulting relative-entropy monotone is proportional to $c-c_{\rm IR}$ to quadratic order along a single stable RG direction near a two-dimensional IR fixed point. We also introduce a complementary measure of the UV information discarded by coarse graining, establish its monotonicity for successive coarse-graining maps, and discuss its holographic realization.

classification.title_zh: 信息论与代数重整化群
classification.abstract_zh: 重整化群（RG）是从统计力学到量子场论的核心概念，但其方案在场论与多体物理之间差异很大。我们将 Wilsonian RG 表述为一个量子信道，其 Kraus 表示对纯输入给出纯条件轨迹，并在平均后恢复混合态流。随后我们发展一个超越通常动量空间、因子化设定的代数推广：低能代数由单粒子谱构造，粗粒化是到其上的条件期望。我们进一步构造 RG 的资源理论，其自由态为不动点。在所述假设下，所得相对熵单调量沿二维红外不动点附近单一稳定 RG 方向到二次阶正比于 c-c_IR。我们还引入一个互补的度量来刻画粗粒化所丢弃的紫外信息，建立其在连续粗粒化映射下的单调性，并讨论其全息实现。
classification.one_liner: 将 Wilsonian 重整化群表述为量子信道并给出代数推广与资源理论，同时讨论其全息实现。

papers.title: Gauss-Bonnet corrections to Complexity Growth with a Probe String
papers.abstract: We investigate the effect of Gauss-Bonnet (GB) corrections on holographic complexity growth within the framework of the Complexity=Action (CA) conjecture. By introducing a probe string into a GB $AdS$ black brane background, we analyze the time derivative of the Nambu-Goto (NG) action as the holographic dual to complexity growth. Our results indicate that the complexity growth is maximized for a stationary string and is suppressed by its motion. At fixed temperature, the stationary string complexity growth is independent of the GB coupling, whereas that of moving strings is suppressed by stronger GB corrections. Finally, the growth rate is shown to increase linearly with temperature, confirming that higher temperatures systematically drive the complexity growth.

classification.title_zh: 探针弦下复杂度增长的高斯-博内修正
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在复杂度=作用量（CA）猜想框架下，研究Gauss-Bonnet（GB）修正对全息复杂度增长的影响。通过将一根探针弦引入GB AdS黑膜背景，我们分析Nambu-Goto（NG）作用量的时间导数，作为复杂度增长的全息对偶。结果表明，复杂度增长在弦静止时达到最大，并因弦的运动而受到抑制。在固定温度下，静止弦的复杂度增长与GB耦合无关，而运动弦的复杂度增长则被更强的GB修正所抑制。最后，增长率随温度线性增加，证实更高温度会系统性地驱动复杂度增长。
classification.one_liner: 在GB AdS黑膜中用探针弦计算CA猜想下的复杂度增长，发现运动抑制增长、静止时与GB耦合无关且随温度线性增大。

papers.title: Set Transformer inference of the neutron star equation of state from stellar observations
papers.abstract: We develop a permutation-invariant Set Transformer to reconstruct the equation of state (EoS) of dense matter from variable-size, unordered sets of neutron star (NS) observations. The model takes stellar masses together with radii, tidal deformabilities, or both, and predicts either the pressure $P(n)$ or the sound speed $c_s^2(n)$ on a fixed density grid, along with density-dependent uncertainties. Nothing in the architecture prescribes which star informs which density: self-attention couples all observations nonlinearly, and each density point reads the full set through its own learnable query, so the star-to-density mapping is learned from the data. Trained on independent piecewise-polytropic and Gaussian-process EoS ensembles, the model provides well-calibrated predictions whose uncertainty increases in density regions that stable stars cannot probe. Reconstruction errors decrease with the number of observations, while tidal deformability generally improves accuracy at a fixed observation count, even when it carries its own measurement noise. Sensitivity analysis reveals a density-local mapping: in the pressure models, predictions at density $n$ depend most strongly on stars whose central densities are near $n$. We also show that the sensitivity of the model to the inferred stellar compactness provides information on the minimum central density. These results demonstrate that set-based neural inference, in which the star-to-density mapping is learned rather than assumed, can extract physically interpretable EoS information with calibrated uncertainties.

classification.title_zh: 用 Set Transformer 从恒星观测推断中子星状态方程
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种置换不变的 Set Transformer，用于从可变大小、无序的中子星观测集合中重构稠密物质的状态方程。模型输入恒星质量以及半径、潮汐形变率或两者，并预测固定密度网格上的压强 P(n) 或声速 c_s^2(n)，同时给出依赖于密度的不确定度。架构本身不规定哪颗星影响哪个密度：自注意力以非线性方式耦合所有观测，每个密度点通过自己的可学习查询读取整个集合，因此星体到密度的映射由数据学习得到。在独立的分段多变体状态方程集合和高斯过程状态方程集合上训练后，模型给出校准良好的预测，其不确定度在稳定恒星无法探测的密度区域增大。重构误差随观测数目增加而下降，而潮汐形变率在固定观测数下通常提高精度，即使其自身带有测量噪声。敏感性分析揭示了密度局域映射：在压强模型中，密度 n 处的预测最强烈依赖于中心密度接近 n 的恒星。我们还表明，模型对推断出的恒星致密度的敏感性提供了关于最小中心密度的信息。这些结果表明，基于集合的神经推断——其中星体到密度的映射是学习而非假设的——能够提取具有校准不确定度的、物理上可解释的状态方程信息。
classification.one_liner: 用置换不变的 Set Transformer 从中子星质量、半径和潮汐形变率观测中学习星体到密度的映射，并以校准不确定度重构稠密物质状态方程。

papers.title: Superradiant and dynamical spin-down of neutron stars with gravitational wave implications
papers.abstract: Neutron stars such as pulsars and magnetars lose angular momentum primarily through electromagnetic dipole radiation, gravitational waves, $r$-mode oscillation. However, spin variations, particularly enhanced spin-down rates, indicate additional spin-down mechanisms. We propose superradiant spin-down as a potential faster spin-down process. By modelling the interplay between conventional and superradiant spin-down channels, we evaluate their impact on neutron star rotational evolution. We also discuss gravitational-wave emission produced by quadrupole deformation, $r$-mode oscillations, and axion-induced bosonic clouds around an isolated neutron star, highlighting their potential as distinct multi-messenger probes in upcoming detectors.

classification.title_zh: 中子星的超辐射与动力学自转减慢及其引力波意义
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星和磁星等中子星主要通过电磁偶极辐射、引力波、r模式振荡失去角动量。然而，自转变化，尤其是增强的自转减慢率，表明存在额外的自转减慢机制。我们提出超辐射自转减慢作为一种潜在的更快自转减慢过程。通过建模常规与超辐射自转减慢渠道之间的相互作用，我们评估它们对中子星转动演化的影响。我们还讨论由四极形变、r模式振荡以及孤立中子星周围轴子诱导的玻色云产生的引力波辐射，强调它们作为未来探测器中独特多信使探针的潜力。

papers.title: Magnetic Field Configurations in Binary Neutron Star Mergers I: Post-merger Remnant and Disk
papers.abstract: We present a suite of general relativistic magnetohydrodynamic (GRMHD) simulations of binary neutron star (BNS) mergers performed with the code GR-Athena++. We investigate how a different initial magnetic field configuration, nuclear equation of state, or binary mass ratio affects the magnetic and thermodynamic evolution of the post-merger remnant and disk. We also analyze the impact of the commonly-assumed reflection (bitant) symmetry across the equatorial plane. Magnetic field amplification occurs shortly after the merger due to the Kelvin-Helmholtz instability; later, the field keeps evolving with a predominantly toroidal configuration due to winding and turbulence. The initial magnetic field topology leaves an imprint on the field structure and affects magnetic field amplification for the initial magnetic field values commonly assumed in the literature and the limited resolution of the simulations. Enforcing equatorial reflection symmetry partially suppresses the development of turbulence near the equatorial plane and impacts the post-merger magnetic field evolution. Stiffer EOSs produce larger, less compact remnants that may retain memory of the pre-merger strong poloidal field.

classification.title_zh: 双中子星并合中的磁场构型 I：并合后遗迹与盘
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用 GR-Athena++ 代码对双中子星（BNS）并合进行了一套广义相对论磁流体力学（GRMHD）模拟。我们研究了不同的初始磁场构型、核状态方程或双星质量比如何影响并合后遗迹和盘的磁场与热力学演化。我们还分析了通常假设的穿过赤道面的反射（bitant）对称性的影响。磁场放大在并合后不久因开尔文-亥姆霍兹不稳定性而发生；随后，由于缠绕和湍流，磁场继续演化，并呈以环向为主的构型。对于文献中通常假定的初始磁场值和模拟的有限分辨率，初始磁场拓扑会在磁场结构上留下印记，并影响磁场放大。施加赤道反射对称性会部分抑制赤道面附近湍流的发展，并影响并合后的磁场演化。更硬的状态方程产生更大、更不致密的遗迹，其可能保留并合前强极向磁场的记忆。
classification.one_liner: GR-Athena++ 的 GRMHD 模拟表明，初始磁场构型、状态方程、质量比及赤道反射对称性显著影响双中子星并合后遗迹与盘的磁场放大和演化。

papers.title: Discovering $\mu$Hz gravitational waves and ultra-light dark matter with binary resonances
papers.abstract: In the presence of a weak gravitational wave (GW) background, astrophysical binary systems act as high-quality resonators, with efficient transfer of energy and momentum between the orbit and a harmonic GW leading to potentially detectable orbital perturbations. In this work, we develop and apply a novel modeling and analysis framework that describes the imprints of GWs on binary systems in a fully time-resolved manner to study the sensitivity of lunar laser ranging, satellite laser ranging, and pulsar timing to both resonant and nonresonant GW backgrounds. We demonstrate that optimal data collection, modeling, and analysis lead to projected sensitivities which are orders of magnitude better than previously appreciated possible, opening up a new possibility for probing the physics-rich but notoriously challenging to access $\mu\mathrm{Hz}$ frequency GWs. We also discuss improved prospects for the detection of the stochastic fluctuations of ultra-light dark matter, which may analogously perturb the binary orbits.

classification.title_zh: 利用双星共振发现 μHz 引力波与超轻暗物质
classification.abstract_zh: 在弱引力波背景存在时，天体物理双星系统可充当高质量共振器，轨道与某一谐波引力波之间高效的能量和动量转移可导致可能可探测的轨道扰动。本工作开发并应用了一种全新的建模与分析框架，以完全时间分辨的方式描述引力波对双星系统的印记，并研究月球激光测距、卫星激光测距和脉冲星计时对共振与非共振引力波背景的灵敏度。我们证明，优化的数据收集、建模和分析可带来比此前认为可能达到的灵敏度高若干数量级的预期灵敏度，从而为探测物理内容丰富但极难触及的 μHz 频段引力波开辟新可能。我们还讨论了探测超轻暗物质随机涨落的改进前景，其可能类似地扰动双星轨道。
classification.one_liner: 通过将双星系统视为引力波谐振器，并结合月球/卫星激光测距与脉冲星计时，提出可大幅提升 μHz 引力波背景和超轻暗物质涨落探测灵敏度的新框架。

papers.title: A Fast and Scalable Transformer Pipeline for Binary Black Hole Detection
papers.abstract: With the projected increase in the detection rate of compact-binary coalescences in the coming decade, there is critical need to develop fast, robust, and scalable alternatives to matched filtering for gravitational-wave searches. Transformer models have revolutionized natural language and audio processing but their application to gravitational-wave astronomy is still largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce \castor, a transformer-based coincident search pipeline for detecting binary black hole gravitational-wave signals from Advanced LIGO detectors. One of the major features of our model is that it allows the false-alarm rate to be estimated via time slides cheaply without requiring repeated evaluations of the neural network. We evaluate \castor\ on datasets from the Machine-Learning Gravitational-Wave Search Challenge (MLGWSC-1) and on approximately five months of real O3b observing strain. When tested on benchmark datasets, \castor\ ranks among the most sensitive machine-learning pipelines and successfully recovers the majority of confident events from the GWTC-3 catalog that lie within its training range. We also benchmark \castor\ against another transformer architecture, GW-Whisper, a domain-adaptation of OpenAI's audio foundation model. We find that \castor\ substantially outperforms the repurposed audio model in sensitivity and also reduces the computational cost of background estimation by a factor of 20. Our results demonstrate a highly practical, scalable approach for deep-learning gravitational wave searches and empirical background estimation for future observing runs.

classification.title_zh: 用于双黑洞探测的快速可扩展Transformer流水线
classification.abstract_zh: 随着未来十年致密双星并合探测率的预期增长，迫切需要开发快速、鲁棒且可扩展的匹配滤波替代方案用于引力波搜寻。Transformer模型已革新了自然语言和音频处理，但它们在引力波天文学中的应用仍很大程度上未被探索。在这项工作中，我们介绍了CASTOR，一个基于Transformer的符合搜索流水线，用于从Advanced LIGO探测器数据中探测双黑洞引力波信号。我们模型的主要特点之一是允许通过时间滑动廉价地估计虚警率，而无需重复评估神经网络。我们在机器学习引力波搜寻挑战赛（MLGWSC-1）的数据集以及大约五个月的真实O3b观测应变上评估了CASTOR。在基准数据集上测试时，CASTOR跻身最灵敏的机器学习流水线之列，并成功恢复了GWTC-3目录中位于其训练范围内的多数置信事件。我们还将CASTOR与另一种Transformer架构GW-Whisper（OpenAI音频基础模型的领域适应版本）进行了基准比较。我们发现CASTOR在灵敏度上大幅优于该重用的音频模型，并将背景估计的计算成本降低了20倍。我们的结果展示了一种高度实用、可扩展的深度学习方法，用于未来观测轮次的引力波搜寻和经验背景估计。
classification.one_liner: 提出基于Transformer的CASTOR流水线，快速可扩展地检测双黑洞引力波信号，性能优于音频模型GW-Whisper并大幅降低背景估计成本。

papers.title: Accretion Disks in Schwarzschild-MOG and Kerr-MOG Backgrounds: MOG Parameter in terms of Observational Quantities
papers.abstract: We apply a general relativistic framework to static and rotating black hole solutions in Scalar-Tensor-Vector Gravity or modified gravity (MOG). Our results yield exact analytic, closed-form relations expressing the mass $M$, the MOG coupling parameter $\alpha$, and the distance $D$ of a Schwarzschild-MOG black hole in terms of a minimal set of directly measurable elements of the accretion disk: the total frequency shift, the telescope aperture angle, and the redshift rapidity. The resulting expressions are derived for particles close to the midline and line of sight, where the redshift rapidity is treated as a relativistic invariant encoding the evolution of the frequency shift with respect to the emitter's proper time in MOG spacetime. We further extend the formalism to the rotating Kerr-MOG geometry and obtain corresponding relations that determine the rotation parameter $a$ jointly with $M$, $\alpha$, and $D$ on the midline. In the rotating background, we introduced the redshift acceleration (general-relativistic version of jerk) to disentangle the spacetime parameters. Crucially, the explicit appearance of $\alpha$ in these formulas enables direct empirical estimation of this parameter, thereby providing a means to test for departures from standard general relativity. The present study focuses on the geodesic motion of massive test particles revolving around Schwarzschild and Kerr-MOG black holes, and the previous results obtained in the standard Schwarzschild and Kerr backgrounds are recovered in the limit $\alpha \to 0$. The derived expressions are concise and suitable for incorporation into black hole parameter-estimation pipelines.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild-MOG 与 Kerr-MOG 背景中的吸积盘：以观测量表示 MOG 参数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将广义相对论框架应用于标量-张量-矢量引力（或修改引力，MOG）中的静态和旋转黑洞解。结果给出精确的闭式解析关系，用吸积盘的一组最小可直接测量量——总频率移动、望远镜孔径角和红移迅度——表示 Schwarzschild-MOG 黑洞的质量 M、MOG 耦合参数 α 和距离 D。这些表达式在靠近中线和视线方向的粒子情形下导出，其中红移迅度被视为一种相对论不变量，编码 MOG 时空中频率移动随发射者固有时的演化。我们进一步把形式推广到旋转 Kerr-MOG 几何，并得到在中线上联合确定转动参数 a 与 M、α、D 的相应关系。在旋转背景中，我们引入红移加速度（jerk 的广义相对论版本）以分离时空参数。关键的是，α 在这些公式中显式出现，使得可以直接对该参数进行经验估计，从而提供检验对标准广义相对论偏离的手段。本研究聚焦于绕 Schwarzschild 和 Kerr-MOG 黑洞运动的巨大测试粒子的测地线运动，并且在 α→0 极限下恢复此前在标准 Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 背景中得到的结果。所得表达式简洁，适合纳入黑洞参数估计流程。
classification.one_liner: 在 Schwarzschild-MOG 与 Kerr-MOG 吸积盘模型中，用总频率移动、望远镜孔径角和红移迅度等观测量解析反解出黑洞质量、MOG 参数与距离。

papers.title: High post-Minkowskian gravitational waveform for hyperbolic encounters in the extreme-mass-ratio limit
papers.abstract: The frequency-domain waveform emitted by a two-body scattering process is computed in the extreme-mass-ratio limit through the fifth post-Minkowskian (PM) order (i.e., $O(G^5)$) and the fractional sixth post-Newtonian (PN) order. The current accuracy of the scattering waveform obtained by quantum amplitude methods is the one-loop level corresponding to the 3PM order, whereas the 4PM waveform is known up to the 2PN order only as derived within the traditional multipolar-post-Minkowskian formalism. Direct comparison between these waveforms to the first order in the mass ratio shows that they differ at most by the effect of an angular-independent time shift, leading to a complete physical agreement at the same level of accuracy. The new results at the 4PM and 5PM orders thus provide a benchmark for future multiloop calculations. The waveform is also used to obtain the radiated energy at $O(G^6)$, extending it from 3PN to 6PN level.

classification.title_zh: 极端质量比极限下双曲遭遇的高阶后闵可夫斯基引力波形
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在极端质量比极限下，通过第五后闵可夫斯基（PM）阶（即 O(G^5)）和分数六阶后牛顿（PN）阶，计算了双体散射过程发射的频率域波形。目前由量子振幅方法得到的散射波形精度为一圈水平，对应 3PM 阶；而 4PM 波形仅在传统多极-后闵可夫斯基形式体系中已知到 2PN 阶。将这些波形在质量比一阶处直接比较表明，它们至多相差一个与角度无关的时间平移效应，从而在同一精度水平上完全物理一致。4PM 和 5PM 阶的新结果因此为未来多圈计算提供了基准。该波形还被用于获得 O(G^6) 阶的辐射能量，将其从 3PN 阶推广到 6PN 阶。
classification.one_liner: 在极端质量比极限下计算了双体双曲散射的频率域引力波形至 5PM 阶，并与量子振幅方法结果比较，为未来多圈计算提供基准。

papers.title: Testing a cosmological teleparallel modified f(T) model with parametric H(z)
papers.abstract: We study the late-time cosmological expansion of a modified teleparallel gravity model. This modified gravitational lagrangian yields a cosmological constant term along with power-law corrections to the Teleparallel Equivalent of General Relativity (TEGR) for small $\lambda$. By combining observational data from cosmic chronometers, Type Ia supernovae from the Pantheon+ dataset, and Baryon Acoustic Oscillations (BAO) from DESI DR2, we constrain the parameters of the modified gravitational dynamics assuming a quadratically parameterized Hubble rate $H(z)$. The joint observational fit indicates a late-time accelerated expansion with a deceleration parameter of $q_0 = -0.388_{-0.038}^{+0.038}$. Furthermore, we analyze the effective energy density, pressure, and equation-of-state parameter $\omega$, showing that this modified gravity theory naturally accommodates quintessence-like and phantom-like behavior. Finally, a linear scalar perturbation analysis confirms that the cosmological background is dynamically stable against homogeneous fluctuations.

classification.title_zh: 用参数化 H(z) 检验一个宇宙学远平行修改 f(T) 模型
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了修改远平行引力模型的晚期宇宙膨胀。该修改引力拉格朗日量在 TEGR 基础上给出宇宙学常数项以及小 λ 时的幂律修正。结合宇宙计时器、Pantheon+ 数据集的 Ia 型超新星和 DESI DR2 的 BAO 观测数据，我们在假设哈勃率按二次参数化 H(z) 的情况下约束修改引力动力学参数。联合观测拟合表明晚期加速膨胀，减速参数为 q0 = -0.388_{-0.038}^{+0.038}。此外，我们分析了有效能量密度、压强和状态方程参数 ω，表明该修改引力理论自然容纳类精质与类幽灵行为。最后，线性标量扰动分析确认宇宙学背景对均匀涨落动力学稳定。
classification.one_liner: 用宇宙学观测约束 f(T) 远平行修改引力模型，发现晚期加速膨胀并分析背景稳定性。

papers.title: Prospects for gravitational wave and ultra-light dark matter detection with binary resonances beyond the secular approximation
papers.abstract: Precision observations of orbital systems have recently emerged as a promising new means of detecting gravitational waves and ultra-light dark matter, offering sensitivity in new regimes with significant discovery potential. These searches rely critically on precise modeling of the dynamical effects of these signals on the observed system; however, previous analyses have mainly only relied on the secularly-averaged part of the response. We introduce here a fundamentally different approach that allows for a fully time-resolved description of the effects of oscillatory metric perturbations on orbital dynamics. We find that gravitational waves and ultra-light dark matter can induce large oscillations in the orbital parameters of realistic binaries, enhancing the sensitivity to such signals by orders of magnitude compared to previous estimates.

classification.title_zh: 超越久期近似下双星共振对引力波和超轻暗物质探测的前景
classification.abstract_zh: 对轨道系统的精密观测最近成为探测引力波和超轻暗物质的一种有前景的新手段，在具有重大发现潜力的新区域提供灵敏度。这些搜寻关键依赖于对这些信号对观测系统动力学效应的精确建模；然而，此前的分析主要仅依赖于响应的久期平均部分。我们在此引入一种根本不同的方法，可以全时间分辨地描述振荡度规扰动对轨道动力学的影响。我们发现，引力波和超轻暗物质可以在现实双星的轨道参数中诱导大幅振荡，与此前估计相比将对此类信号的灵敏度提高若干数量级。
classification.one_liner: 提出全时间分辨的轨道动力学方法，利用双星共振大幅提升对引力波和超轻暗物质的探测灵敏度。

papers.title: Comparison of 4.5PN and 2SF gravitational energy fluxes from quasicircular compact binaries
papers.abstract: Recent years have seen significant advances in models of gravitational waveforms emitted by quasicircular compact binaries in two regimes: the weak-field, post-Newtonian regime, in which the gravitational wave energy flux has now been calculated to fourth-and-a-half post-Newtonian order (4.5PN) [Phys. Rev. Lett. 131}, 121402 (2023)]; and the small-mass-ratio, gravitational self-force regime, in which the flux has now been calculated to second perturbative order in the mass ratio (2SF) [Phys. Rev. Lett. 127, 151102 (2021)]. We compare these results and find evidence of mutual consistency between the two (very distinct though both first-principle) perturbative calculations.

classification.title_zh: 准圆致密双星产生的4.5PN与2SF引力能量通量比较
classification.abstract_zh: 近年来，准圆致密双星发出的引力波波形模型在两个区域取得了显著进展：弱场后牛顿区域，其中引力波能量通量现已计算到四阶半后牛顿阶（4.5PN）[Phys. Rev. Lett. 131, 121402 (2023)]；以及小质量比、引力自力区域，其中通量现已计算到质量比的第二微扰阶（2SF）[Phys. Rev. Lett. 127, 151102 (2021)]。我们比较这些结果，并发现两个（非常不同但均为第一性原理的）微扰计算之间存在相互一致性的证据。
classification.one_liner: 比较4.5PN与2SF引力能量通量，发现两种独立的微扰计算相互一致。

papers.title: Black Holes and Scalar Propagation in Three-Dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet Gravity
papers.abstract: We derive an analytic black-hole family in three-dimensional scalar--tensor Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity with positive coupling. A single implicit equation determines the static circular metric and a scalar linear in time. We show that these solutions exhaust regular nonextremal exteriors with the stated AdS boundary conditions and a fixed nonzero coefficient of time in the scalar. The coupled metric and scalar perturbations have one propagating degree of freedom. On one branch, its kinetic coefficient is positive, its equation is hyperbolic throughout the exterior, and its bulk spatial energy is positive for perturbations of compact support. Scalar signals can cross the metric horizon outward, so exterior evolution needs information from the interior. For linear perturbations with the original metric and scalar boundary values fixed, nonzero compact initial master displacements with zero velocity can evolve only until their first contact with the AdS boundary. We derive this restriction from the original metric and scalar equations.

classification.title_zh: 三维 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中的黑洞与标量传播
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在具有正耦合的三维标量-张量 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中导出一族解析黑洞解。单个隐式方程决定了静态圆对称度规以及一个随时间线性变化的标量。我们表明，在给定的 AdS 边界条件以及标量中时间项系数固定非零的情况下，这些解穷尽了正则非极端外部解。耦合的度规与标量扰动只有一个传播自由度。在其中一个分支上，其动能系数为正，其方程在整个外部区域是双曲型的，并且对于紧支撑扰动，其体空间能量为正。标量信号可以向外穿过度规视界，因此外部演化需要来自内部的信息。对于固定原始度规和标量边界值的线性扰动，非零紧支撑初始主位移且零速度只能在首次接触 AdS 边界之前演化。我们从原始度规和标量方程导出这一限制。
classification.one_liner: 在三维标量-张量 EGB 引力中构造 AdS 黑洞解，并分析标量传播、扰动双曲性以及视界与 AdS 边界带来的因果限制。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要直接研究三维标量-张量 Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet 引力中的黑洞解、标量/度规线性扰动、双曲性以及视界和 AdS 边界因果限制，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；摘要未提及 AdS/CFT 对偶或全息计算，因此不判定为全息理论工作。

papers.title: Zero Temperature, Degenerate Fermion Stars
papers.abstract: We study a zero temperature, degenerate, fermion gas with fermions of rest mass $m$, that only interacts with itself, gravitationally. We describe a self-consistent novel approach to the formation of a degenerate, quantum mechanical, star. In this approach, the fermions occupy the energy levels that are determined by the self consistent gravitational interactions, according to the Pauli exclusion principle. Then the size of the highest occupied level determines the radius of the star. In the Newtonian gravitational limit, the fermions feel a potential corresponding to a simple harmonic well that smoothly attaches in the exterior to the usual $1/r$ Newtonian gravitational potential. We find analytically, solutions for stars with any radius and mass, parametrized by $m$ and $N_s$, the total number of fermions. In the Newtonian limit, we easily find that we can construct a star that is more compact than the Buchdahl bound and indeed can even be smaller than the Schwarzschild radius. Clearly, such cases are outside of the purview of the Newtonian limit. Therefore we expand our analysis to fermions in the general relativistic context, interacting gravitationally with a metric. We consider the metric corresponding to the interior Schwarzschild solution smoothly connecting to the usual exterior Schwarzschild metric. Treating matter semi-classically, we recover the Buchdahl bound in a completely independent analysis. We briefly discuss classical stability of the Newtonian solution, and its relation to Newtonian polytropic fluids.

classification.title_zh: 零温、简并费米子星
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究零温、简并的费米气体，费米子静质量为 m，且仅通过引力相互作用。我们描述一种自洽的新方法来处理简并量子力学星的形成。在此方法中，费米子根据泡利不相容原理占据由自洽引力相互作用决定的能级；最高占据能级的大小决定星体半径。在牛顿引力极限下，费米子感受到对应简谐振子势的势，并在外部平滑连接到通常的 1/r 牛顿引力势。我们解析地找到任意半径和质量星体的解，由 m 和费米子总数 N_s 参数化。在牛顿极限下，我们容易发现可以构造比 Buchdahl 界限更致密、甚至小于 Schwarzschild 半径的星。显然，这些情形超出牛顿极限范围。因此我们将分析推广到广义相对论背景中与度规引力相互作用的费米子。我们考虑内部 Schwarzschild 解对应的度规平滑连接到通常外部 Schwarzschild 度规。对物质作半经典处理，我们以完全独立的分析重新得到 Buchdahl 界限。我们简要讨论牛顿解的经典稳定性及其与牛顿多方流体的关系。
classification.one_liner: 在牛顿与广义相对论框架下，用自洽能级方法研究零温简并费米星的半径、质量及 Buchdahl 界限。

papers.title: Mannheim--Kazanas Black Holes: Horizons, Temperatures and Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: Static black holes in conformal Weyl gravity differ from their Einstein counterparts in a simple but important way: the Mannheim--Kazanas geometry is encoded in a Bach-flat lapse function whose radial dependence is richer than that of Schwarzschild--de Sitter. We study the de Sitter branch of this solution in the Schwarzschild gauge, keeping the characteristic linear term together with the quadratic de Sitter term. In the branch continuously connected to the positive-mass Schwarzschild--de Sitter spacetime, a regular static region between a black-hole horizon and a cosmological horizon exists precisely when \[ -\frac{1}{3}<\beta\gamma<\frac{2}{3}, \qquad 0<\kappa<\frac{1+3\beta\gamma}{27\beta^{2}}. \] In this window the singularity at the origin is hidden, the two positive horizons obey $0<r_b<3\beta<r_c$, and the limiting endpoint is the Nariai geometry. The thermodynamic interpretation is subtler than the root structure: the two horizons generally have different temperatures, and the static patch has no asymptotic region that would select a unique normalization of time. We therefore compare the Killing, Bousso--Hawking normalized, Tolman local, and effective two-horizon temperature conventions, and we compute the corresponding Wald entropy for the pure Weyl-squared action. The result is a local horizon thermodynamic description that keeps the geometric facts separate from the ensemble-dependent choices needed for any global first law.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: Mannheim–Kazanas 黑洞：视界、温度与热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 共形 Weyl 引力中的静态黑洞与 Einstein 对应物在一个简单但重要的方面不同：Mannheim–Kazanas 几何由一个 Bach 平坦的 lapse 函数编码，其径向依赖比 Schwarzschild–de Sitter 更丰富。我们在 Schwarzschild 规范下研究该解的 de Sitter 分支，保留特征线性项以及二次 de Sitter 项。在与正质量 Schwarzschild–de Sitter 时空连续相连的分支中，黑洞视界与宇宙学视界之间存在规则静态区域，当且仅当 -1/3 < βγ < 2/3 且 0 < κ < (1+3βγ)/(27β²)。在此窗口内，原点奇点被隐藏，两个正视界满足 0<r_b<3β<r_c，极限端点是 Nariai 几何。热力学解释比根结构更微妙：两个视界通常具有不同温度，且静态片区没有可选择唯一时间归一化的渐近区域。因此我们比较 Killing、Bousso–Hawking 归一化、Tolman 局域以及有效双视界温度约定，并计算纯 Weyl 平方作用对应的 Wald 熵。结果是一种局域视界热力学描述，它将几何事实与任何全局第一定律所需的系综依赖选择区分开。
classification.one_liner: 研究 Mannheim–Kazanas 共形 Weyl 引力黑洞 de Sitter 分支的视界存在条件、不同温度约定与 Wald 熵，强调局域热力学和全局第一定律的系综依赖。

papers.title: Boltzmann Dynamics in K-essence Cosmology: Photon Propagation in an Emergent Spacetime
papers.abstract: Recent cosmological tensions, notably the Hubble and $S_{8}$ tensions, motivate extensions of the conventional FLRW framework in which additional dynamical fields can alter the effective spacetime experienced by matter and radiation. In K-essence cosmology, the scalar field induces an emergent FLRW geometry disformally related to the gravitational metric, leading to a \emph{tilted causal structure} in which the photon light cone differs from that of gravity. We develop a covariant Boltzmann formalism in a homogeneous K-essence background and derive the modified mass-shell condition, geodesic equations, and collision integrals for both massless and massive species. The photon distribution remains thermal in the emergent frame, while appearing geometrically rescaled in the gravitational frame. Microphysical Thomson/Compton scattering is unmodified; instead, the emergent geometry induces effective rest-frame energies and a geometrically rescaled scattering rate, conveniently encoded in a transport coefficient $\sigma_T^{(\mathrm{geom})}$. Focusing on the tightly coupled pre-recombination era, we obtain modified acoustic dynamics and, for a purely kinetic DBI-type model, find an effective interaction rate scaling $n_{e}\sigma_T^{(\mathrm{geom})}a\propto a^{-8}$ and a diffusion scale scaling $k_{D}^{-2}\propto a^{29/2}$, enhancing the sensitivity of small-scale anisotropies to the evolving geometry. Our results provide a self-consistent kinetic description of particle transport in the emergent K-essence spacetime, and they lay the groundwork for a full numerical Einstein-Boltzmann implementation to compute post-recombination free streaming and the CMB angular power spectrum. A detailed numerical analysis will be pursued in future work.

classification.title_zh: K-essence 宇宙学中的 Boltzmann 动力学：涌现时空中的光子传播
classification.abstract_zh: 近期宇宙学张力，尤其是 Hubble 和 S8 张力，促使人们扩展传统 FLRW 框架，其中额外动力学场可以改变物质和辐射感受到的有效时空。在 K-essence 宇宙学中，标量场诱导出一个涌现 FLRW 几何，它与引力度规通过 disformal 关系相联系，导致倾斜的因果结构，其中光子光锥不同于引力光锥。我们发展了均匀 K-essence 背景中的协变 Boltzmann 形式体系，推导了无质量和有质量粒子的修正质壳条件、测地线方程和碰撞积分。光子分布在涌现标架中保持热性，而在引力标架中表现为几何重标度。微观 Thomson/Compton 散射未被修改；相反，涌现几何诱导有效静止系能量和几何重标度的散射率，方便地编码在输运系数 σ_T^(geom) 中。聚焦于紧耦合的复合前时期，我们得到修改的声学动力学，并且对于纯动能 DBI 型模型，发现有效相互作用率标度 n_e σ_T^(geom) a ∝ a^{-8}，扩散尺度标度 k_D^{-2} ∝ a^{29/2}，增强了小尺度各向异性对演化几何的敏感性。我们的结果为涌现 K-essence 时空中的粒子输运提供了自洽的动理学描述，并为完整的数值 Einstein-Boltzmann 实现以计算复合后自由流和 CMB 角功率谱奠定基础。详细数值分析将在未来工作中进行。
classification.one_liner: 在 K-essence 涌现时空中建立协变 Boltzmann 形式体系，推导修正的光子质壳、测地线与散射率，并给出 CMB 声学/扩散标度。

papers.title: Cosmological Variation of Proton-to-Electron Mass Ratio in a Chameleon-Brans-Dicke Theory
papers.abstract: We investigate the cosmological variation of the proton-to-electron mass ratio, $\mu=m_p/m_e$, within a generalized Brans-Dicke framework with two scalar fields : a geometric scalar field governing the effective gravitational coupling and a matter field whose effective potential has a Higgs-like symmetry-breaking structure. We consider a cosmological background described by a Pad\'e-deformed $\Lambda$CDM and constrain it using a combination of late-time cosmological observational data-sets. We use the resulting expansion history to reconstruct the scalar-field and the matter-sector vacuum expectation value. We calculate the induced variation of $\mu$ and compare it with observational constraints from quasar absorption spectra. We find that a standard Brans-Dicke model with a minimally coupled Higgs-like field produces an unphysical variation of $\mu$. Only after introducing a chameleon-like coupling between the Brans-Dicke scalar and the baryonic matter, we find that the resulting variation is well-suppressed and satisfies the observational bounds.

classification.title_zh: Chameleon-Brans-Dicke 理论中质子-电子质量比的宇宙学变化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在一个具有两个标量场的广义 Brans-Dicke 框架中研究质子-电子质量比 μ=m_p/m_e 的宇宙学变化：一个几何标量场控制有效引力耦合，另一个物质场具有类希格斯对称破缺结构的有效势。我们考虑由 Padé 形变 ΛCDM 描述的宇宙学背景，并使用晚期宇宙观测数据集组合对其进行限制。我们利用得到的膨胀历史重构标量场和物质部门的真空期望值。我们计算由此诱导的 μ 变化，并与类星体吸收光谱的观测限制比较。我们发现，具有最小耦合类希格斯场的标准 Brans-Dicke 模型会产生非物理的 μ 变化。只有在引入 Brans-Dicke 标量与重子物质之间的 chameleon 类耦合后，我们发现所导致的变化被良好压低并满足观测边界。
classification.one_liner: 在双标量场 Brans-Dicke 宇宙学中引入 chameleon 耦合可压低质子-电子质量比的演化，使其满足类星体吸收光谱限制。
