papers.title: Central charge and black hole entropy for regular extremal black-bounce spacetimes
papers.abstract: The Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, proportional to one quarter of the horizon area, is fundamental in black hole thermodynamics and can also be understood via the AdS/CFT correspondence, such as the 3D BTZ black hole and 2D CFT. In this work, we adopt the Kerr/CFT approach to analyze the central charge and black hole entropy for regular extremal black-bounce spacetimes, including the counterparts of the Kerr, Kerr-Newman, and Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes. These spacetimes are free of curvature singularities at $r=0$. We derive the near horizon geometries of these spacetimes and find that they exhibit enhanced symmetry, namely SL$(2,\mathbb{R})\times \mathrm{U}(1)$ or SL$(2,\mathbb{R}) \times \mathrm{SO}(3)$. By imposing appropriate boundary conditions, we analyze their asymptotic symmetry groups, which contain diffeomorphisms as well as the $\mathrm{U}(1)_{\rm gauge}$ symmetry arising from the electromagnetic field. We then extract the central charge from the charge algebra and evaluate the left-moving temperature of the Frolov-Thorne vacuum. It is worth emphasizing that in the black-bounce Kerr-Newman case, the central charge from the electromagnetic contribution vanishes. Furthermore, in the black-bounce Reissner-Nordstr\"om case, we uplift the 4D geometry to a 5D configuration by incorporating a $\mathrm{U}(1)$ gauge fiber. Our results show that the microscopic entropy calculated from the Cardy formula is consistent with the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy. This agreement suggests that the Kerr/CFT approach remains valid for certain regular spacetimes without curvature singularities, thereby providing a microscopic statistical understanding of black hole entropy.

classification.title_zh: 正则极端 black-bounce 时空的中心荷与黑洞熵
classification.abstract_zh: Bekenstein-Hawking 熵正比于视界面积的四分之一，是黑洞热力学的基本内容，也可以通过 AdS/CFT 对应来理解，例如三维 BTZ 黑洞与二维 CFT。本文采用 Kerr/CFT 方法分析正则极端 black-bounce 时空的中心荷与黑洞熵，包括 Kerr、Kerr-Newman 和 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞的对应体。这些时空在 r=0 处没有曲率奇点。我们推导了这些时空的近视界几何，发现它们具有增强对称性，即 SL(2,R)×U(1) 或 SL(2,R)×SO(3)。通过施加适当边界条件，我们分析了其渐近对称群，其中包含微分同胚以及电磁场产生的 U(1)_gauge 对称性。随后我们从电荷代数中提取中心荷，并计算 Frolov-Thorne 真空的左行温度。值得强调的是，在 black-bounce Kerr-Newman 情形中，电磁贡献的中心荷为零。此外，在 black-bounce Reissner-Nordström 情形中，我们通过引入 U(1) 规范纤维将四维几何提升为五维组态。结果表明，由 Cardy 公式计算的微观熵与 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵一致。这一一致性表明 Kerr/CFT 方法对某些无曲率奇点的正则时空仍然有效，从而为黑洞熵提供了微观统计理解。
classification.one_liner: 用 Kerr/CFT 方法计算正则极端 black-bounce 时空的中心荷，并发现 Cardy 微观熵与 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于黑洞熵与 Kerr/CFT 全息计算，并涉及正则/black-bounce 经典时空；与所列全息凝聚态、相变气泡、QNM、探针膜等具体重点标签不直接重合，若关注黑洞全息或经典引力则有一定相关性。

papers.title: Boundary duals of bulk detectors
papers.abstract: What is the boundary dual of an Unruh-DeWitt detector in anti-de Sitter space? We argue that this question is naturally answered by the HKLL reconstruction program. A local detector in the bulk can be associated with a smeared detector in the boundary, where the choice of smearing depends on the choice of HKLL kernel. We use this formalism to analyze entanglement harvesting in the Poincar\'e patch of AdS$_{3}$ for a bulk Unruh-DeWitt detector paired either with a boundary detector or with a second bulk detector. We compute the amount of harvesting in the standard way, namely by evaluating the two-detector density matrix to quadratic order in the coupling $\lambda$. Additionally, we address an apparent tension between microcausality for spacelike-separated bulk detectors and the fact that the dual HKLL detectors may directly overlap in the boundary theory.

classification.title_zh: 体探测器的边界对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 反德西特空间中 Unruh-DeWitt 探测器的边界对偶是什么？我们认为这个问题可由 HKLL 重构纲领自然回答。体中的局域探测器可以联系到边界上的涂抹探测器，其中涂抹的选择取决于 HKLL 核的选择。我们使用该形式体系分析 AdS3 庞加莱片中一个体 Unruh-DeWitt 探测器与一个边界探测器或第二个体探测器配对时的纠缠收获。我们以标准方式计算收获量，即在耦合 λ 的二阶评估双探测器密度矩阵。此外，我们讨论空间分离的体探测器的微观因果性与对偶 HKLL 探测器可能在边界理论中直接重叠这一事实之间的表面张力。
classification.one_liner: 利用 HKLL 重构将体 Unruh-DeWitt 探测器映射为边界涂抹探测器，并分析 AdS3 中的纠缠收获及微观因果性张力。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接属于 AdS/CFT 与量子信息交叉，讨论 HKLL 字典和纠缠收获；但不属于用户列出的特定研究支线（如全息超导、QNM、经典引力等）。

papers.title: Alternative Boundary Conditions in Asymptotically Anti-de Sitter Spacetimes
papers.abstract: Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes are not globally hyperbolic, so boundary conditions are generally needed for well-defined dynamics. Ishibashi and Wald (IW) determined boundary conditions yielding well-posed dynamics with conserved positive energy for scalar, electromagnetic, and linearized gravitational fields, using nonlocal potentials and individual spherical harmonic modes. In this paper, we determine which IW conditions are local in the primary fields and which are AdS-invariant. In four spacetime dimensions, the standard AdS-invariant boundary conditions set the rescaled magnetic field to zero for electromagnetism and the rescaled magnetic Weyl tensor to zero for Einstein gravity on the conformal boundary. We generalize these standard boundary conditions by setting arbitrary linear combinations of the electric and magnetic fields, or the corresponding Weyl tensors, to zero, and we conjecture that these exhaust the local, AdS-invariant, conservative boundary conditions in AdS$_{1,3}$. Boundary conditions with non-AdS-invariance and in different spacetime dimensions are also studied. The AdS-invariant conditions in AdS$_{1,3}$ extend to Yang-Mills theory and nonlinear gravity in a general Fefferman-Graham setting. We construct phase spaces for these general boundary conditions. The covariant phase spaces for general conditions are naturally associated with Lagrangians containing Pontryagin terms and, in gravity, a Gauss-Bonnet term. In gravity, except for the standard boundary condition, no nontrivial asymptotic symmetries exist and all conserved charges such as ADM mass vanish identically, as in a closed universe. Spacetimes with Killing fields including AdS then exhibit linearization instability in the sense of Fischer and Marsden and Moncrief. For nonstandard boundary conditions, the modified symplectic structure yields new expressions for the entropy formula of black holes.

classification.title_zh: 渐近反德西特时空中的替代边界条件
classification.abstract_zh: 反德西特（AdS）时空不是全局双曲的，因此通常需要边界条件才能定义良好的动力学。Ishibashi 和 Wald (IW) 在标量场、电磁场和线性化引力场中确定了能够给出适定动力学且具有守恒正能量的边界条件，其方法是使用非局域势和各个球谐模。本文确定哪些 IW 条件在基本场中是局域的，哪些是 AdS 不变的。在四维时空中，标准 AdS 不变边界条件在共形边界上对电磁场令重标磁感应强度为零，对爱因斯坦引力令重标磁 Weyl 张量为零。我们通过令电场与磁场的任意线性组合，或相应的 Weyl 张量，为零来推广这些标准边界条件，并猜想这些条件穷尽了 AdS_{1,3} 中局域、AdS 不变且保守的边界条件。还研究了非 AdS 不变以及不同时空维数下的边界条件。AdS_{1,3} 中的 AdS 不变条件可以在一般 Fefferman-Graham 框架下推广到 Yang-Mills 理论和非线性引力。我们为这些一般边界条件构造相空间。一般条件的协变相空间自然地与包含 Pontryagin 项的拉格朗日量相关，在引力中还包含 Gauss-Bonnet 项。在引力中，除标准边界条件外，不存在非平凡渐近对称性，并且所有守恒荷（如 ADM 质量）都恒为零，如同闭合宇宙。带有包括 AdS 在内的 Killing 场的时空随后表现出 Fischer、Marsden 和 Moncrief 意义下的线性化不稳定性。对于非标准边界条件，修改后的辛结构给出了黑洞熵公式的新表达式。
classification.one_liner: 本文分类并推广渐近 AdS 时空中的局部、AdS 不变保守边界条件，构造相应相空间，并发现非标准条件下守恒荷消失、线性化不稳定及新黑洞熵公式。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究渐近 AdS 时空中的经典引力与场论边界条件、相空间、守恒荷和黑洞熵，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；摘要未明确涉及全息对偶或 CFT 计算。

papers.title: Carroll-Cotton Tensors and Gravitational Radiation at Null Infinity
papers.abstract: We provide a first-principles definition of Cotton tensors on conformal Carroll geometries by gauging the conformal Carroll algebra. On the mathematical side, this analysis yields a conformally covariant object designed to quantify deviations from conformal flatness in Carrollian geometries. On the physical side, it offers a powerful geometric tool to describe gravitational radiative degrees of freedom at the conformal boundary of four-dimensional asymptotically flat spacetimes. Unlike the Bondi news, whose fully-covariant definition requires amendment by supplementary data that we identify with the Geroch tensor, the Carroll--Cotton tensors offer the natural geometric objects to quantify deviations from stationarity due to the emission of gravitational waves.

classification.title_zh: Carroll-Cotton 张量与零无穷远处的引力辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过规范共形 Carroll 代数，从第一性原理给出了共形 Carroll 几何上 Cotton 张量的定义。在数学方面，这一分析给出了一个共形协变对象，用于量化 Carroll 几何偏离共形平坦的程度。在物理方面，它提供了一个有力的几何工具，用于描述四维渐近平直时空共形边界上的引力辐射自由度。与 Bondi news 不同——其完全协变的定义需要由补充数据修正，我们将其识别为 Geroch 张量——Carroll-Cotton 张量为量化由于引力波发射而偏离稳态的情形提供了自然的几何对象。
classification.one_liner: 通过规范共形 Carroll 代数定义 Carroll-Cotton 张量，为渐近平直时空零无穷远处的引力辐射提供几何描述。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论与平直时空/Carroll 渐近结构，涉及零无穷远的引力辐射，但不涉及全息对偶或用户列出的凝聚态/QCD/超流等全息支线。

papers.title: de Sitter extremal surfaces, time contours, complexifications and pseudo-entropies
papers.abstract: We study no-boundary de Sitter extremal surfaces and their pseudo-entropy areas for generic subregions at the future boundary, building on previous work. For large subregions, timelike+Euclidean extremal surfaces exist with transparent geometric interpretations, as do complex ones. The situation for small subregions is analogous to Poincare $dS$ and only complex extremal surfaces exist. In general, the extremal surface area integrals are defined via time contours in the complex time plane. We find multiple extremal surfaces with indistinguishable areas whose time contours can be deformed into each other in the complex time plane without obstruction, which are equivalent for these purposes. This also suggests equivalences between complex $dS$ replica geometries. We discuss $dS_3$ as a simple example at length. This suggests a picture for multiple subregions and entropy inequalities in de Sitter, as encoding $AdS$ ones via analytic continuation. We also discuss mapping future boundary subregions and those on constant time slices in the static patch via lightrays.

classification.title_zh: 德西特极值曲面、时间围道、复化与伪熵
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究无边界 de Sitter 极值曲面及其对未来边界上一般子区域的伪熵面积，工作基于此前结果。对于大子区域，存在具有清晰几何解释的类时+欧几里得极值曲面，也存在复极值曲面。小子区域情形类似于 Poincare dS，只存在复极值曲面。一般而言，极值曲面面积积分由复时间平面中的时间围道定义。我们发现多个极值曲面具有不可区分的面积，其时间围道可在复时间平面中无阻碍地形变到彼此，在这些目的下等价。这也暗示复 dS 副本几何之间的等价性。我们详细讨论 dS3 作为简单例子。这为 de Sitter 中多个子区域和熵不等式提供了一幅图景，即通过解析延拓编码 AdS 的相应内容。我们还通过光线讨论未来边界子区域与静态补丁中常时切片子区域的映射。
classification.one_liner: 该文用复时间围道与极值曲面研究 de Sitter 未来边界子区域的伪熵，并讨论其与 AdS 熵不等式的解析延拓联系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 dS 全息、极值曲面与伪熵方向，与用户列出的全息超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、QNM、探针膜与 Floquet 驱动等具体重点标签无直接重合。

papers.title: Scalar, vector and tensor fields on $dS_3$ with arbitrary sources: harmonic analysis and antipodal maps
papers.abstract: The scalar, vector and tensor spherical harmonics on three-dimensional de Sitter spacetime are defined and analyzed. Each harmonic defines two sets of asymptotic data on the two-sphere in the asymptotic expansion close to both the past and the future of de Sitter spacetime. For each case, we make explicit the antipodal relationship of both sets of asymptotic data between past and future infinity, which can be non-local. A procedure is defined to extract these asymptotic data in the presence of sources. This provides for each class of propagating field on de Sitter the relationship between two independent sets of data defined on the sphere in the asymptotic future with the corresponding data defined in the asymptotic past. We also provide several theorems on the decomposition of vectors and tensors on de Sitter such as one proving that a large class of tensors obeying an inhomogeneous wave equation can be expressed locally in terms of a symmetric transverse traceless tensor. These results are instrumental in the description of interacting four-dimensional asymptotically flat fields at spatial infinity.

classification.title_zh: 三维 de Sitter 上带任意源的标量、矢量与张量场：调和分析与对跖映射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们定义并分析了三维 de Sitter 时空上的标量、矢量与张量球谐函数。每个谐函数在 de Sitter 时空过去和未来附近的渐近展开中，于二维球面上定义两组渐近数据。对每种情形，我们明确了过去与未来无穷远之间两组渐近数据的对跖关系，这种关系可以是非局域的。我们定义了一套在存在源时提取这些渐近数据的程序。由此，对 de Sitter 上每一类传播场，给出了渐近未来球面上两组独立数据与渐近过去相应数据之间的关系。我们还给出了若干关于 de Sitter 上矢量与张量分解的定理，例如证明一大类满足非齐次波动方程的张量可以局部地由一个对称横向无迹张量表示。这些结果有助于描述空间无穷远处相互作用的四维渐近平坦场。
classification.one_liner: 本文建立了 dS3 上标量、矢量与张量球谐函数及带源渐近数据的对跖关系，为 dS 与平直空间无穷远处的全息式描述提供工具。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 dS/天球/平直时空/BMS-Carroll 方向，讨论 dS 渐近数据与对跖映射，可能服务于 dS/CFT 与天球全息；但摘要未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM、相变或冷原子等支线。

papers.title: Solutions to the Ricci Flow via Einstein Field Equations
papers.abstract: We investigate the relation between stress-tensor deformations of matter theories coupled to gravity and the Ricci flow. We identify the quadratic stress-tensor deformation whose associated metric evolution, on solutions of the Einstein equations, coincides with the Ricci-flow vector field. We show that this pointwise identification does not in general extend to finite deformation parameter: the coupled evolution of the metric and stress tensor must additionally preserve the Einstein equations. We formulate this requirement as the invariance of the Einstein constraint surface and derive the corresponding geometric compatibility condition. We illustrate the resulting obstruction with simple examples and exhibit the Bertotti-Robinson/Born-Infeld flow as a nontrivial sector in which the correspondence is exact. Finally, we introduce an Einstein-compatible completion of the deformation which leaves its associated evolution of the metric unchanged while modifying the stress-tensor evolution so that the Einstein constraint surface is invariant by construction. The completed evolution therefore generates genuine Ricci-flow trajectories from arbitrary Einstein-matter initial data, whenever the corresponding local evolution exists and is unique.

classification.title_zh: 通过爱因斯坦场方程求解 Ricci 流
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究耦合引力的物质理论的应力张量形变与 Ricci 流之间的关系。我们识别出一个二次应力张量形变，其在爱因斯坦方程的解上关联的度规演化与 Ricci 流向量场一致。我们表明，这种逐点对应一般不能推广到有限形变参数：度规与应力张量的耦合演化还必须额外保持爱因斯坦方程。我们将这一要求表述为爱因斯坦约束面的不变性，并推导相应的几何相容条件。我们用简单例子说明由此产生的阻碍，并展示 Bertotti-Robinson/Born-Infeld 流作为一个非平凡扇区，其中该对应是精确的。最后，我们引入该形变的一个与爱因斯坦相容的完备化，它保持关联的度规演化不变，同时修改应力张量演化，使得爱因斯坦约束面按构造不变。因此，只要相应的局部演化存在且唯一，完备化后的演化就能从任意爱因斯坦-物质初始数据生成真正的 Ricci 流轨迹。
classification.one_liner: 研究应力张量形变与Ricci流的关系：爱因斯坦方程上的二次形变逐点对应Ricci流，有限形变需保持约束面，Bertotti-Robinson/Born-Infeld给出精确对应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要讨论爱因斯坦方程与Ricci流的经典引力/几何关系，不涉及AdS/CFT或全息对偶；但属于用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线。

papers.title: The third law of black hole thermodynamics and the mass-to-charge ratio of scalar fields
papers.abstract: Kehle and Unger have recently shown that self-gravitating charged classical scalar fields can collapse to form extremal Reissner-Nordstr\"om (eRN) black holes in finite time, thus violating the third law of thermodynamics (TLT). Reall has subsequently proved that the formation of an eRN black hole in gravitational collapse is impossible if the mass-to-charge ratio of the field exceeds unity, $m/e\geq1$. In the present compact paper we conjecture, using quantum considerations, that the Reall bound is {\it not} sharp. In particular, we point out that the electric field of a charged system with charge $Q$ will spontaneously polarize the vacuum in the regime $(eQ/\hbar)^2>(mQ/\hbar)^2+1/4$, thereby creating pairs of charged particles that discharge the black hole and ensure the quantum validity of the TLT in this regime. Motivated by the TLT, we conjecture that the classical Reall bound can be strengthened such that classical considerations would prevent eRN black holes from forming dynamically in the regime $m/e\geq\sqrt{1-\big({{\hbar}/{2eQ}}\big)^2}$, where quantum polarization effects are unable to protect the TLT.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 黑洞热力学第三定律与标量场的质荷比
classification.abstract_zh: Kehle 和 Unger 最近表明，自引力带电经典标量场可以在有限时间内坍缩形成极值 Reissner-Nordström（eRN）黑洞，从而违反热力学第三定律（TLT）。Reall 随后证明，如果场的质荷比超过 1，即 m/e≥1，则在引力坍缩中形成 eRN 黑洞是不可能的。在这篇简洁论文中，我们借助量子考虑推测，Reall 界并非尖锐。特别地，我们指出，一个电荷为 Q 的带电系统的电场会在 (eQ/ħ)^2>(mQ/ħ)^2+1/4 的区间自发极化真空，从而产生带电粒子对，使黑洞放电，并确保 TLT 在这一区间内的量子有效性。受 TLT 启发，我们推测经典 Reall 界可以被加强，使得在 m/e≥sqrt(1-(ħ/(2eQ))^2) 的区间内，经典考虑会阻止 eRN 黑洞动力学形成，而在该区间量子极化效应无法保护 TLT。
classification.one_liner: 通过真空极化导致黑洞放电的量子机制，作者推测 Reall 界不尖锐，并给出加强的经典界限以维护黑洞热力学第三定律。
classification.relevance_reason: 不属于全息/AdS-CFT 研究，但直接涉及用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论及黑洞热力学。

papers.title: Stability and Formation of Solitonic Boson Stars
papers.abstract: We extend a previous study of the radial stability of solitonic boson stars by nonlinearly evolving them under aspherical perturbations, and by studying their formation from the collapse of scalar clouds. We focus in particular on models previously identified as radially stable, despite having positive binding energy, which ordinarily suggests that dispersion of all scalar matter is energetically preferred. A mode analysis of our 3+1 evolutions produces no evidence for the presence of a non-radial instability in any radially stable model, including those with positive binding energy. However, we do find evidence that such models do not generically form via gravitational cooling. We also find that it is possible to form another kind of compact object, which undergoes long-lasting radial oscillations and hence cannot be described as a stationary boson star. These objects may be characterized, we suggest, by energetically favoured multi-oscillating solutions to the Einstein-Klein-Gordon equations, present in certain regions of the parameter space.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 孤子玻色星的稳定性与形成
classification.abstract_zh: 我们扩展了先前关于孤子玻色星径向稳定性的研究，通过在非球对称微扰下对其进行非线性演化，并研究它们从标量云坍缩中的形成。我们特别关注那些此前被认定为径向稳定、但具有正束缚能的模型，正束缚能通常意味着所有标量物质色散在能量上更有利。对3+1维演化的模式分析没有发现任何径向稳定模型（包括正束缚能模型）中存在非径向不稳定性的证据。然而，我们确实发现此类模型一般不能通过引力冷却形成。我们还发现可以形成另一种致密天体，它经历长寿命的径向振荡，因此不能被描述为稳态玻色星。我们认为，这些天体可能由 Einstein-Klein-Gordon 方程在参数空间某些区域中存在的、能量上更有利的多振荡解来刻画。
classification.one_liner: 研究孤子玻色星在非球对称微扰下的稳定性与由标量云坍缩形成的可能性，发现径向稳定模型无非径向不稳定性，但一般不能通过引力冷却形成，并出现长寿命径向振荡的致密天体。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究广义相对论框架下的玻色星稳定性、形成与非线性演化，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线。

papers.title: Gravitational spin Hall effect in the Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes: evolution equations and charge effects
papers.abstract: We study the spinoptics equations for test electromagnetic wave in the Reissner-Nordstr\"om spacetime. The explicit and hidden symmetries of this background allow the complex null tetrad parallel-propagated along the null geodesic to be constructed explicitly. From this tetrad we obtain the evolution equations for the deviation of the ray from the null geodesic and for the tilting angle of its orbital plane. In these equations the charge term enters with a sign opposite to the mass term. Numerical integration confirms that the gravitational spin Hall effect becomes weaker with increasing charge: at a fixed impact parameter away from the critical value, the magnitude of the dimensionless tilting angle decreases with $Q$. As the turning point approaches the photon sphere, its magnitude grows firstly, and then exhibits an oscillatory behavior. Since the physical tilting angle is proportional to the reduced wavelength, it remains small whenever the spinoptics approximation is applicable. A divergence occurs only when the ray travels on the photon sphere.

classification.title_zh: Reissner-Nordström 黑洞中的引力自旋霍尔效应：演化方程与电荷效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 Reissner-Nordström 时空中试探电磁波的旋光学方程。该背景的显式和隐含对称性允许显式构造沿零测地线平行传播的复零标架。由该标架，我们得到光线相对零测地线的偏离以及其轨道面倾斜角的演化方程。在这些方程中，电荷项与质量项的符号相反。数值积分证实，引力自旋霍尔效应随电荷增加而减弱：在远离临界值的固定碰撞参数下，无量纲倾斜角的幅度随 Q 减小。当转向点接近光子球时，其幅度先增大，随后呈现振荡行为。由于物理倾斜角与约化波长成正比，只要旋光学近似适用，它就保持很小。仅当光线在光子球上传播时才会出现发散。
classification.one_liner: 在 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞时空中推导试探电磁波的自旋光学演化方程，发现电荷项与质量项反号，且引力自旋霍尔效应随黑洞电荷增大而减弱。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞时空中的自旋光学与引力自旋霍尔效应，不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: The Weyl double copy for relativistic Rindler fluids
papers.abstract: We study the Petrov classification and Weyl double copy of the four-dimensional bulk metric dual to a $2+1$-dimensional relativistic Rindler fluid at first order in the relativistic gradient expansion. Upon imposing the fluid equations, the leading Weyl curvature is determined by the fluid vorticity and shear. At this order, the bulk geometry is generically of Petrov type II, with a type D branch for shear-free flows with nonzero vorticity and a type N branch for irrotational flows with nonzero shear. For the type D branch, we construct a purely magnetic Maxwell single copy on a fixed Rindler background and distinguish exact source-free solutions with a constant magnetic field from local perturbative solutions valid through first order in gradients. For the type N branch, we obtain a family of algebraic Weyl double copies parametrized by $\beta$. We derive explicit field strengths and gauge potentials for $\beta=0$ and $\beta=1$, together with the local Cauchy-Riemann conditions imposed by Maxwell's equations. These choices encode the fluid shear differently: for $\beta=0$, the shear dependence resides entirely in the zeroth-copy scalar, whereas for $\beta=1$, it enters the Maxwell field directly. Finally, using the non-relativistic hydrodynamic expansion with explicit $\epsilon$ counting, we derive the non-relativistic limits of the type D single copy and both type N choices, and compare the resulting structures with existing non-relativistic constructions.

classification.title_zh: 相对论 Rindler 流体的 Weyl 双拷贝
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究对偶于 2+1 维相对论 Rindler 流体的四维体度规在相对论梯度展开一阶下的 Petrov 分类和 Weyl 双拷贝。在施加流体方程后，主导 Weyl 曲率由流体涡度和剪切决定。在此阶，体几何一般为 Petrov II 型，其中无剪切但非零涡度的流对应 D 型分支，无旋但非零剪切的流对应 N 型分支。对于 D 型分支，我们在固定 Rindler 背景上构造纯磁 Maxwell 单拷贝，并区分具有常磁场的精确无源解与梯度一阶有效的局部微扰解。对于 N 型分支，我们得到一族由 β 参数化的代数 Weyl 双拷贝。我们推导 β=0 和 β=1 的显式场强与规范势，以及 Maxwell 方程施加的局部 Cauchy-Riemann 条件。这些选择以不同方式编码流体剪切：β=0 时剪切依赖完全位于第零拷贝标量中，而 β=1 时剪切直接进入 Maxwell 场。最后，我们使用带显式 ε 计数的非相对论流体动力学展开，推导 D 型单拷贝和两种 N 型选择的非相对论极限，并将所得结构与已有非相对论构造进行比较。
classification.one_liner: 该文对偶于相对论 Rindler 流体的体度规做 Petrov 分类与 Weyl 双拷贝，得到 D/N 型分支并比较非相对论极限。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要核心是经典引力中的 Weyl 曲率、Petrov 分类与双拷贝/单拷贝构造，并涉及 Rindler 流体/体度规对偶；与重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”直接匹配。

papers.title: Classical soft theorems meet the post-Newtonian expansion
papers.abstract: Classical soft theorems govern the non-analytic structure of electromagnetic and gravitational radiation in the low-frequency regime, with the gravitational memory effect providing the canonical realization of the classical soft graviton theorem. While the soft behavior of radiation from hyperbolic scattering is well understood, its realization in gravitationally bound systems remains less explored. In this work, we study the soft structure of gravitational waveforms generated by compact binaries, focusing on the scattering of emitted radiation off the static background curvature within the multipolar post-Newtonian framework. We isolate the infrared (IR) logarithms associated with hereditary effects, including the tail-of-memory, and their higher generalizations with n-tail insertions. The resulting amplitudes exhibit a Laurent expansion in frequency space consistent with the Sahoo-Sen logarithmic soft theorems, thereby establishing a direct correspondence between gravitational memory effects, their higher-order tail corrections, and the soft expansion. We also comment on ultraviolet (UV) logarithms arising from short-distance sensitivity of the multipole expansion and their associated renormalization-group running.

classification.title_zh: 经典软定理与后牛顿展开相遇
classification.abstract_zh: 经典软定理支配电磁与引力辐射在低频区的非解析结构，其中引力记忆效应是经典软引力定理的典型实现。虽然双曲散射辐射的软行为已被较好理解，但其在引力束缚系统中的实现仍较少探索。本文在多极后牛顿框架下研究紧致双星产生的引力波形软结构，聚焦于发射辐射在静态背景曲率上的散射。我们分离出与遗传效应相关的红外对数，包括记忆尾及其带 n 个尾插入的高阶推广。所得振幅在频率空间呈现洛朗展开，与 Sahoo-Sen 对数软定理一致，从而在引力记忆效应、其高阶尾修正与软展开之间建立直接对应。我们还评论了由多极展开短距敏感产生的紫外对数及其相关的重整化群跑动。
classification.one_liner: 在多极后牛顿框架中研究紧致双星引力波形的红外软结构，将引力记忆、记忆尾及其高阶修正与 Sahoo-Sen 对数软定理联系起来。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典引力、后牛顿引力波与经典软定理，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，未涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: A general static and spherically symmetric black hole in traceless metric-affine bumblebee gravity
papers.abstract: We construct and analyze a general exact static and spherically symmetric black hole solution in traceless metric-affine bumblebee gravity by considering a vacuum expectation value with temporal and radial components. The temporal component remains constant and the auxiliary geometry is Ricci flat, while Lorentz symmetry breaking is transferred to the physical metric through the metric-affine deformation. After introducing the areal radius and normalizing the Killing time at spatial infinity, the geometry is controlled by a single invariant deformation parameter. The resulting spacetime is asymptotically conical, possesses a regular Killing horizon, and retains the causal structure of the Schwarzschild black hole, with a curvature singularity located at the origin. Initially, we examine its thermodynamic properties, gravitational Doppler effect, and tidal forces. Lorentz symmetry breaking modifies the Hawking temperature and the magnitude of the tidal field, although the characteristic ratio between radial stretching and transverse compression is preserved. The thermodynamic-topology analysis reveals no critical point within the admissible black hole sector. Furthermore, massless scalar perturbations are also investigated through WKB and characteristic time domain solution, showing decaying profiles throughout the sampled parameter range and deformation-dependent quasinormal frequencies. Finally, light deflection and perihelion advance are used to establish stringent Solar System bounds on the invariant deformation, which, at leading order, depends on a combination of the temporal and norm sectors of the bumblebee field.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 无迹度规-仿射 Bumblebee 引力中的一般静态球对称黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过考虑具有时间和径向分量的真空期望值，在无迹度规-仿射 Bumblebee 引力中构造并分析了一般的精确静态球对称黑洞解。时间分量保持常数，辅助几何为 Ricci 平坦，而洛伦兹对称性破缺通过度规-仿射变形传递到物理度规。在引入面积半径并在空间无穷远处归一化 Killing 时间后，几何由单个不变量变形参数控制。所得时空渐近为锥形，具有规则的 Killing 视界，并保留 Schwarzschild 黑洞的因果结构，曲率奇点位于原点。首先，我们考察了其热力学性质、引力多普勒效应和潮汐力。洛伦兹对称性破缺修改了 Hawking 温度和潮汐场大小，尽管径向拉伸与横向压缩之间的特征比例保持不变。热力学拓扑分析表明，在允许的黑洞区域中没有临界点。此外，通过 WKB 和特征时域解研究了无质量标量扰动，显示在所采样参数范围内呈衰减剖面以及依赖变形的准正规模频率。最后，利用光线偏折和近日点进动对不变量变形建立了严格的太阳系限制，其在领头阶依赖于 Bumblebee 场的时间部分与范数部分的组合。
classification.one_liner: 在无迹度规-仿射 Bumblebee 引力中构造一般静态球对称黑洞解，分析其热力学、QNM、潮汐效应与太阳系观测限制。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典/修改引力中的黑洞解，并包含 QNM、热力学与太阳系约束，命中‘经典引力/广义相对论’和‘QNM与非线性演化’重点支线；但不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Asymptotic expansion of cavity Quasi-Normal Modes in Schwarzschild de-Sitter black hole
papers.abstract: We study large-overtone quasi-normal modes of a massive scalar field in a four-dimensional Schwarzschild de-Sitter black hole in the presence of a wall placed at the static sphere. Dirichlet boundary condition is imposed at the wall. At leading order the quasi-normal modes with large overtones scale as $n$ for $n\gg 1$ and are inversely proportional to the bouncing time. We analyze correction terms up to $n^{-1}$ order in the asymptotic expansion.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild-de Sitter黑洞中腔体准正规模的渐近展开
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了四维Schwarzschild-de Sitter黑洞中，在静态球面处放置一面墙时，大质量标量场的高阶泛音准正规模。在墙上施加Dirichlet边界条件。在领头阶，高阶泛音准正规模在 n≫1 时按 n 标度，并与反弹时间成反比。我们分析了渐近展开中直到 n^{-1} 阶的修正项。
classification.one_liner: 研究带墙的Schwarzschild-de Sitter黑洞中标量场高阶泛音准正规模，给出按n标度并与反弹时间成反比的领头阶及n^{-1}阶渐近修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究黑洞准正规模及其渐近展开，属于经典引力/广义相对论与QNM重点方向；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: QCD Crossover Transfer Functions for Scalar-Induced Gravitational Waves in the PTA Band
papers.abstract: Pulsar timing array (PTA) collaborations have reported evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background in the nHz band. Should scalar-induced GWs, sourced at second order by enhanced primordial curvature perturbations, contribute to this signal, a coincidence of scales makes them directly sensitive to the softening of the equation of state around the QCD crossover. We solve the tensor and scalar equations of motion across the Standard Model (SM) thermal history and tabulate the transfer functions for direct use in present and future PTA analyses. We show that this SM effect modifies the height of the induced spectrum by up to $\approx55\%$ across the PTA band relative to the radiation-domination expectation, with either sign depending on whether the source modes cross the horizon before or after the crossover. Fitting the NANOGrav 15-year data with a broken-power-law curvature power spectrum, we find that including the crossover shifts the inferred peak amplitude and scale by an amount that could already be relevant for the comparison with primordial black hole overproduction bounds. The importance of this SM effect will grow as the statistical uncertainty on the amplitude and scale shrinks with future, more sensitive PTA datasets, at which point neglecting it could significantly bias the inference.

classification.title_zh: PTA频段中标量诱导引力波的QCD交叉传递函数
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）合作组已报告在nHz频段存在随机引力波背景的证据。如果由增强的原初曲率扰动二阶源生的标量诱导引力波对这一信号有贡献，那么尺度的巧合使它们直接敏感于QCD交叉附近状态方程的软化。我们求解了标准模型（SM）热历史中的张量和标量运动方程，并制表列出传递函数，供当前和未来PTA分析直接使用。我们表明，相对于辐射主导预期，这一SM效应在PTA频段内将诱导谱的高度改变最高约55%，其符号取决于源模式是在QCD交叉之前还是之后越过视界。用破幂律曲率功率谱拟合NANOGrav 15年数据，我们发现纳入该交叉会使推断的峰值振幅和尺度发生偏移，其量级可能已经与原初黑洞过丰度限制的比较相关。随着未来更灵敏PTA数据集使振幅和尺度的统计不确定性缩小，这一SM效应的重要性将增大，届时忽略它可能显著偏置推断。
classification.one_liner: 论文计算QCD交叉对PTA频段标量诱导引力波传递函数的影响，并拟合NANOGrav数据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于宇宙学、引力波与PTA数据分析，不涉及AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力理论。

papers.title: Dynamical Friction in an Ultralight Scalar Medium across Coherent and Stochastic Regimes
papers.abstract: We study the conservative and dissipative forces on a Newtonian binary interacting with a nonrelativistic ultralight scalar medium. We derive integral expressions for the instantaneous force and the orbit-averaged energy flux generated by wake perturbations of a general background field. For a homogeneous coherent background, the conservative force suffers from a well-known infrared divergence. We trace this divergence to the failure of perturbation theory about a constant scalar state and identify the gravitational Bohr scale at which the homogeneous approximation breaks down. In the long-wavelength regime, the leading dissipation into the medium is quadrupolar, and we obtain an explicit expression for the leading energy flux from an eccentric binary. In the short-wavelength regime, we identify a local ''hard'' region in momentum space that produces a universal Coulomb logarithm, while the nonlogarithmic contribution remains orbit dependent. We then promote the background to a stochastic ensemble with a general velocity distribution. Three independent length scales, together with a derived geometric-mean scale, produce eight distinct scale hierarchies, for which we characterize the ensemble-mean response. Finally, we derive the two-point correlation function of the orbit-averaged energy flux and evaluate it in ''coherent-response'' regimes. Wave interference produces order-unity density fluctuations, so the flux in an individual realization can differ substantially from its ensemble mean.

classification.title_zh: 超轻标量介质中跨相干与随机区域的动力学摩擦
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个牛顿双星与一个非相对论超轻标量介质相互作用时受到的保守力和耗散力。我们推导了由一般背景场的尾迹扰动产生的瞬时力和轨道平均能量通量的积分表达式。对于均匀相干背景，保守力存在众所周知的红外发散。我们将该发散追溯到围绕常数标量态的微扰论的失效，并确定了均匀近似失效的引力玻尔尺度。在长波区域，进入介质的主导耗散是四极的，我们得到了偏心双星主导能量通量的显式表达式。在短波区域，我们识别出动量空间中的一个局域“硬”区域，它产生普适库仑对数，而非对数贡献仍依赖于轨道。然后我们将背景提升为具有一般速度分布的随机系综。三个独立长度尺度，以及导出的几何平均尺度，产生八种不同的尺度层级，我们刻画了系综平均响应。最后，我们推导了轨道平均能量通量的两点关联函数，并在“相干响应”区域中对其求值。波干涉产生量级为一的密度涨落，因此单个实现中的通量可以显著不同于其系综平均。
classification.one_liner: 研究牛顿双星在超轻标量介质中的保守力与耗散力，涵盖相干/随机背景及能量通量系综涨落。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接对应重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”，研究经典引力体系中的动力学摩擦、耗散与输运；但不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Emergent Scaling Symmetry and Universal Interior Criticality of Scalarized Black Holes
papers.abstract: Spontaneous scalarization of charged black holes in asymptotically flat spacetime has attracted much recent interest. It is recently reported that inside these spontaneously scalarized black holes, the Kasner parameter $\beta$ at the terminal singularity diverges as $\beta\propto(q/q_c-1)^{-\gamma}$ near the critical charge-to-mass ratio $q_c$, with an exponent $\gamma=1/2$ that appeared model independent within a wide class of couplings. In this paper we report a family of new universality classes in which $\gamma$ differs from 1/2. We show that all these critical behaviors are governed by the same emergent scaling symmetry at the would-be Cauchy horizon of the background Reissner-Nordstr\"om solution. This symmetry leads to a ``seesaw amplification'' to amplify exterior small scalar and produces a limiting autonomous system that is independent of the details of the theory. Our mechanism provides a unified picture of exterior scalarization and interior criticality and makes sharp numerical predictions that we test.

classification.title_zh: 标量化黑洞的涌现标度对称性与普适内部临界性
classification.abstract_zh: 渐近平直时空中带电黑洞的自发标量化近来引起广泛关注。近期报道，在这些自发标量化黑洞内部，终点奇点处的 Kasner 参数 β 在临界荷质比 q_c 附近按 β ∝ (q/q_c - 1)^{-γ} 发散，指数 γ=1/2，且在一大类耦合中表现模型无关。本文报道了一族新的普适类，其 γ 偏离 1/2。我们表明所有这些临界行为都由背景 Reissner-Nordström 解的本应存在的 Cauchy 视界处的同一涌现标度对称性支配。该对称性导致一种“跷跷板式放大”，放大外部小标量场，并产生不依赖于理论细节的极限自治系统。我们的机制为外部标量化与内部临界性提供了统一图像，并给出我们加以检验的明确数值预言。
classification.one_liner: 标量化带电黑洞内部奇点的临界指数虽可偏离1/2，但均由背景RN的Cauchy视界处涌现标度对称性统一支配，并给出数值可检验预言。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究经典广义相对论中的带电黑洞标量化、内部奇点与临界普适性，属于经典引力支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息对偶。

papers.title: Analytic Holographic Pseudo-Entropy in a Boosted BTZ Geometry
papers.abstract: We investigate holographic entanglement entropy and its generalization to pseudo-entropy in a boosted BTZ black hole geometry, which is holographically dual to a moving strongly coupled plasma. By solving the extremal surface equation, we derive an {\it exact closed-form expression} for the holographic entanglement entropy as a function of the boundary interval length, boost velocity, temperature, and conserved quantities. The resulting exact analytic formula correctly reproduces the standard thermal BTZ entanglement entropy in the vanishing-boost limit and smoothly reduces to the vacuum conformal result at zero temperature, thereby providing robust consistency checks. Motivated by the off-diagonal structure of the boosted metric arising from the Lorentz transformation, we then study two families of analytic continuations to Euclidean signature. Both require a simultaneous continuation of the time coordinate and the boost parameter so that the Euclidean metric remains real. If only these two parameters are continued, the boundary interval becomes imaginary and the analytically continued holographic entanglement entropy is complex-valued; we interpret this complex entropy as the holographic dual of pseudo-entropy for the boosted thermal state. If, in addition, a conserved charge is also continued, the boundary interval remains real and the resulting entropy is real. Our construction establishes a direct connection between boosted HEE and holographic pseudo-entropy, extending previous analytic frameworks developed for rotating BTZ geometries to Lorentz-boosted spacetimes.

classification.title_zh: Boosted BTZ 几何中的解析全息伪熵
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 boost 的 BTZ 黑洞几何中的全息纠缠熵及其向伪熵的推广，该几何在全息上对偶于运动的强耦合等离子体。通过求解极值面方程，我们导出了全息纠缠熵作为边界区间长度、boost 速度、温度和守恒量的函数的精确闭式表达式。所得精确解析公式在 boost 消失极限下正确重现标准热 BTZ 纠缠熵，并在零温下平滑退化为真空共形结果，从而提供了稳健的一致性检验。受 boost 度规因洛伦兹变换产生的非对角结构启发，我们随后研究了两类到欧几里得签名的解析延拓。两者都要求同时延拓时间坐标和 boost 参数，以使欧几里得度规保持实数。如果只延拓这两个参数，边界区间变为虚数，解析延拓后的全息纠缠熵为复值；我们将该复熵解释为 boost 热态的伪熵的全息对偶。如果额外延拓一个守恒荷，边界区间保持实数，所得熵也为实数。我们的构造在 boost 的 HEE 与全息伪熵之间建立了直接联系，将先前为旋转 BTZ 几何发展的解析框架推广到洛伦兹 boost 时空。
classification.one_liner: 该文在 boost 的 BTZ 背景中解析求解全息纠缠熵，并通过同时解析延拓时间与 boost 参数得到全息伪熵。

papers.title: Unification of Einstein Gravity with Internal Interactions
papers.abstract: The gauge-theoretic formulation of gravity, enriched with the observation that the tangent group of a curved manifold need not have the same dimension as the manifold itself, provides a natural framework for unifying gravity with internal interactions. In the present work we study the unification of Einstein gravity with the $SO(10)$ grand unified theory within an $SO(1,17)$ gauge theory. As a central result, we derive Einstein gravity with a cosmological constant from the spontaneous symmetry breaking (SSB) of an $SO(1,5)$ gauge theory to the Lorentz group via two independent routes: one using two scalar fields in the fundamental representation $\mathbf{6}$ of $SO(6)$, and one using a single scalar in the adjoint $\mathbf{15}$. Both yield a Gauss-Bonnet + Einstein-Hilbert + cosmological constant action. Embedding the $SO(1,5)$ gravitational sector in $SO(1,17)$ and breaking the full gauge group yields Einstein gravity coupled to $SO(10)$. The Weyl-Majorana condition reduces the fermion family degeneracy to two, in contrast to the four families obtained in the $SO(2,16)$ conformal gravity unification.

classification.title_zh: 将爱因斯坦引力与内部相互作用统一
classification.abstract_zh: 引力的规范理论表述，加上弯曲流形的切群不必与流形本身同维这一观察，为将引力与内部相互作用统一提供了自然框架。在本工作中，我们在一个 SO(1,17) 规范理论中研究爱因斯坦引力与 SO(10) 大统一理论的统一。作为核心结果，我们通过两条独立路径，从 SO(1,5) 规范理论到洛伦兹群的自发对称破缺（SSB）导出带宇宙学常数的爱因斯坦引力：一条使用 SO(6) 基本表示 6 中的两个标量场，另一条使用伴随表示 15 中的单个标量。两者都给出 Gauss-Bonnet + Einstein-Hilbert + 宇宙学常数作用量。将 SO(1,5) 引力部分嵌入 SO(1,17) 并破缺整个规范群，得到与 SO(10) 耦合的爱因斯坦引力。Weyl-Majorana 条件将费米子代简并度约化为两代，这与 SO(2,16) 共形引力统一中得到的四代形成对比。
classification.one_liner: 在 SO(1,17) 规范理论中，通过 SO(1,5) 自发破缺导出带宇宙学常数的 Einstein 引力并耦合 SO(10) 大统一。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息/AdS-CFT 研究；主题为引力规范理论与大统一，虽导出 Einstein-Hilbert 作用量，但不涉及经典引力现象或用户重点的全息、凝聚态、QCD 等支线，相关性低。

papers.title: Holonomy Separation and Anyonic Hair in AdS$_3$
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional Einstein gravity and Chern-Simons-Higgs matter both admit Chern-Simons descriptions, but their holonomies encode different physics. We prove that charge conjugation reverses the vortex winding $n\to-n$ while leaving the metric and the gravitational connections pointwise unchanged, so every closed gravitational holonomy character, the BTZ charges, the Ba\~nados data and the leading geometric mixed-state hierarchy are exactly even in $n$. On a fixed marked Euclidean replica filling the same change of variables gives $Z_q[n;\mathcal J_+]=Z_q[-n;\mathcal J_+]$, so the uncharged R\'enyi hierarchy, the Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena one-loop correction, the renormalized generalized entropy and the quantum extremal surfaces coincide for the two orientations. The complementary sector is fixed exactly: with an Aharonov-Bohm angle $\mu$ conjugate to the entangling-region charge, $Z_q[n;\mu]=Z_q[-n;-\mu]$, so the symmetry-resolved spectrum obeys $\mathcal Z_q(\mathcal Q;n)=\mathcal Z_q(-\mathcal Q;-n)$ and every odd charged cumulant reverses with the winding. The orientation is therefore stored entirely in the charge asymmetry of the entanglement spectrum, and is read at topological order by a linked charged matter line. The pair is a bulk logical qubit on which the neutral gravitational-replica algebra acts as a multiple of the identity. Exact BTZ cross sections show that the purification plateau and the entanglement wedge disconnection transition are orientation blind, the latter closing with the cutoff-independent jump $(c/3)\log(1+\sqrt2)$. Numerical Bogomolny solutions verify odd flux and even energy and spin; used as linearized charge-matching data they give the even asymptotic shifts $\delta\widehat M=16\pi Gv^2|n|$ and $|\delta\widehat j|=16\pi Gv^2n^2/(mL)$ and, conditionally, a finite continuous winding envelope.

classification.title_zh: AdS_3 中的和乐分离与任意子毛发
classification.abstract_zh: 三维 Einstein 引力和 Chern-Simons-Higgs 物质都可接受 Chern-Simons 描述，但它们的和乐编码不同物理。我们证明电荷共轭将涡旋绕数 n -> -n 反转，同时逐点保持度规和引力连接不变，因此每个闭合引力 holonomy character、BTZ 电荷、Bañados 数据以及领头几何混合态层级都精确是 n 的偶函数。在固定标记的欧几里得 replica 填充上，同一变量变换给出 Z_q[n;J_+] = Z_q[-n;J_+]，所以无电荷 Rényi 层级、Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena 单圈修正、重整化广义熵和量子极端曲面在两种取向下重合。互补 sector 被精确固定：以与纠缠区域电荷共轭的 Aharonov-Bohm 角 μ，有 Z_q[n;μ] = Z_q[-n;-μ]，因此对称分辨谱服从 Z_q(Q;n) = Z_q(-Q;-n)，且每个奇带电累积量随绕数反转。因此取向完全存储在纠缠谱的电荷不对称性中，并通过一条链接的带电物质线在拓扑序下读取。该对是一个体逻辑量子比特，中性引力-replica 代数在其上作用为恒等元的倍数。精确 BTZ 截面显示纯化平台和纠缠楔断开转变对取向盲，后者以 cutoff 无关的跳变 (c/3) log(1+sqrt(2)) 闭合。数值 Bogomolny 解验证奇通量以及偶能量与自旋；当用作线性化电荷匹配数据时，它们给出偶的渐近位移 δM=16πGv^2|n| 和 |δj|=16πGv^2n^2/(mL)，并有条件地给出有限连续绕数包络。
classification.one_liner: AdS3 中引力与 Chern-Simons-Higgs 物质的和乐分离：电荷共轭翻转涡旋绕数，但 BTZ、Rényi、QES 等引力/纠缠几何量对取向为偶，取向信息仅存于纠缠谱电荷不对称性，并由带电物质线拓扑读取。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及 AdS3 中 Chern-Simons-Higgs 涡旋/任意子毛发与纠缠谱、QES，和“畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀”重点直接相关；但用户重点中的全息超流超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM、探针膜等支线并不直接匹配。

papers.title: Reduction technique for expanding the Feynman diagrams in AdS$_2$
papers.abstract: We formulate the reduction technique for expanding the $n$-point AdS Feynman diagrams in two dimensions into the Wilson line networks. The technique applies to any $n$-point tree diagram, expressing it as several series of the matrix elements of Wilson line network operators, and employs the Wilson network expansions of the $(n-1)$-point AdS Feynman diagrams, which can in turn be obtained using the same technique. Consequently, the complexity of this technique does not increase with $n$, provided that the expansions of the $(n-1)$-point diagrams are known. To demonstrate the reduction technique, we apply it to all topologically distinct five-point AdS Feynman tree diagrams. The resulting expansions near the conformal boundary reproduce the known decompositions of the corresponding five-point Witten diagrams into conformal blocks.

classification.title_zh: 用于展开 AdS$_2$ 中 Feynman 图的约化技术
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种约化技术，用于将二维 AdS 中的 $n$ 点 Feynman 图展开为 Wilson 线网络。该技术适用于任意 $n$ 点树图，将其表示为 Wilson 线网络算符矩阵元的若干级数，并利用 $(n-1)$ 点 AdS Feynman 图的 Wilson 网络展开，而这些展开又可用同一技术得到。因此，只要已知 $(n-1)$ 点图的展开，该技术的复杂度不随 $n$ 增加。为演示该约化技术，我们将其应用于所有拓扑不同的五点 AdS Feynman 树图。所得在共形边界附近的展开重现了相应五点 Witten 图到共形块的已知分解。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种在 AdS$_2$ 中把任意树级 Feynman/Witten 图递归展开为 Wilson 线网络的约化技术，并验证五点图展开可重现共形块分解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 AdS2 中 Witten/Feynman 图展开与共形块分解，属于 AdS/CFT 基础技术；未涉及用户重点标签中的全息凝聚态、多分量序参量、探针膜、QNM、经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: Blast freezing a black hole
papers.abstract: What happens to information carried through an evaporating black-hole horizon? We introduce a solvable model of evaporation built from coupled Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev systems, in which an initially two-sided black hole is coupled at a finite time to a larger, colder bath. Evaporation is rapid in this model, so we refer to the process as ``blast freezing'' of a black hole. In an appropriate large-$N$ and large-$p$ limit, the two-point functions and certain four-point probes can be computed analytically. Using the two-point functions as input to a generalized HKLL reconstruction, we obtain the emergent bulk geometry of the evaporation process. We then track the information carried by an infalling particle using operator size and Renyi-2 mutual information, showing how it is preserved in nonlocal many-body degrees of freedom after the blast-freezing transition.

classification.title_zh: 暴冻黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 穿过蒸发黑洞视界的信息会发生什么？我们引入一个可解的蒸发模型，由耦合的 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 系统构成；其中，一个初始为双侧的黑洞在有限时刻与一个更大、更冷的浴耦合。该模型中蒸发很快，因此我们将此过程称为黑洞的“暴冻”。在适当的大 N 和大 p 极限下，两点函数和某些四点探针可解析计算。以两点函数作为广义 HKLL 重构的输入，我们得到蒸发过程的涌现体几何。随后，我们利用算符尺寸和 Renyi-2 互信息追踪入射粒子携带的信息，展示在暴冻转变之后它如何保存于非局域多体自由度中。
classification.one_liner: 用耦合 SYK 模型建模黑洞快速蒸发（暴冻），并通过广义 HKLL 重构、算符尺寸与 Renyi-2 互信息追踪信息在转变后的保存。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息/SYK 框架下的黑洞蒸发与信息问题，与黑洞量子信息方向相关；但与用户列出的重点标签（全息超导、p波、multi-trace、D3-D7/Floquet、经典引力等）无直接匹配。

papers.title: Spacetime topology and geometry in JT Gravity from non-crossing permutations
papers.abstract: We study how discrete parameters which enumerate non-crossing permutations become geometric quantities in JT gravity. Analyzing non-crossing permutations on the disk together with two classes of annular non-crossing permutations, we find that under suitable continuum scaling limits the number of marked boundary points becomes the thermal boundary length, while the number of through-connections becomes a geodesic length. In this limit, the enumerations reproduce the universal low-temperature behavior of the Schwarzian theory on the disk and the orientable and orientation-reversing double-trumpet geometries. We then relate these constructions to higher-boundary non-crossing diagrams, whose continuum enumeration reproduces the JT result obtained by attaching trumpets to the top-degree part of genus-zero Weil-Petersson volumes, suggesting that the same trumpet--enumeration parameter mapping extends beyond the planar case. Together, these results establish a direct connection between non-crossing permutation enumerations and Weil-Petersson volumes with trumpets attached, a construction that plays a central role in the gravitational path integral in JT gravity, and suggest that non-crossing diagrams provide a combinatorial route to computing multi-boundary partition functions.

classification.title_zh: 从非交叉置换看 JT 引力中的时空拓扑与几何
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究枚举非交叉置换的离散参数如何在 JT 引力中成为几何量。通过分析圆盘上的非交叉置换以及两类环形非交叉置换，我们发现，在合适的连续标度极限下，边界标记点的数目变为热边界长度，而贯通连接的数目变为测地线长度。在此极限下，这些枚举重现了圆盘上 Schwarzian 理论的普适低温行为，以及可定向和反定向的双喇叭几何。随后，我们将这些构造与更高边界非交叉图联系起来，其连续枚举重现了通过将 trumpet 附着到 genus-zero Weil-Petersson 体积最高次数部分所得到的 JT 结果，表明同一 trumpet–枚举参数映射可推广到平面情形之外。这些结果共同建立了非交叉置换枚举与附着 trumpet 的 Weil-Petersson 体积之间的直接联系；该构造在 JT 引力引力路径积分中起核心作用，并表明非交叉图提供了计算多边界配分函数的组合途径。
classification.one_liner: 非交叉置换的连续极限将离散计数参数映射为 JT 引力中的热边界长度与测地线长度，并重现 double-trumpet 与 Weil-Petersson 体积结果。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 JT/SYK/AdS2 与量子引力路径积分核心主题，但不直接落在所列重点标签（如全息超导、QNM、经典引力等）上。

papers.title: Frame dependence of heavy-quark observables in a rotating strongly coupled plasma
papers.abstract: In genuinely rotating holographic backgrounds, Wilson-loop observables are usually constructed for a quark--antiquark pair static with respect to the rotating plasma. We investigate how this choice affects the heavy-quark sector by comparing two descriptions of the same rotating geometry: a corotating frame, in which the pair is static with respect to the plasma, and a static frame, in which it is static with respect to the static observer. We consider an equal-rotation Myers--Perry black hole in asymptotically global AdS and study Wilson loops oriented longitudinally and transversely to the rotation. We analyze the effective string tension, physical quark--antiquark separation, and heavy-quark potential at fixed thermodynamic temperature measured in the corresponding frame. We find a strong frame dependence of the rotational response. In the corotating frame, the longitudinal and transverse configurations respond qualitatively differently: rotation can either decrease or increase the separation and effective string tension, depending on orientation and, for the latter, on the bulk position and parameter range. The heavy-quark potential increases with angular velocity in both orientations. In the static frame, by contrast, the effective tension, physical separation, and maximal separation decrease with angular velocity in both orientations, while the heavy-quark potential increases. Thus, the anisotropic response is substantially stronger in the corotating frame, both qualitatively and quantitatively. In both frames, rotational modifications generally become less pronounced at higher temperature. These results show that the frame in which the quark pair is static is an essential part of the physical specification of Wilson-loop observables in rotating holographic systems.

classification.title_zh: 旋转强耦合等离子体中重夸克可观测量的参考系依赖性
classification.abstract_zh: 在真正旋转的全息背景中，Wilson 圈可观测量通常针对相对于旋转等离子体静止的夸克-反夸克对构造。我们通过比较同一旋转几何的两种描述来研究这一选择如何影响重夸克部分：共转参考系，其中夸克对相对于等离子体静止；以及静止参考系，其中它相对于静止观测者静止。我们考虑渐近全局 AdS 中等旋转 Myers-Perry 黑洞，并研究沿旋转方向纵向和横向取向的 Wilson 圈。我们在相应参考系中固定的热力学温度下分析有效弦张力、物理夸克-反夸克间距和重夸克势。我们发现旋转响应具有强烈的参考系依赖性。在共转参考系中，纵向和横向构型定性响应不同：旋转既可以减小也可以增大间距和有效弦张力，这取决于取向，且对于后者还取决于体位置和参数范围。重夸克势在两种取向下都随角速度增大而增大。相反，在静止参考系中，有效张力、物理间距和最大间距在两种取向下都随角速度增大而减小，而重夸克势增大。因此，各向异性响应在共转参考系中在定性和定量上都显著更强。在两种参考系中，旋转修正通常随温度升高而变得不那么明显。这些结果表明，夸克对静止所在的参考系是旋转全息系统中 Wilson 圈可观测量物理规格的本质部分。
classification.one_liner: 比较共转与静止参考系下旋转 AdS 等离子体中的重夸克 Wilson 圈与势，发现旋转响应强烈依赖参考系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 QCD/重夸克方向，研究旋转强耦合等离子体中的 Wilson 圈与重夸克势；但未直接涉及用户列出的重点支线标签。

papers.title: A Holographic Open Quantum System
papers.abstract: We construct a holographic open quantum system by coupling two CFTs through a double trace deformation and tracing out the bath degrees of freedom within the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism. This procedure yields an effective description of the nonunitary reduced dynamics of the remaining sector, whose linear response is encoded in its retarded Green's function. Working perturbatively in the double trace coupling, we derive closed form expressions for the quasinormal modes of several coupled geometries involving pure AdS and rotating or nonrotating BTZ black holes, considering both possible system/bath assignments. For the nonrotating configurations previously investigated in arXiv:2509.14312, our analytic expressions agree with the numerical results, while our treatment extends the analysis to configurations involving rotating BTZ black holes. Finally, moving beyond perturbation theory, we derive a relation between dissipation and transmission in the general AdS-BTZ setup.

classification.title_zh: 一个全息开放量子系统
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过在 Schwinger-Keldysh 形式中经由双迹形变耦合两个 CFT 并积掉浴自由度，构建了一个全息开放量子系统。该过程给出了剩余扇区非幺正约化动力学的有效描述，其线性响应编码于推迟格林函数中。在双迹耦合的微扰阶，我们推导了涉及纯 AdS 以及旋转或非旋转 BTZ 黑洞的若干耦合几何的准正规模闭合表达式，并考虑了系统/浴两种可能分配。对于此前在 arXiv:2509.14312 中研究的非旋转构型，我们的解析表达式与数值结果一致，而我们的处理将分析推广到涉及旋转 BTZ 黑洞的构型。最后，超越微扰论，我们在一般 AdS-BTZ 设置中推导了耗散与透射之间的关系。
classification.one_liner: 通过双迹耦合与 Schwinger-Keldysh 形式构建全息开放量子系统，解析给出 AdS/BTZ 耦合几何的 QNM，并讨论耗散-透射关系。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接涉及全息开量子系统、双迹形变、Schwinger-Keldysh 约化动力学与 QNM，并包含 AdS-BTZ 几何中的耗散/透射关系，与全息非平衡/QNM 重点标签高度匹配。

papers.title: AdS$_4$ Celestial Symmetries: from Ambitwistor charges to CFT$_3$ Light-Ray Operators
papers.abstract: The ${L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$ algebra is the cosmological-constant deformation of the celestial $Lw_{1+\infty}$ symmetry algebra of gravity, providing an infinite-dimensional extension of the three-dimensional conformal algebra at the AdS$_4$ boundary. We construct the Hamiltonian charges associated with these symmetries from boundary ambitwistor-space data, using LeBrun's Heaven on Earth correspondence, and translate them to spacetime via the Penrose transform. We relate the resulting expressions to light-ray operators in the boundary CFT$_3$, including ANEC operators, their conformal descendants, and their commutators.

classification.title_zh: AdS4 天球对称性：从 ambitwistor 荷到 CFT3 光射线算符
classification.abstract_zh: L_Λ w_{1+∞} 代数是天球 Lw_{1+∞} 引力对称代数的宇宙学常数形变，它为 AdS4 边界上的三维共形代数提供了无穷维扩张。我们利用 LeBrun 的 Heaven on Earth 对应，从边界 ambitwistor 空间数据构造与这些对称性相关的哈密顿荷，并通过 Penrose 变换将其转换到时空中。我们将所得表达式与边界 CFT3 中的光射线算符联系起来，包括 ANEC 算符、它们的共形后代及其对易子。
classification.one_liner: 从边界 ambitwistor 数据构造 AdS4 天球对称性的哈密顿荷，并映射到 CFT3 光射线算符。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与天球对称性方向，讨论 ambitwistor 荷和 CFT3 光射线算符，但未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、相变、QNM、探针膜等具体支线。

papers.title: Testing cosmic acceleration from thermogravity without vacuum energy
papers.abstract: We present a first background-level observational test of a thermogravity theory in which the Einstein equations are clipped to a trace-free version, the cosmological constant $\Lambda$ does not gravitate, and controlled violations of energy conservation obstruct the usual reinstatement of $\Lambda$ as an integration constant. We therefore set $\Lambda=0$ and ask whether late-time acceleration can instead be generated solely by energy non-conservation, with no extra background parameter relative to flat $\Lambda\mathrm{CDM}$. We contrast a minimal universal implementation with a model in which only CDM partakes in non-conservation. The universal model is strongly disfavored when combining Supernovae and BAO distances, with the inclusion of DESI BAO worsening the fit by $\Delta\chi^2\simeq 51$ relative to $\Lambda\mathrm{CDM}$, because matter creation ties the intermediate-redshift normalization of $H(z)$ too rigidly to the present acceleration. This conclusion, however, should be interpreted with caution, since universal non-conservation would modify the observational dictionary itself. By contrast, restricting non-conservation to CDM leaves baryonic and photon observables unaffected at the background level and therefore allows a self-contained analysis. The resulting $\xi\mathrm{CDM}$ model, which can be thought of as a one parameter extension of $\Lambda\mathrm{CDM}$, provides an improved fit relative to $\Lambda\mathrm{CDM}$ for the background dataset combinations considered, with improvements reaching $\Delta\chi^2=-4.85$ and a maximum Bayesian preference of $\ln\mathcal{B}=2.77$. However, when the BAO ruler is calibrated using BBN or CMB information, the reduced effective early-time CDM density increases the sound horizon and drives $H_0$ towards lower values, thereby increasing rather than alleviating the tension with the distance-ladder calibration.

classification.title_zh: 无真空能情形下从热引力检验宇宙加速
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出对一种热引力理论的首个背景层面观测检验，其中 Einstein 方程被截断为无迹版本，宇宙学常数 Λ 不产生引力，且受控的能量守恒破缺阻碍了通常将 Λ 作为积分常数重新引入的做法。因此我们设 Λ=0，并询问晚期加速是否可以仅由能量不守恒产生，且相对于平坦 ΛCDM 不引入额外背景参数。我们将一个最小普适实现与一个仅 CDM 参与不守恒的模型进行对比。当结合超新星和 BAO 距离时，普适模型被强烈不赞成；加入 DESI BAO 后，相对于 ΛCDM 拟合变差 Δχ²≈51，因为物质产生将 H(z) 的中等红移归一化过于刚性地绑定到当前加速。然而，这一结论应谨慎解释，因为普适不守恒会修改观测字典本身。相反，将不守恒限制在 CDM 使重子和光子观测量在背景层面不受影响，因此允许自洽分析。所得 ξCDM 模型可视为 ΛCDM 的一参数扩展，对于所考虑的背景数据集组合，相对于 ΛCDM 提供了改进拟合，改进达到 Δχ²=-4.85，最大贝叶斯偏好为 lnB=2.77。然而，当 BAO 标尺用 BBN 或 CMB 信息校准时，约化有效早期 CDM 密度会增大声视界并驱使 H0 趋于更低值，从而增加而非缓解与距离阶梯校准的张力。
classification.one_liner: 背景观测检验无 Λ 热引力：普适能量不守恒被强烈排除，仅 CDM 不守恒的 ξCDM 略优，但会加剧 H0 张力。
classification.relevance_reason: 本文属于修改引力宇宙学背景检验，涉及无迹 Einstein 方程与经典引力/广义相对论支线相关；但不涉及全息、纠缠、QCD、凝聚态等用户主要重点标签。

papers.title: Stiffness corrections for f-mode neutron star universal relations
papers.abstract: Excitations of the neutron star (NS) fundamental mode (f-mode) during a binary NS inspiral or from a glitching pulsar can produce gravitational waves (GWs) that will be detectable with the next generation of detectors, opening the door to GW asteroseismology of neutron stars. There exist approximately equation-of-state (EOS)-insensitive, or "universal," relations that relate the f-mode to other NS properties. These universal relations have typically been identified with relatively small, selective EOS samples. To more thoroughly explore the parameter space, we examine the f-modes for a large sample of piecewise-parametric EOSs by solving the linearized fluid perturbation equations for the f-mode frequency and damping time in full general relativity. We utilize our sample to evaluate the EOS-sensitivity of previously-proposed universal relations (URs) for both the f-mode frequency and damping time. We find that URs that depend on combinations of only NS mass and radius have significant residuals, as previously reported; but that these residuals are strongly correlated with the overall stiffness of the EOS. We account for this residual dependence on the EOS by introducing linear correction terms that depend on the characteristic radius predicted by the EOS and the slope of the mass-radius curve at intermediate masses. To assess the impact of our new correction terms on observables, we consider the case of GW emission due to a glitch in a Vela-like pulsar and demonstrate that the predicted signal-to-noise ratio for such an event is over/under-estimated by up to ~10% when using an existing, single-parameter UR, but is recovered nearly exactly with our improved 3-parameter UR. In contrast, we find that URs between the f-mode and tidal deformability exhibit only minimal EOS-dependent correlations in their residuals and overall remain highly EOS-insensitive.

classification.title_zh: 中子星 f 模普适关系的刚度修正
classification.abstract_zh: 双中子星旋近或脉冲星故障过程中对中子星基本模（f 模）的激发可以产生引力波，下一代探测器将能够探测到这些引力波，从而开启中子星引力波星震学。现有一些近似不依赖于状态方程（EOS）的“普适”关系，将 f 模与其他中子星性质联系起来。这些普适关系通常是在相对较小且经过选择的状态方程样本上确定的。为了更全面地探索参数空间，我们通过在全广义相对论下求解线性化流体扰动方程，考察了大量分段参数化状态方程样本的 f 模频率和阻尼时间。我们利用该样本评估先前提出的 f 模频率和阻尼时间普适关系对状态方程的敏感性。我们发现，仅依赖于中子星质量和半径组合的普适关系具有显著残差，这与先前报道一致；但这些残差与状态方程的总体刚度强烈相关。我们通过引入线性修正项来考虑对状态方程的这一残余依赖，这些修正项依赖于状态方程预测的特征半径以及中等质量处质量-半径曲线的斜率。为了评估新修正项对可观测量的影响，我们考虑了一个类似 Vela 的脉冲星故障导致引力波发射的情形，并证明：使用现有的单参数普适关系时，此类事件的预测信噪比会被高估或低估最多约 10%，而使用我们改进的三参数普适关系后几乎可以精确恢复。相反，我们发现 f 模与潮汐形变率之间的普适关系在其残差中仅表现出极小的状态方程依赖关联，整体上仍然高度不依赖于状态方程。
classification.one_liner: 用大量分段参数化状态方程检验并修正中子星 f 模普适关系中的刚度残差。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究中子星 f 模、状态方程与经典广义相对论下的引力波可观测性，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Binary black hole scattering in the extreme-mass-ratio limit: time-domain waveform
papers.abstract: The time-domain gravitational waveform emitted during the scattering of two nonspinning compact bodies is computed in the extreme-mass-ratio limit. It provides a time-domain description of the gravitational radiation emitted during the encounter and complements previous first-order self-force calculations, which have primarily been formulated in the frequency domain. In this way, the present results provide a complementary representation of the radiative dynamics and facilitate a direct comparison between time-domain and frequency-domain approaches to the gravitational-wave signal. The waveform is accurate to the fifth post-Minkowskian (three-loop) level and seventh post-Newtonian order, and will serve as a benchmark for future calculations by other methods, to first order in the mass ratio. The results have been already tested in a previous work by constructing the energy and angular momentum fluxes, thereby computing the corresponding radiative losses at the 5PM and 4PM level, respectively, with the same PN accuracy, which are in agreement with recent amplitude-based calculations.

classification.title_zh: 极端质量比极限下的双黑洞散射：时域波形
classification.abstract_zh: 在极端质量比极限下计算了两个无自旋致密天体散射过程中发射的时域引力波形。该工作给出了相遇期间引力辐射的时域描述，补充了此前主要用频域表述的一阶自引力计算。这样，本文结果为辐射动力学提供了互补表示，并便于直接比较时域与频域引力波信号方法。波形达到五阶后闵可夫斯基（三圈）精度和七阶后牛顿精度，并将作为一阶质量比下其他方法未来计算的基准。此前工作已通过构造能量和角动量通量对其进行了检验，分别以相同后牛顿精度计算了5PM与4PM层次的辐射损耗，结果与近期基于振幅的计算一致。
classification.one_liner: 在极端质量比极限下给出双黑洞散射的时域引力波形，达到5PM/7PN精度，可作为自引力波形基准。

papers.title: A Cartan-geometrical perspective on torsion and non-metricity
papers.abstract: \'{E}lie Cartan established that the metric and intrinsic curvature of a $D$ dimensional embedded manifold $M$ could be determined by tracing the response of another surface $N$ of the same dimensionality, as it is rolled without slipping and twisting on $M$. In the context of spacetime geometry, this construction underpins the MacDowell-Mansouri formulation of General Relativity. We consider extensions of this framework that correspond to rolling of a shape with twisting and with shape evolution; it is shown that these naturally describe torsion and non-metricity respectively. Cartan-geometric formulations of teleparallel gravity and symmetric teleparallelism are discussed in addition to further manifestations of non-metricity in first-order formulations of gravity.

classification.title_zh: 从嘉当几何视角看挠率与非度规性
classification.abstract_zh: 埃利·嘉当确立：一个 D 维嵌入流形 M 的度规和内禀曲率，可以通过追踪另一个同维曲面 N 在 M 上无滑动、无扭转地滚动时的响应来确定。在时空几何语境下，这一构造支撑了广义相对论的 MacDowell-Mansouri 表述。我们考虑该框架的扩展，分别对应形状在滚动时带有扭转以及带有形状演化；并证明它们自然分别描述挠率与非度规性。除了引力一阶表述中非度规性的进一步表现外，还讨论了远平行引力和对称远平行性的嘉当几何表述。
classification.one_liner: 本文用嘉当几何中的滚动构造扩展 MacDowell-Mansouri 框架，将扭转与形状演化分别对应到挠率和非度规性，并讨论远平行引力等表述。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”支线，讨论 Cartan 几何、挠率、非度规性以及远平行引力等经典引力表述；但不涉及全息对偶、黑洞信息或量子引力，因此与全息主线关联有限。

papers.title: Environmental Imprints of Dark Matter and Accretion Disks on Eccentric EMRIs around Kerr Black Holes
papers.abstract: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs), systems in which a stellar-mass compact object spirals into a supermassive black hole ($M_1$), are prime targets for the space-based gravitational-wave interferometers and are acutely sensitive to their astrophysical environment. We quantify the joint imprint of a dark matter (DM) spike and an accretion disk on the waveforms of eccentric, equatorial Kerr EMRIs, integrating four modular effects---DM dynamical friction, DM self-gravity, Newtonian accretion-disk torques, and disk self-gravity---into a fifth post-Newtonian (5PN) augmented analytic kludge (AAK) waveform model, and assess their measurability via a Fisher-matrix analysis. The DM dynamical-friction dephasing peaks at $M_1\sim 10^6\,M_\odot$, reaching $\sim 10^2$--$10^3\,\mathrm{rad}$; there the DM spike slope is measurable to sub-percent precision and both DM channels are unambiguously detectable, while omitting DM biases the intrinsic parameters significantly. At $M_1\gtrsim 10^8\,M_\odot$ the DM and disk self-gravity channels dominate their dissipative counterparts. The disk parameters remain degenerate across the explored parameter space, since the supersonic regime dominates the inspiral and the subsonic-to-supersonic transition only mildly weakens this degeneracy without lifting it; a combined DM$+$disk analysis further reveals a cross-sector degeneracy between the DM slope and the disk parameters. This physical degeneracy, reflected in the near-singular Fisher matrix, implies that independently measuring the disk parameters requires a relativistic torque model or an electromagnetic counterpart.

classification.title_zh: 暗物质与吸积盘对绕Kerr黑洞偏心EMRI的环境印记
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋近（EMRI）是恒星级致密天体旋入超大质量黑洞（M1）的系统，是空间引力波干涉仪的优选目标，且对其天体物理环境高度敏感。我们量化了暗物质（DM）尖峰与吸积盘对偏心、赤道Kerr EMRI波形的联合印记，将四种模块化效应——DM动力学摩擦、DM自引力、牛顿吸积盘力矩和吸积盘自引力——整合进一个五阶后牛顿（5PN）增强解析拼凑（AAK）波形模型，并通过Fisher矩阵分析评估其可测性。DM动力学摩擦引起的相位偏差在 M1~10^6 M_sun 处达到峰值，约为10^2--10^3 rad；在那里DM尖峰斜率可测到亚百分比精度，两个DM通道都可明确探测，而忽略DM会显著偏置内禀参数。当 M1≳10^8 M_sun 时，DM与吸积盘自引力通道主导其耗散对应项。由于超声速区域主导旋近，且亚声速到超声速的过渡只轻微削弱而不消除简并，吸积盘参数在所探索参数空间中仍然简并；联合DM+吸积盘分析进一步揭示DM斜率与吸积盘参数之间的跨扇区简并。这种物理简并反映在近奇异的Fisher矩阵中，意味着独立测量吸积盘参数需要相对论力矩模型或电磁对应体。
classification.one_liner: 将暗物质尖峰与吸积盘的四类环境效应纳入5PN AAK波形，并用Fisher矩阵评估偏心Kerr EMRI参数的测量性。

papers.title: Multi-messenger and multi-band signal from first-order phase transitions in proto-neutron stars
papers.abstract: A first-order phase transition (PT) alters a compact star on two scales: globally, via growth of a quark-matter core, and microscopically, via collision of quark bubbles, driving a simultaneous gravitational-wave (GW) emission in the kHz and MHz bands. Using a constrained ensemble of model-agnostic equations of state, we follow the accretion-driven evolution of proto-neutron stars through the PT and compute the resulting multi-band GW signal. The correlations found between the kHz emission and the MHz burst could help constrain nuclear matter and the physics of the PT. A delayed neutrino burst should accompany the signal, with the delay set by the details of the PT, thus providing a prime multi-messenger source.

classification.title_zh: 原中子星中一阶相变的多信使与多波段信号
classification.abstract_zh: 一阶相变（PT）在两个尺度上改变致密星：整体上通过夸克物质核的生长，微观上通过夸克气泡的碰撞，驱动同时发生在 kHz 和 MHz 波段的引力波（GW）发射。使用受约束的模型无关状态方程集合，我们追踪原中子星在吸积驱动下经历相变的演化，并计算由此产生的多波段引力波信号。所发现的 kHz 发射与 MHz 爆发之间的关联有助于约束核物质及相变物理。信号应伴随一个延迟的中微子爆发，延迟由相变细节决定，因而提供了一个重要的多信使源。
classification.one_liner: 研究原中子星一阶相变产生的 kHz/MHz 多波段引力波与延迟中微子爆发，作为约束核物质和相变物理的多信使信号。

papers.title: The Lanczos potential in the Plebanski paradigm of gravity
papers.abstract: We present a new Plebanski formulation of General Relativity. The key difference is that we work with a gauge vector field derived from the Lanczos potential of the Weyl tensor. We show that, on shell, the gauge vector field encodes all nontrivial gravitational degrees of freedom and, in a suitable Lorentz gauge, Bianchi identities ensure that this gauge vector field satisfies a source-free wave equation for Ricci-flat spacetimes. This description suggests new ways of interpreting the true geometrical degrees of freedom with applications in both classical and quantum gravity.

classification.title_zh: Plebanski 引力范式中的 Lanczos 势
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了广义相对论的一种新的 Plebanski 表述。关键区别在于我们使用一个由 Weyl 张量的 Lanczos 势导出的规范向量场。我们证明，在壳上，该规范向量场编码了所有非平凡引力自由度；并且在适当的 Lorentz 规范下，Bianchi 恒等式保证该规范向量场在 Ricci 平坦时空中满足无源波动方程。这一描述为诠释真实的几何自由度提供了新途径，并在经典引力和量子引力中都有应用。
classification.one_liner: 在 Plebanski 框架下用 Weyl 张量 Lanczos 势构造规范向量场，并证明其编码引力自由度且满足无源波动方程。

papers.title: Joint Model-independent Constraints on the Post-Newtonian Parameter and Cosmic Curvature from Galaxy-scale Strong Lensing, SNe Ia, BAO, and Cosmic Chronometers
papers.abstract: This investigation aims to test the validity of general relativity (GR) on kiloparsec scales via galaxy-scale strong gravitational lensing (SGL) combined with multiple cosmological probes. To circumvent the circularity problem induced by the presumption of a cosmological model based on GR, we apply the distance sum rule in the Friedmann-Lemaitre-Robertson-Walker (FLRW) metric to constrain the post-Newtonian parameter gamma PPN and spatial curvature Omega k independently of any cosmological model. The study introduces two methodological improvements: (i) parameterizing the dark-energy evolution factor with second-order Chebyshev orthogonal polynomials, which ensures uniformly high convergence across the full redshift baseline while retaining Omega k as an explicit free parameter; (ii) extending the original two-probe configuration (SGL + Type Ia supernovae) to a four-probe joint analysis that includes baryon acoustic oscillations and cosmic chronometers. Our results show that gamma PPN = 1.119 (+0.072/-0.072) and Omega k = 0.101 (+0.077/-0.076) at 68% confidence. The gamma PPN value is consistent with the GR prediction of unity at 1.7 sigma, while Omega k favors a mildly open universe, with flatness consistent at 2 sigma. Taking model-independent constraints as a benchmark, we quantify the systematic shift in gamma PPN induced by eight representative dark energy models, and find that all offsets are negligible, well below the baseline 1 sigma uncertainty, with no significant bias at current precision. These results confirm that conventional strong-lensing gravity tests introduce no measurable systematic bias, validating our model-independent framework.

classification.title_zh: 联合模型无关约束后牛顿参数与宇宙曲率：来自星系尺度强透镜、Ia型超新星、BAO和宇宙钟
classification.abstract_zh: 本工作旨在通过星系尺度强引力透镜（SGL）结合多种宇宙学探针，在千秒差距尺度检验广义相对论（GR）的有效性。为避免基于GR的宇宙学模型假设所导致的循环问题，我们使用FLRW度规中的距离和规则，在不依赖任何宇宙学模型的情况下约束后牛顿参数γ_PPN和空间曲率Ω_k。研究引入两项方法改进：(i) 用二阶Chebyshev正交多项式参数化暗能量演化因子，在全红移基线保持均匀高收敛性，同时保留Ω_k为显式自由参数；(ii) 将原先的双探针配置（SGL + Ia型超新星）扩展为四探针联合分析，加入重子声学振荡和宇宙钟。结果表明，在68%置信度下γ_PPN = 1.119 (+0.072/-0.072)，Ω_k = 0.101 (+0.077/-0.076)。γ_PPN在1.7σ内与GR预言的1一致，而Ω_k偏向轻微开放的宇宙，平坦性在2σ内一致。以模型无关约束为基准，我们量化了八种代表性暗能量模型引起的γ_PPN系统偏移，发现所有偏移都可忽略，远低于基线1σ不确定度，在當前精度下无显著偏置。这些结果确认常规强透镜引力检验未引入可测系统偏差，验证了我们的模型无关框架。
classification.one_liner: 利用强透镜与多种宇宙学探针在模型无关框架下联合约束γ_PPN和Ω_k，发现与GR一致且无显著暗能量模型系统偏置。

papers.title: Learning Inspiral-Merger-Ringdown Waveforms from a Post-Newtonian Baseline
papers.abstract: Modeling the full inspiral-merger-ringdown signal requires combining analytically controlled inspiral physics with the nonlinear strong-field information supplied by numerical relativity. We represent the numerical relativity contribution beyond an analytic inspiral waveform as residual amplitude and phase corrections. Retaining the leading-order frequency-domain amplitude and the $3.5$ Post-Newtonian TaylorF2 phase, we use a Kolmogorov-Arnold network to learn these residual corrections from SXS waveforms. After training, the learned corrections are stored as explicit spline functions, so waveform evaluation no longer requires the network itself. On $75$ simulations excluded from training and model selection, the model achieves a median flat-noise mismatch of $2.7\times10^{-5}$. Our results demonstrate a machine learning driven waveform modeling strategy in which numerical relativity augments, rather than replaces, analytically known waveform structure.

classification.title_zh: 从后牛顿基线学习旋进-并合-铃宕波形
classification.abstract_zh: 建模完整的旋进-并合-铃宕信号需要将解析可控的旋进物理与数值相对论提供的非线性强场信息结合起来。我们将超越解析旋进波形的数值相对论贡献表示为残余振幅和相位修正。保留领头阶频域振幅和 3.5 阶后牛顿 TaylorF2 相位，我们使用 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络从 SXS 波形中学习这些残余修正。训练后，学到的修正被存储为显式样条函数，因此波形评估不再需要网络本身。在未用于训练和模型选择的 75 个模拟上，该模型实现了 2.7×10^{-5} 的中位平坦噪声失配。我们的结果展示了一种机器学习驱动的波形建模策略：数值相对论增强而非取代已知的解析波形结构。
classification.one_liner: 用 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络从后牛顿基线学习数值相对论残余修正，以建模双黑洞旋进-并合-铃宕引力波波形。

papers.title: Novel higher-dimensional regular black holes in general relativity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics
papers.abstract: We present a formalism for constructing higher-dimensional regular black holes in general relativity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics, and propose a new class of electrically charged solutions that unifies the Bardeen and Hayward models in a single analytic form valid for any $D\geq4$. The Bardeen and Hayward solutions are shown to have a correct Maxwellian weak-field limit in five and six dimensions, respectively. The matter sector is written as a Hamiltonian density $\mathcal{H}(P)$ containing only fixed coupling constants, so that the mass and the charge enter as integration constants. The resulting theory has a two-parameter family of solutions, of which a one-parameter subfamily is regular, with the mass tied to the charge. We locate the radius at which the Lagrangian $\L(F)$ splits into two branches and show that it is always hidden inside the horizon for $D=4$ but can lie outside it near extremality for $D\geq5$. The null and weak energy conditions hold everywhere, while the strong energy condition is violated near the core. Building on our recent result that the first law holds in its standard form once the theory is fixed, we derive the horizon potential in closed form, the extended first law with the couplings as thermodynamic variables, and a generalized Smarr formula.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论耦合非线性电动力学中的新型高维规则黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在耦合非线性电动力学的广义相对论中构造高维规则黑洞的形式体系，并提出了一类新的带电解，将 Bardeen 和 Hayward 模型统一为适用于任意 D≥4 的单一解析形式。研究表明，Bardeen 和 Hayward 解分别在五维和六维中具有正确的麦克斯韦弱场极限。物质部分写为仅含固定耦合常数的哈密顿密度 H(P)，因此质量和电荷作为积分常数进入。所得理论具有双参数族解，其中一个单参数子族是规则的，且质量与电荷相关联。我们定位了拉格朗日量 L(F) 分裂为两支的半径，并表明对于 D=4 它总是隐藏于视界内，但对于 D≥5 在近极端情况下可位于视界外。零能量条件和弱能量条件处处成立，而强能量条件在核心附近被违反。基于我们最近关于一旦理论固定则第一定律保持标准形式的结果，我们以闭式导出了视界势、以耦合作为热力学变量的扩展第一定律以及广义 Smarr 公式。

papers.title: Ringdown and greybody signatures of rational regular black holes in non-polynomial gravity
papers.abstract: We study the quasinormal mode spectrum and wave-scattering properties of the four-dimensional rational regular black hole recently obtained in non-polynomial (quasi-topological) gravity. Using third-order WKB together with two independent cross-checks a Frobenius--Riccati shooting method and a time-domain evolution we compute the fundamental scalar, electromagnetic, and axial gravitational-type quasinormal frequencies, validating our approach against known Schwarzschild results. We find that as the geometry approaches extremality, its dimensionless ringing frequency is systematically suppressed relative to the Schwarzschild value, a direct and quantifiable imprint of the non-polynomial regularization that we trace, via the photon-sphere correspondence, to the response of the effective potential near the horizon. A Fisher-matrix estimate indicates that this suppression could in principle be resolved by a space-based detector such as LISA for a sufficiently massive and nearby source. We further compute, for the first time, the axial gravitational-type ringdown spectrum of this geometry using the Regge--Wheeler master equation, while noting that a full stability analysis of the underlying gravity theory remains an open problem requiring the linearized field equations of the modified action. Finally, we examine the greybody transmission factors across spins $s=0,1,2$ and show that they follow the same systematic ordering and near-extremal enhancement as the ringing-frequency suppression, pointing to a common physical origin. Together, these results give one of the first quantitative characterizations of the observational signatures and the remaining open theoretical questions of a regular black hole in modified gravity.

classification.title_zh: 非多项式引力中有理正则黑洞的铃宕与灰体特征
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了最近在非多项式（准拓扑）引力中得到的四维有理正则黑洞的准正规模谱和波散射性质。使用三阶 WKB 以及两个独立交叉检验——Frobenius-Riccati 打靶法和时域演化——我们计算了基本的标量、电磁和轴向引力型准正规模频率，并对照已知 Schwarzschild 结果验证了方法。我们发现，当几何趋近极端时，其无量纲铃宕频率相对于 Schwarzschild 值被系统性压低，这是非多项式正则化的直接且可量化印记；我们通过光子球对应将其追溯到视界附近有效势的响应。Fisher 矩阵估计表明，对于足够大质量且较近的源，这种压低原则上可被 LISA 等空间探测器分辨。我们进一步使用 Regge-Wheeler 主方程首次计算了该几何的轴向引力型铃宕谱，同时指出该底层引力理论的完整稳定性分析仍是一个开放问题，需要修改作用量的线性化场方程。最后，我们考察了自旋 s=0,1,2 的灰体透射因子，并表明它们遵循与铃宕频率压低相同的系统排序和近极端增强，指向共同的物理起源。总之，这些结果共同给出了修正引力中正则黑洞的观测特征和仍存理论开放问题的一种早期定量刻画。
classification.one_liner: 计算非多项式引力中有理正则黑洞的准正规模和灰体因子，发现近极端铃宕频率相对 Schwarzschild 被抑制并可望被 LISA 分辨。

papers.title: Null test of general relativity based on gravitational waves
papers.abstract: Several hundreds of gravitational wave events have been detected. They are good tools to investigate various fundamental problems, including tests of general relativity (GR) theory. Among the GR test schemes based on gravitational wave data, the parameterized scheme has been extensively studied by many groups including the LIGO-VIRGO-KAGRA collaboration (LVK). Existing results indicate that the deviation parameters from GR are small. In the current paper, we would like to estimate whether these deviation parameters are small enough to confirm GR. We transform the deviation parameters into mass--mass relations and, by comparing the resulting mass--mass relations from different parameters, we can estimate the probabilities that the data favor the GR theory. Applying our null test scheme to five O1/O2 binary black hole events, we find some GR deviation signatures but they are not conclusive yet. We also find no monotonic correlation between the network SNR and the strength of GR deviation, suggesting that the observed tensions are not simply driven by signal strength. Our null test scheme can be easily generalized and applied to all gravitational wave observation data.

classification.title_zh: 基于引力波的广义相对论零检验
classification.abstract_zh: 目前已探测到数百个引力波事件。它们是研究各种基本问题的良好工具，包括检验广义相对论（GR）理论。在基于引力波数据的GR检验方案中，参数化方案已被包括LIGO-VIRGO-KAGRA合作组（LVK）在内的许多团队广泛研究。现有结果表明，偏离GR的参数较小。在本文中，我们希望估计这些偏离参数是否小到足以确认GR。我们将偏离参数转化为质量-质量关系，并通过比较不同参数得到的质量-质量关系，估计数据支持GR理论的概率。将我们的零检验方案应用于五个O1/O2双黑洞事件，我们发现一些GR偏离迹象，但尚不具决定性。我们还发现网络信噪比与GR偏离强度之间没有单调相关性，表明所观测到的张力并非仅由信号强度驱动。我们的零检验方案可以容易地推广并应用于所有引力波观测数据。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种引力波零检验方案：把GR偏离参数映射为质量-质量关系，以估计数据支持广义相对论的概率，并在五个O1/O2双黑洞事件中发现非决定性偏离迹象。

papers.title: Finite-Temperature Axion-Admixed Neutron Stars in a Quarkyonic Crossover Framework
papers.abstract: We analyze the effect of axion contribution on the mass, radius and dimensionless deformability of a neutron star (NS) at finite temperature. Although the cooling of an NS is mainly due to the emission of neutrinos, additional cooling cannot be ruled out due to the emission of axions. The existence of an axion is needed for addressing the strong CP problem within the standard model. The Peccei-Quinn (PQ) symmetry breaking mechanism generates axions. They are pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone bosons. Their mass is extremely small but non-zero. This naturally resolves the fine-tuning problem of the strong CP-violating parameter ${\theta} \lesssim 10^{-10}$. We propose that a finite temperature NS feature a quark core surrounded by a baryonic medium admixed with the axions, which are pseudo scalar Goldstone bosons and are considered as strong candidates for the dark matter (DM). Unlike the original quarkyonic model, we formulate a quarkyonic-inspired smooth crossover equation of state (EoS) at finite temperatures. This smooth crossover avoids thermodynamic instabilities found in sharp first-order constructions. We add the axionic EoS to the finite temperature quarkyonic one and solve the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations to estimate the properties of the NS both with and without taking the axion into account at different temperatures. We find that the production of axions is maximum within a radius of $5-11$ km in the star's interior; however, the impact on the mass is significant, i.e., $\sim 60\%$ of axion mass concentrated in the central region of the star. We also find that the effect of temperature on the mass of NS is marginal unlike the radius. In general, the influence of axions is significant for the observational properties of NS. These results highlight the pivotal role of axion physics in neutron star phenomenology.

classification.title_zh: 在夸克子交叉框架中的有限温度轴子混合中子星
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析了轴子贡献对有限温度下中子星（NS）的质量、半径和无量纲形变率的影响。尽管中子星冷却主要由于中微子发射，但不能排除轴子发射导致的额外冷却。轴子的存在是解决标准模型中强CP问题所需要的。Peccei-Quinn（PQ）对称性破缺机制产生轴子。它们是赝Nambu-Goldstone玻色子。其质量极小但非零。这自然解决了强CP破坏参数 ${\theta} \lesssim 10^{-10}$ 的微调问题。我们提出有限温度中子星具有被重子介质包围的夸克核心，其中混合有轴子；轴子是赝标量Goldstone玻色子，并被认为是暗物质（DM）的有力候选者。与原始quarkyonic模型不同，我们在有限温度下构造了一个受quarkyonic启发的平滑交叉状态方程（EoS）。这种平滑交叉避免了尖锐一阶构造中出现的热力学不稳定性。我们将轴子EoS加入有限温度quarkyonic EoS，并求解Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff方程，以在不同温度下估计考虑和不考虑轴子时的中子星性质。我们发现轴子的产生在中子星内部5-11 km半径内最大；然而对质量的影响显著，即约60%的轴子质量集中在恒星中心区域。我们还发现温度对中子星质量的影响很小，而对半径则不然。总体而言，轴子对中子星的可观测性质有显著影响。这些结果凸显了轴子物理在中子星现象学中的关键作用。

papers.title: Constraining the Quadratic-mode Amplitude Coupling in GW250114
papers.abstract: Detecting quadratic quasi-normal modes in black hole ringdowns would provide evidence for nonlinear gravitational dynamics, while measuring their properties would enable tests of the corresponding predictions of general relativity. Specifically, second-order black hole perturbation theory predicts that their amplitudes scale with the product of the amplitudes of their parent linear modes, with a coupling coefficient that depends on the spin of the remnant black hole. This mode-specific coupling coefficient has not yet been directly measured from gravitational wave data. Here, we use Bayesian inference on the GW250114 ringdown, modeled with the $220$, $221$, and $220\times220$ modes, to infer the amplitude-coupling coefficient of the $220\times220$ mode. The inferred coefficient is consistent with predictions from numerical relativity fits and second-order perturbation theory; no comparison shows a deviation exceeding $1.3 \sigma$. Although the current data cannot distinguish among these spin-dependent predictions, this measurement establishes a basis for more stringent observational tests of nonlinear gravitational dynamics in black-hole ringdowns.

classification.title_zh: 在 GW250114 中约束二次模式振幅耦合
classification.abstract_zh: 在黑洞铃宕中探测二次准正规模将为非线性引力动力学提供证据，而测量其性质则可用于检验广义相对论的相应预言。具体而言，二阶黑洞微扰论预言这些模式的振幅正比于其母线性模式振幅的乘积，耦合系数依赖于残余黑洞的自旋。这一模式特定的耦合系数尚未直接从引力波数据中测得。本文对 GW250114 的铃宕进行贝叶斯推断，采用 220、221 和 220×220 模式建模，以推断 220×220 模式的振幅耦合系数。推断得到的系数与数值相对论拟合及二阶微扰论的预言一致；没有任何比较显示出超过 1.3σ 的偏离。尽管当前数据尚无法区分这些依赖自旋的预言，该测量为在黑洞铃宕中对非线性引力动力学进行更严格的观测检验奠定了基础。
classification.one_liner: 利用 GW250114 铃宕的贝叶斯推断测量 220×220 二次准正规模振幅耦合系数，结果与数值相对论拟合和二阶微扰论一致。
