papers.title: Quasinormal modes of type II-perturbation for dilaton-Euler-Heisenberg black holes
papers.abstract: We study the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of Type II perturbations for dilaton-Euler-Heisenberg (dEH) black holes. These perturbations consist of coupled even-parity gravitational and dilaton perturbations together with odd-parity electromagnetic perturbations. The background is described by mass $M$, magnetic charge $Q_m$, and dilaton coupling difference $\zeta=\alpha-\beta$ to the Euler-Heisenberg term. To find the QNM frequencies, we need to find the parameter space of $(\zeta, Q_m/M)$ that is free from vector ghosts. For the $\ell=1$ mode, the radiative block couples the dilaton and axial electromagnetic amplitudes, whereas the $\ell=2$ mode also contains metric amplitudes, so the frequencies are obtained from matrix-valued boundary-value problems. We calculate QNM frequencies for the fundamental ($n=0$) branch with direct integration and the Chebyshev pseudospectral method, and compare the two computations wherever their charge intervals overlap. We find that the $\ell=1,2$ modes in the $n=0$ branch remain damped over the ghost-free parameter domain, supporting the stability of dEH black holes against Type II perturbations. The Type I sector will be presented elsewhere; no claim is made here about that sector, higher multipoles, or overtones.

classification.title_zh: dilaton-Euler-Heisenberg 黑洞 Type II 扰动的拟正则模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 dilaton-Euler-Heisenberg (dEH) 黑洞 Type II 扰动的拟正则模（QNM）。这些扰动由耦合的偶宇称引力与 dilaton 扰动，以及奇宇称电磁扰动组成。背景由质量 M、磁荷 Q_m 和与 Euler-Heisenberg 项的 dilaton 耦合差 ζ=α−β 描述。为求 QNM 频率，需要找到无矢量鬼的 (ζ, Q_m/M) 参数空间。对于 ℓ=1 模式，辐射块耦合 dilaton 与轴电磁振幅；ℓ=2 模式还包含度规振幅，因此频率由矩阵值边值问题得到。我们用直接积分法和 Chebyshev 伪谱法计算基频（n=0）支的 QNM 频率，并在电荷区间重叠处比较两种计算。我们发现，在无鬼参数域内，n=0 支的 ℓ=1,2 模式保持阻尼，这支持 dEH 黑洞对 Type II 扰动的稳定性。Type I 部分将另文给出；本文不对该部分、更高多极或泛音作任何断言。
classification.one_liner: 通过直接积分与 Chebyshev 伪谱法计算 dEH 黑洞 Type II 扰动基频 QNM，发现无鬼参数区内 ℓ=1,2 模式阻尼，支持稳定性。

papers.title: Unpolarized Low-Frequency Tail of Causal Chiral Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: Parity violation in the early Universe may lead to a chiral gravitational wave background. We show that, for finite-time parity-violating sources, the low-frequency tail of the generated chiral gravitational wave background is universally unpolarized, and that the chirality fraction decreases linearly with frequency. Our result generally applies to any parity-violating gravitational-wave source that appears quadratically in the wave equation. We consider both Gaussian sources and explicit trispectrum templates. We attribute the lack of chirality of the low-frequency tail to the fact that, on large scales, gravitational wave generation is almost equally inefficient for both helicities.

classification.title_zh: 因果手性引力波的无偏振低频尾部
classification.abstract_zh: 早期宇宙中的宇称破缺可能导致手性引力波背景。我们表明，对于有限时间的宇称破缺源，所生成的手性引力波背景的低频尾部普遍是无偏振的，并且手性分数随频率线性减小。我们的结果普遍适用于任何在波动方程中以二次形式出现的宇称破缺引力波源。我们考虑了高斯源和显式的三谱模板。我们将低频尾部缺乏手性归因于：在大尺度上，引力波产生对两种螺旋度几乎同样低效。

papers.title: Optical and Dynamical Signatures of Pad\'{e} Approximated Wormholes in $f(T)$ Gravity
papers.abstract: We construct traversable wormhole solutions in the linear teleparallel model $f(T) = \alpha T + \beta$, adopting Pad\'e approximants of order [1/0] and [0/1] as shape functions together with the redshift function $\Phi(r) = -M/r$, and derive the corresponding source terms from the modified field equations. We assess the physical viability of both configurations through the energy conditions, Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff equilibrium, the volume integral quantifier, thin-shell junction matching to an exterior Schwarzschild vacuum, embedding diagrams, proper radial distance, the gravitational energy and the active mass. We then examine the observational signatures of each geometry by analysing equatorial null geodesics and the photon-sphere structure, computing shadow maps and radial intensity profiles, ray-tracing relativistic images of a geometrically thin accretion disc, and integrating timelike rosette orbits. Finally, we study the dynamical stability of both wormholes through a third-order WKB quasinormal-mode analysis across scalar, electromagnetic, and axial gravitational perturbations, cross-checked against time-domain evolution and the eikonal photon-sphere correspondence, and examine the parameter dependence of the mode spectrum together with the possibility of trapped-mode echoes.

classification.title_zh: f(T) 引力中 Padé 近似虫洞的光学与动力学特征
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在线性遥平行模型 f(T)=αT+β 中构造可穿越虫洞解，采用 [1/0] 和 [0/1] 阶 Padé 近似作为形状函数，并与红移函数 Φ(r)=-M/r 结合，从修改场方程推导相应源项。我们通过能量条件、Tolman–Oppenheimer–Volkoff 平衡、体积积分量、与外部 Schwarzschild 真空的薄壳衔接匹配、嵌入图、固有径向距离、引力能与活动质量来评估两种位形的物理可行性。随后，我们分析赤道零测地线与光子球结构，计算阴影图和径向强度分布，对几何薄吸积盘的相对论像进行光线追踪，并积分类时玫瑰轨道，以考察每种几何的观测信号。最后，我们通过覆盖标量、电磁和轴向引力扰动的三阶 WKB 准正规模分析研究两种虫洞的动力学稳定性，并与时域演化及 eikonal 光子球对应关系交叉检验，同时考察模谱的参数依赖以及囚禁模回声的可能性。
classification.one_liner: 在 f(T)=αT+β 中构造 Padé 近似可穿越虫洞，并评估其能量条件、光学阴影/吸积盘成像与三阶 WKB 准正规模稳定性。

papers.title: Rotating black holes surrounded by PFDM in STVG: shadow studies and eikonal QNM
papers.abstract: We investigate the optical and dynamical properties of a rotating black hole in scalar--tensor--vector gravity (STVG) surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter (PFDM). Starting from the static STVG--PFDM geometry, we consider a Kerr-like rotating extension characterized by the spin parameter $a$, the STVG coupling $\alpha$, and the PFDM parameter $\lambda$. We first examine the horizon structure and a radial effective mass function, then analyze null geodesics and unstable spherical photon orbits. We use these results to construct the black-hole shadow and study its size, distortion, and dependence on model parameters and observer inclination. We then compare the predicted angular shadow diameter with the Event Horizon Telescope observations of M87$^*$ and Sgr A$^*$ in the $(a,\alpha)$ parameter space for representative values of the PFDM parameter. The comparison shows that the PFDM contribution can shift the parameter-space region compatible with the observed shadow diameter, while the shadow size is generally less sensitive to spin than to deformation. We further estimate the Hawking energy-emission spectrum in the high-frequency geometric-optics approximation, using the shadow radius as an effective absorption scale. Finally, we study the quasinormal-mode spectrum in the eikonal limit through the correspondence between unstable photon orbits and ringdown frequencies. The numerical results recover the expected Schwarzschild limit and show a clear separation between the prograde and retrograde modes as the spin increases. The combined analysis provides a consistent optical, energy emission and ringdown characterization of the rotating STVG--PFDM geometry.

classification.title_zh: STVG 中由完美流体暗物质包围的旋转黑洞：阴影研究与 eikonal 准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在标量-张量-矢量引力（STVG）中、被完美流体暗物质（PFDM）包围的旋转黑洞的光学与动力学性质。从静态 STVG--PFDM 几何出发，我们考虑由自旋参数 a、STVG 耦合 α 和 PFDM 参数 λ 刻画的类 Kerr 旋转推广。我们首先考察视界结构和径向有效质量函数，然后分析零测地线和不稳定球面光子轨道。利用这些结果，我们构建黑洞阴影，并研究其大小、畸变以及对模型参数和观测者倾角的依赖。随后，对于 PFDM 参数的代表性取值，我们在 (a,α) 参数空间中把预测的角阴影直径与 Event Horizon Telescope 对 M87* 和 Sgr A* 的观测进行比较。比较表明，PFDM 贡献可以移动与观测阴影直径相容的参数空间区域，而阴影大小通常对自旋的敏感性低于对形变的敏感性。我们进一步在高频几何光学近似下估算霍金能量发射谱，将阴影半径用作有效吸收尺度。最后，我们通过不稳定光子轨道与铃宕频率之间的对应关系研究 eikonal 极限下的准正规模谱。数值结果恢复了预期的 Schwarzschild 极限，并显示随着自旋增加，顺行与逆行模式出现清晰分离。联合分析给出了旋转 STVG--PFDM 几何在光学、能量发射和铃宕方面的一致刻画。

papers.title: Proper Time Shifts in Pulsar Timing Arrays
papers.abstract: Pulsar timing arrays are a powerful tool for probing low-frequency gravitational phenomena and physics beyond the Standard Model. We establish a general, gauge-invariant framework for the timing residual by identifying the measurable quantity as the proper time interval between consecutive pulse arrivals at Earth. In linearized general relativity, we derive a general expression for this proper time shift and show that it decomposes into Doppler, Shapiro, and Einstein delay contributions whose sum is gauge invariant, similar to frameworks that have been developed for other gravitational-wave detectors such as laser and atom interferometers. We also provide a recipe for computing the resulting timing residual for any specified perturbation, and we illustrate the method with several physically well-motivated sources, recovering known results where they exist in the literature. This recipe can be directly applied to search for new physics from real pulsar timing data using existing numerical software.

classification.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列中的固有时偏移
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列是探测低频引力现象和超出标准模型物理的有力工具。我们为计时残差建立了一个一般且规范不变的框架，将可测量量确定为地球处连续脉冲到达之间的固有时间隔。在线性化广义相对论中，我们推导了该固有时偏移的一般表达式，并表明它分解为多普勒、夏皮罗和爱因斯坦延迟贡献，其总和是规范不变的，类似于为激光干涉仪和原子干涉仪等其他引力波探测器开发过的框架。我们还给出了对任意指定微扰计算所得计时残差的方案，并用若干物理上动机良好的源说明该方法，在文献中存在已知结果之处重现了它们。该方案可直接应用于使用现有数值软件从真实脉冲星计时数据中搜寻新物理。
classification.one_liner: 为脉冲星计时阵列建立规范不变的固有时偏移框架，将计时残差分解为多普勒、夏皮罗和爱因斯坦延迟，并给出可计算任意微扰的方案。

papers.title: Cosmography with gravitational waves I: Taylor expansion in the low-redshift regime
papers.abstract: We evaluate the capability of current and next-generation gravitational-wave detectors, including Advanced LIGO, the Einstein Telescope, and DECIGO, to probe cosmographic parameters using electromagnetically bright standard sirens. Adopting a third-order Taylor expansion, we examine the constraints primarily as a function of the number of detections and, in a complementary analysis, across correlated SNR--redshift regimes. Advanced LIGO can provide a distance-ladder-independent measurement of $H_0$ at the percent level. As the catalogue size increases, the Einstein Telescope reaches subpercent precision on $H_0$ and measures $q_0$ at the tens-of-percent level. DECIGO extends this sensitivity to $j_0$, achieving precision at the few-tens-of-percent level.

classification.title_zh: 引力波宇宙学 I：低红移区的泰勒展开
classification.abstract_zh: 我们评估当前与下一代引力波探测器，包括 Advanced LIGO、Einstein Telescope 和 DECIGO，利用电磁增亮标准汽笛探测宇宙学参数的能力。采用三阶泰勒展开，我们主要考察约束如何随探测数量变化，并在互补分析中考察在相关信噪比—红移区域内的表现。Advanced LIGO 可提供不依赖距离阶梯的百分级 H0 测量。随着目录规模增加，Einstein Telescope 对 H0 达到亚百分级精度，并将 q0 测量到百分之几十的水平。DECIGO 将这一灵敏度扩展到 j0，达到百分之几十的精度。
classification.one_liner: 评估 Advanced LIGO、Einstein Telescope 和 DECIGO 用标准汽笛在低红移区通过三阶泰勒展开约束 H0、q0、j0 的能力。

papers.title: Turbulent Dynamo Action in Binary Neutron Star Mergers
papers.abstract: We perform general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamics zoom-in simulations of the merger of two neutron stars starting with pulsar-like realistic initial magnetic field. We employ unprecedented grid resolution down to $\Delta x \simeq 2.9~{\rm m}$. We find rapid amplification of the magnetic energy at small scales, and demonstrate the action of a small-scale turbulent dynamo. We find evidence that ordered large-scale magnetic structures emerge already during the early post-merger evolution. These results indicate that strong magnetic fields can be established promptly after merger, with important consequences for the electromagnetic counterparts of binary neutron star mergers.

classification.title_zh: 双中子星并合中的湍流发电机作用
classification.abstract_zh: 我们对两颗中子星的并合进行了广义相对论磁流体力学 zoom-in 模拟，初始磁场采用类脉冲星的真实磁场。我们使用了前所未有的网格分辨率，低至 Δx≃2.9 m。我们发现在小尺度上磁能快速放大，并证明存在小尺度湍流发电机作用。我们发现证据表明，在并合后早期演化中就已经出现有序的大尺度磁场结构。这些结果表明，并合后可以迅速建立起强磁场，这对双中子星并合的电磁对应体具有重要影响。
classification.one_liner: 广义相对论磁流体力学高分辨率模拟表明，双中子星并合后小尺度湍流发电机可迅速放大磁场并形成大尺度有序结构。

papers.title: How significant is the lensing interpretation of GW231123?
papers.abstract: GW231123 is one of the most unusual gravitational-wave (GW) events, with exceptionally large inferred masses and near-extremal spins, offering an opportunity to test whether propagation effects contribute to these properties. We therefore examine whether the data support wave-optics microlensing embedded in a strong-lensing galaxy, whose detection becomes increasingly likely as observations accumulate, whether this interpretation can explain these properties, and how significant the preference remains under detector noise and waveform systematics. We compare six hypotheses: unlensed, isolated point mass, and embedded point-mass (EPM) and binary-lens (EB) effective models in Type-I (minimum) and Type-II (saddle) macro images. The EB Type-I model is most favored. For the most accurate waveform model NRSur7dq4, it gives $\log_{10}B^{\rm EB-I}_{\rm U}=2.60$, versus $0.89$ for Type II, indicating sensitivity to macro-image geometry. Within Type I, however, the binary improves over the point mass by only $\log_{10}B^{\rm EB-I}_{\rm EPM-I}=0.16$ and $\Delta\ln\mathcal{L}_{\max}=0.56$, providing no clear evidence for structure beyond a single effective perturber. Moreover, under embedded lensing, waveform-template discrepancies and inferred masses and spins are reduced. However, real O4a backgrounds from numerical-relativity injections show that the apparent lensing evidence is sensitive to waveform systematics and realistic detector noise: although the commonly used waveform IMRPhenomXPHM gives the largest Bayes factor, $\log_{10}B^{\rm EB-I}_{\rm U}=4.52$, it is less exceptional relative to its own background, with a false-alarm probability of $6.5$--$8\%$, whereas NRSur7dq4 gives only $2$--$3\%$. Thus, waveform systematics can amplify apparent lensing evidence, but GW231123 remains an intriguing lensing candidate.

classification.title_zh: GW231123 的透镜解释有多显著？
classification.abstract_zh: GW231123 是最不寻常的引力波事件之一，其推断质量极大且自旋接近极端，这为检验传播效应是否贡献于这些性质提供了机会。因此，我们考察数据是否支持嵌入在强透镜星系中的波光学微透镜——随着观测积累，探测到它的可能性越来越大——这种解释能否说明这些性质，以及在探测器噪声和波形系统误差下这种偏好是否仍然显著。我们比较六种假设：未透镜、孤立点质量，以及 Type-I（极小）和 Type-II（鞍点）宏观像中的嵌入点质量（EPM）和双透镜（EB）有效模型。EB Type-I 模型最受偏好。对于最精确的波形模型 NRSur7dq4，它给出 log10 B^{EB-I}_U = 2.60，而 Type II 为 0.89，表明对宏观像几何敏感。然而，在 Type I 内，双透镜相对于点质量仅改善 log10 B^{EB-I}_{EPM-I}=0.16 和 Δln L_max=0.56，没有明确证据表明存在单个有效扰动体之外的结构。此外，在嵌入透镜下，波形模板差异以及推断的质量和自旋被减小。但是，来自数值相对论注入的真实 O4a 背景表明，表观透镜证据对波形系统误差和真实探测器噪声敏感：虽然常用波形 IMRPhenomXPHM 给出最大的 Bayes 因子 log10 B^{EB-I}_U=4.52，但相对于其自身背景并不那么异常，误报概率为 6.5–8%，而 NRSur7dq4 仅给出 2–3%。因此，波形系统误差可以放大表观透镜证据，但 GW231123 仍是一个有趣的透镜候选。
classification.one_liner: 重新评估 GW231123 的强透镜/微透镜解释，发现证据依赖波形模型且受系统误差影响，但仍是有趣的候选。

papers.title: A Neural Network Approach to Preferred Event Selection for Low-Latency Gravitational-Wave Alerts
papers.abstract: The LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA collaboration uses multiple independent search pipelines to detect gravitational waves, often resulting in multiple triggers (g-events) for a single astrophysical source. These triggers are grouped into superevents, raising a critical question for multimessenger astronomy: which g-event provides the most accurate sky localization for electromagnetic follow-up? Currently, the g-event with the highest signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is selected, under the assumption that it should provide the best estimators of the source's parameters, including its location on the sky. Analysis of simulated signals reveals systematic deviations from this expectation. In particular, a false-alarm rate (FAR)-based selector performs slightly better than the SNR-based method, but introduces pipeline biases. We present a neural network-based selector trained on simulated signals to identify the g-event with the minimum searched area -- a metric quantifying localization accuracy. The network uses information (detector SNRs, FAR, and chirp mass) from all of the triggers associated with each astrophysical source and is designed to be pipeline-agnostic. Our results show that the neural network outperforms both traditional selectors, achieving a mean searched area ~2% smaller than the SNR-based selector. Unlike FAR-based selection, the neural network preserves the underlying distribution of pipeline contributions, avoiding systematic biases toward specific pipelines. The network can be trained in approximately one minute on a few thousand events and performs event selection instantaneously, making it suitable for low-latency applications. These results demonstrate that machine learning can enhance multimessenger astronomy capabilities while maintaining fairness across detection pipelines. We recommend implementing this approach for future observing runs.

classification.title_zh: 面向低延迟引力波警报的优选事件选择神经网络方法
classification.abstract_zh: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 合作组使用多个独立搜索管道探测引力波，这常常导致同一个天体物理源对应多个触发（g-events）。这些触发被归并为超级事件（superevents），由此给多信使天文学提出一个关键问题：哪一个 g-event 能为电磁对应体跟踪提供最准确的天区定位？目前选择信噪比（SNR）最高的 g-event，假设它应能给出源参数（包括天区位置）的最佳估计。对模拟信号的分析表明，这一预期存在系统性偏差。特别是，基于虚警率（FAR）的选择器略优于基于 SNR 的方法，但会引入管道偏差。我们提出一种基于神经网络的选择器，用模拟信号训练，以识别具有最小搜索面积（量化定位精度的指标）的 g-event。该网络使用与每个天体物理源相关的所有触发的信息（探测器 SNR、FAR 和啁啾质量），并设计为与管道无关。结果表明，该神经网络优于两种传统选择器，其平均搜索面积比基于 SNR 的选择器小约 2%。与基于 FAR 的选择不同，该神经网络保持管道贡献的底层分布，避免对特定管道的系统性偏好。该网络可在几分钟内在数千个事件上完成训练，并即时执行事件选择，适用于低延迟应用。这些结果表明，机器学习可以在保持各探测管道公平性的同时增强多信使天文学能力。我们建议在未来观测运行中采用这一方法。
classification.one_liner: 用神经网络从多个引力波触发中挑选定位最优的 g-event，以改善低延迟多信使跟踪，且不引入管道偏差。

papers.title: Resumming Kerr Quasinormal-Mode Frequencies: Accuracy and Breakdown Near Extremality
papers.abstract: Kerr black-hole quasinormal modes are usually computed with numerical methods, but analytic approximations remain useful for identifying the physics that controls different parts of the spectrum. In this paper, we ask whether the divergent, high-order Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin (WKB) expansion about the peak of the Chandrasekhar-Detweiler potential can be made predictive through Pad\'e and Borel-Pad\'e resummation. We develop two complementary implementations: a semi-analytic slow-rotation expansion in the dimensionless spin $a$ (carried out through 21st WKB order), and a fixed-spin Pad\'e-WKB implementation for the resummed frequency equation (carried out through 41st WKB order). In the slow-rotation regime, the 21st-order resummed expansion is significantly more accurate than the fourth-order approximation found previously. For damped modes at larger spins, the fixed-point iteration agrees well with Leaver's method, reaching fractional errors below $10^{-7}$ in the real part of the fundamental $m=0$ mode at $a=0.99$. The same strategy fails for modes that approach the zero-damped branch near extremality. We trace this breakdown to the near-horizon structure of the Chandrasekhar-Detweiler potential. As the extremal limit is approached, nearby poles produce rapid variation on the throat scale, so a local Taylor expansion about the potential peak no longer uniformly captures the relevant region.

classification.title_zh: 重求和 Kerr 准正规模频率：近极端自旋下的精度与失效
classification.abstract_zh: Kerr 黑洞准正规模通常用数值方法计算，但解析近似仍有助于识别控制不同谱段行为的物理。本文考察能否通过 Padé 与 Borel-Padé 重求和，使围绕 Chandrasekhar-Detweiler 势峰值的发散高阶 WKB 展开具有预测能力。我们发展了两套互补实现：无量纲自旋 a 的半解析慢转展开（计算至第 21 阶 WKB），以及针对重求和频率方程的固定自旋 Padé-WKB 实现（计算至第 41 阶 WKB）。在慢转区域，第 21 阶重求和展开显著优于此前四阶近似。对于较大自旋的阻尼模，不动点迭代与 Leaver 方法符合良好；在 a=0.99 时，基频 m=0 模实部分数误差低于 10^{-7}。但同一策略对近极端自旋时趋近零阻尼支的模失效。我们将此失效追溯到 Chandrasekhar-Detweiler 势的近视界结构：当接近极端极限时，邻近极点导致喉区尺度上的快速变化，因此围绕势峰值的局域 Taylor 展开不再一致地覆盖相关区域。
classification.one_liner: 通过 Padé/Borel-Padé 重求和高阶 WKB，Kerr 准正规模频率在慢转与大自旋阻尼模下精度提升，但近极端零阻尼支因势结构失效。

papers.title: Tests of general relativity using analytic derivatives of parametrized post-Einsteinian gravitational waveforms within the Fisher-matrix framework
papers.abstract: Testing gravity beyond general relativity (GR) is essential for probing fundamental physics in the strong-field and highly dynamical regime accessed by gravitational-wave (GW) observations. In this work, we derive analytic expressions for waveform derivatives in the Fisher-matrix formalism within the parametrized post-Einsteinian framework, using the frequency-domain inspiral waveform. These analytic derivatives enable stable and efficient Fisher-matrix calculations without relying on finite-difference schemes. We apply this method to a wide range of detector configurations, including space-based, ground-based, and multiband observations, and combine it with different binary black hole population models. Our results reveal clear and systematic trends in the constraints on non-GR effects as functions of post-Newtonian order, detector type, and source population. They also demonstrate the complementarity between space- and ground-based detectors, particularly for effects that accumulate during the low-frequency inspiral. The analytic approach substantially reduces computational cost and avoids numerical systematics associated with step-size choices, making it well suited for large-scale parameter studies. These results provide robust forecasts for the capability of future GW observations to constrain a broad class of non-GR effects and environmental influences, highlighting the scientific potential of upcoming detector networks for precision tests of gravity.

classification.title_zh: 在Fisher矩阵框架内利用参数化后爱因斯坦引力波形的解析导数检验广义相对论
classification.abstract_zh: 检验超越广义相对论（GR）的引力对于探测引力波（GW）观测所触及的强场和高动态区域中的基础物理至关重要。在本工作中，我们在参数化后爱因斯坦框架内，利用频率域旋近波形，推导了Fisher矩阵形式中波形导数的解析表达式。这些解析导数使得无需依赖有限差分方案即可进行稳定且高效的Fisher矩阵计算。我们将该方法应用于广泛的探测器配置，包括空间基、地面基和多波段观测，并将其与不同的双黑洞族群模型结合。我们的结果揭示了非GR效应约束作为后牛顿阶、探测器类型和源族群函数时清晰且系统性的趋势。它们还展示了空间基与地面基探测器之间的互补性，特别是对于在低频旋近期间累积的效应。该解析方法大幅降低了计算成本，并避免了与步长选择相关的数值系统误差，使其非常适合大规模参数研究。这些结果为未来GW观测约束一大类非GR效应和环境影响提供了稳健预测，突出了即将到来的探测器网络在引力精密检验方面的科学潜力。

papers.title: Red noise and evolving signals: a complete frequentist approach to supermassive black hole binary searches with pulsar timing arrays
papers.abstract: Searches for gravitational waves (GWs) from isolated supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) in pulsar timing array (PTA) data require simultaneous estimation of signal and noise parameters, so the dimensionality of the fit scales with the number of observed pulsars. This computational difficulty is exacerbated when source evolution from GW emission is included, since retaining both Earth and pulsar terms introduces the unknown pulsar distances. Existing frequentist methods such as the $\mathcal{F}$-statistic are restricted to non-evolving sources. In addition, they often rely on a noise covariance estimated from the same data and then held fixed during the signal search, which can bias parameter estimates. We present a Generalized Likelihood Ratio Test and the associated $\mathcal{T}$-statistic that overcomes the aforementioned limitations. This formulation extends earlier work in which the dimensionality of the fitting problem was drastically reduced by semi-analytical maximization of the likelihood over the pulsar phase parameters, followed by efficient global optimization over the remaining parameters using Particle Swarm Optimization. Our simulations demonstrate that for an evolving SMBHB signal with chirp mass $\mathcal{M}=10^{9.2} M_\odot$ and signal-to-noise ratio $20$, this detection statistic achieves a $100\%$ detection probability at a false-alarm probability of $0.06$ in a 30-pulsar timing array, which is characterized by a $100 \mathrm{ns}$ root-mean-square white noise residual and pulsar-specific red noise. For the 30-pulsar timing array at signal-to-noise ratio $10$ and false-alarm probability $0.06$, $\mathcal{T}$ detects $99/100$ realizations, outperforming the $\mathcal{F}_p$ statistic evaluated with the $H_0$-fitted covariance, which detects $71/100$ realizations.

classification.title_zh: 红噪声与演化信号：脉冲星计时阵列搜寻超大质量双黑洞的完整频率派方法
classification.abstract_zh: 在脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）数据中搜寻来自孤立超大质量双黑洞（SMBHB）的引力波，需要同时估计信号与噪声参数，因此拟合的维数会随观测脉冲星数目增加而增大。当纳入由引力波辐射导致的源演化时，这一计算困难进一步加剧，因为保留地球项和脉冲星项会引入未知的脉冲星距离。现有频率派方法（如 F-统计量）仅适用于非演化源。此外，它们通常依赖从同一数据估计出的噪声协方差，并在信号搜索期间保持固定，这可能导致参数估计偏差。我们提出了一种广义似然比检验及相应的 T-统计量，克服了上述限制。该形式推广了此前的工作：通过半解析地对脉冲星相位参数最大化似然，大幅降低拟合问题的维数，然后使用粒子群优化对其余参数进行高效全局优化。我们的模拟表明，对于啁啾质量 M=10^9.2 M_sun、信噪比为 20 的演化 SMBHB 信号，该检测统计量在 30 颗脉冲星计时阵列中，在虚警概率为 0.06 时达到 100% 的检测概率；该阵列具有 100 ns 均方根白噪声残差和脉冲星特定红噪声。对于信噪比为 10、虚警概率为 0.06 的 30 脉冲星计时阵列，T-统计量在 100 次实现中检测到 99 次，优于用 H0 拟合协方差评估的 F_p 统计量，后者在 100 次实现中检测到 71 次。
classification.one_liner: 提出用于脉冲星计时阵列中演化超大质量双黑洞引力波搜索的广义似然比检验和 T-统计量，可同时处理红噪声并优于 F-统计量。

papers.title: On spherically symmetric Berwald vacuum solutions in Finsler gravity
papers.abstract: Berwald-Finsler spacetimes are Finsler spacetimes that are closest to pseudo-Riemannian geometry, as their canonical nonlinear connection defines an affine connection on spacetime. In this paper, we find the first exact, non-Ricci flat, $SO(3)$-symmetric Berwald solutions to the Finsler gravity vacuum equation. To this aim, we first select from all spherically symmetric Berwald spacetimes, the only class that admits flat Finsler spacetime structures, making it particularly suitable for future investigations of asymptotic flatness. Then, for this class, we completely solve the Finsler gravity vacuum equation, and find three families of solutions. In particular, we show that in Finsler geometry there exist $SO(3)$-symmetric, vacuum solutions that are not Ricci-flat. These solutions are promising candidates to model the gravitational field around compact objects, beyond their Riemannian description.

classification.title_zh: 论Finsler引力中球对称Berwald真空解
classification.abstract_zh: Berwald-Finsler时空是一类最接近伪黎曼几何的Finsler时空，其正则非线性联络在时空上定义了一个仿射联络。本文找到了Finsler引力真空方程的首个精确、非Ricci平坦、SO(3)对称的Berwald解。为此，作者首先从所有球对称Berwald时空中选出唯一允许平坦Finsler时空结构的类，这一类特别适合未来研究渐近平坦性。然后，对该类完全求解Finsler引力真空方程，并找到三族解。特别地，作者表明在Finsler几何中存在SO(3)对称的真空解，它们不是Ricci平坦的。这些解有望用于在黎曼描述之外模拟致密天体周围的引力场。
classification.one_liner: 在Finsler引力中首次得到球对称、非Ricci平坦的Berwald真空精确解，为致密天体引力的Finsler描述提供候选模型。

papers.title: Late-Time Dynamics in Accelerating Nonlinear $f(T)$ Gravity via Hybrid Scale Factor : Bayesian Analysis and Cosmological implications
papers.abstract: This study offers a comprehensive reconstruction of $f(T)$ gravity model with three distinct non-linear as well as novel forms employing a hybrid scale factor to depict the expansion history of the universe. We investigate a physically motivated cosmological parametrization through this hybrid scale factor that can explain a smooth transition from an early decelerated epoch to the present accelerated evolution. This scale factor is then used to derive the corresponding model parameters. These parameters are rigorously constrained using the Monte Carlo Markov Chain (MCMC) analysis with the help of Bayesian statistics and incorporating late-time observations from Hubble, Baryon Acoustic Oscillations (BAO) and Patheon+SH0ES datasets. The investigation of dynamical parameters such as the equation of state parameter and cosmological parameters indicates alignment with an accelerated expansion phase in both the present and late time epochs. Validation is conducted by assessing the energy conditions, verifying the feasibility of the model forms with particular emphasis on the violation of the strong energy condition that indicates dark energy dominance in modified gravity scenarios. This investigation has been instrumental in determining models that remain consistent with cosmological observations and theoretical requirements. The reconstructed forms of the model effectively mimic $\Lambda$CDM at late times, providing significant insights into possible extensions of general relativity and bolstering $f(T)$ gravity theory as a robust explanation for cosmic acceleration.

classification.title_zh: 通过混合尺度因子研究加速非线性 f(T) 引力中的晚期动力学：贝叶斯分析与宇宙学启示
classification.abstract_zh: 本研究利用混合尺度因子，对具有三种不同非线性且新颖形式的 f(T) 引力模型进行了综合重构，以描述宇宙的膨胀历史。我们考察了一种有物理动机的宇宙学参数化，该混合尺度因子可解释从早期减速阶段到当前加速演化的平滑过渡，并由此导出相应的模型参数。利用贝叶斯统计和 MCMC 分析，结合 Hubble、重子声学振荡（BAO）和 Pantheon+SH0ES 晚期观测数据，对这些参数进行了严格约束。对状态方程参数和宇宙学参数等动力学量的研究显示，当前和晚期都符合加速膨胀阶段。通过检验能量条件验证模型，尤其强调强能量条件被违反，表明在修改引力场景中暗能量占主导。该研究有助于确定与宇宙学观测和理论要求一致的模型。重构的模型形式在晚期能有效模拟 ΛCDM，为广义相对论的可能扩展提供了重要见解，并支持 f(T) 引力理论作为宇宙加速的稳健解释。
classification.one_liner: 论文用混合尺度因子重构非线性 f(T) 引力模型，并结合晚期宇宙学观测做贝叶斯参数约束与能量条件检验。

papers.title: PANGU I: A Parthenon-Based Framework for Fixed-Spacetime GRMHD
papers.abstract: Existing general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamics (GRMHD) codes offer complementary capabilities, but these capabilities remain distributed across different frameworks. To unify them, we introduce PANGU--Parthenon-Based Astrophysics for Numerical Relativity and GRMHD in a Unified Framework--a modular computational framework that integrates a shared solver across physical regimes, flexible spacetime geometry, and extensible computational infrastructure within a single architecture. In the first paper of this series, we present and validate the fixed-spacetime GRMHD component of PANGU. The shared solver combines finite-volume Godunov methods with constrained transport on uniform and block-structured, statically refined meshes, and covers hydrodynamics and magnetohydrodynamics in Newtonian, special-relativistic, and general-relativistic regimes. PANGU provides a flexible geometry interface supporting coordinate selection and either on-the-fly or precomputed evaluation of prescribed stationary spacetimes, demonstrated here in Kerr spacetime with Cartesian Kerr-Schild and modified Kerr-Schild coordinates; additional components can be incorporated without restructuring the core solver. Verification covers all three regimes on uniform and statically refined meshes: smooth Newtonian and special-relativistic problems approach second order against their analytic solutions, with deliberately matched double-precision trajectories agreeing with AthenaK to roundoff; in fixed-spacetime GRMHD, the stationary analytic solutions are preserved to second order, and the turbulent accretion reproduces the same flow and flux scales as BHAC. Together, these results establish the fixed-spacetime matter-sector foundation for the broader PANGU framework. Numerical-relativity and coupled dynamical-spacetime GRMHD capabilities will be presented in subsequent work.

classification.title_zh: PANGU I：基于 Parthenon 的固定时空 GRMHD 框架
classification.abstract_zh: 现有广义相对论磁流体力学（GRMHD）程序各有互补能力，但这些能力分散在不同框架中。为统一它们，我们提出 PANGU——Parthenon-Based Astrophysics for Numerical Relativity and GRMHD in a Unified Framework——一个模块化计算框架，在单一架构内整合跨物理区域的共享求解器、灵活的时空几何和可扩展计算基础设施。在本系列第一篇论文中，我们展示并验证 PANGU 的固定时空 GRMHD 组件。该共享求解器将有限体积 Godunov 方法与约束传输（constrained transport）结合，适用于均匀网格和块结构静态加密网格，并覆盖牛顿、狭义相对论和广义相对论区域下的流体力学与磁流体力学。PANGU 提供灵活的几何接口，支持坐标选择以及在线或预计算指定的稳态时空，本文在 Kerr 时空中用笛卡尔 Kerr-Schild 和修改 Kerr-Schild 坐标进行演示；附加组件可加入而无需重构核心求解器。验证涵盖均匀与静态加密网格上的全部三个区域：光滑牛顿和狭义相对论问题相对解析解达到二阶收敛，且特意匹配的双精度轨迹与 AthenaK 符合到舍入误差；在固定时空 GRMHD 中，稳态解析解被二阶精度保持，湍流吸积复现与 BHAC 相同的流动和通量尺度。这些结果确立了更广泛 PANGU 框架的固定时空物质区基础。数值相对论与耦合动态时空 GRMHD 能力将在后续工作展示。
classification.one_liner: 提出并验证 PANGU 的固定时空 GRMHD 模块，统一处理牛顿、狭义与广义相对论磁流体，并在 Kerr 时空中对标 AthenaK/BHAC。
keywords: 有限体积 Godunov 方法

papers.title: Compact Object Mergers and Micro-Tidal Disruption Events: A Multi-Messenger Probe of Dense Stellar Environments
papers.abstract: Dense stellar environments such as globular clusters and young massive clusters produce both compact-object mergers detectable in gravitational waves and tidal disruption events observable electromagnetically. We investigate compact-object mergers, tidal disruption events, and micro-tidal disruption events ($\mu$TDEs) in these environments using rapid Monte Carlo star-cluster simulations with the Rapster code, extended with a unified treatment of neutron-star (NS) and black-hole (BH) spin evolution under disk accretion across the NS-to-BH transition, as well as new dynamical channels for disruptions by single compact objects and by BH-BH binaries. Simulating $10^5$ clusters across ten model variations and two formation histories, we find a BH-BH merger-rate density peaking at $z\approx2$-$3$ at several tens ${\rm Gpc}^{-3}\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$, consistent with the local LVK rate, while the cumulative number of $\mu$TDEs exceeds that of mergers by a factor of a few. Since we include only dynamically formed binaries, $\approx90\%$ of $\mu$TDEs proceed through single compact-object-star encounters, and our rates are conservative lower limits. Prograde accretion during $\mu$TDEs spins up compact objects, providing a purely dynamical, randomly oriented pathway for producing high-spin BHs, and can drive accretion-induced collapse of NSs to BHs that populate the lower mass gap.

classification.title_zh: 致密天体并合与微潮汐瓦解事件：致密恒星环境的多信使探针
classification.abstract_zh: 致密恒星环境（如球状星团和年轻大质量星团）既产生可在引力波中探测到的致密天体并合，也产生可通过电磁波观测到的潮汐瓦解事件。我们使用 Rapster 代码进行快速蒙特卡洛星团模拟，研究这些环境中的致密天体并合、潮汐瓦解事件和微潮汐瓦解事件（μTDEs），并将处理扩展到在盘吸积下中子星（NS）到黑洞（BH）转变过程中 NS 和 BH 自旋演化的统一描述，以及由单个致密天体瓦解和 BH-BH 双星瓦解的新动力学通道。模拟 10^5 个星团、十种模型变体和两种形成历史，我们发现 BH-BH 并合率密度在 z≈2–3 达到峰值，为数十 Gpc^-3 yr^-1，与本地 LVK 速率一致，而 μTDEs 的累积数量比并合多几倍。由于我们只包含动力学形成的双星，约 90% 的 μTDEs 通过单致密天体-恒星相遇发生，我们的速率是保守下限。μTDEs 期间的顺行吸积使致密天体加速自旋，提供一种纯动力学、随机取向的产生高自旋 BH 的途径，并可驱动 NS 吸积诱导坍缩为 BH，从而填充低质量间隙。
classification.one_liner: 用星团蒙特卡洛模拟表明致密环境中的微潮汐瓦解事件可产生高自旋黑洞并填充低质量间隙，且其事件率高于并合。

papers.title: Twin Universes and Bimetric Gravity: From Sakharov's Cosmological Symmetry to Modern Speculations on Negative Mass
papers.abstract: We review the conceptual and theoretical status of twin-universe models, from Sakharov's early ideas on baryogenesis, CPT symmetry, and reversed arrows of time to recent quantum-cosmological scenarios involving pair-created entangled universes. Particular attention is given to the distinction between Sakharov-type cosmological symmetry, modern bimetric theories of gravity, and speculative models involving negative mass sectors. We summarize the main consistency conditions faced by bimetric gravity, including the Boulware-Deser ghost, Higuchi-type bounds, covariant conservation laws, and no-go results for positive- and negative-mass sectors. We then examine the Janus cosmological model and related black-hole replacement proposals, emphasizing the difference between heuristic twin-universe narratives and fully specified relativistic field theories. We argue that while twin-universe ideas remain a fertile framework for questions about the arrow of time, matter-antimatter asymmetry, and the quantum origin of the universe, models combining bimetric gravity, negative mass, dark-sector phenomenology, and alternatives to Kerr black holes face a substantial burden of mathematical and observational proof.

classification.title_zh: 孪生宇宙与双度规引力：从萨哈罗夫宇宙学对称性到负质量的现代思辨
classification.abstract_zh: 我们回顾孪生宇宙模型的概念与理论现状：从萨哈罗夫关于重子生成、CPT对称性和时间箭头反转的早期思想，到近来涉及成对产生纠缠宇宙的量子宇宙学情景。特别关注区分萨哈罗夫型宇宙学对称性、现代双度规引力理论，以及涉及负质量部门的思辨模型。我们总结双度规引力面临的主要一致性条件，包括Boulware-Deser鬼、Higuchi型界限、协变守恒律，以及正负质量部门的不可能性结果。随后考察Janus宇宙学模型及相关的黑洞替代方案，强调启发性孪生宇宙叙事与完整指定的相对论场论之间的差别。我们认为，尽管孪生宇宙思想对于时间箭头、正反物质不对称和宇宙量子起源等问题仍是有益框架，但结合双度规引力、负质量、暗部门现象学以及Kerr黑洞替代方案的理论模型仍面临沉重的数学与观测证明负担。
classification.one_liner: 综述孪生宇宙、双度规引力与负质量模型的现状、一致性条件及黑洞替代方案，指出其数学与观测证明负担沉重。

papers.title: Pulsar magnetospheres in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity: deathline conditions and polar-cap particle acceleration
papers.abstract: The role of surface gravity in neutron stars (NSs) is considerable in the radiation mechanisms of the surrounding plasma magnetosphere near the star surface, as they are highly magnetized, compact gravitating objects with compactness $M/R \simeq 0.2$. In this context, they serve as a celestial laboratory for testing gravity theories that dominate the stars' exteriors through plasma magnetospheric radiation. In this paper, we examine how dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) gravity modifies pulsar electrodynamics in the slow-rotation, weak-coupling regime; the leading-order correction affects only the off-diagonal metric component $g_{t\phi}$, while the diagonal components remain as in General Relativity (GR). We first solve the Maxwell equations in the dCS framework for the electromagnetic field components and obtain analytical solutions for the electric and magnetic fields. We show that the magnetic field components are the same as in GR, while the electric field components are modified in dCS. We then derive analytic expressions for the induced electric charge density, known as the Goldreich-Julian (GJ) charge density, which sources the induced electric field arising from the magnetic field and the star's rotation. In dCS, it is larger than in the GR case, whereas the accelerating electric field parallel to the magnetic field lines is weaker. Next, we consider the deathline condition for switching off electron and positron radiation via inverse Compton scattering in the star's polar cap zone and show that the line shifts upward in the $P-\dot{P}$ diagram, explaining the physics of shorter-lived pulsars. Lastly, we study charged-particle acceleration in the polar cap region and show that electrons reach higher energies over shorter distances than in the GR case.

classification.title_zh: 动态 Chern-Simons 引力中的脉冲星磁层：死亡线条件与极冠粒子加速
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星表面引力在高度磁化、致密天体（紧致度 M/R≈0.2）周围等离子体磁层的辐射机制中作用显著，因此可作为检验主导星体外部区域的引力理论的天体实验室。本文在慢转动、弱耦合近似下考察动态 Chern-Simons（dCS）引力如何修正脉冲星电动力学；最低阶修正只影响非对角度规分量 g_{tφ}，而对角度规分量仍与广义相对论（GR）相同。作者先在 dCS 框架下求解麦克斯韦方程，得到电磁场分量的解析解，表明磁场分量与 GR 相同，而电场分量被修正。随后推导感应电荷密度即 Goldreich-Julian（GJ）电荷密度的解析表达式，该密度由磁场与星体转动产生感应电场。在 dCS 中，GJ 电荷密度比 GR 更大，而平行于磁力线的加速电场更弱。接着考虑极冠区通过逆康普顿散射关闭正负电子辐射的死亡线条件，发现死亡线在 P-P 图中上移，可解释寿命更短的脉冲星。最后研究极冠区带电粒子加速，表明电子在更短距离内达到比 GR 更高的能量。
classification.one_liner: 研究动态 Chern-Simons 引力对脉冲星磁层电动力学、死亡线与极冠粒子加速的修正。

papers.title: A Catalog-Wide Study of Gravitational-Wave Residuals in GWTC-4 and GWTC-5
papers.abstract: Improved sensitivity of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA detectors has enabled the accumulation of a large gravitational-wave event catalog, providing an opportunity for catalog-wide residual analyses to assess waveform-model performance. We study GWTC-4 and GWTC-5 events with signal-to-noise ratio $>12$ in at least one detector, applying three goodness-of-fit tests to the normalized Q-transform energies of whitened residuals obtained by subtracting the IMRPhenomXPHM and SEOBNRv5PHM waveform models. Across the catalog, the residuals are consistent with Gaussian noise, with no evidence of systematic deviations in either multi-detector events or valid single-detector events. For events exhibiting strong model dependence in parameter estimation, variations between waveform models likewise do not produce persistent residual structures. These results demonstrate that parameter-estimation biases associated with waveform modeling do not necessarily manifest as detectable features in the residuals. Residual analyses therefore provide a complementary diagnostic in data space for validating gravitational-wave waveform models within the detector sensitivity.

classification.title_zh: GWTC-4和GWTC-5中引力波残差的目录级研究
classification.abstract_zh: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA探测器灵敏度的提升使引力波事件目录不断增大，从而为通过目录级残差分析评估波形模型性能提供了机会。我们研究GWTC-4和GWTC-5中至少在一个探测器中信噪比大于12的事件，对减去IMRPhenomXPHM和SEOBNRv5PHM波形模型后所得白化残差的归一化Q变换能量施加三种拟合优度检验。在整个目录中，残差与高斯噪声一致，在多探测器事件或有效单探测器事件中均无系统偏离证据。对于参数估计中表现出强模型依赖的事件，不同波形模型之间的变化同样未产生持续残差结构。这些结果表明，与波形建模相关的参数估计偏差不一定在残差中表现为可探测特征。因此，残差分析为在探测器灵敏度范围内验证引力波波形模型提供了数据空间中的互补诊断。
classification.one_liner: 对GWTC-4/GWTC-5事件进行目录级残差分析，未发现引力波波形模型的系统性残差偏差。

papers.title: Neural Network Guided Parameter Space Constraints for Gravitational Wave Searches from Binary Black Holes
papers.abstract: The detection of gravitational waves (GWs) from compact binary coalescences (CBCs) using matched filtering is computationally demanding because detector data must be correlated with many template waveforms spanning a high-dimensional intrinsic parameter space. In our previous work, we showed that a convolutional neural network (CNN) can classify noisy signals against pure noise and constrain the intrinsic parameter space of a true non-spinning binary black hole (BBH) signal, enabling a narrower matched-filter search region and reducing computational cost. Here, we extend this framework to aligned-spin BBH systems and investigate how different parameter-space representations affect CNN-based patch identification. Using IMRPhenomD waveforms over the aligned-spin BBH parameter space and Advanced LIGO design sensitivity, we show that a CNN trained solely on the aligned-spin template bank achieves more than 99.8% signal-noise classification accuracy on independently generated uniformly sampled BBH signals, indicating that additional uniformly sampled training data are unnecessary. We partition the template bank into four approximately balanced patches using a Principal Component Analysis (PCA)-based quantile scheme and evaluate five parameter-space representations for patch identification. The chirp mass-duration representation achieves the highest average accuracy (93.2%), followed by chirp mass (91.6%) and component masses (90.5%). The post-Newtonian coordinates tau_0-tau_3 and theta_0-theta_3-theta_3s yield substantially lower accuracies. These results show that the existing template bank is sufficient for training and high-accuracy signal detection, while the choice of parameter-space representation is critical for constraining the parameters of the true signal.

classification.title_zh: 神经网络引导的参数空间约束用于双黑洞引力波搜索
classification.abstract_zh: 利用匹配滤波从致密双星并合中探测引力波在计算上十分昂贵，因为探测器数据必须与覆盖高维内禀参数空间的众多模板波形进行相关。在我们先前的工作中，我们表明卷积神经网络（CNN）能够将含噪信号与纯噪声分类，并约束真实无自旋双黑洞（BBH）信号的内禀参数空间，从而得到更窄的匹配滤波搜索区域并降低计算成本。这里，我们将该框架扩展至对齐自旋 BBH 系统，并研究不同参数空间表示如何影响基于 CNN 的分块识别。使用覆盖对齐自旋 BBH 参数空间的 IMRPhenomD 波形和 Advanced LIGO 设计灵敏度，我们表明，仅在对齐自旋模板库上训练的 CNN 在独立生成的均匀采样 BBH 信号上达到超过 99.8% 的信号-噪声分类准确率，这表明额外的均匀采样训练数据并非必要。我们使用基于主成分分析（PCA）的分位数方案将模板库划分为四个近似平衡的分块，并评估五种参数空间表示用于分块识别。啁啾质量-持续时间表示取得最高平均准确率（93.2%），其次是啁啾质量（91.6%）和分量质量（90.5%）。后牛顿坐标 tau_0-tau_3 和 theta_0-theta_3-theta_3s 的准确率显著更低。这些结果表明，现有模板库足以用于训练和高准确率信号检测，而参数空间表示的选择对于约束真实信号的参数至关重要。
classification.one_liner: 用 CNN 对对齐自旋双黑洞模板库进行分类与参数空间分块，以缩小匹配滤波搜索区域。

papers.title: A nonlinear Newtonian approximation to General Relativity
papers.abstract: We investigate a nonrelativistic approximation to general relativity that does not require the metric coefficients to be weak perturbations of the Minkowski metric. Instead, we assume a differential hierarchy in which the contributions to the curvature containing second derivatives of the metric dominate over those quadratic in its first derivatives, while the metric-dependent coefficients multiplying the retained terms are kept fully nonlinear. Since this separation is not covariant, we formulate the approximation in harmonic coordinates, where it corresponds to retaining the principal part of the reduced Einstein equations. We show that the truncated Einstein tensor satisfies the contracted Bianchi identities up to the order neglected in the derivative hierarchy, ensuring compatibility with energy--momentum conservation at the retained order. The standard Newtonian equations are recovered in the weak-field regime, whereas outside it the dynamics retains a nonlinear dependence on the lapse and spatial metric. In particular, null geodesics probe the spatial geometry at leading order, suggesting gravitational lensing as a natural setting in which observable departures from the standard weak-field description may arise. We illustrate the construction with a static spatially isotropic configuration and discuss the scope and limitations of the approximation.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论的非线性牛顿近似
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究广义相对论的一种非相对论近似，该近似不要求度规系数是闵可夫斯基度规的弱微扰。相反，我们假设一种微分层级，其中曲率中包含度规二阶导数的贡献支配那些一阶导数的二次项，而乘以保留项的度规相关系数则完全保持非线性。由于这种分离不是协变的，我们在调和坐标中表述该近似，在那里它对应于保留约化爱因斯坦方程的主部。我们证明，截断的爱因斯坦张量在微分层级所忽略的阶数内满足缩并的比安基恒等式，从而保证了在保留阶数与能量-动量守恒的相容性。标准牛顿方程在弱场区域被恢复，而在其之外，动力学保持对时滞函数和空间度规的非线性依赖。特别地，零测地线在领头阶探测空间几何，这表明引力透镜是可能出现对标准弱场描述的可观测偏离的自然场景。我们用一个静态空间各向同性的构型来说明该构造，并讨论该近似的适用范围和局限性。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种不要求弱场度规的非线性牛顿近似，在调和坐标下保留约化爱因斯坦方程主部，并讨论其与牛顿极限、比安基恒等式及引力透镜的关系。

papers.title: Evolution and disruption of circular orbits during dynamic black hole scalarization
papers.abstract: Dynamical black hole scalarization describes the process by which a ``no-hair" black hole transitions to a scalarized hairy state. This transition significantly alters the spacetime geometry, including the structure of stable circular orbits of the test particles, which are critical for astrophysical observations and tests of gravity. In this work, we employ numerical relativity simulations to model the time-dependent evolution of a vacuum black hole undergoing scalarization. By evolving timelike geodesic equations within the dynamically changing spacetime background, we investigate how the scalarization process impacts initially stable circular orbits. Our results reveal that the growth of the scalar hair destroys the circular nature of these orbits, forcing them to either become eccentric or plunge into the black hole. This orbital destabilization arises from the rapid change of spacetime curvature induced by the scalar field. Our findings provide novel insights into the interplay between scalar fields and black hole dynamics, with significant implications for gravitational-wave signatures, accretion disk stability, and observational tests of extended theories of gravity.

classification.title_zh: 动态黑洞标量化过程中圆轨道的演化与破坏
classification.abstract_zh: 动态黑洞标量化描述“无毛”黑洞向带标量毛的黑洞态转变的过程。这一转变显著改变时空几何，包括测试粒子的稳定圆轨道结构，而这些轨道对天体物理观测和引力检验至关重要。在本工作中，我们采用数值相对论模拟来建模一个经历标量化的真空黑洞的时间依赖演化。通过在动态变化的时空背景中演化类时测地线方程，我们研究了标量化过程如何影响初始稳定的圆轨道。结果表明，标量毛发的增长破坏了这些轨道的圆轨道性质，迫使它们要么变为偏心轨道，要么坠入黑洞。这种轨道失稳源于标量场引起的时空曲率快速变化。我们的发现为标量场与黑洞动力学之间的相互作用提供了新见解，并对引力波信号、吸积盘稳定性以及扩展引力理论的观测检验具有重要意义。
classification.one_liner: 数值相对论显示，黑洞动态标量化过程中标量毛发增长会破坏测试粒子的稳定圆轨道，使其偏心或坠入黑洞。

papers.title: Quasinormal-mode redshifts of black holes in galactic halos with radial pressures
papers.abstract: We investigate the black-hole quasinormal mode redshifts induced by a galactic dark-matter halo with nonvanishing radial pressure. The halo is described by an anisotropic fluid with a generalized density profile and a constant radial equation-of-state parameter $w$. We construct the corresponding static, spherically symmetric spacetime and study the resulting corrections to the unstable light ring and quasinormal-mode spectrum. For dilute halos and $w\neq -1$, the light-ring angular frequency and Lyapunov exponent acquire the same leading-order gravitational redshift, implying a universal shift of the real and imaginary parts of the quasinormal frequencies. The magnitude of this effect depends on both the halo structure and the radial pressure. This universal redshift relation holds not only in the case of $w=0$ that has been discovered in the literature but also in a much wider scenario, supporting its importance in black hole spectroscopy. On the other hand, the case $w=-1$ is qualitatively different: the factor that corresponds to the leading common redshift vanishes, the corrections are further suppressed by the hierarchy between the black-hole and halo scales, and the universal relation is broken, with the dominant contribution controlled by the inner halo profile. Our numerical computations of scalar-field quasinormal mode spectra confirm the analytic eikonal results.

classification.title_zh: 带径向压强的星系晕中黑洞的准正规模红移
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由具有非零径向压强的星系暗物质晕诱导的黑洞准正规模红移。该晕由各向异性流体描述，具有广义密度剖面和恒定的径向状态方程参数 w。我们构造相应的静态球对称时空，并研究其对不稳定光子环和准正规模谱的修正。对于稀薄晕和 w≠−1，光子环角频率与 Lyapunov 指数获得相同的领头阶引力红移，意味着准正规模频率实部和虚部有普适移动。该效应的幅度取决于晕结构和径向压强。这一普适红移关系不仅在文献中已发现的 w=0 情形成立，也在更广泛情形成立，支持其在黑洞光谱学中的重要性。另一方面，w=−1 情形定性不同：对应领头共同红移的因子消失，修正进一步受到黑洞尺度与晕尺度层级关系的抑制，普适关系被破坏，主导贡献由内晕剖面控制。我们对标量场准正规模谱的数值计算证实了解析 eikonal 结果。
classification.one_liner: 在带径向压强的暗物质晕中，黑洞准正规模实部与虚部获得相同领头阶引力红移，而 w=-1 时该普适关系被破坏。

papers.title: Correcting for Evidence Uncertainty in the Templated Background Search for the Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background
papers.abstract: We report a new source of systematic bias in the Bayesian Templated Background Search (TBS) for the astrophysical stochastic gravitational-wave background. This bias arises from the statistical uncertainty in nested sampling evidence estimates at the segment level and persists even when the likelihood model accurately characterizes the data. Using an analytically tractable model and a frequency-domain mock data analysis with an astrophysically motivated binary black hole population, we show that this uncertainty coherently inflates the inferred duty cycle by up to an order of magnitude when millions of segments are accumulated. We propose a simple and efficient correction and demonstrate its effectiveness across all tested configurations. We also find that a search prior restricted to high optimal signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) misattributes intermediate-strength signals, while extending the prior to support weaker signals amplifies the evidence uncertainty. Both the correction and careful search prior design are essential for robust inference as TBS analyses scale to upcoming observing runs.

classification.title_zh: 修正随机引力波背景模板化背景搜索中的证据不确定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们报告了用于天体物理随机引力波背景的贝叶斯模板化背景搜索（TBS）中的一个新系统偏差来源。该偏差来自分段层面嵌套采样证据估计的统计不确定性，并且即使似然模型准确刻画数据时也会持续存在。使用一个解析可处理的模型和带有天体物理动机双黑洞种群的频域模拟数据分析，我们表明当累积数百万个分段时，这种不确定性会相干地将推断的占空比抬高最多一个数量级。我们提出一种简单高效的校正，并证明其在所有测试配置中的有效性。我们还发现，限制在高最优信噪比（SNR）的搜索先验会错误归因中等强度信号，而将先验扩展到支持更弱信号会放大证据不确定性。随着TBS分析扩展到即将到来的观测运行，校正和仔细的搜索先验设计对于稳健推断都至关重要。
classification.one_liner: TBS随机引力波背景搜索中，分段嵌套采样证据的统计不确定性会系统性抬高占空比，需校正并谨慎设计先验。

papers.title: Null Completeness and Directional Rigidity in Bianchi I Spacetimes
papers.abstract: A smooth Bianchi I spacetime satisfying the null convergence condition in every null direction is static if it contains a single null geodesic complete to both the past and the future. We prove this result for a general spatial metric, allowing non-diagonal evolution and arbitrary signs of the principal expansion rates. The proof starts from affine Raychaudhuri evolution. On a complete generator of a regular twist-free congruence, nonnegativity of an independent or fixed-ratio sharp-cutoff lower limit forces the full optical tensor to vanish. Dilated square weights give an exact sum rule equal to minus the total optical-square integral, with no assumed endpoint limits for the expansion. In Bianchi I, this optical saturation fixes the metric on the kernel of the conserved spatial covector. We classify the resulting geometry: a non-static metric has at most two saturated unoriented lines, corresponding to four oriented rays; two lines force diagonalizability by a constant spatial transformation, and a third forces staticity. Periodic and finite-duration geometries attain the bound. For finite pulses with a common static exterior, we derive the negative affine curvature integrals, their weak-amplitude angular dependence, and a nonperturbative bound on the metric excursion from three directional integral budgets. Saturated modes of a massless minimally coupled test scalar propagate without Bogoliubov mixing across the pulse. We also state the field-equation and averaged-energy assumptions under which these geometric results imply matter or semiclassical rigidity.

classification.title_zh: Bianchi I 时空中的零测地完备性与方向刚性
classification.abstract_zh: 一个光滑的 Bianchi I 时空，若在每个零方向满足零收敛条件，并且包含一条向过去和未来都完备的零测地线，则它是静态的。我们为一般空间度规证明这一结果，允许非对角演化和主膨胀率的任意符号。证明从仿射 Raychaudhuri 演化出发。在一个正则无扭转汇的完备生成元上，独立或固定比例 sharp-cutoff 下界的非负性迫使整个光学张量消失。膨胀平方权重给出精确求和规则，等于负的总光学平方积分，且不假设膨胀的端点极限。在 Bianchi I 中，这种光学饱和固定守恒空间余向量核上的度规。我们分类所得几何：非静态度规至多有两条饱和的无向线，对应四条有向射线；两条线迫使可由常数空间变换对角化，而第三条线迫使静态性。周期和有限持续时间几何达到该界。对于具有共同静态外部的有限脉冲，我们推导负仿射曲率积分、其弱振幅角依赖，以及由三个方向积分预算给出的度规偏离的非微扰界。无质量最小耦合试探标量的饱和模式在穿过脉冲时传播没有 Bogoliubov 混合。我们还陈述了这些几何结果蕴含物质或半经典刚性的场方程与平均能量假设。
classification.one_liner: Bianchi I 时空中单条双向完备零测地线迫使静态，并给出方向刚性分类与有限脉冲非微扰界。

papers.title: Nonsingular Rotating Black Holes in the Dark-Energy Dominated Universe
papers.abstract: Motivated by quantum-gravity scenarios that replace the classical black hole singularity with a regular core, and by the possibility that the dark-energy sector may be scale dependent, we construct a broad class of nonsingular rotating black-hole spacetimes embedded in an improved de Sitter--like background with either constant or running $\Lambda$. Because the Newman--Janis algorithm is generically incompatible with a cosmological-constant fluid, we instead propose a generalized Kerr--Schild construction on a (possibly scale-dependent $\Lambda$) de Sitter seed, yielding a Carter-type metric characterized by a mass function and a $\Lambda$ function. Our construction provides a direct map from static, spherically symmetric regular models to their rotating counterparts. We derive sharp regularity conditions at the ring and we identify a minimal-order subclass. We analyze chronology and show that, for non-negative mass function and $\Lambda$ above a certain negative limit, the spacetimes are stably causal. For minimal-order geometries with non-negative mass, we prove that the weak energy condition must be violated. Finally, we illustrate the framework with an asymptotic-safety--inspired model and discuss horizon structure, surface gravities, and conformal diagrams. These results provide a controlled, observationally oriented arena to confront regular rotating black holes in dark-energy backgrounds with the rapidly improving gravitational-wave and horizon-scale imaging data.

classification.title_zh: 暗能量主导宇宙中的非奇异旋转黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 受量子引力场景（用正则核心取代经典黑洞奇点）以及暗能量部门可能尺度依赖的可能性启发，我们构建了一大类非奇异旋转黑洞时空，嵌入在改进的类 de Sitter 背景中，其中 Λ 要么为常数，要么跑动。由于 Newman-Janis 算法通常与宇宙学常数流体不相容，我们转而提出一种在（可能尺度依赖 Λ 的）de Sitter 种子上的广义 Kerr-Schild 构造，得到由质量函数和 Λ 函数刻画的 Carter 型度规。我们的构造提供了从静态球对称正则模型到其旋转对应物的直接映射。我们推导了环处的严格正则性条件，并识别出最小阶子类。我们分析时序，并表明对于非负质量函数以及高于某一负极限的 Λ，这些时空是稳定因果的。对于非负质量的最小阶几何，我们证明弱能量条件必须被破坏。最后，我们用一个受渐近安全启发的模型说明该框架，并讨论视界结构、表面引力与共形图。这些结果为在暗能量背景中检验正则旋转黑洞提供了受控且面向观测的平台，以应对快速改进的引力波和视界尺度成像数据。
classification.one_liner: 构建暗能量背景下非奇异旋转黑洞的广义 Kerr-Schild 度规类，分析正则性、因果性与能量条件。

papers.title: BMS$_3$ modules from path integrals on the coadjoint orbits
papers.abstract: In this paper, we provide a systematic construction of quantum modules associated with coadjoint orbits of asymptotic symmetry groups through the path integral quantization at one-loop order. In particular, for the orbits with Hamiltonians unbounded from below, we show that an appropriate choice of integration contour defines a convergent Euclidean half-line path integral. The reference state associate with the orbit is determined by the path integral of the geometric action on the corresponding coadjoint orbit. The coadjoint module is therefore spanned by the reference state and its descendants. We apply this formalism to the Virasoro and BMS$_3$ groups and derive the coadjoint modules corresponding to all constant orbits. We also compute the characters of all constant Virasoro and BMS$_3$ coadjoint orbits by counting the states within the modules, and the results agree with the corresponding computations from the path integral of the geometric action with a periodic Euclidean direction.

classification.title_zh: 从余伴随轨道上的路径积分构造 BMS$_3$ 模
classification.abstract_zh: 本文通过单圈阶路径积分量子化，系统构造了与渐近对称群余伴随轨道相关的量子模。特别地，对于哈密顿量无下界的轨道，我们表明适当选择积分围道可定义收敛的欧几里得半直线路径积分。与轨道相关的参考态由相应余伴随轨道上几何作用的路径积分确定。因此，余伴随模由参考态及其后代张成。我们将该形式应用于 Virasoro 和 BMS$_3$ 群，导出所有常轨道对应的余伴随模。我们还通过计数模内状态计算了所有常 Virasoro 和 BMS$_3$ 余伴随轨道的特征标，结果与具有周期欧几里得方向的几何作用路径积分相应计算一致。
classification.one_liner: 通过单圈路径积分从渐近对称群余伴随轨道构造 Virasoro 与 BMS3 量子模并计算特征标。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于平直时空/BMS 渐近对称与路径积分量子化方向，并与 AdS3/CFT2 的 Virasoro 表示相关；但与用户列出的全息超流、p波/多分量、QNM、经典引力等重点支线无直接匹配，对 BMS/天球方向有参考价值。

papers.title: Metric Source Completions and Integrability in Celestial Gravity
papers.abstract: We study metric-source responses of celestial Einstein amplitudes while retaining their momentum-conservation distribution. The consecutive opposite-helicity response is related to the simultaneous gravitational contact at arbitrary hard multiplicity. Their difference contains a Lorentz transformation that annihilates the conservation delta function, determining the normal recoil contribution and its relation to the undifferentiated coefficient. A six-graviton tree calculation evaluates both coefficients on a real scattering channel. For the summed homogeneous contact, momentum conservation cancels the leading angular singularities. Uniform bounds at coincident soft directions and hard punctures yield integrated endpoint estimates that determine the ordered Mellin residues after smooth source smearing. The mixed Mellin divisor also retains logarithms of soft--hard invariant ratios at generic conformal weight. In Weyl--Beltrami variables, the quadratic reference Ward response combines soft-leg, shadow-map and spin-frame terms into the transported metric Hessian, with a nonzero symmetric mixed susceptibility. Relative shadow primitives require boundary currents when represented across logarithmic cuts; their source variation fixes the accompanying contour contribution. Joint factorization and angular expansions organize the additional NMHV relative-contour terms into residue coefficients that distinguish metric integrability from matching to a specified source functional. An independent vacuum completion supplies the Euler response, which fixed-area harmonic combinations separate from local curvature terms at bounded derivative order.

classification.title_zh: 天球引力中的度规源完备化与可积性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究天球 Einstein 振幅的度规源响应，同时保留其动量守恒分布。连续的相反螺旋度响应与任意硬粒子多重数下的同时引力接触项相关。它们的差包含一个湮灭守恒 delta 函数的 Lorentz 变换，从而确定法向反冲贡献及其与未微分系数的关系。一个六引力子树图计算在真实散射道中评估这两个系数。对于求和后的齐次接触项，动量守恒抵消了领头角奇异性。在重合软方向和硬穿刺处的均匀界给出积分端点估计，从而在光滑源抹平后确定有序 Mellin 留数。混合 Mellin 除子还在一般共形权重下保留软-硬不变量比值的对数。在 Weyl--Beltrami 变量中，二次参考 Ward 响应将软腿、shadow 映射和自旋标架项组合为输运的度规 Hessian，并具有非零的对称混合感受率。相对 shadow 原语在对数割线两侧表示时需要边界流；其源变分固定了伴随的围道贡献。联合因子化与角展开将额外的 NMHV 相对围道项组织为留数系数，这些系数区分度规可积性与匹配到指定源泛函。一个独立真空完备化提供 Euler 响应，其中固定面积的调和组合在有界导数阶数下与局部曲率项分离。
classification.one_liner: 本文研究天球 Einstein 振幅的度规源响应，用六引力子树图与 Mellin、shadow、Weyl--Beltrami 分析区分度规可积性与源匹配，并讨论真空完备化的 Euler 响应。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于天球全息/天球引力方向，涉及引力振幅、软定理、Mellin 留数与可积性；但未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息凝聚态、QNM、经典引力、多迹等支线。

papers.title: On-shell recursion and soft theorems for worldline quantum field theory
papers.abstract: We derive a set of on-shell recursion relations for amplitudes in worldline quantum field theory (WQFT), an effective theory of gravity coupled to a massive worldline which is relevant for computing classical gravitational observables. We overcome the poor large-$z$ falloff of amplitudes under an all-line complex momentum deformation by deriving and exploiting a new soft-graviton theorem in the presence of a worldline. This theorem generalizes the leading (Weinberg) and subleading soft theorems with additional contributions due to soft emission from the worldline. Our main result is a $d$-dimensional recursion formula, expressing any $n$-graviton rational amplitude in terms of lower-point amplitudes from WQFT and pure gravity. Using the soft-worldline theorem, we can obtain amplitudes with any number of external worldline fluctuations from the corresponding all-graviton amplitudes, making the recursion sufficient to construct any rational amplitude of the theory. We verify our results by explicitly computing two-graviton and three-graviton amplitudes.

classification.title_zh: 世界线量子场论中的在壳递推关系与软定理
classification.abstract_zh: 我们推导了世界线量子场论（WQFT）振幅的一组在壳递推关系。WQFT是引力与一条大质量世界线耦合的有效理论，与计算经典引力可观测量相关。我们通过推导并利用存在世界线时的新软引力子定理，克服了全线复动量形变下振幅大-$z$衰减不佳的问题。该定理推广了领头（Weinberg）和次领头软定理，并包含来自世界线软发射的额外贡献。我们的主要结果是一个$d$维递推公式，将任意$n$引力子有理振幅表示为来自WQFT和纯引力的低点振幅。利用软世界线定理，我们可以从相应的全引力子振幅获得带有任意数量外部世界线涨落的振幅，使该递推足以构造该理论的任意有理振幅。我们通过显式计算双引力子和三引力子振幅验证了结果。
classification.one_liner: 推导了带大质量世界线的引力有效理论WQFT的在壳递推关系与推广的软引力子定理，用于系统构造经典引力散射振幅。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/散射振幅与有效场论技术，不涉及AdS/CFT或全息对偶；但与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”相关。

papers.title: Linear Dilaton in Cosmology and Particle Physics
papers.abstract:
A warped extra dimension in a five-dimensional (5D) anti-de Sitter (AdS) background was introduced in 1999 by Lisa Randall and Raman Sundrum to solve the gauge hierarchy problem in particle physics. As a bonus, a holographic interpretation in terms of four-dimensional (4D) conformal field theories (CFTs) was found. Interestingly enough, another 5D background, linear dilaton (LD), was found to have a holographic interpretation in terms of Little String Theory. In this review, we will show how a set of 5D backgrounds, parametrized in terms of a real parameter $
u$, generalizes both theories and gives rise, in particular, to AdS for $
u=0$ and to LD for $
u=1$. Furthermore, working in the 5D theory, we will consider applications of the LD background to: (i) particle physics, so that the 5D Planck scale can be lowered to sub-Planckian values, and (ii) Brane World Cosmology (BWC), based on the appearance of an extra vacuum characterized by a 5D black hole. In all cases, we find a gapped continuum for bulk propagating fields, which makes a connection with unparticles. In the case of BWC, we also point out the existence of a pressureless holographic fluid that could play the role of dark matter (DM), with feeble (gravitational) interactions with the Standard Model (SM), decoupled from the thermal SM bath, and generated by a freeze-in mechanism after inflation. We also point out the additional possibility of identifying DM with a long-lived, feebly interacting massive graviton, as an isolated resonance generated by radiative corrections to the continuum graviton propagator self-energy.

classification.title_zh: 宇宙学与粒子物理中的线性伸缩子
classification.abstract_zh: 1999年，Lisa Randall 和 Raman Sundrum 引入五维反德西特（AdS）背景中的翘曲额外维，以解决粒子物理中的规范等级问题。作为额外收获，人们发现了其与四维共形场论（CFT）的全息解释。有趣的是，另一个五维背景——线性伸缩子（LD）——被发现具有基于小弦理论的全息解释。在这篇综述中，我们将展示一组由实参数 ν 参数化的五维背景如何推广这两种理论，特别地，ν=0 给出 AdS，ν=1 给出 LD。进一步，在五维理论中，我们将考虑 LD 背景在以下方面的应用：(i) 粒子物理，使五维普朗克尺度可以降低到亚普朗克值；(ii) 膜世界宇宙学（BWC），基于由一个五维黑洞表征的额外真空的出现。在所有情形中，我们发现体传播场具有带隙连续谱，这与 unparticles（非粒子）相关。在 BWC 情形中，我们还指出存在一种无压全息流体，可能充当暗物质（DM），与标准模型（SM）仅有微弱（引力）相互作用，与热的标准模型浴退耦，并在暴胀后通过 freeze-in 机制产生。我们还指出另一种可能性：将暗物质等同于一个长寿命、微弱相互作用的大质量引力子，作为由对连续谱引力子传播子自能的辐射修正所产生的孤立共振。
classification.one_liner: 综述线性伸缩子五维背景如何统一 AdS 与线性伸缩子全息，并用于粒子物理、膜世界宇宙学、非粒子及暗物质。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT、额外维与膜世界宇宙学方向，涉及五维黑洞和经典引力背景；但不直接涉及所列全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/Floquet 等重点支线。

papers.title: Classical gravitational scattering with a massive scalar mediator
papers.abstract: We consider the classical scattering of two gravitating compact objects in the presence of a massive scalar mediator, providing a simple model of exotic phenomena. Through dimensional analysis, we argue that such a process can only be classical in the presence of gravity, a consequence of which is that perturbing in the coupling of the scalar to a worldline is not separate from the post-Minkowskian expansion. When computing asymptotic observables, the massive mediator complicates the Fourier transforms to impact-parameter space at next-to-leading order. We reduce these to univariate parametric integrals - amenable to numerical integration - and produce analytic results for the linear impulse and the scattering angle to the second post-Minkowskian order. The scattering angle exhibits a maximum when the range of the scalar-mediated force is comparable to the impact parameter, a possible signature of a massive scalar mediator. In the opposite, large-mass regime we uncover a screening effect: integrating out the scalar sourced by each compact object reduces its gravitational mass by an amount linear in the scalar's mass. Both of these phenomena are next-to-leading-order effects.

classification.title_zh: 带有大质量标量媒介子的经典引力散射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑在两个引力致密物体之间存在大质量标量媒介子时的经典散射，为奇异现象提供一个简单模型。通过量纲分析，我们论证此类过程只有在引力存在时才能是经典的；其一个后果是，对标量与世界线耦合的微扰展开与后闵可夫斯基展开并不分离。在计算渐近可观测量时，大质量媒介子使到碰撞参数空间的傅里叶变换在次领头阶变得复杂。我们将这些化为单变量参数积分——适于数值积分——并给出直到第二后闵可夫斯基阶的线性冲量和散射角的解析结果。当标量媒介力的程与碰撞参数相当时，散射角出现极大值，这可能是大质量标量媒介子的一个特征信号。在相反的大质量区域，我们发现一种屏蔽效应：积掉由每个致密物体作为源产生的标量后，会使其引力质量减少一个与标量质量线性成正比的量。这两种现象都是次领头阶效应。
classification.one_liner: 在含大质量标量媒介子的经典引力散射中，计算到第二后闵可夫斯基阶的冲量与散射角，并发现散射角极大值和标量屏蔽效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力与后闵可夫斯基散射研究，完全对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；但与全息、量子信息或规范/引力对偶无直接关系。

papers.title: Thermal Casimir Effect in A Schwarzschild-like Wormhole Spacetime
papers.abstract: We study the finite-temperature Casimir effect for a massless scalar field confined between two parallel plates in a Schwarzschild-like wormhole spacetime. Imposing Dirichlet boundary conditions, we compute the renormalized Casimir free energy in the comoving frame. We find that the thermal correction to the renormalized Casimir free energy decreases gradually with the temperature and becomes independent of the background geometry in this frame. Thermodynamic quantities derived from the Casimir free energy, namely, the renormalized Casimir entropy, internal energy, and heat capacity at constant volume, exhibit distinct temperature dependence. At low temperatures, all thermodynamic quantities recover the expected behavior, consistent with the fundamental laws of thermodynamics. These results provide a compact framework for analyzing quantum vacuum forces in gravitational backgrounds.

classification.title_zh: 类史瓦西虫洞时空中的热卡西米尔效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在类史瓦西虫洞时空中，限制在两平行板之间的无质量标量场的有限温度卡西米尔效应。施加 Dirichlet 边界条件，我们在共动系中计算了重整化卡西米尔自由能。我们发现，重整化卡西米尔自由能的热修正随温度逐渐减小，并在该参考系中变得与背景几何无关。由卡西米尔自由能导出的热力学量，即重整化卡西米尔熵、内能和定容热容，表现出不同的温度依赖。在低温下，所有热力学量恢复预期行为，符合热力学基本定律。这些结果为分析引力背景中的量子真空力提供了一个紧致框架。
classification.one_liner: 在类史瓦西虫洞时空中计算有限温度无质量标量场的重整化卡西米尔自由能与热力学量，并分析其温度依赖。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于弯曲时空量子场论中的热卡西米尔效应，使用类史瓦西虫洞背景但不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶；与经典引力/弯曲时空背景下的量子真空效应有一定关联，但与全息核心主题相关性有限。

papers.title: Brane-probes response to poly-vector deformations
papers.abstract: We probe poly-vector deformations of Type II backgrounds using the fundamental string, D0-brane and D3-brane, and of the 11D membrane background by the fundamental M2-brane. We show that the corresponding deformations of the world-volume theories can be written in terms of flows similar to the $\mathrm{T}\bar{\mathrm{T}}$ flow (for the D3-brane flow --- with a square-root term). This interpretation works equally well for abelian (TsT) and non-abelian deformations.

classification.title_zh: 膜探针对多矢量形变的响应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用基本弦、D0 膜和 D3 膜探测 Type II 背景的多矢量形变，并使用基本 M2 膜探测 11 维膜背景。我们表明，世界体理论相应的形变可以写成类似于 T\bar{T} 流的流（对于 D3 膜流——带有平方根项）。这种解释对阿贝尔（TsT）和非阿贝尔形变同样有效。
classification.one_liner: 用基本弦、D0/D3 膜和 M2 膜探测多矢量形变，发现世界体理论形变可由类 T\bar{T} 流描述，并覆盖 TsT 与非阿贝尔情形。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究弦论背景形变与膜探针世界体理论中的类 TTbar 流，属于 AdS/CFT 基础技术范畴，但未直接涉及用户重点标签所列的全息超导、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜与 Floquet 驱动或经典引力等具体方向。

papers.title: Strong-coupling results in (non-)conformal $\mathcal{N}=2$ theories with fundamental flavors
papers.abstract: We study a class of four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$ SU($N$) gauge theories with two massless hypermultiplets in the rank-two antisymmetric representation and $0\leq N_f\leq 4$ fundamental flavors. These theories are superconformal for $N_f=4$ and asymptotically free otherwise. Supersymmetric localization on the four-sphere applies in both cases and leads to matrix-model representations for a broad class of protected observables. Within this framework, we compute the free energy and the expectation value of the $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in the large-$N$ limit. For any $N_f$, we show that the infinite series of non-planar corrections at large 't Hooft coupling $\lambda$ can be resummed in terms of an effective coupling $\widetilde{\lambda}$. In the non-conformal window ($0\leq N_f<4$), this provides a first example in which localization leads to explicit results in the planar limit at strong 't Hooft coupling. In the superconformal case ($N_f=4$), the large-$N$ expansion in $\widetilde{\lambda}$ suggests a refined AdS/CFT dictionary in which $\widetilde{\lambda}$, rather than $\lambda$, plays the role of the bulk string coupling.

classification.title_zh: 带基本味道的（非）共形 \mathcal{N}=2 理论中的强耦合结果
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一类四维 \mathcal{N}=2 SU(N) 规范理论，包含两个位于二阶反对称表示的无质量超多重态以及 0≤N_f≤4 个基本味道。这些理论在 N_f=4 时为超共形，否则渐近自由。四球面上的超对称局域化在两种情形下均适用，并给出对一大类受保护可观测量的矩阵模型表示。在此框架内，我们计算了大 N 极限下的自由能以及 1/2-BPS 圆形 Wilson 环的期望值。对于任意 N_f，我们证明在大 't Hooft 耦合 λ 下，非平面修正的无穷级数可以用一个有效耦合 \widetilde{\lambda} 重求和。在非共形窗口（0≤N_f<4）中，这提供了局域化在强 't Hooft 耦合下给出平面极限显式结果的首个例子。在超共形情形（N_f=4）中，以 \widetilde{\lambda} 进行的大 N 展开暗示了一种改进的 AdS/CFT 字典，其中扮演体弦耦合角色的是 \widetilde{\lambda} 而非 λ。
classification.one_liner: 通过四球局域化计算带基本味道的 N=2 SU(N) 理论在大 N 强耦合下的自由能与 1/2-BPS 圆 Wilson 环，并用有效耦合重求和非平面修正，暗示改进的 AdS/CFT 字典。
classification.relevance_reason: 主要面向 AdS/CFT 字典与 N=2 规范理论强耦合计算，未直接对应列出的重点支线（如全息超导、探针膜、QNM 等）。

papers.title: One-loop Corrected Holographic Shear Viscosity to Entropy Density Ratio at Low Temperatures
papers.abstract: Near-extremal black holes contain infrared-enhanced quantum fluctuations in their near-horizon near-AdS$_2$ throat, governed in part by Schwarzian modes. We study the effect of these fluctuations on the zero-frequency stress-tensor response of a near-extremal asymptotically AdS$_4$ Reissner--Nordstr\"om black brane whose transverse directions are regulated by a finite toroidal quotient. Working directly in four dimensions, we compute the leading correction in the weakly coupled Schwarzian regime $T_q\ll T\ll r_0/L^2$. At one loop, the shear perturbation couples to the $n=2$ would-be zero mode and produces a correction proportional to $T_q/T$. Together with the logarithmic correction to the entropy, this yields a finite-volume correction to $\eta/s$. Our calculation provides a direct four-dimensional benchmark, complementary to exact two-dimensional treatments, while keeping the asymptotic AdS$_4$ source explicit.

classification.title_zh: 低温下全息剪切黏度与熵密度比的单圈修正
classification.abstract_zh: 近极端黑洞在其近视界 near-AdS2 喉区包含红外增强的量子涨落，部分由 Schwarzian 模支配。我们研究这些涨落对近极端渐近 AdS4 Reissner-Nordström 黑膜零频应力张量响应的影响，其横向方向由有限环面商调控。直接在四维中工作，我们计算弱耦合 Schwarzian 区域 T_q << T << r_0/L^2 的首项修正。在一圈阶，剪切微扰与 n=2 的准零模耦合，并产生正比于 T_q/T 的修正。与熵的对数修正一起，这给出 η/s 的有限体积修正。我们的计算提供了一个直接的四维基准，补充精确的二维处理，同时显式保留渐近 AdS4 源。
classification.one_liner: 在近极端 AdS4 Reissner-Nordström 黑膜中，利用一圈 Schwarzian 修正计算低温下 η/s 的有限体积修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息输运与近极端黑洞量子修正，涉及 AdS/CFT、Schwarzian 和 η/s；但未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7 或纯经典引力。

papers.title: Holographic Schwinger effect with Translational Symmetry Breaking
papers.abstract: We investigate the holographic Schwinger effect in a background with translational symmetry breaking (TSB) at finite chemical potential. The gravitational background is characterized by two independent parameters: the TSB parameter \(\alpha\), which controls momentum relaxation, and the chemical potential \(\mu\), which determines the finite density of the dual field theory. Using the potential analysis method, we derive the total potential governing the pair production process and examine its dependence on \(\alpha\), \(\mu\), the external magnetic field, and the ratio \(\beta=E/E_c\). Our results show that the effects of \(\alpha\) and \(\mu\) on the Schwinger process strongly depend on the dynamical regime. In the subcritical regime, increasing either \(\alpha\) or \(\mu\) lowers the potential barrier and facilitates pair production. However, near and above the critical electric field, the roles of these two parameters become qualitatively different. While increasing the chemical potential lowers the total potential and enhances the Schwinger pair production process, increasing the translational symmetry breaking parameter shifts the potential upward and suppresses the production process. We further show that, at fixed $\beta=E/E_c$, a perpendicular external magnetic field lowers the effective potential barrier and thereby facilitates the Schwinger process, while the physical electric field changes accordingly through the magnetic-field dependence of $E_c$. The corresponding pair production rate is not independently calculated; instead, its qualitative behavior is characterized through a proxy derived from the total potential. Overall, our analysis provides a comprehensive picture of how translational symmetry breaking, finite density, and external magnetic fields influence holographic non-perturbative pair production.

classification.title_zh: 具有平移对称破缺的全息Schwinger效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在有限化学势下具有平移对称破缺（TSB）背景中的全息Schwinger效应。引力背景由两个独立参数刻画：控制动量弛豫的TSB参数 α，以及决定对偶场论有限密度的化学势 μ。使用势分析方法，我们推导了控制对产生过程的总势，并考察了其对 α、μ、外磁场以及比值 β=E/E_c 的依赖。结果表明，α 和 μ 对Schwinger过程的影响强烈依赖于动力学区域。在亚临界区域，增大 α 或 μ 都会降低势垒并促进对产生。然而，在临界电场附近及以上，这两个参数的作用在定性上变得不同。增大化学势会降低总势并增强全息Schwinger对产生过程，而增大平移对称破缺参数则使势上移并抑制产生过程。我们进一步表明，在固定 β=E/E_c 时，垂直外磁场会降低有效势垒，从而促进Schwinger过程，同时物理电场通过 E_c 的磁场依赖性相应改变。相应的对产生率并未独立计算；相反，其定性行为通过由总势导出的代理量来刻画。总体而言，我们的分析全面展示了平移对称破缺、有限密度和外磁场如何影响全息非微扰对产生。
classification.one_liner: 在有限化学势和动量弛豫背景下，用势分析研究平移对称破缺、有限密度和外磁场对全息Schwinger对产生的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于AdS/CFT理论全息研究，涉及非平衡对产生、临界电场以及有限密度/平移对称破缺背景；与‘相变与气泡成核’有部分概念重叠，但未直接对应全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5、经典引力等具体重点支线。

papers.title: Entropy applications in cosmology: spacetime thermodynamics, holographic dark energy, entropic gravity and beyond - a review
papers.abstract: Entropy has emerged as a key concept at the intersection of gravity, quantum theory, and cosmology, revealing deep connections between geometry, information, and thermodynamics. The realization that black holes are thermodynamic systems, characterized by an entropy proportional to their horizon area, has provided evidence that spacetime itself may possess a microscopic structure. Since then, entropy has acquired a central role across quantum field theory, holography, quantum gravity, and cosmology. In this review, we present a unified account of entropy in gravitational and cosmological contexts. We first survey entropy in gravitational systems, focusing on black-hole thermodynamics, entropy bounds, the holographic principle, entanglement entropy, and the area law, together with the main corrections and generalizations arising from quantum field theory, generalized uncertainty principles, modified statistics, and extended theories of gravity. We then discuss three conceptually distinct ways in which entropy is employed in cosmology. The first is through the spacetime-thermodynamics conjecture, in which gravitational dynamics emerge from thermodynamic relations applied to cosmological horizons, and generalized entropy forms consequently lead to modified cosmological evolution. The second is the holographic approach, in which entropy bounds constrain the vacuum energy of the Universe, giving rise to the holographic dark energy scenario and its various extensions. The third is entropic gravity, where gravity is interpreted as an emergent phenomenon of entropic origin, leading to interesting cosmological phenomenology. By reviewing the theoretical foundations and cosmological implications of these entropic frameworks, we aim to clarify the role of entropy, discuss open issues and outline directions toward a deeper thermodynamic and informational understanding of gravity and cosmology.
