classification.title_zh: 熵在宇宙学中的应用：时空热力学、全息暗能量、熵引力及其他——综述
classification.abstract_zh: 熵已成为引力、量子理论与宇宙学交叉领域的关键概念，揭示了几何、信息与热力学之间的深刻联系。黑洞是热力学系统，其熵正比于视界面积，这一认识提供了时空本身可能具有微观结构的证据。此后，熵在量子场论、全息、量子引力与宇宙学中取得了核心地位。在这篇综述中，我们对引力和宇宙学语境中的熵给出统一论述。我们首先综述引力系统中的熵，聚焦黑洞热力学、熵界、全息原理、纠缠熵与面积律，以及由量子场论、广义不确定性原理、修改统计和扩展引力理论带来的主要修正与推广。随后我们讨论熵在宇宙学中被使用的三种概念上不同的方式。第一种是时空热力学猜想，其中引力动力学由应用于宇宙学视界的热力学关系涌现，而广义熵形式随之导致修改后的宇宙学演化。第二种是全息方法，其中熵界约束宇宙真空能，产生全息暗能量场景及其多种扩展。第三种是熵引力，其中引力被解释为熵起源的涌现现象，并带来有趣的宇宙学现象学。通过回顾这些熵框架的理论基础与宇宙学含义，我们旨在阐明熵的作用，讨论开放问题，并勾勒通向对引力与宇宙学更深刻热力学与信息理解的方向。
classification.one_liner: 一篇统一综述引力与宇宙学中熵的角色，涵盖黑洞热力学、全息原理、时空热力学、全息暗能量与熵引力。
classification.relevance_reason: 该综述涉及全息原理、全息暗能量和引力热力学，与全息及引力学主题相关；但它不是专门针对用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、探针膜、QNM或冷原子等具体支线。

papers.title: Black Holes and Scalar Propagation in Three-Dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet Gravity
papers.abstract: We derive an analytic black-hole family in three-dimensional scalar--tensor Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity with positive coupling. A single implicit equation determines the static circular metric and a scalar linear in time. We show that these solutions exhaust regular nonextremal exteriors with the stated AdS boundary conditions and a fixed nonzero coefficient of time in the scalar. The coupled metric and scalar perturbations have one propagating degree of freedom. On one branch, its kinetic coefficient is positive, its equation is hyperbolic throughout the exterior, and its bulk spatial energy is positive for perturbations of compact support. Scalar signals can cross the metric horizon outward, so exterior evolution needs information from the interior. For linear perturbations with the original metric and scalar boundary values fixed, nonzero compact initial master displacements with zero velocity can evolve only until their first contact with the AdS boundary. We derive this restriction from the original metric and scalar equations.

classification.title_zh: 三维Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet引力中的黑洞与标量传播
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在三维标量-张量Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet引力中，针对正耦合，推导出一类解析黑洞解族。单个隐式方程确定了静态圆对称度规以及一个随时间线性变化的标量。我们证明，在所述AdS边界条件且标量中时间系数固定非零的情况下，这些解穷尽了规则非极端外部解。耦合的度规与标量扰动只有一个传播自由度。在其中一个分支上，其动能系数为正，其方程在整个外部区域为双曲型，且对于紧支撑扰动，其体空间能量为正。标量信号可以向外穿过度规视界，因此外部演化需要来自内部的信息。对于固定原度规与标量边界值的线性扰动，具有零速度的非零紧支撑初始主位移只能演化到它们第一次接触AdS边界为止。我们从原度规与标量方程推导出这一限制。
classification.one_liner: 三维正耦合标量-张量Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet引力中给出解析黑洞解族，并分析耦合标量/度规扰动的传播、视界穿越与AdS边界限制。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文主要研究三维Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet修改引力中的经典黑洞解与标量扰动传播，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；摘要未涉及AdS/CFT对偶或量子引力信息。

papers.title: On the Modes at the Schwarzschild Black Hole Horizon
papers.abstract: We discuss the origin of the modes appearing at the Schwarzschild black hole horizon and decaying at integer multiples of the surface gravity. We argue that no excitations generated at the horizon by the plunging of a particle into a black hole can leave it. Our argument is based on the fact that, when the particle approaches the horizon, its speed is necessarily boosted to ultra-relativistic values and its near-horizon gravitational field becomes a Dray-'t Hooft shockwave, which is an exact, nonanalytic, and nonperturbative solution of Einstein's equations. The corresponding metric perturbations are localized at the horizon and can never reach a distant observer.

classification.title_zh: 关于史瓦西黑洞视界处的模式
classification.abstract_zh: 我们讨论了出现在史瓦西黑洞视界处、并以表面引力的整数倍衰减的模式的起源。我们认为，由粒子坠入黑洞在视界处产生的激发不能离开视界。我们的论证基于如下事实：当粒子趋近视界时，其速度必然被加速到超相对论值，其近视界引力场变为 Dray-'t Hooft 冲击波，而这是爱因斯坦方程的一个精确、非解析且非微扰的解。相应的度规扰动局域在视界处，永远无法到达远处观测者。
classification.one_liner: 粒子坠入史瓦西黑洞时，近视界引力场成为 Dray-'t Hooft 冲击波；视界处产生的模式被局域化，无法逃逸到远处观测者。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究史瓦西黑洞视界、爱因斯坦方程与经典引力扰动，属于用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线；其关于视界处模式与衰减的讨论也接近 QNM 相关主题。

papers.title: Conserved charges and the first law of black holes for field dependent symmetry generators in the covariant phase space formalism
papers.abstract: In this paper, we generalize the covariant phase space formalism conjugate to field dependent vectors to include internal gauge transformations when gauge fields are present. In our formalism, the symmetry generators are combination of diffeomorphisms plus internal gauge transformations and depend on the field configuration. When the field dependence of the symmetry generators is considered in the covariant phase space formalism, the first law of black hole thermodynamics is a direct result for generally invariant gravitational theories. To check the validity of our formalism, we investigate the conserved charges and the first laws of thermodynamics for a torus-like black hole in Einstein-Maxwell theory and a charged Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg AdS black hole in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg nonlinear electrodynamics.

classification.title_zh: 协变相空间形式中依赖场的对称生成元的守恒荷与黑洞第一定律
classification.abstract_zh: 本文推广了与场依赖矢量共轭的协变相空间形式，以在存在规范场时纳入内部规范变换。在我们的形式中，对称生成元是微分同胚加内部规范变换的组合，并依赖于场构型。当在协变相空间形式中考虑对称生成元的场依赖性时，对于一般协变引力理论，黑洞热力学第一定律是一个直接结果。为检验该形式的有效性，我们研究了爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦理论中环面状黑洞以及爱因斯坦-欧拉-海森堡非线性电动力学中带电的爱因斯坦-欧拉-海森堡 AdS 黑洞的守恒荷与热力学第一定律。
classification.one_liner: 将协变相空间形式推广到场依赖的微分同胚加规范生成元，并导出一般协变引力理论中的黑洞第一定律，在 Einstein-Maxwell 环面黑洞与 Euler-Heisenberg AdS 黑洞中验证。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典引力中的协变相空间、守恒荷与黑洞第一定律，直接属于用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；摘要未涉及全息对偶、量子信息或凝聚态等全息支线。

papers.title: Evolution dynamics of spinning binaries in effective-one-body theory to fifth Post-Minkowskian order
papers.abstract: This paper investigates a self-consistent effective-one-body (EOB) theory developed to describe the dynamics of spinning binary systems. We systematically derive, using field-theoretic principles, all expressions and quantities entering Hamilton's equations, which govern the dynamical evolution of the system. Based on the effective rotating metric up to fifth post-Minkowskian (PM) order recently obtained by us, we construct the Hamiltonian and the stress-energy tensor. We then derive a decoupled, separable Teukolsky-like equation with a source term for the Newman--Penrose Weyl scalar $\psi_4^B$ and present its formal solution. Finally, using this solution, we obtain the energy flux, radiation-reaction force, and gravitational waveforms for the ``plus'' and ``cross'' polarizations generated by spinning binaries. The EOB theory applies to systems with arbitrary mass ratio, which filling the gap between comparable mass ratios and extreme mass ratios.

classification.title_zh: 五阶后闵可夫斯基有效单体理论中自旋双星系统的演化动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究了为描述自旋双星系统动力学而建立的自洽有效单体（EOB）理论。我们利用场论原理系统推导了进入哈密顿方程的表达式和量，这些方程支配该系统的动力学演化。基于我们最近得到的直到五阶后闵可夫斯基（PM）阶的有效旋转度规，我们构造了哈密顿量和应力-能量张量。随后，我们推导了带有源项的、解耦可分离的类Teukolsky方程，用于Newman-Penrose外尔标量 ψ4^B，并给出其形式解。最后，利用该解，我们得到了自旋双星产生的能量通量、辐射反作用力以及“加”和“叉”偏振的引力波波形。该EOB理论适用于任意质量比系统，填补了可比质量比与极端质量比之间的空白。
classification.one_liner: 在五阶后闵可夫斯基阶构建自旋双星的有效单体理论，推导哈密顿量、类Teukolsky方程并给出引力波波形与辐射反作用。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力/广义相对论框架下的自旋双星动力学、后闵可夫斯基展开与引力波波形，匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；与全息对偶无关。

papers.title: Scalar Gauss-Bonnet Wormholes and the Imaginary Distance Bound
papers.abstract: We study $O(4)$ symmetric Euclidean wormholes in four-dimensional gravity with a massless scalar linearly coupled to the Gauss-Bonnet invariant. At nonzero coupling, the Einstein wormhole becomes a regular complex saddle that satisfies the Kontsevich-Segal-Witten criterion until its branch ends at a finite coupling. In asymptotically flat space, the Gauss-Bonnet term modifies the scalar displacement and the on-shell action for finite wormholes, but the size dependent parts of both corrections vanish in the large throat limit. The original imaginary distance threshold therefore remains unchanged. A negative cosmological constant already lowers the Einstein large throat imaginary distance relative to its flat space value. When the Gauss-Bonnet coupling is also present, the scalar is no longer a modulus as it develops a logarithmic running and its trajectory has infinite length. Subtracting the logarithmic asymptotic behavior leaves a finite regulated displacement. Its large throat value is shifted upward from the Einstein AdS result by the Gauss-Bonnet interaction and determines the leading large charge behavior of the renormalized fixed charge action.

classification.title_zh: 标量 Gauss-Bonnet 虫洞与虚距离界限
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了四维引力中 O(4) 对称欧几里得虫洞，其中无质量标量与 Gauss-Bonnet 不变量线性耦合。在非零耦合下，Einstein 虫洞变为规则复鞍点，并满足 Kontsevich-Segal-Witten 判据，直到其分支在有限耦合处结束。在渐近平直空间中，Gauss-Bonnet 项修正有限虫洞的标量位移和壳上作用量，但两者中依赖尺寸的修正在大喉极限下消失；因此原虚距离阈值保持不变。负宇宙学常数已使 Einstein 大喉虚距离低于平直空间值。当也存在 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合时，标量不再是模量，因为它产生对数跑动且其轨迹长度无限。减去对数渐近行为后留下有限正则化位移。其大喉值被 Gauss-Bonnet 相互作用从 Einstein AdS 结果向上移动，并决定重整化固定电荷作用量的大电荷主导行为。
classification.one_liner: 在含标量-Gauss-Bonnet 耦合的四维欧几里得虫洞中，平直空间虚距离阈值保持不变，而 AdS 中标量迹出现对数跑动，正则化位移的大喉值上移并主导重整化固定电荷作用量的大电荷行为。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要涉及四维标量-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中的欧几里得虫洞解、壳上作用量和复鞍点判据，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；但与全息超流、p 波、multi-trace、QNM 等其他用户重点标签无关。

papers.title: Fermionic cosmic strings in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate topological defects produced by a chiral phase transition in a fermionic ultraviolet completion of dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) gravity. The model contains a complex scalar field with a chiral Yukawa coupling to fermions. Below the chiral symmetry breaking scale, integrating out the gapped bulk modes produces a gravitational Chern-Simons coupling which, we argue, modifies cosmic string solutions from the phase transition. The resulting corrected string metric is supported by a generalization of the Callan-Harvey fermionic zero mode solution, in which the null current generated by these zero modes provides a mechanism for parity violation. In the weak-coupling and weak-gravity regime, we derive the leading order-reduced dCS correction to this exterior metric. We also discuss the effective action description for generic string configurations in dCS gravity. The gravitational Pontryagin term provides the anomaly inflow required to cancel the gravitational anomaly of the chiral worldsheet theory.

classification.title_zh: 动力学 Chern-Simons 引力中的费米子宇宙弦
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了动态 Chern-Simons (dCS) 引力的一个费米子紫外完成中，由手征相变产生的拓扑缺陷。该模型包含一个复标量场，其与费米子存在手征 Yukawa 耦合。在手征对称性破缺标度以下，积掉有能隙的体模式会产生一个引力 Chern-Simons 耦合；我们论证，这会修改相变产生的宇宙弦解。所得的修正弦度规由 Callan-Harvey 费米子零模解的一个推广所支持，其中这些零模产生的零流提供了宇称破坏的机制。在弱耦合与弱引力区域，我们推导了该外部度规的主导阶约化 dCS 修正。我们还讨论了 dCS 引力中一般弦构型的有效作用量描述。引力 Pontryagin 项提供了必要的反常流入，以抵消手征世界面理论的引力反常。
classification.one_liner: 在手征相变费米子紫外完成中，动态 Chern-Simons 引力修正宇宙弦度规，并由 Callan-Harvey 零模和反常流入支持。
classification.relevance_reason: 与“经典引力/广义相对论”支线直接相关，研究 dCS 引力中宇宙弦的修正度规；拓扑缺陷对应“畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀”。不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息，因此全息相关性强弱有限。

papers.title: Equal-GNO Sectors and Fuzzy-Sphere Vacua: Large-Charge ADHM-BMN Index Matching
papers.abstract: We establish a protected-sector relation between the superconformal index of the three-dimensional ADHM theory and the fixed-vacuum Witten index of BMN matrix quantum mechanics. The comparison selects a positive equal-magnetic-charge sector of the ADHM localization formula and a BMN vacuum made from identical fuzzy-sphere blocks. Equal magnetic charges preserve the complete multiplicity gauge group and make the vector and adjoint determinants independent of the common charge. Fundamental fields instead experience the full monopole background and develop a magnetic gap. In the large-GNO-charge limit, their oscillator determinant decouples from every fixed order of the protected expansion, while the associated vacuum monomial survives and fixes the normalization of the sector. After this normalization, the ADHM matrix integral in the large-GNO-charge limit agrees coefficientwise with the large-block limit of the BMN index. The matching therefore arises from two physically distinct mechanisms: in the large-GNO-charge limit, the fundamental-hypermultiplet excitations become magnetically heavy and decouple on the ADHM side, while in the large-block limit, the finite fuzzy-sphere angular-momentum cutoff is removed on the BMN side, leaving the complete angular tower. We establish the correspondence coefficientwise, distinguish the exact determinant identities from the large-charge asymptotics, and show that the GNO-charge partition becomes, after the M-theory uplift, the distribution of longitudinal momentum among the BMN fuzzy-sphere blocks.

classification.title_zh: 等 GNO 荷扇区与模糊球真空：大荷 ADHM-BMN 指数匹配
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了三维 ADHM 理论的超共形指数与 BMN 矩阵量子力学的固定真空 Witten 指数之间的受保护扇区关系。该比较选取 ADHM 定域公式中一个正等磁荷扇区，以及由相同模糊球块构成的 BMN 真空。相等磁荷保持完整的重数规范群，并使矢量与伴随行列式不依赖于公共荷。基本场则经历完整磁单极背景并产生磁间隙。在大 GNO 荷极限下，它们的振子行列式与受保护展开的每一固定阶解耦，而相关真空单项式仍保留并固定该扇区的归一化。经过此归一化后，大 GNO 荷极限下的 ADHM 矩阵积分与 BMN 指数的大块极限逐系数一致。因此匹配来自两个物理上不同的机制：在 ADHM 一侧的大 GNO 荷极限中，基本超多重态激发变得磁重并解耦；而在 BMN 一侧的大块极限中，有限的模糊球角动量截断被移除，留下完整的角动量塔。我们逐系数建立该对应关系，区分精确行列式恒等式与大荷渐近行为，并表明 GNO 荷配分在 M 理论升维后成为 BMN 模糊球块之间纵向动量的分布。
classification.one_liner: 在大 GNO 荷与模糊球大块极限下，ADHM 超共形指数与 BMN 矩阵量子力学 Witten 指数逐系数匹配。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 ADHM 与 BMN 的受保护指数匹配，属于矩阵模型/全息形式化方向；与用户列出的全息超流超导、p波、探针膜、相变成核、QNM、经典引力等重点标签无直接对应。

papers.title: Collapse to extremality: The third law of black hole thermodynamics in quantum gravity
papers.abstract: We present a two-step construction to violate the classical third law of black hole thermodynamics for charged black holes in four dimensions. A near-extremal black hole with an $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times X$ throat is first prepared and then driven to extremality in finite time by a charged shell. This construction suggests that the second step is universal for near-extremal black holes, and can be used to construct violations of the third law for Kerr black holes. The same description allows us to study the process in quantum gravity. The classical collapse condition selects a BF-violating matter sector, for which we construct a holographic dictionary and derive the quantum transition amplitude. Quantum effects replace the classical extremal endpoint by a probability distribution that vanishes at extremality and peaks at positive energy. This obstruction is consistent with the absence of non-supersymmetric extremal black hole states in quantum gravity. We show that driving the peak close enough to extremality for quantum gravity to become important requires a preparation time that scales with the black hole entropy.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 坍缩至极端性：量子引力中的黑洞热力学第三定律
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个两步构造，在四维带电黑洞中违反经典黑洞热力学第三定律。首先制备一个具有 AdS2×X 喉道的近极端黑洞，然后由带电壳在有限时间内将其驱动至极端。该构造表明第二步对近极端黑洞是普适的，并可用于构造克尔黑洞第三定律的违反。同一描述允许我们在量子引力中研究该过程。经典坍缩条件选择了一个 BF 违背的物质部分，我们为这部分构造了全息字典并推导出量子跃迁振幅。量子效应将经典极端端点替换为一个概率分布，该分布在极端处消失并在正能量处达到峰值。这一阻碍与量子引力中不存在非超对称极端黑洞态一致。我们表明，要使峰值足够接近极端性以使量子引力变得重要，所需的制备时间随黑洞熵标度。
classification.one_liner: 通过带电壳将近极端黑洞驱动至极端性可在经典上违反第三定律；量子引力将其改为在极端处消失的概率分布，且所需准备时间随黑洞熵增长。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究带电黑洞和克尔黑洞的经典第三定律违反及其量子引力/全息描述，涉及经典引力、近极端 AdS2 和全息字典，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”高度相关；未涉及全息超导、冷原子、QNM 等其他重点支线。

papers.title: Frustration-Free Models for Topological Holography: Fusion Spin Chains as Boundary Algebras
papers.abstract: We introduce a class of $2d$ quantum spin systems based on a unitary spherical fusion category with a chosen object. These models have frustration-free, reflection positive, but generally non-commuting local interactions, generalizing the Levin-Wen string-net models. Based on the theory developed in arXiv:2510.20662, we explicitly realize the Temperley-Lieb-Jones algebra, and more generally fusion spin chains as their boundary algebras.

classification.primary_topic: 全息凝聚态/超流超导/强关联
classification.title_zh: 拓扑全息的无阻挫模型：融合自旋链作为边界代数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们引入了一类基于带有选定对象的酉球面融合范畴的二维量子自旋系统。这些模型具有无阻挫、反射正性但通常非对易的局域相互作用，推广了 Levin-Wen 弦网模型。基于 arXiv:2510.20662 中发展的理论，我们显式实现了 Temperley-Lieb-Jones 代数，并且更一般地，将融合自旋链实现为其边界代数。
classification.one_liner: 提出一类推广 Levin-Wen 弦网模型的无阻挫二维量子自旋系统，并将融合自旋链实现为边界代数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于拓扑全息/融合范畴与量子自旋链的数学物理，与用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、multi-trace、QNM、经典引力等方向无直接交集。

papers.title: Strange Quark Stars and Spontaneous Scalarization
papers.abstract: Strange quark matter, as one of the most extreme dense states in astrophysics, can be explored through relativistic compact objects. Hypothetical relativistic stars composed of dense strange quark matter are characterized by the equation of state of that matter. The spontaneous scalarization of strange quark stars is influenced by the equation of state of strange quark matter. Here, we investigate how the equation of state of strange quark matter influences the spontaneous scalarization of these stars. Considering Normal, color-flavor-locked (CFL), and CFLm quark matter in the bag models and applying the scalar-tensor gravity, we calculate the structure of scalarized strange quark stars. We investigate how the effective bag constant, perturbative QCD parameter, CFL pairing gap, and strange quark mass control the mass-radius relation, the central scalar field, the scalarization thresholds, and the scalar charge. Our results demonstrate that strange quark stars in scalar-tensor gravity are viable, testable objects, and they establish a complete framework for constraining both the gravitational theory and the properties of cold quark matter with current and future multimessenger observations.

classification.title_zh: 奇异夸克星与自发标量化
classification.abstract_zh: 奇异夸克物质作为天体物理中最极端的致密态之一，可以通过相对论性致密天体进行研究。由致密奇异夸克物质构成的假想相对论性恒星，其特征由该物质的物态方程决定。奇异夸克星的自发标量化受到奇异夸克物质物态方程的影响。在这里，我们研究奇异夸克物质物态方程如何影响这些恒星的自发标量化。考虑袋模型中的正常、色味锁定（CFL）和 CFLm 夸克物质，并应用标量-张量引力，我们计算了标量化奇异夸克星的结构。我们研究有效袋常数、微扰 QCD 参数、CFL 配对能隙和奇异夸克质量如何控制质量-半径关系、中心标量场、标量化阈值和标量荷。我们的结果表明，标量-张量引力中的奇异夸克星是可行且可检验的天体，并且它们为利用当前和未来多信使观测来同时限制引力理论和冷夸克物质性质建立了一个完整框架。
classification.one_liner: 在标量-张量引力中研究不同奇异夸克物质物态方程对奇异夸克星自发标量化及星体结构的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/致密星与修改引力中的自发标量化研究，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶、量子信息或其他全息重点支线。

papers.title: Exact horizon response and charge ensembles of Majumdar--Papapetrou black holes
papers.abstract: We determine the electrostatic Dirichlet-to-Neumann map of an arbitrary four-dimensional Majumdar--Papapetrou spacetime. For a minimally coupled spectator Maxwell field, the potentials of the disconnected extremal horizons may be prescribed independently, and the resulting flux charges are related by an exact capacitance matrix. If the centers have masses $M_A$ and coordinate separations $R_{AB}$, its entries are $C_{AA}=M_A+\sum_{B\ne A}M_AM_B/R_{AB}$ and $C_{AB}=-M_AM_B/R_{AB}$. The matrix is a positive diagonal term plus the weighted Laplacian of the complete graph of horizons, giving an exact common-mode and differential-mode decomposition of the field energy. The grounded Dirichlet Green function shows that a point charge partitions its flux among infinity and the horizons according to elementary harmonic measures. A direct translation of the multicenter Green function of Frolov and Zelnikov gives the diagonal completion used in their published Eq.~(68), whose component-resolved Gauss flux preserves the total horizon charge but generally transfers charge between horizons. The symmetric Green function that preserves every horizon charge instead contains the inverse of the full capacitance matrix. For a binary, the difference gives a finite, negative-semidefinite shift of the electrostatic self-energy and a corresponding exact self-force difference without an additional ultraviolet subtraction. We finally extend the response matrix, flux partition, and fixed-charge Green function to $D=n+3$ dimensions, where the graph weights acquire the universal factor $\pi^{n/2}/\Gamma(n/2)$.

classification.title_zh: Majumdar--Papapetrou 黑洞的精确视界响应与电荷系综
classification.abstract_zh: 我们确定了任意四维 Majumdar--Papapetrou 时空的静电 Dirichlet-to-Neumann 映射。对于最小耦合的旁观 Maxwell 场，互不连通的极端视界的势可独立指定，产生的通量电荷由一个精确电容矩阵联系。若中心质量为 M_A，坐标间距为 R_AB，则矩阵元为 C_AA=M_A+Σ_{B≠A} M_A M_B/R_AB，C_AB=-M_A M_B/R_AB。该矩阵是一个正对角项加上视界完全图的加权 Laplacian，给出场能的精确共模与差模分解。接地 Dirichlet Green 函数表明，点电荷根据初等调和测度将其通量分配于无穷远与各视界之间。直接翻译 Frolov 和 Zelnikov 的多中心 Green 函数，可给出他们已发表 Eq.(68) 中使用的对角补全；其按分量分辨的 Gauss 通量保持总视界电荷，但通常会在视界之间转移电荷。而保持每个视界电荷的对称 Green 函数则包含完整电容矩阵的逆。对于双黑洞，二者之差给出静电自能的有限、半负定移动，以及相应的精确自作用力差，无需额外紫外减除。最后，我们将响应矩阵、通量分配和固定电荷 Green 函数推广到 D=n+3 维，其中图权重获得普适因子 π^{n/2}/Γ(n/2)。
classification.one_liner: 该文给出四维及更高维 Majumdar--Papapetrou 黑洞的精确视界静电响应矩阵、通量分配与保持视界电荷的 Green 函数，并导出双黑洞自能与自作用力修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典广义相对论中的多中心极端黑洞、视界电磁响应、Green 函数与自作用力，属于用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”的范围。

papers.title: Tidal Love numbers of wormholes as black-hole mimickers
papers.abstract: We study the dynamical scalar tidal Love numbers of wormholes that provide viable mimickers for black holes, focusing on thin-shell Schwarzschild and Damour-Solodukhin geometries. Using a matched near- and far-zone expansion, we determine their tidal response in the low-frequency regime. The presence of a long throat introduces an additional characteristic scale and naturally separates the modes into two classes. Super-throat modes probe the global wormhole geometry and are sensitive to both asymptotic regions, whereas sub-throat modes probe only one side of the wormhole and effectively perceive the throat as a black-hole horizon. We derive the scalar tidal Love numbers analytically for both classes of modes and show that their dissipative parts exhibit distinct low-frequency behavior, reflecting whether one or both potential barriers participate in the scattering process. We further find that, as the wormhole approaches the black-hole limit, the super-throat contribution becomes progressively negligible, while the sub-throat response smoothly reduces to that of a Schwarzschild black hole. These results demonstrate that the tidal response of wormholes depends crucially on whether the perturbation probes the global structure of the throat.

classification.title_zh: 作为黑洞模拟体的虫洞的潮汐 Love 数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究作为黑洞可行模拟体的虫洞的动态标量潮汐 Love 数，重点关注薄壳 Schwarzschild 和 Damour-Solodukhin 几何。利用匹配的近区和远区展开，我们确定它们在低频区域中的潮汐响应。长喉的存在引入了一个额外特征尺度，并自然地将模式分为两类。超喉模式探测全局虫洞几何，并对两个渐近区域都敏感；而亚喉模式只探测虫洞的一侧，并有效地将喉感知为黑洞视界。我们解析地推导了两类模式的标量潮汐 Love 数，并表明它们的耗散部分表现出不同的低频行为，反映了是一个还是两个势垒参与散射过程。我们进一步发现，当虫洞趋近黑洞极限时，超喉贡献逐渐变得可忽略，而亚喉响应平滑地约化为 Schwarzschild 黑洞的响应。这些结果表明，虫洞的潮汐响应关键取决于扰动是否探测喉的全局结构。
classification.one_liner: 虫洞的标量潮汐 Love 数因长喉分为超喉与亚喉两类，并在趋近黑洞极限时平滑回到 Schwarzschild 黑洞响应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力中的虫洞/黑洞替代体潮汐响应，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，与用户重点标签高度相关；摘要未涉及全息对偶或量子信息。

papers.title: Evaporating cosmologically coupled black holes
papers.abstract: Cosmologically coupled black holes (CCBHs), whose masses evolve in response to the cosmological expansion, have recently attracted significant theoretical and observational interest. Existing studies have treated CCBHs as purely classical objects, neglecting the effect of Hawking radiation (HR), which competes with the cosmological coupling (CC) mechanism. We take a first step towards studying evaporating CCBHs, adopting a quasi-adiabatic approximation in which the HR rate is evaluated at the instantaneous CCBH mass, and modeling the CC mechanism through the phenomenological scaling of the mass with the scale factor, $M \propto a^k$. We show that, depending on the coupling strength $k$, even late-time CC activation can significantly delay Hawking evaporation, or lead to asymptotic CC-dominated mass growth, with important implications. We set limits on the abundance of primordial CCBHs from $\gamma$-ray observations, finding limits which are weaker than their uncoupled counterparts, as CCBHs are kept farther from the endpoint of evaporation for a longer time. Unlike standard primordial black holes, the CCBH formation and present-day masses no longer approximately coincide, even for formation masses $M_{\text{form}} \gtrsim 10^{15}\,{\text{g}}$. Therefore, the same population of primordial CCBHs may be subject to evaporation limits through its past emission history, as well as to other limits (such as microlensing) through its present-day mass.

classification.title_zh: 蒸发中的宇宙学耦合黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 宇宙学耦合黑洞（CCBH）的质量随宇宙膨胀演化，近来引起理论和观测上的关注。已有研究将 CCBH 视为纯经典客体，忽略了霍金辐射（HR）的影响，而 HR 会与宇宙学耦合（CC）机制竞争。我们采用准绝热近似，在瞬时 CCBH 质量处计算 HR 速率，并通过质量随标度因子的唯象标度 M ∝ a^k 来建模 CC 机制，从而首次研究蒸发中的 CCBH。我们表明，取决于耦合强度 k，即使晚期才激活 CC，也能显著延迟霍金蒸发，或导致渐近的 CC 主导质量增长，具有重要含义。我们利用伽马射线观测对原初 CCBH 丰度设限，发现限制比未耦合情形更弱，因为 CCBH 在更长时间内远离蒸发终点。与标准原初黑洞不同，即使形成质量 M_form ≳ 10^15 g，CCBH 的形成质量和今日质量也不再近似相等。因此，同一原初 CCBH 族群可能因其过去的发射历史而受到蒸发限制，也可能因其今日质量而受到其他限制（如微引力透镜）。
classification.one_liner: 采用准绝热近似研究宇宙学耦合黑洞的霍金蒸发，并给出原初 CCBH 的伽马射线丰度限制。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于黑洞蒸发、原初黑洞宇宙学与观测限制，不属于 AdS/CFT 全息、纠缠或量子信息主线；仅与经典引力/黑洞宇宙学相关。

papers.title: Dynamical tidal response of neutron stars: From effective field theory to gravitational waveforms
papers.abstract: We investigate the fully relativistic dynamical tidal response of neutron stars up to second order in the frequency. Combining the worldline effective field theory for extended gravitating bodies with perturbation theory of relativistic stellar models, we derive the tidal deformation induced by an external time-dependent field, including a universal logarithmic running term. In the effective theory, we work in dimensional regularization and, through a consistent matching procedure, obtain for the first time the complete leading-order dynamical tidal corrections to both the conservative dynamics and the gravitational-wave signal of compact binaries, including the scheme-dependent finite terms in addition to the running. We show that, in the relativistic regime, dynamical effects cannot be fully captured by mode excitations alone. The magnitude of the additional contribution depends on the stellar compactness, the equation of state, and the running term. Dynamical Love numbers are significantly enhanced with respect to their static counterparts for relatively small compactness. As a result, although they formally enter the gravitational-wave phase at eighth post-Newtonian order, dynamical tidal effects yield a nonnegligible contribution during the late inspiral. Using a Fisher-matrix analysis, we show that third-generation detectors such as the Einstein Telescope could measure dynamical Love numbers for a range of neutron-star masses and equations of state. Conversely, neglecting these effects can lead to significant biases in the inference of static Love numbers, and hence on the nuclear equation of state. Our results highlight the importance of dynamical tidal effects for high-precision gravitational-wave modeling with future detectors.

classification.title_zh: 中子星的动态潮汐响应：从有效场论到引力波波形
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了中子星完全相对论性的动态潮汐响应，精确到频率的二阶。将扩展引力体的世界线有效场论与相对论恒星模型的微扰论相结合，我们推导了由外部含时场诱导的潮汐形变，其中包括一个普适的对数跑动项。在有效理论中，我们在维数正规化下工作，并通过一致匹配程序，首次得到了对紧致双星保守动力学和引力波信号两者的完整领头阶动态潮汐修正，包括除跑动项之外还依赖于方案的有穷项。我们表明，在相对论区域，动态效应不能仅由模式激发完全描述。附加贡献的大小取决于恒星紧致度、物态方程和跑动项。对于相对较小的紧致度，动态 Love 数相对于其静态对应值显著增强。因此，尽管它们形式上以第八后牛顿阶进入引力波相位，动态潮汐效应在旋近晚期产生不可忽略的贡献。使用 Fisher 矩阵分析，我们表明第三代探测器如爱因斯坦望远镜可以测量一定范围的中子星质量和物态方程下的动态 Love 数。相反，忽略这些效应会导致对静态 Love 数推断的显著偏差，从而影响对核物态方程的推断。我们的结果凸显了动态潮汐效应对未来探测器高精度引力波建模的重要性。
classification.one_liner: 结合世界线有效场论与相对论恒星微扰，首次给出紧致双星引力波中完整领头阶动态潮汐修正，并评估第三代探测器可测性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究中子星动态潮汐、紧致双星引力波波形与未来探测器测量，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Cosmological horizons in regular bouncing backgrounds
papers.abstract: It is often stated that a phase of standard, decelerated cosmological expansion is characterised by the absence of global event horizons, while a phase of accelerated expansion is associated with the absence of particle horizons. This is not necessarily true because such horizons, being non-local properties of the spacetime geometry, depend on the full (past and future) history of the given cosmological background. We provide examples of various different scenarios for the case in which the final asymptotic phase of standard expansion and decreasing curvature is connected, through a regular bounce, with an initial (and possibly infinitely extended in time) regime of growing curvature.

classification.title_zh: 规则反弹背景中的宇宙学视界
classification.abstract_zh: 人们常说，标准减速宇宙膨胀阶段的特点是不存在全局事件视界，而加速膨胀阶段则与不存在粒子视界相关。这未必正确，因为这类视界作为时空几何的非局域性质，依赖于给定宇宙学背景的完整（过去和未来）历史。我们给出了各种不同情形的例子：标准膨胀且曲率减小的最终渐近阶段，通过一个规则反弹，与曲率增长的初始（并且可能时间上无限延伸）阶段相连接。
classification.one_liner: 在规则反弹宇宙学背景中，事件视界与粒子视界的存在性取决于完整时空历史，而非仅由膨胀阶段加速或减速决定。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/宇宙学方向，讨论规则反弹时空中的宇宙学视界；未涉及全息对偶，但与用户重点标签‘经典引力/广义相对论’直接相关。

papers.title: Dynamical Tidal response of compact stars -- An EFT approach
papers.abstract: We apply the point particle EFT approach to a compact star to systematically compute dynamical tidal love numbers for various non-rotating compact objects, extending the treatment of {arXiv:2307.10391[hep-th], arXiv:2407.08327 [gr-qc]}. We calculate the scattering amplitude in Black Hole Perturbation Theory(BPHT) for \textit{arbitrary} non-rotating compact stars using the Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi(MST) method with non zero surface reflectivity and match it with that obtained from point particle EFT order by order in the low frequency expansion. This sets up a systematic framework for extracting the static and dynamical tidal love numbers(TLNs) to any order in the multipole expansion. In this paper, we employ the technique to compute the Next-to-Next-to Leading Order TLN upto a universal constant and its Renormalization Group equation for non-viscous Neutron stars and Neutron stars admixed with Bosonic or Fermionic dark matter.

classification.title_zh: 致密星的动力学潮汐响应——一种有效场论方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将点粒子有效场论（EFT）方法应用于致密星，以系统计算各种非旋转致密天体的动力学潮汐Love数，并扩展了 arXiv:2307.10391[hep-th] 与 arXiv:2407.08327[gr-qc] 的处理。我们使用 Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi（MST）方法，在非零表面反射率下计算任意非旋转致密星在黑洞微扰理论（BHPT）中的散射振幅，并将其与点粒子EFT在低频展开中逐阶得到的振幅相匹配。这建立了一个在多重展开中提取任意阶静态与动力学潮汐Love数（TLN）的系统框架。在本文中，我们使用该技术计算非粘性中子星以及混合玻色子或费米子暗物质的中子星的次次领头阶（NNLO）TLN（至一个普适常数）及其重整化群方程。
classification.one_liner: 用点粒子EFT与BHPT/MST匹配，系统提取致密星的静态与动力学潮汐Love数，并计算中子星及含暗物质中子星的NNLO TLN与RG方程。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究致密星潮汐响应与经典引力/广义相对论，使用EFT、BHPT和MST方法，匹配用户“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但与全息对偶无直接关系。

papers.title: Effective description of generalized disformal theories
papers.abstract: Generalized disformal transformations enable us to construct the generalized disformal Horndeski theories, which form the most general class of ghost-free scalar-tensor theories to this date. We extend the effective field theory (EFT) of cosmological perturbations to incorporate these generalized disformal Horndeski theories. The main difference from the conventional EFT is that our extended EFT involves operators with higher spatial derivatives of the lapse function. Our EFT also accommodates the generalized disformal transformation of U-DHOST theories.

classification.title_zh: 广义 disformal 理论的有效描述
classification.abstract_zh: 广义 disformal 变换使我们能够构造广义 disformal Horndeski 理论，这是迄今为止最一般的无鬼标量-张量理论。我们将宇宙学扰动的有效场论（EFT）推广以纳入这些广义 disformal Horndeski 理论。与传统 EFT 的主要区别在于，我们的扩展 EFT 包含带 lapse 函数更高空间导数的算符。我们的 EFT 也可容纳 U-DHOST 理论的广义 disformal 变换。
classification.one_liner: 将宇宙学扰动 EFT 推广到广义 disformal Horndeski 理论，包含 lapse 的高空间导数算符，并覆盖 U-DHOST。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典标量-张量修改引力与宇宙学扰动 EFT，可归入经典引力/广义相对论支线，但与全息、量子引力或量子信息主题无直接关系。

papers.title: Matrix Theory from Holography
papers.abstract: We propose a setup that embeds Matrix Theory for M-theory into the AdS/CFT correspondence, allowing the former to be tested using the latter. The central claim is a triality among the BMN matrix model of rank $m$, a large-charge monopole sector of ABJM theory with charge $J$, and M-theory on the maximally supersymmetric eleven-dimensional pp-wave with a compact lightlike direction. The relevant ABJM limit sends $N,k,J\to\infty$ while keeping $N/k^2$ and $m=J/k$ fixed. We provide quantitative evidence for this triality by showing that, in this triple-scaling limit, the ABJM superconformal index agrees precisely with a grand-canonical sum of Witten indices of the $U(m)$ BMN matrix model. This relation also yields a compact grand-canonical expression for the BMN index, which we use to revisit its large-$m$ behavior. Our analytic and numerical results reveal strong boson--fermion cancellations and show no evidence for the previously claimed $e^{O(m^2)}$ growth when the BMN charge scales as $Q \sim m^2$. We further study the correspondence between the BPS cohomologies of the two theories by constructing a letter-level dictionary. This leads to a new notion of BPS fortuity in ABJM theory that survives even at strict $N=\infty$: although the usual fortuity associated with finite-$N$ trace relations disappears in the triple-scaling limit, each fixed-monopole sector is governed by the effective rank $m$, and finite-$m$ trace relations generate fortuitous states that map directly to fortuitous states of the BMN matrix model. Finally, we discuss connections to related concepts such as large-charge matrix models, open--closed--open triality, and worldline holography.

classification.title_zh: 来自全息的矩阵理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个将 M 理论的矩阵理论嵌入 AdS/CFT 对应的方案，使前者能够借助后者接受检验。核心主张是秩 m 的 BMN 矩阵模型、ABJM 理论中电荷为 J 的大电荷磁单极子扇区，以及具有紧致类光方向的十一维最大超对称 pp-wave 上的 M 理论三者之间的 triality。相关 ABJM 极限令 N,k,J→∞，同时固定 N/k^2 和 m=J/k。我们通过证明在该三重标度极限下 ABJM 超共形指标与 U(m) BMN 矩阵模型 Witten 指标的大正则求和精确一致，为该 triality 提供定量证据。该关系还给出 BMN 指标的紧凑大正则表达式，我们用它重新审视其大 m 行为。我们的解析和数值结果显示强玻色-费米抵消，并表明当 BMN 电荷按 Q ∼ m^2 标度时，没有先前声称的 e^{O(m^2)} 增长的证据。我们进一步通过构造 letter-level 字典来研究两理论 BPS 上同调之间的对应。这引出 ABJM 理论中一种新的 BPS fortuity 概念，即使在严格 N=∞ 时仍存在：虽然与有限 N trace relations 相关的通常 fortuity 在三重标度极限中消失，但每个固定磁单极子扇区由有效秩 m 支配，有限 m trace relations 会产生直接映射到 BMN 矩阵模型 fortuitous states 的 fortuitous states。最后，我们讨论与 large-charge matrix models、open-closed-open triality 和 worldline holography 等相关概念的联系。
classification.one_liner: 提出 BMN 矩阵模型、ABJM 大电荷磁单极子扇区与十一维 pp-wave 上的 M 理论之间的三重对偶，并用指标匹配检验矩阵理论。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与矩阵模型理论，核心是 BMN/ABJM 指标匹配和 trace relations/fortuity，因此与重点标签中的 multi-trace 支线间接相关；但不涉及全息超导、p波、畴壁、相变气泡、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7 或经典引力等具体方向。

papers.title: Criticality of ISCOs and AdS/CFT
papers.abstract: We study the trajectories of massive particles in spherically symmetric black holes in arbitrary dimensions, and find certain universal features based on the topological classification of the fixed points. If the system admits a center, we find two possible outcomes: regardless of the value of the angular momentum, the center always survives, which is realized in global AdS spacetimes or, the center disappears below a critical value of angular momentum, which happens for various spherically symmetric black holes. For the latter case, we find that irrespective of the details of the black hole, there must always be a saddle point. Topological arguments show that there exists a certain critical value of energy, angular momentum and the angular velocity, where the center and the saddle coalesce. This happens at a special point in the parameter space where the trajectories are the limiting innermost stable circular orbits (ISCOs). At the critical point, conserved quantities show universal, van der Waals-like mean-field scaling typical of a second-order phase transition. The anomalous dimensions $\gamma$ of the double-twist operators in the CFT are found, both using AdS/CFT and through the the heavy-heavy-light-light four point correlators, giving negative and positive values for the center and saddle, respectively, including the emergence of certain non-analytic behaviour at the ISCO. For the center, we also find subleading corrections in $\frac{1}{\Delta_H}$ to $\gamma$ in the dual CFT, and dsicuss the implications of our results.

classification.title_zh: ISCO 的临界性与 AdS/CFT
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究任意维球对称黑洞中大质量粒子的轨迹，并基于不动点的拓扑分类发现某些普适特征。如果系统存在中心，我们发现两种可能结果：无论角动量取值如何，中心始终存在，这实现于全域 AdS 时空中；或者当角动量低于临界值时中心消失，这发生在多种球对称黑洞中。对于后一种情形，我们发现无论黑洞细节如何，必存在一个鞍点。拓扑论证表明，存在某个能量、角动量和角速度的临界值，使中心与鞍点合并。这发生在参数空间中的特殊点，其轨迹为极限最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）。在临界点，守恒量显示出普适的、类似范德瓦尔斯平均场标度的二阶相变行为。我们得到 CFT 中双扭算符的反常维度 γ，既通过 AdS/CFT，也通过重-重-轻-轻四点关联函数，中心与鞍点分别给出负值和正值，并包括在 ISCO 处出现某种非解析行为。对于中心，我们还得到对偶 CFT 中 γ 在 1/Δ_H 的次领头修正，并讨论结果的意义。
classification.one_liner: 黑洞 ISCO 的拓扑临界点呈现范德瓦尔斯型二阶相变标度，并对应 AdS/CFT 中双扭算符反常维度的符号与临界行为。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及用户关注的经典引力/广义相对论中的 ISCO 与黑洞测地线，并讨论相变临界标度和 CFT 双扭算符反常维度，与 multi-trace/双迹类算符有间接关联；但不直接涉及全息超流超导、p波序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或 Floquet 驱动。

papers.title: Flat holography for spinor fields
papers.abstract: We extend the hyperbolic Milne-slicing construction of flat holography in four-dimensional Minkowski spacetime from scalar fields to massless spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ fields. We solve the massive mode equation and restrict the boundary source-response analysis to the massless sector. Decomposition into harmonics on three-dimensional hyperbolic space, labeled by a continuous principal-series parameter, yields a separated-point nonlocal kernel up to the action normalization and local contact terms. The kernel has the universal form required by two-dimensional conformal covariance for spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ principal-series primaries. Then we construct regular source-normalized conformal-primary wavefunctions in planar and global coordinates on the celestial sphere $S^2$. We show that the planar source-response kernel is naturally identified with the spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ shadow transform, while inverse shadowing recovers the angular delta-function structure of the unshadowed basis. We also analyze radial renormalization by analytic continuation from the principal-series problem to a real-mass AdS$_3$ problem.

classification.title_zh: 旋量场的平直全息
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将四维 Minkowski 时空中平直全息的双曲 Milne 切片构造从标量场推广到无质量自旋-1/2 场。我们求解有质量模式方程，并将边界源-响应分析限制在无质量扇区。通过按三维双曲空间上的谐波分解，并由连续主系列参数标记，得到在作用量归一化和局部接触项之外的一个分离点非局域核。该核具有二维共形协变性对自旋-1/2 主系列原场所要求的普遍形式。随后我们构造天球 S^2 上平面坐标和全局坐标中的正则源归一化共形原场波函数。我们表明平面源-响应核自然等同于自旋-1/2 shadow 变换，而逆 shadowing 恢复未 shadow 基的角向 delta 函数结构。我们还通过从主系列问题到实质量 AdS3 问题的解析延拓分析径向重整化。
classification.one_liner: 将平直全息的双曲 Milne 切片构造推广到无质量旋量场，并给出其天球共形原场与 shadow 变换结构。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于平直时空/天球全息中的旋量场构造，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet或经典引力支线。

papers.title: Photon sphere for a dyonic black hole corresponding to $A_2$ Toda chain
papers.abstract: We consider a dilatonic dyon black hole solution with a gravitational radius of $2 \mu$ and two charges, $Q_1$ (electric) and $Q_2$ (magnetic), within the framework of a four-dimensional gravitational model comprising one scalar field and one 2-form. The dilaton coupling constant $\lambda$ is fixed by $\lambda^2 = \frac{3}{2}$. This solution is related to the $A_2$ Toda chain. The circular orbits of null geodesics are explored, and the fifth-order polynomial master equation governing the photon sphere radius $R_0$ is analyzed. It is shown to admit a unique solution satisfying $R_0 > 2 \mu$. The circular null geodesics are proven to be unstable. Finally, the black hole shadow is examined, yielding relations for the shadow angle and the critical impact parameter.

classification.title_zh: 对应于 A2 Toda 链的双荷黑洞的光子球
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在一个由单个标量场和一个 2-形式组成的四维引力模型框架内，考虑一个带有引力半径 2μ 和两个电荷 Q1（电）与 Q2（磁）的膨胀双荷黑洞解。膨胀耦合常数 λ 由 λ² = 3/2 固定。该解与 A2 Toda 链相关。我们探讨了零测地线的圆轨道，并分析了控制光子球半径 R0 的五阶多项式主方程。证明该方程存在唯一满足 R0 > 2μ 的解。我们证明这些圆零测地线是不稳定的。最后，我们考察了黑洞阴影，得到了阴影角和临界碰撞参数的关系。
classification.one_liner: 研究了 A2 Toda 链相关膨胀双荷黑洞的零测地线圆轨道、光子球半径与阴影。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究特定膨胀双荷黑洞的零测地线、光子球与黑洞阴影；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力信息课题。

papers.title: Light Cone Thermodynamics: Quasi-Local Formalism
papers.abstract: Inspired by black hole thermodynamics and other results suggesting that general relativity has some intrinsic connection with thermodynamics, this work aims to establish a quasi-local thermodynamic formalism in general spacetimes. With this purpose, we generalize the Bondi-Sachs formalism to past light cones associated with an arbitrary worldline. From this generalization, we demonstrate the emission of Hawking radiation in a quasi-local context through a few examples, suggesting that it may occur under mild conditions. In addition, we argue that an "irreversible inequality" is satisfied in typical gravitational systems, indicating that an analogue of the second law may be established. Together with a definition of internal energy derived from the Landau-Lifshitz pseudotensor, these results are used to construct a postulational framework that generalizes classical thermodynamics in order to include the dynamics of spacetime. As a consequence, it is possible to define the rest-mass density from thermodynamic variables, decoupling it from the dynamics of constituent numbers.
authors: Matheus G. Barbosa (S\~ao Carlos Institute of Physics

classification.title_zh: 光锥热力学：准局域形式体系
classification.abstract_zh: 受黑洞热力学以及其他暗示广义相对论与热力学存在内在联系的结果启发，本文旨在一般时空中建立准局域热力学形式。为此，作者将 Bondi-Sachs 形式推广到与任意世界线相关的过去光锥。通过若干例子，本文展示准局域背景下的 Hawking 辐射发射，并暗示它可能在温和条件下发生。此外，作者论证典型引力系统满足一种“不可逆不等式”，表明可以建立类似于第二定律的表述。结合由 Landau-Lifshitz 赝张量导出内能定义，这些结果被用于构造一个公理化框架，以将经典热力学推广至包含时空动力学。因此，可以从热力学变量定义静止质量密度，使其与组分数的动力学解耦。
classification.one_liner: 将 Bondi-Sachs 形式推广到任意世界线的过去光锥，建立准局域时空热力学并讨论 Hawking 辐射与类第二定律。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要属于经典引力/广义相对论与引力热力学支线，而非 AdS/CFT 全息研究；但涉及黑洞热力学、Hawking 辐射和准局域热力学，与用户的经典引力/广义相对论重点标签相关。

papers.title: Cosmology in sixth-order higher-derivative theories of gravity
papers.abstract:
We analyze the cosmological implications of theories of gravity with quadratic curvature invariants $R^2$ and $C^{\mu
uho\sigma}C_{\mu
uho\sigma}$, and six-derivative operators $R\Box R$ and $C^{\mu
uho\sigma}\Box C_{\mu
uho\sigma}$. We first analyze homogeneous and isotropic cosmological solutions, showing that the theory admits expanding, recollapsing and non-singular bouncing solutions. We clarify in the Einstein-frame formulation the mechanism that circumvents the Hawking--Penrose singularity theorems, and identify the role played by the additional higher-derivative degrees of freedom in that mechanism. We show that the complete set of linear equations governing tensor perturbations on standard backgrounds admit analytically stable solutions. The analysis reveals that the stability properties are determined by the pole structure of the propagator and by specific relations among the higher-derivative couplings, while the singularity-free backgrounds are found to be unstable against tensor perturbations. For scalar cosmological perturbations, the higher-derivative theories presents super-horizon scalar instabilities in de Sitter spacetimes for both quadratic and sixth-order gravity. To extract inflationary observables, we adopt an EFT approach to the sixth-order theory, treating these terms as perturbative corrections around the Starobinsky background. Within this framework, we compute the modification of the primordial scalar and tensor power spectra, obtaining predictions for the scalar spectral index and tensor-to-scalar ratio. We find that sixth-order operators produce controlled deviations from the Starobinsky model while preserving the EFT expansion, thereby providing a consistent phenomenological framework to probe ultraviolet gravitational corrections through cosmological observables.

classification.title_zh: 六阶高阶导数引力理论中的宇宙学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们分析了含二次曲率不变量 R^2 与 C^{μνρσ}C_{μνρσ}，以及六阶导数算符 R□R 与 C^{μνρσ}□C_{μνρσ} 的引力理论的宇宙学含义。首先研究均匀各向同性宇宙学解，表明该理论允许膨胀、再收缩以及非奇异反弹解。我们在 Einstein 框架中澄清了规避 Hawking–Penrose 奇点定理的机制，并指出额外高阶导数自由度在该机制中的作用。我们证明，标准背景上支配张量扰动的完整线性方程组具有解析稳定解。分析表明，稳定性由传播子的极点结构以及高阶导数耦合之间的特定关系决定，同时发现无奇点背景对张量扰动不稳定。对于标量宇宙学扰动，二次和六阶高阶导数理论在 de Sitter 时空中都存在超视界标量不稳定性。为提取暴胀观测量，我们对六阶理论采用 EFT 方法，将这些项视为 Starobinsky 背景附近的微扰修正。在此框架下，我们计算原初标量和张量功率谱的修正，得到标量谱指数和张量标量比的预言。我们发现六阶算符产生相对于 Starobinsky 模型的可控偏离，同时保持 EFT 展开，从而为通过宇宙学观测量探测紫外引力修正提供了一个一致的现象学框架。
classification.one_liner: 在含二次曲率与六阶导数项的引力理论中研究宇宙学解、扰动稳定性及对 Starobinsky 暴胀的 EFT 修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典/修改引力与宇宙学，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子信息，因此对全息相关支线不相关。

papers.title: Operator-Level Quantum-Classical Correspondence in Relativistic Quantum Theory and Curved Spacetime
papers.abstract: In a recent work \cite{Shaikh:2026nsi}, it was shown that for a non-relativistic particle, the operator equations of motion can be cast in the same differential form as Newton's equation of motion. This establishes a correspondence between quantum operator dynamics and classical mechanics at the level of the equations of motion. In this work, we investigate whether this correspondence extends to quantum field theory and linearized gravity. We explicitly show that the Heisenberg equations of motion for quantum field operators reproduce the corresponding classical equations of motion for a broad class of field theories. The Klein-Gordon equation, Maxwell's equations, Yang-Mills equations, and linearized Einstein equations are shown to arise at the operator level without taking the limit $\hbar\rightarrow0$. We then extend the analysis to curved spacetime and show that the quantum field operators satisfy the corresponding covariant field equations at the operator level. In the weak-field approximation, we show that the Heisenberg evolution of the metric-perturbations reproduces the linearized Einstein equations at the operator level. For a quantum particle in curved spacetime, the Heisenberg equations for position and momentum reproduce classical geodesic motion in the semiclassical limit, thereby extending the operator-level quantum-classical correspondence from fields to particle dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 相对论量子理论与弯曲时空中的算符级量子-经典对应
classification.abstract_zh: 在最近的一项工作中，已经表明对于非相对论粒子，算符运动方程可以写成与牛顿运动方程相同的微分形式。这在运动方程层面建立了量子算符动力学与经典力学之间的对应。在本工作中，我们研究这种对应是否能推广到量子场论和线性化引力。我们明确展示，对于一大类场论，量子场算符的海森堡运动方程重现相应的经典运动方程。Klein-Gordon 方程、Maxwell 方程、Yang-Mills 方程和线性化 Einstein 方程被证明可以在算符层面出现，而无需取 ħ → 0 极限。随后我们将分析推广到弯曲时空，并表明量子场算符在算符层面满足相应的协变场方程。在弱场近似下，我们表明度规微扰的海森堡演化在算符层面重现线性化 Einstein 方程。对于弯曲时空中的量子粒子，位置和动量算符的海森堡方程在半经典极限下重现经典测地线运动，从而将算符层面的量子-经典对应从场推广到粒子动力学。
classification.one_liner: 量子场算符的海森堡方程在不取 ħ → 0 时重现 Klein-Gordon、Maxwell、Yang-Mills 和线性化 Einstein 方程，并推广到弯曲时空与测地线运动。
classification.relevance_reason: 不属于 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶研究；但涉及线性化 Einstein 方程、弯曲时空和经典测地线运动，可对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签，故给中等相关度。

papers.title: Black Hole Perturbation Toolkit: Low frequency and post-Newtonian expansions
papers.abstract: The Teukolsky and SpinWeightedSpheroidalHarmonics packages of the black hole perturbation toolkit (BHPT) are one of the main public libraries to compute numerical solutions to the Teukolsky equation and related quantities. This work is a companion paper presenting their new and improved weak-field analytic functionality focusing on post-Newtonian expansions. The Teukolsky package now allows users to independently extract multiple useful quantities, such as the so called MST coefficients, renormalized angular momentum, amplitudes of the radial functions or the phase shift as a low frequency/PM expansion. It also provides PN expansions of the homogeneous radial functions or - for circular orbits in Kerr - inhomogeneous amplitudes, as well as energy and angular momentum fluxes at infinity and the horizon. All quantities can be computed to state of the art precision on regular laptops. It also provides a suite of tools for post-Newtonian self force computations and updates the analytic functionality of the SpinWeightedSpheroidalHarmonics package. Computations are possible both for specific and generic spin weight $s$ and harmonic mode numbers $\ell$ and $m$. This package paves the way for intensive high-order post-Newtonian self-force calculations at the forefront of waveform modelling of small mass ratio black hole binaries, as well as giving widely useful low-frequency expansions for black hole perturbation theory. All functions described in this paper are available in BHPT versions Teukolsky v.1.2 and SpinWeightedSpheroidalHarmonics v.1.1.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞微扰工具包：低频与后牛顿展开
classification.abstract_zh: 本文是黑洞微扰工具包（BHPT）中 Teukolsky 与 SpinWeightedSpheroidalHarmonics 软件的配套论文，介绍其新的和改进的弱场解析功能，重点是后牛顿展开。Teukolsky 包现在允许用户独立提取多个量，例如 MST 系数、重正化角动量、径向函数振幅或相移的低频/PM 展开；还提供齐次径向函数的 PN 展开，或 Kerr 圆轨道情形下非齐次振幅，以及无穷远和视界处的能量与角动量通量。所有量可在普通笔记本电脑上以当前先进精度计算。它还为后牛顿自能计算提供一套工具，并更新了 SpinWeightedSpheroidalHarmonics 包的解析功能。计算可针对特定和一般的自旋权重 s 与谐波模式数 ell、m 进行。该软件包为小质量比黑洞双星波形建模所需的高阶后牛顿自能计算铺路，并为黑洞微扰论提供广泛有用的低频展开。本文描述的所有函数均可在 BHPT 版本 Teukolsky v.1.2 和 SpinWeightedSpheroidalHarmonics v.1.1 中使用。
classification.one_liner: BHPT 新增低频与后牛顿解析展开功能，用于 Teukolsky 方程、自旋球谐、通量与自能计算。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要处理经典黑洞微扰、Teukolsky 方程以及后牛顿/自能计算，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Reconnection of Gravitational Fields
papers.abstract: In a tetrad formulation of general relativity, an ideal Ohm-type condition for the gravitational field implies the conservation of gravitational fluxes and the preservation of the connectivity of gravitational field sheets. We investigate the consequences of departures from ideal gravitational evolution by developing a theory of gravitational reconnection, defined as a change in the connectivity of gravitational field sheets arising from the breakdown of the ideal frozen-in evolution of the gravitational field. We derive quantitative measures of the gravitational reconnection rate, show that gravitational reconnection alters the energy-momentum exchange between the gravitational and matter sectors, and determine how it modifies the evolution of gravitational helicity. Our results provide a quantitative framework for describing changes in gravitational connectivity and their consequences in dynamical spacetimes.

classification.title_zh: 引力场的重联
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论的标架表述中，引力场的理想欧姆型条件意味着引力通量守恒以及引力场薄片连通性的保持。我们通过发展引力重联理论来研究偏离理想引力演化的后果；引力重联定义为由引力场理想冻结演化破缺所引起的引力场薄片连通性改变。我们推导引力重联率的定量度量，表明引力重联会改变引力部门与物质部门之间的能动量交换，并确定它如何修正引力螺旋度的演化。我们的结果为描述动力学时空中引力连通性的变化及其后果提供了定量框架。
classification.one_liner: 在标架广义相对论中建立引力重联理论，量化引力场连通性变化、能动量交换与引力螺旋度演化。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究引力场重联与理想冻结演化破缺，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签。

papers.title: Frozen-In Gravitational Fields
papers.abstract: Spacetime can undergo complex nonlinear evolution, as governed by the Einstein field equations, and a central challenge is to understand the geometric structures that arise, persist, and interact throughout its evolution. Using a formulation of Einstein equations that parallels nonlinear electrodynamics of continuous media, we show that general relativity admits gravitational field connections---two-surfaces and associated field lines whose connectivity is maintained by the spacetime dynamics. This gravitational frozen-in behavior is enabled by an ideal Ohm-type condition for the gravitational field. We further show that the same framework naturally leads to a conserved ``gravitational magnetic'' flux. A conserved gravitational helicity also emerges, with a clear topological interpretation in terms of gravitational field-line structures. These results identify well-defined topological constraints on admissible spacetime evolution and provide an organizing principle underlying the nonlinear dynamics of spacetime.

classification.title_zh: 冻结引力场
classification.abstract_zh: 时空可以经历复杂的非线性演化，这由爱因斯坦场方程支配；一个核心挑战是理解在其演化过程中出现、持续并相互作用的几何结构。通过一种与连续介质非线性电动力学相平行的爱因斯坦方程表述，我们表明广义相对论容许引力场连接——即双曲面及相关的场线，其连通性由时空动力学维持。这种引力冻结行为由引力场的理想欧姆型条件所促成。我们进一步表明，同一框架自然导致守恒的“引力磁”通量。一个守恒的引力螺旋度也随之出现，并在引力场线结构方面具有清晰的拓扑解释。这些结果给出了可容许时空演化的明确定义拓扑约束，并提供了一个支撑时空非线性动力学的组织原则。
classification.one_liner: 利用与连续介质非线性电动力学平行的爱因斯坦方程表述，发现广义相对论中引力场线可像理想磁流体中的磁场一样被冻结，并出现守恒的引力磁通与引力螺旋度，从而给出时空演化的拓扑约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究爱因斯坦场方程下的经典时空演化、引力场拓扑结构与守恒量，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Accurate Black Hole Quasinormal Modes, Regge Poles, and Greybody Factors from Light Ring Ladder Symmetry
papers.abstract: The characteristic oscillations of a black hole can be understood in terms of null rays trapped near its unstable light ring, with this correspondence becoming exact in the high-frequency limit. In this regime, we uncover a hidden ladder symmetry in the perturbation equations, which maps the calculation of quasinormal modes, Regge poles, and greybody factors for a spherically symmetric black hole onto the quantum-mechanical problem of an anharmonic oscillator. This provides a systematic, efficient framework for computing the black hole response, with improved convergence properties compared with existing approximation schemes. As an explicit application, we analytically compute all three quantities for a Schwarzschild black hole through eighteenth order in inverse angular momentum, obtaining highly accurate results. We explore different resummation schemes and find that they can further improve the accuracy of the Regge poles and, particularly, the greybody factors. Our framework can be readily extended to rotating black holes and to modified theories of gravity.

classification.title_zh: 从光环阶梯对称性精确计算黑洞准正规模、Regge 极点和灰体因子
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞的特征振荡可以借助被困在其不稳定光环附近的光线来理解，这种对应在高频极限下变得精确。在这一区域内，我们在微扰方程中发现了一种隐藏的阶梯对称性，它把球对称黑洞的准正规模、Regge 极点和灰体因子的计算映射为一个量子力学非谐振子问题。这为计算黑洞响应提供了一个系统而高效的框架，与现有近似方案相比收敛性更好。作为一个显式应用，我们在逆角动量的展开中解析计算了 Schwarzschild 黑洞的这三个量直至第十八阶，并获得了高精度结果。我们研究了不同重求和方案，发现它们可以进一步提高 Regge 极点、尤其是灰体因子的精度。我们的框架可以方便地推广到旋转黑洞和修改引力理论。
classification.one_liner: 利用光环附近的隐藏阶梯对称性，将 Schwarzschild 黑洞的 QNM、Regge 极点和灰体因子映射为非谐振子问题并高精度解析计算。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论，并研究黑洞 QNM、Regge 极点和灰体因子，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”高度相关。

papers.title: The BTZ black hole, the Third Law and gravitational collapse
papers.abstract: We prove that a Third Law of black hole mechanics holds for the BTZ black hole in 3d gravity coupled to matter obeying the dominant energy condition. This law states that initial data containing a trapped surface cannot evolve in finite time to a black hole that coincides with extremal BTZ on the event horizon, for any choice of boundary conditions at infinity. The result is proved by defining a quasilocal energy and angular momentum and using spinorial methods to establish a BPS inequality that is saturated by the extremal BTZ solution. Nevertheless, we show that gravitational collapse of a massless scalar field can result in the formation of an extremal BTZ black hole in finite time. The difference between these results arises because gravitational collapse occurs in the Neveu-Schwarz sector, whereas extremal BTZ is supersymmetric in the Ramond sector. Solutions that settle down to extremal BTZ in infinite time along the event horizon are also discussed.

classification.title_zh: BTZ黑洞、第三定律与引力坍缩
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在与满足主导能量条件的物质耦合的三维引力中，BTZ黑洞满足黑洞力学第三定律。该定律指出，包含陷阱面的初始数据不能在有穷时间内演化成一个在事件视界上与极端BTZ重合的黑洞，无论无穷远处边界条件如何选择。证明通过定义准局域能量和角动量，并使用旋量方法建立由极端BTZ解饱和的BPS不等式。尽管如此，我们表明无质量标量场的引力坍缩可以在有限时间内导致极端BTZ黑洞的形成。这些结果之间的差异源于引力坍缩发生在Neveu-Schwarz扇区，而极端BTZ在Ramond扇区是超对称的。还讨论了沿事件视界在无限时间内渐近趋于极端BTZ的解。
classification.one_liner: 证明物质耦合三维引力中BTZ黑洞满足第三定律：有陷阱面的初态不能在有限时间内成为视界上极端BTZ；但无质量标量场坍缩可在有限时间内形成极端BTZ，差异源于NS与R扇区。

papers.title: Density-driven reversal of flavour-entanglement anisotropy in the D3-D7 holographic conductor
papers.abstract: We study the leading probe-flavour contribution to equal-time spatial entanglement entropy in a homogeneous 3+1-dimensional strongly coupled conductor at finite temperature and charge density, realised holographically by the D3-D7 system and driven by a constant DC electric field. We compare slab-shaped subregions that are extended in two spatial directions and have finite width parallel or transverse to the field. The difference between the corresponding entropy corrections isolates a homogeneous, spatially traceless response and exhibits a density-driven sign reversal. Over the investigated parameter range, the crossover density increases with the electric-field magnitude and decreases with the strip width. Mutual information shows the same qualitative reversal and provides an ultraviolet-finite check. We trace the effect to a radial sign competition in the full Dirac-Born-Infeld stress anisotropy. The reversal is a smooth response crossover rather than a thermodynamic phase transition.

classification.title_zh: D3-D7 全息导体中密度驱动的味纠缠各向异性反转
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了有限温度和电荷密度下均匀 3+1 维强耦合导体中，探针味对等时空间纠缠熵的领头贡献；该导体由 D3-D7 系统全息实现，并由恒定 DC 电场驱动。我们比较了在两个空间方向上延展、且有限宽度平行或垂直于电场的板状子区域。相应熵修正之间的差异分离出均匀、空间无迹的响应，并表现出密度驱动的符号反转。在所考察的参数范围内，交叉密度随电场强度增大而增大，并随条带宽度减小而减小。互信息表现出相同的定性反转，并提供了紫外有限的检验。我们将该效应追溯到完整 Dirac-Born-Infeld 应力各向异性中的径向符号竞争。该反转是平滑的响应交叉，而不是热力学相变。
classification.one_liner: D3-D7 全息导体中，味探针的等时空间纠缠各向异性随密度发生平滑反转，并与 DBI 应力的径向符号竞争相关。

papers.title: BRST quantization of the induced gauge theory for the Higgs-branch CFT${}_2$
papers.abstract: We study Witten's induced gauge theory associated with the D1-D5 Higgs-branch CFT${}_2$, in which the non-dynamical vector multiplet becomes reanimated by integrating out the fundamental hypermultiplets. We propose a BRST quantisation of this theory and derive its induced propagators. We show that the ghost sector first contributes at subleading order, that the induced $A\phi^2$ vertex satisfies the Slavnov-Taylor identity and that gauge-invariant correlators are independent of the gauge parameter. Together with our chosen regularization prescription, this gives a perturbative framework for computing observables in the induced theory.

classification.title_zh: Higgs 分支 CFT₂ 的诱导规范理论的 BRST 量子化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了与 D1-D5 Higgs 分支 CFT₂ 相关的 Witten 诱导规范理论；在该理论中，通过积分掉基本超多重态，非动力学矢量多重态获得动力学。我们提出了该理论的 BRST 量子化，并推导了其诱导传播子。我们表明鬼场部分最先在次领头阶贡献，诱导的 Aφ² 顶点满足 Slavnov-Taylor 恒等式，并且规范不变关联函数不依赖于规范参数。与我们选择的正规化方案一起，这为计算诱导理论中的可观测量提供了一个微扰框架。
classification.one_liner: 对 D1-D5 Higgs 分支 CFT₂ 的 Witten 诱导规范理论进行 BRST 量子化，并建立微扰计算框架。

papers.title: Numerical Sasaki--Einstein metrics and harmonic forms on del Pezzo links
papers.abstract: We numerically construct the Sasaki--Einstein metric on the link of the cone over the second del Pezzo surface $\mathrm{dP}_2$ and two primitive harmonic basic $(1,1)$-forms at its irregular volume-minimizing Reeb vector. Being toric, the metric in symplectic coordinates is encoded in a single convex function on a polygon. We approximate the correction to the canonical Guillemin potential in two ways: polynomial expansion and neural networks. The polynomial fit achieves a held-out mean-squared Monge--Amp\`ere residual below $10^{-13}$, in contrast to the $10^{-2}$ plateau for the non-volume-minimizing regular Reeb vector. We validate our method against closed-form metrics of $Y^{p,q}$ using curvature invariants, and also against the numerical result of Doran et al. (2007) for the K\"ahler--Einstein metric of $\mathrm{dP}_3$ using the Laplacian spectrum of low torus-invariant modes. Our data for the metric and harmonic forms can be used to study warped non-conformal holographic IIB backgrounds, the analogues of the Klebanov--Tseytlin solution on the conifold.

classification.title_zh: del Pezzo 链环上的数值 Sasaki–Einstein 度规与调和形式
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在第二 del Pezzo 曲面 dP2 的锥的链环上数值构造 Sasaki–Einstein 度规，并在其非规则、体积最小化的 Reeb 向量处构造两个本原调和 basic (1,1)-形式。由于该结构是环面的，辛坐标中的度规可由一个多边形上的单个凸函数编码。我们通过多项式展开和神经网络两种方式近似对正则 Guillemin 势的修正。多项式拟合在留出集上的 Monge–Ampère 均方残差低于 10^{-13}，而非体积最小化正则 Reeb 向量则停留在 10^{-2} 平台。我们用曲率不变量对 Y^{p,q} 的闭式度规验证方法，并利用低环面不变模的 Laplacian 谱，对 Doran 等人（2007）关于 dP3 的 Kähler–Einstein 度规的数值结果进行验证。我们的度规与调和形式数据可用于研究翘曲非共形全息 IIB 背景，即 conifold 上 Klebanov–Tseytlin 解的类似物。
classification.one_liner: 用多项式与神经网络数值构造 dP2 链环上的 Sasaki–Einstein 度规及调和形式，服务于翘曲非共形全息 IIB 背景。

papers.title: Negative Rank Relations for Giant Graviton Correlators
papers.abstract: We study correlation functions of giant and dual giant gravitons in $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang--Mills theory. Although the two objects correspond to rather different D3 brane configurations in $AdS_5\times S^5$, their gauge theory operators are Schur polynomials associated with transposed Young diagrams. We show that this transposition is accompanied by a formal rank reflection $N\to -N$ at the level of correlation functions. For both $U(N)$ and $SU(N)$, the relation is exact for free correlators at finite $N$, and, using Lagrangian insertion, extends to separated point weak coupling integrands at every loop order. More generally, it applies to any number of Schur polynomial external operators, provided all Young diagrams are transposed. We illustrate the relation in several examples and also discuss evidence for its extension beyond perturbative integrands.

classification.title_zh: 巨引力子关联函数的负秩关系
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中巨引力子与对偶巨引力子的关联函数。尽管这两个对象对应于 AdS5×S5 中相当不同的 D3 膜构型，它们的规范理论算符是与转置杨图相关联的 Schur 多项式。我们证明这种转置在关联函数层面伴随着形式上的秩反射 N→-N。对于 U(N) 和 SU(N)，该关系对有限 N 的自由关联函数精确成立；并且利用拉格朗日量插入，可推广到每一圈阶的分离点弱耦合被积函数。更一般地，只要所有杨图都转置，它适用于任意数量的 Schur 多项式外算子。我们用若干例子说明该关系，并讨论其推广到微扰被积函数之外的证据。
classification.one_liner: 在 N=4 SYM 中，巨引力子与对偶巨引力子的 Schur 多项式关联函数通过杨图转置与形式秩反射 N→-N 相联系，并在自由及弱耦合微扰被积函数层面精确成立。

papers.title: Holographic description of RN-like black hole in bumblebee gravity
papers.abstract: We study the holographic description of the RN-like black hole in bumblebee gravity, which is a vector-tensor theory with spontaneous Lorentz violation. By combining the first laws of the outer and inner horizons, the thermodynamics method yields the right- and left-moving entropies, temperatures, and chemical potentials of the dual two-dimensional conformal field theory (CFT), determines the central charges from the mass-independent entropy product, and reproduces the outer and inner horizon entropies through the Cardy formula. An independent dynamical test based on the hidden conformal symmetry of a charged scalar probe confirms these results. A central outcome is the equality of the right- and left-moving central charges, $c_R=c_L$, which we trace to the spontaneous character of Lorentz breaking. Because the action of bumblebee gravity preserves diffeomorphism and local Lorentz invariance, and the symmetry is broken only by a vector vacuum expectation value, no chirally asymmetric structure arises in the dual theory, in sharp contrast to topologically massive gravity in $(2+1)$ dimensions. All CFT data depend smoothly on the Lorentz-violating parameter and reduce to the known RN results when Lorentz violation is switched off.

classification.title_zh: bumblebee 引力中类 RN 黑洞的全息描述
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 bumblebee 引力中类 RN 黑洞的全息描述；bumblebee 引力是一种具有自发洛伦兹破缺的矢量-张量理论。通过结合外视界与内视界的第一定律，热力学方法给出对偶二维共形场论（CFT）的右行与左行熵、温度和化学势，由与质量无关的熵乘积确定中心荷，并通过 Cardy 公式重现外视界和内视界熵。基于带电标量探针的隐藏共形对称性的独立动力学检验证实了这些结果。一个核心结果是右行与左行中心荷相等，c_R=c_L；我们将其追溯到洛伦兹破缺的自发性质。由于 bumblebee 引力作用量保持微分同胚和局域洛伦兹不变性，而对称性仅由矢量真空期望值破缺，对偶理论中不会出现手征不对称结构，这与 (2+1) 维拓扑大质量引力形成鲜明对比。所有 CFT 数据都光滑依赖于洛伦兹破缺参数，并在关闭洛伦兹破缺时回到已知的 RN 结果。
classification.one_liner: 用视界热力学与隐藏共形对称性为 bumblebee 引力中的类 RN 黑洞构造对偶二维 CFT，并指出自发洛伦兹破缺使左右中心荷相等。

papers.title: Hidden symmetries and the universality of Hawking radiation
papers.abstract: Quantum tunneling of particles across a black hole (BH) horizon provides an intuitive interpretation of Hawking radiation (HR), yielding a conceptually simple derivation of the thermal spectrum within a semiclassical framework. However, for BHs obeying the no-hair theorem, usual implementations of the complex-path (Hamilton-Jacobi) method typically rely on approximating the metric near the BH horizon. In this work, we demonstrate that the Hawking spectrum can be derived without such approximations by exploiting gauge invariance in quantum field theory and the separability of the Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) equation arising from hidden symmetries of these spacetimes. However, for BHs obeying the no-hair theorem, usual implementations of the complex-path (Hamilton--Jacobi) method typically rely on approximating the metric near the horizon. This perspective shows explicitly why the BH behaves as an effective $(1+1)$-dimensional blackbody at the event horizon, provides the conditions needed to extend the HR to higher-spin particles, and offers a framework that can naturally incorporate back-reaction and quantum-gravity effects.

classification.title_zh: 隐藏对称性与霍金辐射的普适性
classification.abstract_zh: 跨越黑洞视界的粒子量子隧穿为霍金辐射提供了直观解释，并在半经典框架内给出热谱的概念上简单的推导。然而，对于服从无毛定理的黑洞，复路径（Hamilton-Jacobi）方法的通常实现依赖于对黑洞视界附近度规的近似。在本工作中，我们证明可以通过利用量子场论中的规范不变性以及这些时空因隐藏对称性而导致的 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程可分离性，在不使用此类近似的情况下推导霍金谱。这一视角明确展示了为什么黑洞在事件视界处表现为有效的 (1+1) 维黑体，提供了将霍金辐射推广到高自旋粒子所需的条件，并给出了一个可自然纳入反作用和量子引力效应的框架。
classification.one_liner: 利用量子场论规范不变性和时空隐藏对称性带来的 Hamilton-Jacobi 可分离性，无需视界附近近似即可推导黑洞霍金谱，并解释视界有效 (1+1) 维黑体行为。

papers.title: The Double Copy of the Black Ring
papers.abstract: We construct an exact Weyl double copy of the singly spinning five-dimensional Emparan--Reall black ring. Its complete nonlinear Weyl curvature is the sum of two scalar-weighted Maxwell squares. One field is generated by the stationary Killing vector; the other carries topological magnetic flux through a sphere linking the ring. Both are source-free Maxwell fields on the black-ring spacetime, with corresponding scalar partners obeying a common sourced wave equation. This extends exact five-dimensional Weyl doubling beyond the type-$\mathrm D$ and type-$\mathrm N$ examples to a black hole whose exterior contains both type-$\mathrm G$ and type-$\mathrm{I}_i$ regions. The Weyl polynomial factorizes into two distinct irreducible quadratics, establishing genuine De Smet type $22$, thereby ruling out a reduction to a single Maxwell square.

classification.title_zh: 黑环的双拷贝
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了单转五维 Emparan--Reall 黑环的精确 Weyl 双拷贝。其完整非线性 Weyl 曲率是两个标量加权 Maxwell 平方之和。一个场由稳态 Killing 矢量生成；另一个场携带穿过环绕环的球面的拓扑磁通。二者都是黑环时空上的无源 Maxwell 场，相应的标量伙伴满足共同的带源波动方程。这将精确五维 Weyl 双拷贝扩展到 type-D 和 type-N 例子之外，推广到外区同时包含 type-G 和 type-I_i 区域的黑洞。Weyl 多项式分解为两个不同的不可约二次式，确立真正的 De Smet type 22，从而排除约化为单个 Maxwell 平方的可能。
classification.one_liner: 构造五维 Emparan-Reall 黑环的精确 Weyl 双拷贝，证明其 Weyl 曲率为两个 Maxwell 平方之和且为 De Smet type 22。

papers.title: On Thermodynamic Universalities and Optics of B-deformed Reissner--Nordstr\"om--AdS Black Holes
papers.abstract: Using machine learning techniques, we study the Reissner--Nordstr\"om--AdS black holes in the framework of extended space-time derivatives inspired by non-commutative geometry in string theory where the deformation parameters are related to the inverse of the NS-NS B-field. We refer to these solutions as B-deformed Reissner--Nordstr\"om--AdS black holes. Precisely, we examine the thermodynamic and the optical behaviors of such stringy deformed AdS black holes. Exploiting advanced numerical computations, we first examine the corresponding thermodynamic Van der Waals behaviors by calculating the universal ratios describing the P-V criticality and the Joule-Thomson expansion features. Applying such numerical results, we construct reliable training data for a fully connected neural network being developed to determine whether such stringy black hole configurations exhibit thermodynamic Van der Waals aspects. Concretely, we reveal that the fully connected and trained neural network accurately detects Van der Waals behaviors. Supported by the observational data reported by the Event Horizon Telescope international collaborations, we investigate the optical shadows of such B-deformed Reissner--Nordstr\"om--AdS black holes using machine learning methods. In order to provide corroborated models, we constraint the involved parameters including the stringy one B by making use of M87* and Sgr A* black hole empirical data.

classification.title_zh: 论 B-形变 Reissner–Nordström–AdS 黑洞的热力学普适性与光学
classification.abstract_zh: 利用机器学习技术，我们在受弦论中非对易几何启发的扩展时空导数框架下研究 Reissner–Nordström–AdS 黑洞，其中形变参数与 NS-NS B 场的逆相关。我们将这些解称为 B-形变 Reissner–Nordström–AdS 黑洞。精确地说，我们考察这类弦论形变 AdS 黑洞的热力学与光学行为。利用先进数值计算，我们首先通过计算描述 P-V 临界性和 Joule-Thomson 膨胀特征的普适比，考察相应的热力学 Van der Waals 行为。应用这些数值结果，我们为正在开发的全连接神经网络构建可靠训练数据，以判定此类弦黑洞构型是否呈现热力学 Van der Waals 特征。具体而言，我们揭示训练后的全连接神经网络能够准确检测 Van der Waals 行为。在事件视界望远镜国际合作报告观测数据的支持下，我们使用机器学习方法研究此类 B-形变 Reissner–Nordström–AdS 黑洞的光学阴影。为了提供得到佐证的模型，我们利用 M87* 与 Sgr A* 黑洞经验数据约束包括弦参数 B 在内的相关参数。

papers.title: Magnetic Eruption and Nucleosynthesis in GR{\nu}MHD Simulations of Spinning Neutron Star Mergers
papers.abstract: We present three-dimensional general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics simulations of equal-mass binary neutron star mergers with varied neutron star spin configurations and second-moment neutrino transport, following the formation and early evolution of long-lived remnants. We compare a fiducial irrotational binary with binaries having spins that are aligned or antialigned with the orbital angular momentum, and examime how spin affects the merger dynamics, magnetic field evolution, outflows, and nucleosynthesis. Compared to the fiducial case, the aligned spin configuration releases more cold, neutron-rich tidal ejecta in the equatorial plane, which enables the development of a more tightly collimated polar outflow erupting from the remnant and inner accretion disk. Conversely, the case with spins antialigned with the orbit experiences a more violent collision at merger, disrupting magnetic amplification, loading the environment with debris, and impeding the propagation of magnetically driven winds. Strong neutrino reprocessing of the polar outflow in the irrotational and aligned spin cases produces $2.4\times 10^{-3}\,M_\odot$ of proton-rich ($Y_e \geq 0.49$) material, resulting in the synthesis of light r-process elements, whose subsequent decay potentially sends a unique electromagnetic signal from long-lived remnants. However, the outflows remain too dense and slow to be consistent with typical short gamma-ray bursts.

classification.title_zh: 自旋中子星并合的 GRνMHD 模拟中的磁爆发与核合成
classification.abstract_zh: 我们展示了等质量双中子星并合的三维广义相对论磁流体力学模拟，包含不同中子星自旋构型以及二阶矩中微子输运，并追踪长寿命残骸的形成与早期演化。我们将基准的无旋并合与自旋同向或反向于轨道角动量的并合进行比较，考察自旋如何影响并合动力学、磁场演化、外流和核合成。与基准情形相比，自旋同向构型在赤道面释放更多冷而富中子的潮汐抛出物，这使得从残骸和内吸积盘发展出更紧密准直的极向外流。相反，自旋与轨道反向对齐的情形在并合时经历更剧烈的碰撞，破坏磁场放大，使环境充满碎片，并阻碍磁驱动风的传播。无旋和同向自旋情形中极向外流受到强烈中微子再处理，产生 2.4×10^{-3} M⊙ 的富质子（Ye ≥ 0.49）物质，从而合成轻 r 过程元素，其后续衰变可能从长寿命残骸发出独特的电磁信号。然而，这些外流仍然过密且过慢，与典型的短伽马射线暴不一致。
classification.one_liner: 三维 GRνMHD 模拟表明中子星自旋构型显著改变并合后的磁爆发、外流与轻 r 过程核合成，但外流不足以解释典型短伽马暴。

papers.title: Unified study of nuclear physics and dark matter constraints through gravitational-wave observations of binary neutron star mergers
papers.abstract: Understanding the properties of strongly interacting matter at extreme densities is a central problem in fundamental physics, with neutron star mergers offering a natural laboratory to probe this regime. However, the complexity of the merger process complicates the interpretation of the associated gravitational-wave and electromagnetic signals. This picture becomes even more complex in the potential scenario in which dark matter accumulates around and in neutron stars, altering their structure and the associated observables. In this work, we study synthetic gravitational-wave observations of binary neutron star mergers with next-generation detectors, investigating their potential to extract both nuclear physics and dark matter constraints. We also examine how the potential presence of fermionic, non-self-interacting dark matter inside neutron stars affects the inference of nuclear empirical parameters. We find that combining observations can tighten constraints on nuclear empirical parameters. However, the inferred values remain sensitive to systematic modeling biases and intrinsic degeneracies among the parameters. Conversely, our analysis reveals that for non-self-interacting fermionic dark matter at mass fractions below one percent, it will be unlikely to find decisive evidence for dark matter when analyzing gravitational-wave signals. Consequently, systematic biases in nuclear empirical parameter inference potentially resulting from such a dark matter component are expected to be negligible even for observations with next-generation gravitational-wave detectors.

classification.title_zh: 通过双中子星并合引力波观测统一研究核物理与暗物质约束
classification.abstract_zh: 理解极端密度下强相互作用物质的性质是基础物理的核心问题，而中子星并合为探测这一区域提供了天然实验室。然而，并合过程的复杂性使相关引力波与电磁信号的解释变得困难。若暗物质在中子星周围或内部积聚，改变其结构及相关可观测量，这一图像会变得更加复杂。本文研究下一代探测器对双中子星并合引力波的合成观测，考察其同时提取核物理与暗物质约束的潜力。我们还检验中子星内部可能存在费米子型、非自相互作用暗物质时，如何影响核经验参数的推断。我们发现，联合观测可以收紧对核经验参数的约束；但推断值仍对系统建模偏差及参数间内禀简并敏感。反之，我们的分析表明，对于质量分数低于百分之一的非自相互作用费米子暗物质，在分析引力波信号时不太可能找到决定性暗物质证据。因此，即使使用下一代引力波探测器，此类暗物质成分可能导致的核经验参数推断系统偏差预计也可忽略。
classification.one_liner: 利用下一代双中子星并合引力波观测，评估同时约束核物理与暗物质性质的能力，并指出百分之一以下非自相互作用费米子暗物质难以产生决定性证据。

papers.title: Foiling Black Hole Foils: Revealing Horizon Alternatives with Baryonic Atmospheres
papers.abstract: Event horizons are a defining feature of black holes. Consequently, there have been many efforts to probe their existence in astrophysical black hole candidates, spanning ten orders of magnitude in mass. Nevertheless, horizons remain an obstacle to unifying general relativity and quantum mechanics, most sharply presented by the information paradox. This has motivated a proliferation of horizonless alternatives (black hole foils) that avoid event horizons and are therefore presumably benign. We explore the fate of accreting material in the context of spherically symmetric horizonless compact objects in the steady state regime. We find that for typical accreting astronomical targets, foils can develop an optically thick, convectively stable baryonic atmosphere, immediately implying the creation of an emitting photosphere at modest redshift even when the surface redshift is extreme. The emergent photosphere luminosity is driven toward the accretion powered equilibrium value and is only weakly sensitive to the foil redshift. Moreover, local gas-surface interaction provides a microphysical lower bound on the effective base temperature, insulating the atmosphere from arbitrarily cold foils. The unknown properties of the foil enter only through local boundary conditions controlling baryon processing and thermal coupling at the surface, making the solutions broadly applicable to horizonless alternatives that do not invoke significant additional nonlocal interactions. Thus, under minimal assumptions (GR exterior and local surface interactions), spherically symmetric horizonless foils in accreting systems are generically observationally exposed: the absence of a thermal photosphere directly constrains or rules out broad classes of such models.

classification.title_zh: 挫败黑洞替代物：用重子大气揭示视界替代方案
classification.abstract_zh: 事件视界是黑洞的定义性特征。因此，人们已付出许多努力，试图在质量跨越十个数量级的候选天体黑洞中探测其存在。尽管如此，视界仍是统一广义相对论与量子力学的一个障碍，信息悖论最尖锐地体现了这一点。这促使大量不具视界的替代模型（black hole foils）出现，它们避免事件视界，并因此被认为可能是良性的。我们在稳态、球对称无视界致密天体背景下研究吸积物质的命运。我们发现，对于典型吸积天文目标，foils 可以形成光学厚、对流稳定的重子大气，即使表面红移极端，也会立刻意味着在中等红移处产生一个发射光球。出射光球光度被驱动到吸积供能的平衡值附近，并且对 foil 红移只有弱敏感。此外，局域气体-表面相互作用给出了有效基底温度的微观下限，使大气免受任意冷 foil 的影响。foil 的未知性质仅通过控制表面重子处理和热耦合的局域边界条件进入，使这些解广泛适用于不引入显著额外非局域相互作用的无视界替代模型。因此，在最小假设（广义相对论外部和局域表面相互作用）下，吸积系统中的球对称无视界 foils 通常会在观测上暴露：缺乏热光球可直接限制或排除广泛类别的此类模型。
classification.one_liner: 无事件视界的致密替代模型在吸积时会形成热重子光球，因此可被观测检验。

papers.title: Mapping the Gravitational-wave Background Across the Spectrum with a Next-Generation Anisotropic Per-frequency Optimal Statistic
papers.abstract: With pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) having observed a gravitational wave background (GWB) at nanohertz frequencies, the focus of the field is shifting towards determining and characterizing its origin. While the primary candidate is a population of GW-emitting supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs), many other cosmological processes could produce a GWB with similar spectral properties as have been measured. One key argument to help differentiate an SMBHB GWB from a cosmologically sourced one is its level of anisotropy; a GWB sourced by a finite population will likely exhibit greater anisotropy than a cosmological GWB through finite source effects (``shot noise'') and potentially large-scale structure. Current PTA GWB anisotropy detection methods often use the frequentist PTA optimal statistic for its fast estimation of pulsar pair correlations and relatively low computational overhead compared to spatially-correlated Bayesian analyses. However, there are critical limitations with the status quo approach. In this paper, we improve this technique by incorporating three recent advancements: accounting for covariance between pulsar pairwise estimates of correlated GWB power; the per-frequency optimal statistic to dissect the GWB across the spectrum; and constructing null-hypothesis statistical distributions that include cosmic variance. By combining these methods, our new pipeline can localize GWB anisotropies to specific frequencies, through which anisotropy detection prospects -- while impacted by cosmic variance -- are shown to improve in our simulations from a $p$-value of $\sim0.2$ in a broadband search to $\sim0.01$ in the per-frequency search. Our methods are already incorporated in community-available code and ready to deploy on forthcoming PTA datasets.

classification.title_zh: 用下一代各向异性逐频最优统计量绘制全频谱引力波背景
classification.abstract_zh: 随着脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）在纳赫兹频段观测到引力波背景（GWB），该领域焦点正转向确定并刻画其起源。主要候选是发出引力波的大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）族群，但许多其他宇宙学过程也可产生与已测谱性质相似的 GWB。帮助区分 SMBHB GWB 与宇宙学起源 GWB 的一个关键论据是其各向异性程度；由有限源族群产生的 GWB 可能因有限源效应（“散粒噪声”）和潜在的大尺度结构而表现出比宇宙学 GWB 更大的各向异性。当前 PTA GWB 各向异性探测方法常使用频率学派 PTA 最优统计量，因为它能快速估计脉冲星对关联，且相比空间相关贝叶斯分析计算开销相对较低。然而，现状方法存在关键局限。本文通过纳入三项近期进展改进该技术：考虑脉冲星成对相关 GWB 功率估计之间的协方差；使用逐频最优统计量在全频谱上剖析 GWB；构建包含宇宙方差的零假设统计分布。结合这些方法，我们的新流程可将 GWB 各向异性定位到特定频率；模拟显示，尽管受宇宙方差影响，各向异性探测前景从宽带搜索中约 0.2 的 p 值改善到逐频搜索中约 0.01。我们的方法已纳入社区可用代码，并准备部署于即将到来的 PTA 数据集。
classification.one_liner: 提出结合协方差、逐频最优统计量和宇宙方差的 PTA 流程，以在全频谱上定位引力波背景各向异性。

papers.title: Boson Star Factory: Past, Present, and Future
papers.abstract: Boson stars are self-gravitating solitons of the Einstein-Klein-Gordon equations for a massive complex scalar field, and arguably the simplest horizonless compact objects arising in General Relativity. Beyond spherical symmetry, their construction requires solving a system of nonlinear elliptic partial differential equations, a difficult task per se and that each group has traditionally addressed with its own numerical implementation. A systematic comparison of different methods applied to the same physical model has so far been lacking. In this work, we carry out such a comparison for the two simplest non-spherical configurations: rotating boson stars and static dipolar boson stars. We employ three independent codes, based respectively on finite differences (FIDISOL/CADSOL), finite elements (FreeFem), and spectral methods (Kadath), and assess their accuracy through different diagnostics. The three solvers agree on the global observables to typically eight significant digits. We further compare the runtime of each code on identical hardware and provide precise benchmark values of the relevant physical quantities, intended to serve as reference data for future numerical studies of boson stars. As a further proof of concept, we also present the use of physics-informed neural networks to construct a rotating Q-ball solution.

classification.title_zh: 玻色星工厂：过去、现在与未来
classification.abstract_zh: 玻色星是大质量复标量场在 Einstein-Klein-Gordon 方程下的自引力孤子，可以说是广义相对论中出现的最简单的无事件视界致密天体。超出球对称后，其构造需要求解非线性椭圆偏微分方程，本身困难，且传统上各小组使用各自的数值实现。此前缺乏对同一物理模型采用不同方法的系统比较。本工作对两种最简单的非球对称位形——旋转玻色星和静态偶极玻色星——进行此类比较。我们使用三个独立程序，分别基于有限差分（FIDISOL/CADSOL）、有限元（FreeFem）和谱方法（Kadath），并通过不同诊断量评估其精度。三个求解器对整体可观测量通常在八位有效数字上一致。我们进一步比较各程序在相同硬件上的运行时间，并给出相关物理量的精确基准值，旨在为未来玻色星数值研究提供参考数据。作为进一步的概念验证，我们还展示利用物理信息神经网络构造旋转 Q-ball 解。
classification.one_liner: 系统比较三种数值方法构建旋转与偶极玻色星，给出高精度基准数据并探索 PINN 求解旋转 Q-ball。
