papers.title: The third law of black hole thermodynamics: Quantum versus classical considerations
papers.abstract: Kehle and Unger have recently shown that, under suitable conditions, a massless charged classical scalar field can produce an extremal black hole in finite time. This result appears to violate the third law of thermodynamics (TLT), since extremal black holes have zero temperature. However, because the TLT is intrinsically a quantum principle, a self-consistent analysis of this problem must account for quantum effects. In particular, we point out that the electric field of the system may spontaneously polarize the vacuum, thereby creating massless charged pairs that will discharge the black hole. This mechanism guarantees the {\it quantum} validity of the TLT in the regime $|eQ|\geq\hbar/2$ (here ${Q,e}$ denote, respectively, the electric charges of the black hole and the scalar field). This leaves open the question of what happens for lower values of $|eQ|/\hbar$. Recently, Schneider derived a classical bound showing that extremal black holes cannot be formed \`a la Kehle-Unger in the small-charge regime $|eQ|\leq\hbar/3$. His analysis leaves open the possibility that a stronger bound may exist. We conjecture here that this bound can indeed be strengthened such that classical considerations would prevent extremal (zero-temperature) charged Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes from forming dynamically in the regime $|eQ|<\hbar/2$, where quantum polarization effects are too weak to preserve the validity of the TLT.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 黑洞热力学第三定律：量子与经典考量
classification.abstract_zh: Kehle 和 Unger 最近表明，在适当条件下，无质量带电经典标量场可以在有限时间内产生一个极端黑洞。该结果似乎违反热力学第三定律（TLT），因为极端黑洞温度为零。然而，由于 TLT 本质上是一条量子原理，对该问题自洽的分析必须考虑量子效应。特别地，我们指出系统的电场可能自发极化真空，从而产生无质量带电对并使黑洞放电。该机制在 |eQ|≥ℏ/2 的区间保证了 TLT 的量子有效性（这里 Q,e 分别表示黑洞和标量场的电荷）。这留下了在更低 |eQ|/ℏ 值下会发生什么的问题。最近 Schneider 推导了一个经典界，表明在 |eQ|≤ℏ/3 的小电荷区间，极端黑洞不能按 Kehle-Unger 的方式形成。他的分析留下了可能存在更强界的可能性。我们在此猜测该界确实可以被加强，使得在 |eQ|<ℏ/2 的区间，经典考量会阻止极端（零温）带电 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞动力学形成，而此时量子极化效应太弱，无法维护 TLT 的有效性。
classification.one_liner: 论文讨论无质量带电经典标量场形成极端带电黑洞是否违反黑洞热力学第三定律，指出真空极化可在 |eQ|≥ℏ/2 时通过放电量子地维护第三定律，并猜测在 |eQ|<ℏ/2 时经典效应阻止极端 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞形成。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于黑洞/经典引力与黑洞热力学方向，可对应‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签；但不涉及全息、AdS/CFT 或用户列出的全息凝聚态、QCD、QNM 等专门支线。

papers.title: Towards All-Order Locality in the Higher-Spin Holomorphic Zero-Form Sector
papers.abstract: This work addresses the construction of local interaction vertices in the holomorphic zero-form sector obtained from Vasiliev equations. We focus on a requirement on zero-form vertices, previously proposed in a less restrictive form in arXiv:2208.02004, which, together with spinor spin-locality, guarantees space-time spin-locality. Necessary and sufficient conditions on the holomorphic one-form sector vertices are derived that ensure the existence of holomorphic zero-form vertices satisfying this requirement. As a concrete demonstration, the proposed scheme is applied to compute the spin-local holomorphic $\eta^2$ zero-form sector vertex, a result that goes beyond previous work where only spinor spin-locality was established. These findings lay the groundwork for a systematic all-order construction of local vertices in higher-spin theory.

classification.title_zh: 迈向高自旋全纯零形式扇区的全阶局域性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文讨论从 Vasiliev 方程得到的全纯零形式扇区中局域相互作用顶点的构造。我们关注零形式顶点的一个要求，该要求在 arXiv:2208.02004 中曾以限制较少的形式提出；它与旋量自旋局域性一起保证时空自旋局域性。我们推导了全纯一体形式扇区顶点上的充分必要条件，以确保存在满足该要求的全纯零形式顶点。作为具体演示，将所提方案应用于计算自旋局域的全纯 η^2 零形式扇区顶点，这一结果超越了此前仅建立旋量自旋局域性的工作。这些发现为高自旋理论中局域顶点的系统性全阶构造奠定了基础。
classification.one_liner: 从 Vasiliev 方程出发，推导保证全纯零形式顶点时空自旋局域性的充分必要条件，并计算自旋局域的 η^2 零形式顶点。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于高自旋/Vasiliev 全息理论的方法论构造，未直接涉及用户列出的重点标签分支（如全息超流超导、multi-trace、QNM、经典引力等）。

papers.title: Finite-Time Doppler Covariance Spectroscopy in the AdS/CFT correspondence
papers.abstract: From a holographic perspective, we formulate an exact finite-duration covariance framework that resolves chirality in the AdS/CFT correspondence. In a rotating BTZ black hole spacetime, relative motion between two boundary controls converts sum-frequency matching on the compact boundary cylinder into discrete velocity resonances indexed by the angular momentum of the scalar field. Because the complete real-control covariance also contains difference-frequency sectors, a two-setting quadrature cycle cancels them and reconstructs the resonant pair contribution from complete positive-semidefinite covariance matrices. For an isolated angular mode, reconstructed pair responses at opposite resonance velocities sample the boundary spectrum at opposite angular momentum and a common control-selected frequency. Their normalized contrast cancels reflection-symmetric control factors and the state-independent operator normalization, yielding a finite-linewidth estimator of intrinsic bath chirality. For a smooth bath spectrum, the bias from common centered even narrowing windows begins at quadratic order in linewidth, extending the protection beyond Gaussian sampling. An explicit real-projection leakage bound controls contamination from neighboring modes. Long-pulse calculations with the exact BTZ spectrum verify phase-cycle reconstruction and quadratic linewidth scaling. Bath-weighted calculations with exact truncated transfer amplitudes establish convergence to this baseline. Under the default controls, the first two nonzero angular modes support extraction from the complete angular sum and reconstruct the BTZ rotation parameter with subpercent deterministic bias. The framework thus separates control-induced resonance kinematics from intrinsic bath chirality and converts finite-time covariance data into a quantitative estimate of the rotating BTZ black hole.

classification.title_zh: AdS/CFT 对应中的有限时间多普勒协方差谱学
classification.abstract_zh: 从全息视角，我们建立了一个精确的有限时长协方差框架，用于在 AdS/CFT 对应中分辨手性。在旋转 BTZ 黑洞时空中，两个边界控制之间的相对运动将紧致边界柱面上的和频匹配转化为由标量场角动量标记的离散速度共振。由于完整实控制协方差还包含差频部分，一个双设置正交循环可将其抵消，并从完备半正定协方差矩阵中重构共振对贡献。对于孤立角模，在相反共振速度处重构的配对响应，在半角动量与共同的控制选择频率上采样边界谱。其归一化对比度抵消反射对称的控制因子和态无关的算符归一化，给出内禀浴手性的有限线宽估计量。对于平滑浴谱，由共同中心偶窄化窗口引起的偏差从线宽的二次阶开始，从而将保护扩展到高斯采样之外。显式实投影泄漏界控制了相邻模的污染。使用精确 BTZ 谱的长脉冲计算验证了相位循环重构和二次线宽标度。使用精确截断转移振幅的浴加权计算确立了向该基线的收敛。在默认控制下，前两个非零角模支持从完整角动量求和中的提取，并以亚百分比确定性偏差重构 BTZ 旋转参数。因此，该框架将控制诱导的共振运动学与内禀浴手性分开，并将有限时间协方差数据转化为对旋转 BTZ 黑洞的定量估计。
classification.one_liner: 提出有限时间多普勒协方差谱学，利用旋转 BTZ 边界控制从全息协方差数据中提取内禀浴手性并重构 BTZ 旋转参数。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 全息框架，但聚焦有限时间协方差谱学与旋转 BTZ 参数提取，未直接涉及用户列出的全息超导、多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet 或经典引力主线。

papers.title: ABJM to BMN in a Double Scale Limit: Indices and Bubbling Geometries
papers.abstract: We study a double scale limit of $U(N)_k\times U(N)_{-k}$ ABJM theory, with $N,k\to\infty$ and $N/k^2\to\nu\in(0,\infty)$, at fixed positive total monopole charge $q$. In this limit, the Penrose geometry retains a compact null circle of finite radius, and the sector of monopole charge $q$ carries $q$ units of longitudinal momentum. It is therefore naturally associated with the rank-$q$ BMN matrix model, while $\nu$ fixes its dimensionless coupling. We establish this relation from both gravity and the supersymmetric index. On the gravity side, we take the double scale limit of Hopf quotients of the Donos--Sim\'on half-BPS geometries. The disk carrying the growing background flux becomes an infinite conducting plane, while the remaining finite disks reproduce the Lin--Maldacena electrostatic problem. Their quantized fluxes map directly to the partition data labeling BMN vacua. On the field-theory side, starting from the finite-$N$, finite-$k$ ABJM localization formula, we prove that, at fixed positive monopole charge $q$, the ABJM superconformal index factorizes coefficientwise in the transverse fugacities into a universal neutral contribution and the refined Witten index of the rank-$q$ BMN matrix model, together with the longitudinal momentum weight. The neutral contribution is precisely the limiting zero-monopole-charge index. Dividing by this universal factor therefore isolates the BMN index summed over all its supersymmetric vacua.

classification.title_zh: ABJM 到 BMN 的双尺度极限：指标与气泡几何
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 U(N)_k × U(N)_{-k} ABJM 理论的双尺度极限，其中 N,k→∞ 且 N/k^2→ν∈(0,∞)，总磁单极荷 q 固定为正。在此极限下，Penrose 几何保留一个有限半径的紧致零圆，磁单极荷 q 的扇区携带 q 单位纵向动量。因此它自然关联于 rank-q BMN 矩阵模型，而 ν 固定其无量纲耦合。我们从引力和超对称指标两方面建立这一关系。在引力侧，我们取 Donos--Simón 半 BPS 几何的 Hopf 商的双尺度极限。携带增长背景通量的圆盘变成一个无限导电平面，而其余有限圆盘复现 Lin--Maldacena 静电问题。它们的量子化通量直接映射到标记 BMN 真空的划分数据。在场论侧，从有限 N、有限 k 的 ABJM 局域化公式出发，我们证明在固定正磁单极荷 q 下，ABJM 超共形指标在横向逸度中逐系数分解为一个普适中性贡献和 rank-q BMN 矩阵模型的精炼 Witten 指标，并带有纵向动量权重。中性贡献正是极限零磁单极荷指标。因此，除以这一普适因子可分离出对所有其超对称真空求和的 BMN 指标。
classification.one_liner: 在 ABJM 的双尺度极限中，磁单极荷 q 扇区通过引力对偶和超对称指标分解联系到 rank-q BMN 矩阵模型，引力侧对应半 BPS 气泡几何与 Lin-Maldacena 静电问题。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 全息对偶与 BMN 矩阵模型，引力侧涉及经典半 BPS 气泡几何，因此与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签部分相关；但不涉及全息超导、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子等多数重点支线。

papers.title: On the (In)equivalence of de Sitter and Holographic Entanglement Entropies in Lovelock Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate the relation between de Sitter entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in higher-curvature gravity and its braneworld realization. Using the canonical formulation of the gravitational action and the Euclidean gravitational path integral, we derive the de Sitter entropy, including contributions from higher-curvature surface terms, and compare it with the holographic entanglement entropy obtained from the corresponding entropy functional. We first consider Gauss-Bonnet gravity and show that the two entropies coincide for static asymptotically de Sitter braneworld spacetimes on the RS II model, while they generally differ for stationary spacetimes. The mismatch in the stationary case arises from an extrinsic-curvature contribution associated with the constant-time surface, which vanishes for static configurations but is generally nonzero for stationary geometries. We then extend the analysis to general Lovelock gravity and show that the agreement between the de Sitter entropy and holographic entanglement entropy persists for static asymptotically de Sitter braneworld spacetimes in the RS II model beyond the Gauss-Bonnet case. We also comment that the same distinction between static and stationary configurations applies to braneworld black holes: the black hole entropy agrees with the holographic entanglement entropy in the static case, while the two generally differ for stationary braneworld black holes. Our results clarify the relation between gravitational and holographic entropies in higher-curvature gravity and provide a broader perspective on holographic correspondence in Lovelock theories and their braneworld realizations.

classification.title_zh: 论 Lovelock 引力中 de Sitter 熵与全息纠缠熵的（非）等价性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究高曲率引力及其膜世界实现中 de Sitter 熵与全息纠缠熵之间的关系。利用引力作用量的正则表述和欧几里得引力路径积分，我们推导了 de Sitter 熵，包括来自高曲率表面项的贡献，并将其与由相应熵泛函得到的全息纠缠熵进行比较。我们首先考虑 Gauss-Bonnet 引力，并表明在 RS II 模型的静态渐近 de Sitter 膜世界时空中，两种熵一致，而在稳态时空中通常不同。稳态情形的不一致来自与等时面相关的外曲率贡献，该贡献对静态位形为零，但对稳态几何一般非零。随后我们将分析推广到一般 Lovelock 引力，并表明在 Gauss-Bonnet 情形之外，de Sitter 熵与全息纠缠熵之间的这种一致性对于 RS II 模型中静态渐近 de Sitter 膜世界时空仍然成立。我们还评论说，静态与稳态位形之间的同样区别适用于膜世界黑洞：在静态情形下黑洞熵与全息纠缠熵一致，而对稳态膜世界黑洞两者通常不同。我们的结果阐明了高曲率引力中引力熵与全息熵之间的关系，并为 Lovelock 理论及其膜世界实现中的全息对应提供了更广阔的视角。
classification.one_liner: 在 Lovelock 引力与 RS II 膜世界中，静态渐近 de Sitter 时空的 de Sitter 熵与全息纠缠熵一致，而稳态时空中二者因外曲率项一般不等价。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究 Lovelock 高曲率引力中的 de Sitter/黑洞熵与全息纠缠熵关系，涉及经典引力、膜世界和全息纠缠，与经典引力/广义相对论支线直接相关；但不属于全息超导、p 波、畴壁/孤子或 QNM 等更具体重点支线。

papers.title: Braneworld tidal charge through the classical double copy
papers.abstract: We investigate the classical double copy of the rotating black-hole geometry induced on the brane in the Randall-Sundrum II scenario. The influence of the five-dimensional bulk is encoded in the effective four-dimensional geometry through a tidal charge, while the metric admits a Kerr-Schild representation over a flat background. We construct the corresponding single and zeroth copies and find that their regular sources are entirely proportional to the tidal charge, whereas the mass-dependent contribution is source-free in the regular region. Comparison with Kerr-Newman reveals a formal correspondence between the tidal charge and the squared electromagnetic charge at the level of the induced geometry and its double copies, despite their different physical origins and the fact that the tidal charge may take either sign. When an electromagnetic field is included on the brane, both contributions enter the low-energy Kerr-Schild geometry and its double copies only through the combination $Q^2+\beta$. These results illustrate how physically distinct brane and bulk contributions can become indistinguishable in the classical double copy of an effective geometry.

classification.title_zh: 通过经典双拷贝研究膜世界潮汐荷
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在 Randall-Sundrum II 情景中膜上诱导的旋转黑洞几何的经典双拷贝。五维体的影响通过潮汐荷编码在有效四维几何中，而度规允许在平坦背景上的 Kerr-Schild 表示。我们构造了相应的单拷贝和零拷贝，并发现它们的正则源完全正比于潮汐荷，而质量依赖的贡献在正则区域是无源的。与 Kerr-Newman 的比较揭示了，在诱导几何及其双拷贝层面，潮汐荷与电磁荷平方之间存在形式对应，尽管它们的物理起源不同，且潮汐荷可以取任意符号。当膜上包含电磁场时，两种贡献仅通过组合 $Q^2+\beta$ 进入低能 Kerr-Schild 几何及其双拷贝。这些结果说明，在有效几何的经典双拷贝中，物理上不同的膜和体贡献可以变得不可区分。
classification.one_liner: 在 RS II 膜世界模型中，旋转黑洞潮汐荷的 Kerr-Schild 经典双拷贝表现出与电荷平方形式对应的贡献。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究膜世界黑洞几何与经典双拷贝，但未涉及全息对偶或用户重点中的其他全息方向。

papers.title: Unistochastic reduction of multi-matrix coherent-state kernels
papers.abstract: We revisit the finite-$N$ coherent-state overlap integrals appearing in multi-matrix BPS correlators. For commuting coherent-state parameters, these integrals take the form $I_N(C)=\int_{U(N)}d\mu_H(U)\, \exp\!\left(\sum_{ij}C_{ij}|U_{ij}|^2\right)$. We show that $I_N(C)$ is naturally the Laplace transform of the Haar-pushforward measure on the unistochastic set. Row and column stochasticity reduce the source variables from $N^2$ to $(N-1)^2$. For $N=3$, using the known Haar-induced measure on the unistochastic body, we obtain a compact three-dimensional Bessel-integral representation. For general finite $N$, the same formulation gives an exact low-order moment expansion via Weingarten calculus and a direct Haar-pushforward sampling program.

classification.title_zh: 多矩阵相干态核的单随机约化
classification.abstract_zh: 重新考察多矩阵 BPS 关联函数中出现的有限 N 相干态重叠积分。对易相干态参数下，积分形式为 I_N(C)=∫_{U(N)}dμ_H(U) exp(∑ C_ij |U_ij|^2)。证明该积分是单随机集合上 Haar 前推测度的拉普拉斯变换；行、列随机性将源变量从 N^2 降至 (N-1)^2。N=3 时利用已知单随机体上的 Haar 诱导测度得到三维 Bessel 积分表示；一般有限 N 通过 Weingarten 演算给出低阶矩展开及直接 Haar 前推采样。
classification.one_liner: 将多矩阵 BPS 相干态重叠积分表示为单随机集合上 Haar 前推测度的拉普拉斯变换，并给出 N=3 的 Bessel 积分及一般 N 的 Weingarten 矩展开。
classification.relevance_reason: 处理 N=4 SYM 多矩阵 BPS 关联函数中的 U(N) Haar 积分，属于全息对偶中 BPS 关联函数与矩阵模型的技术工具；摘要未直接讨论引力对偶或具体全息应用。

papers.title: T-duality of string charge density/bit threads correspondence in type II supergravity
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study Abelian T-duality of the string charge density/bit threads correspondence in ten-dimensional Type II supergravity. T-duality along the common compact circle maps the Type IIB F1-NS5-P background to a Type IIA P-NS5-F1 background with the winding and momentum charges exchanged. The radial F1 source remains an F1 source, and its projected charge density gives a bit-thread flow whose maximal flux reproduces the black hole entropy. The same duality maps D1-D5-P to D0-D4-F1. In this case, a radial D1 source becomes a D2 source wrapped on the dual circle. Contracting the resulting spatial bivector with the normalized closed one-form on that circle gives a conserved effective radial flow whose maximal flux again reproduces the entropy. Although the local metrics, dilatons, source currents, and flow norms change, the dilaton-weighted transverse area density and the integrated maximal flux are invariant. These results provide a nontrivial T-duality test of the correspondence and extend it from string currents to wrapped-brane currents that reduce to string-like flows.

classification.title_zh: II 型超引力中弦电荷密度/bit threads 对应的 T-对偶性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究十维 II 型超引力中弦电荷密度/bit threads 对应的阿贝尔 T-对偶性。沿共同紧致圆的 T-对偶将 IIB F1-NS5-P 背景映射为 IIA P-NS5-F1 背景，其中缠绕荷与动量荷交换。径向 F1 源仍为 F1 源，其投影电荷密度给出一个 bit-thread 流，其最大通量再现黑洞熵。同一对偶将 D1-D5-P 映射为 D0-D4-F1。在此情形，径向 D1 源变为缠绕在对偶圆上的 D2 源。将所得空间双矢量与该圆上归一化闭 1-形式缩并，给出守恒的有效径向流，其最大通量也再现熵。尽管局域度规、膨胀子、源流和流的范数改变，膨胀子加权的横向面积密度与积分最大通量保持不变。这些结果为该对应提供了非平凡的 T-对偶检验，并将其从弦流扩展到可约化为弦状流的缠绕膜流。
classification.one_liner: 在十维 II 型超引力中检验弦电荷密度/bit threads 对应的 T-对偶，发现黑洞熵的最大通量在 F1-NS5-P↔P-NS5-F1 与 D1-D5-P↔D0-D4-F1 下不变。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于全息 bit threads、黑洞熵与弦论 T-对偶的基础对应检验，与全息量子信息相关；但不直接匹配所列全息凝聚态、p波/多分量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/Floquet 等重点支线。

papers.title: Spin-curvature effects in slowly rotating black hole spacetime
papers.abstract: We investigate the spin-curvature interaction for a massive spin-1/2 quantum particle in a slowly rotating black hole spacetime. In contrast to the flat Minkowski space, the curved spacetime introduces non-trivial spin connections into the Dirac equation due to the direct curvature-spin interaction. The force arising from this non-trivial spin-curvature coupling makes the particle deviate from its geodesics. We first calculate the tetrads in the co-moving frame of the particle in the slowly rotating black hole background. We then compute the components of the relativistic quantum force, arising from the spin-curvature interaction, using these co-moving tetrads up to linear order in the rotation parameter ($a$) of the black hole. The procedure of computing the force is based on the WKB approximation and the Gordon decomposition method for the Dirac probability four current. Our results show that the rotation parameter modifies the magnitude of the force by introducing a term that decays more rapidly with radial distance than the force magnitude in a static spherically symmetric Schwarzschild black hole spacetime.

classification.title_zh: 缓慢旋转黑洞时空中的自旋-曲率效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了缓慢旋转黑洞时空中一个有质量的 spin-1/2 量子粒子的自旋-曲率相互作用。与平坦的闵可夫斯基空间相比，弯曲时空由于直接的曲率-自旋相互作用，在狄拉克方程中引入了非平凡的自旋联络。由这种非平凡自旋-曲率耦合产生的力使粒子偏离其测地线。我们首先计算了粒子在缓慢旋转黑洞背景中共动系内的四元标架。随后，我们使用这些共动四元标架，在黑洞旋转参数(a)的线性阶内，计算了由自旋-曲率相互作用产生的相对论量子力的分量。计算该力的过程基于 WKB 近似以及针对狄拉克概率四流量的 Gordon 分解方法。我们的结果表明，旋转参数通过引入一个项来修正力的大小，该项随径向距离的衰减比静态球对称 Schwarzschild 黑洞时空中的力的大小更快。
classification.one_liner: 在缓慢旋转黑洞时空中，自旋-曲率耦合产生使自旋1/2粒子偏离测地线的相对论量子力，且黑洞旋转以更快径向衰减项修正该力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论重点标签，研究黑洞时空中的自旋-曲率效应；与全息、量子信息或凝聚态全息等主题无直接关联。

papers.title: Saddle-Order Universality in Ensemble-Averaged Black Hole Thermodynamics
papers.abstract: We establish a saddle-order proposition for the ensemble-averaged generalized free energy in reduced Euclidean black hole ensembles. Under regularity and stability assumptions, the leading fluctuation contribution is determined by the order of the first stabilizing term around the dominant saddle. An ordinary critical point is governed by a quartic soft mode, giving a quarter-temperature contribution instead of the familiar half-temperature Gaussian result. We verify this analytically for four-dimensional RN-AdS and Kerr-AdS black holes and map their thermodynamic controls to a common quartic normal form, whose scaling function connects the critical and Gaussian regimes along the zero-field one-well direction. The proposition also extends to coupled collective modes with weighted-homogeneous leading potentials. These results provide a unified description of reduced-ensemble fluctuations through black hole criticality.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 系综平均黑洞热力学中的鞍点阶普适性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为约化欧几里得黑洞系综中的系综平均广义自由能建立了一个鞍点阶命题。在正则性与稳定性假设下，主导涨落贡献由主导鞍点周围第一个稳定项的次数决定。普通临界点由四次软模支配，给出四分之一温度贡献，而非熟悉的高斯半温度结果。我们对四维 RN-AdS 和 Kerr-AdS 黑洞进行了解析验证，并将其热力学控制量映射到共同的四次正规形，其标度函数沿零场单井方向连接临界区与高斯区。该命题还推广到具有加权齐次主导势的耦合集体模式。这些结果为通过黑洞临界性统一描述约化系综涨落提供了基础。
classification.one_liner: 在约化欧几里得黑洞系综中，平均广义自由能的涨落由鞍点软模阶数普适决定，且四维 RN-AdS 与 Kerr-AdS 临界性可映射到共同四次正规形。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接讨论黑洞热力学临界性、系综平均自由能涨落以及 AdS 黑洞相变普适性，与“相变与气泡成核”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点高度一致。

papers.title: Critical Kasner scaling from Cauchy-horizon collapse near holographic phase transitions
papers.abstract: We study continuous scalar-hair bifurcations from stationary black holes with a nonextremal Cauchy horizon. Although the exterior deformation vanishes at criticality, the critical zero mode generically develops a logarithmic branch at the reference Cauchy horizon, producing a nonuniform critical limit. We show that the coefficient of this logarithm in the scalar perturbation, together with local Cauchy-horizon data, determines the exponential collapse rate of the Einstein-Rosen bridge. If the post-collapse geometry evolves into a Kasner regime, the boundary order-parameter scaling $O\propto|\lambda-\lambda_c|^\beta$ further implies $ 1-p_t\propto|\lambda-\lambda_c|^{2\beta}. $ Crucially, zero-mode matching fixes both the critical exponents and the associated amplitudes, without any fit to the nonlinear interior. We illustrate this mechanism in the transition from rotating BTZ to hairy rotating black holes. For scalarized RN-AdS$_4$ black branes, we quantitatively verify the predicted Kasner scaling using fully nonlinear numerical solutions. At low temperature, two charged models with identical linear critical data instead approach different infrared endpoints, yielding respectively power-law and inverse-logarithmic Kasner scaling. Thus interiors near a finite-temperature bifurcation are controlled by zero-mode transmission, whereas low temperature scaling is governed by the nonlinear infrared completion.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 全息相变附近由柯西视界坍缩产生的临界 Kasner 标度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有非极端柯西视界的稳态黑洞的连续标量毛发分叉。尽管外部形变在临界点消失，临界零模在参考柯西视界处通常会发展出一个对数分支，产生非均匀的临界极限。我们表明，标量微扰中该对数的系数，连同局部柯西视界数据，决定了爱因斯坦-罗森桥的指数坍缩率。如果坍缩后的几何演化进入 Kasner 区域，则边界序参量标度 O ∝ |λ−λc|^β 进一步意味着 1−p_t ∝ |λ−λc|^{2β}。至关重要的是，零模匹配确定了临界指数和相应振幅，而无需拟合非线性内部。我们在从旋转 BTZ 到带毛旋转黑洞的转变中说明了这一机制。对于标量化 RN-AdS4 黑膜，我们使用完全非线性数值解定量验证了预测的 Kasner 标度。在低温下，两个具有相同线性临界数据的带电模型却趋向不同的红外终点，分别产生幂律和反对数 Kasner 标度。因此，有限温度分叉附近的内部由零模透射控制，而低温标度则由非线性红外完成决定。
classification.one_liner: 在全息相变附近，柯西视界处的临界零模对数分支控制爱因斯坦-罗森桥坍缩，并确定 Kasner 临界标度。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究全息相变附近的黑洞内部柯西视界坍缩、零模匹配与临界 Kasner 标度，涉及相变临界指数和经典引力/非线性演化，与用户重点标签中的“相变与气泡成核”“经典引力/广义相对论”“QNM与非线性演化”高度相关。

papers.title: Where's Kasner? OPE Signature of Kasner Exponents
papers.abstract: At large $N$, the analytic structure of holographic thermal correlation functions contains non-trivial information about the near-singularity region of dual black holes. In particular, complex-time singularities can be related to geodesics that probe the black hole interior and bounce off the singularity. We analyse the asymptotic behaviour of holographic OPE data entering scalar two-point functions in states dual to black branes whose blackening factors truncate at finite order in inverse powers of the radial coordinate. For this class of geometries, we find a direct relation between the power-law exponent of these bouncing singularities and the Kasner exponent associated with the time direction near the black hole singularity. We discuss the regime of validity of this relation and comment on possible extensions to the transverse spatial directions.

classification.title_zh: Kasner 在哪里？Kasner 指数的 OPE 特征
classification.abstract_zh: 在大 N 下，全息热关联函数的解析结构包含对偶黑洞近奇点区域的非平凡信息。特别是，复时间奇点可与探测黑洞内部并从奇点反弹的测地线相联系。我们分析了进入标量两点函数中全息 OPE 数据的渐近行为，这些态对偶于其 blackening factor 在径向坐标逆幂的有限阶处截断的黑膜。对此类几何，我们发现这些反弹奇点的幂律指数与黑洞奇点附近时间方向相关的 Kasner 指数之间存在直接关系。我们讨论了该关系的适用区域，并评论了向横向空间方向推广的可能性。
classification.one_liner: 论文通过全息热两点函数的 OPE 渐近数据，将反弹复时间奇点的幂律指数与对偶黑膜奇点附近时间方向的 Kasner 指数联系起来。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息对偶与黑洞内部奇点/OPE 理论研究，但与用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论等具体重点支线没有直接重叠。

papers.title: Spin density from second order transport in fluids
papers.abstract: We study the hydrodynamics of a charged fluid with spin degrees of freedom. We argue that, in a conformal field theory in 3+1 dimensions, the spin density is related to a linear combination of standard second-order transport coefficients, and an additional term quadratic in the gauge- and mixed gauge-gravitational anomaly coefficients. We compute the spin density in several free and holographic theories and compare the results.

classification.title_zh: 流体中来自二阶输运的自旋密度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究带自旋自由度的带电流体的流体力学。我们论证，在3+1维共形场论中，自旋密度与标准二阶输运系数的一个线性组合以及一个由规范异常和混合规范-引力异常系数平方构成的附加项有关。我们在若干自由理论和全息理论中计算了自旋密度，并比较了结果。
classification.one_liner: 在3+1维CFT中，自旋密度由二阶输运系数线性组合与异常系数平方项给出，并在自由与全息理论中比较。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息流体/输运与异常研究，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜或经典引力等重点支线。

papers.title: Toroidal Charged AdS Branes and Deformed Toda Equations
papers.abstract: We show that the equations of motion for magnetically charged $p$-branes in $(n+p+2)$-dimensional AdS reduce to coupled one-dimensional Toda-type equations, and use this structure to construct static toroidal black branes with $T^n$ symmetry and $p$ translation-invariant directions. In the pure-Maxwell case we obtain an exact $\sinh$ solution--a $(p+2)$-dimensional black brane times an $n$-torus, asymptotically $\mathrm{AdS}_{p+2}\times T^n$--whose dilatonic analogue, with a scalar coupled through $e^{a\phi}$, has a running torus modulus and a non-trivial dilaton. A perturbative expansion reduces the linearized system to a pair of P\"oschl-Teller equations, one elementary and one solved by associated Legendre functions of non-integer degree, so that the general solution is non-elementary; at weak coupling $\epsilon=a^2$ we construct the $O(a^2)$ backreaction explicitly. From the surface gravity, horizon area, and holographic renormalization we obtain the Hawking temperature, entropy density, and mass density, verifying the first law $d\mathcal{M}=T_H\,ds$ and the traceless conformal stress tensor of the dual $(p+1)$-dimensional theory. At $O(a^2)$ the first law persists, but the dilaton source shifts the Stefan-Boltzmann exponent to $p_{\rm eff}=p+a^2/2$, breaking the clean power law $s\propto T_H^p$ while the normalizable dilaton hair decouples from the entropy.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 环面带电 AdS 膜与变形 Toda 方程
classification.abstract_zh: 我们表明，(n+p+2) 维 AdS 中磁荷 p-膜的运动方程约化为耦合的一维 Toda 型方程，并利用该结构构造具有 T^n 对称性和 p 个平移不变方向的静态环面黑洞膜。在纯 Maxwell 情形，我们获得精确的 sinh 解——(p+2) 维黑洞膜乘以 n-环面，渐近为 AdS_{p+2}×T^n——其膨胀子类比中，标量通过 e^{aφ} 耦合，具有跑动的环面模量和非平凡膨胀子。微扰展开将线性化系统化为两个 Pöschl-Teller 方程，一个是初等的，另一个由非整数阶连带 Legendre 函数求解，因此一般解是非初等的；在弱耦合 ε=a^2 下，我们显式构造了 O(a^2) 反作用。从表面引力、视界面积和全息重整化，我们得到 Hawking 温度、熵密度和质量密度，验证第一定律 dM=T_H ds 以及对偶 (p+1) 维理论的无迹共形应力张量。在 O(a^2) 阶，第一定律仍然成立，但膨胀子源将 Stefan-Boltzmann 指数移动为 p_eff=p+a^2/2，破坏了干净的幂律 s∝T_H^p，而可归一化膨胀子毛从熵中解耦。
classification.one_liner: 该文将 AdS 中磁荷 p-膜运动方程约化为 Toda 型方程，构造环面黑洞膜并计算全息热力学，发现膨胀子修正改变 Stefan-Boltzmann 指数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 AdS 中的经典黑洞膜解、Toda 型方程与全息热力学，属于理论全息与经典引力支线；但其重点不落在用户列出的全息超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM 等特定方向上。

papers.title: Tripartite Form Universality in Holographic Entropy Inequalities
papers.abstract: To elucidate the meaning of holographic entropy inequalities (beyond subadditivity) which characterize the entanglement structure of geometric states in holography, arXiv:2309.06296 proposed the "tripartite form" for these inequalities, consisting of tripartite information and conditional tripartite information terms with unit coefficients. While this provides a compact and useful packaging of the inequalities, it is not a priori guaranteed that all inequalities can be recast in this form. Here we conjecture that they can, and present substantial evidence, by proving that the two known infinite families of holographic entropy inequalities found in arXiv:2309.15145 can indeed be written in the tripartite form. This is significant because such recasting is particularly nontrivial for these families. Apart from providing the explicit tripartite form expressions for every member of these two infinite families, we detail how we arrived at them, in the process deriving several useful identities which may serve as stepping stones to formulate further repackaging of the corresponding information quantities. We also illustrate the power of the tripartite form by proving a number of structural properties satisfied by any holographic entropy inequality.

classification.title_zh: 全息熵不等式中的三分形式普适性
classification.abstract_zh: 为了阐明全息熵不等式（超出次可加性）的含义——这些不等式刻画了全息中几何态的纠缠结构——arXiv:2309.06296 提出了这些不等式的“三分形式”，其中包含三分信息和条件三分信息项，系数均为 1。虽然这为不等式提供了紧凑且有用的封装，但先验地并不保证所有不等式都能改写成这种形式。这里我们猜想它们可以，并给出大量证据：证明 arXiv:2309.15145 中发现的两个已知无限族全息熵不等式确实可以写成三分形式。这一点很重要，因为对于这些族，这种改写特别不平凡。除了给出这两个无限族中每个成员的显式三分形式表达式外，我们还详细说明我们如何得到它们，在此过程中推导出若干有用的恒等式，它们可能成为进一步重新封装相应信息量的垫脚石。我们还通过证明任何全息熵不等式都满足的若干结构性质，来展示三分形式的威力。
classification.one_liner: 本文猜想所有全息熵不等式均可写成三分形式，并证明两个已知无限族可显式改写，同时推导若干结构性质。

papers.title: Bayesian Inferences on Analytical Equations of State Approximations of Neutron Stars
papers.abstract: Equations of state (EoS) for dense matter are commonly provided in tabulated pressure-energy density relations, complicating numerical implementation and potentially compromising thermodynamic consistency. In this work, we propose a piecewise-continuous analytical form with a common parametrization capable of representing a broad class of dense matter EoSs. We validate this parametrization against tabulated EoSs from the CompOSE and LALSimulation repositories. Following the initial deterministic fitting, we employed two distinct Bayesian approaches: one based on synthetic EoSs generated by adding noise to the fitted EoS and another based on multi-messenger measurements of neutron-star masses and tidal deformabilities. In both approaches, the initial best-fit parameters are used as reference values. For the considered EoSs, spanning from very soft to very stiff, the resulting fits reproduce the tabulated EoSs and the associated macroscopic neutron-star observables in the repositories with sufficient accuracy. The inferred parameters exhibit strong correlations arising from the continuity conditions imposed at the segment boundaries. These correlations persist in the low- and intermediate-density segments under multi-messenger inference but become weak in the core, reflecting the limited constraining power of current observations at high densities. The ability of a single functional form to describe EoSs derived from different microscopic frameworks, together with the recurrence of similar parameter correlations, suggests that diverse dense matter EoSs may share a common underlying structure.

classification.title_zh: 中子星解析状态方程近似的贝叶斯推断
classification.abstract_zh: 致密物质的状态方程（EoS）通常以表格形式给出压强-能量密度关系，这会使数值实现复杂化，并可能损害热力学一致性。在本工作中，我们提出一种分段连续解析形式，具有共同参数化，能够表示广泛类别的致密物质EoS。我们利用CompOSE和LALSimulation库中的表格EoS对该参数化进行了验证。在初步确定性拟合之后，我们采用了两种不同的贝叶斯方法：一种基于通过在拟合EoS上添加噪声生成的合成EoS，另一种基于中子星质量和潮汐形变的多信使测量。在两种方法中，初始最佳拟合参数被用作参考值。对于所考虑从非常软到非常硬的EoS，所得拟合能以足够精度再现库中的表格EoS及相关的宏观中子星可观测量。推断出的参数表现出强相关性，这些相关性源自分段边界处施加的连续性条件。这些相关性在多信使推断下在低密度和中密度段持续存在，但在核心处变弱，反映出当前观测对高密度约束能力有限。单一函数形式能够描述源自不同微观框架的EoS，并且相似参数相关性的重复出现，表明多种致密物质EoS可能共享一个共同的基础结构。
classification.one_liner: 提出分段连续解析状态方程参数化，并用贝叶斯方法拟合中子星表格EoS与多信使观测。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为中子星状态方程与贝叶斯推断，属于经典引力/核天体物理；与 AdS/CFT 全息对偶及用户重点全息支线无直接关联。

papers.title: Spin effects in superfluidity, neutron matter and neutron stars
papers.abstract: We review selected aspects of the interior physics of compact stars, focusing on the microscopic and macroscopic manifestations of spin, magnetic fields, and nucleonic superfluidity and superconductivity. Spin statistics of fermions allow quantum degeneracy pressure to determine the stability and global properties of neutron stars, whose structure depends sensitively on the strong interactions among baryons in dense matter. Using a generic metamodeling framework based on an expansion of the nuclear energy density around the isospin-symmetric and saturation-density limits, we highlight how various lesser-known terms in this expansion affect compact-star observables and review multimessenger constraints on mass, radius, and moment of inertia. The influence of magnetic fields on dense matter is examined, showing that substantial effects in their structure require extremely strong fields, whereas lower fields are sufficient to affect their superfluid phases. At the mesoscopic scale, the coexistence of superfluid and superconducting components features vortex and flux-tube lattices, with pinning and mutual friction processes playing central roles in neutron-star rotational dynamics. We discuss unresolved issues concerning vortex structure, flux-tube configurations, and the origin of pulsar glitches and postglitch relaxation. We also briefly address the possible emergence of deconfined quark phases in compact-star cores, including their color-superconducting properties, as well as the associated vortex structures and magnetic-field responses in such phases.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 超流性、中子物质与中子星中的自旋效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们综述致密星内部物理的若干方面，重点关注自旋、磁场以及核子超流与超导的微观和宏观表现。费米子的自旋统计使量子简并压决定中子星的稳定性和整体性质，而其结构敏感依赖于稠密物质中重子间的强相互作用。使用基于在等旋对称和饱和密度极限附近展开核能量密度的一般元建模框架，我们强调该展开中各种较少被关注的项如何影响致密星可观测量，并综述对质量、半径和转动惯量的多信使约束。我们考察磁场对稠密物质的影响，表明要在结构中产生显著效应需要极强磁场，而较低磁场就足以影响其超流相。在介观尺度上，超流与超导组分的共存表现为涡旋和磁通管晶格，钉扎和互摩擦过程在中子星转动动力学中起核心作用。我们讨论关于涡旋结构、磁通管构型以及脉冲星glitch和后glitch弛豫起源的未解决问题。我们还简要讨论致密星核心中可能出现的去禁闭夸克相，包括其色超导性质，以及此类相中相关的涡旋结构和磁场响应。
classification.one_liner: 综述中子星内部自旋、磁场、核子超流/超导及涡旋/磁通管物理，并讨论夸克相与脉冲星glitch。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为致密星核物理与中子星超流/超导，未涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Gravitational-wave constraints on $H_0$ are robust to putative redshift evolution in the binary black hole mass spectrum at current sensitivity
papers.abstract: Spectral-siren cosmology constrains the Hubble constant $H_0$ using gravitational-wave observations of compact-binary coalescences. The method combines luminosity distances inferred from the waveform with redshift information statistically encoded in population features of the source-frame mass spectrum. Because the detector measures redshifted masses, structure in the intrinsic mass distribution acts as an internal ``ruler,'' making the inference sensitive to assumptions about the population model. In particular, redshift evolution of the mass spectrum is widely discussed as a potential systematic for $H_0$ measurements. We revisit spectral-siren constraints with the GWTC-4.0 binary black hole catalog, explicitly allowing the main mass scales of a standard parametric mass model to evolve with redshift. We find no compelling evidence for evolution at current sensitivity. Allowing evolution produces a modest, nonstatistically significant shift of the $H_0$ posterior toward lower values, which we interpret with targeted posterior and event-level diagnostics. Importantly, the associated systematic uncertainty is subdominant to that induced by alternative redshift-independent descriptions of the mass spectrum, such as the number of spectral features and the functional form used to model them. Our results indicate that, at current sensitivity, spectral-siren constraints on $H_0$ are robust to redshift evolution of the mass spectrum within the flexibility explored here. Using injection studies, we show that this mild $H_0$ shift is reproduced when a nonevolving underlying population is analyzed with an evolving model, consistent with an overflexible population description at the present signal-to-noise. The sign and magnitude of the shift can, however, depend on detector sensitivity and redshift reach as the population features become increasingly constrained directly by the data.

classification.title_zh: 引力波对 H0 的约束在当前灵敏度下对双黑洞质量谱的假定红移演化稳健
classification.abstract_zh: 谱警笛宇宙学利用致密双星并合的引力波观测来限制哈勃常数 H0。该方法把波形给出的光度距离与源框架质量谱族群特征中统计编码的红移信息结合起来。由于探测器测量的是红移后的质量，内禀质量分布中的结构充当内部“标尺”，使推断对族群模型假设敏感。特别是，质量谱的红移演化被广泛视为 H0 测量的潜在系统误差。我们利用 GWTC-4.0 双黑洞目录重新审视谱警笛约束，显式允许标准参数化质量模型的主要质量尺度随红移演化。我们发现当前灵敏度下没有令人信服的演化证据。允许演化会使 H0 后验向较低值产生适度、统计上不显著的移动，我们用有针对性的后验和事件级诊断加以解释。重要的是，相关系统不确定度小于替代的红移无关质量谱描述（如谱特征数目及其函数形式）所引入的不确定度。结果表明，在当前灵敏度下，谱警笛对 H0 的约束在本文探索的灵活性范围内对质量谱红移演化是稳健的。通过注入研究，我们表明当用演化模型分析非演化 underlying population 时，可以重现这一轻微 H0 移动，这与当前信噪比下族群描述过于灵活一致。然而，随着族群特征越来越直接受数据约束，该移动的符号和幅度可能依赖于探测器灵敏度和红移覆盖范围。
classification.one_liner: GWTC-4.0 双黑洞谱警笛分析表明，允许质量谱红移演化对 H0 后验仅有不显著影响，当前 H0 约束主要受质量谱模型选择而非红移演化系统误差限制。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息/量子引力论文；属于经典引力与引力波宇宙学，直接使用双黑洞引力波族群推断 H0，契合“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线，但与全息研究无直接关联。

papers.title: Lorentzian Cheeger-Gromov convergence and temporal functions
papers.abstract: Uniqueness (up to isometries) and existence of limits are studied in the context of Cheeger-Gromov convergence of spacetimes. To address the non-compactness of the linear isometry group in the semi-Riemannian setting, standard pointed convergence is strengthened to anchored convergence, which in the Lorentzian case requires the convergence of a timelike direction. This allows one to construct a local isometry between the neighborhoods of the basepoints, which can be extended globally when one of the limits is geodesically complete for a single causal type of geodesics and the other one is inextensible; a Misner-type example shows that inextensibility of both limits is not enough. In spacetimes, by using Cauchy temporal functions both as a strengthening of the anchors and as a tool to ``Wick rotate'' metrics, a special notion of convergence for globally hyperbolic spacetimes (including those with timelike boundaries) is introduced. After revisiting the tools related to time functions and studying their connections with the Sormani-Vega null distance, the machinery of Riemannian Cheeger-Gromov theory becomes applicable. In particular, several results of independent interest are obtained, including global and local characterizations of $h$-steep functions, independence of steepness and $h$-steepness for temporal functions, compatibility of both conditions for Cauchy temporal functions, and the stability of the latter.

classification.title_zh: 洛伦兹 Cheeger-Gromov 收敛与时间函数
classification.abstract_zh: 研究时空 Cheeger-Gromov 收敛背景下的唯一性（至等距）与极限存在性。为处理半黎曼情形中线性等距群的非紧性，将标准的带基点收敛加强为锚定收敛；在洛伦兹情形，这要求一个类时方向的收敛。由此可在基点邻域之间构造局部等距，并且当其中一个极限对某一因果类型的测地线测地完备、而另一个极限不可延拓时，可将其整体延拓；一个 Misner 型例子表明，两个极限都不可延拓并不足够。在时空中，通过把 Cauchy 时间函数同时用作锚的加强和“Wick 旋转”度规的工具，引入了一种针对全局双曲时空（包括带类时边界者）的特殊收敛概念。在回顾与时间函数相关的工具并研究其与 Sormani-Vega 零距离的联系之后，黎曼 Cheeger-Gromov 理论的机器变得可用。特别地，获得若干具有独立兴趣的结果，包括 h-steep 函数的整体与局部刻画、时间函数的 steepness 与 h-steepness 的独立性、Cauchy 时间函数两条件的相容性，以及后者的稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 该文将 Cheeger-Gromov 收敛推广到洛伦兹时空，借助锚定收敛与 Cauchy 时间函数研究全局双曲时空的收敛与稳定性。

papers.title: Modeling general-relativistic plasmas with collisionless moments and dissipative two-fluid magnetohydrodynamics
papers.abstract: Relativistic plasmas are central to the study of black hole accretion, jet physics, neutron star mergers, and compact object magnetospheres. Despite the need to accurately capture the dynamics of these plasmas and the implications for relativistic transients, their fluid modeling is typically done using a number of (overly) simplifying assumptions, which do not hold in general. This is especially true when the mean free path in the plasma is large compared to the system size, and kinetic effects start to become important. Going beyond common approaches used in the literature, we describe a fully relativistic covariant 14-moment based two-fluid system appropriate for the study of electron-ion or electron-positron plasmas. This generalized Israel-Stewart-like system of equations of motion is obtained directly from the relativistic Boltzmann-Vlasov equation. Crucially, this new formulation can account for non-ideal effects, such as anisotropic pressures and heat fluxes. We show that a relativistic two-fluid plasma can be recast as a single fluid coupled to electromagnetic fields with (potentially large) out-of-equilibrium corrections. In particular, we keep all electron degrees of freedom, which provide self-consistent evolution equations for electron temperature and momentum. The equations outlined in this paper are able to capture the full two-fluid character of collisionless plasmas found in black hole accretion and flaring processes around compact objects, as well Braginskii-like two-fluid magnetohydrodynamics applicable to weakly collisional plasmas inside accretion disks. This new formulation will be instrumental in the construction of a large class of next-generation simulations of relativistic transient phenomena produced around black holes and neutron stars.

classification.title_zh: 用无碰撞矩和耗散双流体磁流体力学建模广义相对论等离子体
classification.abstract_zh: 相对论等离子体是黑洞吸积、喷流物理、中子星并合以及致密天体磁层研究的核心。尽管需要准确捕捉这些等离子体的动力学及其对相对论暂现现象的影响，但对它们的流体建模通常采用若干（过度）简化的假设，而这些假设一般并不成立。当等离子体中的平均自由程大于系统尺度、动理学效应开始变得重要时，尤其如此。超越文献中常用方法，我们描述一个完全相对论性协变的、基于14矩的双流体系统，适用于电子-离子或电子-正电子等离子体研究。这个广义的 Israel-Stewart 型运动方程组直接由相对论 Boltzmann-Vlasov 方程得到。关键的是，这一新表述可以计入非理想效应，如各向异性压强和热流。我们表明，相对论性双流体等离子体可重写为一种与电磁场耦合的单流体，并带有（可能很大的）非平衡修正。特别地，我们保留所有电子自由度，为电子温度和动量提供自洽演化方程。本文列出的方程能够刻画黑洞吸积和致密天体周围耀发过程中无碰撞等离子体的完整双流体特性，以及适用于吸积盘内弱碰撞等离子体的类 Braginskii 双流体磁流体力学。这一新表述将有助于构建一大类关于黑洞和中子星周围产生的相对论性暂现现象的下一代模拟。
classification.one_liner: 构建了从相对论 Boltzmann-Vlasov 方程导出的完全协变 14 矩双流体 Israel-Stewart 型方程，用于模拟黑洞吸积/中子星并合等广义相对论等离子体，并包含各向异性压强与热流等非理想效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于广义相对论等离子体/耗散双流体磁流体力学，面向黑洞吸积、中子星并合等经典引力与相对论天体物理场景，未涉及全息对偶；与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签直接相关。

papers.title: Dynamics for Spin-$1/2$ Particles in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity II: Non-Relativistic Case
papers.abstract: In this work, I investigate the non-relativistic quantum dynamics of spin-1/2 particles in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (EGB) gravity and establish a direct connection between higher-curvature corrections, fermionic dynamics, and the phenomenology of compact objects. Starting from the Dirac Hamiltonian in a static, spherically symmetric EGB spacetime, we perform a Fold-Wouthuysen transformation and derive the effective Hamiltonian, including relativistic kinetic, gravitational, spin-orbit, and higher-curvature contributions. Heisenberg equations are then used to obtain the dynamics of velocity, force, and spin, revealing explicit EGB corrections for both translational motion and spin transport. In particular, the spin-orbit sector induces a modified precession frequency whose fractional deviation from general relativity scales as $\delta_{\Omega}=-4(\xi/M^{2})(M/\rho)^{3}$, providing a clear dimensionless signature of the Gauss-Bonnet coupling. Through Ehrenfest's theorem, we also establish the correspondence between the dynamics of quantum operators and their semiclassical gravitational limit. As an astrophysical application, we consider the stellar-mass black hole A0620-00 and show that prospective relative sensitivities in spin precession on the order of $10^{-3}$ to $10^{-4}$ can probe Gauss-Bonnet couplings in the range of approximately $10^{6}$ to $10^{8}\,{\rm m}^{2}$, depending on the orbital radius. This result identifies fermionic spin precession as a complementary channel for testing gravity with higher-curvature corrections and provides a quantum-mechanical framework connecting modified gravitational dynamics to precision phenomenology in strong-gravity regimes.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中自旋-1/2 粒子的动力学 II：非相对论情形
classification.abstract_zh: 在本工作中，我研究了 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (EGB) 引力中自旋-1/2 粒子的非相对论量子动力学，并建立了高阶曲率修正、费米子动力学与致密天体现象学之间的直接联系。从静态球对称 EGB 时空中的 Dirac 哈密顿量出发，我们执行 Fold-Wouthuysen 变换并推导出有效哈密顿量，其中包括相对论动能、引力、自旋-轨道以及高阶曲率贡献。随后使用 Heisenberg 方程得到速度、力和自旋的动力学，揭示了对平动和自旋输运的显式 EGB 修正。特别地，自旋-轨道部分诱导出一个修正的进动频率，其相对广义相对论的分数偏差按 δΩ = -4(ξ/M²)(M/ρ)³ 标度，给出了 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合的清晰无量纲特征。通过 Ehrenfest 定理，我们还建立了量子算符动力学与其半经典引力极限之间的对应关系。作为一个天体物理应用，我们考虑恒星质量黑洞 A0620-00，并表明自旋进动中预期达到 10⁻³ 至 10⁻⁴ 量级的相对灵敏度可以探测约 10⁶ 至 10⁸ m² 范围内的 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合，具体取决于轨道半径。这一结果将费米子自旋进动认定为检验具高阶曲率修正引力的一个互补通道，并提供了一个连接修正引力动力学与强引力区精密现象学的量子力学框架。
classification.one_liner: 在 EGB 引力中对自旋-1/2 粒子作非相对论展开，导出修正自旋进动并给出黑洞 A0620-00 的探测灵敏度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 EGB 修正引力中自旋-1/2 粒子的非相对论量子动力学及黑洞自旋进动检验，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但全文不涉及全息对偶、AdS/CFT 或量子引力信息。

papers.title: Wide parameter-space O3 search for continuous gravitational waves from unknown neutron stars in binary systems
papers.abstract: Continuous gravitational waves, i.e., persistent and nearly-monochromatic signals emitted by asymmetric spinning neutron stars, remain elusive. Searches for these signals from unknown binary systems are the most computationally challenging, but they are essential, given that binary accretion provides a natural mechanism for creating the required asymmetry, and around half of the known pulsars rotating above 25 Hz are part of a binary system. Here we report on a search of a large uncharted parameter-space region: for the first time we cover gravitational-wave frequencies above 520 Hz (from 50 to 1000 Hz), and, for the first time with advanced detectors, orbital periods lower than 3 days are explored. No signal is detected, and we set the most stringent constraints to date on the amplitude of signals of this kind. Our results exclude with $95\%$ confidence neutron stars within 100 pc and rotating faster than $\sim$ 495 Hz from having ellipticities above $5.2 \times 10^{-8}$. Within the same distance our results also exclude r-mode amplitudes above $1.5 \times 10^{-6}$ for stars rotating faster than $\sim$ 740 Hz.

classification.title_zh: 双星系统中未知中子星的宽参数空间 O3 连续引力波搜索
classification.abstract_zh: 连续引力波，即非对称自转中子星发出的持续且近乎单色的信号，至今仍未被探测到。对未知双星系统中这类信号的搜索在计算上最具挑战性，但它们至关重要，因为双星吸积提供了产生所需非对称性的自然机制，而且已知自转频率高于 25 Hz 的脉冲星中约有一半位于双星系统中。本文报告了对一大片未探索参数空间区域的搜索：我们首次覆盖了 520 Hz 以上的引力波频率（搜索频段为 50 至 1000 Hz），并且首次用先进探测器探索了短于 3 天的轨道周期。未探测到信号，我们给出了迄今对这类信号振幅最严格的限制。我们的结果以 95% 置信度排除了距离 100 pc 以内、自转快于约 495 Hz 的中子星具有高于 5.2×10^{-8} 的椭率。在同一距离内，我们的结果还排除了自转快于约 740 Hz 的星体具有高于 1.5×10^{-6} 的 r 模振幅。
classification.one_liner: O3 数据首次在 50–1000 Hz 和轨道周期小于 3 天的大参数空间搜索未知双星中子星连续引力波，未探测到信号并给出迄今最严格的椭率与 r 模限制。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究双星系统中子星的连续引力波搜索与限制，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但并非全息或量子引力研究。

papers.title: Time delay as a probe of multiple photon spheres
papers.abstract: Black hole shadow images are primarily determined by the properties of photon spheres and can exhibit degeneracies across different spherically symmetric spacetime geometries. We show that time delay observables associated with higher-order images of transient sources provide a robust probe to break such degeneracies in spacetimes admitting multiple photon spheres. Adopting a theory-agnostic, parametrized, static, spherically symmetric framework that captures the generic features of double-peak effective potentials, we investigate photon geodesics and quantify them in terms of angular deflection, travel time, and the order of the image. We identify distinctive signatures of trajectories probing the region between the unstable photon spheres. In particular, we find that these trajectories are characterized by the nontrivial temporal behavior, including a minimum travel time, a minimum angular deflection, and a characteristic triplet structure of higher-order images with a specific arrival sequence. We further show that the influence of the depth of the potential well, between the two photon spheres, on the observed time delays provides a direct handle on otherwise inaccessible regions of the spacetime. Although we consider a parametrized framework, these identified signatures are primarily influenced by the potential structure and will therefore occur in any spacetime with a similar double-peak effective potential. Our results highlight that time-domain lensing observables encode information beyond static shadow images and offer a promising avenue for probing the structure of compact objects and the strong-field regime of gravity.

classification.title_zh: 时间延迟作为多光子球的探针
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞阴影图像主要由光子球性质决定，并且在不同球对称时空几何之间可能出现简并。我们表明，瞬变源高阶像对应的时间延迟观测量，为在允许多个光子球的时空中打破这种简并提供了稳健探针。采用一个与理论无关、参数化、静态球对称的框架，该框架捕捉双峰有效势的一般特征，我们研究光子测地线，并用角偏转、旅行时间和像的阶数量化它们。我们识别出探测两个不稳定光子球之间区域的轨迹的独特特征。特别地，我们发现这些轨迹具有非平凡的时间行为，包括最小旅行时间、最小角偏转，以及高阶像具有特定到达顺序的特征性三重态结构。我们进一步表明，两个光子球之间势阱深度对观测时间延迟的影响，为探测原本不可及的时空区域提供了直接手段。尽管我们考虑的是参数化框架，这些识别出的特征主要受势结构影响，因此会出现在任何具有类似双峰有效势的时空中。我们的结果强调，时域透镜观测量编码了静态阴影图像之外的信息，并为探测致密天体结构和引力强场区域提供了有前景的途径。
classification.one_liner: 时间延迟可打破多光子球时空的黑洞阴影简并，并揭示双峰有效势之间的光子轨迹特征。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力中的黑洞强场透镜、多光子球与时间延迟，对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Light deflection in the gravimagnetic dipole spacetime
papers.abstract: The gravimagnetic dipole is an asymptotically flat, stationary, axisymmetric vacuum solution to Einstein's General Relativity describing two non-extreme black holes with equal masses and opposite NUT charges connected by a Misner string. The string tension's can be set to zero by choosing the black hole separation accordingly, yielding a stable system of oppositely rotating black holes at a fixed distance. Numerical simulations of massless particle geodesics reveal gravitational lensing effects for extended sources at infinity on the equatorial plane or on the vertical axis.

classification.title_zh: 引力磁偶极子时空中的光线偏折
classification.abstract_zh: 引力磁偶极子是爱因斯坦广义相对论的一个渐近平坦、稳态、轴对称真空解，描述两个质量相等、NUT 荷相反、由 Misner 弦连接的非极端黑洞。通过相应选择黑洞间距，可将弦张力设为零，从而得到一个稳定、以固定距离彼此反向旋转的黑洞系统。对无质量粒子测地线的数值模拟揭示了赤道面或竖直轴上来自无穷远延展源的引力透镜效应。
classification.one_liner: 研究引力磁偶极子精确解中无质量粒子测地线与引力透镜，并讨论通过选取间距消除 Misner 弦张力的稳定双黑洞构型。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究广义相对论精确时空解、黑洞构型与光线偏折，属于用户指定的经典引力/广义相对论重点支线。

papers.title: Measuring the neutron star equation of state from EMRIs in dark matter environments with LISA
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave observations of extreme mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) in vacuum are largely insensitive to the internal structure of the small compact companion. We show that this conclusion can change when the central black hole is surrounded by a dense dark matter environment. We compute, for the first time, the relativistic dynamical-friction force on a neutron star moving through a collisionless medium and its impact on the evolution of EMRIs embedded in dense dark matter spikes. We then perform a Bayesian parameter-estimation analysis of simulated LISA observations to assess the measurability of both spike properties and the companion's internal structure.We find that, in our fiducial dark matter spike models, EMRIs with signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) $\gtrsim 120$ can already distinguish neutron star from black hole companions. At comparable signal-to-noise ratios, discrimination among neutron star equations of state begins to emerge and becomes significantly stronger toward the high-SNR tail.

classification.title_zh: 利用LISA在暗物质环境中的EMRI测量中子星状态方程
classification.abstract_zh: 在真空中的极端质量比旋进（EMRI）引力波观测在很大程度上对小型致密伴星的内部结构不敏感。我们表明，当中心黑洞被致密暗物质环境包围时，这一结论可能改变。我们首次计算了中子星在无碰撞介质中运动时受到相对论动力学摩擦力，以及它对嵌入致密暗物质尖峰中的EMRI演化的影响。随后，我们对模拟LISA观测进行贝叶斯参数估计分析，以评估暗物质尖峰性质和伴星内部结构的可测量性。我们发现，在我们的基准暗物质尖峰模型中，信噪比（SNR）≳120 的 EMRI 已能够区分中子星伴星和黑洞伴星。在可比的信噪比下，不同中子星状态方程之间的区分开始显现，并在高信噪比端变得显著更强。
classification.one_liner: 在含暗物质尖峰的EMRI中，相对论动力学摩擦使LISA观测能够区分中子星与黑洞伴星，并开始测量中子星状态方程。

papers.title: Nonlinearly Causal General-Relativistic Two-Fluid Dissipative Magnetohydrodynamics
papers.abstract: We present a formulation of general-relativistic (GR) 19-moment dissipative magnetohydrodynamics (MHD), capable of handling all first-order dissipative terms (viscosity, heat conductivity, resistivity and Hall terms), as well as all ideal electron degrees of freedom (number density, momentum and energy) in a GR astrophysical two-fluid plasma. We derive necessary and sufficient nonlinear causality conditions for the constrained first-order 19-moment system, as well as both necessary and sufficient conditions for strong hyperbolicity. To assess the formulation numerically, we develop a high-resolution shock-capturing scheme that solves these equations in a performance-portable fashion. The scheme expresses all evolution equations, including the dissipative and electron sectors, in flux-divergence form, allowing us to model systems with scales separated by orders of magnitude without resolving kinetic scales everywhere on the grid. In addition, we use implicit integration methods to systematically overstep kinetic scales in MHD regions, such as cyclotron and plasma frequencies. To make the scheme as robust as GRMHD codes, we construct necessary and sufficient conditions for a conserved state to be physically admissible, and based on these construct a new physicality-enforcement scheme. As an exact validation comparison, we formulate and derive a full solution to dissipative two-fluid Bondi accretion in general relativity. We then validate the equations against a series of results from kinetic particle-in-cell models of black hole accretion and magnetospheric dynamics, demonstrating that our formulation and scheme can correctly capture major features relevant for feedback on global scales of these solutions, including dimensionless reconnection rates of order $0.1$ and Braginskii-like anisotropic pressures and heat fluxes.

classification.title_zh: 非线性因果的广义相对论双流体耗散磁流体力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出广义相对论（GR）19矩耗散磁流体力学（MHD）的一种表述，能够处理GR天体物理双流体等离子体中的所有一阶耗散项（黏滞、热导、电阻率和霍尔项），以及所有理想电子自由度（数密度、动量和能量）。我们推导了约束一阶19矩系统的必要且充分的非线性因果性条件，以及强双曲性的必要且充分条件。为对该表述进行数值评估，我们发展了高分辨率激波捕获格式，以性能可移植的方式求解这些方程。该格式将所有演化方程，包括耗散和电子部分，写成通量-散度形式，使我们能在网格上不处处解析动理学尺度的情况下模拟尺度相差数量级的系统。此外，我们使用隐式积分方法在MHD区域系统性地跨越动理学尺度，如回旋频率和等离子体频率。为使格式像GRMHD代码一样稳健，我们构造了守恒态物理可容许性的必要且充分条件，并基于此构造了一种新的物理性强制方案。作为精确验证比较，我们建立并推导了广义相对论中耗散双流体Bondi吸积的完整解。随后，我们针对黑洞吸积和磁层动力学的动理学PIC模型的一系列结果验证了方程，表明我们的表述和格式能够正确捕捉这些解在全局尺度上反馈相关的主要特征，包括约0.1的无量纲重联率和类Braginskii各向异性压强与热流。
classification.one_liner: 建立广义相对论19矩耗散双流体磁流体力学，给出非线性因果性与强双曲性条件，并发展数值格式及验证。

papers.title: Combining astrometry with pulsar timing: the first joint analysis of very low frequency gravitational waves
papers.abstract: The pHz to sub-nHz GW regime remains largely unexplored but is crucial for mapping the early inspiral stage of SMBHBs and probing early-Universe physics. Astrometry and pulsar timing offer orthogonal and deeply complementary secular observables to investigate this frequency band. We aim to present the first joint data analysis combining real astrometric proper motions with binary pulsar timing, to search for and constrain continuous gravitational waves (CWs) sourced by SMBHBs in the ultra-low-frequency regime ($10^{-12} \le f_{GW} \le10^{-9} Hz$). We employ a Bayesian model selection and upper limit estimation framework to combine apparent proper motion displacements of $\sim 1.5 \times 10^6$ quasars from the Gaia CRF3 catalog with the line-of-sight orbital period derivatives ($\dot{P}_b$) of 11 high-precision binary pulsars. To prevent spurious detections, we heavily model instrumental and astrophysical systematics: we propagate the Galactic potential uncertainty for pulsars via Monte Carlo simulations and perform a Vector Spherical Harmonics (VSH) decomposition up to the octupole order (l=3) for quasars. We find no statistically significant evidence for a CWs signal in the joint analysis ($\ln B_{joint} = -0.42 \pm 0.03$). In the absence of detection, we set the tightest constraints to date on CW strain in the pHz band, yielding a 95% upper limit of $h_0\le6.4x10^{-11}$ at a reference frequency of $f_{ref} = 4 \times 10^{-10}$ Hz. The combined dataset achieves full sky coverage and improves single-dataset upper limits by 20%-30%. Combining orthogonal observables successfully breaks spatial degeneracies intrinsic to isolated searches. Furthermore, forecasts from inj.-rec. indicate that with the extended temporal baseline and reduced uncertainties of the upcoming Gaia DR4, this joint framework is poised to break the $h_0 < 10^{-11}$ upper limit barrier for sub-nHz CWs.

classification.title_zh: 结合天体测量与脉冲星计时：首次对甚低频引力波的联合分析
classification.abstract_zh: pHz 至亚 nHz 的引力波频段在很大程度上仍未被探索，但它对于描绘超大质量双黑洞（SMBHB）早期旋进阶段和探测早期宇宙物理至关重要。天体测量与脉冲星计时提供了正交且高度互补的长期观测量，可用于研究该频段。我们旨在给出首次将真实天体测量自行与双脉冲星计时相结合的联合数据分析，以搜寻并限制由 SMBHB 产生的超低频连续引力波（CWs，10^{-12}≤f_GW≤10^{-9} Hz）。我们采用贝叶斯模型选择与上限估计框架，将 Gaia CRF3 星表中约 1.5×10^6 个类星体的视自行位移与 11 颗高精度双脉冲星的视线轨道周期导数（\dot{P}_b）结合起来。为防止虚假探测，我们大量建模仪器和天体物理系统误差：通过蒙特卡洛模拟传播脉冲星的银河系势不确定性，并对类星体进行直到八极阶（l=3）的矢量球谐（VSH）分解。我们在联合分析中未发现连续引力波信号的统计显著证据（ln B_joint=-0.42±0.03）。在未探测到信号的情况下，我们给出了迄今对 pHz 频段连续引力波应变的最严格限制，在参考频率 f_ref=4×10^{-10} Hz 处 95% 上限为 h_0≤6.4×10^{-11}。联合数据集实现了全天覆盖，并将单数据集上限改进了 20%-30%。结合正交观测量成功打破了单独搜寻中固有的空间简并。此外，注入-回收（inj.-rec.）预报表明，随着即将到来的 Gaia DR4 具有更长的时间基线和更小的不确定性，该联合框架有望突破亚 nHz 连续引力波的 h_0<10^{-11} 上限壁垒。
classification.one_liner: 首次联合 Gaia 类星体天体测量与脉冲星计时，在 pHz 波段未发现连续引力波并给出迄今最严格上限。

papers.title: A note on oscillons: non-negligible metric fluctuations during preheating
papers.abstract: The dominant lattice approach to post-inflationary preheating and oscillon formation evolves an inhomogeneous inflaton field on a spatially homogeneous Friedmann-Lema\^itre-Robertson-Walker background, whose expansion is sourced by a volume-averaged energy density, while metric perturbations are neglected. We examine the consistency of this approximation with General Relativity. Using the linearized Einstein constraints, we show that the suppression of the Bardeen potential, characteristic of slow-roll inflation, disappears during preheating: once the first slow-roll parameter becomes of order unity, the metric and inflaton fluctuations enter at the same perturbative order. We further show that the scalar-field equation evolved in the fixed-FLRW prescription omits leading-order contributions generated by metric fluctuations. We then derive the proper-volume average of the ADM Hamiltonian constraint and show that it does not reduce to the Friedmann equation used in lattice simulations: the exact averaged constraint contains additional contributions from the spatial curvature, the variance of the local expansion, the shear, and metric corrections to the local energy density. Finally, we illustrate numerically, for Starobinsky and $\alpha$-attractor models, that the metric contribution becomes comparable to the scalar-field contribution during the amplification stage. These results directly affect the standard lattice description of oscillon formation and motivate numerical relativity as a consistent framework for the nonlinear preheating problem.

classification.title_zh: 关于振荡子的注记：预加热期间不可忽略的度规涨落
classification.abstract_zh: 后暴胀预加热与振荡子形成的主流格点方法是在空间均匀的 Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker 背景上演化非均匀暴胀子场；该背景的膨胀由体积平均能量密度驱动，而度规微扰被忽略。我们检验该近似与广义相对论的一致性。利用线性化 Einstein 约束，我们表明，慢滚暴胀中 Bardeen 势被抑制的特征在预加热期间消失：一旦第一慢滚参数达到 1 的量级，度规与暴胀子涨落进入同一微扰阶。我们进一步表明，固定 FLRW 方案中演化的标量场方程遗漏了由度规涨落产生的领头阶贡献。随后我们推导 ADM Hamilton 约束的固有体积平均，并表明它并不约化为格点模拟中所用的 Friedmann 方程：精确平均约束包含来自空间曲率、局域膨胀的方差、剪切以及度规对局域能量密度修正的额外贡献。最后，我们针对 Starobinsky 和 α-attractor 模型数值展示，在放大阶段度规贡献与标量场贡献相当。这些结果直接影响振荡子形成的标准格点描述，并促使将数值相对论作为非线性预加热问题的一致框架。
classification.one_liner: 预加热/振荡子格点模拟若忽略度规涨落，会遗漏与标量场同阶的领头贡献，需用数值相对论处理。

papers.title: Rotating Neutron Star Migrations as a Standardized Test for 3+1 Numerical Relativity
papers.abstract: When simulating dynamically unstable neutron stars, truncation errors can introduce perturbations that drive the stellar configuration either toward gravitational collapse into a black hole or toward migration to a dynamically stable, lower-density configuration. This mechanism has become a standard benchmark for validating general-relativistic hydrodynamics codes in the case of spherically symmetric neutron-star models. In this work, we extend the analysis to the more general case of uniformly rotating neutron stars evolved in three spatial dimensions. We investigate these transitions using two equations of state: a cold polytrope and a hybrid prescription, which allow us to distinguish the barotropic response from the effects of shock-generated thermal pressure. We find that the migrated remnant remains close to uniform rotation after the transition, and we trace its quasi-radial pulsations through complementary diagnostics involving the central density, the rotation profile, and the axisymmetric gravitational-wave channel. We investigate the properties of these transitions and propose a standardized test for validating numerical-relativity codes by requiring the migration behavior to be consistent with the dynamics reported here.

classification.title_zh: 旋转中子星迁移作为3+1数值相对论的标准化检验
classification.abstract_zh: 在模拟动力学不稳定的中子星时，截断误差会引入扰动，促使星体构型要么引力坍缩成黑洞，要么迁移到动力学稳定的低密度构型。对于球对称中子星模型，这一机制已成为验证广义相对论流体力学代码的标准基准。在本工作中，我们将分析推广到在三维空间中演化的均匀旋转中子星这一更一般情形。我们使用两种状态方程研究这些转变：冷多方状态方程和混合状态方程方案，从而区分正压响应与激波产生的热压效应。我们发现迁移后的残余星体在转变后仍接近均匀旋转，并通过中心密度、旋转剖面和轴对称引力波通道等互补诊断追踪其准径向脉动。我们研究这些转变的性质，并提出一个标准化检验，要求迁移行为与本文报告的动力学一致，以用于验证数值相对论代码。
classification.one_liner: 将旋转中子星向稳定低密度态的迁移行为扩展为3+1数值相对论的标准化检验。

papers.title: Structure and astrophysical properties of dark energy admixed neutron stars
papers.abstract: The presence of a dark energy (DE) core, made of a Chaplygin dark fluid, is capable of influencing the diverse observable properties of neutron stars (NSs). However, there is also the possibility that NSs could contain a mixture of ordinary nuclear matter and DE. In this perspective, we propose an equation of state (EoS) that includes both normal matter and DE, where a free parameter $f$ quantifies the ratio of DE density with respect to the total energy density. As expected, in the limit $f \rightarrow 0$ we recover the already known results corresponding to pure nuclear matter. Remarkably, increasing this fraction $f$ leads to a softer EoS and thus strongly favors the fulfillment of the causality condition. As a consequence of our mass--radius results, the central compact object in HESS J1731-347 can be satisfactorily described as a DE admixed NS. For sufficiently high stellar masses, our calculations further indicate that both the gravitational redshift and the fundamental nonradial oscillation frequency increase significantly with an increasing DE fraction, whereas the opposite trend is observed for the total gravitational mass and tidal deformability. As is typical for compact stars composed purely of ordinary matter, we find that in our DE admixed stellar models the central density corresponding to the maximum-mass configuration coincides with the point at which the squared radial vibration frequency vanishes. Moreover, higher DE concentrations lead to enhanced stability of these configurations.

classification.title_zh: 暗能量混合中子星的结构与天体物理性质
classification.abstract_zh: 由 Chaplygin 暗流体构成的暗能量（DE）核心能够影响中子星（NSs）的各种可观测性质。然而，中子星也有可能包含普通核物质与暗能量的混合物。在此视角下，我们提出一个同时包含普通物质和暗能量的状态方程（EoS），其中自由参数 f 量化暗能量密度占总能量密度的比例。正如预期，在 f → 0 的极限下，我们恢复与纯核物质对应的已知结果。值得注意的是，增大该比例 f 会导致更软的状态方程，从而强烈有利于满足因果性条件。根据我们的质量—半径结果，HESS J1731-347 中的中心致密天体可以被满意地描述为一颗暗能量混合中子星。对于足够高的恒星质量，我们的计算进一步表明，随着暗能量比例增加，引力红移和基本非径向振荡频率都显著增大，而总引力质量和潮汐形变则呈现相反趋势。正如纯普通物质组成的致密星的典型情况，我们发现在我们的暗能量混合恒星模型中，最大质量构型对应的中心密度与径向振动频率平方消失的点重合。此外，更高的暗能量浓度导致这些构型稳定性增强。
classification.one_liner: 提出含 Chaplygin 暗流体的暗能量—核物质混合状态方程，计算中子星质量半径、潮汐形变与振荡性质，并讨论 HESS J1731-347 的暗能量混合中子星解释。

papers.title: Revisiting the Entangled Relativity gravity framework
papers.abstract: One revisits the Entangled Relativity theory framework, embedding it in a larger set of theories. From their scalar-tensor reformulation, these theories admit General Relativity spacetime solutions as solutions with the same matter content, if this matter obeys an "intrinsic decoupling" condition. One shows that a set of matter Lagrangians satisfying this condition is completely characterized by the way they depend on the metric tensor. One then shows that it is possible to define a perfect fluid Lagrangian fulfilling the intrinsic decoupling condition up to 1PN order. Specifying to weak field spherical stars suggests that Entangled Relativity and its proposed generalization are worthy alternatives to General Relativity. Indeed, the obtained numerical values of the Eddington parameters abruptly satisfy the known observational constraints. However, the non strict compliance of the theory with conservation laws demands to reconsider the link between observational data and the parameters for a definitive clarification of this point.

classification.title_zh: 重新审视纠缠相对论引力框架
classification.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视纠缠相对论理论框架，并将其嵌入一个更大的理论集合中。通过它们的标量-张量重构，这些理论在物质满足“内禀解耦”条件时，允许广义相对论时空解作为具有相同物质内容的解。文章表明，满足该条件的一组物质拉格朗日量完全由它们对度规张量的依赖方式刻画。随后表明，可以定义一个满足内禀解耦条件至1PN阶的理想流体拉格朗日量。具体到弱场球对称恒星，结果表明纠缠相对论及其提出的推广是广义相对论的有价值替代方案。事实上，所得到的Eddington参数数值突然满足已知观测约束。然而，该理论对守恒律的非严格遵循要求重新考虑观测数据与参数之间的联系，以最终澄清这一点。
classification.one_liner: 重新审视纠缠相对论，将其嵌入标量-张量理论集合，并研究弱场球对称恒星与Eddington参数观测约束。

papers.title: Non-Conservative Mechanics in the Compact-Body Mass-Shell Model and its Waveform Structuring
papers.abstract: A novel reinterpretation on the effective one-body (EOB) mapping of compact-body binary (CBB) coalescence was previously considered. Instead of the conventional ``marble in a funnel" description of EOB, CBB coalescence is modeled as the concurrent rotation and contraction of a hollow shell with a constant reduced mass measure. Merger is achieved, therefore, when the shell radius reaches the total mass radius. While past works analyzed the energetics sector of the model and the radiated gravitational waves (GWs), this work considers the geometric waveform modeling aspect. More specifically, we mature the mass-shell waveform analysis initially discussed with toy-model conditions by imposing necessary non-conservative mechanics, leading to the analytical expression of usable mass-shell modeled GW-forms. This is to set the foundation for eventual computational endeavors with the analytical waveforms presented here, enabling a comparison against current and state-of-the-art models.

classification.title_zh: 紧凑天体质量壳模型中的非保守力学及其波形结构
classification.abstract_zh: 此前曾考虑对紧凑双星并合的有效单体（EOB）映射作一种新解释。不同于传统 EOB 的“漏斗中的弹珠”描述，这里将紧凑双星并合建模为一个具有恒定约化质量测度的空心壳的同步旋转与收缩。因此，当壳半径达到总质量半径时并合发生。既往工作分析了该模型的能量部分以及辐射的引力波（GW），本工作考虑几何波形建模方面。更具体地，我们通过引入必要的非保守力学，使最初在玩具模型条件下讨论的质量壳波形分析趋于成熟，从而得到可用的质量壳建模引力波波形的解析表达式。这是为最终的计算工作奠定基础，以便将这里给出的解析波形与当前及最先进的模型进行比较。
classification.one_liner: 在紧凑双星并合的质量壳EOB模型中引入非保守力学，推导可用的解析引力波波形。

papers.title: Slowly Rotating Wormholes in f(R,T) Gravity: Particle Dynamics and Weak-field Lensing
papers.abstract: Among all gravitational solutions, traversable wormholes stand out as truly fascinating, yet within general relativity, they almost always demand exotic matter that necessarily violate null energy requirement. The inclusion of matter-geometry coupling in modified gravity theories provides a viable platform where wormholes remain open which are supported by effective gravitational field. We therefore examine the structure and properties of slowly rotating traversable wormholes using the $f(R,T)$ framework. We formulate stationary wormhole models coupled with the anisotropic fluid and show that they are regular, horizon-free, approach a flat spacetime geometry at large distances, and satisfy the flare-out requirement at the throat. Our results indicate that the required matter meets both the null and strong energy conditions, demonstrating that rotating wormholes do not necessarily require unconventional sources. We further study particle trajectories, frame dragging phenomena, and non-geodesic behavior resulting from matter-geometry coupling, alongside the weak-field and lensing effects caused by the rotation. Our results establish the potential astrophysical viability of rotating wormholes in $f(R,T)$ gravity.

classification.title_zh: f(R,T) 引力中的慢转虫洞：粒子动力学与弱场透镜效应
classification.abstract_zh: 在所有引力解中，可穿越虫洞尤为引人注目，但在广义相对论中，它们几乎总是需要违反零能量条件的奇异物质。在修改引力理论中引入物质-几何耦合，提供了一个可行平台，使虫洞可由有效引力场支撑而保持开放。因此，我们利用 f(R,T) 框架考察慢转可穿越虫洞的结构与性质。我们构建了与各向异性流体耦合的静态虫洞模型，并表明它们是正则的、无事件视界、在大距离上趋近平直时空几何，并在喉部满足 flare-out 要求。我们的结果表明，所需物质满足零能量条件和强能量条件，说明转动虫洞不一定需要非常规源。我们进一步研究了粒子轨迹、参考系拖曳现象、由物质-几何耦合导致的非测地行为，以及转动引起的弱场和透镜效应。我们的结果确立了 f(R,T) 引力中转动虫洞在天体物理上的潜在可行性。
classification.one_liner: 在 f(R,T) 引力中构建慢转可穿越虫洞，并分析其能量条件、粒子动力学与弱场透镜效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于经典引力/修改引力支线，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”直接相关；但不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或其他全息研究主题。

papers.title: Holographic Soliton Crystals for Dense Nuclear Matter and Neutron Stars
papers.abstract: We construct a nuclear-matter equation of state (EOS) from holographic QCD in the Witten-Sakai-Sugimoto (WSS) model, going beyond the homogeneous ansatz by building dense baryonic matter more directly from the solitonic description of holographic baryons. Employing the two-baryon interaction potential obtained from the linearized soliton tails sourced in the curved background by point-like (core) instantons, we assemble an infinite face-centered cubic (FCC) crystal with nearest neighbors in the most attractive channel as an approximation to the quantum liquid of baryons and compute the energy density $\mathcal{E}(n_B)$, the chemical potential $\mu_B$, and the pressure $P$. We calibrate the symmetric-matter EOS by fixing the 't Hooft coupling $\lambda$ and the WSS scale $M_{\rm KK}$ to saturation-density and onset-chemical-potential properties, and by including a quark-mass term to reproduce the physical pion mass $m_\pi=135\,\mathrm{MeV}$. This fit turns out to remain reasonably close to the parameters required by the vacuum meson sector, while their modification is consistent with Brown-Rho scaling in a dense medium, and the incompressibility at saturation is of the correct order of magnitude, both in clear contrast to the homogeneous approximation. We then extend to beta-equilibrated matter, using phenomenological input for the symmetry energy, and obtain hybrid EOS and neutron-star observables that are compatible with the NICER constraints.
