papers.title: Quasinormal modes of Schwarzschild--AdS black holes with a near-horizon reflective surface
papers.abstract: We investigate the scalar quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum of Schwarzschild-AdS black holes with a partially reflective surface placed near the event horizon. The corresponding QNM problem is solved numerically using Chebyshev spectral collocation. The resulting spectra exhibit a characteristic cavity structure at sufficiently large real part, where the modes form approximately equally spaced sequences whose spacing and damping are controlled mainly by the cavity length and the surface reflectivity. For large AdS radius, an additional weakly damped quasibound-state branch appears due to trapping between the centrifugal barrier and the AdS potential wall. We show that these spectral features can be understood within a finite radial cavity picture. A WKB analysis provides a quantitative asymptotic description of the spectra which have high real parts. We find that changes in the near-horizon boundary condition can lead to substantial changes in the QNM spectrum, indicating the strong sensitivity of Schwarzschild--AdS QNMs to the effect of horizon correction.

classification.title_zh: 具有近视界反射面的 Schwarzschild-AdS 黑洞的准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在事件视界附近放置部分反射面的 Schwarzschild-AdS 黑洞的标量准正规模（QNM）谱。相应的 QNM 问题用 Chebyshev 谱配置法数值求解。所得谱在实部足够大时呈现特征性的腔结构，其中模式形成近似等间距的序列，其间距和阻尼主要由腔长度和表面反射率控制。对于大 AdS 半径，由于离心势垒与 AdS 势墙之间的囚禁，会出现额外的弱阻尼准束缚态分支。我们表明这些谱特征可以在有限径向腔图像中理解。WKB 分析对具有高实部的谱给出了定量渐近描述。我们发现近视界边界条件的改变可导致 QNM 谱的显著变化，表明 Schwarzschild-AdS QNM 对视界修正效应具有强敏感性。
classification.one_liner: 该文数值计算带近视界部分反射面的 Schwarzschild-AdS 黑洞标量准正规模，发现由径向腔控制的近似等间距模式及对近边界条件高度敏感的谱。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究黑洞准正规模，属于 QNM 与经典引力/广义相对论支线；但摘要未涉及全息对偶、量子信息或纠缠等主题。

papers.title: Extending the Love-Q Relation to Rapidly Rotating Neutron Stars for Gravitational-Waveform Modelling
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave observations of binary neutron star mergers probe the neutron star equation of state through finite-size effects on the waveform. These include the tidal deformation of the stars due to their respective companion, but for spinning neutron stars also include the spin-induced quadrupole moment of the stars. Typically, to avoid introducing additional equation of state dependent parameters, waveform models relate this quadrupole moment to the tidal deformability through so-called quasi-universal relations. These are derived under the slow-rotation approximation, which at larger spins, i.e., for millisecond pulsars, becomes unreliable. We attempt to extend the existing quasi-universal relations by explicitly accounting for the spin, calibrating it against numerically computed quadrupole moments across a broad set of equations of state and spins $0.15 \leq |\chi| \leq 0.6$ with the $\chi\rightarrow 0$ limit enforced by construction. The resulting spin-extended relation reduces the median absolute percentage error relative to the slow-rotation relation by 66\% across this range. Parameter estimation using the spin-extended relation reduces biases in recovered intrinsic parameters in some cases, though biases from mass-spin degeneracies dominate largely when a population is considered. These results provide a more accurate description of the spin-induced quadrupole moment for spinning neutron star binaries, relevant for waveform modelling with third-generation gravitational-wave detectors.

classification.title_zh: 将 Love-Q 关系推广到快速旋转中子星以用于引力波波形建模
classification.abstract_zh: 双中子星并合的引力波观测通过波形中的有限尺寸效应探测中子星物态方程。这些效应包括双星相互潮汐形变，对于旋转中子星还包括自旋诱导的四极矩。通常为避免引入额外依赖物态方程的参数，波形模型通过所谓准普适关系将该四极矩与潮汐形变联系起来。这些关系在慢转近似下导出，在较大自旋（如毫秒脉冲星）下变得不可靠。我们尝试通过显式考虑自旋来扩展已有准普适关系，在一系列物态方程和自旋 0.15≤|χ|≤0.6 范围内用数值计算的四极矩进行校准，并通过构造强制 χ→0 极限。所得自旋扩展关系在该范围内将相对于慢转关系的中位绝对百分比误差降低 66%。使用自旋扩展关系进行参数估计在某些情形下减小了恢复内禀参数的偏差，不过考虑族群时，质量-自旋简并导致的偏差在很大程度上占主导。这些结果为旋转中子星双星的自旋诱导四极矩提供了更准确描述，适用于第三代引力波探测器的波形建模。
classification.one_liner: 将 Love-Q 准普适关系显式扩展至快转中子星，提高自旋诱导四极矩描述精度，用于引力波波形建模。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于广义相对论/经典引力与引力波波形建模，涉及中子星自旋诱导四极矩和准普适关系；与用户经典引力/广义相对论重点标签直接相关，但与全息研究无关。

papers.title: Relativistic Stellar Oscillations from Ultralight Dark Matter
papers.abstract: Ultra-light dark matter, composed of bosons behaving as classical waves, can resonantly excite stellar oscillations. In this work, we investigate this phenomenon in relativistic stars, showing that $\ell=0$ fluid modes can be excited. We derive a framework for calculating the mode amplitude and apply it to neutron stars to predict the associated surface temperature fluctuations; the resulting signal lies beyond current observational sensitivities. We discuss prospects for extending this approach to other compact objects.

classification.title_zh: 超轻暗物质引起的相对论性恒星振荡
classification.abstract_zh: 由表现为经典波的玻色子组成的超轻暗物质，能够共振激发恒星振荡。在这项工作中，我们在相对论性恒星中研究这一现象，表明可以激发 ℓ=0 流体模式。我们推导了一个计算模式振幅的框架，并将其应用于中子星，以预测相关的表面温度涨落；所得信号超出当前观测灵敏度。我们讨论了将该方法推广到其他致密天体的前景。
classification.one_liner: 超轻暗物质可共振激发相对论性恒星的 ℓ=0 流体模式，文中以中子星估算表面温度涨落，但信号尚不可观测。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究相对论性恒星与中子星的振荡及其观测信号，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

papers.title: On Stochastic Memory Backgrounds In LISA
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave (GW) memory is a permanent change in spacetime geometry induced by a burst of gravitational waves. It is theoretically interesting for its connection to asymptotic symmetries, but has not yet been observed. The upcoming Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) is predicted to detect memory directly in loud events from supermassive black hole (SMBH) mergers. We assess the prospects for the cumulative effect of memory contributions as a stochastic GW memory background (SGWMB). Using two SMBH population models, we recover previously obtained single-event SNR forecasts and compute the power spectrum of the unresolved background, using numerical-relativity waveforms for modeling the memory signal during each event. We find the predicted spectrum is significantly smaller than ones found by modeling the memory waveform with a Heaviside function, with expected SNRs of order $O(0.1-10)$. We further find that our models favor a highly non-Gaussian ("popcorn") spectrum, demonstrating that the background may not appear as the union of continuous, overlapping signals, but rather as a collection of intermittent bursts. In both measures, we demonstrate that any current prediction of the spectrum is heavily dependent on the choice of population model. We interpret these findings in the light of the future LISA mission and emphasize their importance for properly handling memory within the LISA global fit.

classification.title_zh: 论 LISA 中的随机记忆背景
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波记忆是由一列引力波爆发引起的时空几何的永久改变。它在理论上因与渐近对称性的联系而有趣，但尚未被观测到。即将到来的激光干涉空间天线（LISA）被预测能在来自超大质量黑洞（SMBH）并合的响亮事件中直接探测到记忆。我们评估记忆贡献的累积效应作为随机引力波记忆背景（SGWMB）的前景。使用两个 SMBH 族群模型，我们复现了先前得到的单事件信噪比预测，并计算未分辨背景的功率谱，使用数值相对论波形来建模每个事件期间的记忆信号。我们发现预测谱显著小于用 Heaviside 函数建模记忆波形所得到的谱，预期信噪比量级为 O(0.1-10)。我们进一步发现我们的模型倾向于一个高度非高斯的（“爆米花”）谱，表明该背景可能不会表现为连续、重叠信号的并集，而是一系列间歇性爆发。在这两项度量中，我们证明当前任何谱预测都严重依赖于族群模型的选择。我们结合未来 LISA 任务解释这些发现，并强调它们对于在 LISA 全局拟合中正确处理记忆的重要性。
classification.one_liner: 使用数值相对论波形和两种超大质量黑洞族群模型评估 LISA 中随机引力波记忆背景，发现其功率谱依赖族群模型且呈高度非高斯间歇爆发特征。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力波方向，涉及 LISA 对引力波记忆随机背景的预测，符合“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶或 AdS/CFT。

papers.title: Deep Learning Detection of Beyond-General-Relativity Deviations in Gravitational-Wave Signals: A Detection-Threshold Study with Real LIGO Noise
papers.abstract: We study machine-learning detection of controlled beyond-General-Relativity (beyond-GR) deviations in gravitational-wave signals, using both synthetic aLIGO-PSD noise and real LIGO H1 detector strain. Three deviation families are applied to General-Relativistic inspiral-merger-ringdown waveforms: amplitude modulation, phase modulation, and frequency modulation, each parameterized by a dimensionless strength coefficient $\beta$. A hybrid classifier combining a one-dimensional convolutional neural network with ten hand-crafted waveform statistics is trained on GR and modified waveforms and tested on a deviation type excluded from training. The central result is a quantitative detectability curve as a function of $\beta$. Using the real GW150914 strain as a template and real H1 detector noise, we find a detection threshold at $\beta \approx 0.25$, with accuracy rising smoothly from chance at $\beta \leq 0.2$ to perfect classification at $\beta \geq 0.5$. The threshold value is specific to the quadratic-in-time modulation form adopted here and should not be interpreted as a generic constraint on beyond-GR parameters. We nevertheless argue that the negative result at small $\beta$ is informative: it establishes a quantitative limit on machine-learning-only beyond-GR searches in real detector noise, in the absence of matched-filter signal extraction.

classification.title_zh: 深度学习检测引力波信号中超越广义相对论的偏差：基于真实LIGO噪声的探测阈值研究
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用合成aLIGO-PSD噪声和真实LIGO H1探测器应变，研究机器学习对引力波信号中受控超越广义相对论偏差的检测能力。将三种偏差族（振幅调制、相位调制、频率调制）施加到广义相对论旋近-并合-铃宕波形上，每种偏差由无量纲强度系数β参数化。一个结合一维卷积神经网络与十个手工波形统计量的混合分类器在GR与修改波形上训练，并在训练中排除的一类偏差上测试。核心结果是作为β函数的定量可探测性曲线。以真实GW150914应变为模板、真实H1探测器噪声，我们发现探测阈值约为β≈0.25，准确率从β≤0.2时的随机水平平滑上升到β≥0.5时的完美分类。该阈值特定于本文采用的时间二次调制形式，不应被解释为对超越GR参数的通用限制。尽管如此，我们认为小β下的负面结果具有信息量：它确立了在缺乏匹配滤波信号提取时，仅靠机器学习的超越GR搜索在真实探测器噪声中的定量极限。
classification.one_liner: 用真实LIGO噪声评估深度学习对三类超越GR引力波调制的探测阈值，阈值约β≈0.25且依赖具体调制形式。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论中的引力波检验与数据分析，直接匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”。

papers.title: Schwarzschild solution from a Raychaudhuri-Huygens relation
papers.abstract: Null-congruences encode the causal structure of spacetime, describing a phase space of radiation channels, whose expansion scalar $\theta$ satisfies the Raychaudhuri equation. In spherical symmetry, the expansion scalar of wave fronts of area $A=4\pi r^2$ satisfies $\theta = A^\prime/A = 2/r$. About a mass $M$, this carries an encoding area $A_E = \lambda \varphi \ell_p^2 = \lambda R_g r \le A$ in a UV-IR consistent coupling $\ell_p^2= G\hbar/c^3$ to its Compton phase $\varphi = (mc/\hbar)r \propto 1/\hbar$. Here, $\lambda = 8\pi $ is fixed by the Newtonian limit at large distances and the saturation limit $A_E=A$ at horizon about $M$ based on the non-local extension of the equivalence principle in Rindler spacetime, without using the Einstein equations. In spherical symmetry, this recovers the Schwarzschild metric from a geometric embedding of $p=A_E/A$, which is directly observable in gravitational lensing. The result shows a non-thermal origin of the scaling dimension of two of gravitational phase space, previously derived based on the second law of thermodynamics by Bekenstein (1973), with possible implications for cosmological spacetime.
authors: Maurice H. P. M. van Putten

classification.title_zh: 从 Raychaudhuri-Huygens 关系导出 Schwarzschild 解
classification.abstract_zh: 零测地线汇编码时空的因果结构，描述辐射通道的相空间，其膨胀标量 θ 满足 Raychaudhuri 方程。在球对称下，面积为 A=4πr² 的波前膨胀标量满足 θ = A'/A = 2/r。围绕质量 M，这携带一个编码面积 A_E = λφℓ_p² = λR_g r ≤ A，处于 UV-IR 一致耦合 ℓ_p² = Gℏ/c³ 与其 Compton 相位 φ = (mc/ℏ)r ∝ 1/ℏ 中。这里 λ=8π 由大距离牛顿极限以及基于 Rindler 时空中等价原理非局域延拓的、围绕 M 的视界处饱和极限 A_E=A 固定，而不使用 Einstein 方程。在球对称下，这从 p=A_E/A 的几何嵌入恢复 Schwarzschild 度规，该嵌入可直接在引力透镜中观测。结果表明引力相空间中两个自由度的标度维数的非热起源，此前 Bekenstein (1973) 基于热力学第二定律导出，并可能对宇宙学时空有启示。
classification.one_liner: 在球对称下，利用 Raychaudhuri 方程与编码面积关系，无需 Einstein 方程即可恢复 Schwarzschild 度规。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，直接从 Raychaudhuri 方程与编码面积恢复 Schwarzschild 度规，并使用“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签。

papers.title: Timelike ideal boundary of non-positively curved Lorentzian spaces
papers.abstract: We introduce the notion of timelike ideal boundary of a Lorentzian length space as the set of asymptotic classes of future or past-directed timelike geodesic rays, a construction complementary to the causal boundary in the sense of Geroch-Kronheimer-Penrose and akin to the concept of ideal boundary of a metric space. We endow such a timelike ideal boundary with a natural cone topology and an angular metric, and establish upper curvature bounds for the resulting metric space. Finally, we consider generalized cones as a model and study the relation between the timelike ideal boundary and both the metric ideal boundary of the fiber and the asymptotic behaviour of the warping function.

classification.title_zh: 非正曲率洛伦兹空间的类时理想边界
classification.abstract_zh: 我们引入洛伦兹长度空间的类时理想边界概念，即未来或过去指向类时测地射线的渐近类集合；这一构造在 Geroch-Kronheimer-Penrose 意义下与因果边界互补，并类似于度量空间的理想边界。我们为该类时理想边界赋予自然的锥拓扑和角度量，并为所得度量空间建立曲率上界。最后，我们以广义锥为模型，研究类时理想边界与纤维的度量理想边界以及翘曲函数渐近行为之间的关系。
classification.one_liner: 定义洛伦兹长度空间的类时理想边界，赋予锥拓扑与角度量并证明曲率上界，并以广义锥联系纤维理想边界与翘曲函数渐近行为。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于洛伦兹几何/因果边界构造，不涉及全息对偶、AdS/CFT或量子引力；仅可作为经典洛伦兹时空几何的背景，与所列全息重点支线关联弱。

papers.title: Horizon--orbit scale competition underlying chaos bound violation for spinning particles
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the chaos bound through the local radial instability of charged spinning test particles on unstable circular orbits in the black-bounce--Kerr--Newman spacetime. Our results show that violation of the bound is governed by the competition between the local orbital-instability scale and the surface gravity scale, with variations of the black hole background and the particle dynamics providing two complementary routes to the same threshold crossing. Background variations affect both scales and can drive the system into the bound-violating regime when the surface gravity is suppressed more strongly than the orbital instability. At fixed background, by contrast, the surface gravity remains unchanged, and the transition across the threshold is driven by changes in the unstable orbit dynamics induced by the particle parameters. The background-controlled and probe-dynamics-controlled routes therefore represent two realizations of a unified horizon--orbit scale competition rather than independent mechanisms.

classification.title_zh: 自旋粒子混沌界破坏背后的视界-轨道尺度竞争
classification.abstract_zh: 本文通过在 black-bounce--Kerr--Newman 时空中，带电自旋试验粒子在不稳定圆轨道上的局域径向不稳定性，来研究混沌界。我们的结果表明，混沌界的破坏由局域轨道不稳定性尺度与表面重力尺度之间的竞争所支配；黑洞背景的变化和粒子动力学的变化提供了两条通往同一阈值跨越的互补途径。背景变化会影响两个尺度，并且当表面重力比轨道不稳定性受到更强抑制时，可驱动系统进入破坏混沌界的区域。相比之下，在固定背景下，表面重力保持不变，跨越阈值的转变由粒子参数引起的不稳定轨道动力学变化所驱动。因此，背景控制路径和探针动力学控制路径是统一的视界—轨道尺度竞争的两种实现，而不是彼此独立的机制。
classification.one_liner: 在黑反弹-Kerr-Newman 时空中，带电自旋试验粒子的混沌界破坏由视界表面重力与轨道不稳定性尺度的竞争控制。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究黑洞时空中的试验粒子轨道稳定性与混沌界破坏，属于经典引力/广义相对论；未使用 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶，故全息相关性低，但匹配经典引力重点标签。

papers.title: Stationary generalizations for the vacuum ring wormhole
papers.abstract: The ring wormhole is the zero-mass limit of the Kerr metric. Its geometry is locally flat, but the topology is nontrivial, with a throat connecting two asymptotic regions and a distributional curvature singularity on the ring encircling the throat. We construct stationary generalizations of this static wormhole that are different from Kerr and invariant under reflections across the wormhole throat. The problem reduces to solving the vacuum Ernst equations subject to the corresponding symmetry conditions. The slowly rotating perturbative solutions were constructed previously, while we now present a detailed analysis of non-perturbative solutions obtained within a numerical framework. For slow rotation, they exhibit the non-relativistic relation $M\sim J^2$ between the mass and angular momentum, which transforms into the Regge relation $J=M^2$ in the fast-rotation regime, when $J\to\infty$ and the ring is stretched without bound by the centrifugal force. However, if the ring size in the static limit is sent to zero at the same time, then $M$ and $J$ remain bounded as the throat linear velocity approaches unity. The wormhole geometry then approaches the extremal Kerr solution, thus ``mimicking'' it. The wormholes carry a curvature singularity at the ring, but this can be removed by via simple ``scalarization'' procedure that promotes the vacuum solutions to regular wormholes with a phantom scalar field.

classification.title_zh: 真空环状虫洞的定态推广
classification.abstract_zh: 环状虫洞是 Kerr 度规的零质量极限。其几何局部平坦，但拓扑非平凡，喉部连接两个渐近区域，环绕喉部的环上存在分布曲率奇点。我们构造了该静态虫洞的定态推广，它们不同于 Kerr，并且在跨虫洞喉部的反射下不变。问题约化为在相应对称条件下求解真空 Ernst 方程。此前已构造慢转微扰解，现在我们详细分析在数值框架下得到的非微扰解。对于慢转，它们表现出质量与角动量之间的非相对论关系 M∼J^2；在快转区域，当 J→∞ 且环被离心力无界拉伸时，该关系转变为 Regge 关系 J=M^2。然而，如果同时令静态极限中的环尺寸趋于零，则当喉部线速度趋近于 1 时，M 和 J 保持有界。虫洞几何随后趋近于极端 Kerr 解，从而“模仿”它。这些虫洞在环上带有曲率奇点，但可以通过简单的“标量化”程序消除，该程序将真空解提升为带有幻影标量场的规则虫洞。
classification.one_liner: 构造真空环状虫洞的定态、反射对称推广，数值求解 Ernst 方程，发现慢转 M∼J^2 过渡到快转 Regge 关系 J=M^2，并可通过标量化消除环奇点。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究真空环状虫洞的定态推广、Ernst 方程数值解与标量化，属于经典广义相对论/引力，直接对应重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”。

papers.title: Relativistic elastic shells: material support and cavity geometry
papers.abstract: We derive the source moments that determine the leading tidal field and rotational clock shift inside a finite-thickness relativistic elastic shell. In weak gravity and slow rotation, these moments depend on the elastic response of the material and its two free vacuum faces. Two choices of elastic moduli, each causal near relaxation, give opposite signs for both observables. Both shells have oblate faces and gain rotational mass. The tide depends on differential flattening, bulk deformation, and rotational stress and energy; the central clock shift measures a distinct inverse-radius moment. A single constitutive action determines the material support and response. Nonnegative isotropic pressure cannot support a static spherical shell of positive-density matter with two free vacuum faces, whereas tangential elastic stress admits equilibria near relaxation. For sufficiently weak gravity these equilibria obey the dominant energy condition and have subluminal sound speeds. Their static cavities are locally flat, with clocks redshifted relative to infinity. At leading weak-gravity order, static redshift and linear frame dragging probe the same inverse-radius mass moment. Energy estimates establish radial linear stability and exclude exponentially growing odd-parity modes for weakly gravitating spherical equilibria. Nonlinear compression can nevertheless produce unbounded gradients while the material remains causal. Nonspherical even-parity and rotating stability, together with quantitative bounds at finite rotation, remain open. The cavity observables distinguish material responses that surface shape and total mass alone do not determine.

classification.title_zh: 相对论弹性壳：材料支撑与空腔几何
classification.abstract_zh: 我们推导决定有限厚度相对论弹性壳内部领头潮汐场和转动钟移的源矩。在弱引力和慢转动下，这些矩依赖于材料的弹性响应及其两个自由真空表面。两种弹性模量选择各自在弛豫附近保持因果，并对两个可观测量给出相反的符号。两种壳的面均呈扁椭球状并获得转动质量。潮汐依赖于差分扁率、体形变以及转动应力和能量；中心钟移测量一个不同的反半径矩。单一本构作用量决定材料支撑与响应。非负各向同性压强不能支撑具有两个自由真空表面的正密度物质静态球壳，而切向弹性应力允许在弛豫附近存在平衡态。对于足够弱的引力，这些平衡态满足主能量条件且声速亚光速。它们的静态空腔局部平坦，时钟相对于无穷远红移。在领头弱引力阶，静态红移和线性参考系拖曳探测同一个反半径质量矩。能量估计确立了径向线性稳定性，并排除了弱引力球对称平衡态的指数增长奇宇称模式。然而，非线性压缩仍可产生无界梯度，而材料保持因果。非球对称偶宇称稳定性、转动稳定性以及在有限转动下的定量界限仍然开放。空腔可观测量能够区分仅靠表面形状和总质量无法确定的材料响应。
classification.one_liner: 推导有限厚度相对论弹性壳内的领头潮汐场与转动钟移，并研究弹性支撑、空腔红移/参考系拖曳及稳定性。

papers.title: Lattice simulations of scalar-induced gravitational waves from inflation
papers.abstract: Scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) provide a powerful probe of inflationary dynamics on scales far smaller than those accessible to the cosmic microwave background and large-scale structure. In scenarios with a transient ultra-slow-roll (USR) phase, the curvature power spectrum can be strongly enhanced on small scales, potentially generating an observable stochastic GW background. In this regime, scalar dynamics during inflation can become nonlinear, challenging the validity of standard perturbative predictions. Existing semi-analytical calculations of SIGWs rely on the linear evolution of inflation fluctuations. In this work, we compute SIGWs from USR inflation using lattice simulations. We evolve the inflaton field nonlinearly during inflation and extract the curvature perturbation nonperturbatively, then simulate its post-reheating horizon re-entry by evolving the Newtonian potential linearly while retaining the full non-Gaussian structure of the initial conditions for the primordial fluctuations in the tensor source. For moderate non-Gaussianity, the semi-analytical prediction captures the correct order of magnitude of the GW signal but receives important corrections. When inflationary non-Gaussianities are large, it can fail dramatically in both amplitude and spectral shape, independently of the overall size of the tensor power spectrum. Our results show that reliable predictions of SIGWs in such scenarios require nonperturbative control of the inflationary scalar dynamics. The code used for this work is available at https://github.com/caravangelo/inflation-easy.git.

classification.title_zh: 暴胀中标量诱导引力波的格点模拟
classification.abstract_zh: 标量诱导引力波（SIGWs）为探测远比宇宙微波背景和大尺度结构所及尺度更小的暴胀动力学提供了有力探针。在具有瞬态超慢滚（USR）阶段的场景中，曲率功率谱可在小尺度上被强烈增强，从而可能产生可观测的随机引力波背景。在此机制下，暴胀期间的标量动力学可能变得非线性，挑战标准微扰预测的有效性。现有 SIGWs 的半解析计算依赖于暴胀扰动的线性演化。在本工作中，我们使用格点模拟计算来自 USR 暴胀的 SIGWs。我们在暴胀期间非线性地演化暴胀子场，并非微扰地提取曲率扰动，然后通过线性演化牛顿势来模拟其在再加热后重新进入视界的过程，同时在张量源中保留原初涨落初始条件的完整非高斯结构。对于中等非高斯性，半解析预测能抓住引力波信号的正确数量级，但会得到重要修正。当暴胀非高斯性很大时，无论张量功率谱的整体幅度如何，它都可能在幅度和谱形状上严重失效。我们的结果表明，在此类场景中可靠预测 SIGWs 需要对暴胀标量动力学进行非微扰控制。本工作所用代码见 https://github.com/caravangelo/inflation-easy.git。
classification.one_liner: 格点模拟显示，USR 暴胀的非线性标量动力学会显著修正甚至破坏标量诱导引力波的半解析预测。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于暴胀宇宙学与标量诱导引力波，涉及经典引力波/宇宙学扰动；与全息对偶、AdS/CFT 或量子引力无直接关系，但可归入经典引力/广义相对论相关关注。

papers.title: Turbulent gravitational wakes
papers.abstract: We construct turbulent gravitational wakes in asymptotically AdS$_4$ spacetimes by solving the full non-linear Einstein equations in the characteristic formulation. Specifically, we show that a localized boundary deformation acting on a boosted black brane generates a wake whose boundary dynamics exhibit the formation of coherent vortical structures that are advected downstream by the background flow. Analysing a wake propagating along the x direction, we show that it displays the characteristic self-similar scaling of classical turbulent wakes. We then identify the geometric imprint of the wake on the horizon area density, the traceless horizon extrinsic curvature, and bulk metric perturbations, finding coherent structures that extend from the asymptotic boundary to the horizon. These results provide the first study of turbulent gravitational wakes in four-dimensional asymptotically AdS spacetimes.

classification.title_zh: 湍流引力尾迹
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在渐近 AdS4 时空中通过特征形式求解完整非线性爱因斯坦方程，构造了湍流引力尾迹。具体而言，我们表明作用于一个被推进的黑膜上的局域边界形变会产生一个尾迹，其边界动力学表现出相干涡旋结构的形成，这些结构被背景流向下游输运。分析沿 x 方向传播的尾迹，我们表明它显示出经典湍流尾迹的特征自相似标度。然后我们在视界面积密度、无迹视界外曲率和体度规扰动中识别出尾迹的几何印记，发现从渐近边界延伸到视界的相干结构。这些结果提供了四维渐近 AdS 时空中湍流引力尾迹的首次研究。
classification.one_liner: 在渐近AdS4中通过求解非线性Einstein方程构造湍流引力尾迹，发现边界动力学中的相干涡旋与自相似标度，并追踪其视界和体度规几何印记。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文在渐近AdS4中求解非线性Einstein方程，研究经典引力湍流尾迹、相干涡旋和视界几何印记，直接对应经典引力/广义相对论、非平衡演化及涡旋/非均匀结构等用户重点支线。

papers.title: String charge density/bit threads correspondence and its S-duality in type IIB supergravity
papers.abstract: We identify the spatial projection of a conserved string charge density with a bit-thread flow. This correspondence gives bit threads a string worldsheet description and allows us to compute black hole entropy from the maximal entropy flux of a worldsheet-derived current. We first reproduce the BTZ entropy and then extend the construction to the ten-dimensional F1-NS5-P and D1-D5-P systems. Under Type IIB S-duality, the F1 current maps to the D1 current. Although the local currents, metrics, and flow norms change, the maximal physical flux remains unchanged and gives the same entropy. This provides a nontrivial check of the correspondence. Finally, we propose a D1-D5 boundary-matching conjecture. In the coarse-grained picture, each string-charge line defines an entropy-carrying tube. The boundary CFT entanglement entropy and the bulk black hole entropy both fix the product of the number of tubes and the maximum entropy carried by each tube. For a fixed tube discretization, they assign the same capacity to each tube. They therefore describe the same conserved maximal entropy flux, providing an information-flow interpretation of the equality between entanglement entropy and black hole entropy.

classification.title_zh: 弦电荷密度/比特线程对应及其在 IIB 型超引力中的 S-对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们识别出守恒弦电荷密度的空间投影与比特线程流。该对应赋予比特线程一种弦世界面描述，并允许我们从由世界面导出的流的最大熵通量计算黑洞熵。我们首先重现 BTZ 熵，然后将该构造推广到十维 F1-NS5-P 和 D1-D5-P 系统。在 IIB 型 S-对偶下，F1 流映射为 D1 流。尽管局域流、度规和流范数发生变化，最大物理通量保持不变并给出相同熵。这为该对应提供了非平凡检验。最后，我们提出一个 D1-D5 边界匹配猜想。在粗粒化图像中，每根弦电荷线定义一根携带熵的管。边界 CFT 纠缠熵和体黑洞熵都固定了管数与每根管携带的最大熵的乘积。对固定管离散化，它们给每根管分配相同容量。因此，它们描述相同的守恒最大熵通量，为纠缠熵与黑洞熵相等提供了信息流解释。
classification.one_liner: 通过将守恒弦电荷密度的空间投影对应为比特线程流，该文从世界面最大熵通量重现 BTZ 及十维 D-brane 系统黑洞熵，并用 IIB S-对偶提出 D1-D5 边界匹配猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 核心属于全息纠缠/量子信息与黑洞熵，未直接匹配所列重点标签；与 D-brane 系统有间接关联，故为 medium。

papers.title: Thermodynamics of Lorentzian Taub-NUT spacetimes in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS gravity
papers.abstract: We study the thermodynamics of Lorentzian Taub--NUT spacetimes in Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet AdS gravity in arbitrary even dimensions, constructed as $U(1)$ fibrations over Einstein--K\"ahler base manifolds. We compute the temperature from the surface gravity and the energy as the conserved charge associated with the stationary Killing vector using the off-shell Abbott--Deser--Tekin formalism. Within the same framework, we obtain the entropy as a horizon Noether charge. The result agrees with the Iyer--Wald formula and includes a Gauss--Bonnet correction to the Bekenstein--Hawking area law. Retaining the Misner strings whenever present, we formulate a first law of full cohomogeneity in which the NUT parameter varies independently of the horizon radius. This requires an additional thermodynamic charge and its conjugate potential, which we determine explicitly. We also briefly discuss the static limit.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS 引力中洛伦兹 Taub-NUT 时空的热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究任意偶数维 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS 引力中洛伦兹 Taub-NUT 时空的热力学，这些时空构造为 Einstein-Kähler 底流形上的 U(1) 纤维丛。我们由表面引力计算温度，并使用 off-shell Abbott-Deser-Tekin 形式，将能量取为与稳态 Killing 矢量相关的守恒荷。在同一框架内，我们将熵作为视界 Noether 荷获得。结果与 Iyer-Wald 公式一致，并包含对 Bekenstein-Hawking 面积律的 Gauss-Bonnet 修正。在 Misner 弦出现时保留它们，我们建立了具有完全同质性的第一定律，其中 NUT 参数独立于视界半径变化。这需要额外的热力学荷及其共轭势，我们明确确定它们。我们还简要讨论了静态极限。
classification.one_liner: 在任意偶数维 EGB AdS 引力中，用 ADT/Iyer-Wald 形式研究洛伦兹 Taub-NUT 时空热力学，并给出包含 NUT 荷与 Misner 弦贡献的第一定律。

papers.title: Tachyonic (In)stability in Randall-Sundrum Braneworld Scenarios
papers.abstract: Low-energy effective theories provide a natural description of four-dimensional physics in higher-dimensional geometries, where the imprint of the bulk geometry appears as parameters of the lower-dimensional theory. Inspired by the Damour-Esposito-Far\'ese (DEF) model of spontaneous scalarization in first generation Scalar-Tensor theories of gravity, we investigate the possibility of tachyonic instability and spontaneous scalarization in braneworld scenarios. We consider the two-brane Randall-Sundrum model where the low-energy effective theory on either brane is of scalar-tensor nature with the extra-dimensional radion playing the role of the scalar. We have determined the possibilities for tachyonic (in)stability of the radion field on either brane in three scenarios: the Randall-Sundrum (RS) model with fine-tuning conditions in which the potential of the radion field vanishes identically, the RS model without fine-tunings where the radion potential arises purely from the gravity sector and the RS model with a bulk stabilizing field that generates a radion potential with a minimum. With the bulk stabilizing field, we have found that on-brane matter with $T>0$ changes the VEV of the radion, destroying the resolution of the gauge hierarchy problem, whereas on-brane matter with $T<0$ does not alter the stability and VEV of the radion. We further determined the exact condition of tachyonic (in)stability of radion field with the on-brane dS$_4$ and AdS$_4$ geometries.

classification.title_zh: Randall-Sundrum 膜世界场景中的快子（不）稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 低能有效理论为高维几何中的四维物理提供自然描述，其中体几何的印记表现为低维理论的参数。受第一代标量-张量引力中 Damour-Esposito-Farèse (DEF) 自发标量化模型启发，我们研究膜世界场景中快子不稳定与自发标量化的可能性。我们考虑双膜 Randall-Sundrum 模型，其中任一膜上的低能有效理论具有标量-张量性质，额外维 radion 扮演标量角色。我们在三种情形下确定了任一膜上 radion 场快子（不）稳定性的可能性：具有精细调节条件因而 radion 势恒为零的 RS 模型；无精细调节且 radion 势完全来自引力部分的 RS 模型；以及具有体稳定化场、产生带有极小值 radion 势的 RS 模型。对于含体稳定化场情形，我们发现膜上 T>0 的物质会改变 radion 的 VEV，破坏规范层级问题的解决，而膜上 T<0 的物质不改变 radion 的稳定性与 VEV。我们进一步确定了膜上 dS4 与 AdS4 几何下 radion 场快子（不）稳定性的精确条件。
classification.one_liner: 研究双膜 Randall-Sundrum 膜世界中 radion 的快子不稳定与自发标量化条件。

papers.title: Holographic Krylov Complexity for Charged, Composite and Extended Probes
papers.abstract: We study the holographic spread/Krylov complexity of operators with non-trivial internal structure and of genuinely extended operators. We first consider a massive particle in AdS$_5\times S^5$ carrying conserved $R$-charge, and show how motion in the internal space modifies the complexity growth, yielding a natural holographic realisation of symmetry-resolved Krylov complexity. We then move to probes that are effectively pointlike from the field-theory viewpoint but possess an intrinsic structure in the bulk: baryon-vertex configurations and giant gravitons. Our results indicate that, for this broad class of structured but pointlike probes, the leading large-time behaviour retains the characteristic form expected for local operators in conformal theories, while the internal structure and induced charges produce informative subleading effects. We also study a genuinely extended probe, a fundamental string falling in AdS while stretched along a spatial direction, as a model for the spread complexity of a non-local operator. In this case, although the leading behaviour still exhibits the expected growth pattern, the subleading terms and intermediate regimes differ qualitatively from those of pointlike probes. This provides concrete evidence that extended operators carry a finer notion of spread complexity, sensitive to their spatial structure. Our results broaden the class of probes for which holographic Krylov complexity can be analysed explicitly, clarify which features are universal and which depend on the nature of the operator, and open a promising route toward a sharper field-theory understanding of complexity for charged, composite and extended excitations.

classification.title_zh: 带电、复合与延展探针的全息Krylov复杂度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有非平凡内部结构的算符以及真正延展算符的全息展开/Krylov复杂度。首先考虑在 AdS5×S5 中携带守恒 R-荷的大质量粒子，并展示内部空间运动如何改变复杂度增长，从而给出对称性分辨 Krylov 复杂度的自然全息实现。然后转向从场论观点看有效点状但在体空间具有内在结构的探针：重子顶点位形和巨引力子。结果表明，对这一大类有结构但点状的探针，大时间领头行为保持共形理论中局域算符预期的特征形式，而内部结构和诱导荷产生有信息量的次领头效应。我们还研究一个真正延展的探针，即沿空间方向拉伸并在 AdS 中下落的基本弦，作为非局域算符展开复杂度的模型。此时，尽管领头行为仍表现出预期增长模式，次领头项和中间区域与点状探针定性不同。这提供具体证据表明延展算符携带更精细的展开复杂度概念，对其空间结构敏感。我们的结果拓宽了可显式分析全息 Krylov 复杂度的探针类别，厘清哪些特征是普适的、哪些依赖算符性质，并开辟了更精细理解带电、复合和延展激发复杂度的场论途径。
classification.one_liner: 研究 AdS5×S5 中带电粒子、重子顶点、巨引力子及延展弦的全息 Krylov/展开复杂度，比较点状与延展探针的普适和次领头特征。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 全息理论，并讨论探针与复杂度，但不直接落在给出的重点标签支线（如全息超流超导、p波、D3-D7/D3-D5、经典引力等）上。

papers.title: Electromagnetic form factors of vector mesons in Einstein-dilaton holographic QCD
papers.abstract: We investigate the electromagnetic form factors of the $\rho$ meson family within a holographic QCD framework based on Einstein-dilaton gravity with confining backgrounds. We obtain the elastic and transition form factors using a spectral decomposition of the three-point isospin current correlator and an independent approach based on the Kaluza-Klein expansion. Furthermore, we establish a holographic dictionary of the current matrix element. The elastic form factors are in agreement with available lattice QCD results, whereas the transition form factors, not yet determined within lattice QCD, are predictions of the model. For the elastic case, the electric form factor for the $\rho$ meson family exhibits a zero at $q^{2} = 6\, m_{\rho^{n}}^{2}$ and in particular for the ground state $q^{2} = 3.61\,\text{GeV}^{2}$, consistent with light-front and Dyson-Schwinger calculations. We also compute strong couplings between vector meson states and find some approximate selection rules. In the elastic case and low-$q^{2}$ regime, we calculate dimensionless electric radius, magnetic and quadrupole moments and compare with other approaches. In the high-$q^{2}$ regime, the form factors follow the expected scaling behavior, and the model predicts their asymptotic normalization. The results in the high-$q^{2}$ regime lead to superconvergence relations and establish a new sum rule involving masses, decay constants and couplings.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-dilaton 全息 QCD 中矢量介子的电磁形状因子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在基于带共形禁闭背景的 Einstein-dilaton 引力的全息 QCD 框架内研究 ρ 介子家族的电磁形状因子。我们通过三点同位旋流关联函数的谱分解，以及基于 Kaluza-Klein 展开的独立方法，得到弹性形状因子和跃迁形状因子。此外，我们建立了流矩阵元的全息字典。弹性形状因子与现有格点 QCD 结果一致，而跃迁形状因子尚未由格点 QCD 确定，是该模型的预言。对于弹性情形，ρ 介子家族的电形状因子在 q^2=6 m_{ρ^n}^2 处出现零点，对基态尤其为 q^2=3.61 GeV^2，与光前和 Dyson-Schwinger 计算一致。我们还计算了矢量介子态之间的强耦合，并发现一些近似选择定则。在弹性情形和低 q^2 区域，我们计算无量纲电半径、磁矩和四极矩，并与其他方法比较。在高 q^2 区域，形状因子遵循预期的标度行为，模型预言其渐近归一化。高 q^2 区域的结果导致超收敛关系，并建立了一个涉及质量、衰变常数和耦合的新求和规则。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-dilaton 全息 QCD 中计算 ρ 介子家族的电磁形状因子、强耦合与高能求和规则。

papers.title: On the Extended Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson Spacetime: Two Black Holes and a Naked Singularity in Bertotti-Robinson Universe
papers.abstract: We introduce new coordinates that extend the Kerr--Newman--Bertotti--Robinson spacetime consistently with the previous reciprocal continuation. In these coordinates, the two points at $\Omega=0$ are resolved into complete Bertotti--Robinson null infinities. The extended spacetime describes two black holes sharing a common exterior of nontrivial topology, together with a naked ring singularity. In the regular static limit, the new coordinates globally identify the spacetime with the balanced Alekseev--Garc\'ia geometry.

classification.title_zh: 论扩展的 Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson 时空：Bertotti-Robinson 宇宙中的两个黑洞和一个裸奇点
classification.abstract_zh: 我们引入新坐标，以与先前的 reciprocal continuation 一致的方式扩展 Kerr--Newman--Bertotti--Robinson 时空。在这些坐标中，Ω=0 处的两个点被解并为完整的 Bertotti--Robinson 零无穷。扩展时空描述了两个共享具有非平凡拓扑的共同外部的黑洞，以及一个裸环奇点。在规则静态极限下，新坐标将时空整体等同于平衡的 Alekseev--García 几何。
classification.one_liner: 通过新坐标扩展 KN-BR 时空，得到共享非平凡外部的双黑洞与裸环奇点，并在静态极限联系到平衡 Alekseev-García 几何。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文研究经典广义相对论中的精确解、黑洞时空与奇点结构，属于用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；但它不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息，与全息主线无直接关系。

papers.title: Gravity from Invariant Weyl-Integrable space-time (IWIST)
papers.abstract: In this paper we propose a geometrically motivated formulation of gravity in an invariant Weyl--Integrable space-time (IWIST), in which the background geometry is not imposed a priori but is dynamically determined through the Palatini variational principle. For a scalar field non-minimally coupled to gravity action, the resulting compatibility condition defines a Weyl--Integrable geometry which is preserved by a local Weyl transformation of the metric and the geo\-me\-tri\-cal scalar field. We construct an action invariant under both diffeomorphisms and Weyl transformations and introduce a Weyl-covariant variational procedure based on an invariant extension of the divergence theorem. The corresponding field equations are obtained for the metric, the Weyl scalar, and the Weyl gauge field. We further formulate the theory in the Einstein--Riemann frame, where the effective metric is Riemannian and the scalar field is re\-inter\-pre\-ted as a phy\-si\-cal degree of freedom of geometric origin. Finally, we propose a geometrical mechanism for the explicit breaking of Weyl symmetry by introducing a coupling between the Weyl gauge field and a current constructed from the scalar sector. The resulting theory remains diffeomorphism covariant while departing from local Weyl invariance. The Einstein--Riemann representation of the broken theory contains an additional generally covariant interaction, making the Weyl-invariant model a particular limit of a more general gravitational theory.

classification.title_zh: 从不变 Weyl-可积时空（IWIST）构造引力
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种在不变 Weyl-可积时空（IWIST）中具有几何动机的引力表述；其中背景几何并非先验给定，而是通过 Palatini 变分原理动力学地确定。对于非最小耦合到引力的标量场作用量，所得相容性条件定义了一个 Weyl-可积几何，该几何在度规和几何标量场的局域 Weyl 变换下保持不变。我们构造一个同时满足微分同胚不变性和 Weyl 变换不变性的作用量，并基于散度定理的不变扩展引入 Weyl 协变变分程序。针对度规、Weyl 标量和 Weyl 规范场得到相应场方程。我们进一步在 Einstein-Riemann 标架中表述该理论；在此标架中有效度规为黎曼型，标量场被重新解释为具有几何起源的物理自由度。最后，我们通过引入 Weyl 规范场与由标量部分构造的流之间的耦合，提出一种显式破缺 Weyl 对称性的几何机制。所得理论仍保持微分同胚协变性，但偏离局域 Weyl 不变性。破缺理论的 Einstein-Riemann 表示包含一个额外的广义协变相互作用，使得 Weyl 不变模型成为更一般引力理论的一个特定极限。
classification.one_liner: 在不变 Weyl-可积时空中用 Palatini 变分构造引力，并给出 Weyl 对称性显式破缺机制及 Einstein-Riemann 标架表述。

papers.title: Higher-order generalized uncertainty principle corrections to Casimir-supported traversable wormholes
papers.abstract: We investigate traversable wormholes supported by Casimir vacuum energy with second-order generalized uncertainty principle (GUP) corrections. For two representative GUP models, we derive higher-order corrections to the Casimir energy and construct exact wormhole solutions in general relativity. The resulting geometries satisfy the throat, flare-out, and asymptotic-flatness conditions. Higher-order corrections modify the wormhole mass and reduce the exotic matter required, although the null and weak energy conditions remain violated near the throat. We further analyze weak gravitational lensing and gravitational-wave echoes, finding model-dependent signatures that may distinguish different GUP realizations. By relating the dimensionless parameter used in the solutions to the conventional phenomenological GUP parameter, we show that its physical interpretation depends strongly on the throat radius. Most current experimental bounds favor near-Planckian throats for appreciable GUP corrections, while macroscopic throats generally require much weaker corrections. These results provide a framework for confronting GUP-corrected Casimir wormholes with laboratory constraints and astrophysical observations.

classification.title_zh: Casimir支撑的可穿越虫洞的高阶广义不确定原理修正
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由Casimir真空能支持、并带有二阶广义不确定原理（GUP）修正的可穿越虫洞。对于两个代表性GUP模型，我们推导了Casimir能量的高阶修正，并在广义相对论中构造了精确虫洞解。所得几何满足喉部、外翻和渐近平坦条件。高阶修正改变虫洞质量并减少所需的奇异物质，尽管在喉部附近零能量条件和弱能量条件仍被违反。我们进一步分析弱引力透镜和引力波回声，发现可能区分不同GUP实现方式的模型依赖信号。通过将解中使用的无量纲参数与传统的现象学GUP参数相联系，我们表明其物理解释强烈依赖于喉半径。大多数当前实验界限倾向于，对可观的GUP修正而言喉部接近普朗克尺度；而宏观喉部通常需要弱得多的修正。这些结果为用实验室约束和天体物理观测检验GUP修正的Casimir虫洞提供了一个框架。
classification.one_liner: 在广义相对论中构造含二阶GUP修正的Casimir可穿越虫洞，并分析能量条件、弱引力透镜与引力波回声特征。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论中的虫洞精确解与引力波回声分析，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点；但不涉及AdS/CFT全息字典或全息凝聚态/超流等分支。

papers.title: Bosonic stars with dark electroweak fields
papers.abstract: We construct bosonic stars in the Einstein-Weinberg-Salam theory, namely the bosonic sector of the electroweak Standard Model minimally coupled to Einstein's theory of gravity. These configurations are everywhere regular, spherically symmetric and asymptotically flat, consisting of a static condensate of the massive $W$ and $Z$ bosons, whose masses arise from the Higgs mechanism. Although the corresponding fields exist in nature, gravitational effects are negligible at the physical electroweak scale and the configurations would be microscopic. Keeping Newton's constant and the electroweak mass ratios at their physical values, we therefore interpret the model as the bosonic sector of a \textit{dark} electroweak theory with a radically different energy scale. Choosing the ultralight vector boson mass $m_{\mathrm{W}}c^{2}=8.7\times10^{-13}\,$eV, as suggested by the Proca star interpretation of GW190521, our bosonic stars can attain masses in the intermediate-mass black hole range.

classification.title_zh: 具有暗电弱场的玻色星
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 Einstein-Weinberg-Salam 理论，即电弱标准模型的玻色子部分与 Einstein 引力理论最小耦合，中构造玻色星。这些位形处处正则、球对称且渐近平坦，由质量来自 Higgs 机制的大质量 W 和 Z 玻色子的静态凝聚体组成。尽管相应场在自然界中存在，但在物理电弱能标下引力效应可忽略，这些位形将是微观的。因此，在保持 Newton 常数和电弱质量比为其物理值的情况下，我们将该模型解释为一个暗电弱理论的玻色子部分，其能标与通常电弱理论截然不同。选取超轻矢量玻色子质量 m_W c^2 = 8.7×10^-13 eV（由 GW190521 的 Proca 星解释所建议），我们的玻色星可以达到中等质量黑洞范围的质量。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-Weinberg-Salam 理论中构造球对称玻色星，并将物理电弱能标重解释为暗电弱理论，使其质量可落在中等质量黑洞范围。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力与致密星/玻色星方向，使用 Einstein 方程研究静态孤子解；不涉及全息对偶、AdS/CFT 或量子引力，因此与全息主线关联有限，但与经典引力重点标签相关。

papers.title: M2-brane matrix models and Fermi gas on affine ABCD quivers
papers.abstract: We study a new class of M2-brane matrix models associated with affine BC and twisted affine AD quivers. These models exhibit the characteristic $N^{3/2}$ scaling of the free energy in the large $N$ limit. We establish a Fermi gas formalism and demonstrate that their grand canonical sum is given by a Fredholm Pfaffian, which is in parallel with the affine D quiver matrix models. The resulting Fermi gas density matrix shows a rational dependence on the canonical position/momentum operators in addition to the standard hyperbolic dependence. This leads to unconventional sub-leading corrections, which obstruct the Airy function structure in the $1/N$ expansion of the free energy observed in the previously studied M2-brane matrix models.

classification.title_zh: 仿射 ABCD 箭图上的 M2-膜矩阵模型与费米气体
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一类新的 M2-膜矩阵模型，它们与仿射 BC 箭图以及扭曲仿射 AD 箭图相关。这些模型在大 N 极限下自由能表现出特征的 N^{3/2} 标度。我们建立费米气体形式，并证明其巨正则和由 Fredholm Pfaffian 给出，这与仿射 D 箭图矩阵模型平行。所得的费米气体密度矩阵除了标准双曲依赖外，还显示出对正则位置/动量算符的有理依赖。这导致非常规的次领头修正，阻碍了在先前研究的 M2-膜矩阵模型中观察到的自由能 1/N 展开中的 Airy 函数结构。
classification.one_liner: 研究仿射 BC 和扭曲仿射 AD 箭图的 M2-膜矩阵模型，建立 Fredholm Pfaffian 费米气体形式并发现阻碍 Airy 行为的次领头修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 M2-膜矩阵模型与费米气体形式，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动或经典引力/广义相对论等方向。

papers.title: Environmental Effects in Post-Minkowskian Dynamics: Effective Field Theory, Feynman Rules, and Ward Identities for Compact Objects in Relativistic Fluids
papers.abstract: We develop a hydrodynamic effective field theory for the gravitational dynamics of compact objects moving through an inviscid fluid environment. The fluid is described by the effective theory of perfect fluids, whose Goldstone phonons are kept as explicit fields coupled to gravity. We establish a consistent power counting for the resulting Feynman rules and derive the propagators and interaction vertices through four points in $D$ dimensions, together with the generalized on-shell Ward identities they obey. These identities relate amplitudes with an external graviton to those with the graviton replaced by a phonon, and thus provide nontrivial checks on higher-order calculations. As an application, we recover the leading-order relativistic dynamical-friction force from the tree-level amplitude for single-phonon emission. This work is a first step towards a toolkit for incorporating environmental effects into the scattering-amplitude pipeline used in post-Minkowskian calculations.

classification.title_zh: 后闵可夫斯基动力学中的环境效应：相对论流体中致密天体的有效场论、费曼规则与 Ward 恒等式
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为在无粘流体环境中运动的致密天体的引力动力学发展了一个流体力学有效场论。流体由理想流体的有效理论描述，其 Goldstone 声子作为与引力耦合的显式场保留。我们为所得费曼规则建立了自洽的幂次计数，并在 D 维中推导出直到四点的传播子和相互作用顶点，以及它们满足的广义在壳 Ward 恒等式。这些恒等式将带有一个外腿引力子的振幅与将引力子替换为声子的振幅联系起来，从而为高阶计算提供非平凡检验。作为应用，我们从单声子发射的树级振幅恢复了领头阶相对论动力学摩擦力。本工作是迈向将环境效应纳入后闵可夫斯基计算所用散射振幅流程的工具箱的第一步。
classification.one_liner: 构建相对论流体中致密天体后闵可夫斯基引力动力学的流体力学有效场论，给出费曼规则与 Ward 恒等式，并用单声子发射恢复领头阶动力学摩擦力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于后闵可夫斯基经典引力与相对论流体有效场论，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Toward a Unique Filter for the Gravitational Path Integral
papers.abstract: In recent work, McNamara and Wang demonstrated that the failure of factorization for a gravitational path integral (GPI) can be understood as an incompleteness of its spectrum of states by constructing a unitary quantum field theory (QFT) into which the GPI embeds. We examine this construction from an algebraic point of view, and use it to verify a conjecture of the author concerning the existence and uniqueness of a unitary completion for the GPI by means of the theory of conditional expectations. We explore how the unitary QFT can be regarded as a single coherent theory in which the quantitative signatures of ensemble averaging emerge purely from projecting to the underlying, smooth GPI. The conditional expectation relating the two theories may therefore be interpreted as a filter in the sense of Liu. The factorizing theory differs from a more standard QFT in the sense that it is reducible, meaning the Hilbert space associated with the empty set is non-trivial. We explain how the structure of reducible QFTs are generically encoded in weak Hopf algebraic symmetries and demonstrate how the weak structure allows for generalized $\alpha$-sectors and half wormholes to coexist within a single Hilbert space.

classification.title_zh: 迈向引力路径积分的唯一滤波器
classification.abstract_zh: 在最近的工作中，McNamara 和 Wang 证明，引力路径积分（GPI）的因子化失败可被理解为其态谱的不完备性，方式是构造一个 GPI 可嵌入其中的幺正量子场论（QFT）。我们从代数角度考察这一构造，并借助条件期望理论验证作者关于 GPI 的幺正完成之存在性与唯一性的猜想。我们探讨如何将这种幺正 QFT 视为一个单一相干理论，其中系综平均的定量特征完全来自投影到底层的、光滑的 GPI。因此，联系这两个理论的条件期望可以解释为 Liu 意义上的滤波器。因子化理论与更标准的 QFT 不同，因为它是可约的，这意味着与空集相联系的 Hilbert 空间是非平凡的。我们解释可约 QFT 的结构如何一般地编码在弱 Hopf 代数对称性中，并展示这种弱结构如何允许广义 α-扇区和半虫洞共存于单一 Hilbert 空间。
classification.one_liner: 从条件期望与弱 Hopf 代数角度研究引力路径积分的幺正完成、唯一滤波器与半虫洞/α-扇区。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于量子引力/全息路径积分的因子化与幺正完成问题，与全息对偶基础相关；但未直接涉及用户重点列出的全息超导、p 波、畴壁、QNM、经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: Holographic correlators with non-supersymmetric multi-particle states
papers.abstract: We consider heavy-heavy-light-light (HHLL) holographic correlators in which the heavy states are coherent superpositions of $n$-particle operators. In the limit of large $n$ and large central charge, $c$, with $n/c$ held fixed, these HHLL correlators are described by a classical supergravity computation. When the multi-particle operators are half-BPS, it has been shown that the $n/c\to 0$ limit of the HHLL correlator encodes the tree-level connected contribution to the 4-point function with the heavy operators replaced by two $n$-particle operators with finite $n$. We provide evidence that this relation continues to hold when the multi-particle operators are non-supersymmetric. Although our checks are carried out in the AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ setting, we expect that our conjecture extends to more general holographic dualities.

classification.title_zh: 非超对称多粒子态的全息关联函数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑重-重-轻-轻（HHLL）全息关联函数，其中重态是 n 粒子算符的相干叠加。在大 n 和大中心荷 c、且 n/c 固定的极限下，这些 HHLL 关联函数由经典超引力计算描述。当多粒子算符为半 BPS 时，已有研究表明 HHLL 关联函数的 n/c→0 极限编码了四点函数中树级连通贡献，其中重算符被两个具有有限 n 的 n 粒子算符取代。我们提供证据表明，当多粒子算符为非超对称时，这一关系仍然成立。尽管我们的检验在 AdS3/CFT2 设置中进行，我们预期该猜想可推广到更一般的全息对偶。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS3/CFT2 中给出证据，表明非超对称多粒子重态 HHLL 全息关联函数与经典超引力描述之间的关系继续成立。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 基础与字典方向，直接讨论全息关联函数与多粒子重态；可能与 multi-trace 或多粒子态研究相关，但未涉及用户重点标签中的凝聚态、超流超导、相变、QNM 等具体支线。

papers.title: Four-Point Yang-Mills Correlators in AdS$_4$ from All-Line Recursion: All-Plus, Single-Minus and MHV
papers.abstract: We review Raju's all-line recursion relations for Yang-Mills theory in AdS${}_4$ and evaluate four-point correlators for the All-plus, Single-minus, and MHV helicity configurations. We point out the relevant deformation for the legs needed to obtain the correlators. In particular, we explicitly derive the expressions for all the residues contributing to all three correlators. We also perform an explicit numerical check with the results computed by Witten diagram computations and find perfect agreement with our results. Finally, we conclude by discussing some applications of these recursions for obtaining higher-point functions.

classification.title_zh: 从全线递归计算 AdS4 中的四点 Yang-Mills 关联函数：All-plus、Single-minus 与 MHV
classification.abstract_zh: 我们回顾 Raju 的 AdS4 中 Yang-Mills 理论的全线递归关系，并计算 All-plus、Single-minus 和 MHV 螺旋度构型的四点关联函数。我们指出为得到这些关联函数所需的腿上的相关形变。特别地，我们明确推导了贡献于这三个关联函数的所有留数表达式。我们还与 Witten 图计算得到的结果进行显式数值检验，发现完全一致。最后，我们讨论这些递归关系在获得更高点函数方面的一些应用。
classification.one_liner: 用全线递归计算 AdS4 中 Yang-Mills 四点关联函数，并与 Witten 图数值结果一致。
