papers.title: Schwinger stability of T-duality-inspired extremal black holes
papers.abstract: We study the near-horizon charged-scalar instability associated with Schwinger pair production in the charged regular black hole geometry of the zero-point-length T-duality prescription. Using the same effective geometry and regularized gauge potential, we construct the extremal branch, its ${\rm AdS}_2 \times S^2$ near-horizon throat, and the charged-scalar instability threshold for a general form factor. For the explicit T-duality form factor the extremal branch terminates at $r_\mathrm{ext} = \sqrt2 \, l_0$, where the extremal charge and the near-horizon electric field vanish while the ${\rm AdS}_2$ radius remains finite at $\sqrt3 \, l_0$. At this endpoint the exact near-horizon instability parameter is negative. In the semiclassical regime the corresponding charge-to-mass threshold diverges as the endpoint is approached. Thus, for each fixed massive species with finite $q/m$, a sufficiently near-endpoint portion of the extremal branch is free of the local charged-scalar instability. For comparison, the Ay\'on-Beato-Garc\'ia (ABG) Einstein-nonlinear-electrodynamics solution has a nonvanishing extremal near-horizon electric field. For an additional minimally coupled charged-scalar probe, the corresponding local Schwinger threshold remains finite. Thus the divergent near-endpoint Schwinger barrier found in the T-duality branch is not a generic consequence of regularity.

classification.title_zh: T-对偶启发的极端黑洞的 Schwinger 稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究与 Schwinger 对产生相关的近视界带电标量不稳定性，对象是零点长度 T-对偶方案中的带电正则黑洞几何。使用相同的有效几何和正则化规范势，我们构造了极端分支、其 AdS2 × S2 近视界喉区，以及对于一般形式因子的带电标量不稳定性阈值。对于显式的 T-对偶形式因子，极端分支终止于 r_ext = √2 l0，此时极端电荷和近视界电场消失，而 AdS2 半径保持有限为 √3 l0。在此端点，精确的近视界不稳定性参数为负。在半经典区域，相应的荷质比阈值在接近端点时发散。因此，对于每个固定的有限 q/m 的大质量粒子种类，极端分支中足够接近端点的部分没有局域带电标量不稳定性。作为比较，Ayón-Beato-García (ABG) Einstein-非线性电动力学解具有非零的极端近视界电场。对于额外的最小耦合带电标量探针，相应的局域 Schwinger 阈值保持有限。因此，在 T-对偶分支中发现的发散的近端点 Schwinger 势垒并不是规则性的普遍结果。
classification.one_liner: 在 T-对偶启发的正则极端黑洞中，近视界带电标量 Schwinger 不稳定性阈值在极端分支端点附近发散，而 ABG 解保持有限，表明该发散并非规则性必然结果。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典正则极端黑洞的近视界几何与带电标量 Schwinger 不稳定性，并比较非线性电动力学黑洞，属于用户重点的“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；但未使用 AdS/CFT 对偶或量子信息框架。

papers.title: Turbulent gravitational waves
papers.abstract: We construct turbulent gravitational wakes in asymptotically AdS$_4$ spacetimes by solving the full non-linear Einstein equations in the characteristic formulation. Specifically, we show that a localized boundary deformation acting on a boosted black brane generates a wake whose boundary dynamics exhibit the formation of coherent vortical structures that are advected downstream by the background flow. Analysing a wake propagating along the x direction, we show that it displays the characteristic self-similar scaling of classical turbulent wakes. We then identify the geometric imprint of the wake on the horizon area density, the traceless horizon extrinsic curvature, and bulk metric perturbations, finding coherent structures that extend from the asymptotic boundary to the horizon. These results provide the first study of turbulent gravitational wakes in four-dimensional asymptotically AdS spacetimes.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 湍流引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过在特征表述下求解完全非线性 Einstein 方程，在渐近 AdS$_4$ 时空中构造了湍流引力尾迹。具体而言，我们表明作用在 boosted 黑膜上的局域边界形变会产生一个尾迹，其边界动力学表现出相干涡旋结构的形成，并被背景流向下游平流输送。通过分析沿 x 方向传播的尾迹，我们表明它显示出经典湍流尾迹的特征自相似标度。随后，我们在视界面积密度、无迹视界外曲率以及体度规微扰中识别出该尾迹的几何印记，发现从渐近边界延伸到视界的相干结构。这些结果首次研究了四维渐近 AdS 时空中的湍流引力尾迹。
classification.one_liner: 在渐近 AdS4 中求解完全非线性 Einstein 方程构造湍流引力尾迹，发现经典湍流自相似标度、相干涡旋结构与延伸到视界的几何印记。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究全息框架下的非线性 Einstein 方程与湍流引力尾迹，属于非平衡/流体动力学与经典引力的交叉，包含涡旋结构、自相似标度与视界几何，匹配 QNM 与非线性演化、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、经典引力/广义相对论等支线。

papers.title: Growing Einstein-Rosen Bridge with Multi-partite Entanglement
papers.abstract: Can quantum entanglement continue to grow even after the entanglement entropies of subsystems have saturated? We address this question using genuine multi-entropy, which probes multi-partite entanglement structure beyond bipartite entanglement. In a two-sided BTZ black hole, this quantity grows linearly with time after every subsystem entropy of a fixed tripartition has saturated, extending the interval in which entanglement detects Einstein-Rosen bridge growth. The result refines the ER=EPR relation by identifying multi-partite structure invisible to ordinary entanglement entropies. Some spin-chain models and the spatially partitioned Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model exhibit distinct transients, while the late-time plateau values in holography, the SYK model, and Haar-random states share a universal behaviour.

classification.title_zh: 多分体纠缠下增长的 Einstein-Rosen 桥
classification.abstract_zh: 量子纠缠能否在子系统的纠缠熵饱和之后继续增长？我们使用真正的多熵（genuine multi-entropy）来探讨这一问题，该量探测超出二分纠缠的多分体纠缠结构。在双边 BTZ 黑洞中，该量在一个固定三分划的每个子系统熵都饱和后随时间线性增长，扩展了纠缠能够探测 Einstein-Rosen 桥增长的区间。该结果通过识别普通纠缠熵不可见的多分体结构，细化了 ER=EPR 关系。一些自旋链模型和空间分割的 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型表现出不同的瞬态行为，而全息、SYK 模型和 Haar 随机态中的晚期平台值具有普遍行为。
classification.one_liner: 双边 BTZ 中，子系统纠缠熵饱和后真正的多熵仍线性增长，表明多分体纠缠可继续探测 ER 桥增长，并细化 ER=EPR。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究全息多体纠缠与 ER=EPR，涉及 BTZ 和 SYK，不属于用户列出的重点标签（全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC/凝聚态实验启发、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论）中的具体支线。

papers.title: Central charge and black hole entropy for regular extremal black-bounce spacetimes
papers.abstract: The Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, proportional to one quarter of the horizon area, is fundamental in black hole thermodynamics and can also be understood via the AdS/CFT correspondence, such as the 3D BTZ black hole and 2D CFT. In this work, we adopt the Kerr/CFT approach to analyze the central charge and black hole entropy for regular extremal black-bounce spacetimes, including the counterparts of the Kerr, Kerr-Newman, and Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes. These spacetimes are free of curvature singularities at $r=0$. We derive the near horizon geometries of these spacetimes and find that they exhibit enhanced symmetry, namely SL$(2,\mathbb{R})\times \mathrm{U}(1)$ or SL$(2,\mathbb{R}) \times \mathrm{SO}(3)$. By imposing appropriate boundary conditions, we analyze their asymptotic symmetry groups, which contain diffeomorphisms as well as the $\mathrm{U}(1)_{\rm gauge}$ symmetry arising from the electromagnetic field. We then extract the central charge from the charge algebra and evaluate the left-moving temperature of the Frolov-Thorne vacuum. It is worth emphasizing that in the black-bounce Kerr-Newman case, the central charge from the electromagnetic contribution vanishes. Furthermore, in the black-bounce Reissner-Nordstr\"om case, we uplift the 4D geometry to a 5D configuration by incorporating a $\mathrm{U}(1)$ gauge fiber. Our results show that the microscopic entropy calculated from the Cardy formula is consistent with the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy. This agreement suggests that the Kerr/CFT approach remains valid for certain regular spacetimes without curvature singularities, thereby providing a microscopic statistical understanding of black hole entropy.

classification.title_zh: 正则极端黑洞反弹时空的中心荷和黑洞熵
classification.abstract_zh: Bekenstein-Hawking 熵与视界面积的四分之一成正比，是黑洞热力学的基本内容，也可通过 AdS/CFT 对应（如三维 BTZ 黑洞与二维 CFT）理解。本文采用 Kerr/CFT 方法分析正则极端黑洞反弹时空的中心荷和黑洞熵，包括 Kerr、Kerr-Newman 和 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞的对应体。这些时空在 r=0 处没有曲率奇点。我们推导这些时空的近视界几何，发现它们具有增强对称性，即 SL(2,R)×U(1) 或 SL(2,R)×SO(3)。通过施加适当边界条件，我们分析其渐近对称群，其中包含微分同胚以及电磁场产生的 U(1)_gauge 对称性。随后从荷代数提取中心荷，并计算 Frolov-Thorne 真空的左手温度。需要强调，在黑洞反弹 Kerr-Newman 情形中，电磁贡献的中心荷消失。此外，在黑洞反弹 Reissner-Nordström 情形中，我们通过引入 U(1) 规范纤维将四维几何提升为五维构型。结果表明，由 Cardy 公式计算的微观熵与 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵一致。这种一致表明 Kerr/CFT 方法对某些无曲率奇点的正则时空仍然有效，从而为黑洞熵提供了微观统计理解。
classification.one_liner: 用 Kerr/CFT 方法计算正则极端黑洞反弹时空的中心荷，并由 Cardy 公式重现 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵。
classification.relevance_reason: 与黑洞熵、Kerr/CFT 和经典引力相关，但不属于所列重点标签中的全息超流超导、相变成核、QNM、冷原子等具体支线。

papers.title: Full Eigenstate Thermalization in Quantum Field Theory: Free Cumulants and Gravitational Scrambling
papers.abstract: Using thermal analyticity, we derive directional large-frequency bounds on the smooth functions entering full eigenstate thermalization in continuum quantum field theory. The strongest directions reproduce the scales previously identified for lattice systems, while the complete analyticity domain reveals a broader asymmetric multifrequency structure. In thermal two-dimensional conformal field theory, exact two- and three-point functions saturate the corresponding bounds. At fourth order, where genuine dynamical information first appears, we show that the holographic CFTs studied here saturate the strongest full-ETH bounds. These results establish a direct connection between full ETH, free cumulants, and gravitational scrambling, and are consistent with the emergence of asymptotic freeness realized by the gravitational scrambling algebra.

classification.title_zh: 量子场论中的完整本征态热化：自由累积量与引力扰乱
classification.abstract_zh: 利用热解析性，我们推导了连续量子场论中进入完整本征态热化的光滑函数的方向性大频率界。最强方向重现了此前为格点系统识别出的尺度，而完整解析性区域揭示了更广的非对称多频率结构。在热二维共形场论中，精确的两点和三点函数饱和相应的界。在四阶，真正动力学信息首次出现，我们表明这里研究的全息 CFT 饱和最强的完整 ETH 界。这些结果建立了完整 ETH、自由累积量与引力扰乱之间的直接联系，并与由引力扰乱代数实现的渐近自由性的出现一致。
classification.one_liner: 用热解析性导出连续 QFT 中 full ETH 的多频率界，并证明全息 CFT 在四阶饱和最强界，连接自由累积量与引力扰乱。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 CFT 中的热化、混沌/扰乱与量子信息主题，与用户关注的理论全息研究相关；但不直接匹配所列重点标签（如全息超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7、经典引力）。

papers.title: Representation Theory of Three-dimensional Corner Symmetries
papers.abstract: We study the representation theory of the three-dimensional extended corner symmetry group associated with a circular corner. Using induced representation techniques, we construct families of representations of the infinite-dimensional corner symmetry group and analyze their unitarity and irreducibility. We also determine the maximal central extension of the symmetry group and construct the corresponding projective representations. The analysis is motivated by the role that corner symmetries play in quantum gravity, where boundary degrees of freedom --- acted upon by the corner transformations --- are expected to encode aspects of the quantum structure of spacetime. In three dimensions, the representation-theoretic structures that emerge are closely related to symmetry groups and quantum theories that already appeared as central to the study of gravity. This work provides a first step toward a systematic description of quantum gravitational corner degrees of freedom in three dimensions.

classification.title_zh: 三维角对称性的表示论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究与圆形角相关的三维扩展角对称群的表示论。利用诱导表示技术，我们构造了无限维角对称群的若干族表示，并分析其酉性与不可约性。我们还确定了该对称群的最大中心扩张，并构造相应的投影表示。该分析的动机来自角对称性在量子引力中的作用：受角变换作用的边界自由度被期望编码时空量子结构的某些方面。在三维中，所出现的表示论结构与已在引力研究中占据中心地位的对称群和量子理论密切相关。这项工作为系统描述三维量子引力角自由度迈出了第一步。
classification.one_liner: 研究三维圆形角处扩展角对称群的表示论，包括诱导表示、酉性、不可约性、最大中心扩张与投影表示，并联系量子引力中的边界自由度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦角对称性表示论与量子引力边界自由度，未涉及用户列出的全息超导、p波/多分量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet或经典引力等具体支线；仅在广义全息/量子引力兴趣上间接相关。

papers.title: The Kerr/CFT energy gap
papers.abstract: Noether charges in gravity are always defined with respect to a reference metric, but the near-horizon extremal Kerr (NHEK) solution does not come with an obvious choice of reference metric (it is not asymptotically flat, for example). We discuss a one parameter generalization of the NHEK solution due to Kinnersley and Kelley which interpolates between NHEK and an analytically continued version of Minkowski spacetime. We use this interpolating family of solutions to compute the conformal energy of NHEK above the Minkowski reference metric. We find an interesting order of limits issue when computing the conformal energy of the Minkowski vacuum and we discuss a few natural prescriptions for fixing it, including one motivated by the Kerr/CFT correspondence.

classification.title_zh: Kerr/CFT 能隙
classification.abstract_zh: 引力中的诺特荷总是相对于一个参考度规定义，但近视界极端克尔（NHEK）解并没有显然的参考度规选择（例如它不是渐近平坦的）。我们讨论由 Kinnersley 和 Kelley 给出的 NHEK 解的单参数推广，它在 NHEK 与闵可夫斯基时空的一个解析延拓版本之间插值。我们利用这个插值解族计算 NHEK 相对于闵可夫斯基参考度规的共形能量。在计算闵可夫斯基真空的共形能量时，我们发现了一个有趣的极限顺序问题，并讨论了几种自然的修正方案，其中包括一个受 Kerr/CFT 对应启发的方案。
classification.one_liner: 利用 Kinnersley-Kelley 插值解族计算 NHEK 相对解析延拓 Minkowski 参考的共形能量，并讨论 Kerr/CFT 相关的极限顺序修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签，并涉及黑洞全息的 Kerr/CFT；但未涉及用户列出的全息凝聚态、超流超导等更具体支线。

papers.title: Modelling Dissipative Dynamics of r-mode Instability in Hybrid Stars
papers.abstract: Compact star cores reach extreme densities and may contain exotic dense-matter phases. Information about the exotic interiors of rapidly rotating pulsars can be inferred from r-mode oscillations, whose stability is governed by viscous dissipation. In this work, we model a compact star containing a possible mixed phase of hadronic and quark matter and employ a hybrid statistical framework based on Bayesian inference to infer the dissipation time scales associated with the hybrid phase. Using low-mass X-ray binaries (LMXB) timing observations together with mass-radius constraints from the Neutron Star Interior Composition Explorer (NICER) mission, we estimate the shear and bulk viscosity contributions to r-mode damping for a hybrid star of two layers. Our inference yields shear and bulk viscous dissipation time scales of $\tau_s=(4.99^{+0.49}_{-0.52}) \times 10^8 T^{\frac{5}{3}}$s and $\tau_B=(2.150^{+1.23}_{-0.60}) \times 10^{19} (T^4 10^{-12}+T^2 10^{-6})^{-1}\Omega^{-2}$s respectively. The timescales thus obtained can be implemented to obtain the minima of the star's rotation frequency at $\Omega=451.87$ Hz at temperature $T=0.259$ MeV for a hybrid star of mass $1.5$ $M_{\odot}$ and $\Omega=517.47$ Hz at $T=0.234$ MeV for $M=1.75 M_{\odot}$. We find that the instability window obtained through the inference framework effectively explains the observed stability of millisecond pulsars in both the radio and LMXB populations, particularly for XTE J0929-314 and XTE J1807-294, J0437-4715, J2124-3358, respectively. These results demonstrate that Bayesian inference combined with r-mode phenomenology provides a powerful and observationally consistent framework for constraining the transport properties of dense hybrid matter.

classification.title_zh: 混合星中 r 模不稳定性的耗散动力学建模
classification.abstract_zh: 致密星核心可达到极端密度，并可能包含奇异致密物质相。快速旋转脉冲星奇异内部的信息可由 r 模振荡推断，而其稳定性由黏性耗散决定。在本工作中，我们建模一颗包含可能的强子与夸克物质混合相的致密星，并采用基于贝叶斯推断的混合统计框架来推断与混合相相关的耗散时间尺度。利用低质量 X 射线双星（LMXB）计时观测以及中子星内部组成探测探索者（NICER）任务给出的质量-半径限制，我们估计了双层混合星的剪切黏性和体黏性对 r 模阻尼的贡献。我们的推断给出剪切和体黏性耗散时间尺度分别为 τ_s=(4.99^{+0.49}_{-0.52}) × 10^8 T^{5/3} s 和 τ_B=(2.150^{+1.23}_{-0.60}) × 10^{19} (T^4 10^{-12}+T^2 10^{-6})^{-1} Ω^{-2} s。由此得到的时间尺度可用于获得恒星转动频率的极小值：对于质量为 1.5 M⊙ 的混合星，在温度 T=0.259 MeV 时 Ω=451.87 Hz；对于 M=1.75 M⊙，在 T=0.234 MeV 时 Ω=517.47 Hz。我们发现，通过推断框架得到的不稳定性窗口能有效解释射电和 LMXB 族群中毫秒脉冲星观测到的稳定性，特别是 XTE J0929-314 和 XTE J1807-294、J0437-4715、J2124-3358。这些结果表明，贝叶斯推断结合 r 模现象学为约束致密混合物质的输运性质提供了一个强大且与观测一致的框架。
classification.one_liner: 用贝叶斯推断从 LMXB/NICER 观测约束混合星 r 模黏性耗散时间尺度，并解释毫秒脉冲星的观测稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/致密星与输运研究，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶、AdS/CFT 或量子引力。

papers.title: Gravitational lensing of neutrinos through the lens of decoherence
papers.abstract: We propose a new source of neutrino decoherence arising from stochastic gravitational lensing by unresolved mass substructure. Unlike traditional models that treat the lensing potential as smooth and deterministic, we decompose the lensing potential into a smooth component and a stochastic population of compact clumps. The substructure induced fluctuations of the lensing potential generate stochastic corrections to the neutrino time delay, thereby producing random relative phases between different neutrino mass eigenstates. Averaging over the clump ensemble converts these phase fluctuations into an effective dampening of flavour coherence. This framework connects stochastic gravitational lensing with neutrino phenomenology and offers a novel route to probe dark matter substructure through astrophysical neutrino flavour transitions.

classification.title_zh: 从退相干视角看中微子的引力透镜
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的中微子退相干来源，它来自未被分辨的质量子结构引起的随机引力透镜效应。不同于将透镜势视为光滑且确定性的传统模型，我们把透镜势分解为光滑分量和随机分布的致密团块。子结构导致的透镜势涨落会对中微子时间延迟产生随机修正，从而在不同中微子质量本征态之间产生随机相对相位。对团块系综取平均后，这些相位涨落转化为对味道相干性的有效阻尼。该框架将随机引力透镜与中微子现象学联系起来，并为通过天体物理中微子味道转换探测暗物质子结构提供了新途径。
classification.one_liner: 把未分辨暗物质团块造成的随机引力透镜视为中微子退相干来源，并提出用中微子味道转换探测暗物质子结构。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息研究；主要涉及经典引力透镜与中微子退相干/暗物质子结构，仅与‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签有间接关联。

papers.title: Correlated Galactic Confusion Foreground for the LISA-Taiji-TianQin Network and Its Impacts on Resolvable-Source Analysis
papers.abstract: The millihertz gravitational-wave sky is expected to be observed by a network of space-based detectors (LISA, Taiji, and TianQin) in the 2030s. A dominant noise in this band is the confusion foreground produced by O(10^7) unresolved Galactic binaries (GBs). Because the same population projects onto the time-delay interferometry (TDI) channels of the different detectors, the foreground is necessarily correlated across the network. We construct the full foreground noise covariance matrix for the LISA-Taiji-TianQin network from a catalogue of ~3 x 10^7 GBs through numerical simulation, and we derive an analytic model of the cross-detector foreground coherence that provides a cross-check and physical interpretation of the numerical results. We derive the overall sensitivity of the detector network based on this covariance matrix, and further characterize the frequency- and time-dependent cross-detector foreground correlations. Taking massive black hole binaries (MBHBs) and GBs as representative transient and continuous sources, we further compare the block-diagonal (i.e., neglecting the cross-detector foreground correlation) and full-covariance noise models in terms of their impacts on the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), parameter uncertainties, and Bayesian posteriors. The impact is confined to specific signal regimes, affecting primarily high-mass (M_c ~ 10^7 M_sun) MBHBs and low-frequency (f_0 <~ 2 mHz) GBs, with SNR relative differences of up to ~30% and ~10%, respectively. No statistically significant parameter bias arises under either noise model, as verified by probability-probability tests. Parameter estimations for MBHBs and GBs are performed using the network analysis pipelines implemented in the Triangle-BBH and Triangle-GB codes. Both repositories, together with the simulated foreground data and network sensitivities, are publicly released for diverse scientific investigations.

classification.title_zh: LISA-太极-天琴网络的相关银河混淆前景及其对可分辨源分析的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 毫赫兹引力波天空预计将在2030年代由空间引力波探测器网络（LISA、太极和天琴）观测。该频段的一个主导噪声是由 O(10^7) 个未分辨银河双星（GBs）产生的混淆前景。由于同一星族投影到不同探测器的时间延迟干涉（TDI）通道上，该前景在网络中必然是相关的。我们通过数值模拟，从约 3 x 10^7 个 GBs 的目录构建了 LISA-太极-天琴 网络的完整前景噪声协方差矩阵，并推导了跨探测器前景相干性的解析模型，用于对数值结果进行交叉检验和物理解释。基于该协方差矩阵，我们推导了探测器网络的整体灵敏度，并进一步刻画了频率和时间依赖的跨探测器前景相关性。以超大质量黑洞双星（MBHBs）和 GBs 作为代表性的暂现源和连续源，我们进一步比较了块对角（即忽略跨探测器前景相关性）噪声模型与完整协方差噪声模型在信噪比（SNR）、参数不确定度和贝叶斯后验上的影响。该影响局限于特定信号区域，主要影响高质量（M_c ~ 10^7 M_sun）MBHBs 和低频（f_0 <~ 2 mHz）GBs，SNR 相对差异分别可达约 30% 和约 10%。在两种噪声模型下均未出现统计显著参数偏差，这通过概率-概率检验得到验证。MBHBs 和 GBs 的参数估计使用 Triangle-BBH 和 Triangle-GB 代码中实现的网络分析流程完成。两个代码库连同模拟前景数据和网络灵敏度均已公开发布，供多样化的科学研究使用。
classification.one_liner: 构建 LISA-太极-天琴 网络的相关银河双星混淆前景协方差，并评估其对可分辨源参数估计的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于空间引力波探测器网络的数据分析与前景噪声建模，匹配经典引力/引力波方向，但不涉及全息、量子引力或理论物理核心问题。

papers.title: Inverse Reconstruction of Causal Nonlinear Electrodynamics: Functional Families, Spectral Constraints, and Single-Horizon Black Holes
papers.abstract: Nonlinear electrodynamics (NLED) admits many causal theories, so causality alone does not provide a unique selection principle. We formulate an inverse construction in which constitutive integrability, the Maxwell weak-field limit, and causal propagation are imposed before either a Lagrangian or a spacetime geometry is chosen. An affine-separable reduction of the two-invariant Pleba\'nski class yields an infinite-dimensional causal family $\mathcal{C}_X$, characterized by a bounded logarithmic index; Born-Infeld is its unique self-dual member, while generic members are birefringent. On the magnetic axis, complete monotonicity gives a positive spectral representation. Finite monopole self-energy is equivalent to the existence of the spectral moment of order $-1/4$, whereas global magnetic causality restricts the support. Generalized-gamma spectra are simultaneously causal and finite-energy precisely for $1/4<\gamma\le1/2$, independently of the shape parameter, and a separate criterion determines when the magnetic law admits a causal two-invariant completion. After coupling to Einstein gravity, a positive magnetic response and characteristic factor, finite self-energy, and nonnegative residual mass imply a strictly increasing metric function, excluding more than one positive horizon; positive residual mass guarantees a unique horizon. The two optical metrics of $\mathcal{C}_X$ remain Lorentzian with overlapping timelike cones, establishing symmetric hyperbolicity of the electromagnetic subsystem. Thus inverse matter selection connects local causal consistency to global black-hole structure without prescribing the geometry.

classification.title_zh: 因果非线性电动力学的逆重构：函数族、谱约束与单视界黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 非线性电动力学（NLED）允许许多因果理论，因此仅凭因果性并不能提供唯一的选择原则。我们提出一种逆构造：在选定拉格朗日量或时空几何之前，先施加本构可积性、麦克斯韦弱场极限和因果传播条件。对双不变量 Plebański 类的仿射可分约化给出一个无限维因果族 C_X，其特征是有界对数指标；Born-Infeld 是其唯一的自对偶成员，而一般成员具有双折射。在磁轴上，完全单调性给出正谱表示。有限单极自能等价于 -1/4 阶谱矩的存在，而全局磁因果性限制其支集。广义伽马谱同时满足因果性和有限能量，当且仅当 1/4<γ≤1/2，且与形状参数无关；另一个判据决定磁定律何时允许因果的双不变量完备化。耦合到 Einstein 引力后，正磁响应与特征因子、有限自能以及非负剩余质量意味着度规函数严格递增，从而排除多于一个正视界；正剩余质量保证唯一视界。C_X 的两个光学度规保持洛伦兹号差且时间锥重叠，确立了电磁子系统的对称双曲性。因此，逆物质选择将局部因果一致性与全局黑洞结构联系起来，而无需预先指定几何。
classification.one_liner: 通过逆构造从因果性、可积性和弱场极限筛选非线性电动力学，并证明其与爱因斯坦引力耦合时限制黑洞视界数量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典非线性电动力学及其与爱因斯坦引力的耦合，涉及黑洞视界结构，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点；但不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力信息。

papers.title: Inspiral waveforms of charged compact binaries and observational constraints
papers.abstract: Electric charges carried by compact objects can affect binary dynamics and imprint characteristic signatures on gravitational-wave signals. We derive next-to-leading-order post-Newtonian frequency-domain waveforms for charged compact binaries in both the gravitational-quadrupole and electric-dipole dominated regimes, including electromagnetic corrections beyond leading-order electric-dipole radiation that reduce the degeneracy between the component charge-to-mass ratios. Using gravitational wave events from GWTC-5.0, we place constraints on the charge-to-mass ratio and mass of each component of the binary system.

classification.title_zh: 带电致密双星的旋进波形与观测约束
classification.abstract_zh: 致密天体所携带的电荷会影响双星动力学，并在引力波信号中留下特征性印记。我们推导了带电致密双星在引力四极主导和电偶极主导两种情形下的次领头阶后牛顿频域波形，包含超越领头阶电偶极辐射的电磁修正，这些修正降低了各分量电荷质量比之间的简并。利用 GWTC-5.0 的引力波事件，我们对双星系统各分量的电荷质量比和质量给出了约束。
classification.one_liner: 推导带电致密双星次领头阶后牛顿频域旋进波形，并利用 GWTC-5.0 约束电荷质量比与质量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力/广义相对论框架下的引力波旋进波形与观测约束，符合用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”。

papers.title: From massless wormholes to massive black bounces: Shadows and multiple light rings
papers.abstract: We develop a general framework for constructing massive black bounce geometries from massless wormhole seeds by introducing a position-dependent mass function while preserving the underlying areal-radius profile. We apply this procedure to the generalized Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole and obtain a new family of generalized Bardeen-like black bounce space-times, which continuously interpolates between traversable wormholes and regular black holes. We investigate the motion of massive particles and photons and show that, in contrast with the simpler orbital structure of the massless generalized Ellis-Bronnikov geometry, the generalized Bardeen-like space-time can exhibit multiple circular orbits and a rich light ring structure, including configurations with two unstable circular photon orbits separated by a stable one. We determine the corresponding photon sphere and shadow radii and compare our predictions with Event Horizon Telescope observations of Sgr A*, deriving observational constraints on the parameter space of the model. We further investigate the optical appearance produced by a geometrically and optically thin accretion disk through ray tracing. Multiple light rings generate characteristic nested structures in the high-resolution intensity profiles, whose relative brightness is strongly affected by the mass deformation and gravitational redshift. However, after modeling the finite angular resolution of the EHT with a Gaussian beam convolution, these fine structures are largely washed out, revealing a strong observational degeneracy between these exotic compact objects and standard black hole geometries at current EHT resolution.

classification.title_zh: 从无质量虫洞到有质量黑洞反弹：阴影与多重光环
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个通用框架，通过引入位置相关的质量函数，同时保持底层面积半径剖面，从无质量虫洞种子构造有质量黑洞反弹几何。我们将该过程应用于广义 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞，得到一类新的广义类 Bardeen 黑洞反弹时空，它在可穿越虫洞和规则黑洞之间连续插值。我们研究有质量粒子和光子的运动，并表明与无质量广义 Ellis-Bronnikov 几何较简单的轨道结构相比，广义类 Bardeen 时空可以表现出多重圆轨道和丰富的光环结构，包括两个不稳定圆光子轨道被一个稳定圆光子轨道分隔的构型。我们确定相应的光子球和阴影半径，并将我们的预言与事件视界望远镜对 Sgr A* 的观测比较，得到模型参数空间的观测约束。我们进一步通过光线追踪研究几何和光学薄吸积盘产生的光学外观。多重光环在高分辨率强度剖面中产生特征性的嵌套结构，其相对亮度受到质量形变和引力红移的强烈影响。然而，在用高斯光束卷积模拟 EHT 有限角分辨率后，这些精细结构在很大程度上被抹平，表明在当前 EHT 分辨率下，这些奇异致密天体与标准黑洞几何之间存在强烈的观测简并。
classification.one_liner: 通过位置相关质量函数从无质量虫洞生成有质量黑洞反弹，发现多重光环与阴影，并指出当前EHT分辨率下与标准黑洞存在观测简并。
classification.relevance_reason: 纯经典引力/致密天体阴影与光环研究，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，与全息对偶无直接关系。

papers.title: Charged black-hole binary radiation at second post-Newtonian order
papers.abstract: In this work, we build on Ref.~[Phys.~Rev.~D 112, 124060 (2025)], where we derived the dynamics of an electrically charged binary system at second post-Newtonian (2PN) order, by extending the analysis, at the same PN accuracy, to the associated emission of electromagnetic and gravitational radiation. We focus on non-spinning binaries that evolve quasi-adiabatically along a sequence of circular orbits, and compute the 2PN expression for the corresponding total energy flux at infinity. With respect to the well-known case of a neutral binary, the presence of charge induces both a new leading-order electromagnetic contribution of dipolar nature and additional charge-dependent corrections in the gravitational sector. To account for this richer phenomenology, we extend both the PN-matched multipolar post-Minkowskian and the effective field theory approaches to the radiation sector of charged binaries, with exact agreement for the contributions computed independently in both formalisms. We derive the radiative symmetric-trace-free multipole moments of the vector and gravitational fields at 2PN order. In doing so, we also compute 2PN-accurate charge-dependent corrections to the spherical multipoles of the waveform emitted by the binary, including a new memory contribution sourced by the stress-energy tensor of the electromagnetic radiation. These results lay the foundation for developing accurate waveform models capable of assessing the observational signatures of electric charge in gravitational-wave signals.

classification.title_zh: 带电黑洞双星在二阶后牛顿阶的辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在先前工作的基础上，将电带电双星系统在二阶后牛顿（2PN）阶的动力学分析扩展到相应的电磁辐射与引力辐射发射。作者聚焦于无自旋、沿圆轨道准绝热演化的双星，计算了无穷远处总能量通量的2PN表达式。与中性双星情形相比，电荷会引入新的领头阶偶极电磁贡献，并在引力部分带来额外的电荷相关修正。为处理这一更丰富的现象学，作者将PN匹配的多极后闵可夫斯基方法和有效场论方法推广到带电双星辐射部分，两种形式独立计算的贡献完全一致。文中给出了矢量场与引力场在2PN阶的辐射对称无迹多极矩，并计算了双星发射波形的2PN精度电荷相关球多极修正，其中包括由电磁辐射应力能量张量产生的新记忆贡献。这些结果为发展能够评估引力波信号中电荷观测特征的精确波形模型奠定了基础。
classification.one_liner: 将带电黑洞双星的2PN动力学推进到辐射 sector，计算电磁与引力能量通量、多极矩及波形中的新记忆效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究广义相对论框架下带电双星的引力波与电磁辐射，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线。

papers.title: Classical and Loop Quantum Cosmology of Interacting Dark Energy: A Dynamical System Analysis with Superfluid Dark Matter and Dust Matter
papers.abstract: We study the cosmological dynamics of interacting dark energy and dark matter in Classical Einstein Gravity and Loop Quantum Cosmology. Two dark matter scenarios are considered: superfluid dark matter described by a generalized cubic equation of state and the standard pressureless fluid. The dark energy component is modeled using both a generalized nonlinear equation of state and a constant equation of state. We examine two phenomenological interaction terms, $Q=\alpha\dot{\rho}_m$ and $Q=\beta\dot{\rho}_d$, which govern the energy transfer between the dark sectors. In classical gravity, the pressureless matter model exhibits stable late-time attractors, whereas the superfluid dark matter model admits only saddle and non-hyperbolic critical points. Extending the analysis to Loop Quantum Cosmology, quantum geometric corrections replace the Big Bang singularity with a nonsingular quantum bounce, and significantly modify the phase-space dynamics. As a result, the stable attractors of the classical pressureless matter model disappear, and all interacting models possess only saddle and non-hyperbolic critical points. These findings highlight the significant influence of both dark matter properties and quantum gravitational effects on the asymptotic evolution of interacting dark-sectors.

classification.title_zh: 相互作用暗能量的经典与圈量子宇宙学：超流暗物质和尘埃物质的动力学系统分析
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在经典爱因斯坦引力和圈量子宇宙学中研究相互作用暗能量与暗物质的宇宙学动力学。考虑两种暗物质情形：由广义三次状态方程描述的超流暗物质，以及标准无压流体。暗能量组分则分别用广义非线性状态方程和常状态方程建模。我们考察两个现象学相互作用项，Q=α\dot{\rho}_m 和 Q=β\dot{\rho}_d，它们控制暗部门之间的能量转移。在经典引力中，无压物质模型展现出稳定的晚期吸引子，而超流暗物质模型只允许鞍点和非双曲临界点。将分析推广到圈量子宇宙学后，量子几何修正将大爆炸奇点替换为无奇点量子反弹，并显著改变相空间动力学。结果，经典无压物质模型的稳定吸引子消失，所有相互作用模型都只具有鞍点和非双曲临界点。这些发现凸显了暗物质性质和量子引力效应对相互作用暗部门渐近演化的显著影响。
classification.one_liner: 论文用动力学系统比较经典引力与圈量子宇宙学中相互作用暗能量模型，发现量子反弹修正会消除经典稳定晚期吸引子。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文包含经典爱因斯坦引力框架下的宇宙学动力学，并属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；但主体是暗能量/暗物质动力学系统与圈量子宇宙学，不涉及全息对偶或量子信息。

papers.title: Self-stimulated avalanche in superradiant axion clouds
papers.abstract: Boson clouds formed via superradiance around spinning black holes offer a novel probe of ultralight particles. We show that such gravitational atoms can undergo a self-stimulated avalanche: a coherent quadrupolar transition is seeded by external gravitational waves and amplified by self-generated radiation feedback. We formulate an effective two-level description that captures the logistic population transfer and the resulting delayed gravitational-wave pulse with a characteristic envelope. This cooperative emission mechanism opens a new observational avenue into the ultralight dark sector.

classification.title_zh: 超辐射轴子云中的自激雪崩
classification.abstract_zh: 围绕旋转黑洞通过超辐射形成的玻色子云为探测超轻粒子提供了新途径。我们表明，此类引力原子可以经历自激雪崩：一个相干四极跃迁由外部引力波种子触发，并通过自身产生的辐射反馈被放大。我们建立了一个有效二能级描述，刻画了逻辑斯蒂布居转移以及由此产生的具有特征包络的延迟引力波脉冲。这种协同发射机制为观测超轻暗部门开辟了新途径。
classification.one_liner: 黑洞超辐射轴子云可通过自激雪崩产生特征延迟引力波脉冲，为超轻暗物质探测提供新途径。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于黑洞超辐射与引力波相关的经典引力现象，与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”相关；但与全息对偶及其重点全息支线无直接关系。

papers.title: Distorting Kerr Images with Parity-Odd Scalar Hair
papers.abstract: We investigate thin-disk imaging of Kerr black holes with synchronized scalar hair, focusing on backreacted parity-odd excited states of a complex scalar field minimally coupled to Einstein gravity. The spacetime displays a core-double-torus lensing structure, with a central black hole surrounded by two scalar clouds. We study the dependence of the images on hair strength and viewing angle, identifying a weak-hair regime close to Kerr. With increasing hair, the photon ring and shadow region shrink and become more distorted. In the strong-hair regime, gravitational lensing produces new features, including multiple disconnected shadow components, crescent-shaped structures, and signatures of chaotic lensing. For nearly edge-on viewing angles, repeated equatorial crossings generate nested ring-like patterns. These results highlight possible geometric signatures of black holes with excited scalar hair.

classification.title_zh: 宇称奇标量毛发对 Kerr 黑洞图像的扭曲
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有同步标量毛发的 Kerr 黑洞的薄盘成像，重点关注复标量场与 Einstein 引力最小耦合的反作用宇称奇激发态。该时空呈现核心-双环面透镜结构，中心黑洞被两个标量云包围。我们研究了图像对毛发强度和观测角度的依赖，识别出接近 Kerr 的弱毛发区域。随着毛发增强，光子环和阴影区域收缩并变得更加扭曲。在强毛发区域，引力透镜产生新特征，包括多个不连通的阴影成分、新月形结构以及混沌透镜的迹象。对于近乎侧视的观测角度，重复的赤道穿越产生嵌套环状图案。这些结果突出了具有激发标量毛发的黑洞可能的几何特征。
classification.one_liner: 宇称奇同步标量毛发会显著扭曲 Kerr 黑洞的薄盘图像，在强毛发下产生多阴影、新月形和混沌透镜等几何特征。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论中的黑洞时空与强透镜成像，并对应重点标签‘经典引力/广义相对论’；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Inspirals into bosonic dark matter stars and chirp mimickers
papers.abstract: We investigate extreme--mass--ratio inspirals in which a stellar-mass compact object orbits a supermassive bosonic dark matter star, modeled as a boson star, using fully relativistic perturbative methods. Unlike inspirals around electro-vacuum black holes, these systems can shed scalar matter through dynamical friction which significantly alters the inspiral dynamics. We show that this additional dissipation can induce a chirp-like gravitational-wave signal closely resembling that of black hole binaries, allowing boson stars to act as gravitational-wave chirp mimickers even when they are not ultracompact. The inspiral evolution and resulting waveform depend sensitively on the compactness of the central boson star: highly compact configurations trigger dipolar scalar radiation, leading to a rapid plunge, whereas less compact stars yield smoother inspirals dominated by gravitational and quadrupolar scalar waves. To support waveform modeling, we derive semi-analytical prescriptions for the gravitational and scalar energy fluxes that remain accurate deep into the relativistic regime. Our findings indicate that future space-based detectors such as LISA could distinguish these mimicker signals from true black hole inspirals through measurable phase dephasings induced by scalar dissipation.

classification.title_zh: 向玻色暗物质星的旋进与啁啾模仿者
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用完全相对论性的微扰方法研究极端质量比旋进，其中一颗恒星级致密天体绕着一颗超大质量玻色暗物质星（建模为玻色星）运行。与绕电真空黑洞的旋进不同，这些系统可以通过动力学摩擦抛出标量物质，从而显著改变旋进动力学。我们表明，这种额外耗散可以产生类啁啾引力波信号，与黑洞双星的信号高度相似，使得玻色星即使在并非超致密时也能充当引力波啁啾模仿者。旋进演化和由此产生的波形敏感地依赖于中心玻色星的致密度：高度致密的构型会触发偶极标量辐射，导致快速坠落；而致密度较低的星体产生由引力和四极标量波主导的更平滑旋进。为支持波形建模，我们推导了引力和标量能量通量的半解析表达式，这些表达式在深入相对论区域时仍保持准确。我们的发现表明，未来天基探测器（如 LISA）可以通过标量耗散引起的可测量相位退相，将这些模仿者信号与真实黑洞旋进区分开。
classification.one_liner: 玻色暗物质星上的极端质量比旋进可通过动力学摩擦耗散标量物质，产生与黑洞双星相似的啁啾引力波，LISA 可借相位退相区分。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要属于经典引力/广义相对论与引力波天体物理，涉及玻色星（孤子/非均匀构型）和 EMRI；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: A nonlinear voice from GW250114 ringdown
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave astronomy, by detecting ripples in spacetime, has opened a new window to observe compact objects and probe theories of gravity in the nonlinear strong-field regime. The ringdown signal of a binary black hole merger contains a superposition of damped sinusoids known as quasi-normal modes (Ref.[1]), whose frequencies are completely determined by the mass and spin of the remnant black hole and form the basis of black hole spectroscopy (Refs.[2-4]). A crucial prediction yet to be observationally confirmed is the existence of quadratic quasi-normal modes, which represent fundamental properties associated with wave-wave coupling in general relativity, and the leading mode is predicted to be detectable with next-generation ground-based detectors (Refs.[5-7]) using traditional methods. Here we show the first observational evidence for a set of quadratic quasi-normal modes in the ringdown of the binary black hole merger GW250114, the loudest gravitational-wave event detected to date, enabled by a novel analysis. These nonlinear modes result from the quadratic coupling of the linear $(2,2,n)$ modes with $n\leq3$. Starting the analysis at a time corresponding to four times the remnant mass ($M_\mathrm{f}$) after the merger, the evidence for their presence reaches a Bayes factor of 62. A phenomenological test allowing these modes to deviate from the theoretical prediction rejects the zero-amplitude hypothesis at a significance of 3.4 $\sigma$, while the inferred amplitude and complex frequency are consistent with the prediction of general relativity. This finding provides the first observational evidence of gravitational wave-wave interaction and extends black hole spectroscopy from the linear to the nonlinear regime. It also establishes a new direction for testing the fundamental nonlinear structure of general relativity with the most extreme gravity.

classification.title_zh: 来自 GW250114 铃宕的非线性之声
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波天文学通过探测时空中的涟漪，打开了观测致密天体并在非线性强场区检验引力理论的新窗口。双黑洞并合的铃宕信号包含被称为准正规模的阻尼正弦叠加，其频率完全由残余黑洞的质量和自旋决定，并构成黑洞谱学的基础。一个尚未被观测证实的关键预言是二次准正规模的存在，它们代表广义相对论中波-波耦合相关的基本性质，并且主要模式被预测可用传统方法在下一代地面探测器中被探测到。这里我们展示了对双黑洞并合 GW250114（迄今探测到的最响引力波事件）铃宕中一组二次准正规模的首次观测证据，这得益于一种新的分析。这些非线性模式来自线性 (2,2,n) 模式（n≤3）的二次耦合。从并合后对应于四倍残余质量 (M_f) 的时间开始分析，它们存在的证据达到贝叶斯因子 62。一个允许这些模式偏离理论预言的唯象检验以 3.4σ 的显著性排除零振幅假设，而推断的振幅和复频率与广义相对论的预言一致。这一发现提供了引力波-波相互作用的首次观测证据，并将黑洞谱学从线性扩展到非线性区。它也为用最极端引力检验广义相对论的基本非线性结构确立了一个新方向。
classification.one_liner: 在 GW250114 铃宕中发现二次准正规模的观测证据，将黑洞谱学从线性推进到非线性区。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究双黑洞并合铃宕中的准正规模与非线性波-波耦合，属于经典引力/广义相对论，并对应 QNM 与非线性演化重点方向。

papers.title: Timelike Ollivier-Ricci curvature
papers.abstract: We introduce a codimension one construction of coarse Ricci curvature in Lorentzian geometry. Using the $1$-Lorentz-Wasserstein distance $\ell_1$, we compare probability measures supported on small spacelike hypersurfaces through nearby events and recover, in a precise asymptotic regime, the ambient Ricci curvature in future-directed unit timelike directions, with a universal dimensional prefactor reflecting this codimension one construction. The construction echoes the Raychaudhuri equation, which relates the evolution of spatial volume expansion along timelike geodesics to Ricci curvature. Our quantitative estimates rely on transport maps with controlled displacement, constructed through a Moser-type flow. At leading order, the slice construction is insensitive to smooth weights. By smearing the spacelike slices into thin timelike tubes and calibrating the temporal and spatial scales, we recover the timelike Bakry-\'Emery tensor $\mathrm{Ric}+\mathrm{Hess}\,V$ associated with the weighted reference measure $\smash{\mathfrak{m}=\mathrm{e}^{-V}\,\mathrm{vol}_g}$.

classification.title_zh: 时间性 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率
classification.abstract_zh: 我们引入一种在洛伦兹几何中余维一构造的粗粒化 Ricci 曲率。利用 1-Lorentz-Wasserstein 距离 ℓ1，我们通过邻近事件比较支撑在小类空超曲面上的概率测度，并在精确渐近区域恢复沿未来指向单位类时方向的背景 Ricci 曲率，具有反映该余维一构造的普适维度前因子。该构造呼应 Raychaudhuri 方程，后者将沿类时测地线的空间体积膨胀演化与 Ricci 曲率联系起来。我们的定量估计依赖于通过 Moser 型流构造的受控位移输运映射。在领头阶，切片构造对光滑权重不敏感。通过将类空切片涂抹为薄类时管并校准时间与空间尺度，我们恢复与加权参考测度 m=e^{-V} vol_g 相关的时间性 Bakry-Émery 张量 Ric+Hess V。
classification.one_liner: 在洛伦兹几何中通过最优传输构造余维一粗粒 Ricci 曲率，并渐近恢复时间性 Ricci 曲率及 Bakry-Émery 张量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典洛伦兹几何/广义相对论中的 Ricci 曲率与 Raychaudhuri 方程主题，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；不涉及全息、量子引力或黑洞信息。

papers.title: Infrared Universality of Scalar Induced Gravitational Waves Beyond Second Order
papers.abstract: Primordial black hole dark matter is formed from the collapse of enhanced primordial density fluctuations. The formation of primordial black holes is accompanied by scalar induced gravitational waves whose infrared scaling only depends on the equation of state, $w$, of the background at leading order. Establishing whether this characteristic scaling remains robust under corrections of arbitrary perturbative order, including in the presence of non-Gaussianities, requires a physical understanding of the infrared scaling. In this work, we provide such a physical interpretation. We find that the stress of sound waves with nearly equal frequencies produces a slow beat. Although the incoming waves oscillate rapidly, this slow beat continues to source the long wavelength tensor perturbation before its horizon entry, thus generating an infrared scaling that only depends on the expanding background. We show that higher order interactions generate freely propagating waves that finally lead to the same slow beat deep inside the horizon. Since non-Gaussianities would not change the speed of the freely propagating waves, they do not modify the infrared scaling. As the source with a slow beat has enough time to accumulate before the horizon entry of the infrared tensor mode, it records the background expansion and thus the infrared scaling could provide a robust probe of the cosmological equation of state.

classification.title_zh: 二阶以上标量诱导引力波的红外普适性
classification.abstract_zh: 原初黑洞暗物质由增强的原初密度扰动坍缩形成。原初黑洞的形成伴随标量诱导引力波，其红外标度在领头阶只依赖于背景的状态方程 w。要确定这一特征标度在任意微扰阶修正下（包括存在非高斯性时）是否仍然稳健，需要对红外标度有物理理解。本文提供了这种物理解释。我们发现，频率近似相等的声波应力会产生慢拍。尽管入射波快速振荡，这种慢拍在其视界进入之前持续作为长波长张量扰动的源，从而产生只依赖于膨胀背景的红外标度。我们表明，高阶相互作用会产生自由传播的波，这些波最终在视界深处导致相同的慢拍。由于非高斯性不会改变自由传播波的速度，因此它们不会修改红外标度。由于具有慢拍的源在红外张量模进入视界之前有足够时间积累，它记录了背景膨胀，因此红外标度可以为宇宙学状态方程提供稳健的探针。
classification.one_liner: 标量诱导引力波的红外标度源于近等频声波的慢拍，只依赖于背景状态方程，且对高阶微扰和非高斯性稳健。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于宇宙学中的标量诱导引力波/经典引力波研究，匹配‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签，但与全息、AdS/CFT 及各全息凝聚态支线无直接关系。

papers.title: Proper Time Shifts in Pulsar Timing Arrays
papers.abstract: Pulsar timing arrays are a powerful tool for probing low-frequency gravitational phenomena and physics beyond the Standard Model. We establish a general, gauge-invariant framework for the timing residual by identifying the measurable quantity as the proper time interval between consecutive pulse arrivals at Earth. In linearized general relativity, we derive a general expression for this proper time shift and show that it decomposes into Doppler, Shapiro, and Einstein delay contributions whose sum is gauge invariant, similar to frameworks that have been developed for other gravitational-wave detectors such as laser and atom interferometers. We also provide a recipe for computing the resulting timing residual for any specified perturbation, and we illustrate the method with several physically well-motivated sources, recovering known results where they exist in the literature. This recipe can be directly applied to search for new physics from real pulsar timing data using existing numerical software.

classification.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列中的固有时移
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列是探测低频引力现象和超越标准模型物理的有力工具。我们建立了一个关于计时残差的普适且规范不变的框架，将可测量量认定为地球处连续脉冲到达之间的固有时时间间隔。在线性化广义相对论中，我们推导了该固有时移的一般表达式，并表明它分解为多普勒延迟、夏皮罗延迟和爱因斯坦延迟贡献，其总和规范不变，类似于为激光干涉仪和原子干涉仪等其他引力波探测器所建立的框架。我们还给出了对任意指定微扰计算所得计时残差的方法，并用若干物理动机明确的源来说明该方法，在文献已有结果处重现了已知结果。该方案可直接应用于利用现有数值软件从真实脉冲星计时数据中搜寻新物理。
classification.one_liner: 建立脉冲星计时阵列中规范不变的固有时移框架，统一推导多普勒、夏皮罗与爱因斯坦延迟并用于新物理搜寻。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究线性化广义相对论、引力波探测与脉冲星计时，直接对应重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”。

papers.title: Unifying spatial correlation with hierarchical population inference to constrain the AGN channel for binary black hole mergers
papers.abstract: The origin of the stellar-mass binary black holes (BBHs) observed in gravitational wave (GW) events by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) detectors remains uncertain. One promising formation pathway is the active galactic nucleus (AGN) channel, in which BBHs embedded in AGN accretion discs experience enhanced merger rates and may produce rapidly spinning black holes in the upper mass gap. Previous constraints on the AGN contribution to the LVK merger population have relied either on spatial correlations between GW localisations and AGN catalogues or on modelling the intrinsic properties of GW sources. We develop a hierarchical Bayesian framework that unifies these approaches within a single likelihood for the fraction of AGN-hosted GW events, $f_{\rm agn}$. This framework, combined with the latest gravitational wave transient catalogue GWTC-5.0 and the electromagnetic Quaia AGN catalogue, cannot exclude an AGN contribution to the observed merger rate. For unobscured AGN in the optical and infrared bands with bolometric luminosities $L_{\rm bol}\geq\{10^{44.5},10^{45.5},10^{46.5}\}\,\mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}}$, we exclude $f_{\rm agn} \geq \{0.52,0.41, 0.61\}$ at the 95 percent credible level under our fiducial model. The methodology and results presented in this work lay down the pathway for combining the full GW posterior with electromagnetic observations to infer the properties of GW populations and AGN discs.

classification.title_zh: 将空间关联与分层族群推断统一起来以限制双黑洞并合的AGN通道
classification.abstract_zh: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA（LVK）探测器在引力波（GW）事件中观测到的恒星级双黑洞（BBH）的起源仍不确定。一个有前景的形成途径是活动星系核（AGN）通道，其中嵌入AGN吸积盘内的BBH经历增强的并合率，并可能在上质量间隙中产生快速自旋的黑洞。此前对AGN在LVK并合族群中贡献的限制，要么依赖于GW定位与AGN星表之间的空间关联，要么依赖于对GW源内禀性质的建模。我们发展了一个分层贝叶斯框架，将这两种方法统一在关于AGN宿主GW事件比例 f_agn 的单个似然中。该框架结合最新的引力波瞬变星表 GWTC-5.0 和电磁 Quaia AGN 星表，无法排除AGN对所观测并合率的贡献。对于光学和红外波段中未被遮蔽、热辐射光度 L_bol ≥ {10^44.5, 10^45.5, 10^46.5} erg/s 的AGN，在我们基准模型下，我们在95%可信水平排除 f_agn ≥ {0.52, 0.41, 0.61}。这项工作提出的方法和结果为将完整GW后验与电磁观测结合起来以推断GW族群和AGN盘的性质铺平了道路。
classification.one_liner: 该工作提出统一空间关联与分层族群推断的贝叶斯框架，利用 GWTC-5.0 与 Quaia AGN 星表限制双黑洞并合的 AGN 通道贡献。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波与黑洞天体物理，使用GW观测和AGN星表限制双黑洞并合形成通道，可归入“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线中的引力波方向；但它不涉及全息、AdS/CFT或量子引力。

papers.title: Fermionic Signatures of Antispacetime-spacetime Domain Walls
papers.abstract: Antispacetime arises naturally in the vielbein formulation of general relativity yet remains invisible to probes coupling only to the metric. We show that domain walls separating spacetime from antispacetime constitute physically distinct and observable structures. Fermions interacting with such walls exhibit striking signatures: scattering induces particle-hole conversion, reflecting tetrad orientation reversal, while the wall hosts localized zero-energy Majorana and chiral modes. In 1+1 dimensions, these modes acquire a pseudoscalar mass term tied to topology and quantum anomalies, providing a direct link to the observability of $\theta$ vacua. These results identify fermionic response as a definitive probe of antispacetime and establish its domain walls as physically detectable.

classification.title_zh: 反时空-时空畴壁的费米子特征
classification.abstract_zh: 反时空自然出现在广义相对论的标架（vielbein）表述中，但对仅与度规耦合的探针不可见。我们表明，分隔时空与反时空的畴壁是物理上不同且可观测的结构。与这类畴壁相互作用的费米子表现出显著特征：散射诱导粒子-空穴转换，反映标架取向反转；同时畴壁承载局域化的零能 Majorana 模和手征模。在 1+1 维中，这些模获得与拓扑和量子反常相关的赝标量质量项，为 θ 真空的可观测性提供直接联系。这些结果将费米子响应确定为反时空的决定性探针，并确立其畴壁在物理上可探测。
classification.one_liner: 反时空-时空畴壁可通过费米子散射的粒子-空穴转换和局域 Majorana/手征模被探测，1+1 维质量项联系拓扑与 θ 真空。
classification.relevance_reason: 不属于 AdS/CFT 全息，但直接涉及广义相对论标架表述中的时空/反时空畴壁，并研究局域费米子模式，匹配经典引力与畴壁/非均匀重点标签。

papers.title: Searching for gravitational wave echo with group equivariant neural posterior estimation
papers.abstract: Current methods for the gravitational-wave (GW) echo searches generally require substantial computational time and resources. Recent advances in group equivariant neural posterior estimation (GNPE) have demonstrated the potential to substantially accelerate posterior inference. In this work, we adopt this framework and train a GNPE model to perform echo searches, significantly improving computational efficiency while maintaining comparable inference accuracy. We apply it to the O4a events and find no significant evidence for the GW echo.

classification.title_zh: 用群等变神经后验估计搜寻引力波回声
classification.abstract_zh: 当前引力波（GW）回声搜寻方法通常需要大量计算时间和资源。群等变神经后验估计（GNPE）的最新进展已显示出大幅加速后验推断的潜力。在这项工作中，我们采用该框架并训练一个 GNPE 模型来进行回声搜寻，在保持相近推断精度的同时显著提高计算效率。我们将其应用于 O4a 事件，未发现引力波回声的显著证据。
classification.one_liner: 采用群等变神经后验估计加速引力波回声搜寻，并在 O4a 事件中未发现显著回声证据。

papers.title: Massively parallel transdimensional sampling with data assimilation: an application to LISA galactic binaries
papers.abstract: Transdimensional Bayesian inference is becoming a key ingredient in gravitational-wave astronomy. In many relevant applications, the number of components needed to describe the data is not known a priori and must be inferred jointly with their parameters. We present a transdimensional Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) framework designed to exploit massive parallelism. The method evolves a population of particles through a sequence of tempered distributions and uses the No-U-Turn Sampler for the exploration of fixed-dimensional parameter space while reversible-jump birth and death moves allow the number of components to vary. The same SMC construction also enables posterior samples obtained from a shorter data segment to be updated as additional data become available, enhancing the overall efficiency of the analysis. We validate the approach on two proof-of-concept problems: the recovery of a sequence of Gaussian pulses and a simplified LISA Galactic-binary inference problem. In both cases, the method recovers the injected number of components and produces consistent posterior estimates. These results indicate that the proposed method is a promising avenue toward scalable and parallel Bayesian transdimensional inference for current and future gravitational-wave astronomy.

classification.title_zh: 大规模并行跨维采样与数据同化：应用于 LISA 银河双星
classification.abstract_zh: 跨维贝叶斯推断正在成为引力波天文学的关键组成部分。在许多相关应用中，描述数据所需的组分数目并非先验已知，必须与其参数联合推断。我们提出一个跨维序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）框架，旨在利用大规模并行性。该方法使粒子群通过一系列退火分布演化，并使用 No-U-Turn Sampler 探索固定维参数空间，同时可逆跳变的生灭移动允许组分数目变化。同一 SMC 构造还使得从较短数据段获得的后验样本能够在更多数据可用时得到更新，从而提高分析的整体效率。我们在两个概念验证问题上验证了该方法：恢复一系列高斯脉冲和一个简化的 LISA 银河双星推断问题。在这两种情况下，该方法都恢复了注入的组分数目，并产生一致的后验估计。这些结果表明，所提出的方法是为当前和未来引力波天文学实现可扩展并行贝叶斯跨维推断的一条有前景的途径。
classification.one_liner: 提出可大规模并行的跨维序贯蒙特卡洛推断框架，用可逆跳变与 NUTS 处理未知组分数，并在 LISA 银河双星等概念验证中验证。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波天文学/经典引力支线中的贝叶斯推断与数据同化方法，非全息研究；若关注 LISA 与引力波推断则相关，但与 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶无直接关系。

papers.title: A closer look at Viaggiu Holographic Dark Energy with Statefinder Hierarchy and Fractional Growth Diagnostics
papers.abstract: We employ the statefinder hierarchy along with the fractional growth parameter to investigate the recently proposed noninteracting Viaggiu holographic dark energy (VHDE) model with the future event horizon as the infrared cut-off. By adjusting different values of the VHDE model parameter $\delta$, we illustrate the evolution trajectories of several important parameters, prticularly, the statefinder hierarchy $S_3^{(1)}$, $S_3^{(2)}$, $S_4^{(1)}$, $S_4^{(2)}$ and the fractional growth parameter $\epsilon$ against the redshift $z$ and the fractional energy density of matter, $\Omega_m$. Together with the growth rate of matter perturbations, we present the statefinder hierarchy that defines a composite null diagnostic (CND), which can differentiate dynamical dark energy from $\Lambda$CDM. The joint use of the statefinder hierarchy and the fractional growth parameter offers a powerful diagnostic tool for probing VHDE, effectively resolving the degeneracy between different parameter choices within the model. We find that employing a CND pair, rather than a single diagnostic, significantly enhances the diagnostic power for the VHDE model. Finally, we perform an $\omega_d-\omega_d'$ analysis and, in addition, assess the squared sound speed $v_{s}^{2}$ to determine the model's dynamical stability under small perturbations.

classification.title_zh: 利用状态查找器层级与分数增长诊断细察 Viaggiu 全息暗能量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用状态查找器（statefinder）层级以及分数增长参数，研究最近提出的、以未来事件视界为红外截断的非相互作用 Viaggiu 全息暗能量（VHDE）模型。通过调节 VHDE 模型参数 δ 的不同取值，我们展示了若干重要参数的演化轨迹，特别是状态查找器层级 S_3^(1)、S_3^(2)、S_4^(1)、S_4^(2) 和分数增长参数 ε 随红移 z 以及物质分数能量密度 Ω_m 的变化。结合物质扰动增长率，我们给出了定义复合零诊断（CND）的状态查找器层级，它能够区分动力学暗能量与 ΛCDM。联合使用状态查找器层级和分数增长参数为探测 VHDE 提供了强有力的诊断工具，有效解决了模型内部不同参数选择之间的简并。我们发现，采用 CND 对而非单一诊断，显著增强了对 VHDE 模型的诊断能力。最后，我们进行了 ω_d-ω_d' 分析，并评估平方声速 v_s^2，以确定模型在小扰动下的动力学稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 用 statefinder 层级和分数增长诊断检验 Viaggiu 全息暗能量模型，并用复合零诊断区分动力学暗能量与 ΛCDM。
classification.relevance_reason: 本文虽以‘全息暗能量’为名，但属于宇宙学暗能量模型诊断，不涉及 AdS/CFT 对偶或量子引力全息；与用户重点的全息强关联、纠缠/量子信息等方向关联较低，仅与经典引力/宇宙学有边缘关联。

papers.title: From Geometry to Gravity: A Friendly Introduction to the Schwarzschild Metric
papers.abstract: The first exact solution to the field equations of general relativity was found by the German physicist and astronomer Karl Schwarzschild in 1916. Due to its simplicity and its various astronomical applications, the Schwarzschild solution is the most important, which gives it great educational potential. However, this potential is not usually exploited, since the Schwarzschild solution is generally taught in advanced undergraduate physics courses or in specialized graduate courses. The objective of this article is to offer a friendly introduction to the Schwarzschild solution, and at the same time analyze some concepts of Riemannian geometry and general relativity, employing only simple mathematical tools that do not go beyond the rudiments of differential and integral calculus.

classification.title_zh: 从几何到引力：Schwarzschild度规的友好导论
classification.abstract_zh: 德国物理学家和天文学家卡尔·史瓦西于1916年找到了广义相对论场方程的第一个精确解。由于其简洁性以及多种天文学应用，史瓦西解是最重要的，这赋予它巨大的教育潜力。然而这种潜力通常未被充分利用，因为史瓦西解一般在高级本科物理课程或专门的研究生课程中讲授。本文旨在对史瓦西解作友好介绍，同时分析黎曼几何与广义相对论的一些概念，仅使用不超过微积分初步的简单数学工具。
classification.one_liner: 一篇仅用微积分基础、面向初学者的Schwarzschild解与广义相对论/黎曼几何概念教学导论。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，但为教学性介绍而非新的研究结果。

papers.title: Fold-Point Scaling and Phenomenological Cascade Closures in Regular Black Hole Spacetimes
papers.abstract: Semiclassical analyses of regular black holes suggest that inner-horizon instabilities can drive the trapped region to evaporate faster than the Hawking time and seed a transient anti-trapped region. Whether this repeats into a cascade terminating in a horizon-free configuration requires a self-consistent solution of the semiclassical Einstein equations, which we do not attempt. Instead, within the static Bardeen family, we show that the renormalized-stress-tensor (RSET) result of Arrechea, Liberati and Spadafora (arXiv:2608.03538) does not by itself force any damping of a hypothetical cascade near extremality, since its near-extremal limit at fixed cycle duration is finite and nonzero. We then prove, under explicit nondegeneracy hypotheses on any static metric family whose horizons merge at a fold point, that the inner-horizon surface gravity scales as |kappa_-| ~ (M-M_crit)^{1/2}, and verify this in two regular black hole families, Bardeen and Hayward, with a quantified systematic uncertainty. A phenomenological closure built on this scaling gives a mass gap decaying as x_n ~ n^{-2}, generalizing to x_n ~ n^{-1/(pq)} for a fold exponent p and an uncalibrated closure exponent q; the required cycle count is a property of the closure, not a physical prediction. As a separate exercise, we build an effective adiabatic model for the outer-horizon mass from the exact Einstein tensor of a generalized Vaidya-Bardeen ansatz matched to the cited RSET flux; the resulting law includes an O(1) correction absent from the naive Schwarzschild-Vaidya relation, relaxes to M_crit only asymptotically, and gives a timescale shorter than the inner-horizon amplification timescale by up to four orders of magnitude away from extremality but longer very close to extremality. We distinguish what is derived under stated assumptions from what the closure simply postulates.

classification.title_zh: 规则黑洞时空中的折叠点标度与现象学级联闭合
classification.abstract_zh: 对规则黑洞的半经典分析表明，内视界不稳定性可驱动囚禁区比霍金时间更快蒸发，并孕育瞬态反囚禁区。这是否重复成终止于无视界位形的级联，需要对半经典 Einstein 方程的自洽求解，而作者并未尝试。相反，在静态 Bardeen 族中，他们表明 Arrechea、Liberati 和 Spadafora 的重整化应力张量（RSET）结果本身并不强制假设级联在近极端处的任何阻尼，因为固定循环周期下其近极端极限有限且非零。随后，在对任何在折叠点视界合并的静态度规族施加显式非退化假设下，他们证明内视界表面引力按 |κ_-| ~ (M-M_crit)^{1/2} 标度，并在 Bardeen 与 Hayward 两个规则黑洞族中验证，给出了量化系统不确定度。基于该标度的现象学闭合给出按 x_n ~ n^{-2} 衰减的质量间隙，并推广为 x_n ~ n^{-1/(pq)}，其中折叠指数 p、未校准闭合指数 q；所需循环数是闭合的性质，而非物理预言。作为单独练习，他们由匹配到所引 RSET 通量的广义 Vaidya-Bardeen 拟设的精确 Einstein 张量，构建外视界质量的有效绝热模型；所得规律包含朴素 Schwarzschild-Vaidya 关系中缺失的 O(1) 修正，仅渐近松弛到 M_crit，并给出在远离极端处比内视界放大时标短最多四个数量级、但在非常接近极端处更长的时标。作者区分了在所述假设下导出的内容与闭合仅假设的内容。
classification.one_liner: 在规则黑洞中，作者证明折叠点处内视界表面引力的平方根标度，并据此构造现象学级联闭合，同时澄清 RSET 与推导/假设的边界。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究半经典规则黑洞、内视界不稳定性与经典时空度规族，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Horizon Structure and Geodesic Properties of Simpson-Visser Black Holes in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg Theory
papers.abstract: We investigate a regularized charged black hole (BH) spacetime constructed by applying the Simpson-Visser (SV) prescription to a BH in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg (EEH) theory. The resulting Simpson-Visser Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg (SV-EEH) geometry incorporates nonlinear electromagnetic corrections through the parameter $(a)$ and the SV regularization through the length scale $(b)$. By varying these parameters, spacetime provides a smooth interpolation between a regular BH, a one-way wormhole, and a traversable wormhole configuration. Introducing the effective areal radius $(R=\sqrt{r^{2}+b^{2}})$, we analyze the horizon structure and derive the conditions for degenerate and extremal configurations. Furthermore, we examine the null and timelike geodesic structures, computing the photon sphere radius, the BH shadow size, and the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). Our results demonstrate how nonlinear electrodynamics and SV regularization jointly modify the causal and geodesic structure of charged BHs while preserving the appropriate Reissner-Nordstr\"om and SV limits.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg 理论中 Simpson-Visser 黑洞的视界结构与测地线性质
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个正则带电黑洞时空，它通过将 Simpson-Visser (SV) 方案应用于 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg (EEH) 理论中的黑洞而构造。所得的 Simpson-Visser Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg (SV-EEH) 几何通过参数 (a) 引入非线性电磁修正，并通过长度尺度 (b) 引入 SV 正则化。通过改变这些参数，该时空可在正则黑洞、单向虫洞和可穿越虫洞构型之间平滑插值。引入有效面积半径 R = sqrt(r^2 + b^2) 后，我们分析了视界结构，并推导了简并与极值构型的条件。此外，我们考察了零测地线和类时测地线结构，计算了光子球半径、黑洞阴影大小和最内稳定圆轨道 (ISCO)。我们的结果表明，非线性电动力学和 SV 正则化如何共同修改带电黑洞的因果与测地线结构，同时保留相应的 Reissner-Nordström 和 SV 极限。
classification.one_liner: 将 Simpson-Visser 正则化与非线性的 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg 电动力学结合，研究正则带电黑洞/虫洞的视界、测地线、光子球、阴影和 ISCO。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典/半经典引力中的黑洞时空研究，直接对应重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；未涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子信息。

papers.title: Exceptional points and the breaking of Schwarzschild isospectrality under local potential perturbations
papers.abstract: The odd- and even-parity gravitational perturbations of a Schwarzschild black hole are governed by the distinct Regge-Wheeler and Zerilli potentials, yet their quasinormal-mode (QNM) spectra are identical in vacuum. Building on our previous study of the odd-parity Regge-Wheeler spectrum [M. Ould El Hadj and S. R. Dolan, arXiv:2608.16283], we investigate the corresponding even-parity Zerilli problem and compare the two sectors under the same perturbation of amplitude $\epsilon$ at radius $r_0$. Using the Chandrasekhar-Detweiler relation, we derive an exact relation between the normalized Wronskians and show that Schwarzschild QNM isospectrality is not preserved under an identical nonzero localized defect. We find that the even- and odd-parity repelling-point branches approach the same Schwarzschild QNM frequencies at large $r_0$, with their first parity-dependent separation appearing at order $1/\mathcal R^2$, where $\mathcal R=r_{0*}/M$ is the dimensionless tortoise-coordinate location of the defect. The corresponding exceptional points (EPs) form two shifted sequences with the same asymptotic spacing in the tortoise coordinate, while their relative displacement is fixed by the phase of the asymptotic Chandrasekhar-Detweiler factor. The critical perturbation amplitudes share the same exponential decay rate in the two sectors, whereas the ratio of their asymptotic prefactors is fixed by the modulus of the same factor. We further find that the even- and odd-parity EPs connect the same neighboring QNM overtones, with nearly identical arclengths for the corresponding spectral bridges. Finally, the exceptional degeneracy is parity selective: at identical values of $(r_0,\epsilon)$, a pair of QNMs may coalesce at an EP in one parity sector while remaining distinct in the other, leading to a corresponding difference in the local pole structure of the ringdown response.

classification.title_zh: 局部势扰动下的例外点与史瓦西等谱性的破缺
classification.abstract_zh: 史瓦西黑洞的奇宇称与偶宇称引力扰动分别由不同的 Regge-Wheeler 和 Zerilli 势描述，但在真空中它们的准正规模（QNM）谱相同。基于我们此前对奇宇称 Regge-Wheeler 谱的研究 [M. Ould El Hadj and S. R. Dolan, arXiv:2608.16283]，我们研究相应的偶宇称 Zerilli 问题，并在半径 r0 处施加相同振幅 ε 的扰动下比较这两个扇区。利用 Chandrasekhar-Detweiler 关系，我们推导了归一化 Wronskian 之间的精确关系，并表明在相同的非零局域缺陷下，史瓦西 QNM 等谱性不再保持。我们发现，偶宇称与奇宇称的排斥点分支在大 r0 下趋近相同的史瓦西 QNM 频率，其首个依赖宇称的分离出现在 1/R^2 阶，其中 R = r_{0*}/M 是缺陷在无量纲龟坐标中的位置。相应的例外点（EP）形成两个平移序列，在龟坐标中具有相同的渐近间距，而其相对位移由渐近 Chandrasekhar-Detweiler 因子的相位固定。两个扇区的临界扰动振幅具有相同的指数衰减率，而其渐近前因子的比值由同一因子的模固定。我们进一步发现，偶宇称与奇宇称 EP 连接相同的相邻 QNM 泛音，相应谱桥的弧长几乎相同。最后，例外简并是宇称选择性的：在相同的 (r0, ε) 值下，一对 QNM 可能在一个宇称扇区中于 EP 处合并，而在另一个扇区中仍保持分开，从而导致铃宕响应局域极点结构的相应差异。
classification.one_liner: 该文研究史瓦西黑洞奇偶宇称准正规模的等谱性如何被局域势缺陷破坏，并揭示其例外点谱结构及宇称选择性。

papers.title: Observationally Reconstructed Spacetime of NGC 5907: Dark-Matter-Corrected Black Hole Thermodynamics and Galactic Shadow
papers.abstract: We present an observationally guided relativistic framework to investigate the thermodynamic and optical properties of a black hole in the NGC 5907 galaxy. By reconstructing the spacetime directly from the observed rotation curve, we obtain a dark-matter-corrected metric that incorporates both the galactic halo and the central compact object. The reconstructed geometry admits horizon solutions, allowing us to evaluate the Hawking temperature, Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, and heat capacity, which indicate a thermodynamically stable supermassive black hole influenced by its dark matter environment. We further analyze photon motion and the resulting gravitational shadow, deriving the photon sphere, critical impact parameter, and shadow size. Comparison with WISE W1 infrared photometry shows consistency with the predicted suppression of photon escape near the shadow radius. These results establish a unified link between galactic rotation curves, dark matter, black hole thermodynamics, and observable photometric signatures.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: NGC 5907 的观测重构时空：暗物质修正的黑洞热力学与星系阴影
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个由观测引导的相对论框架，用来研究 NGC 5907 星系中黑洞的热力学与光学性质。通过直接从观测到的旋转曲线重构时空，我们得到了一个同时包含星系晕和中心致密天体的暗物质修正度规。重构几何允许视界解，使我们能够计算 Hawking 温度、Bekenstein-Hawking 熵和热容，结果表明该超大质量黑洞在暗物质环境影响下热力学稳定。我们进一步分析光子运动及由此产生的引力阴影，推导出光子球、临界碰撞参数和阴影大小。与 WISE W1 红外测光比较，显示与阴影半径附近光子逃逸受到抑制的预言一致。这些结果在星系旋转曲线、暗物质、黑洞热力学和可观测测光特征之间建立了统一联系。
classification.one_liner: 从 NGC 5907 旋转曲线重构含暗物质晕与中心天体的度规，研究黑洞热力学、光子球与引力阴影。
classification.relevance_reason: 主要属于经典引力/广义相对论支线：重构暗物质修正度规并研究黑洞热力学与阴影，不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: A singularity theorem in terms of asymptotic expansion
papers.abstract: We prove a sharp singularity theorem in which the classical focusing hypothesis of Hawking--Penrose theory is replaced by a condition on the asymptotic volume growth of timelike geodesics. More precisely, let $(M,g)$ be a smooth, globally hyperbolic Lorentzian manifold satisfying the strong energy condition, and let $V\subset M$ be a smooth, compact Cauchy hypersurface. We associate to the future-directed timelike geodesics orthogonal to $V$ asymptotic volume-expansion invariants $\theta_\alpha$, and show that a uniform lower bound $\theta_\alpha\ge c>0$ forces a sharp upper bound on the time separation between $V$ and its chronological past. In particular, $(M,g)$ is past timelike geodesically incomplete. The estimate is sharp and equality is attained by Lorentzian cones. Moreover, in the smooth setting we prove a rigidity theorem showing that equality characterizes these cone models. The argument extends to globally hyperbolic Lorentzian length spaces satisfying the synthetic strong energy condition in the form of the Timelike Measure Contraction Property, TMCP(0,N). In this non-smooth setting we also obtain corresponding raywise and measure-rigidity statements.

classification.title_zh: 基于渐近展开的奇点定理
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明了一个尖锐的奇点定理，用类时测地线的渐近体积增长条件取代了 Hawking--Penrose 理论中的经典聚焦假设。具体地，设 (M,g) 为满足强能量条件的光滑全局双曲洛伦兹流形，V⊂M 为光滑紧致 Cauchy 超曲面。我们对与 V 正交的未来指向类时测地线定义渐近体积膨胀不变量 θ_α，并证明一致下界 θ_α ≥ c > 0 会迫使 V 与其时序过去之间的时间间隔具有尖锐上界。特别地，(M,g) 是过去类时测地不完备的。该估计是尖锐的，并且等号由洛伦兹锥实现。在光滑情形下，我们还证明了刚性定理，刻画了等号情形对应于锥模型。论证可推广到满足合成强能量条件（以类时测度收缩性质 TMCP(0,N) 表述）的全局双曲洛伦兹长度空间。在非光滑情形下，我们也得到相应的逐射线和测度刚性陈述。
classification.one_liner: 用类时测地线渐近体积膨胀代替经典聚焦条件，证明尖锐奇点定理与锥模型刚性，并推广到满足 TMCP 的洛伦兹长度空间。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论/洛伦兹几何中的奇点定理研究，直接匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”，且不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Komar superpotentials in extended theories of gravity
papers.abstract: This paper investigates Lagrangians with arbitrary dependence on the Riemann tensor and any number of derivatives. Noether's second theorem is applied separately to ${\cal L}_{G}$ and ${\cal L}_{M}$, where the matter Lagrangian depends on a scalar field. For ${\cal L}_{G}$ diffeomorphism invariance requires that the generalized Einstein tensor satisfy $\nabla_{\alpha}E^{\alpha\beta}=0$ and that there is a current satisfying $0=\partial_{\alpha}(\sqrt{g}\, J^{\alpha}_{G2})$. The main result is an explicit formula for the superpotential $\Phi^{[\alpha\mu]}$ that solves $\partial_{\mu}\Phi^{[\alpha\mu]}=\sqrt{g}\,J^{\alpha}_{G2}$. Some applications to $f(R)$ gravity and various quadratic gravity theories are discussed. There are analogous results, including superpotentials, for the matter sector whenever the couplings to the matter fields contain derivatives of the metric.

classification.title_zh: 扩展引力理论中的Komar超势
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究对黎曼张量有任意依赖且可含任意阶导数的拉格朗日量。将诺特定理第二定理分别应用于 ${\cal L}_{G}$ 和 ${\cal L}_{M}$，其中物质拉格朗日量依赖于标量场。对于 ${\cal L}_{G}$，微分同胚不变性要求广义爱因斯坦张量满足 $\nabla_{\alpha}E^{\alpha\beta}=0$，并且存在满足 $0=\partial_{\alpha}(\sqrt{g}\, J^{\alpha}_{G2})$ 的流。主要结果是给出超势 $\Phi^{[\alpha\mu]}$ 的显式公式，使其满足 $\partial_{\mu}\Phi^{[\alpha\mu]}=\sqrt{g}\,J^{\alpha}_{G2}$。文中讨论了在 $f(R)$ 引力和各种二次引力理论中的一些应用。当物质场与度规的耦合包含度规导数时，物质部分也有类似结果，包括超势。
classification.one_liner: 将诺特定理第二定理用于含任意黎曼张量依赖与任意阶导数的引力/物质拉格朗日量，导出Komar型超势的显式公式。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论，讨论扩展引力理论中的守恒量与超势；但不涉及全息对偶或AdS/CFT，因此相关性为中等。

papers.title: Periodic orbits around a magnetically charged black hole in $f(R,T)$ gravity coupled with Euler-Heisenberg electrodynamics
papers.abstract: We systematically investigate the zoom-whirl periodic orbits of a small compact object orbiting a magnetically charged black hole in $f(R, T)$ gravity coupled with Euler-Heisenberg nonlinear electrodynamics. We evaluate the impact of the magnetic charge $Q_m$ and the Euler-Heisenberg parameter $a$ on the characteristics of the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) and the marginally bound orbit (MBO). Particularly, we focus on the precession parameter q and systematically examine how the magnetic charge and other parameters affect the trajectories of periodic orbits. Using the numerical kludge method, we generate gravitational waveforms for these periodic orbits. The results presented in our work demonstrate that the magnetic charge can significantly modify not only the precession parameter but also the orbital trajectories of the periodic orbits. Moreover, changing the magnetic charge $Q_m$ could cause a significant phase shift in the gravitational waveforms, while other parameters exert a relatively weaker influence on the gravitational waves.

classification.title_zh: f(R,T) 引力耦合 Euler-Heisenberg 电动力学中磁荷黑洞周围的周期轨道
classification.abstract_zh: 我们系统研究了在 f(R,T) 引力耦合 Euler-Heisenberg 非线性电动力学中，一个小致密天体绕磁荷黑洞运动的 zoom-whirl 周期轨道。我们评估了磁荷 Q_m 和 Euler-Heisenberg 参数 a 对最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）和边际束缚轨道（MBO）特征的影响。特别地，我们关注进动参数 q，并系统考察磁荷及其他参数如何影响周期轨道的轨迹。利用数值 kludge 方法，我们为这些周期轨道生成了引力波形。结果说明，磁荷不仅能显著修改进动参数，也能显著修改周期轨道的轨迹。此外，改变磁荷 Q_m 会导致引力波形出现显著相位移动，而其他参数对引力波的影响相对较弱。
classification.one_liner: 在 f(R,T) 引力与 Euler-Heisenberg 非线性电动力学中，磁荷黑洞周围致密天体的周期轨道及其引力波特征。

papers.title: Octupolar Gravitational Radiation in de Sitter Spacetime
papers.abstract: We derive the gravitational radiation generated by a localised matter source in de Sitter spacetime at octupolar order in the multipolar expansion, working in generalised harmonic gauge in the future Poincar\'e patch. The scalar, vector, and tensor perturbation equations are solved explicitly, taking into account the cosmological tail. This constitutes the first extension of the de Sitter multipolar expansion beyond quadrupolar order. A key technical ingredient is a universal multipole moment differentiation identity, which unifies the relations between multipole moments into a single recursive formula and enables a controlled extension to higher multipoles. Using the symmetric trace-free tensor formalism of Blanchet, Damour, and Iyer, we further develop a systematic translation of the radiative solution into a spherical harmonic basis, and apply it to both the quadrupolar and octupolar metric perturbations. This representation renders the angular structure of the radiation manifest, simplifies the verification of the linearised field equations, and facilitates direct comparison with Bondi-gauge and other perturbative treatments of de Sitter spacetime.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 时空中的八极引力辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 de Sitter 时空的未来 Poincaré 片中，采用广义调和规范，推导了局域物质源在多极展开中八极阶产生的引力辐射。我们显式求解了标量、矢量与张量扰动方程，并考虑了宇宙学尾项。这是 de Sitter 多极展开首次被推广到四极阶之外。一个关键的技术要素是一个普适的多极矩微分恒等式，它将多极矩之间的关系统一为一个递归公式，并使得向更高多极的受控推广成为可能。利用 Blanchet、Damour 与 Iyer 的对称无迹张量形式，我们进一步发展了将辐射解系统翻译到球谐基的方法，并将其应用于四极和八极度规扰动。这种表示使辐射的角向结构变得显明，简化了线性化场方程的验证，并便于与 Bondi 规范以及 de Sitter 时空的其他微扰处理进行直接比较。
classification.one_liner: 首次将 de Sitter 时空中的多极引力辐射展开推进到八极阶，并给出球谐表示。

papers.title: Local law and delocalization for the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model
papers.abstract: We establish a mesoscopic local law and quantitative eigenvector-delocalization estimates for the Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model (SYK) Hamiltonian of $N$ interacting Majorana fermions subject to a $q$-body interaction. For even $q\ll N^{\frac{1}{2}}$, we prove that the normalized Stieltjes transform is approximated, uniformly on bounded energy intervals, by an explicit deterministic profile which we construct as an asymptotic expansion in the proportion $\alpha_{N,q}$ of anticommuting $q$-body interaction terms. The result holds both on the full Hilbert space and in each fermion-parity sector. We derive mesoscopic eigenvalue counting and spectral form factor estimates. For fixed $q$, we further obtain high-probability $\ell^\infty$-delocalization bounds in any deterministic orthonormal basis for individual bulk eigenvectors. These are the first mesoscopic laws and eigenvector delocalization estimates for the SYK Hamiltonian, which we obtain using the resolvent method.

classification.title_zh: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型的局部律与退局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为具有 N 个相互作用 Majorana 费米子、含有 q 体相互作用的 Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev 模型（SYK）哈密顿量，建立介观局部律和定量的本征矢量退局域化估计。对于偶数 q ≪ N^{1/2}，我们证明归一化 Stieltjes 变换在有界能量区间上一致地由显式确定性剖面逼近；该剖面通过按反交换 q 体相互作用项比例 α_{N,q} 的渐近展开构造。结果在全希尔伯特空间以及每个费米子宇称扇区均成立。我们推导介观本征值计数和谱形状因子估计。对于固定 q，我们进一步在任意确定性正交归一基中，对单个体能本征矢量得到高概率的 ℓ∞ 退局域化界。这些是 SYK 哈密顿量的首个介观律和本征矢量退局域化估计，我们使用预解式方法获得。
classification.one_liner: 用预解式方法为 SYK 哈密顿量证明介观局部律、本征值计数、谱形状因子估计及本征矢量退局域化界。

papers.title: Parametrized beyond-Teukolsky framework in the time domain
papers.abstract: Modifications to General Relativity can significantly alter the perturbative response of black holes, leaving imprints on quasinormal-mode spectra, waveform amplitudes and phases, and late-time tails. The parametrized beyond-Teukolsky framework was introduced to capture possible deviations from Kerr dynamics, but the ringdown has so far only been explored as an eigenvalue problem. We present the first time-domain implementation of this framework and perform (2+1)-dimensional scattering experiments with Gaussian wave packets. This approach provides the full linear evolution of the perturbation, from the initial prompt response through the ringdown and into the late-time regime. Using frequency-domain eigenvalue results as benchmarks, we find excellent agreement for low azimuthal numbers, while higher azimuthal numbers are affected by mode mixing, which limits the precision of the extracted modes. We further use the time-domain waveforms to estimate quadratic and mixed coefficients within the linearized modified-potential model, providing a diagnostic for the regime of validity of the linear approximation. Beyond mode frequencies, we show that the deformation parameters can strongly affect the ringdown amplitude and phase, with trends that can be understood from the near-horizon structure of the modified potential. We also analyze the late- time behavior, finding that near-horizon deformations leave the tail exponent unchanged but can substantially shift the onset of the power-law decay. These results demonstrate that time-domain evolutions provide a complementary and flexible framework for testing parametrized deviations from General Relativity in black-hole perturbation theory.

classification.title_zh: 时域中的参数化超越-Teukolsky 框架
classification.abstract_zh: 对广义相对论的修改会显著改变黑洞的微扰响应，并在准正规模谱、波形振幅和相位以及晚期尾中留下印记。参数化超越-Teukolsky 框架被引入以刻画与 Kerr 动力学的可能偏离，但此前铃宕仅在特征值问题中研究。我们给出该框架的首个时域实现，并用高斯波包进行 (2+1) 维散射实验。该方法给出微扰从初始瞬态响应、经过铃宕到晚期区域的完整线性演化。以频域特征值结果作为基准，我们在低方位角数下发现良好一致，而较高方位角数受模式混合影响，限制了提取模式的精度。我们进一步利用时域波形估计线性化修改势模型中的二次和混合系数，为线性近似适用范围提供诊断。除模式频率外，我们表明形变参数能强烈影响铃宕振幅和相位，其趋势可由修改势的近视界结构理解。我们还分析晚期行为，发现近视界形变不改变尾指数，但可显著移动幂律衰减的起始。这些结果表明，时域演化提供了在黑洞微扰论中检验参数化广义相对论偏离的互补而灵活的框架。
classification.one_liner: 首次在时域实现参数化超越-Teukolsky 框架，用高斯波包散射研究修改引力下黑洞扰动、铃宕、晚期尾及波形振幅相位。

papers.title: Reverse Isoperimetry from Boundary--Completed Canonical Energy
papers.abstract: The reverse isoperimetric conjecture states that, at fixed thermodynamic volume, Schwarzschild--AdS black holes maximize entropy. We show that its local fixed-volume form admits a boundary-completed canonical-energy interpretation. The key observation is that the bulk Hollands--Wald canonical energy vanishes on exact stationary black-hole families, while the fixed-volume entropy Hessian is encoded in an asymptotic boundary contribution. The same structure governs the global comparison. We choose an affine parameterization of a fixed-volume stationary branch connecting Schwarzschild--AdS to the solution of interest. If the stationary boundary Hessian is non-negative along this comparison, entropy concavity gives the reverse isoperimetric bound, while equality is determined by the directions along which the boundary Hessian vanishes. In Einstein gravity this reproduces the area--volume inequality on the stated comparison branches, and the formulation extends naturally to Wald entropy in higher-derivative theories.

classification.title_zh: 从边界完备正则能量看反向等周
classification.abstract_zh: 反向等周猜想指出，在固定热力学体积下，Schwarzschild--AdS 黑洞使熵最大化。我们表明，其局域固定体积形式可采用边界完备的正则能量解释。关键观察是，体相的 Hollands--Wald 正则能量在精确稳态黑洞族上为零，而固定体积的熵 Hessian 则编码在渐近边界贡献中。同一结构支配全局比较。我们选取连接 Schwarzschild--AdS 与所关注解的固定体积稳态分支的仿射参数化。若沿此比较的稳态边界 Hessian 非负，则熵凹性给出反向等周界，而等号由边界 Hessian 为零的方向决定。在 Einstein 引力中，这在所述比较分支上重现面积--体积不等式，且该表述自然推广到高阶导数理论中的 Wald 熵。
classification.one_liner: 将反向等周猜想的固定体积形式解释为边界完备的 Hollands-Wald 正则能量条件，并在 Einstein 引力中重现面积-体积不等式。

papers.title: Probing the Kinematic Dipole with LISA: an analytical treatment
papers.abstract: The motion of the Solar System with respect to the cosmic rest frame induces a kinematic dipole in the stochastic gravitational-wave background (GWB). Detecting this signal with space-based interferometers would provide an independent measurement of our peculiar velocity and a GW probe of cosmic anisotropies. We present a fully analytic derivation of the response of the \emph{Laser Interferometer Space Antenna} (LISA) to a kinematic dipole, and construct an optimal estimator for its detection. We show that the dipolar response is governed by a single frequency-dependent function fixed by symmetry, and we compute its behaviour across the LISA band. Using Fisher forecasts, we find that for a scale-invariant background detectability requires $h^2\Omega_{\rm GW} \gtrsim 5\times 10^{-8}$ for \emph{fiducial} LISA, and $h^2\Omega_{\rm GW} \gtrsim 5\times 10^{-10}$ for a detector with characteristic instrumental-noise amplitudes improved by an order of magnitude. Prospects are more favorable for signals with richer frequency profile. We also explore the potential of the kinematic dipole to break degeneracies, particularly in the presence of strong galactic foregrounds or noise features that closely mimic the primordial signal.

classification.title_zh: 用 LISA 探测运动学偶极：一种解析处理
classification.abstract_zh: 太阳系相对于宇宙静止系的运动会在随机引力波背景（GWB）中诱导出一个运动学偶极。用空间干涉仪探测该信号将提供对本地特殊速度的独立测量，并提供宇宙各向异性的引力波探针。我们给出了激光干涉空间天线（LISA）对运动学偶极响应的完全解析推导，并构造了用于其探测的最优估计量。我们表明偶极响应由单个频率依赖函数决定，该函数由对称性固定，并计算了其在 LISA 频段内的行为。利用 Fisher 预报，我们发现对于尺度不变背景，可探测性要求 h^2Ω_GW ≳ 5×10^{-8}（基准 LISA），而对于特征仪器噪声幅度改善一个量级的探测器，要求 h^2Ω_GW ≳ 5×10^{-10}。对于频率剖面更丰富的信号，前景更有利。我们还探讨了运动学偶极在打破简并性方面的潜力，特别是在存在强银河系前景或与原始信号极为相似的噪声特征时。
classification.one_liner: 本文解析推导了 LISA 对随机引力波背景中运动学偶极的响应，并用 Fisher 预报评估其探测前景。

papers.title: Spectator Composes a Gravitational Canon: Spectator-field-triggered Phase Transition During Inflation and its Anisotropic Gravitational Wave Signals
papers.abstract: We propose a general framework in which a phase transition is triggered during cosmic inflation by the slow-roll dynamics of a spectator field. The topological defects formed at the transition are inflated outside the horizon, reenter it after inflation, and can subsequently generate characteristic gravitational-wave (GW) signals. Quantum fluctuations of the spectator field modulate the timing of the transition, imprinting large-scale anisotropies in the resulting GW background. As an explicit realization, the spectator field may be identified with the Higgs field in a supersymmetric Standard Model. More generally, our framework applies to a wide class of spectator-modulated phenomena, providing a generic mechanism for producing anisotropic GW signals.

classification.title_zh: 旁观者场谱写引力波卡农：暴胀期间旁观者场触发的相变及其各向异性引力波信号
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个通用框架：在宇宙暴胀期间，由旁观者场的慢滚动力学触发相变。相变时形成的拓扑缺陷被暴胀到视界之外，在暴胀后重新进入视界，随后可产生特征性的引力波（GW）信号。旁观者场的量子涨落会调制相变发生的时间，从而在所得 GW 背景中留下大尺度各向异性。作为一个显式实现，旁观者场可被识别为超对称标准模型中的希格斯场。更一般地，我们的框架适用于一大类旁观者场调制的现象，为产生各向异性 GW 信号提供了一种普适机制。
classification.one_liner: 提出旁观者场慢滚触发暴胀时期相变，拓扑缺陷与量子涨落调制产生各向异性引力波信号的通用框架。

papers.title: Thermodynamic topology of AdS black holes with $F^{\alpha\beta}F^{\gamma\lambda}R_{\alpha\gamma}R_{\beta\lambda}$ coupling in the grand canonical ensemble
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermodynamic and topological phase structure of charged AdS black holes with a nonminimal gauge--curvature coupling in the grand canonical ensemble. In the minimal-coupling limit $\epsilon=0$, the system exhibits only Hawking--Page-like behavior and does not possess van der Waals criticality. Working perturbatively in the nonminimal coupling, we find that the $\epsilon\neq0$ interaction generates a rich phase structure as the electric potential is varied, including several distinct regimes of critical behavior, a double-critical region, and a regime where conventional criticality disappears. We complement the conventional thermodynamic analysis with a topological description based on the winding number of the thermodynamic vector field. The resulting $r_h$--$\tau$ diagrams reveal that the ordering and morphology of the black-hole branches depend sensitively on both the pressure and the off-shell inverse temperature, with monotonic, disconnected, S-shaped, and cusp-like structures appearing in different parameter ranges. Remarkably, these substantial rearrangements of the solution branches can occur without changing the global winding number. In particular, the system remains in the $W=+1$ topological class beyond the range of conventional criticality, before eventually entering a $W=0$ sector. Our results demonstrate that thermodynamic topology provides complementary global information that is not captured by conventional local criticality criteria alone.
