papers.title: Weak in the Presence of Beauty: Gravitational waves from the mergers of black holes and neutron stars as a messenger
papers.abstract: In 2025, the 4th Gravitational Wave Transient Catalog reported the discovery of over 200 gravitational wave events since 2015. These gravitational waves (GWs) are emitted by compact binary coalescenses (CBCs) between neutron stars and black holes, and detected with a global network of ground-based laser interferometers. GWs represent a new `messenger' -- ripples in spacetime that propagate across cosmological distances, and carry information about the physical properties of compact objects and their location in the Universe. In this review, we consider what information we can learn about black holes and neutron stars using GWs as a messenger. We explore how the GW observation process allows us to transform the outputs of laser interferometers like LIGO, Virgo and KAGRA into knowledge about black holes and neutron stars. We show that the GW source population acts as a messenger that can lead us to breakthroughs in our understanding of stellar evolution, how the Universe has changed across cosmic time, and fundamental physics. Finally, we discuss three key opportunities to learn more about our Universe using GWs as a messenger in the coming decades.

classification.title_zh: 美中不足的微弱信号：黑洞与中子星并合的引力波作为信使
classification.abstract_zh: 2025 年，第四版引力波瞬变星表报告了自 2015 年以来发现的 200 多个引力波事件。这些引力波由中子星与黑洞之间的致密双星并合（CBC）发出，并由全球地面激光干涉仪网络探测到。引力波代表了一种新的“信使”——穿越宇宙学距离传播的时空涟漪，携带着关于致密天体物理性质及其在宇宙中位置的信息。在这篇综述中，我们考察以引力波作为信使能够了解到关于黑洞和中子星的哪些信息。我们探讨引力波的观测过程如何使我们把 LIGO、Virgo 和 KAGRA 等激光干涉仪的输出转化为关于黑洞与中子星的知识。我们表明，引力波源族群作为一种信使，能够引领我们在对恒星演化、宇宙如何随宇宙时间变化以及基础物理的理解上取得突破。最后，我们讨论未来数十年中以引力波作为信使来进一步了解宇宙的三个关键机遇。
classification.one_liner: 综述引力波作为信使，如何从致密双星并合中提取黑洞与中子星的性质，并展望未来机遇。

papers.title: Bridging the chirp-mass gap: searching for gravitational waves from inspiraling ultra-compact binaries using LIGO O4ab data
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave searches for subsolar-mass compact binaries have left a gap between the planetary-mass regime accessible to long-duration searches and the higher masses probed by conventional compact-binary analyses. We close this gap by searching for the inspiral of ultra-compact binaries with chirp masses $10^{-2}$--$10^{-1}\,M_\odot$ in LIGO O4ab data. Using the statistically robust BinaryGFH-v2 method, a time-frequency technique to search for rapidly evolving inspirals lasting minutes to hours, we cover this previously challenging parameter space with a computational cost of only $\sim 350$ CPU-hours, and find no significant candidates. We thus set 90\% confidence upper limits on the binary merger-rate density, providing the first gravitational-wave constraints across this chirp-mass range. Assuming that primordial-black-hole binaries formed in the early Universe with no binary suppression ($f_{\rm sup}=1$), these results provide the first gravitational-wave constraints on the primordial-black-hole \dmh fraction in this mass range, yielding upper limits with $f_{\rm PBH}<1$ for equal-mass binaries with component masses $10^{-2}$--$10^{-1}\,M_\odot$ and asymmetric binaries with secondary masses $m_2=3\times10^{-4}$--$10^{-2}\,M_\odot$ for a primary mass $m_1=2.5\,M_\odot$.

classification.title_zh: 弥合啁啾质量间隙：利用 LIGO O4ab 数据搜寻旋近的超致密双星引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 对亚太阳质量致密双星的引力波搜寻，在长时搜寻可及的行星质量区间与传统致密双星分析所探测的较高质量区间之间留下了一个间隙。我们通过在 LIGO O4ab 数据中搜寻啁啾质量为 10^{-2}--10^{-1} M⊙ 的超致密双星旋近信号来弥合该间隙。使用统计稳健的 BinaryGFH-v2 方法，这是一种用于搜寻持续数分钟至数小时的快速演化旋近信号的时间-频率技术，我们以仅约 350 CPU 小时的计算代价覆盖了这一此前具有挑战性的参数空间，并未发现显著候选体。因此，我们对双星并合率密度给出了 90% 置信度的上限，首次在这一啁啾质量范围内提供引力波限制。假设早期宇宙中形成的原初黑洞双星没有双星抑制（f_sup=1），这些结果为该质量范围内的原初黑洞暗物质分数提供了首个引力波限制：对于分量质量为 10^{-2}--10^{-1} M⊙ 的等质量双星，以及主质量 m1=2.5 M⊙、次质量 m2=3×10^{-4}--10^{-2} M⊙ 的非对称双星，得到 f_PBH<1 的上限。
classification.one_liner: LIGO O4ab 未发现啁啾质量 10^{-2}--10^{-1} M⊙ 的超致密双星旋近信号，并首次给出该质量范围并合率及原初黑洞暗物质分数上限。

papers.title: Analog Gravity in Magneto-Viscous Fluids: Enhanced Analog Hawking Temperature in Accretion Disks
papers.abstract: We present a three-dimensional visco-magnetoacoustic framework for analog gravity in magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) flows. While standard fluid dissipation typically breaks the Lorentzian signature of acoustic metrics, we demonstrate that evaluating wave perturbations in the eikonal limit alongside the Shakura-Sunyaev $\alpha$-viscosity prescription preserves a well-defined effective spacetime geometry for the fast magnetoacoustic mode. The slow-magnetoacoustic mode and Alfv\'en mode do not admit a non-degenerate metric. To investigate analog horizon thermodynamics, we utilize astrophysical accretion disks as background media, specifically modeling numerical magnetized advective accretion flows around rotating black holes and analytical advection-dominated inflow-outflow solutions (ADIOS). Standard self-similar ADIOS models strictly enforce a constant Mach number, precluding horizon formation. We therefore introduce a magnetic field perturbation that breaks self-similarity, generates a dynamic Mach number, and enables the formation of a visco-magnetoacoustic horizon. By evaluating the spontaneous phonon emission at these horizons, we reveal that the analog Hawking temperature is highly sensitive to the magnetic field topology; the spatial orientation of the background magnetic gradients dictates whether the Hawking radiation is amplified or suppressed. Furthermore, we find that increasing the viscosity parameter leads to a monotonic increase in the analog Hawking temperature.

classification.title_zh: 磁黏性流体中的类比引力：吸积盘中增强的类比霍金温度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个用于磁流体力学（MHD）流动中类比引力的三维黏磁声学框架。标准流体耗散通常会破坏声学度规的洛伦兹号差，但我们证明，在程函极限下评估波扰动，并结合 Shakura-Sunyaev α 黏性方案，可以为快磁声模保留一个定义良好的有效时空几何。慢磁声模和 Alfvén 模不允许非退化度规。为了研究类比视界热力学，我们利用天体物理吸积盘作为背景介质，具体建模了旋转黑洞周围的数值磁化平流吸积流以及解析的平流主导流入-流出解（ADIOS）。标准自相似 ADIOS 模型严格强制常马赫数，从而阻止视界形成。因此我们引入一个破坏自相似性的磁场扰动，产生动态马赫数，并使得黏磁声学视界得以形成。通过评估这些视界处的自发声子发射，我们揭示类比霍金温度对磁场拓扑高度敏感；背景磁场梯度的空间取向决定了霍金辐射是被放大还是被抑制。此外，我们发现增加黏性参数会导致类比霍金温度单调增加。
classification.one_liner: 在含黏性的磁流体吸积盘背景中构建三维类比引力框架，并发现磁场拓扑与黏性可显著调节类比霍金温度。

papers.title: Bayesian approach study of hybrid neutron stars
papers.abstract: In this work, we explore how astronomical observations (specifically measurements of masses and radii) can constrain the presence of quark matter inside neutron stars, namely the phase transition from nuclear matter to deconfined quark matter. Our approach employs Bayesian analysis to study this constraint. In this sense to model Hadronic matter we used the relativistic mean-field approximation, for which we have selected two parameter sets: \(NL3^{*}\omega\rho\), representing hadronic matter with nucleons only, and $EL3\omega\rho$ with nucleons only and $EL3\omega\rho Y$, which includes hyperons. On the other hand deconfined quark matter is modeled using the vector-MIT bag model. Also, for our purpose, the first order phase transition is implemented using the Maxwell construction. Bayesian inference is performed by optimizing three parameters: the bag constant (i.e. $B^{1/4}$), the vector coupling constant \(\left(G_{v}\right)\), and the Dirac sea contribution ($b_{4}$). We found that a phase transition could exist at densities below \(2.0\,n_{0}\) for both the $EL3\omega\rho$ and $NL3^{*}\omega\rho$ parametrizations. As a consequence, the inferred parameters of the vector MIT bag model, based on our likelihood function, imply hybrid stars with large quark cores.

classification.title_zh: 混合中子星的贝叶斯方法研究
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们探索天文观测（特别是质量与半径测量）如何约束中子星内部夸克物质的存在，即从核物质到解禁闭夸克物质的一级相变。我们的方法采用贝叶斯分析来研究这一约束。为此，我们使用相对论平均场近似来建模强子物质，并选取两组参数集：NL3*ωρ（表示仅含核子的强子物质），以及 EL3ωρ（仅含核子）和 EL3ωρY（包含超子）。另一方面，解禁闭夸克物质用矢量 MIT 袋模型建模。此外，我们使用 Maxwell 构造实现一级相变。贝叶斯推断通过优化三个参数进行：袋常数（即 B^{1/4}）、矢量耦合常数 G_v 和狄拉克海贡献 b_4。我们发现，对于 EL3ωρ 和 NL3*ωρ 参数化，相变可能存在于低于 2.0 n_0 的密度。因此，基于我们的似然函数推断出的矢量 MIT 袋模型参数意味着具有大夸克核心的混合星。
classification.one_liner: 用贝叶斯分析结合相对论平均场与矢量 MIT 袋模型，约束中子星内一级强子-夸克相变，并推断可能出现大夸克核心的混合星。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息研究；主题为中子星致密物质与强子-夸克相变，可与经典引力/中子星观测支线相关，但不涉及 AdS/CFT、量子引力或引力场方程。

papers.title: Quark stars in regularized 4D Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity: A perturbative QCD equation of state
papers.abstract: We investigate the equilibrium structure and stability of selfbound quark stars in the framework of regularized four-dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet (4DEGB) gravity, employing the perturbative QCD equation of state of Fraga, Kurkela and Vuorinen [1]. The equation of state, parameterised by a single renormalization-scale parameter $X$, contains no effective bag constant and defines the stellar surface entirely through the vanishing of the quark-matter pressure. We solve the modified Tolman-Oppenheimer--Volkoff equations derived from the scalar--tensor formulation of 4DEGB gravity for $X \in \{3, 4\}$ and Gauss--Bonnet coupling $\alpha \in \{0, 1, 10\}\,\mathrm{km}^2$. For the soft EOS ($X = 3$), the maximum mass increases from $2.0431\,M_\odot$ (GR) to $2.5013\,M_\odot$ at $\alpha = 10\,\mathrm{km}^2$, with only the latter entering the PSR~J0952$-$0607 mass band. For the stiff EOS($X = 4$), the GR baseline already yields $3.0415\,M_\odot$, and all configurations exceed both the GW190814 secondary mass and the PSR~J0952$-$0607 constraint. The compactness $C = M/R$ at maximum mass ranges from $0.2531$ to $0.3123$ across all configurations, remaining well below the Buchdahl bound throughout. Radial profiles of the squared speed of sound confirm that $c_s^2 < 1/3$ holds pointwise throughout the stellar interior for all parameter choices, establishing that the quark matter remains sub-conformal and causal inside the maximum-mass star. These results demonstrate that higher-curvature corrections in 4DEGB gravity systematically enhance the maximum supported mass of perturbative QCD quark stars, with the stiff ($X = 4$) branch already exceeding the most massive compact objects currently observed even at the GR level, while the soft ($X = 3$) branch requires $\alphaGB \sim 10\,\mathrm{km}^2$ to approach those thresholds.

classification.title_zh: 正则化四维Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet引力中的夸克星：微扰QCD物态方程
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在正则化四维Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet（4DEGB）引力框架下，采用Fraga、Kurkela和Vuorinen的微扰QCD物态方程，研究自束缚夸克星的平衡结构与稳定性。该物态方程由单一重整化标度参数X参数化，不含有效袋常数，并通过夸克物质压强为零来定义星体表面。我们对X∈{3,4}和Gauss--Bonnet耦合α∈{0,1,10} km²求解由4DEGB引力标量-张量表述导出的修正Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff方程。对于软物态方程（X=3），最大质量从广义相对论的2.0431 M⊙增加到α=10 km²时的2.5013 M⊙，其中只有后者进入PSR J0952−0607的质量带。对于硬物态方程（X=4），广义相对论基线已经给出3.0415 M⊙，且所有构型都超过GW190814次级质量和PSR J0952−0607限制。最大质量处的致密度C=M/R在所有构型中范围为0.2531至0.3123，始终远低于Buchdahl界限。声速平方的径向分布证实，对所有参数选择，c_s²<1/3在整个星体内部逐点成立，表明在最大质量星体内部夸克物质保持亚共形且因果。这些结果表明，4DEGB引力中的高阶曲率修正系统性地提高了微扰QCD夸克星的最大支持质量；硬（X=4）分支即使在广义相对论层面也已超过目前观测到的最重致密天体，而软（X=3）分支需要αGB∼10 km²才能接近这些阈值。
classification.one_liner: 在4DEGB引力中用微扰QCD物态方程研究夸克星，发现高阶曲率修正提高最大质量，硬物态分支在广义相对论下已超过观测最重致密天体。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究修改引力中致密星结构与稳定性，与用户重点标签‘经典引力/广义相对论’直接相关；但不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: Survey of Novel Deep Learning Architectures for Denoising Gravitational-wave Signals
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave denoising must handle the full diversity of spinning, precessing binaries, since the recovered waveform underpins parameter estimation, tests of general relativity, and population studies. Matched filtering achieves this at a cost that becomes prohibitive as next-generation detectors push event rates higher; deep learning offers real-time reconstruction, but current methods are developed on narrow parameter spaces, precluding principled comparison and reliable deployment. We present the first controlled comparison of five neural-network architectures for gravitational-wave denoising, trained identically across the full astrophysically-motivated spinning binary-black-hole parameter space. A unifying principle emerges: matching network structure to the spectral anatomy of a coalescence -- inspiral, merger, ringdown -- outperforms brute-force model scaling. Our Multi-Scale Frequency-Aware architecture embodies this via dedicated parallel branches per frequency regime, achieving the best fidelity while using fewer parameters than larger models. It generalizes from simulated training to real LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA data without retraining, recovering merger morphology across confirmed events spanning three observing runs and both detectors, despite training on a single detector's simulated noise. We construct population-level uncertainty bands from denoising residuals, validate their calibration, and stress-test the framework on extended mass ratios and a spin population resembling hierarchical-merger remnants. Applied to real noise with no known signal, the network suppresses its output almost everywhere, with rare exceptions traced to noise transients rather than a general weakness -- indicating the statistic discriminates signal from noise and motivating a future detection study. Released weights give a deployable, reproducible benchmark for future extensions.

classification.title_zh: 引力波信号去噪的新型深度学习架构比较研究
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波去噪必须处理自旋、进动双星的全部多样性，因为恢复的波形支撑参数估计、广义相对论检验和族群研究。匹配滤波能够做到这一点，但随着下一代探测器推高事件率，其代价变得难以承受；深度学习提供实时重建，但当前方法在狭窄参数空间上开发，妨碍了有原则的比较和可靠部署。我们首次对五种神经网络架构进行受控比较，用于引力波去噪，并在全 astrophysically-motivated 自旋双黑洞参数空间上以相同方式训练。一个统一原则浮现：将网络结构与并合过程的频谱解剖（旋近、并合、铃宕）匹配，优于暴力模型扩展。我们的多尺度频率感知架构通过按频率区域设置专用并行分支体现这一点，在用比更大模型更少参数的情况下取得最佳保真度。它无需重新训练即可从模拟训练泛化到真实 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 数据，在跨越三个观测运行和两个探测器的已确认事件中恢复并合形态，尽管训练仅使用单个探测器的模拟噪声。我们从去噪残差构建族群级不确定度带，验证其校准，并在扩展质量比和类似等级并合遗迹的自旋族群上对该框架进行压力测试。应用于没有已知信号的真实噪声时，网络几乎处处抑制其输出，少数例外追溯到噪声瞬变，而非普遍弱点——表明该统计量能区分信号与噪声，并推动未来探测研究。发布的权重为未来扩展提供了一个可部署、可复现的基准。
classification.one_liner: 对五种神经网络架构在全自旋双黑洞参数空间下进行统一训练与受控比较，提出多尺度频率感知架构，在模拟训练后无需重训练即可泛化到真实 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 数据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力波观测数据分析与机器学习方法，不涉及全息对偶或量子引力；与经典引力/引力波探测支线相关，因此对相关研究有中等相关性。

papers.title: Effective Matter Conversion in Gravitational Collapse and the Dynamical Formation of Regular Black Holes
papers.abstract: We study inverse source reconstruction in generalized Vaidya spacetimes. A prescribed density fixes the mass and tangential pressure, while a two-sector decomposition determines a dimensionless radial balance function. We distinguish this function from a time-directed conversion rate and identify the additional null-flux information required for a covariant exchange vector. Positivity restricts the allowed target pressures: a de Sitter core cannot be represented by nonnegative sectors with nonnegative tangential equations of state. An explicit finite-density profile admits a positive vacuum-like completion, finite curvature invariants, and inner and outer trapping horizons above a calculable threshold. Its total source satisfies the null, weak, and dominant energy conditions during monotonic accretion, while the timelike convergence condition fails in the core. We check polytropic, bag-model-inspired, and condensate-inspired profiles and the corresponding cosmological reconstruction. Finally, we compute the stationary endpoint's shadow and compare its exterior deformation with published Sagittarius A* measurements. The construction establishes local curvature regularity and marginal-sphere formation, without claiming a microscopic formation mechanism, perturbative stability, or geodesic completeness.

classification.title_zh: 引力坍缩中的有效物质转换与规则黑洞的动态形成
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究广义Vaidya时空中的逆源重构。给定密度确定质量和切向压强，而双扇区分解确定无量纲径向平衡函数。我们将该函数与时间指向的转换率区分开，并识别协变交换矢量所需的额外零通量信息。正性限制允许的目标压强：de Sitter核心不能由具有非负切向状态方程的非负扇区表示。一个显式有限密度剖面允许正真空样完成、有限曲率不变量，以及在可计算阈值之上的内、外捕获视界。在单调吸积期间，其总源满足零、弱和主能量条件，而类时收敛条件在核心中失效。我们检验了多方、袋模型启发和凝聚体启发的剖面以及相应的宇宙学重构。最后，我们计算稳态终点的阴影，并将其外部变形与已发表的Sgr A*测量结果进行比较。该构造确立了局部曲率正则性和边际球形成，但不声称微观形成机制、微扰稳定性或测地完备性。
classification.one_liner: 在广义Vaidya时空中通过逆源重构研究规则黑洞的引力坍缩形成，并分析能量条件、视界与阴影约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究广义Vaidya时空中的引力坍缩与规则黑洞形成，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及AdS/CFT或全息对偶。

papers.title: Frequency shift in gravitational lensing by Kerr metric
papers.abstract: In this study, we calculate the relative frequency shift ($\Delta \nu / \nu$) caused by gravitational lensing resulting from the transverse motion of a spinning lens described by the Kerr metric \cite{Kerr:1963ud}. While the effect of transverse velocity on the frequency shift has previously been investigated using the Schwarzschild metric \cite{Rahvar_2020,10.1093/mnras/stae1938}, extending this to the Kerr metric provides a new window for measuring the transverse velocity of a lens or its spin parameter, a parameter often subject to degeneracy in gravitational microlensing observations. Recent microlensing observations have revealed black holes as viable lensing candidates \cite{2022ApJ...933...83S}. Since spinning black holes form naturally from stellar evolution, astrophysical black hole lenses are best described by the Kerr metric. Furthermore, recent observations of supermassive black holes at the centers of galaxies provide an ideal laboratory for testing the observational effects of the Kerr metric by measuring the frequency shifts of lensed sources.

classification.title_zh: Kerr 度规引力透镜中的频率漂移
classification.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们计算了由 Kerr 度规描述的自旋透镜横向运动引起的引力透镜所导致的相对频率漂移（Δν/ν）。虽然横向速度对频率漂移的影响此前已在 Schwarzschild 度规下研究过，但将其推广到 Kerr 度规为测量透镜横向速度或自旋参数提供了新窗口，而该参数在引力微透镜观测中常存在简并。近期微透镜观测表明黑洞是可行的透镜候选者。由于自旋黑洞自然形成于恒星演化，天体物理黑洞透镜最好由 Kerr 度规描述。此外，近期对星系中心超大质量黑洞的观测为通过测量透镜源频率漂移来检验 Kerr 度规的观测效应提供了理想实验室。
classification.one_liner: 计算 Kerr 度规下自旋透镜横向运动引起的引力透镜频率漂移，为测量透镜横向速度或自旋提供新途径。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 Kerr 度规、引力透镜和经典黑洞时空效应，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点方向。

papers.title: Black Hole Solutions with Scalar Fields and Anisotropic Matter in Non-Minimal $Y(R)F^2$ Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate exact spherically symmetric and static black hole solutions in a non-minimally coupled Einstein--Maxwell theory of the $Y(R)F^2$ type, extended by a minimally coupled real scalar field and an anisotropic matter distribution. The Maxwell field is coupled to the spacetime curvature through an arbitrary function of the Ricci scalar, while the scalar field is described by a kinetic term and a scalar potential. We obtain exact solutions for power-law and logarithmic forms of the non-minimal coupling function and analyze the corresponding spacetime geometries. In particular, we identify a special $\beta=-1/3$ case for which the general power-law solution becomes singular and derive a new logarithmic metric by solving the field equations independently. The resulting configurations are asymptotically flat and exhibit modified gravitational properties associated with the interplay between the scalar field, anisotropic matter, and non-minimal electromagnetic coupling. We further show that the magnetic solutions admit electrically charged counterparts through an electromagnetic duality transformation, under which the metric and scalar sector remain invariant while the non-minimal coupling function is inverted. The obtained solutions provide a useful framework for investigating black hole horizons, thermodynamic properties, geodesic motion, and astrophysical phenomena such as galactic rotation curves in curvature-dependent electromagnetic theories.

classification.title_zh: 非最小 Y(R)F^2 引力中带标量场与各向异性物质的黑洞解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在非最小耦合的 Einstein--Maxwell 理论中研究精确的球对称静态黑洞解，该理论属于 Y(R)F^2 类型，并扩展了一个最小耦合实标量场和各向异性物质分布。Maxwell 场通过 Ricci 标量的任意函数与时空曲率耦合，而标量场由动能项和标量势描述。我们得到了非最小耦合函数为幂律和对数形式时的精确解，并分析了相应的时空几何。特别地，我们发现了一个特殊的 β=-1/3 情形，此时一般幂律解变为奇异，并通过独立求解场方程导出了一个新的对数度规。所得构型渐近平直，并展现出与标量场、各向异性物质和非最小电磁耦合之间相互作用相关的修正引力性质。我们进一步表明，磁解通过电磁对偶变换可得到带电解的对应解；在该变换下，度规和标量部分保持不变，而非最小耦合函数被倒置。所得解为研究曲率依赖电磁理论中的黑洞视界、热力学性质、测地线运动以及星系旋转曲线等天体物理现象提供了一个有用的框架。
classification.one_liner: 在非最小 Y(R)F^2 引力中，引入标量场和各向异性物质，构造并分析渐近平直的精确黑洞解及电磁对偶解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究曲率依赖电磁耦合修正引力中的经典黑洞精确解，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；与全息对偶无直接关系，但契合用户列出的经典引力重点标签。

papers.title: From massless wormholes to massive black bounces: Relativistic astrophysical observations of shadows and multiple light rings
papers.abstract: We develop a general framework for constructing massive black bounce geometries from massless wormhole seeds by introducing a position-dependent mass function while preserving the underlying areal-radius profile. We apply this procedure to the generalized Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole and obtain a new family of generalized Bardeen-like black bounce space-times, which continuously interpolates between traversable wormholes and regular black holes. We investigate the motion of massive particles and photons and show that, in contrast with the simpler orbital structure of the massless generalized Ellis-Bronnikov geometry, the generalized Bardeen-like space-time can exhibit multiple circular orbits and a rich light ring structure, including configurations with two unstable circular photon orbits separated by a stable one. We determine the corresponding photon sphere and shadow radii and compare our predictions with Event Horizon Telescope observations of Sgr A*, deriving observational constraints on the parameter space of the model. We further investigate the optical appearance produced by a geometrically and optically thin accretion disk through ray tracing. Multiple light rings generate characteristic nested structures in the high-resolution intensity profiles, whose relative brightness is strongly affected by the mass deformation and gravitational redshift. However, after modeling the finite angular resolution of the EHT with a Gaussian beam convolution, these fine structures are largely washed out, revealing a strong observational degeneracy between these exotic compact objects and standard black hole geometries at current EHT resolution.

classification.title_zh: 从无质量虫洞到有质量黑洞反弹：阴影与多重光环的相对论天体物理观测
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了一个通用框架，通过引入位置相关的质量函数，同时保持底层的面积半径剖面不变，从无质量虫洞种子构造有质量黑洞反弹几何。我们将这一程序应用于广义 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞，获得了一类新的广义 Bardeen 型黑洞反弹时空；它连续地插值于可穿越虫洞与正则黑洞之间。我们研究了有质量粒子和光子的运动，并表明：与无质量广义 Ellis-Bronnikov 几何更简单的轨道结构不同，广义 Bardeen 型时空可以呈现多重圆轨道和丰富的光环结构，包括两个不稳定圆光子轨道被一个稳定圆光子轨道分隔的构型。我们确定了相应的光子球和阴影半径，并将预测与事件视界望远镜对 Sgr A* 的观测比较，从而给出模型参数空间的观测约束。我们进一步通过光线追踪研究了几何薄且光学薄吸积盘产生的光学外观。多重光环在高分辨率强度剖面中产生特征性嵌套结构，其相对亮度受到质量形变和引力红移的强烈影响。然而，在用高斯光束卷积对 EHT 的有限角分辨率建模后，这些精细结构在很大程度上被抹平，表明在当前 EHT 分辨率下这些奇异致密天体与标准黑洞几何之间存在很强的观测简并。
classification.one_liner: 通过位置相关质量函数从无质量虫洞构造有质量黑洞反弹，并研究其多重光环、阴影及 EHT 观测简并。

papers.title: Parameter Estimation of Ringdown Quasinormal Modes with Autoencoder
papers.abstract: Ringdown gravitational waves from binary black hole mergers can be modeled as superpositions of quasinormal modes (QNMs), whose frequencies and excitation factors encode properties of the remnant Kerr black hole. Reliable extraction of multiple QNM components is challenging because of mode overlap and noise. We develop an autoencoder-based framework for multi-component QNM analysis, in which the latent space is trained to represent the physical parameters of individual modes, enabling waveform denoising and parameter estimation within a common framework. Using controlled model waveforms constructed as finite sums of Kerr QNMs with recently established high-precision frequencies and excitation factors, including their nontrivial spin dependence near resonant excitation, we assess the method across partitioned spin intervals. The model achieves good in-domain waveform reconstruction and parameter recovery for the two longest-lived components of eight-component input waveforms, while its performance degrades when the validation spins lie far outside the training range. In a selected spin interval, the framework also recovers the 32 parameters of an eight-component waveform with good overall agreement. These results demonstrate the feasibility of physics-informed autoencoder-based inference for a prescribed multi-component ringdown waveform family and motivate further tests with progressively more realistic signals.

classification.title_zh: 用自编码器估计铃宕准正规模参数
classification.abstract_zh: 双黑洞并合产生的铃宕引力波可以建模为准正规模（QNM）的叠加，其频率和激发因子编码了并合后 Kerr 黑洞的性质。由于模式重叠和噪声，可靠提取多个 QNM 分量具有挑战性。我们提出了一个基于自编码器的多分量 QNM 分析框架，其中潜空间被训练来表示单个模式的物理参数，从而在统一框架内实现波形去噪和参数估计。我们使用由 Kerr QNM 有限和构成的受控模型波形，并采用近期建立的高精度频率和激发因子，包括共振激发附近非平凡的自旋依赖关系，在划分的自旋区间上评估该方法。该模型对八分量输入波形中寿命最长的两个分量取得了良好的域内波形重建和参数恢复，但当验证自旋远离训练范围时性能下降。在选定的自旋区间内，该框架还能以总体良好的一致性恢复八分量波形的 32 个参数。这些结果表明，对于给定的多分量铃宕波形族，基于物理信息自编码器的推断是可行的，并推动用更接近真实的信号进行进一步测试。
classification.one_liner: 该文提出用自编码器从铃宕引力波中同时去噪并估计多分量 Kerr 准正规模参数，并在受控波形上验证其可行性。

papers.title: Perturbations and quasinormal modes of black holes in general relativity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics
papers.abstract: We investigate the quasinormal spectra and time-domain evolution of scalar, electromagnetic, and gravitational perturbations of the Einstein-Bronnikov black hole in Einstein gravity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics. The effective potentials associated with all perturbation sectors are shown to form positive potential barriers that vanish at the event horizon and spatial infinity. Their height increases with the magnetic charge, while the scalar perturbation possesses the largest potential barrier. Unlike the Reissner-Nordstr\"om black hole, axial and polar electromagnetic perturbations are characterized by distinct effective potentials, demonstrating the breaking of isospectrality due to nonlinear electrodynamics. Quasinormal frequencies are computed using the sixth-order WKB approximation and the asymptotic iteration method, yielding excellent agreement for both fundamental and higher overtone modes. The oscillation frequencies increase monotonically with the magnetic charge, whereas the damping rates exhibit only moderate variations, confirming the linear stability of the Einstein-Bronnikov black hole under all perturbations considered. Time-domain profiles display exponentially damped ringdown signals consistent with the frequency-domain analysis. These results demonstrate that nonlinear electrodynamics leaves measurable imprints on black hole perturbations and may provide observational signatures for testing regular black hole geometries through future gravitational wave observations.

classification.title_zh: 与非线性电动力学耦合的广义相对论中黑洞的微扰与准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了爱因斯坦引力与非线性电动力学耦合中 Einstein-Bronnikov 黑洞的标量、电磁和引力扰动的准正规模谱和时域演化。所有扰动部分的关联有效势均表现为在事件视界和空间无穷远处消失的正势垒。其高度随磁荷增加，而标量扰动具有最大的势垒。与 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞不同，轴向和极性电磁扰动具有不同的有效势，表明非线性电动力学破坏了等谱性。使用六阶 WKB 近似和渐近迭代法计算准正规模频率，对基频和更高泛音模式均给出良好一致性。振荡频率随磁荷单调增加，而阻尼率仅表现出适度变化，确认了 Einstein-Bronnikov 黑洞在所有考虑扰动下的线性稳定性。时域剖面显示与频域分析一致的指数衰减铃宕信号。这些结果表明非线性电动力学在黑洞扰动上留下可测量印记，并可能为未来引力波观测检验正则黑洞几何提供观测特征。
classification.one_liner: 研究 Einstein-Bronnikov 黑洞标量、电磁与引力扰动准正规模，发现非线性电动力学破坏电磁等谱性并留下可观测印记。

papers.title: Quasinormal modes of Reissner-Nordstr\"om black hole from bound state spectrum
papers.abstract: We apply a newly proposed bound state method to revisit the computation of gravitational and electromagnetic quasinormal modes (QNMs) for Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes (RNBHs). It is found that the method yields QNM frequencies of high accuracy for low-lying modes with overtones $n\leq3$. The accuracy degrades for higher overtones, however, a homotopy deformation to the potential enables us to compute more high overtone modes reliably. It is known that the continued fraction method for computing QNMs of extremal RNBHs differs significantly from that used for nonextremal ones. In contrast, the bound state method demonstrates advantage of simplicity: one only need to account for the definition of tortoise coordinate in the extremal case, and the rest of the computational procedure remains exactly the same as that for the nonextremal case.

classification.title_zh: 从束缚态谱计算 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞的准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们应用一种新近提出的束缚态方法来重新计算 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞（RNBH）的引力与电磁准正规模（QNM）。发现该方法对低阶模式（overtone n≤3）给出高精度的 QNM 频率。对更高的 overtone，精度下降；然而，通过对势进行同伦形变，我们能够可靠地计算更多高阶 overtone 模式。已知用于计算极端 RNBH 的 QNM 的连分式方法与用于非极端情形的有显著不同。相反，束缚态方法展现出简洁性的优势：只需在极端情形中考虑乌龟坐标的定义，其余计算步骤与非极端情形完全相同。
classification.one_liner: 束缚态方法可高精度计算RN黑洞低阶准正规模，并通过势的同伦形变处理高阶overtone，且对极端情形保持简单统一。

papers.title: Inspiraling waveforms of charged compact binaries and observational constraints
papers.abstract: Electric charges carried by compact objects can affect binary dynamics and imprint characteristic signatures on gravitational-wave signals. We derive next-to-leading-order post-Newtonian frequency-domain waveforms for charged compact binaries in both the gravitational-quadrupole and electric-dipole dominated regimes, including electromagnetic corrections beyond leading-order electric-dipole radiation that reduce the degeneracy between the component charge-to-mass ratios. Using events from GWTC-5.0, we place constraints on the charge-to-mass ratio and mass of each component of the binary system.

classification.title_zh: 带电致密双星的旋近波形与观测约束
classification.abstract_zh: 致密天体所携带的电荷会影响双星动力学，并在引力波信号上留下特征印记。我们推导了带电致密双星在引力四极主导和电偶极主导两种情形下的次领头阶后牛顿频域波形，并纳入超出领头阶电偶极辐射的电磁修正，这些修正可减弱双星各组分荷质比之间的简并。利用 GWTC-5.0 中的事件，我们对双星系统每个组分的荷质比和质量给出了约束。
classification.one_liner: 推导带电致密双星次领头阶后牛顿频域波形，并用 GWTC-5.0 约束各组分荷质比与质量。

papers.title: Periodic Orbits of Van der Waals Black Holes
papers.abstract: Black holes in asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime whose extended-phase-space thermodynamics reproduces that of a van der Waals fluid exactly form a distinctive class, the van der Waals black holes (VBHs). The timelike geodesics of VBHs are solved, their periodic orbits are catalogued, and the gravitational waves emitted along them are computed, so as to trace how the thermodynamic pressure P and the molecular-volume parameter b shape the orbital dynamics. Integrating the geodesic equations numerically yields the energy, angular momentum and radius of the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) and maps out the family of bound orbits. To delimit the parameter window in which the effective potential stays well behaved, we introduce a critical angular momentum Ls. Within the orbit-classification scheme, we compute the energies corresponding to rational q for several parameter sets and display the resulting orbits. The waveforms produced along these orbits are generated within the "Kludge" formalism, which makes it possible to quantify the imprint of b on the wave amplitude and on the period. Both the orbital architecture and the gravitational-wave signature turn out to be strongly sensitive to b. The dynamical behavior of VBHs and Schwarzschild-AdS (SAdS) black holes differs markedly, providing a new perspective for probing black hole thermodynamics via gravitational wave observations.

classification.title_zh: 范德瓦尔斯黑洞的周期轨道
classification.abstract_zh: 在渐近反德西特（AdS）时空中，其扩展相空间热力学精确再现范德瓦尔斯流体的黑洞构成一类独特的黑洞，即范德瓦尔斯黑洞（VBHs）。我们求解了 VBHs 的类时测地线，对其周期轨道进行了分类，并计算了沿这些轨道发射的引力波，以追踪热力学压力 P 和分子体积参数 b 如何塑造轨道动力学。通过数值积分测地线方程，得到最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）的能量、角动量和半径，并描绘出束缚轨道族。为了界定有效势保持良好行为的参数窗口，我们引入临界角动量 Ls。在轨道分类方案中，我们针对若干参数组计算了对应于有理数 q 的能量，并展示了所得的轨道。沿这些轨道产生的波形在“Kludge”形式框架下生成，这使得可以量化 b 对波幅和周期的影响。轨道结构和引力波信号都被发现对 b 强烈敏感。VBHs 与 Schwarzschild-AdS（SAdS）黑洞的动力学行为显著不同，为通过引力波观测探测黑洞热力学提供了新视角。
classification.one_liner: 求解范德瓦尔斯黑洞的类时测地线与周期轨道，并用 Kludge 波形显示热力学参数 b 对轨道和引力波有强烈影响。

papers.title: Deterministic denoising of long-duration gravitational-wave signal candidates with $\alpha$-(de)blending
papers.abstract: We present a deterministic machine-learning method for denoising candidate signals from all-sky searches for continuous gravitational waves from rotating neutron stars. Using the time-domain $F$-statistic search pipeline, we post-process the resulting $F(f,\dot{f})$ candidate patterns with iterative $\alpha$-(de)blending, a deterministic diffusion-type generative model implemented as a U-Net, well suited to the non-Gaussian, correlated noise of the $F$-statistic output. Two models, trained on data based on simulated 6- and 12-day time-domain segments with software-injected signals similar to the LVK hardware injections, are tested by comparing deblended images to the library of expected signal patterns via the Structural Similarity Index Measure. In general the method recovers the correct sky-position-dependent pattern for signal-to-noise ratios $\rho \gtrsim 4$, moderately below typical all-sky detection thresholds, with recovery depending strongly on pattern morphology, demonstrating that deterministic diffusion-based denoising may serve as a consistency/veto tool ahead of the semi-coherent coincidence stage. We also discuss limitations and possible improvements of the method.

classification.title_zh: 用 α-(去)混合对长时引力波候选信号进行确定性去噪
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种确定性机器学习方法，用于对来自旋转中子星连续引力波全天搜索的候选信号进行去噪。利用时域 F 统计量搜索流程，我们对得到的 F(f, \dot{f}) 候选图样使用迭代 α-(去)混合进行后处理；这是一种以 U-Net 实现的确定性扩散型生成模型，适合处理 F 统计量输出中的非高斯、相关噪声。两个模型分别基于模拟的 6 天和 12 天时域数据段训练，数据中注入了类似 LVK 硬件注入的信号；通过用结构相似性指数将去混合后的图像与预期信号图样库比较来进行测试。总体而言，该方法在信噪比 ρ ≳ 4 时能恢复正确的、依赖天空位置的图样，略低于典型全天探测阈值；恢复效果强烈依赖图样形态，表明确定性扩散去噪可以作为半相干符合阶段之前的一致性/否决工具。我们还讨论了该方法的局限性和可能的改进。
classification.one_liner: 用确定性 α-(去)混合 U-Net 对连续引力波 F 统计候选图样去噪，可在较低信噪比恢复信号图样，作为一致性/否决工具。

papers.title: Analysis of GWTC-3 with multiple quasicircular models
papers.abstract: The interpretation of gravitational wave sources depends on the specific choice of model used to interpret signals. Previous analyses of GWTC-3 event candidates using SEOBNRv4PHM, IMRPhenomXPHM, and NRSur7dq4 have sometimes arrived at notably different conclusions about event properties. Subtle analysis settings and code differences can also produce notable differences. We revisit 60 publicly available events from the first three observing runs, released across GWTC-1, GWTC-2, GWTC-2.1, and GWTC-3, using a consistent analysis framework and three waveform models: two state-of-the-art time-domain models with higher-order modes (SEOBNRv5PHM and IMRPhenomTPHM) and one older frequency-domain model without higher-order modes (IMRPhenomPv2). The two state-of-the-art models agree well overall, although about 20\% of events have a visible difference in at least one one-dimensional marginal posterior. By contrast, the older model often arrives at qualitatively different conclusions for key events across the mass spectrum. We also identify a bug in published LVK GWTC-2.1 SEOBNRv4PHM results and in a later reprocessing of GW200105. At the adopted sampling rates, the model's Nyquist-frequency restriction excluded part of the allowed parameter space and artificially truncated the mass-ratio posterior away from equal mass for seven low-mass events. These results emphasize the need to use multiple state-of-the-art waveform models and carefully validated analysis settings to characterize uncertainty in gravitational-wave source properties.

classification.title_zh: 使用多个准圆轨道模型分析 GWTC-3
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波源的解释依赖于用于解读信号的具体模型选择。此前使用 SEOBNRv4PHM、IMRPhenomXPHM 和 NRSur7dq4 对 GWTC-3 事件候选者的分析，有时会对事件性质得出显著不同的结论。细微的分析设置和代码差异也可能产生明显差别。我们利用一致的分析框架和三种波形模型，重新审视了来自前三个观测运行、在 GWTC-1、GWTC-2、GWTC-2.1 和 GWTC-3 中公开发布的 60 个事件：两个包含高阶模式的最先进时域模型（SEOBNRv5PHM 和 IMRPhenomTPHM），以及一个不含高阶模式的较旧频域模型（IMRPhenomPv2）。两个最先进模型总体吻合良好，尽管约 20% 的事件在至少一个一维边缘后验上存在可见差异。相比之下，较旧模型对质量谱中的关键事件常常得出定性不同的结论。我们还发现已发表的 LVK GWTC-2.1 SEOBNRv4PHM 结果以及后来对 GW200105 的一次再处理中存在一个缺陷。在所采用的采样率下，该模型的奈奎斯特频率限制排除了部分允许的参数空间，并人为地将七个低质量事件的质量比后验从等质量处截断。这些结果强调，需要使用多个最先进波形模型并仔细验证分析设置，以刻画引力波源性质中的不确定性。
classification.one_liner: 用一致框架比较三种波形模型重分析 GWTC-3 的 60 个事件，发现最先进模型总体一致但较旧模型常给出定性不同结论，并指出 LVK 部分结果中的采样率截断缺陷。

classification.title_zh: 伪复广义相对论中的曲率正则化与动力学真空结构
classification.abstract_zh:
经典时空在任意高曲率下是否仍然良好定义是一个核心问题。在广义相对论中，奇点标志着经典描述的失效，促使人们修改时空的短距离结构。伪复广义相对论（pcGR）将时空几何推广到伪复坐标，自然引入两个度规扇区：物理度规 g_{\mu
u} 和辅助场 f_{\mu
u}。伪虚分量的大小定义了不变加速度标度 a0，这是伪复结构的直接结果。同时性条件要求两个幂等扇区分别独立满足伪复 Einstein 方程，从而代数地固定辅助场，不引入新的传播自由度，并对 lapse 给出下界以正则化曲率。正则化通过 lapse-gap 条件 e^{
u}(r) > a0（确保径向度规分量保持非退化）与面积半径原点处的正则性条件 B(0)=1、B'(0)=0（自然来自伪复几何）的共同作用实现。这些条件共同消除了 Schwarzschild 型曲率发散，而不是仅由 gap 条件起作用。
classification.one_liner: 伪复广义相对论通过同时性条件与 lapse 下界，在不引入新传播自由度的情况下正则化 Schwarzschild 型曲率发散。

papers.title: Distinguishing cosmology, astrophysics and systematics: the Bayesian search for a primordial gravitational-wave background in next-generation observatories
papers.abstract: Next-generation gravitational-wave observatories like Cosmic Explorer will provide an unprecedented opportunity to probe the cosmological stochastic gravitational-wave background, providing insight into the early Universe that is inaccessible with other means. We investigate the prospects for measuring a Gaussian cosmological gravitational-wave background in Cosmic Explorer in the presence of a distinguishable, non-Gaussian foreground of binary black hole mergers, using a Bayesian search that simultaneously fits binary black hole and background parameters. We successfully recover a Gaussian cosmological background with a signal-to-noise ratio of 5 in one day of simulated data in Cosmic Explorer without contamination from unresolved signals or data exclusion. However, when introducing waveform systematic errors to our analysis, our inference on the stochastic background parameters becomes biased and can falsely infer the presence of a background when there is none. The bias is driven by signal mismatches at low frequencies (<20 Hz), especially when the recovery waveform is missing physical effects included in the injected signals. While we propose a metric for diagnosing if measurements will be strongly biased by waveform systematics, our results suggest improvements in waveform modeling or other mitigation techniques will be required to accurately recover a primordial stochastic gravitational-wave background in next-generation detectors.

classification.title_zh: 区分宇宙学、天体物理与系统误差：下一代观测站中原初引力波背景的贝叶斯搜索
classification.abstract_zh: 像 Cosmic Explorer 这样的下一代引力波观测站，将为探测宇宙学随机引力波背景提供前所未有的机会，从而揭示其他手段无法触及的早期宇宙信息。我们研究在 Cosmic Explorer 中测量高斯型宇宙学引力波背景的前景，背景中存在一个可区分的、非高斯的双黑洞并合前景；我们采用贝叶斯搜索，同时拟合双黑洞与背景参数。在 Cosmic Explorer 的一天模拟数据中，我们成功以信噪比 5 恢复出高斯型宇宙学背景，且未受到未分辨信号污染，也无需排除数据。然而，当我们把波形系统误差引入分析时，对随机背景参数的推断会变得有偏，并可能在实际上不存在背景时错误地推断其存在。这种偏差由低频（<20 Hz）处的信号失配驱动，尤其是当恢复波形缺少注入信号中包含的物理效应时。我们提出了一种诊断测量是否会因波形系统误差而严重有偏的指标；结果表明，要在下一代探测器中准确恢复原初随机引力波背景，仍需改进波形建模或其他缓解技术。
classification.one_liner: 在 Cosmic Explorer 模拟中，贝叶斯联合推断可在一日内以 SNR 5 恢复高斯原初引力波背景，但低频波形系统误差会造成有偏结果甚至虚假背景信号。

papers.title: The Loud Tail of the Supermassive Black Hole Binary Population: Multimessenger Candidates and Prospects for SKAO
papers.abstract: We assess whether electromagnetically identified supermassive black hole (SMBH) binary candidates populate the rare, high-amplitude tail of the gravitational wave (GW) amplitude distribution. Using an SMBH binary population model fitted to the NANOGrav 15-year data, we find that 3C~66B and Mrk~501 are likely to stand out from the GW background, making them promising targets for individual-source searches. Furthermore, we show that individual detections can probe the binary hardening mechanism, as models with strong environmental hardening predict a higher abundance of individually resolvable binaries than purely GW-driven models. Applying the same population fits and accounting for the confusion noise from the unresolved population, we forecast that the Square Kilometre Array Observatory (SKAO) will resolve tens of individual binaries, with 3C~66B robustly detectable.

classification.title_zh: 超大质量黑洞双星族群的高振幅尾部：多信使候选体与 SKAO 前景
classification.abstract_zh: 我们评估电磁证认的超大质量黑洞（SMBH）双星候选体是否占据引力波（GW）振幅分布中罕见的高振幅尾部。利用拟合 NANOGrav 15 年数据的 SMBH 双星族群模型，我们发现 3C 66B 和 Mrk 501 很可能从 GW 背景中凸显，使其成为单源搜索的有希望目标。此外，我们表明单源探测可以探测双星硬化机制，因为具有强环境硬化的模型预测可单独分辨的双星数量比纯 GW 驱动模型更多。应用相同的族群拟合并考虑未分辨族群带来的混淆噪声，我们预测平方公里阵列天文台（SKAO）将分辨数十个单源双星，其中 3C 66B 可稳健探测。
classification.one_liner: 利用拟合 NANOGrav 15 年数据的 SMBH 双星族群模型，预测 3C 66B、Mrk 501 等候选体位于引力波背景高振幅尾部，并展望 SKAO 可分辨数十个双星。

papers.title: Demonstrating the thermal noise limit in a backaction-free bulk acoustic wave resonator chain for gravitational wave detection
papers.abstract: We report the full sub-Kelvin characterization of the BAUSCIA high-frequency gravitational-wave antenna, based on cryogenic Bulk Acoustic Wave resonators coupled to SQUID amplifiers for signal readout. The end-to-end performance analysis of the experimental chain, from the sensor to the DAQ, demonstrates that resonator thermal noise dominates the noise budget at temperatures well below 100 mK for all investigated modes. The measurements also verify proper thermalization of the resonator modes and rule out significant SQUID backaction on the strain sensor, confirming that the system operates close to its fundamental limits with comparable resonator thermal noise and additive readout noise. From this characterization, we derive projected strain sensitivities in the range $1$--$10 \times 10^{-21}\,\mathrm{Hz}^{-1/2}$ for several resonant frequencies between 5 and 20~MHz, with corresponding fundamental thermal limits in the range $0.7$--$1.4 \times 10^{-21}\,\mathrm{Hz}^{-1/2}$. Equipped with three resonators and synchronized to an absolute global time reference for multi-site coincidences, the antenna is ready to enter a pilot science run.

classification.title_zh: 在用于引力波探测的无反作用体声波谐振器链中展示热噪声极限
classification.abstract_zh: 我们报告了 BAUSCIA 高频引力波天线的完整亚开尔文表征，该天线基于低温体声波谐振器，并与 SQUID 放大器耦合用于信号读出。对从传感器到 DAQ 的整个实验链的端到端性能分析表明，对所有研究的模式，在远低于 100 mK 的温度下，谐振器热噪声在噪声预算中占主导。测量还验证了谐振器模式的适当热化，并排除了 SQUID 对应变传感器显著的背反作用，确认系统运行在接近其基本极限，谐振器热噪声与附加读出噪声相当。基于该表征，我们推导出在 5 至 20 MHz 之间的若干谐振频率下，应变灵敏度预计在 1–10 × 10^-21 Hz^-1/2 范围内，相应的基本热极限在 0.7–1.4 × 10^-21 Hz^-1/2 范围内。该天线配备三个谐振器，并同步到绝对全球时间参考以进行多站点符合，已准备好进入试点科学运行。
classification.one_liner: BAUSCIA 体声波谐振器引力波天线的亚开尔文表征显示其噪声由谐振器热噪声主导，系统接近基本极限并准备试点运行。

papers.title: A compact time-domain reduced order quadrature for gravitational wave inspirals with non-stationary noise
papers.abstract: We develop the first time-domain reduced order quadrature for gravitational waves in the early inspiral period, motivated by the need for dataset compression in the presence of gaps, uneven sampling, and dense covariance matrices. A single reduced basis with 1290 elements can represent inspirals from supermassive black hole binary sources with chirp masses between $10^7-10^{10}$ $M_\odot$, but in the presence of non-stationary noise $\sim 1290^2$ reduced order quadrature weights must be stored. We are able to reduce the stored weights by a factor of two by partitioning our parameter space by GW frequency, with relative waveform/likelihood accuracies remaining below $10^{-5}$/$10^{-3}$ after partition. Finally, we point out that heterodyning can be combined with reduced order methods with no loss in accuracy. Our reduced order quadrature makes inspiral searches in the time domain feasible for both pulsar timing arrays and relative stellar astrometry.

classification.title_zh: 面向非平稳噪声引力波旋近的紧致时域降阶求积
classification.abstract_zh: 我们开发了首个用于早期旋近阶段引力波的时间域降阶求积，其动机是在存在数据缺口、不均匀采样和密集协方差矩阵时进行数据集压缩。一个包含1290个元素的单一降阶基可以表示啁啾质量在10^7-10^10太阳质量之间的超大质量双黑洞旋近，但在非平稳噪声下需存储约1290^2个降阶求积权重。我们通过按引力波频率划分参数空间，将存储权重减半，划分后波形/似然相对精度仍低于10^-5/10^-3。最后指出外差法可与降阶方法结合且不损失精度。我们的降阶求积使脉冲星计时阵列和相对恒星天体测量中的时域旋近搜索变得可行。
classification.one_liner: 提出首个时域降阶求积方法，用于非平稳噪声下超大质量双黑洞早期旋近的引力波搜索与数据压缩。

papers.title: The effect of pressure confinement on the maximum mass of rapidly accreting supermassive stars
papers.abstract: We derive an extension of Chandrasekhar's pulsational stability criterion for relativistic stars with a pressure boundary condition at the surface. We then apply the new criterion to hylotropes, a model describing rapidly accreting supermassive stars with a core-envelope structure. We find that confinement typically stabilises stars, delaying the onset of the general relativistic instability when the external pressure at the surface is roughly $\sim10^{-3}$ of the stars' hydrostatic pressure scale. Beyond this value, the critical mass at marginal stability increases rapidly, exceeding the value of $\sim 10^5$ M$_{\odot}$ for helium burning, isolated $n=3$ polytropes by orders of magnitude. We discuss how the required pressure boundary conditions may be produced by the combined ram and magnetic pressure supplied by the accretion flow as it assembles the supermassive star, and provide a fitting formula for the final mass before collapse. As a rough estimate assuming equipartition between magnetic and thermal pressures in a standard $\alpha$-disk, we find that the critical mass doubles at accretion rates of order $\dot M\sim100\,{\rm M_\odot}\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$, again increasing rapidly after this value. Our results show under what conditions, potentially realized in a subset of high redshift halos, non-rotating SMS may collapse into black holes beyond the typical scale of heavy seeds.

classification.title_zh: 压力约束对快速吸积超大质量星最大质量的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 我们推导了 Chandrasekhar 脉动稳定性判据在具有表面压力边界条件的相对论星情形下的扩展形式。随后我们将新判据应用于 hylotropes，这是一种描述具有核-包层结构的快速吸积超大质量星的模型。我们发现，约束通常会使恒星稳定，当表面外部压力约为恒星流体静压尺度的 ~10^-3 时，会推迟广义相对论不稳定性的开始。超过该值后，临界稳定质量迅速增大，比氦燃烧、孤立 n=3 多方球的 ~10^5 太阳质量高出几个数量级。我们讨论了所需的压力边界条件如何可能由吸积流在组装超大质量星时提供的冲压与磁压联合产生，并给出了坍缩前最终质量的拟合公式。作为粗略估计，假设标准 α 盘中磁压与热压均分，我们发现临界质量在吸积率约 100 太阳质量/年的量级时加倍，此后再次迅速增大。我们的结果说明在何种条件下——可能在部分高红移晕中实现——非旋转超大质量星可能坍缩成超过典型重种子尺度的黑洞。
classification.one_liner: 扩展 Chandrasekhar 脉动稳定性判据至带表面压力边界条件的相对论星，发现约束通常稳定恒星并可使临界质量提高几个数量级，在特定吸积率下可能形成超过重种子典型尺度的黑洞。

papers.title: Probing Nonlinear Logarithmic Kalb-Ramond Black Holes: Particle Dynamics, Epicyclic Oscillations and Thermodynamic Signatures
papers.abstract: In contrast to conventional linear coupling frameworks, the proposed work investigated the nonlinear effects that become more significant in the strong field regime of a black hole. We have investigated a new class of Kalb Ramond black holes generated by a nonlinear logarithmic coupling of the field, referred to as a Logarithmic Kalb Ramond black hole. The logarithmic coupling introduces strong-field modifications to the spacetime geometry, leading to significant departures from the Schwarzschild and Reissner Nordstrom BHs. We analyze the motion of test particles using the effective potential formalism and derive the conserved energy and angular momentum for circular equatorial geodesics. The stability of circular orbits and the location of the innermost stable circular orbit are examined, revealing a strong dependence on the model parameters Q, l, and $\beta$. The epicyclic frequencies (radial, vertical, and azimuthal) together with the associated periastron precession demonstrate that nonlinear logarithmic corrections can substantially modify quasi periodic oscillation observables. We further investigate the Hawking temperature and energy emission rate, which show that the nonlinear coupling also impacts distinct imprints on the thermodynamic behavior and evaporation characteristics of the black hole. Our results also identify the BH parameters as key regulators of the orbital dynamics, oscillatory properties, and thermal evolution, providing a unified framework for probing nonlinear KR gravity through strong-field astrophysical phenomena.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 探测非线性对数 Kalb-Ramond 黑洞：粒子动力学、本轮振荡与热力学特征
classification.abstract_zh: 与传统的线性耦合框架不同，本工作研究了在黑洞强场区域中变得更为显著的非线性效应。我们研究了一类由场的非线性对数耦合产生的新 Kalb-Ramond 黑洞，称为对数 Kalb-Ramond 黑洞。该对数耦合对时空几何引入强场修正，导致其显著偏离 Schwarzschild 和 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞。我们用有效势形式分析检验粒子运动，并推导赤道圆测地线的守恒能量与角动量。考察圆轨道稳定性与最内稳定圆轨道位置，发现其强烈依赖模型参数 Q、l 和 β。径向、垂直与方位角本轮频率以及相关的近星点进动表明，非线性对数修正可以显著改变准周期振荡观测量。我们进一步研究霍金温度与能量发射率，发现非线性耦合也会对黑洞热力学行为和蒸发特征留下不同印记。结果还表明黑洞参数是轨道动力学、振荡性质与热演化的关键调节量，为通过强场天体物理现象探测非线性 KR 引力提供了统一框架。
classification.one_liner: 研究对数非线性 Kalb-Ramond 黑洞的粒子轨道、本轮振荡和热力学信号，表明模型参数显著影响强场观测。

papers.title: Cosmological dynamics based on Lovelock's gravity. Qualitative analysis
papers.abstract: We perform a complete qualitative analysis of the cosmological dynamics of Lovelock gravity in a spatially flat Friedmann-Robertson-Walker (FRW) universe filled with a perfect fluid obeying a barotropic equation of state $p=\omega\rho$. Starting from the generalized $N$-dimensional Friedmann equations written in terms of the independent components of the Riemann tensor, we reduce the dynamics to a single autonomous first-order equation for the Hubble parameter $H$, whose right-hand side is a ratio of polynomials in $H^2$ fixed by the order $n$ of the Lovelock polynomial, the number of dimensions $N$, and the coupling constants $\alpha_i$. The real roots of these polynomials determine the fixed points and the singular points of the system, which govern its asymptotic behaviour. We give a complete classification of the possible evolution scenarios, identify the attractive and repulsive fixed points, locate the "phantom intervals" in which the effective matter density becomes negative, and show that fixed points are reached in infinite time whereas singular points are reached in finite time. For $N>4$ and suitable negative couplings a qualitatively new scenario arises, which we call the "Big Shock": the universe starts from a state with finite density and finite scale factor but with an infinite rate of change of the Hubble parameter, replacing the standard Big Bang. The general analysis is illustrated for $n=1$, $N=4$ (general relativity), $n=2$, $N=5$ (Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity), and $n=3$, $N=7$ (cubic Lovelock gravity).

classification.title_zh: 基于Lovelock引力的宇宙学动力学：定性分析
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在充满满足状态方程 p=ωρ 的完美流体的空间平直 Friedmann-Robertson-Walker（FRW）宇宙中，对 Lovelock 引力的宇宙学动力学进行完整定性分析。从用 Riemann 张量独立分量写出的推广 N 维 Friedmann 方程出发，我们将动力学约化为关于 Hubble 参数 H 的单个一阶自治方程，其右端是 H^2 的多项式之比，由 Lovelock 多项式的阶数 n、维数 N 和耦合常数 α_i 决定。这些多项式的实根确定系统的固定点与奇点，并支配其渐近行为。我们给出可能演化情景的完整分类，识别吸引与排斥固定点，定位有效物质密度变为负值的“phantom intervals”，并表明固定点在无限时间达到，而奇点在有限时间达到。对于 N>4 和合适的负耦合，会出现一种新的定性情景，我们称之为“Big Shock”：宇宙从有限密度和有限尺度因子但 Hubble 参数变化率为无穷的状态开始，取代标准大爆炸。一般分析以 n=1,N=4（广义相对论）、n=2,N=5（Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力）和 n=3,N=7（三次 Lovelock 引力）为例进行说明。
classification.one_liner: 对Lovelock引力平直FRW宇宙学做完整定性分析，分类不动点与奇点，并发现N>4负耦合下可取代标准大爆炸的Big Shock情景。

papers.title: On the physical origin of the radial acceleration relation
papers.abstract: The radial acceleration relation (RAR) is a tight correlation between the distribution of baryonic matter in galaxies and their observed dynamics, even in systems where dark matter dominates. This suggests a universal acceleration scale exists in galaxies, which appears to challenge the $\Lambda$CDM standard cosmological model and favor Modified Newtonian dynamics (MOND). However, MOND also deviates from the RAR, so these deviations are not fully explained by the $\Lambda$CDM model or MOND. A theory that explains gravity and the dark sector geometrically, and treats dark matter as a spin-1 particle, is required, such as Modified General Relativity (MGR). It is the only metric-compatible theory of gravity that describes local gravitational energy-momentum by the connection-independent symmetric tensor $\varPhi_{\alpha\beta}$, which completes the total energy-momentum tensor of the Einstein equation. Dark energy is explained by the energy-related component $\varPhi_{00}$, and dark matter by the stress components $\varPhi_{ij}$. Dark matter is extremely difficult to observe because it is fundamentally related to the Lorentzian metric of spacetime itself. The physical origin of the RAR follows directly from the equilibrium between the dark energy and Newtonian forces in the outer part of the rotation curve of galaxies or galaxy clusters, and that between the dark sector forces in the inner part of the rotation curve. It is shown that MGR subsumes MOND, accounts for the gravitational anomaly observed in wide binaries, and exhibits the observed Newtonian behavior of gravity at large scales.

classification.title_zh: 论径向加速度关系的物理起源
classification.abstract_zh: 径向加速度关系（RAR）是星系中重子物质分布与其观测动力学之间的一种紧密关联，即使在暗物质主导的系统中也是如此。这表明星系中存在一个普适加速度尺度，似乎挑战了 ΛCDM 标准宇宙学模型，并偏向修正牛顿动力学（MOND）。然而，MOND 也偏离 RAR，因此这些偏离无法由 ΛCDM 或 MOND 完全解释。需要一种从几何上解释引力与暗区、并将暗物质视为自旋 1 粒子的理论，例如修正广义相对论（MGR）。它是唯一与度规兼容的引力理论，通过独立于联络的对称张量 Φ_{αβ} 描述局域引力能量-动量，并补全 Einstein 方程的总能量-动量张量。暗能量由与能量相关的分量 Φ_{00} 解释，暗物质由应力分量 Φ_{ij} 解释。暗物质极难观测，因为它从根本上与时空的洛伦兹度规本身相关。RAR 的物理起源直接来自星系或星系团旋转曲线外部区域中暗能量力与牛顿力之间的平衡，以及旋转曲线内部区域中暗区力之间的平衡。研究表明，MGR 包含了 MOND，解释了宽双星中观测到的引力异常，并展现出大尺度上观测到的牛顿引力行为。
classification.one_liner: 该文提出修正广义相对论（MGR）以几何方式解释暗区，并给出径向加速度关系（RAR）的物理起源。

papers.title: Note on pulsar timing array correlation functions induced by peculiar velocities
papers.abstract: Several papers have recently calculated the contribution to pulsar timing array overlap reduction functions (ORFs) induced by our peculiar velocity with respect to the rest frame of the stochastic gravitational-wave background. Here we show that a harmonic-space calculation confirms the most recent result. We note that, with the harmonic-space calculation, the ORFs for spin-1 GWs and the correlations with astrometry measurements are also easily obtained.

classification.title_zh: 关于本动速度引起的脉冲星计时阵列相关函数的注记
classification.abstract_zh: 最近若干论文计算了相对于随机引力波背景静止系的本动速度对脉冲星计时阵列重叠约化函数（ORF）的贡献。这里我们表明，谐空间计算证实了最新结果。我们指出，借助谐空间计算，自旋为 1 的引力波以及天体测量测量对应的相关函数也容易得到。

papers.title: Estimating galactic foreground with the population of resolved galactic binaries
papers.abstract: The stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) in the millihertz band constitutes a primary science target for future space-based interferometers. The detection of such a signal, however, poses substantial data-processing challenges, not least due to the overwhelming contribution from numerous compact binaries in our Galaxy. Only a fraction of these binaries are sufficiently bright to be resolved as individual sources. The superposition of gravitational waves from the inspiral phases of the unresolved majority gives rise to a confusion foreground that must be accurately estimated. In this work, we model this foreground as an anisotropic SGWB and derive the variation of detector response intensity by analyzing the spatial distribution of binary systems. We further examine the distribution of resolved systems to assess whether they are representative of the total population. Finally, we perform parameter estimation to an injected stochastic background using the modeled foreground within the Taiji Data Challenge II. Our results demonstrate that a foreground description based on the population properties of resolved Galactic binaries can yield preliminarily viable estimates.

classification.title_zh: 利用已分辨银河双星种群估计银河前景
classification.abstract_zh: 毫赫兹频段的随机引力波背景（SGWB）是未来空间引力波干涉仪的主要科学目标之一。然而，探测这种信号面临巨大的数据处理挑战，尤其是来自银河系中大量致密双星的压倒性贡献。只有一部分双星足够明亮，可以被分辨为单个源。未分辨的大多数双星在旋近阶段的引力波叠加形成混淆前景，必须被准确估计。在这项工作中，我们将该前景建模为各向异性 SGWB，并通过分析双星系统的空间分布推导探测器响应强度的变化。我们进一步考察已分辨系统的分布，以评估它们是否能代表总体种群。最后，我们在 Taiji Data Challenge II 中，利用所建模的前景对注入的随机背景进行参数估计。结果表明，基于已分辨银河双星种群性质的前景描述能够给出初步可行的估计。
classification.one_liner: 用已分辨银河双星种群性质建模毫赫兹频段各向异性随机引力波前景，并在 Taiji Data Challenge II 中检验参数估计。

papers.title: Tidal Disruption of Blanets by Supermassive Black Holes: From Test Particles to Planetary-Mass Bodies in Kerr Spacetime
papers.abstract: Planetary-mass bodies formed in active galactic nucleus (AGN) discs, termed "blanets", may undergo tidal disruption by the central supermassive black hole (SMBH). We analyse this process in Kerr spacetime using Mino-time geodesics and the Marck tidal tensor in a parallel-transported tetrad, treating the blanet as a test particle with finite size entering through the disruption criterion. For a blanet of $100 M_{\oplus}$ and $6 R_{\oplus}$ around a $10^7 M_{\odot}$ SMBH, the tidal radius is 0.82 AU, or 8.3 gravitational radii, requiring a non-perturbative relativistic treatment. The Hills mass depends on bulk density as $M_{\rm Hills}\propto\rho_p^{-1/2}$ and is independent of blanet mass at fixed density. Rocky compositions yield a lower Hills mass than a Sun-like star, while volatile-rich compositions yield a higher value, suggesting a potential composition diagnostic. The frozen-in fallback model gives a peak time of about 15 yr and a peak luminosity of $3.7\times10^{40}$ erg/s, about $3\times10^{-5}$ of the Eddington luminosity, predicting a faint, ultraviolet-peaked transient lasting roughly a century. Scalar resonant relaxation in the surrounding nuclear star cluster may deliver blanets to disruptive orbits over $10^8$ to $10^9$ yr, implying an estimated per-AGN event rate of $10^{-7}$ to $10^{-6}$ per year. Gravitational waves from sub-Earth-mass debris fragments remain approximately nine orders of magnitude below Laser Interferometer Space Antenna sensitivity.

classification.title_zh: 超大质量黑洞对 Blanets 的潮汐瓦解：Kerr 时空中从测试粒子到行星质量天体
classification.abstract_zh: 在活动星系核（AGN）盘中形成的行星质量天体被称为“blanets”，它们可能被中心超大质量黑洞（SMBH）潮汐瓦解。我们使用 Mino 时间测地线和沿平行传输四元标架中的 Marck 潮汐张量，在 Kerr 时空中分析这一过程，将 blanet 视为具有有限尺寸的测试粒子，并通过瓦解判据进入。对于围绕 10^7 M_⊙ SMBH 的 100 M_⊕ 和 6 R_⊕ 的 blanet，潮汐半径为 0.82 AU，即 8.3 引力半径，需要非微扰相对论处理。Hills 质量依赖体密度为 M_Hills ∝ ρ_p^{-1/2}，在固定密度下与 blanet 质量无关。岩石成分给出比类太阳恒星更低的 Hills 质量，而富挥发分成分给出更高值，表明潜在成分诊断。冻结回落模型给出峰值时间约 15 年，峰值光度 3.7×10^40 erg/s，约为 Eddington 光度的 3×10^{-5}，预测一个微弱、紫外峰值、持续约一个世纪的暂现源。周围核星团中的标量共振弛豫可能在 10^8 到 10^9 年将 blanets 送入瓦解轨道，意味着每个 AGN 的事件率估计为每年 10^{-7} 到 10^{-6}。来自亚地球质量碎片的引力波仍比 LISA 灵敏度低约九个数量级。
classification.one_liner: 在 Kerr 时空中研究 AGN 盘内行星质量 Blanets 被超大质量黑洞潮汐瓦解，预测微弱紫外暂现源、事件率与 LISA 可忽略的引力波。

papers.title: Topological Orders from Reflection Positive Frustration-free Hamiltonians
papers.abstract: We establish a framework based on reflection positivity for analyzing topologically ordered quantum spin systems and reconstructing their boundary algebras. For any reflection positive frustration-free Hamiltonian, we prove that the local topological quantum order (LTQO) condition of ground states on a disk holds, if and only if the ground state on the sphere obtained by gluing the disk with its reflection is nondegenerate. Furthermore, we show that Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction produces the local net of boundary operator algebras from the local ground states, offering a constructive approach to topological holography through spatial reflection positivity.

classification.title_zh: 来自反射正性无阻挫哈密顿量的拓扑序
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了一个基于反射正性的框架，用于分析拓扑有序量子自旋系统并重构其边界代数。对于任意反射正性无阻挫哈密顿量，我们证明：圆盘上基态的局域拓扑量子序（LTQO）条件成立，当且仅当通过将圆盘与其反射粘合得到的球面基态非简并。此外，我们表明 Osterwalder-Schrader 重构从局域基态产生边界算符代数的局域网，通过空间反射正性为拓扑全息提供了一种构造性途径。

papers.title: Diffraction of gravitational waves by extended dark objects
papers.abstract: Many dark sector models predict the formation of dark objects, such as solitons and dark stars, which can be searched for through their gravitational lensing of gravitational waves (GWs). Although these objects vary widely in size and compactness, most GW lensing studies have focused on point-like lenses. The finite size of an extended lens is important when it exceeds its Einstein radius. We evaluate the frequency-dependent effects on GW waveforms from extended lenses and demonstrate that they can be probed with current and future GW data. While finite-size effects can weaken the bounds on the fraction of dark matter in these objects compared to the point-like limit, current GW data provides complementary constraints to other gravitational tests for lens masses between $10^2M_\odot$ and $10^5M_\odot$; future LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA data and next-generation observatories will surpass their sensitivity. As expected, we find that the finite-size effects are important when the lens radius exceeds $\sim \text{few} \times 10^{6}R_\odot (M_L/100 M_\odot)^{1/2}$. Interpreting these constraints within specific models (a simple dissipative dark sector and axion stars), we show that current and future observations probe significant portions of the microphysical parameter space.

classification.title_zh: 延展暗天体对引力波的衍射
classification.abstract_zh: 许多暗区模型预言暗天体的形成，例如孤子和暗星，这些暗天体可以通过其对引力波（GWs）的引力透镜效应被搜寻。尽管这些天体在大小和致密程度方面差异很大，但大多数引力波透镜研究都集中于点状透镜。当延展透镜的有限尺寸超过其爱因斯坦半径时，该尺寸效应变得重要。我们评估了延展透镜对引力波波形产生的频率依赖效应，并证明它们可以用当前和未来的引力波数据探测。虽然与点状极限相比，有限尺寸效应可能削弱对暗物质在这些天体中所占份额的限制，但对于透镜质量在 10^2 M_sun 到 10^5 M_sun 之间，当前引力波数据提供了与其他引力检验互补的限制；未来 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 数据和下一代天文台将超越其灵敏度。正如预期，我们发现当透镜半径超过约几 × 10^6 R_sun (M_L/100 M_sun)^{1/2} 时，有限尺寸效应很重要。将这些限制在具体模型（一个简单耗散暗区与轴子星）中解释，我们表明当前和未来观测可探测微观物理参数空间的重要部分。
classification.one_liner: 研究延展暗天体对引力波波形的频率依赖衍射/透镜效应，并利用当前与未来引力波数据限制暗天体参数空间。

papers.title: NICER neutron stars with dark energy and dark matter: effects on the inferred equation of state
papers.abstract: [Abridged] In this work, we compare neutron stars where dark energy or dark matter are present in the core, contrasting them against purely baryonic stars with the same central energy density. From this comparison, we find that the dark energy models are more constrained by neutron star observations than the dark matter models, suggesting that neutron stars can place strong constraints on dark energy parameters. We consider four configurations: purely baryonic neutron stars described by a piecewise polytropic (PP) equation of state (EoS), baryonic stars admixed with bosonic or fermionic asymmetric dark matter (ADM) cores, and stars with a dark energy core and baryonic shell, where the dark energy is described by the modified Chaplygin dark fluid (MCDF). Using the masses and radii of PSR J0740$+$6620, PSR J0437$-$4715, and PSR J0030$+$0451, we employ Bayesian inference to investigate how accounting for bosonic/fermionic ADM and MCDF cores affects the inferred neutron star properties. We find that MCDF cores, more than PP and ADM admixed models, substantially broaden neutron star mass-radius and pressure-energy density posterior distributions. Moreover, the MCDF EoS parameters can be tightly constrained. While bosonic and fermionic ADM cores decrease the inferred maximum mass, their posteriors strongly coincide with those of the PP model for ADM mass-fractions $F_\chi \leq 5\%$. These results demonstrate that current mass-radius observations cannot rule out MCDF cores, but they can constrain the MCDF parameter space to narrow regions. ADM admixed neutron stars, however, remain observationally identical to purely baryonic stars for all explored mass-fractions, even with improved mass-radius uncertainties. This suggests that mass-radius measurements alone are insufficient to detect ADM core inside neutron stars and that independent astrophysical or particle physics probes will be required.

classification.title_zh: 带暗能量与暗物质的 NICER 中子星：对推断状态方程的影响
classification.abstract_zh: [节略] 在这项工作中，我们比较了核心中存在暗能量或暗物质的中子星，并将它们与具有相同中心能量密度的纯重子星进行对比。通过比较，我们发现暗能量模型比暗物质模型受到中子星观测更强的约束，这表明中子星可以对暗能量参数施加严格限制。我们考虑四种位形：由分段多方（PP）状态方程（EoS）描述的纯重子中子星；混合玻色或费米非对称暗物质（ADM）核心的重子星；以及具有暗能量核心和重子壳层的星体，其中暗能量由修正 Chaplygin 暗流体（MCDF）描述。利用 PSR J0740+6620、PSR J0437−4715 和 PSR J0030+0451 的质量和半径，我们采用贝叶斯推断来研究考虑玻色/费米 ADM 和 MCDF 核心如何影响推断出的中子星性质。我们发现，与 PP 和 ADM 混合模型相比，MCDF 核心显著展宽了中子星质量-半径以及压强-能量密度后验分布。此外，MCDF 的 EoS 参数可以被严格约束。虽然玻色和费米 ADM 核心会降低推断的最大质量，但在 ADM 质量分数 Fχ ≤ 5% 时，它们的后验与 PP 模型的后验强烈重合。这些结果表明，当前质量-半径观测不能排除 MCDF 核心，但可以把 MCDF 参数空间限制到狭窄区域。然而，对于所有探索的质量分数，ADM 混合中子星在观测上仍然与纯重子星相同，即使质量-半径不确定度得到改善。这表明仅靠质量-半径测量不足以探测中子星内部的 ADM 核心，需要独立的天体物理或粒子物理探针。
classification.one_liner: 利用 NICER 质量-半径数据贝叶斯推断含暗物质或暗能量核心的中子星状态方程，发现暗能量核心参数可被约束，而 ADM 核心难以与纯重子星区分。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文以中子星质量-半径观测和状态方程为核心，属于经典引力/致密星与暗物质暗能量效应研究，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点方向。

papers.title: Stability and Structural Properties of Hot Quark Stars within Perturbative QCD
papers.abstract: The hypothesis of strange quark matter (SQM) and the possible existence of strange stars have been extensively investigated within the thermodynamic bag model, typically employing the free Fermi gas approximation with or without perturbative QCD corrections at zero temperature, where quark confinement is modeled by the bag pressure. In this work, based on the perturbative inclusion of quark mass effects, we develop a thermodynamically consistent equation of state (EOS) for SQM at finite temperature, incorporating perturbative corrections up to $\mathcal{O}(\alpha_s)$ in the strong coupling constant $\alpha_s$ while ensuring full adherence to the Maxwell relations. These corrections are essential for accurately describing hot quark stars potentially formed during core-collapse events. We present results for both fixed and running couplings, using a phenomenological model to include the breakdown of the perturbative running of $\alpha_s$ at low momenta. Our results demonstrate that incorporating finite-temperature perturbative QCD corrections leads to SQM configurations that fall within the absolute stability window, with equilibrium energies per baryon lying below that of iron, the most tightly bound nucleus. Our EOS supports compact stars with masses exceeding $1.4\,M_\odot$ (and above $2\,M_\odot$ for some values of the bag constant), in agreement with current astrophysical constraints from pulsar and gravitational-wave observations.

classification.title_zh: 微扰QCD中热夸克星的稳定性与结构性质
classification.abstract_zh: 奇异夸克物质（SQM）假说以及奇异星的可能存在，已在热力学袋模型框架下得到广泛研究，通常采用自由费米气体近似，并在零温下考虑或不考虑微扰QCD修正，其中夸克禁闭由袋压建模。在本工作中，基于对夸克质量效应的微扰纳入，我们构建了有限温度下SQM的热力学一致状态方程（EOS），其中包含至强耦合常数α_s的O(α_s)阶微扰修正，同时确保完全满足麦克斯韦关系。这些修正对于准确描述核心坍缩事件中可能形成的高温夸克星至关重要。我们给出了固定耦合和跑动耦合两种情形下的结果，并使用一个唯象模型来纳入α_s微扰跑动在低动量处的失效。结果表明，纳入有限温度微扰QCD修正后，SQM组态落入绝对稳定窗口，其每重子平衡能量低于最紧束缚核铁的能量。我们的EOS支持质量超过1.4 M_sun的致密星（对于某些袋常数取值还可超过2 M_sun），这与当前来自脉冲星和引力波观测的天体物理约束一致。
classification.one_liner: 构建有限温度微扰QCD修正的奇异夸克物质状态方程，并考察热夸克星的稳定性与质量约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要未涉及全息/AdS/CFT，主要讨论微扰QCD奇异夸克物质与热夸克星结构；若从经典引力/致密星支线看有一定关联，但与全息理论核心无关。

papers.title: Spin alignment of vector mesons in a plasma at finite density
papers.abstract: We study the spectral functions and spin alignment of $J/\psi$ and $\phi$ mesons at finite density in a soft-wall holographic model. The quark-gluon plasma background is described by a charged black hole geometry, and the vector mesons are treated as probe bulk vector fields. The present analysis extends the zero-density study of Phys. Rev. D 110 (2024) 056047 (Ref.~\cite{XLS2024}) to finite density; in the zero-density limit our results reproduce the corresponding findings. We derive the relation between the production rates in different spin channels and the corresponding in-medium spectral functions, and examine their dependence on the chemical potential, meson momentum, and temperature. We analyze the spin alignment induced by the motion of the vector meson relative to the thermal bath. At $T=0.15~\mathrm{GeV}$, the $J/\psi$ spectral function exhibits a clear resonance peak, indicating that the $c\bar{c}$ pair can still form a quasistable bound state. As the chemical potential increases, this peak becomes lower and broader, signaling enhanced dissociation in the medium. For the $\phi$ meson at the same temperature, no pronounced peak is observed, indicating substantial melting; its spectral function thus better characterizes the distribution of unstable $s\bar{s}$ pairs in the thermal environment. At $T=0.15~\mathrm{GeV}$, the helicity-frame spin alignment parameter $\rho_{00}$ shows a positive deviation from $1/3$ for the $J/\psi$ and a negative one for the $\phi$ meson. A finite chemical potential alters these deviations, reducing the magnitude for the $J/\psi$ while increasing it for the $\phi$ meson. The calculations are performed within a bottom-up soft-wall model; the results should be read as model-based estimates rather than model-independent predictions.

classification.title_zh: 有限密度等离子体中矢量介子的自旋排列
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在软墙全息模型中研究有限密度下 J/ψ 和 φ 介子的谱函数与自旋排列。夸克-胶子等离子体背景由带电黑洞几何描述，矢量介子被视为探测体矢量场。本分析将 Phys. Rev. D 110 (2024) 056047 的零密度研究推广至有限密度；在零密度极限下，我们的结果重现相应发现。我们推导不同自旋通道的产生率与相应介质中谱函数之间的关系，并考察它们对化学势、介子动量和温度的依赖。我们分析由矢量介子相对于热浴运动诱导的自旋排列。在 T=0.15 GeV 时，J/ψ 谱函数呈现清晰共振峰，表明 c\bar{c} 对仍可形成准稳定束缚态。随着化学势增加，该峰变低变宽，表明介质中解离增强。对于同一温度下的 φ 介子，未观察到明显峰，表明大量熔化；其谱函数因而更好地刻画热环境中不稳定 s\bar{s} 对的分布。在 T=0.15 GeV 时，螺旋度框架自旋排列参数 ρ00 对 J/ψ 显示出相对于 1/3 的正偏离，对 φ 介子显示出负偏离。有限化学势改变这些偏离，减小 J/ψ 的幅度而增大 φ 介子的幅度。计算在自下而上软墙模型中进行；结果应理解为基于模型的估计，而非模型无关预言。
classification.one_liner: 在软墙全息模型中，有限密度等离子体里 J/ψ 与 φ 介子的谱函数和自旋排列随化学势、动量和温度变化，J/ψ 峰变低变宽而 φ 介子明显熔化。
