papers.title: Ollivier-Ricci curvature for causal sets
papers.abstract: We introduce a novel notion of Ollivier-Ricci curvature for causal sets using Lorentzian optimal transport. The construction is motivated by a new Lorentzian asymptotic formula of independent interest, which recovers timelike Ricci curvature, up to higher-order terms, from the transport distance between probability measures on nearby causal diamonds. Passing to the discrete setting, this leads to a mesoscopic notion of Ricci curvature defined along maximal chains and built from probability measures on causal diamonds. We study several variants, including idle and Lin-Lu-Yau type curvatures, prove local-to-global propagation results and timelike Bonnet-Myers theorems, and compute the curvature for a range of explicit causal sets. We design high-density Poisson sprinkling numerical experiments recovering the expected constant-curvature signatures of Minkowski, de Sitter, and anti-de Sitter space. These results provide evidence that the construction captures timelike Ricci curvature from order-theoretic data.

classification.title_zh: 因果集的 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用洛伦兹最优传输为因果集引入了一种新的 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率概念。该构造由一个本身具有独立意义的新洛伦兹渐近公式驱动；该公式从邻近因果菱形上概率测度之间的传输距离出发，在更高阶项意义下恢复类时 Ricci 曲率。转到离散情形后，这导向一种沿最大链定义、并由因果菱形上的概率测度构建的细观 Ricci 曲率概念。我们研究若干变体，包括 idle 型和 Lin-Lu-Yau 型曲率，证明局部到整体的传播结果以及类时 Bonnet-Myers 定理，并计算一系列显式因果集的曲率。我们设计高密度 Poisson 撒点数值实验，恢复了 Minkowski、de Sitter 和 anti-de Sitter 空间预期的常曲率特征。这些结果提供了证据，表明该构造从序论数据中捕捉到了类时 Ricci 曲率。
classification.one_liner: 为因果集引入基于洛伦兹最优传输的 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率，并在高密度 Poisson 撒点中恢复 Minkowski、dS、AdS 的常曲率特征。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文非 AdS/CFT 全息；其核心是洛伦兹几何中的类时 Ricci 曲率、Ollivier-Ricci 曲率与因果集离散构造，与‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签相关，但不属于用户主要全息支线。

papers.title: Failure of local equi-Lipschitzness for families of Lorentz distances to Cauchy surface foliations
papers.abstract: The families of Lorentzian distance functions to and from points along a complete timelike line in a spacetime are known to be locally equi-Lipschitz continuous in a neighborhood of the line. This is an essential component in the proof of the classical Lorentzian splitting theorems. We show that this property fails in general for families of Lorentzian distances to and from the level sets of a given Cauchy temporal function. Moreover, we formulate conjectures based on the existence of Cauchy temporal functions in cosmological and timelike geodesically complete spacetimes such that the Lorentz distances to its level sets are equi-Lipschitz, which are equivalent to Bartnik's splitting conjecture.

classification.title_zh: Cauchy 面叶状结构的 Lorentz 距离族局部等 Lipschitz 性失效
classification.abstract_zh: 已知在时空中，沿一条完备类时线到其上的点以及从这些点出发的 Lorentz 距离函数族，在该线邻域内局部等 Lipschitz 连续。这是经典 Lorentz 分裂定理证明中的关键要素。我们证明，对于给定 Cauchy 时间函数的水平集，到其以及从其出发的 Lorentz 距离函数族，这一性质一般而言会失效。此外，我们基于宇宙学且类时测地完备的时空上存在 Cauchy 时间函数，使得到其水平集的 Lorentz 距离等 Lipschitz，提出若干猜想；这些猜想等价于 Bartnik 分裂猜想。
classification.one_liner: 证明到 Cauchy 时间函数水平集的 Lorentz 距离族一般不局部等 Lipschitz，并给出与 Bartnik 分裂猜想等价的猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典洛伦兹几何/广义相对论中的距离函数、Cauchy 叶状结构与 splitting 猜想，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；与全息对偶无直接关系。

papers.title: Search for Long-Transient Gravitational Waves from Supernova SN2023ixf using GFH-v2 Pipeline
papers.abstract: We present a directed search for long-transient gravitational waves from the possible newborn magnetar remnant of SN2023ixf, a nearby Type II core-collapse supernova in the M101 galaxy. The analysis uses LIGO Hanford and Livingston data from Engineering Run 15, using coincident data lying within the on-source window associated with the supernova. We target signals from a rapidly rotating, non-axisymmetric neutron star whose spin-down is dominated by gravitational-wave emission, producing a power-law decrease in frequency and a corresponding decrease in strain amplitude. The search is performed with the GFH-v2 pipeline, based on the Generalized Frequency Hough transform. No candidate survives the coincidence and follow-up analysis. We therefore set upper limits on the maximum detectable distance as a function of initial frequency and ellipticity. For the highest ellipticity interval, the 90% upper limits reach distances of about 1-2.5~Mpc across most of the analysed band. Although these limits are below the distance to M101, the search provides the first application of GFH-v2 to a nearby core-collapse supernova and characterizes its performance on real detector data.

classification.title_zh: 利用GFH-v2流程搜寻来自超新星SN2023ixf的长暂现引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们展示了对来自SN2023ixf可能新生磁星遗迹的长暂现引力波的有向搜索，SN2023ixf是M101星系中附近的II型核心坍缩超新星。分析使用LIGO Hanford和Livingston在Engineering Run 15期间的数据，使用与超新星相关的on-source窗口内的符合数据。我们针对快速旋转、非轴对称中子星的信号，其自转减慢由引力波辐射主导，产生频率的幂律下降以及相应的应变振幅下降。搜索使用基于广义频率Hough变换的GFH-v2流程进行。没有候选者通过符合和后续分析。因此，我们设定了最大可探测距离作为初始频率和椭率函数的上限。对于最高椭率区间，90%上限在分析频带大部分达到约1-2.5 Mpc的距离。尽管这些限制低于M101的距离，该搜索提供了GFH-v2对附近核心坍缩超新星的首次应用，并刻画了其在真实探测器数据上的性能。
classification.one_liner: 利用GFH-v2对SN2023ixf磁星遗迹进行长暂现引力波搜索，未发现候选并给出距离上限。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/引力波观测，使用LIGO数据搜寻超新星遗迹的长暂现引力波，并匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；但不涉及全息、量子引力或量子信息理论。

papers.title: Enabling new sampling strategies for continuous-wave analyses by integrating Bilby into PyFstat
papers.abstract: Continuous-wave searches for rotating neutron stars usually cover wide parameter spaces and produce a large number of candidate signals. Stochastic sampling methods therefore play an important role in candidate follow-up and parameter estimation. We present the integration of the Bayesian inference library BILBY into the open-source continuous-wave analysis package PyFstat, enabling access to the broad range of stochastic samplers available through BILBY while preserving the existing PyFstat analysis infrastructure. The implementation is validated through injection studies in Gaussian noise for two representative single-stage follow-up configurations: candidates from a directed search and candidates from an all-sky search. Using the nested sampler DYNESTY, we obtain detection efficiencies consistent with the theoretical sensitivity predictions. In this setup, DYNESTY performs comparably to the existing PTEMCEE-based implementation of PyFstat for the directed case, and also provides an effective single-stage approach for the all-sky candidate follow-up considered here, where we did not identify a PTEMCEE setup with similar recovery performance. Percentile-percentile tests for DYNESTY further show well-calibrated credible intervals, demonstrating reliable parameter estimation. While a full exploration of DYNESTY settings, multi-stage setups, and other samplers is left for future work, these results demonstrate that this flexible and publicly available framework opens useful new possibilities for Bayesian continuous-wave analyses.

classification.title_zh: 通过将 Bilby 集成到 PyFstat 实现连续波分析的新采样策略
classification.abstract_zh: 对旋转中子星的连续波搜索通常覆盖宽广参数空间并产生大量候选信号，因此随机采样方法在候选后续跟踪与参数估计中发挥重要作用。我们介绍了将贝叶斯推断库 BILBY 集成到开源连续波分析软件包 PyFstat 中，从而在保留现有 PyFstat 分析基础设施的同时，能够使用 BILBY 提供的广泛随机采样器。我们通过高斯噪声中的注入研究，对两种代表性的单阶段后续跟踪配置（定向搜索候选和全天搜索候选）验证了该实现。使用嵌套采样器 DYNESTY，我们获得了与理论灵敏度预测一致的探测效率。在此设置下，DYNESTY 在定向情形中与 PyFstat 现有的基于 PTEMCEE 的实现表现相当，并且对于此处考虑的全天候选后续跟踪也提供了一种有效的单阶段方法，而我们未找到具有类似恢复性能的 PTEMCEE 设置。DYNESTY 的百分位-百分位检验进一步显示出校准良好的可信区间，表明参数估计可靠。虽然对 DYNESTY 设置、多阶段设置和其他采样器的完整探索留待未来工作，但这些结果表明，这一灵活且公开可用的框架为贝叶斯连续波分析开辟了有用的新可能性。
classification.one_liner: 将 Bilby 集成进 PyFstat，用 Dynesty 等采样器改进连续引力波候选的贝叶斯后续跟踪与参数估计。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于连续引力波数据分析与贝叶斯采样软件集成，不是理论全息、量子引力或经典引力理论研究；与用户的全息重点方向无关，仅与“经典引力/广义相对论”标签下的引力波/中子星主题有边缘方法学关联。

papers.title: The properties of strange quark matter and evolution of strange quark stars
papers.abstract: In this work, we study the properties of strange quark matter and reveal the evolution process of strange quark stars employing a self consistent thermodynamic treatment. A comprehensive and reliable thermodynamic basis for the study of the dynamic evolution from proto-strange quark stars to stable strange stars at a zero temperature is provided. The relative abundance of particles, equation of state, temperature, and mass-radius relationship at each stage of the evolution of stars are discussed, where the cold strange quark star are consistent with the observational mass and radius of Hess J1731-347, PSR J1231-1411, PSR J0030+0451, PSR J0348+0432, and PSR J0740+6620, which could be difficult to be explained by the standard neutron star model. A schematic diagram is provided as well, illustrating the state of different stages along the evolution of stars at a fixed baryon-mass.

classification.title_zh: 奇异夸克物质的性质与奇异夸克星的演化
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们采用自洽热力学处理研究了奇异夸克物质的性质，并揭示了奇异夸克星的演化过程。我们为研究从原初奇异夸克星到零温稳定奇异星的动力学演化提供了全面而可靠的热力学基础。讨论了恒星演化各阶段的粒子相对丰度、物态方程、温度和质量-半径关系，其中冷奇异夸克星与 Hess J1731-347、PSR J1231-1411、PSR J0030+0451、PSR J0348+0432 和 PSR J0740+6620 的观测质量和半径一致，而这些可能难以用标准中子星模型解释。还给出了示意图，说明固定重子质量下恒星演化不同阶段的状态。
classification.one_liner: 采用自洽热力学处理研究奇异夸克物质性质，并刻画从原初奇异夸克星到稳定奇异星的演化及质量-半径关系。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究奇异夸克物质与奇异夸克星演化，涉及致密星物态方程和观测质量半径，属于经典引力/致密星方向；不涉及全息、量子信息或所列其他重点标签。

papers.title: Neutron Star vs Quark Star in the Multimessenger Era
papers.abstract: Neutron stars (NSs) and self-bound quark stars (QSs) remain the two primary candidates for the compact objects observed as pulsars and in gravitational-wave (GW) events from binary mergers. Using a physics-agnostic equation of state (EOS) for compact star (CS) matter constructed via nonparametric Gaussian process regression, we perform Bayesian inference of the properties of NSs and QSs by analyzing multimessenger observations from GW170817, PSR J0740+6620, PSR J0030+0451, PSR J0437$-$4715, and PSR J0614$-$3329 together with {\it ab initio} calculations from perturbative quantum chromodynamics and chiral effective field theory. We consider competing cases arising from three scenarios: the NS scenario, in which all CSs are NSs; the udQS scenario, in which all CSs are up-down QSs; and the two-family scenario, in which NSs and strange QSs (SQSs) coexist. Our results based on systematic Bayesian model selection indicate that the most favored case belongs to the two-family scenario, with a Bayes factor of $6.1$ relative to the udQS case. In this case, PSR J0740+6620 is favored as an SQS, while the other five CSs, including the two in GW170817, are favored as NSs. The corresponding maximum mass of a static CS is $M_\text{TOV} = 1.72_{-0.16}^{+0.18} M_\odot$ for NSs and $M_\text{TOV} = 2.63_{-0.31}^{+0.36} M_\odot$ for SQSs at the $68\%$ confidence interval. Moreover, the inferred sound speed in both NS and QS matter increases monotonically and saturates at high densities, whereas a pronounced peak structure is found in the NS scenario. Our work provides a new framework for identifying the nature of individual CSs and constraining the properties of dense matter in both NSs and QSs. In particular, the most favored case provides potential astrophysical support for the absolute stability of strange quark matter according to the Witten hypothesis.

classification.title_zh: 多信使时代的中子星与夸克星
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星（NS）和自束缚夸克星（QS）仍是脉冲星观测以及双星并合引力波（GW）事件中致密天体的两个主要候选。我们使用通过非参数高斯过程回归构建的、对物理模型不敏感的致密星（CS）物质状态方程（EOS），结合GW170817、PSR J0740+6620、PSR J0030+0451、PSR J0437-4715和PSR J0614-3329的多信使观测，以及来自微扰量子色动力学和手征有效场论的第一性原理计算，对中子星和夸克星的性质进行贝叶斯推断。我们考虑三种情景下的竞争情况：NS情景，即所有致密星均为中子星；udQS情景，即所有致密星均为上-下夸克星；以及双家族情景，即中子星与奇异夸克星（SQS）共存。基于系统贝叶斯模型选择的结果表明，最受青睐的情况属于双家族情景，相对于udQS情况的贝叶斯因子为6.1。在该情况下，PSR J0740+6620被倾向于认为是SQS，而其他五颗致密星（包括GW170817中的两颗）被倾向于认为是NS。相应的静态致密星最大质量为：NS的M_TOV=1.72_{-0.16}^{+0.18} M_sun，SQS的M_TOV=2.63_{-0.31}^{+0.36} M_sun（68%置信区间）。此外，推断出的NS和QS物质中的声速都随密度单调增加并在高密度处饱和，而在NS情景中发现一个显著的峰结构。我们的工作为识别单个致密星的性质以及约束NS和QS中致密物质性质提供了新框架。特别地，最受青睐的情况为根据Witten假说奇异夸克物质的绝对稳定性提供了潜在的天体物理支持。
classification.one_liner: 利用多信使观测和贝叶斯模型选择，双家族情景（中子星与奇异夸克星共存）最受青睐，并为奇异夸克物质绝对稳定性提供潜在支持。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要利用多信使观测和贝叶斯推断研究中子星/夸克星状态方程，属于经典引力与致密星/引力波天体物理，而非全息对偶；与用户列出的“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签相关，但与全息主线无关。

papers.title: Constant Maps and Exponentially Small Sectors in ABJM Bethe Observables
papers.abstract: The topologically twisted index of ABJM theory captures the microscopic entropy of magnetically charged supersymmetric $\mathrm{AdS}_4$ black holes. Building on the companion Letter arXiv:2608.04107, which reconstructed the finite-rank twisted superpotential at the universal twist, we determine the finite-rank index using high-precision Bethe-vacuum data, physics-informed symbolic regression, and integer relations. The Hessian, effective dilaton, and one-loop factors encode information beyond the on-shell twisted superpotential. The two observables share the same shifted rank. Within a declared finite class, we reconstruct the index constant map from the ABJM $S^3$ constant maps at levels $k$ and $k/2$, the constant map of the twisted superpotential, and elementary terms. We prove that it equals a convergent one-kernel integral for real $k>0$, resumming the large-$k$ expansion, fixing a previously numerical constant, and yielding type-IIA coefficients at arbitrary genus. We also prove that the Clausen expression in arXiv:2608.04107 equals an alternating Euler sum and an absolutely convergent integral, giving closed evaluations for two rational-argument Euler-sum families. At $k=1,2,4$, the exponentially suppressed sectors exhibit arithmetic structure. The reconstructed coefficients of the twisted superpotential obey a divisor-sum formula with a conjectural all-order Eichler-integral series associated with a weight-four Eisenstein form. The index coefficients reduce to two rational generators; one admits modular-product formulas reproducing every available coefficient and suggesting an all-order completion. Conditional on this continuation, modular transformations determine the nearest logarithmic singularity, radius of convergence, and leading coefficient growth. These results provide a finite-$N$ benchmark for quantum gravitational blocks and bulk black hole quantum entropy.

classification.title_zh: ABJM Bethe 可观测量中的常量映射与指数小扇区
classification.abstract_zh: ABJM 理论的拓扑扭曲指数刻画了带磁荷的超对称 AdS4 黑洞的微观熵。基于伴随论文 arXiv:2608.04107（其重构了 universal twist 处的有限秩扭曲超势），我们利用高精度 Bethe 真空数据、物理启发的符号回归和整数关系确定有限秩指数。Hessian、有效膨胀子和单圈因子编码了超出在壳扭曲超势的信息。两个可观测量共享相同的移位秩。在一个明确声明的有限类中，我们由第 k 阶和第 k/2 阶的 ABJM S^3 常数映射、扭曲超势的常数映射以及初等项重构出指数的常数映射。我们证明对于实数 k>0，它等于一个收敛的单核积分，从而重求和了大 k 展开，固定了此前为数值的常数，并给出任意亏格的 type-IIA 系数。我们还证明 arXiv:2608.04107 中的 Clausen 表达式等于一个交错 Euler 和以及一个绝对收敛积分，从而给出两个有理参数 Euler 和族的闭式求值。在 k=1,2,4 时，指数压制扇区展现出算术结构。扭曲超势的重构系数满足一个除数和公式，并带有一个与权四 Eisenstein 形式相关的、猜想性的全阶 Eichler 积分级数。指数系数约化为两个有理生成元；其中一个具有模积公式，能重现每一个可获得的系数，并暗示一个全阶完成。在此延续条件下，模变换确定了最近的对数奇点、收敛半径和主导系数增长。这些结果为量子引力块和体黑洞量子熵提供了一个有限 N 基准。
classification.one_liner: 通过 Bethe 真空数据与符号回归重构 ABJM 有限秩拓扑扭曲指数，揭示其常数映射和指数小扇区的算术结构，并为 AdS4 黑洞量子熵提供有限 N 基准。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 ABJM/AdS4 黑洞量子熵与全息计算，但未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 或经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: One-point functions of the Lagrangian in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM with boundaries, defects and interfaces
papers.abstract: We obtain one-point functions of the ambient Lagrangian $\mathcal{O}_{\mathcal{L}}$ in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM with $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS boundaries, defects and interfaces classified by Gaiotto and Witten, which include maximally supersymmetric Janus interfaces and BCFTs relevant for double holography, as well as for Janus interfaces with reduced supersymmetry. For Janus interfaces we extend recent results capturing $\langle \mathcal{O}_{\mathcal{L}}\rangle$ in certain limits to exact dependence on $N$ and $\lambda$, and confirm a non-renormalization conjecture. We also clarify recent results for Janus variants preserving less supersymmetry. For general $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS Gaiotto-Witten theories with genuine defect degrees of freedom we derive one-point functions using supersymmetric localization, confirm that the results agree with holographic predictions in the appropriate limits, and show that the one-point functions in general exhibit non-trivial coupling dependence.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 带边界、缺陷和界面的 N=4 SYM 中拉格朗日量的单点函数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们获得了 N=4 SYM 中环境拉格朗日量 O_L 的单点函数，其中包含由 Gaiotto 和 Witten 分类的 1/2-BPS 边界、缺陷和界面，这些包括最大超对称 Janus 界面和与双全息相关的 BCFT，以及超对称性降低的 Janus 界面。对于 Janus 界面，我们将最近在某些极限下捕获 <O_L> 的结果推广到对 N 和 λ 的精确依赖，并证实了一个非重整化猜想。我们还澄清了最近关于保持较少超对称性的 Janus 变体的结果。对于具有真实缺陷自由度的通用 1/2-BPS Gaiotto-Witten 理论，我们使用超对称局域化推导单点函数，确认结果在适当极限下与全息预测一致，并表明这些单点函数一般表现出非平凡的耦合依赖性。
classification.one_liner: 计算 N=4 SYM 中带边界/缺陷/界面的拉格朗日量单点函数，验证全息预言和非重整化猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及边界、缺陷和界面等非均匀全息构型，属于用户关注的畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀方向，但并非直接关于超流超导或冷原子。

papers.title: The Geometry of Gravitational Radiation
papers.abstract: We consider 4-dimensional asymptotically flat vacuum spacetimes near future null infinity endowed with the most general allowable Carroll geometry. We show that the near-boundary radial expansion (to a certain order) can be organised in terms of connections that can be obtained by gauging the conformal Carroll algebra. The only non-vanishing curvatures in this gauging procedure are those that are associated with the special conformal generators and we will refer to these as the $K$-curvatures. The vanishing of these $K$-curvatures defines an asymptotic vacuum spacetime and we use this to construct a boundary (i.e. Carroll) covariant expression for the vacuum (soft) shear in terms of two boundary Carroll scalar fields. The $K$-curvatures transform in a hierarchical fashion into one another under Carroll boosts. This leads to a classification of 4 types of spacetimes: vacuum, strongly and weakly non-radiative, and radiative spacetimes. It is shown that the $K$-curvatures correspond to 5 of the 10 Weyl tensor components at leading order in their $1/r$ expansion. We furthermore observe that one of the $K$-curvatures is equal to the recently found Carroll boost anomaly. Finally, we show that the Bondi loss equations for the boundary energy-momentum-news complex can be cast into a form involving another energy-momentum tensor with vanishing energy flux that is traceless and whose non-conservation is entirely captured by the $K$-curvatures. The BMS currents can be obtained by contracting this latter energy-momentum tensor with a Carroll conformal Killing vector.

classification.title_zh: 引力辐射的几何
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑四维渐近平直真空时空在未来零无穷附近的几何，并赋予其最一般的允许 Carroll 几何。我们证明，近边界径向展开（到某一阶）可以用通过对共形 Carroll 代数做规范得到的联络来组织。这个规范过程中唯一非零的曲率是与特殊共形生成元相关的曲率，我们称之为 K-曲率。这些 K-曲率的消失定义了一个渐近真空时空，并用它构造真空（软）剪切在边界（即 Carroll）协变形式下由两个边界 Carroll 标量场表示的表达式。K-曲率在 Carroll boost 下以层级方式相互转化。这导致对四类时空的分类：真空、强非辐射、弱非辐射和辐射时空。文章表明，K-曲率对应于在 1/r 展开领头阶的 10 个 Weyl 张量分量中的 5 个。我们还观察到其中一个 K-曲率等于最近发现的 Carroll boost 反常。最后，我们证明边界能量-动量-news 复形的 Bondi 损失方程可以改写为涉及另一个能量-动量张量的形式，该张量具有消失的能量通量、无迹，并且其非守恒完全由 K-曲率捕获。BMS 流可以通过将后一个能量-动量张量与 Carroll 共形 Killing 矢量缩并得到。
classification.one_liner: 用共形 Carroll 规范几何组织渐近平直时空的引力辐射，并用 K-曲率分类真空/非辐射/辐射时空及 BMS 流。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，聚焦渐近平直时空、BMS/Carroll 形式与引力辐射的经典结构，与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”高度匹配。

papers.title: An Effective $S$-Matrix Approach to Low-Frequency Waveforms from Black Hole Mergers
papers.abstract: We develop an on-shell description of low-frequency gravitational waveforms from black-hole mergers beyond leading order. Treating the strongly coupled merger as effective hard $S$-matrix data, we organize its long-wavelength response using soft theorems and the KMOC formalism. At next-to-leading order, the quantum soft theorem contains logarithmic terms absent from the classical soft theorem. We show that these extra terms cancel in the full KMOC in-in observable between the one-loop radiative amplitude and the corresponding graviton cut, leaving precisely the classical logarithmic contributions associated with gravitational drag and early-time acceleration. We also identify the $1/\omega$ corrections from remnant recoil and Christodoulou non-linear memory. These results reveal a hierarchy of merger information accessible at low frequency: logarithmic tails depend only on asymptotic hard data, recoil probes total radiated momentum, while non-linear memory probes the angular distribution of the emitted radiation.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞并合低频波形的有效 S-矩阵方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了一种在壳描述，用于超出领头阶的黑洞并合低频引力波形。将强耦合并合视为有效硬 S-矩阵数据，我们利用软定理和 KMOC 形式组织其长波响应。在次领头阶，量子软定理包含经典软定理中没有的对数项。我们表明，这些额外项在一圈辐射振幅与相应引力子割线之间的完整 KMOC in-in 可观测量中相消，只留下与引力拖曳和早期加速相关的经典对数贡献。我们还识别了来自残余反冲和 Christodoulou 非线性记忆的 1/ω 修正。这些结果揭示了在低频可及的并合信息层级：对数尾仅依赖于渐近硬数据，反冲探测总辐射动量，而非线性记忆探测发射辐射的角分布。
classification.one_liner: 用有效 S-矩阵、软定理与 KMOC 研究黑洞并合低频引力波波形，并揭示对数尾、反冲与非线性记忆的信息层级。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力波方向，研究黑洞并合低频波形，与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签直接匹配；但不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息。

papers.title: Null String Holography, Null Strings Probe Projective Boundary of Their Target Spaces
papers.abstract: We prove that the \textit{minimal null string theory} on background manifold ${\cal M}$ is classically equivalent to the ILST theory on the projective boundary of $\mathcal M$, ${\mathcal B}_{_{\text{P}}}={\partial_{_{\text{P}}}\mathcal{M}}$. We conjecture that this equivalence also holds as quantum level, which we dub \textit{null string holography}. In particular, we show classical null string theory on Poincar\'e patch of $D$ dimensional Anti de Sitter (AdS$_D$) background is described by ILST on $D-1$ dimensional Minkowski background, paralleling the celebrated AdS/CFT. Null strings on cosmological patch of dS$_D$ is governed by ILST on $D-1$ dimensional flat Euclidean space. For null strings on $D$ dimensional Minkowski space, depending on the coordinate patch used, the projective boundary where the ``dual'' ILST theory resides, can by dS$_{D-1}$, $D-1$ dimensional Carrollian space and $D-1$ dimensional hyperboloid, respectively including spacelike asymptotic boundary $\iota^0$, asymptotic null boundaries ${\cal I}^\pm$ and timelike infinities $\iota^\pm$. We comment on physical implications of the null string holography on black hole backgrounds whose projective boundary includes horizons.

classification.title_zh: 零弦全息：零弦探测其目标空间的射影边界
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，背景流形 M 上的最小零弦理论在经典意义上等价于其射影边界 ∂_P M 上的 ILST 理论。我们猜想该等价性在量子层面也成立，并将其称为零弦全息。特别地，我们表明 D 维反 de Sitter（AdS_D）的 Poincaré 片上的经典零弦理论由 D-1 维 Minkowski 背景上的 ILST 描述，与著名的 AdS/CFT 相对应。dS_D 宇宙学片上的零弦由 D-1 维平坦欧几里得空间上的 ILST 支配。对于 D 维 Minkowski 空间中的零弦，根据所用坐标片，其“对偶”ILST 理论所在的射影边界可以分别是 dS_{D-1}、D-1 维 Carroll 空间和 D-1 维双曲面，分别包括类空渐近边界 ι^0、渐近零边界 I^± 和类时无穷 ι^±。我们评论零弦全息对黑洞背景的物理意义，这些背景的射影边界包含视界。
classification.one_liner: 证明最小零弦理论与其目标空间射影边界上的 ILST 理论经典等价，并将该对应猜想为量子零弦全息。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息对偶基础与边界构造的新提议，涉及 AdS/dS/Minkowski/Carroll 框架，但不直接对应所提供的重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet 或经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: Long-lived resonances of massive scalar fields in the Reissner-Nordstr\"om black-hole spacetime: Analytic treatment in the large-mass regime
papers.abstract: The physical and mathematical properties of the composed Reissner-Nordstr\"om-black-hole-massive-scalar-field system are studied {\it analytically} in the dimensionless large-mass $M\mu\gg1$ regime [here $\{M,\mu\}$ are respectively the mass of the central black hole and the proper mass of the scalar field]. It is proved that, for a given value ${\bar Q}\equiv Q/M$ of the dimensionless charge parameter of the central black hole, the system is characterized by the presence of quasi-resonances, linearized perturbation modes with arbitrarily long lifetimes. In particular, using analytical techniques, we determine the black-hole-field critical mass spectrum $\{M\mu_{\text{crit}}({\bar Q})\}$ which characterizes the long-lived resonances of the composed physical system.

classification.title_zh: Reissner-Nordström 黑洞时空中大质量标量场的长寿命共振：大质量区间的解析处理
classification.abstract_zh: 在无量纲大质量 Mμ≫1 区间（其中 M 和 μ 分别为中心黑洞质量和标量场固有质量），对 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞-大质量标量场复合系统的物理与数学性质进行了解析研究。结果证明，对于中心黑洞无量纲电荷参数  ar Q≡Q/M 的给定值，该系统具有准共振特征，即寿命任意长的线性化扰动模式。特别地，利用解析技术，我们确定了刻画该复合物理系统长寿命共振的黑洞-场临界质量谱 {Mμ_crit( ar Q)}。
classification.one_liner: 解析证明 RN 黑洞-大质量标量场系统在大质量区存在长寿命准共振，并给出临界质量谱。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞时空中大质量标量场的准共振/长寿命线性化扰动模式，匹配“QNM与非线性演化”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不属于全息研究。

papers.title: On scalar and electromagnetic perturbations of the root--Kerr object
papers.abstract: We study scalar and electromagnetic perturbations of the root--Kerr object. Its source-free exterior carries the electromagnetic field obtained in the vanishing-mass limit of the Kerr--Newman black hole, while its physical source is a rotating disk with an essential distributional rim contribution. For a massless charged scalar, the minimally coupled Klein--Gordon equation separates into a confluent-Heun (CHE) radial equation with a direct coupling between the scalar and background charges. We give the associated Nekrasov--Shatashvili (NS) dictionary and show that the disk is an ordinary radial point. For electromagnetic pertubations, we derive the equations for the radiative Newman--Penrose Maxwell scalars directly. They have the same confluent-Heun structure, but a Maxwell perturbation has no bulk coupling to the background potential. Charge-dependent photon scattering data therefore cannot be fixed by the exterior equation alone. We formulate the disk/rim boundary-data problem, identify the response data required to convert exact CHE/NS connection coefficients into a physical scattering matrix, and show how all-spin helicity-flip Compton information constrains the response on the radiative subspace. The analysis separates exact exterior propagation and amplitude matching from the additional source dynamics required for a microscopic response.

classification.title_zh: 论根-Kerr天体的标量与电磁扰动
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究根-Kerr天体的标量与电磁扰动。其无源外部携带由Kerr-Newman黑洞零质量极限得到的电磁场，而其物理源是一个带有本质性分布边缘贡献的旋转圆盘。对于无质量带电标量，最小耦合Klein-Gordon方程分离为共流Heun（CHE）径向方程，且标量与背景电荷之间存在直接耦合。我们给出相应的Nekrasov-Shatashvili（NS）字典，并表明圆盘是一个普通径向点。对于电磁扰动，我们直接推导辐射Newman-Penrose Maxwell标量的方程。它们具有相同的共流Heun结构，但Maxwell扰动与背景势没有体耦合。因此，依赖电荷的光子散射数据不能仅由外部方程确定。我们表述圆盘/边缘边界数据问题，识别将精确CHE/NS连接系数转换为物理散射矩阵所需的响应数据，并说明全自旋螺旋度翻转Compton信息如何约束辐射子空间上的响应。该分析将精确外部传播与振幅匹配同微观响应所需的额外源动力学分离开来。
classification.one_liner: 研究根-Kerr天体的标量与电磁扰动，给出CHE/NS字典并阐明圆盘/边缘响应与散射矩阵的关系。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究弯曲时空背景中的标量与电磁扰动、精确散射和Newman-Penrose形式，符合用户重点标签。

papers.title: One Gravity, Many G's: Generalized Horizon Entropy and Gravitational Susceptibility
papers.abstract: Effective and thermodynamic derivations of gravity theory in the context of generalized entropy can give rise to multiple, and potentially varying, gravitational couplings, raising the question of which quantity should be identified with the physically measured Newton constant. Motivated by this ambiguity, we formulate the notion of gravitational susceptibility of the horizon. In spacetimes containing multiple horizons, if the entropy is a function on a multi-horizon state space, $S=S(A_1,A_2,\cdots,A_n)$, then the derivatives of the entropy with respect to individual horizon areas define the horizon gravitational response coefficients. Different horizons may possess distinct gravitational responses without requiring multiple fundamental gravitational couplings, analogous to direction-dependent response coefficients in macroscopic media. This framework naturally suggests the possibility that horizon entropies (such as the cosmological apparent horizon and a black hole horizon) can influence one another, which could explain the black hole-cosmology coupled "black hole mass growth" previously discussed in the literature.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 一个引力，多个G：广义视界熵与引力磁化率
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义熵背景下，对引力理论的有效推导和热力学推导可能产生多个、且可能变化的引力耦合，这引发了一个问题：哪一个量应被认定为物理上测量的牛顿常数。受此歧义启发，我们提出了视界引力磁化率的概念。在包含多个视界的时空中，如果熵是多视界状态空间上的函数 S=S(A_1,A_2,\cdots,A_n)，那么熵对各个视界面积的导数定义了视界引力响应系数。不同视界可以具有不同的引力响应，而不需要多个基本引力耦合，这类似于宏观介质中方向依赖的响应系数。这一框架自然提示，视界熵（例如宇宙学表观视界和黑洞视界）可以相互影响，这可能解释文献中先前讨论过的黑洞-宇宙学耦合的“黑洞质量增长”。
classification.one_liner: 提出视界引力磁化率框架，用多视界熵的导数定义各视界的引力响应，从而无需多个基本引力耦合即可解释不同视界响应差异及黑洞-宇宙学耦合的质量增长。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论下的视界热力学与引力热力学方向，讨论广义熵、牛顿常数与多视界引力响应，直接匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；未涉及全息对偶或量子信息。

papers.title: Evolving wormhole cosmology: modified Friedmann dynamics and observational constraints
papers.abstract: We construct an evolving wormhole cosmological model from a Morris--Thorne metric with a separable, time-dependent shape function in a spatially flat Friedmann--Lemaitre--Robertson--Walker background, deriving the corrected wormhole energy-momentum tensor and a volume-averaging procedure that yields a modified Friedmann equation with a redshift-dependent wormhole correction term. We show that the shape-function index and throat-evolution exponent combine into a single macroscopic exponent $\beta$, and we demonstrate that the resulting wormhole equation of state is consistent with this geometric averaging. All traversability conditions are verified. Confronting the model with cosmic chronometer, DESI Data Release~2 BAO, and standard BAO data across seven dataset combinations, our findings show that all combinations are mutually consistent, with the joint fit giving a present-day expansion rate intermediate between local and CMB-inferred values, a deceleration-to-acceleration transition consistent with independent determinations, and an effective dark-energy equation of state close to, but distinguishable from, a pure cosmological constant. The evolving throat radius offers a novel, geometry-specific observable for discriminating wormhole spacetimes from phenomenological dark-energy parametrisations.

classification.title_zh: 演化虫洞宇宙学：修正的 Friedmann 动力学与观测约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个演化虫洞宇宙学模型：在空间平坦的 Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker 背景中采用具有可分离、时间依赖形函数的 Morris-Thorne 度规，导出修正的虫洞能量-动量张量，并通过体平均程序得到含红移依赖虫洞修正项的修正 Friedmann 方程。我们表明形函数指数与喉部演化指数可组合成单一宏观指数 β，并证明所得的虫洞物态方程与该几何平均一致。所有可穿越性条件均得到验证。利用宇宙钟、DESI Data Release 2 BAO 和标准 BAO 数据在七种数据集组合下检验模型，结果显示所有组合彼此一致；联合拟合给出的当前膨胀率介于局域和 CMB 推断值之间，减速到加速的转变与独立测定一致，且有效暗能量物态方程接近但可区别于纯宇宙学常数。演化中的喉部半径为区分虫洞时空与唯象暗能量参数化提供了一种新颖的、几何特异的可观测量。
classification.one_liner: 在 FLRW 背景中构建含时变喉部的 Morris-Thorne 虫洞宇宙学，导出修正 Friedmann 方程并用宇宙钟、DESI DR2 BAO 等数据约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/宇宙学，研究虫洞几何、修正 Friedmann 方程与观测约束，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶；与‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签直接相关。

papers.title: Constraints on Scalar--Tensor--Vector Gravity Theory Parameters Inferred from Quasiperiodic Oscillations
papers.abstract: We study circular geodesics of neutral test particles in the static charged solution of Scalar--Tensor--Vector Gravity (STVG), and we use the twin kilohertz quasiperiodic oscillations (QPOs) of twelve accreting compact objects to bound its parameters. Starting from the effective potential we obtain closed forms for the specific energy, the specific angular momentum and the Keplerian angular velocity, and from these the radial and vertical epicyclic frequencies. The horizon, photon sphere, shadow radius and innermost stable circular orbit are given in closed form as well, and each one reduces to the RN and Schwarzschild value in the appropriate limit. Null geodesics are integrated numerically and show how the enhanced coupling widens the capture cross section while leaving the logarithmic divergence of the deflection angle at the photon sphere intact. Within the RP model we then run Metropolis--Hastings MCMC simulations on the QPO pairs of eight neutron stars and four microquasars, comparing the Schwarzschild spacetime, the RN spacetime, STVG with vanishing charge and the full STVG solution. The best fits are obtained mainly for the charged solutions in the neutron star sample, while all four models describe the black hole sample equally well. We show that the orbital dynamics depends on the mass $M$, the coupling $\alpha$ and the charge $Q$ only through the two combinations $\Meff=(1+\alpha)M$ and $\Qeff^{2}=(1+\alpha)(\alpha M^{2}+Q^{2})$, which accounts for the multimodal posteriors found in the neutron star sample and sets a model-independent limit on what QPO timing alone can measure. The astrophysical implications of these bounds, in particular for inferred masses above the Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff limit, are discussed in detail.

classification.title_zh: 从准周期振荡推断标量-张量-矢量引力理论参数的约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究标量-张量-矢量引力（STVG）静态带电解中中性测试粒子的圆轨道，并使用十二个吸积致密天体的双千赫兹准周期振荡（QPO）来限制其参数。从有效势出发，我们得到比能、比角动量和开普勒角速度的闭式表达式，并由此得到径向和垂向的 epicyclic 频率。视界、光子球、阴影半径和最内稳定圆轨道也以闭式给出，并且各自在适当极限下退化为 RN 和 Schwarzschild 值。数值积分零测地线，表明增强的耦合加宽捕获截面，同时保留光子球处偏折角的对数发散。随后在 RP 模型中，我们对八颗中子星和四个微类星体的 QPO 对运行 Metropolis--Hastings MCMC 模拟，比较 Schwarzschild 时空、RN 时空、电荷消失的 STVG 以及完整 STVG 解。最佳拟合主要在中子星样本的带电解中获得，而四个模型对黑洞样本描述得同样好。我们表明轨道动力学仅通过两个组合 Meff=(1+α)M 和 Qeff^2=(1+α)(αM^2+Q^2) 依赖于质量 M、耦合 α 和电荷 Q，这解释了在中子星样本中发现的多峰后验，并对仅凭 QPO 计时所能测量的量给出了模型无关限制。详细讨论了这些界限的天体物理意义，特别是对推断质量高于 Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff 极限的情况。
classification.one_liner: 在 STVG 静态带电时空中推导测试粒子轨道与 QPO 频率，并用中子星和微类星体 QPO 数据约束参数，发现轨道动力学仅依赖两个有效组合。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要属于经典引力/修改引力中的 STVG 时空、测地线与 QPO 观测约束，符合经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；但不涉及全息对偶、量子信息或全息强关联。

papers.title: Gravitational Radiation from Shockwave Scattering in the Self-Force EFT
papers.abstract: We investigate the high-energy collision of two spinless bodies within the Self-Force Effective Field Theory, taking one of the two bodies to be massless and highly energetic, such that it generates a gravitational shockwave (GSW) background. The GSW is perturbed by a second body, either massless or massive, satisfying respectively $E_2/E_1\ll1$ or $m_2/E_1\ll1$. Although the Self-Force expansion for shockwaves is frame-dependent, we choose a frame in which this EFT manifests its full power, obtaining results valid to all orders in Newton's constant that make the underlying resummation patterns manifest. Specifically, we push the expansion to 1SF order and conjecture the all-order vanishing of the so-called recoil operators in a given gauge. We obtain the exact graviton propagator on the shockwave background, matching previous results, and use it to compute the on-shell waveform at 1SF order in momentum space, specialising to the massless-massless collision. The waveform is computed to all orders in the Post-Minkowskian expansion, and its resummed form proved to vanish at the leading order in the super-Planckian regime. We use this result to prove the UV finiteness of the angular spectrum of radiated energy in the region collinear to the shockwave with energy $E_1$.

classification.title_zh: 自力 EFT 中冲击波散射的引力辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在自力有效场论中研究两个无自旋物体的高能碰撞，取其中一个物体无质量且能量很高，使其产生引力冲击波背景。该冲击波受到第二个物体微扰，第二个物体可以无质量或有质量，并分别满足 E2/E1<<1 或 m2/E1<<1。尽管冲击波的自力展开依赖参考系，我们选择一个能使该 EFT 充分发挥其威力的参考系，获得对牛顿常数所有阶有效的结果，使潜在的重新求和模式显现。具体地，我们将展开推进到 1SF 阶，并猜想在给定规范下所谓反冲算符的全阶消失。我们得到冲击波背景上的精确引力子传播子，与先前结果一致，并用它计算动量空间中 1SF 阶的在壳波形，专门针对无质量-无质量碰撞。该波形被计算到后闵可夫斯基展开的所有阶，并且其重求和形式被证明在超普朗克区域的领头阶消失。我们利用这一结果证明，在与能量为 E1 的冲击波共线的区域内，辐射能量角谱的 UV 有限性。
classification.one_liner: 用自力 EFT 研究冲击波背景中的高能散射与引力辐射，计算 1SF 阶波形并证明共线能量角谱的 UV 有限性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力框架下的高能冲击波散射、引力子传播子与引力波波形，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线。

papers.title: From driven oscillations to free ringdown: a particle plunging into Kerr
papers.abstract: We show that a ringdown waveform can admit a constant-coefficient quasinormal-mode (QNM) representation while its individual QNM-pole contributions remain driven. To establish this result, we construct a first-principles rational approximation to the Kerr Green's function from its QNM poles, physical residues, and horizon-frequency zeros. For particles plunging from the innermost stable circular orbit into Kerr black holes with spins 0.5-0.9, each QNM-pole contribution initially follows the source's instantaneous complex frequency and decouples only after the source decays faster than the corresponding mode. At late times, the source approaches a sum of damped oscillations at the third and higher horizon frequencies. The corresponding zeros in the Green's function cancel these source-frequency components in the coherent waveform, while the continuing drive generates oscillations at QNM frequencies. Thus, an apparently free QNM superposition can emerge before its individual contributions dynamically decouple from the source.

classification.title_zh: 从驱动振荡到自由铃宕：粒子落入 Kerr 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们表明，铃宕波形可以具有常系数准正态模式（QNM）表示，而其中各个 QNM 极点的贡献仍处于受驱状态。为建立这一结果，我们从 Kerr 格林函数的 QNM 极点、物理留数以及视界频率零点构造了第一性原理有理近似。对于从最内稳定圆轨道落入自旋 0.5–0.9 的 Kerr 黑洞的粒子，每个 QNM 极点贡献最初跟随源的瞬时复频率，只有当源比相应模式衰减更快后才解耦。在晚期，源趋近于第三及更高视界频率的阻尼振荡之和。格林函数中相应的零点在相干波形中抵消这些源频率成分，而持续的驱动则产生 QNM 频率的振荡。因此，在其各个贡献仍与源动态耦合时，一个看似自由的 QNM 叠加就可能出现。
classification.one_liner: Kerr 黑洞铃宕可在外表上呈自由 QNM 叠加，即使各 QNM 极点贡献仍被源驱动；作者用极点和视界零点构造了格林函数有理近似。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究 Kerr 黑洞铃宕与准正态模式表示，属于 QNM 重点标签；但不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

papers.title: Kaniadakis Holographic Dark Energy with Particle Horizon as IR Cutoff
papers.abstract: We construct a holographic dark-energy model using Kaniadakis entropy with the particle horizon as the infrared cutoff, consistently modifying both the holographic density and the Friedmann background. In standard Einstein gravity, noninteracting particle-horizon holographic dark energy (HDE) does not produce the sufficiently negative pressure required for late-time accelerated expansion. We show that the Kaniadakis deformation changes this behavior while the particle horizon is retained. For the representative parameter choice $K=1.90\times10^{-36}$, with $\Omega_{\rm DE0}=0.7$ and $c^2=0.64$, the deceleration parameter changes sign at $z\simeq0.585$ in the noninteracting case. Including the interaction strengths $b^2=0.03$ and $0.06$ changes the transition only slightly, giving $z\simeq0.586$ and $0.589$, respectively. Thus, for the parameter set considered here, the interaction does not generate the acceleration; rather, the transition is already present in the noninteracting Kaniadakis model and the interaction produces only a small shift in its timing. We derive the autonomous evolution equations, the effective dark-energy equation of state, and the deceleration parameter. The adiabatic squared sound speed is also examined as a diagnostic of the effective-fluid stability, while statefinder variables are used to characterize deviations from $\Lambda$CDM. Finally, we verify that the $K\to0$ limit continuously recovers standard Einstein-gravity particle-horizon HDE, for which the noninteracting model remains decelerating.

classification.title_zh: 以粒子视界为红外截断的 Kaniadakis 全息暗能量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个全息暗能量模型，使用 Kaniadakis 熵并以粒子视界作为红外截断，同时一致地修改全息密度和 Friedmann 背景。在标准 Einstein 引力中，非相互作用的粒子视界全息暗能量（HDE）不会产生晚期加速膨胀所需的足够负压。我们表明，在保留粒子视界的同时，Kaniadakis 变形改变了这种行为。对于代表性参数选择 K=1.90×10^-36、Ω_DE0=0.7 和 c^2=0.64，在非相互作用情形下减速参数在 z≃0.585 变号。包含相互作用强度 b^2=0.03 和 0.06 仅轻微改变转变，分别给出 z≃0.586 和 0.589。因此，对于这里考虑的参数集，相互作用并不产生加速；相反，转变已存在于非相互作用 Kaniadakis 模型中，而相互作用仅对其发生时间产生小的移动。我们推导了自治演化方程、有效暗能量状态方程和减速参数。还检验了绝热平方声速作为有效流体稳定性的诊断，并使用 statefinder 变量来刻画对 ΛCDM 的偏离。最后，我们验证 K→0 极限连续地恢复标准 Einstein 引力粒子视界 HDE，其中非相互作用模型仍为减速。
classification.one_liner: 用 Kaniadakis 熵修正粒子视界全息暗能量，使非相互作用模型也能实现晚期加速，并分析其动力学与稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为宇宙学中的全息暗能量，不涉及用户列出的 AdS/CFT、全息凝聚态、QCD、QNM、探针膜、超流超导等具体重点支线；仅与广义全息/宇宙学有边缘关联。

papers.title: Anomalies at the End of the Universe?
papers.abstract: The spatial distribution of anomalies in extra dimensional theories on a slice of AdS leads to a puzzle where anomalies may not match across different geometries that are dual to various states of the same CFT. We argue that consistency of the anomaly across such geometries necessitates the addition of topological terms or other bulk fermions to the theory that flow any IR localized consistent anomaly into the ``UV" region of these geometries if one wishes to have such a dual interpretation.

classification.title_zh: 宇宙尽头的反常？
classification.abstract_zh: 在 AdS 切片上的额外维理论中，反常的空间分布导致一个困惑：对于同一个 CFT 的不同状态所对偶的不同几何，反常可能不匹配。我们认为，要使反常在这些几何之间保持一致，如果希望有这样的对偶解释，就必须在理论中加入拓扑项或其他体费米子，将任何红外局域的一致反常流到这些几何的“紫外”区域。
classification.one_liner: 讨论 AdS 切片额外维理论中反常在不同对偶几何间的一致性，并提出需引入拓扑项或体费米子来移动红外反常。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与额外维全息对偶的基础问题，涉及反常一致性，但不直接落在用户列出的具体重点支线中。

papers.title: Point particles in general relativity: beyond linear perturbation theory
papers.abstract: Point particles are generically ill defined in fully nonlinear general relativity, although they are naturally well defined in linear perturbation theory. In a previous paper, two of us showed how they can be rigorously defined from matched asymptotic expansions at second order in perturbation theory on a generic background spacetime. Here we show how the resulting field equations can be recast in a more practical, more fully ``skeletonized'' form. We also show that this form of the field equations enables simple derivations of equations of motion. Finally, we show how calculations in second-order perturbation theory can bypass the use of singular ``punctures'' and make rigorous use of off-the-shelf regularization methods such as Hadamard regularization, opening new avenues to second-order self-force calculations in black hole binaries.

classification.title_zh: 广义相对论中的点粒子：超越线性微扰理论
classification.abstract_zh: 在完全非线性的广义相对论中，点粒子通常是定义不良的，尽管它们在线性微扰理论中自然定义良好。在此前的一篇论文中，我们中的两位作者展示了如何在一般背景时空上，通过二阶微扰理论中的匹配渐近展开严格定义点粒子。这里我们展示如何将所得到的场方程重写为一种更实用、更完全“骨架化”的形式。我们还展示，这种形式的场方程能够使运动方程的推导变得简单。最后，我们展示二阶微扰理论中的计算如何绕过奇异“puncture”的使用，并严格利用现成的正则化方法，例如 Hadamard 正则化，从而为黑洞双星中的二阶自作用力计算开辟新途径。
classification.one_liner: 将二阶微扰理论中匹配渐近展开给出的点粒子场方程重写为骨架化形式，并用于简化运动方程推导与二阶自作用力计算。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文直接研究经典广义相对论中的点粒子定义、非线性微扰、运动方程与黑洞双星二阶自作用力计算，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线。

papers.title: Probing the singularity at the holographic screen via $q$-holography
papers.abstract: We study the emergence of $q$-deformed spacetime in a lower-dimensional gravitational system whose asymptotic region geometrizes the global symmetry of a $q$-deformed CFT. More precisely, we consider the 2d sinh dilaton gravity model, whose classical metric solutions exhibit a curvature singularity at the holographic boundary. Our aim is to probe this UV near-boundary regime by injecting a small probe into the bulk, and identifying the geometrical features it observes. At the level of the two-point correlator, we see the emergence of $q$-deformed hyperbolic disk isometries. By formulating DSSYK in terms of the analogous sine dilaton gravity model, we expect this $q$-deformed holographic duality to persist.

classification.title_zh: 通过 q-全息探测全息屏处的奇点
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究低维引力系统中 q-变形时空的出现，该系统的渐近区域几何化了 q-变形 CFT 的全局对称性。更具体地说，我们考虑二维 sinh dilaton 引力模型，其经典度规解在全息边界处表现出曲率奇点。我们的目标是通过向体内注入一个小探针并识别它所观察到的几何特征，来探测这一 UV 近边界区域。在两点关联函数层面，我们看到 q-变形双曲圆盘等距的出现。通过用类似的 sine dilaton 引力模型表述 DSSYK，我们预计这种 q-变形全息对偶将持续存在。
classification.one_liner: 在二维 sinh/sine dilaton 引力中，通过小探针与两点关联函数探测全息边界奇点，并浮现 q-变形双曲圆盘等距与 DSSYK 相关的 q-全息对偶。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于二维 dilaton 引力、DSSYK 与 q-全息对偶方向，与用户列出的重点支线（全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论）无直接对应；仅在广义全息对偶与二维引力方法上相关。

papers.title: Universal relations for two- and three-point functions of the CFT energy-momentum tensor and the Weyl anomaly
papers.abstract: We establish universal relations, valid for a generic conformal field theory in even dimension $d\geqslant6$, between the coefficients $\mathcal{A}$, $\mathcal{B}$, $\mathcal{C}$ of the energy-momentum tensor three-point function and the coefficients of the quadratic and cubic terms in the Weyl tensor in the Weyl anomaly. Alternatively, we can replace the three-point function coefficients with the two-point function coefficient $C_T$ and the two energy flux parameters $t_2$ and $t_4$. Our derivation combines well-known holographic results for $C_T$ with more recent holographic results for $t_2$ and $t_4$, along with a newly obtained Chern--Gauss--Bonnet formula for compact Einstein manifolds. This theorem isolates the Weyl-squared and Weyl-cubed contributions in the relation between the Euler density and the $Q$-curvature, allowing us to identify the relevant quadratic and cubic terms unambiguously. We also provide two genuine CFT derivations for $C_T$ based on the renormalization-group running of the $TT$-correlator with respect to the arbitrary but necessary mass scale $\mu$. We revisit several examples to illustrate and validate the general result. These include free scalars, GJMS operators, and holographic duals of higher-derivative gravities.

classification.title_zh: CFT能量动量张量两点与三点函数和Weyl反常的普适关系
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了对于偶数维 d≥6 的一般共形场论成立的普适关系，将能量动量张量三点函数系数 A、B、C 与 Weyl 反常中 Weyl 张量二次和三次项的系数联系起来。或者，我们可以用两点函数系数 C_T 和两个能量通量参数 t_2 与 t_4 替换三点函数系数。我们的推导把关于 C_T 的已知全息结果、关于 t_2 和 t_4 的较新全息结果，以及新得到的紧致 Einstein 流形的 Chern-Gauss-Bonnet 公式结合起来。该定理分离出 Euler 密度与 Q-曲率关系中的 Weyl 平方和 Weyl 立方贡献，使我们能够无歧义地识别相关的二次和三次项。我们还给出两个真正的 CFT 推导，基于 TT 关联函数相对于任意但必要的质量标度 μ 的重整化群跑动。我们重新考察若干例子来展示和验证一般结果，包括自由标量、GJMS 算子和高阶导数引力对偶。
classification.one_liner: 该文给出偶数维一般 CFT 中能量动量张量多点函数系数与 Weyl 反常系数的普适关系，并用全息结果和 Chern-Gauss-Bonnet 公式加以推导。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究 CFT 能量动量张量关联函数与 Weyl 反常，并使用全息方法，但不涉及用户重点列出的全息超导、p波/多分量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/Floquet 等支线。

papers.title: Quasinormal modes and continuum response of de Sitter black holes via complex scaling method
papers.abstract: We apply the complex scaling method to black-hole perturbations in four-dimensional Schwarzschild--de~Sitter (dS) spacetimes. The method converts the outgoing-wave boundary-value problem into a non-Hermitian spectral problem and enables quasinormal-mode poles and the rotated continuum to be treated in a common framework. We focus in particular on the continuum level density, which characterizes the continuum response beyond isolated quasinormal-mode frequencies. Using Regge--Wheeler-type perturbation equations for scalar, electromagnetic, and gravitational fields, we investigate how a nonzero cosmological constant modifies the pole and continuum sectors. We also discuss a possible extension to string-inspired coupled-channel systems, and illustrate that higher-dimensional dS black holes can be treated within the same framework, at least in tensor- and vector-type sectors. Our results indicate that complex scaling offers a useful spectral framework for analyzing both quasinormal modes and continuum response in black-hole physics.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 黑洞的准正规模与连续谱响应：复标度方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将复标度方法应用于四维 Schwarzschild-de Sitter (dS) 时空中的黑洞微扰。该方法将出射波边值问题转化为非厄米谱问题，使准正规模极点与旋转连续谱能够在统一框架中处理。我们尤其关注连续谱能级密度，它刻画了孤立准正规模频率之外的连续谱响应。使用标量、电磁和引力场的 Regge-Wheeler 型微扰方程，我们研究非零宇宙学常数如何改变极点扇区与连续谱扇区。我们还讨论对弦启发的耦合通道系统的可能推广，并说明高维 dS 黑洞至少可在张量型和矢量型扇区中用同一框架处理。结果表明，复标度提供了一个有用的谱框架，用于分析黑洞物理中的准正规模与连续谱响应。
classification.one_liner: 用复标度方法统一处理四维 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 黑洞的准正规模极点与连续谱响应，并探讨向高维及耦合通道的推广。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 de Sitter 黑洞准正规模与连续谱响应，属于经典引力/广义相对论和 QNM 重点支线；但与 AdS/CFT 全息无直接关系。

papers.title: Membrane instantons and non-perturbative effects in $\mathrm{AdS}_{4}/\mathrm{CFT}_{3}$
papers.abstract: We study Euclidean M2-brane instantons in Freund-Rubin backgrounds $\mathrm{AdS}_{4}\times \mathrm{Y}_7$. For a seven-dimensional weak $G_{2}$ manifold $\mathrm{Y}_7$, we show that the BPS condition for an M2-brane wrapping a three-cycle $\Sigma\subset \mathrm{Y}_7$ is equivalent to the associativity condition with respect to the nearly parallel $G_{2}$-structure. When $\mathrm{Y}_7$ is Sasaki-Einstein, we identify a special class of BPS M2-branes that preserve both real internal Killing spinors and correspond to invariant three-dimensional submanifolds inheriting a Sasakian structure. We analyse the quadratic fluctuations around BPS M2-brane instantons in these backgrounds. For the special class of M2-branes in Sasaki-Einstein manifolds, the fluctuation problem reduces to transversely elliptic complexes, and the one-loop partition function can be expressed in terms of the corresponding equivariant indices. We then apply the index formula for the one-loop partition function to invariant M2-branes in $S^{7}/\mathbb{Z}_{k}$, recovering the known result for the $S^3/\mathbb{Z}_k$ instantons and discussing more general invariant BPS cycles. As a further application, we consider M2-brane instantons with $S^3$-quotient worldvolumes in the $(p,q)$-model geometry.

classification.title_zh: 膜瞬子与 AdS4/CFT3 中的非微扰效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 Freund-Rubin 背景 AdS4×Y7 中的欧几里得 M2-膜瞬子。对于七维弱 G2 流形 Y7，我们证明，包裹三循环 Σ⊂Y7 的 M2-膜的 BPS 条件等价于相对于近平行 G2 结构的结合性条件。当 Y7 为 Sasaki-Einstein 时，我们识别出一类特殊的 BPS M2-膜，它们同时保持实内部 Killing 旋量，并对应于继承 Sasakian 结构的不变三维子流形。我们分析了这些背景中 BPS M2-膜瞬子周围的二次涨落。对于 Sasaki-Einstein 流形中的特殊类 M2-膜，涨落问题约化为横向椭圆复形，单圈配分函数可用相应的等变指标表示。随后，我们将单圈配分函数的指标公式应用于 S^7/Z_k 中的不变 M2-膜，重现了 S^3/Z_k 瞬子的已知结果，并讨论了更一般的不变 BPS 循环。作为进一步应用，我们考虑了 (p,q)-模型几何中具有 S^3-商世界体积的 M2-膜瞬子。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS4×Y7 中研究欧几里得 M2-膜瞬子的 BPS 条件、二次涨落和单圈配分函数，并应用于 Sasaki-Einstein、S^7/Z_k 及 (p,q)-模型几何。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文核心是 AdS4/CFT3 与 M 理论膜瞬子的理论全息计算，属于全息对偶基础；但未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、探针膜、经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: Proto-Area Response Beyond Bulk Entropy
papers.abstract: We study how much of the proto-area response can be inferred from the bulk von Neumann entropy. In the perturbative holographic code setting considered by CCKLP and Witten, we keep the recovery frame fixed and analyze the response averaged over the GUE at second order in the encoding perturbation. Near the maximally mixed bulk spectrum, the response is fixed by the entropy through quadratic order. For $d_1\geq3$, spectral information first enters at cubic order through the third centered moment, so states with the same entropy can have different responses. We determine the resulting response range on small equal-entropy level sets and obtain its sharp leading $D^{3/2}$ dependence, including the coefficient. The corresponding minimax error for prediction from entropy alone is one half of this range. For $d_1=2$, the entropy instead determines the response exactly.

classification.title_zh: 超越体熵的原初面积响应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究从体冯诺依曼熵可以推断出多少原初面积响应。在 CCKLP 和 Witten 所考虑的微扰全息码设定中，我们固定恢复框架，并分析在编码微扰二阶下对 GUE 平均后的响应。在最大混合的体谱附近，响应在二次阶前由熵固定。对于 d1≥3，谱信息首次在三次阶通过第三中心矩进入，因此具有相同熵的态可以有不同的响应。我们确定小等熵层集上由此产生的响应范围，并得到其尖锐的主导 D^{3/2} 依赖，包括系数。仅从熵预测的相应 minimax 误差为该范围的一半。对于 d1=2，熵反而精确决定响应。
classification.one_liner: 在全息码微扰框架下，体熵只能部分决定原初面积响应；d1≥3 时谱信息在三次阶进入，等熵态响应范围呈 D^{3/2} 标度。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于全息量子信息与 AdS/CFT 基础方向，讨论全息码、体熵与原初面积响应，但不涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM 与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或经典引力等具体支线。

papers.title: Gravitational wave memory and geodesic congruence response in generalised Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes
papers.abstract: We investigate gravitational wave memory in generalised Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole spacetimes by studying the response of neighbouring timelike geodesics and geodesic congruences to a localized test gravitational wave pulse. Using proper time as the evolution parameter, we identify pulse-induced displacement and velocity memory after subtracting the background geodesic evolution. We further investigate the response of timelike congruences through the expansion and shear using the Raychaudhuri equations. We find that the memory response depends systematically on the wormhole throat radius, the steepness parameter and the location of the pulse relative to the throat. In particular, a pulse at the throat produces zero net integrated expansion but a finite shear response, while a pulse away from the throat generates an asymmetric congruence response. These results show that wormhole geometry can imprint characteristic signatures on both detector-based and congruence-based memory observables.

classification.title_zh: 广义 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞中的引力波记忆与测地线汇响应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过研究邻近类时测地线和测地线汇对局部测试引力波脉冲的响应，考察广义 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞时空中的引力波记忆。以固有时为演化参数，在扣除背景测地线演化后，识别出脉冲引起的位移记忆和速度记忆。进一步利用 Raychaudhuri 方程，通过膨胀和剪切研究类时汇的响应。发现记忆响应系统性地依赖于虫洞喉半径、陡度参数以及脉冲相对于喉的位置。特别地，位于喉处的脉冲产生零净积分膨胀，但有有限剪切响应；而远离喉的脉冲则产生非对称的汇响应。这些结果表明虫洞几何可在基于探测器和基于汇的记忆观测量上留下特征印记。
classification.one_liner: 研究广义 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞中测试引力波脉冲引起的测地线与汇记忆响应，并显示其对虫洞参数的依赖。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，直接研究虫洞时空中的引力波记忆与测地线汇响应，与用户重点标签中的经典引力方向一致。

papers.title: Quark flavors in hot and dense holographic QCD: setup and comparison to data
papers.abstract: We establish a flavor dependent holographic framework for hot and dense QCD. To this end, we generalize a class of bottom-up holographic models for QCD in the Veneziano limit (V-QCD) by incorporating explicit flavor dependence. Specifically, we develop a $2+1$ flavor model characterized by two massless light quarks and a massive strange quark. Including the non-zero quark mass modifies the tachyon dependence of the model action, which yields a good agreement with the lattice data for thermodynamics in QCD in the low baryon number density and high temperature limit. We compare the model with various hadron resonance gas models at low temperature. We also compute the equation of state (EOS) at high density and low temperatures and find a smooth matching of this EOS with the nuclear matter EOS, suggesting significantly lower latent heat of the nuclear to quark matter transition than in earlier version of the V-QCD model. We observe that the smooth matching with the nuclear theory EOS is only applicable to a subset of potentials; furthermore, constraining the predictions of the model by limiting the potential parameters. We also identify the relevant fixed points of the model, particularly AdS$_2$ and AdS$_5$ fixed points.

classification.title_zh: 热密全息QCD中的夸克味：模型建立及与数据比较
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为热且稠密的QCD建立一个依赖夸克味的全息框架。为此，我们在Veneziano极限下的QCD自下而上全息模型（V-QCD）中引入显式味依赖。具体地，我们构建一个2+1味模型，包含两个无质量轻夸克和一个有质量奇异夸克。引入非零夸克质量会修改模型作用量中的tachyon依赖；该模型在低重子数密度、高温极限下与QCD热力学的格点数据符合良好。我们在低温下将模型与多种强子共振气体模型进行比较。我们还计算了高密度、低温下的状态方程（EOS），发现该EOS与核物质EOS平滑匹配，表明核物质到夸克物质的相变潜热比早期V-QCD模型显著降低。我们观察到与核理论EOS的平滑匹配只适用于一部分势函数；此外，我们通过限制势参数来约束模型预言。我们还识别了模型的相关不动点，特别是AdS2和AdS5不动点。
classification.one_liner: 在V-QCD中引入显式味依赖，构建2+1味热密QCD全息模型，并用格点、强子共振气体和核物质EOS检验其热力学与相变预言。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息QCD/核物理方向，涉及V-QCD味依赖、状态方程和核-夸克物质相变；未直接对应所列重点标签中的超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、探针膜/Floquet、QNM、经典引力等支线。

papers.title: Nonlinear evolution of the ergoregion instability: Turbulence, bursts of radiation, and black hole formation
papers.abstract: Spacetimes with an ergoregion that is not connected to a horizon are linearly unstable. While the linear regime has been studied in a number of settings, little is known about the nonlinear evolution of this ergoregion instability. Here, we investigate this by numerically evolving the unstable growth of a massless vector field in a rapidly spinning boson star in full general relativity. We find that the backreaction of the instability causes the star to become more gravitationally bound, accelerating the growth, and eventually leading to black hole formation. During the nonlinear growth phase, small scale features develop in the unstable mode and emitted radiation as nonlinear gravitational interactions mediate a direct turbulent cascade. The gravitational wave signal exhibits bursts, akin to so-called gravitational wave echoes, with increasing amplitude towards black hole formation.

classification.title_zh: 能层不稳定性的非线性演化：湍流、辐射爆发与黑洞形成
classification.abstract_zh: 具有不与视界相连的能层的时空在线性层面上不稳定。虽然线性区域已在多种情形中得到研究，但人们对这种能层不稳定性的非线性演化知之甚少。在这里，我们通过在完整广义相对论中数值演化快速自旋玻色星中无质量矢量场的不稳定增长来研究这一点。我们发现，不稳定性的反作用使星体变得更加引力束缚，加速了增长，并最终导致黑洞形成。在非线性增长阶段，不稳定模式和发射的辐射中发展出小尺度特征，因为非线性引力相互作用介导了直接的湍流级联。引力波信号表现出类似所谓引力波回波的爆发，其振幅在接近黑洞形成时不断增加。
classification.one_liner: 数值演化表明，快速自旋玻色星的能层不稳定性在非线性阶段加速并导致黑洞形成，同时产生湍流级联和逐渐增强的引力波爆发。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论/数值相对论，核心为非线性演化、引力波爆发与黑洞形成，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”重点标签；不涉及全息对偶。

papers.title: Gravitational Wave-Inspired Scrambling Delay in Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Wormhole Teleportation
papers.abstract: In the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model, traversable wormhole teleportation fidelity probes the many-body scrambling of holographic black holes. We apply a gravitational-wave-inspired periodic Floquet deformation derived from the lowest-dimensional bilinear $\text{SYK}_4$ sector to the boundary, thereby characterizing the channel response via exact numerical time evolution at $\beta J = 2$. Re-optimizing under the drive isolates genuine physical effects from calibration mismatch, yielding four main results: (i) distinct perturbative and non-perturbative amplitude regimes separated near $\varepsilon \sim J$; (ii) a natural low-pass filter response, with maximum fidelity suppression at $\omega \lesssim \beta^{-1}$ and monotonic recovery above the thermal scale; (iii) a scrambling delay, evidenced by a delayed fidelity peak under an inspiral chirp ($\Delta t_{\mathrm{scr}}^{(\mathrm{fid})} = +0.11\, J^{-1}$) and independently confirmed by OTOC measurements to grow monotonically with drive amplitude; and (iv) robust, non-zero fidelity suppression across $N \in \{10, 12, 14, 16\}$ Majorana modes. These findings establish that holographic wormholes degrade gracefully under metric-like boundary deformations, providing direct diagnostic signatures for near-term quantum hardware.

classification.title_zh: 引力波启发的 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 虫洞隐形传态中的加扰延迟
classification.abstract_zh: 在 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型中，可穿越虫洞隐形传态的保真度探测全息黑洞的多体加扰。我们将一种源自最低维双线性 SYK4 扇区的引力波启发的周期性 Floquet 形变施加到边界，从而在 βJ=2 下通过精确数值时间演化刻画通道响应。在驱动下重新优化，将真实物理效应与校准失配分离，得到四个主要结果：(i) 在 ε∼J 附近分离出不同的微扰与非微扰振幅区域；(ii) 自然的低通滤波响应，在 ω≲β^{-1} 处保真度抑制最大，并在热尺度以上单调恢复；(iii) 一个加扰延迟，由旋近啁啾（inspiral chirp）下保真度峰的延迟所证明（Δt_scr^(fid)=+0.11 J^{-1}），并由 OTOC 测量独立确认其随驱动振幅单调增长；(iv) 在 N∈{10,12,14,16} 个 Majorana 模式中稳健的非零保真度抑制。这些发现表明，全息虫洞在类度规边界形变下会优雅地退化，为近期量子硬件提供直接诊断特征。
classification.one_liner: SYK 可穿越虫洞隐形传态在引力波启发的 Floquet 边界驱动下出现低通滤波式保真度抑制与可测量的加扰延迟。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 SYK/AdS2 全息与可穿越虫洞隐形传态，并采用 Floquet 驱动、OTOC 与加扰诊断；与用户重点标签中的 Floquet 驱动部分相关，但属于 SYK 支线而非 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜支线，也不涉及全息超流超导或经典引力。

papers.title: Bounding axion dark energy
papers.abstract: We study cosmological solutions of (pseudo)scalar theories with periodic potentials, in the presence of arbitrary cosmological fluids -- including a cosmological constant of either sign. Independently of the initial misalignment angle and field velocity, we derive an analytic bound that the axion mass parameter and decay constant fulfill as the universe decreases its acceleration rate, finding a natural application in models of thawing quintessence. As a first application, we illustrate the analytic handle our bound provides in bounding axion dark energy, after observational inputs from DESI and various supernovae data sets are taken into account. As a second application, we argue that our analytic bounds in combination with proposed quantum gravity constraints on axions exclude vast regions of parameter space. The combined constraints push the axion masses to be much larger than the Hubble scale, in tension with basic models of axion quintessence.

classification.title_zh: 限制轴子暗能量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有周期势的（赝）标量理论在存在任意宇宙学流体——包括正负宇宙学常数——时的宇宙学解。独立于初始错位角和场速度，我们推导出当宇宙加速度降低时轴子质量参数和衰变常数必须满足的解析界限，并在 thawing quintessence 模型中找到了自然应用。作为第一个应用，在考虑 DESI 和各种超新星数据集的观测输入后，我们展示了该界限为限制轴子暗能量提供的解析手段。作为第二个应用，我们论证，我们的解析界限与针对轴子的量子引力约束相结合，可以排除大片参数空间。联合约束将轴子质量推向远大于哈勃尺度，与基本的轴子 quintessence 模型存在张力。
classification.one_liner: 推导周期势轴子场在宇宙加速率下降时的解析质量-衰变常数界限，并用DESI/超新星数据及量子引力约束限制轴子暗能量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典宇宙学中的轴子暗能量/quintessence研究，涉及经典宇宙学解与观测约束；与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”部分相关，但不涉及全息、黑洞信息、纠缠等全息核心方向。

papers.title: Geometrically Significant Surfaces of Black Holes from a Single Scalar
papers.abstract: Black hole spacetimes contain several geometrically distinguished hypersurfaces, including event and Cauchy horizons, stationary-limit surfaces, and curvature singularities. These structures are usually identified by different geometric or causal criteria. We show that, for the Kerr--Newman black hole, the membrane-paradigm pressure of a stretched horizon admits an analytically continued scalar representative whose fully factorized form has zeros, poles, and singular factors aligned with these standard Kerr--Newman loci. Its zeros occur at the outer and inner horizons, its poles occur at the outer and inner stationary-limit surfaces, its higher-order divergence contains the ring-singularity factor, and its large-$r$ behavior records the asymptotic decay of the scalar. The construction is not proposed as a new invariant characterization of the spacetime, nor as a physical extension of the membrane fluid into the black-hole interior. Rather, it gives a compact membrane-pressure-based diagnostic whose analytic structure reorganizes several familiar surfaces of the Kerr--Newman geometry. We also note a secondary, purely algebraic analogy with generalized multi-component van der Waals-type equations of state.

classification.title_zh: 由单一标量给出的黑洞几何显著曲面
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞时空中包含多个几何上特殊的超曲面，包括事件视界和柯西视界、静止极限面以及曲率奇点。这些结构通常由不同的几何或因果判据识别。我们表明，对于 Kerr–Newman 黑洞，拉伸视界的膜范式压强存在一个解析延拓的标量代表，其完全因子化形式的零点、极点和奇异因子分别与这些标准 Kerr–Newman 位置对齐。其零点出现在外、内视界，极点出现在外、内静止极限面，其高阶发散包含环奇点因子，而大 r 行为记录了标量的渐近衰减。该构造不是作为时空的新不变量刻画，也不是将膜流体物理地延拓到黑洞内部。相反，它给出一个紧凑的、基于膜压强的诊断，其解析结构重新组织了 Kerr–Newman 几何中若干熟悉的曲面。我们还注意到一个次要的、纯代数的与广义多分量 van der Waals 型状态方程的类比。
classification.one_liner: 通过解析延拓拉伸视界的膜范式压强标量，将 Kerr–Newman 黑洞的视界、静止极限面和环奇点等结构统一表现为同一函数的零点、极点和奇异因子。
keywords: van der Waals 状态方程类比
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 Kerr–Newman 黑洞经典几何与膜范式诊断，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但未涉及 AdS/CFT、量子信息或全息相变等主要全息支线。

papers.title: Deriving Feynman's Consistency Condition from His Abandoned Energy--Momentum Approach
papers.abstract: Feynman briefly considered a nonlinear theory of gravity in flat spacetime by imposing energy--momentum conservation on the sum of the energy--momentum tensor of matter and that of the gravitational field. He used the symmetrized canonical energy-momentum tensor as the energy--momentum tensor of the gravitational field.He reported that the resulting construction gave an incorrect value for Mercury's perihelion precession and abandoned this route in favor of a variational argument based on dynamical consistency. We reconsider the abandoned route. The key step is to identify the gravitational energy--momentum tensor not with the conventional Belinfante tensor, which becomes symmetric upon use of the field equations, but with its off--shell Belinfante--Rosenfeld tensor, which contains explicit Euler--Lagrange terms. If we apply the law of conservation of energy and momentum to the sum of this tensor and the matter energy-momentum tensor, we obtain Feynman's consistency condition.Thus Feynman's dynamical-consistency argument and the reconstructed energy--momentum argument, although based on different physical assumptions, yield the same identity. The Euler--Lagrange terms are essential to this result.

classification.title_zh: 从费曼放弃的能量—动量方法推导费曼一致性条件
classification.abstract_zh: 费曼曾短暂考虑过平直时空中的非线性引力理论，通过要求物质能量—动量张量与引力场能量—动量张量之和满足能量—动量守恒来实现。他将对称化的正则能量—动量张量用作引力场的能量—动量张量。他报告说，由此得到的构造给出了水星近日点进动的错误值，并因此放弃了这条路线，转而采用基于动力学一致性的变分论证。我们重新考虑这条被放弃的路线。关键步骤是将引力能量—动量张量不认同为传统的 Belinfante 张量——它在使用场方程后变得对称——而是认同为其离壳 Belinfante-Rosenfeld 张量，其中包含显式的 Euler-Lagrange 项。如果我们把能量和动量守恒定律应用于该张量与物质能量—动量张量之和，就得到费曼的一致性条件。因此，费曼的动力学一致性论证与重构的能量—动量论证，虽然基于不同的物理假设，却给出相同的恒等式。Euler-Lagrange 项对这一结果至关重要。
classification.one_liner: 重新审视费曼放弃的平直时空非线性引力能量—动量方法，并证明其与动力学一致性条件等价。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论重点标签，讨论引力能量—动量守恒、Belinfante-Rosenfeld 张量与费曼一致性条件；不涉及全息或量子引力。

papers.title: $g_{tt}g_{rr} =-1$ black hole thermodynamics in general quasi-topological gravity
papers.abstract: We present a unified framework for the discussion of black hole thermodynamics of $d$-dimensional static black holes with spherical or compact hyperbolic horizon topology satisfying $g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1$ in Schwarzschild gauge. To that end, we consider any such black hole as a solution to an integrable $2$-dimensional effective dilaton theory and thereby as a vacuum solution to a generalised notion of $d$-dimensional quasi-topological gravity. We show that the generating function determining $f(r) = -g_{tt} $ in the integrated equation of motion provides the thermodynamic mass in a generalised first law with entropy computed as the Wald entropy. The framework presented here can be applied to singular and regular black holes with flat or anti-de Sitter asymptotics.

classification.title_zh: 广义准拓扑引力中的 $g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1$ 黑洞热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个统一框架，用于讨论在 Schwarzschild 规范下满足 $g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1$ 的 $d$ 维静态球面或紧致双曲视界拓扑黑洞的热力学。为此，我们将任何此类黑洞视为可积二维有效膨胀子理论的解，并因此视为 $d$ 维准拓扑引力推广概念的真空解。我们证明，在积分运动方程中决定 $f(r)=-g_{tt}$ 的生成函数，在广义第一定律中给出热力学质量，其中熵由 Wald 熵计算。这里提出的框架可应用于具有平坦或反 de Sitter 渐近行为的奇异黑洞和规则黑洞。
classification.one_liner: 提出统一框架，将满足 $g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1$ 的静态黑洞视为二维膨胀子理论与广义准拓扑引力解，并导出广义第一定律与 Wald 熵。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线中的黑洞热力学与高阶曲率引力框架；摘要未涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

papers.title: Multi-band cross-correlation dark sirens: enhancing cosmological parameter and gravitational-wave bias constraints
papers.abstract: Multi-band gravitational-wave (GW) observation, combining space-borne and ground-based detectors across different frequency bands, can improve the sky localization of compact binary sources by two to three orders of magnitude compared to single-band detection. This enhancement is crucial for cross-correlation dark siren analyses, since the sky localization uncertainty directly determines the noise level of the GW angular power spectrum. In this work, we present the first Fisher forecast for cross-correlation dark siren cosmology with multi-band GW observations, cross-correlating GW events from the Einstein Telescope (ET), Cosmic Explorer (CE), and B-DECIGO with the Chinese Space-station Survey Telescope photometric galaxy survey. We compare three network configurations: the multi-band B-DECIGO+ET+2CE (BDET2CE), the ground-only ET+2CE (ET2CE), and B-DECIGO alone. In the $\Lambda$CDM model, BDET2CE achieves $\sigma(h)/h = 0.35\%$, improving by $37\%$ over the ground-only ET2CE ($0.55\%$) and by $86\%$ over B-DECIGO alone ($2.45\%$). Extending to the $w_0w_a$CDM framework, the multi-band advantage on cosmological parameters becomes more moderate, with BDET2CE improving $\sigma(h)/h$ by $\sim 4\%$ over ET2CE and $\sim 22\%$ over B-DECIGO. The most striking advantage of multi-band observation lies in the per-bin measurement of the GW clustering bias $b_{\rm GW}(z)$: at $z \sim 1-2$, BDET2CE constrains the bias to $\sim 3\%$ precision, compared to $\sim 8-60\%$ for ET2CE and $\sim 20-33\%$ for B-DECIGO. These precise, redshift-resolved bias measurements open a new avenue for probing the astrophysics of compact binary mergers, enabling constraints on formation channels such as isolated binary evolution and dynamical assembly that predict distinct clustering signatures.

classification.title_zh: 多波段互相关暗标准汽笛：增强宇宙学参数与引力波偏置约束
classification.abstract_zh: 多波段引力波（GW）观测结合空间与地面探测器、覆盖不同频段，可将致密双星源的天区定位相比单波段探测提高两到三个数量级。这一提升对互相关暗标准汽笛分析至关重要，因为天区定位不确定性直接决定引力波角功率谱的噪声水平。本文首次给出利用多波段GW观测进行互相关暗标准汽笛宇宙学的Fisher预报，将来自爱因斯坦望远镜（ET）、宇宙探索者（CE）和B-DECIGO的GW事件与中国空间站巡天望远镜测光星系巡天进行互相关。我们比较三种网络构型：多波段B-DECIGO+ET+2CE（BDET2CE）、仅地面ET+2CE（ET2CE）以及单独B-DECIGO。在ΛCDM模型中，BDET2CE达到σ(h)/h = 0.35%，比仅地面ET2CE（0.55%）改善37%，比单独B-DECIGO（2.45%）改善86%。扩展到w0waCDM框架时，多波段对宇宙学参数的优势变得较温和，BDET2CE对σ(h)/h的改善比ET2CE约4%，比B-DECIGO约22%。多波段观测最显著的优势在于对GW成团偏置b_GW(z)的分箱测量：在z∼1-2，BDET2CE将偏置约束到约3%精度，而ET2CE为约8-60%，B-DECIGO为约20-33%。这些精确的、按红移分辨的偏置测量为探测致密双星并合天体物理开辟了新途径，使人们能够限制孤立双星演化与动力学组装等形成通道，这些通道预言不同的成团信号。
classification.one_liner: 首次Fisher预报显示，多波段引力波观测可显著提升互相关暗标准汽笛的宇宙学参数与红移分辨的引力波成团偏置约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 不属于全息/AdS-CFT 或量子引力；属于引力波宇宙学与暗标准汽笛观测，涉及引力波（经典引力现象）并与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”部分相关，但并非广义相对论经典场论研究。

papers.title: A Pontryagin class obstruction for purely electric and purely magnetic Weyl curvature tensors
papers.abstract: Do all manifolds that admit Lorentzian metrics also admit such metrics that have a purely electric (PE) or purely magnetic (PM) Weyl curvature tensor? To (partially) answer this question, we show that for all algebraic curvature tensors on a $4k$-dimensional scalar product space that are even or odd under the action of a orientation-reversing isometry, the products of Pontryagin forms that land in the top-degree exterior power of the dual vector space vanish. We use this to derive the vanishing of all products of Pontryagin classes that land in the top-degree de Rham cohomology of a $4k$-dimensional pseudo-Riemannian manifold with a PE or PM Riemann or Weyl curvature tensor. For compact manifolds, this gives nontrivial cohomological obstructions to the existence of such pseudo-Riemannian metrics with globally PE or PM Riemann or Weyl curvature tensors. These obstructions can be linked to the existence of Lorentzian metrics of several Petrov subtypes, which play an important role in classifying exact solutions to the Einstein equations. Moreover, they can be applied to foliations by nondegenerate umbilic hypersurfaces, which may appear as timeslices of spacetimes.

classification.title_zh: 纯电和纯磁 Weyl 曲率张量的 Pontryagin 类障碍
classification.abstract_zh: 是否所有容许洛伦兹度规的流形也都容许具有纯电（PE）或纯磁（PM）Weyl 曲率张量的此类度规？为了（部分）回答这个问题，我们证明：对于 4k 维标量积空间上所有在定向反转等距作用下为偶或为奇的代数曲率张量，落入对偶向量空间最高次外幂的 Pontryagin 形式乘积都为零。我们由此推出：对于具有 PE 或 PM Riemann 或 Weyl 曲率张量的 4k 维伪黎曼流形，所有落入最高次 de Rham 上同调的 Pontryagin 类乘积都为零。对紧流形，这给出了存在整体 PE 或 PM Riemann 或 Weyl 曲率张量的此类伪黎曼度规的非平凡上同调障碍。这些障碍可与若干 Petrov 子型的洛伦兹度规的存在性相联系，而 Petrov 子型在分类 Einstein 方程精确解中起重要作用。此外，它们可应用于由非退化脐超曲面构成的叶状结构，这些超曲面可作为时空的时间切片出现。
classification.one_liner: 该文用 Pontryagin 类给出伪黎曼/Lorentz 流形上整体纯电或纯磁 Riemann/Weyl 曲率张量存在的上同调障碍，并联系 Petrov 分类与 Einstein 方程精确解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接讨论洛伦兹/伪黎曼流形、Weyl 曲率、Petrov 分类与 Einstein 方程精确解，属于经典引力/广义相对论主题。
